\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s, f, g, x.; \forall q \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, g))) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(\operatorname{opr}(m)(u, v)) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(h(u), h(v))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{carr}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda b \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = h(x))\}.\; [s(\operatorname{nth}(1, b)), s(\operatorname{nth}(2, b))])((\lambda b \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, g))) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}.\; [h(\operatorname{nth}(1, b)), h(\operatorname{nth}(2, b))])(q)) \\ \quad \quad =\; q \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s, f, g, x.; \forall q \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = h(x))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(\operatorname{opr}(m)(u, v)) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(h(u), h(v))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{carr}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda b \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, g))) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}.\; [h(\operatorname{nth}(1, b)), h(\operatorname{nth}(2, b))])((\lambda b \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = h(x))\}.\; [s(\operatorname{nth}(1, b)), s(\operatorname{nth}(2, b))])(q)) \\ \quad \quad =\; q \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(\operatorname{opr}(m)(u, v)) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(h(u), h(v))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{carr}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda q \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, g))) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad [h(\operatorname{nth}(1, q)), h(\operatorname{nth}(2, q))]) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathrm{Bij}(\{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, g))) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}, \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = h(x))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(\operatorname{opr}(m)(u, v)) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(h(u), h(v))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{carr}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, f, g))(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f), \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, g))(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(\operatorname{opr}(m)(u, v)) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(h(u), h(v))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, f, g)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f), \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, s, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) = f \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m).\; \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) \in (\operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \to \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m).\; \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f)) \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{finsupp}(a, m), \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}iso}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(\operatorname{opr}(m)(u, v)) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(h(u), h(v))) \wedge \\ \quad h(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = \operatorname{iden}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{monalg}(a, m), \operatorname{monalg}(a, m), (\lambda f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m).\; \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/product2-laws.scm}{theorem-library/product2-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small product2-laws.scm -- the laws of PRODUCT2-MS (structure-library/product2-vocab.scm), the binary product of two metric spaces with the MAX metric.  Everything PROVEN, modulo 0; nothing asserted.  Helper prefix p2-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \simeq (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}slot}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{p2u\_}, \operatorname{p2v\_}] \in ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)) \times (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t))).\; \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{p2u\_}), \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{p2v\_})), \operatorname{dist}(t)(\operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{p2u\_}), \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{p2v\_}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t))(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(1, q)), \operatorname{dist}(t)(\operatorname{nth}(2, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, q)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, c, b, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t))([a, b], [c, d]) \simeq \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{dist}(s)(a, c), \operatorname{dist}(t)(b, d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}fst-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t.; \forall h \in ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), x \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)).\; (h(z) = \operatorname{nth}(1, z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t), s, h, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}snd-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t.; \forall h \in ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), x \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t)).\; (h(z) = \operatorname{nth}(2, z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t), t, h, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, s, t, f, g, x.; \forall h \in (\operatorname{pts}(w) \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, s, f, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, t, g, x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(w).\; (h(z) = [f(z), g(z)]) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, \operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t), h, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}coords}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, s, t, f, g, h, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(w) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{pts}(w) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(w).\; (h(z) = [f(z), g(z)]) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, \operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t), h, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, s, f, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, t, g, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, s, t, f, g, h, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(w) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{pts}(w) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(w) \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(w).\; (h(z) = [f(z), g(z)]) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, \operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t), h, x) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, s, f, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(w, t, g, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, u, a, b, l, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad u \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(n) = [a(n), b(n)]) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t), u, [l, m]) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, a, l) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(t, b, m)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-prod-of-sums.scm}{theorem-library/rake-prod-of-sums.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-prod-of-sums.scm -- the product-of-sums expansion, proven.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{difference-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{difference}(\emptyset, s) = \emptyset)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{insert-\allowbreak{}remove}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall k \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \neg (k \in s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{difference}((s \cup \{k\}), \{k\}) = s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((|x| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in x.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, f, x) \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}insert-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x, k \in \mathbf{Set}, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad |x| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k \in x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in (x \cup \{k\}).\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, f, (x \cup \{k\})) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, f, x), f(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}congruence-\allowbreak{}q}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((|x| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in x.\; (f(z) = g(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, f, x) \simeq \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, g, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cra-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r)) = \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cra-\allowbreak{}op}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r)) = \operatorname{add}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{difference-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in \mathbf{Set}, s.\; (\operatorname{difference}(w, s) \in \operatorname{power}(w))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall w \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(w). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((|w| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in w.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, f, s) \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}summand-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall w \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b.; \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(w). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad |w| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in w.\; (a(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in w.\; (b(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, a, s), \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, b, \operatorname{difference}(w, s))) \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{power-\allowbreak{}insert-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, k \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \neg (k \in x) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda s \in \operatorname{power}(x).\; (s \cup \{k\})) \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{power}(x), \operatorname{power}((x \cup \{k\}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lambda-\allowbreak{}eta-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, m.; \forall t \in m.\; ((\lambda z \in m.\; f(z))(t) \simeq f(t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall w \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad |w| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in w.\; (a(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in w.\; (b(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda v \in w.\; \operatorname{add}(r)(a(v), b(v))), w) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{sv} \in \operatorname{power}(w).\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, a, \mathit{sv}), \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, b, \operatorname{difference}(w, \mathit{sv})))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}expansion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in (x \to \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (|x| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda k \in x.\; \operatorname{add}(r)(a(k), b(k))), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda s \in \operatorname{power}(x).\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, a, s), \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, b, \operatorname{difference}(x, s)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-smith-leaves.scm}{theorem-library/rake-smith-leaves.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-smith-leaves.scm -- finsum-interval-shift, PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(g, f, \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{opr}(g)(f(1), \operatorname{finsum}(g, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; f((z + 1))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-monalg-comm.scm}{theorem-library/rake-monalg-comm.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/rake-monalg-comm.scm -- rake batch 5b, assignment 5b-A.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda q \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{nth}(2, q), \operatorname{nth}(1, q)]) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\} \to \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, g) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, f)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, f, g, x.; \forall u \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda q \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, g) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, f)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}.\; [\operatorname{nth}(2, q), \operatorname{nth}(1, q)])((\lambda q \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}.\; [\operatorname{nth}(2, q), \operatorname{nth}(1, q)])(u)) \\ \quad \quad =\; u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda q \in \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{nth}(2, q), \operatorname{nth}(1, q)]) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathrm{Bij}(\{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, f) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}, \{p \in (\operatorname{supp}(a, m, g) \times \operatorname{supp}(a, m, f)) : (\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) = x)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}comm-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{carr}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, f, g)(x) = \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, g, f)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, f, g) = \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, g, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{monalg}(a, m)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z6-mpoly.scm}{theorem-library/la-z6-mpoly.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z6-mpoly.scm -- R[x\_1, ..., x\_n] and linear algebra Proposition 3.15 (LA-Z6, 2026-10-25).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{multi-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)) \simeq (s \to \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multi-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{miu\_}, \operatorname{miv\_}] \in ((s \to \mathbb{N}) \times (s \to \mathbb{N})).\; \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, \operatorname{miu\_}, \operatorname{miv\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multi-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{mi\text{-}zero}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, u, v.; \forall j \in s.\; (\operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, u, v)(j) \simeq (u(j) + v(j)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall j \in s.\; (\operatorname{mi\text{-}zero}(s)(j) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}reindex-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, a, b.; \forall j \in s.\; (\operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, b)(j) \simeq b(a(j)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, v. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((u \in (s \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge (v \in (s \to \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, u, v) \in (s \to \mathbb{N}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{mi\text{-}zero}(s) \in (s \to \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}reindex-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (s \to s)) \wedge (b \in (s \to \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, b) \in (s \to \mathbb{N}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, v, w. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((u \in (s \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge ((v \in (s \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge (w \in (s \to \mathbb{N}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, u, v), w) = \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, u, \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, v. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((u \in (s \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge (v \in (s \to \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, u, v) = \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, v, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (u \in (s \to \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, u, \operatorname{mi\text{-}zero}(s)) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (u \in (s \to \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, \operatorname{mi\text{-}zero}(s), u) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multi-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}comm-\allowbreak{}monoid}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in \mathbf{Set}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(\operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}reindex-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, v. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (s \to s)) \wedge ((u \in (s \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge (v \in (s \to \mathbb{N}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, u, v)) = \operatorname{mi\text{-}add}(s, \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, u), \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}reindex-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (a \in (s \to s))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, \operatorname{mi\text{-}zero}(s)) = \operatorname{mi\text{-}zero}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mi-\allowbreak{}reindex-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, t, b. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (s \to s)) \wedge ((t \in (s \to s)) \wedge (\forall q \in s.\; (a(t(q)) = q) \wedge (b \in (s \to \mathbb{N})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, t, \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, b)) = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multi-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}reindex-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}iso}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (a \in \mathrm{Bij}(s, s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{monalg}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)), \operatorname{monalg}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s), (\lambda b \in (s \to \mathbb{N}).\; \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, b)), f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mpoly-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r, n.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{mpoly}(r, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mpoly-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}commutative-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{mpoly}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{var-\allowbreak{}permute-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}iso}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (s \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{mpoly}(r, n), \operatorname{mpoly}(r, n), (\lambda p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{mpoly}(r, n)).\; \operatorname{var\text{-}permute}(r, n, s, p))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/coord-block-estimate-proof.scm}{theorem-library/coord-block-estimate-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/coord-block-estimate-proof.scm ==================================================================== coord-block-estimate -- PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{coord-\allowbreak{}block-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, b, p, a, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}along}(s, g, b, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((c \leq j) \Rightarrow (a(j) \in b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(g, a), p) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/module-zero-act.scm}{theorem-library/module-zero-act.scm}
\noindent{\small module-zero-act.scm -- 0 . x = 0\_V : the ring zero annihilates every vector.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{module-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(s)(\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(s)), x) = \operatorname{vzero}(s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/module-laws.scm}{theorem-library/module-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/module-laws.scm -- the generic laws of a MODULE: the vector group (associativity, commutativity, zero, inverse, the differences x - y = x + (-y)) and the scalar action on negatives and differences.  Prefix mlaw-.  Library: linear-algebra. (MODLAWS, 2026-10-24, the user's order: one early home for the ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{hbs-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y), z) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hbs-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hbs-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}lr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vzero}(m), x) = x) \wedge (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) = x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hbs-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hbs-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vzero}(m), x) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hbs-\allowbreak{}interchange}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall a, b, c, d \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(c, d)) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, c), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hbs-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, s.; \forall x \in s.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s)) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}mvag-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d)) = \operatorname{vneg}(d)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)) = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vneg}(m)(x), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}anti}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(z))) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)) = \operatorname{vzero}(m))) \Rightarrow (x = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y, r \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, r), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, r))) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y, u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(u, v))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(u)), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vzero}(m))) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m))) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m))) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r), x) = \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m))) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m))) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m))) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(s)), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(s, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, s, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m))) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m))) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(s, y))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(s)), y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/nn-least-element.scm}{theorem-library/nn-least-element.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/nn-least-element.scm =================================================================== The well-ordering of NN, PROVEN from the well-ordering of ORD.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}least-\allowbreak{}element}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad ((t \subseteq \mathbb{N}) \wedge \exists n.\; (n \in t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in t.\; \forall k \in t.\; (m \leq k) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/pair-self-cartesian3.scm}{theorem-library/pair-self-cartesian3.scm}
\noindent{\small pair-self-cartesian3.scm -- three generic set lemmas: a set is the one member of its own singleton PAIR(a, a) (pair-self-member, pair-self-eq), and the ternary product of three sets is a set (cartesian3-set).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pair-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (a \in \{a\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pair-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, x.\; (((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (x \in \{a\})) \Rightarrow (x = a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cartesian3-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (w \in \mathbf{Set}))) \Rightarrow ((u \times v) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/th3-sort.scm}{theorem-library/th3-sort.scm}
\noindent{\small th3-sort.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-SORT), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/sort/th3-sort.scm. Library: core.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}max}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \exists w.\; (w \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s.\; \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \leq f(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}maximizer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f \in \mathbf{Set}, q.; \forall w \in q. \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (|\{y \in p : (f(x) \leq f(y))\}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in q.\; (z \in p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in q.\; \forall z \in q.\; (f(z) \leq f(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\forall x \in p.\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \forall x \in p.\; (|\{y \in p : (f(x) \leq f(y))\}| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \{u \in \operatorname{power}(p) : (|u| \in \mathbb{N})\}). \\ \quad \quad \quad t(0) = \emptyset \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in p.\; (z \in t(k)) \wedge (t((k + 1)) = t(k)) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{srx} \in p. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{srx} \in t(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in p.\; (\neg (z \in t(k)) \Rightarrow (f(z) \leq f(\mathit{srx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad t((k + 1)) = (t(k) \cup \{\mathit{srx}\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}picks}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f \in \mathbf{Set}, t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \{u \in \operatorname{power}(p) : (|u| \in \mathbb{N})\}). \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (|\{y \in p : (f(x) \leq f(y))\}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (|p| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in p.\; (z \in t(k)) \wedge (t((k + 1)) = t(k)) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{srx} \in p. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{srx} \in t(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in p.\; (\neg (z \in t(k)) \Rightarrow (f(z) \leq f(\mathit{srx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad t((k + 1)) = (t(k) \cup \{\mathit{srx}\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in (\mathbb{N} \to p). \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad h(k) \in p \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (h(k) \in t(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in p.\; (\neg (z \in t(k)) \Rightarrow (f(z) \leq f(h(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad t((k + 1)) = (t(k) \cup \{h(k)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}picks-\allowbreak{}sorted}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f \in \mathbf{Set}, t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \{u \in \operatorname{power}(p) : (|u| \in \mathbb{N})\}), h \in (\mathbb{N} \to p). \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (|\{y \in p : (f(x) \leq f(y))\}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad t(0) = \emptyset \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad h(k) \in p \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (h(k) \in t(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in p.\; (\neg (z \in t(k)) \Rightarrow (f(z) \leq f(h(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad t((k + 1)) = (t(k) \cup \{h(k)\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathbb{N}, p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(h((n + 1))) \leq f(h(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq n) \Rightarrow (f(h(n)) \leq f(h(m)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c \leq f(h(n))) \Rightarrow \neg (|\{y \in p : (c \leq f(y))\}| \in \mathbb{N}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}sort-\allowbreak{}infinite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (0 < f(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall d.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow (|\{y \in p : (d \leq f(y))\}| \in \mathbb{N})) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (|p| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathbb{N}, p). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(h((n + 1))) \leq f(h(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq n) \Rightarrow (f(h(n)) < d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}sort-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|p| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall x \in p.\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathrm{OS}(|p|), p). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((n + 1) < |p|) \Rightarrow (f(h((n + 1))) \leq f(h(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{srt-\allowbreak{}superlevel-\allowbreak{}sort}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f \in (s \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall d.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow (|\{x \in s : (d \leq f(x))\}| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{x \in s : (0 < f(x))\}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathrm{OS}(|\{x \in s : (0 < f(x))\}|), \{x \in s : (0 < f(x))\}). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((n + 1) < |\{x \in s : (0 < f(x))\}|) \Rightarrow (f(h((n + 1))) \leq f(h(n))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \neg (|\{x \in s : (0 < f(x))\}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathbb{N}, \{x \in s : (0 < f(x))\}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(h((n + 1))) \leq f(h(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq n) \Rightarrow (f(h(n)) < d)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/meta-syntax-laws.scm}{theorem-library/meta-syntax-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small meta-syntax-laws.scm -- THE SYNTAX OF THE KERNEL AS A VNB OBJECT: the laws of the locally nameless expressions (structure-library/meta-syntax.scm). (docs/meta-k2-admissibility-2026-10-08.md, section 6, phase 1: the cost probe.) Agent META-1, 2026-10-08.  Template: theorem-library/strand-messages-laws.scm, whose local}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{efvar-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n.\; (\operatorname{efvar}(n) \simeq [0, n])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebvar-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{ebvar}(k) \simeq [1, k])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{econst-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{econst}(c) \simeq [2, c])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eapp-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h, l.\; (\operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \simeq [3, h, l])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebind-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h, c, a, b.\; (\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \simeq [4, h, c, a, b])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eapp-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h, l, a, b.\; ((\operatorname{eapp}(h, l) = \operatorname{eapp}(a, b)) \Rightarrow ((h = a) \wedge (l = b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebind-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b, d, f, g, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) = \operatorname{ebind}(d, f, g, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (h = d) \wedge ((c = f) \wedge ((a = g) \wedge (b = k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}fvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{efvar}(n) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}bvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ebvar}(k) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{econst}(c) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}keep}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, m.\; (((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n))) \Rightarrow (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}((n + 1))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}app}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, h, l. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}((n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}bind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n))) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}((n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(0). \\ \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m = \operatorname{efvar}(c)) \vee \\ \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m = \operatorname{ebvar}(c)) \vee \\ \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m = \operatorname{econst}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, m. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}((n + 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathbb{N}, l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n)).\; (m = \operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists h, c \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n)), b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n). \\ \quad \quad \quad m = \operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, j, m. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}((j + d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, m.\; (((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n))) \Rightarrow (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cartesian5-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}. \\ \quad ((a_{1} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{2} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{3} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{4} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (a_{5} \in \mathbf{Set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a_{1} \times a_{2}) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n) \in \mathbf{Set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}some-\allowbreak{}stage}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}).\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{efvar-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{efvar}(n) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebvar-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ebvar}(k) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{econst-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{econst}(c) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eapp-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h, l.\; (((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebind-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}. \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{efvar}(n) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ebvar}(k) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{econst}(c) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall h, l. \\ \quad \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(i, l) \in s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall h, b, a, \mathit{mxjb}. \\ \quad \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{mxjb} \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(a))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(i, a) \in s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{mxjb} \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ebind}(h, b, a, \mathit{mxjb}) \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(e) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(e)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(e) \leq j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}fvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(\operatorname{efvar}(n)) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}bvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(\operatorname{ebvar}(n)) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(\operatorname{econst}(n)) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}app}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) = (k + 1)) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k))) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}bind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}rank}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b)) = (k + 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{makeset-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, l, w.\; (((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(s)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l))) \Rightarrow (w \in s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, e. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fv\text{-}stage}((k + 1))(e) \simeq \operatorname{fv\text{-}stage}(k)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}coh}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fv\text{-}stage}((j + d))(e) \simeq \operatorname{fv\text{-}stage}(j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}fv-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(e) \simeq \operatorname{fv\text{-}stage}(j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}efvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{efvar}(n)) \simeq \{n\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}ebvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{ebvar}(k)) \simeq \emptyset)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}econst}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{econst}(c)) \simeq \emptyset)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}eapp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \simeq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l), \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}ebind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b)) \simeq (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(a), \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(w)) \cup \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bu-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, m. \\ \quad ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall v_{5} \in s.\; ((m(v_{5}) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((m(v_{5}) \subseteq \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|m(v_{5})| \in \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, s, m(w)) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, s, m(w)) \subseteq \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, s, m(w))| \in \mathbb{N} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(e) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(e) \subseteq \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(e)| \in \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mapl-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, l. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{length}(l) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow (g(\operatorname{nth}(i, l)) \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mapl}(g, l) \in \operatorname{tuples}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{mapl}(g, l)) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(i, \operatorname{mapl}(g, l)) = g(\operatorname{nth}(i, l))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maplk-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, l, x. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{length}(l) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow (g(\operatorname{nth}(i, l), x) \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{maplk}(g, l, x) \in \operatorname{tuples}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{maplk}(g, l, x)) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(i, \operatorname{maplk}(g, l, x)) = g(\operatorname{nth}(i, l), x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{subst\text{-}stage}(m, u, n) \in (\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n) \to \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, k, e. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{subst\text{-}stage}(m, u, (k + 1))(e) \simeq \operatorname{subst\text{-}stage}(m, u, k)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}coh}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, m, u, j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{subst\text{-}stage}(m, u, (j + d))(e) \simeq \operatorname{subst\text{-}stage}(m, u, j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}subst-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(e, m, u) \simeq \operatorname{subst\text{-}stage}(m, u, j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.; \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(e, m, u) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}efvar-\allowbreak{}hit}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{efvar}(m), m, u) \simeq u)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}efvar-\allowbreak{}miss}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, n. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (n = m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{efvar}(n), m, u) \simeq \operatorname{efvar}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}ebvar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, k. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{ebvar}(k), m, u) \simeq \operatorname{ebvar}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}econst}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, c. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{econst}(c), m, u) \simeq \operatorname{econst}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}eapp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, h, l. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l), m, u) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(h, \operatorname{mapl}(\operatorname{subst\text{-}fun}(m, u), l))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}ebind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b), m, u) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(h, c, \operatorname{mapl}(\operatorname{subst\text{-}fun}(m, u), a), \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(b, m, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}fresh}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}. \\ \quad \neg (m \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(e)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(e, m, u) = e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}fun-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, u.\; (\operatorname{subst\text{-}fun}(m, u) \simeq (\lambda w \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(w, m, u)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}subst}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, x \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(e, m, u)). \\ \quad ((x \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(e)) \wedge \neg (x = m)) \vee (x \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{open\text{-}stage}(u, n) \in ((\operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n) \times \mathbb{N}) \to \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, k, e, x. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k)) \wedge (x \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{open\text{-}stage}(u, (k + 1))(e, x) \simeq \operatorname{open\text{-}stage}(u, k)(e, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}coh}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, u, j, e, x. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j)) \wedge (x \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{open\text{-}stage}(u, (j + d))(e, x) \simeq \operatorname{open\text{-}stage}(u, j)(e, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, j, e, x. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j)) \wedge (x \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, x, u) \simeq \operatorname{open\text{-}stage}(u, j)(e, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, x \in \mathbb{N}, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, x, u) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}ebvar-\allowbreak{}hit}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, x.\; (((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (x \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{ebvar}(x), x, u) \simeq u))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}ebvar-\allowbreak{}miss}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, x, j. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (j = x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{ebvar}(j), x, u) \simeq \operatorname{ebvar}(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}efvar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, x, n. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{efvar}(n), x, u) \simeq \operatorname{efvar}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}econst}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, x, c. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{econst}(c), x, u) \simeq \operatorname{econst}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}eapp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, x, h, l. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l), x, u) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(h, \operatorname{maplk}(\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u), l, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}ebind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, x, h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b), x, u) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(h, c, \operatorname{maplk}(\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u), a, x), \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(b, (x + c), u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, e. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{lcd\text{-}stage}((k + 1))(e) \simeq \operatorname{lcd\text{-}stage}(k)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}coh}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{lcd\text{-}stage}((j + d))(e) \simeq \operatorname{lcd\text{-}stage}(j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}lcd-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(e) \simeq \operatorname{lcd\text{-}stage}(j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}efvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(\operatorname{efvar}(n)) \simeq \mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}econst}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(\operatorname{econst}(c)) \simeq \mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}ebvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(\operatorname{ebvar}(k)) \simeq \{d \in \mathbb{N} : (k < d)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}eapp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \simeq \{d \in \mathbb{N} : \forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (d \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(w))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}ebind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b)) \simeq \{d \in \mathbb{N} : (\forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(a).\; (d \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(w)) \wedge ((d + c) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(b)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, x, d. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((d \leq x) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(e))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, x, u) = e \end{array}}}
