\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}lc}(e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, x, u) = e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}commute}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u, v.; \forall e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \operatorname{expr\text{-}lc}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, x, u), n, v) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(e, n, v), x, \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(u, n, v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/meta-core-laws.scm}{theorem-library/meta-core-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small meta-core-laws.scm -- THE CORE OF K2: the laws of well-formedness, sequents, DERIVABLE, and the admissibility of eight kernel rules (structure-library/meta-core.scm): detach, contraposition, union-intro (section H, phase 2; their proofs rewritten as dk-derive! trees by META-KIT), and union-elim, intersection-intro, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}not}(p) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(2, [p]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}and}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(3, [p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(4, [p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}imp-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}imp}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(5, [p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(6, [p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(7, [p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}eq}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(8, [p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}qeq-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(9, [p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}union}(l) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(11, l))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, a.\; (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, a) \simeq (g \cup \{a\}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}fv-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g) \simeq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, g, \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(w)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{derivable}(t) \simeq \{q \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set} : \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{seq\text{-}set}).\; (\operatorname{core\text{-}closed}(t, s) \Rightarrow (q \in s))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, e. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{wks\text{-}stage}((k + 1))(e) \simeq \operatorname{wks\text{-}stage}(k)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}coh}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{wks\text{-}stage}((j + d))(e) \simeq \operatorname{wks\text{-}stage}(j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{expr-\allowbreak{}wks-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, e. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(j))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(e) \simeq \operatorname{wks\text{-}stage}(j)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}efvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{efvar}(n)) \simeq \{1\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}ebvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{ebvar}(n)) \simeq \{1\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}econst}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{econst}(n)) \simeq \{1\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}eapp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \simeq \{k \in \mathbb{N} : ((k = \operatorname{hd\text{-}res}(h)) \wedge (\operatorname{app\text{-}ar\text{-}ok}(h, \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (\operatorname{hd\text{-}argk}(h) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(w))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}ebind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b)) \simeq \{k \in \mathbb{N} : ((k = \operatorname{hd\text{-}bres}(h)) \wedge (\operatorname{bind\text{-}sig}(h, c, \operatorname{length}(a)) \wedge (\forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(a).\; (1 \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(w)) \wedge (\operatorname{hd\text{-}body}(h) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(b)))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eapp-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, h, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n)) \Rightarrow ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eapp-\allowbreak{}expr-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h, l.\; ((\operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \Rightarrow ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms2-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (b \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow ((a \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}([a, b])) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}([a, b]))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms1-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (a \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}([a]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms2-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.; \forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}([a, b]).\; ((w = a) \vee (w = b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms1-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}([a]).\; (w = a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall e.\; ((e \in \mathit{clf}) \Leftrightarrow ((e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (\operatorname{wf\text{-}fml}(e) \wedge \operatorname{expr\text{-}lc}(e))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall e.\; ((e \in \mathit{clt}) \Leftrightarrow ((e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (\operatorname{wf\text{-}term}(e) \wedge \operatorname{expr\text{-}lc}(e))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}eapp-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l, k. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad k \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((k = \operatorname{hd\text{-}res}(h)) \wedge (\operatorname{app\text{-}ar\text{-}ok}(h, \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (\operatorname{hd\text{-}argk}(h) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(w)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}eapp-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}lc}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \Leftrightarrow \forall w \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; \operatorname{expr\text{-}lc}(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}conn2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((3 \leq h) \wedge ((h \leq 6) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a, b]) \in \mathit{clf}) \Leftrightarrow ((a \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (b \in \mathit{clf})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}rel2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((7 \leq h) \wedge ((h \leq 9) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a, b]) \in \mathit{clf}) \Leftrightarrow ((a \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (b \in \mathit{clt})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}not1}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; ((\operatorname{eapp}(2, [a]) \in \mathit{clf}) \Leftrightarrow (a \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{eapp}(11, l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Leftrightarrow \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}falsity0}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{eapp}(1, []) \in \mathit{clf}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}truth0}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{eapp}(0, []) \in \mathit{clf}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}imp-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}imp}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}) \Rightarrow ((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}imp-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}imp}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p \in \mathit{clf}.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}not}(p) \in \mathit{clf})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, y) \in \mathit{clf}) \Rightarrow ((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (y \in \mathit{clt})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (y \in \mathit{clt})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, y) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{enc\text{-}union}(l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}falsity}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{enc\text{-}falsity} \in \mathit{clf}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}and}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}and}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}) \Rightarrow ((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}) \Rightarrow ((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(p, q) \in \mathit{clf}) \Rightarrow ((p \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (q \in \mathit{clf})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}not}(p) \in \mathit{clf}) \Rightarrow (p \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}truth}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{enc\text{-}truth} \in \mathit{clf}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, f.\; (([g, f] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \Leftrightarrow ((g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}) \wedge (f \in \mathit{clf})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; ((g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}) \Leftrightarrow ((g \in \operatorname{power}(\mathit{clf})) \wedge (|g| \in \mathbb{N})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, a.\; (((g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}) \wedge (a \in g)) \Rightarrow (a \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}has}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (a \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}keeps}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (b \in g)) \Rightarrow (b \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}ctx}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, a.\; (((g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}) \wedge (a \in \mathit{clf})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, a) \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (g \subseteq \operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}cons}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, g.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (((d \subseteq g) \wedge (a \in g)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(d, a) \subseteq g))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}snoc}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, g.; \forall b \in \mathbf{Set}.\; ((d \subseteq g) \Rightarrow (d \subseteq \operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.; \forall s \in \operatorname{derivable}(t).\; (s \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, \mathit{mczs}, s. \\ \quad ((\mathit{mczs} \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{seq\text{-}set})) \wedge (\operatorname{core\text{-}closed}(t, \mathit{mczs}) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad s \in \mathit{mczs} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{core-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, a, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{core\text{-}closed}(t, s) \wedge (\operatorname{core\text{-}rule}(t, a, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(a, s) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, \mathit{mczs}.\; (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \mathit{mczs}) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}all}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, \mathit{mczs}.; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \mathit{mczs}) \wedge ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(s)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(i, s) \in \mathit{mczs}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{core\text{-}rule}(t, s, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}0}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}([], s)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, s.\; ((a \in s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}([a], s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, s.\; (((a \in s) \wedge (b \in s)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}([a, b], s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, s.\; ((([a] = [a]) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}([a], s)) \Rightarrow (a \in s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cr\text{-}and\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cr\text{-}and\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}intro-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cr\text{-}or\text{-}intro\text{-}left}(t, s, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}intro-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cr\text{-}or\text{-}intro\text{-}right}(t, s, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cr\text{-}or\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cr\text{-}implies\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge (\operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}cut-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, f, a. \\ \quad (([g, f] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \wedge (([g, a] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge ([\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, a), f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}weakening-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, f, d. \\ \quad (([g, f] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \wedge ((d \subseteq g) \wedge ([d, f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}intro-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a. \\ \quad (([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}not}(a)] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \wedge ([\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, a), \operatorname{enc\text{-}falsity}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}not}(a)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}elim-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, f, a. \\ \quad (([g, f] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \wedge ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}not}(a) \in g) \wedge (a \in g))) \Rightarrow ([g, f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}intro-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad (([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \wedge ([g, a] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}intro-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad (([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \wedge ([g, b] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}elim-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, f, a, b. \\ \quad [g, f] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(a, b) \in g \wedge \\ \quad [\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}imp}(a, b)), \operatorname{enc\text{-}imp}(b, a)), f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{derivable-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, x, l. \\ \quad ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}union}(l)), \operatorname{enc\text{-}orl}(x, l, \operatorname{length}(l)))] \in \operatorname{seq\text{-}set}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}union}(l)), \operatorname{enc\text{-}orl}(x, l, \operatorname{length}(l)))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}detach}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}detach}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orl-\allowbreak{}clf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, l. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (\forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (n \leq \operatorname{length}(l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}orl}(x, l, n) \in \mathit{clf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orl-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, x, l, k. \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{nth}(k, l))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq k \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}orl}(x, l, n)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}union\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\mathit{clf} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{seq\text{-}set} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}fv-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((\operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g) \subseteq \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|\operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g)| \in \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fresh-\allowbreak{}name-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, f. \\ \quad ((g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (n \in (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g) \cup \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}app2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a, b])) = (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(a) \cup \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}app1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, a. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a])) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}app0}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [])) = \emptyset)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}bind0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, a, b. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, a, [], b)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}eapp-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l, a. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(a) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{nth}(i, a)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{nth}(i, l))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, a)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}ebind-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, d, b, f. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(d) = \operatorname{length}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(a))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{nth}(i, d)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{nth}(i, a))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(f) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, d, f)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}subst}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(u) = \{1\}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(e, m, u)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(u) = \{1\}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, x, u)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}inter}(l) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(12, l))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}tuples-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}tuples}(p) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(14, [p]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}list}(l) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(17, l))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{eapp}(12, l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Leftrightarrow \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{eapp}(17, l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Leftrightarrow \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}tuples1}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; ((\operatorname{eapp}(14, [a]) \in \mathit{clt}) \Leftrightarrow (a \in \mathit{clt}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{enc\text{-}inter}(l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{enc\text{-}list}(l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}cart-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}cart}(l) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(13, l))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}cart}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{eapp}(13, l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Leftrightarrow \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}cart-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{enc\text{-}cart}(l) \in \mathit{clt}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}tuples-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}tuples}(p) \in \mathit{clt}) \Rightarrow (p \in \mathit{clt}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, b.\; (\operatorname{difference}(g, b) \subseteq g)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}andl-\allowbreak{}clf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, l. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (\forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (n \leq \operatorname{length}(l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}andl}(x, l, n) \in \mathit{clf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}ande-\allowbreak{}clf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, l.; \forall a \in \mathit{clt}. \\ \quad ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (\forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (n \leq \operatorname{length}(l)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}ande}(l, a, n) \in \mathit{clf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}andl-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, x, l. \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq k) \wedge (k \leq n)) \Rightarrow ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{nth}(k, l))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}andl}(x, l, n)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}ande-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, l, a. \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq k) \wedge (k \leq n)) \Rightarrow ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nth}(k, l), a)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}ande}(l, a, n)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}andl-\allowbreak{}elim-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, x, l, k. \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}andl}(x, l, n)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq k \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{nth}(k, l))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}ande-\allowbreak{}elim-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, l, a, k. \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}ande}(l, a, n)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq k \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nth}(k, l), a)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orl-\allowbreak{}elim-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, f, x, l. \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq k) \wedge (k \leq n)) \Rightarrow ([\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{nth}(k, l))), f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}orl}(x, l, n)), f] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}union\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}intersection-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}intersection\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}intersection-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}intersection\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}tuples-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}tuples\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}tuples-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}tuples\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cartesian4-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}. \\ \quad ((a_{1} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{2} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{3} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (a_{4} \in \mathbf{Set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a_{1} \times a_{2}) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rw-\allowbreak{}univ-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{rw\text{-}univ} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{eqv}(t) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ} : \operatorname{eqv\text{-}ok}(t, x)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rewr-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rewr}(t, k) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ} : \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{rw\text{-}univ}).\; (\operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(t, k, s) \Rightarrow (x \in s))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{eqv}(t) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{rw\text{-}univ}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rewr-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{rw\text{-}univ}), x \in \operatorname{rewr}(t, k). \\ \quad \operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(t, k, s) \Rightarrow (x \in s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad ([2, g, a, b] \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge ((b \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad ([1, g, a, b] \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ((b \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge ((b \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [2, g, a, b] \in \operatorname{eqv}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ((b \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [1, g, a, b] \in \operatorname{eqv}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rw-\allowbreak{}univ-\allowbreak{}ctx}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, g, a, b.\; (([k, g, a, b] \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ}) \Rightarrow (g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad (([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge ([g, a] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, b] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad (([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge ([g, b] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, a] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, t, x. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{rw\text{-}top}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ}))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}not}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}not}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}and\text{-}l}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}and\text{-}r}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}or\text{-}l}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}or\text{-}r}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}imp-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}imp\text{-}l}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}imp-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}imp\text{-}r}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}iff\text{-}l}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}iff\text{-}r}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}app2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, h, a, b. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a, b]), m, u) = \operatorname{eapp}(h, [\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(a, m, u), \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(b, m, u)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}hole-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, s, c, h. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(c)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [\operatorname{efvar}(z), c]), z, s) = \operatorname{eapp}(h, [s, c]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}hole-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, s, c, h. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(c)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [c, \operatorname{efvar}(z)]), z, s) = \operatorname{eapp}(h, [c, s]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}atom-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, g, h, s, t, c. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, [s, c]) \in \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(s, t)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{eapp}(h, [t, c])] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{eapp}(h, [s, c])] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}atom-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, g, h, s, t, c. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, [c, s]) \in \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(s, t)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{eapp}(h, [c, t])] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{eapp}(h, [c, s])] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}qeq-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, g, s, t. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ((t \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(s, t)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(t, s)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}rel\text{-}l}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}rel\text{-}r}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}all}(p) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(20, 1, [], p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}ex-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}ex}(p) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(21, 1, [], p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clt-\allowbreak{}efvar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{efvar}(n) \in \mathit{clt})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (y \in \mathit{clt})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}eq}(x, y) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebind-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, h, c, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n)) \Rightarrow (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebind-\allowbreak{}body-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h, c, a, b.\; ((\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \Rightarrow (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mr-\allowbreak{}fresh}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, f. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((s \subseteq \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (n \in s) \wedge \neg (n \in (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g) \cup \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(f)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}all}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}all}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}ex}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}ex}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}qeq-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (y \in \mathit{clt})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(x, y) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}qeq-\allowbreak{}join}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, x, y, c. \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad y \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(x, c)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(y, c)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(x, y)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}if-\allowbreak{}cond}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}if\text{-}cond}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}if-\allowbreak{}then}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}if\text{-}then}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}if-\allowbreak{}else}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}if\text{-}else}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j.\; ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(j, 1, \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j.\; ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(j, 2, \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}3}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j.\; ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(j, 3, \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j, x.\; (((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 1))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j, x.\; (((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 2))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}3}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j, x.\; (((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 3))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}goal-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, g, o, o_{2}. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (([2, g, o, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 1)) \wedge ([g, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, o] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}goal-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, g, o, o_{2}. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (([2, g, o, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 2)) \wedge ([g, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, o] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}goal-\allowbreak{}3}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, g, o, o_{2}. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (([2, g, o, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 3)) \wedge ([g, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, o] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, l, k, z. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq k \wedge \\ \quad k \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{nth}(k, l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hole-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, l, i. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mrlz} \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{length}(\mathit{mrlz}) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(i, \mathit{mrlz}) = \operatorname{efvar}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \neg (j = i))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, \mathit{mrlz}) = \operatorname{nth}(j, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}hole-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, h, l, a, b, i. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(a) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(b) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq i \wedge \\ \quad i \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nth}(i, a) = \operatorname{efvar}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \neg (j = i))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, a) = \operatorname{nth}(j, l)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \neg (j = i))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, b) = \operatorname{nth}(j, l)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, a), z, \operatorname{nth}(i, b)) = \operatorname{eapp}(h, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agree-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, a, i.; \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(a) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \neg (j = i))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, a) = \operatorname{nth}(j, l)) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq j \wedge \\ \quad j \leq \operatorname{length}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (j = i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(j, l) = \operatorname{nth}(j, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}hole}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, h, l, a, i. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(a) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq i \wedge \\ \quad i \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \neg (j = i))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, a) = \operatorname{nth}(j, l)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, a) \in \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(\operatorname{nth}(i, a), \operatorname{nth}(i, l))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{eapp}(h, l)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{eapp}(h, a)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}tapp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, h, l, a, i. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(a) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq i \wedge \\ \quad i \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \neg (j = i))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, a) = \operatorname{nth}(j, l)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, l) \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{eapp}(h, a) \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(\operatorname{nth}(i, l), \operatorname{nth}(i, a))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, l), \operatorname{eapp}(h, a))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}tapp}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}tapp}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}pred}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, t, x.\; ((\operatorname{rw\text{-}pred}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
