\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}goal-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, g, o, o_{2}. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (([2, g, o, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 4)) \wedge ([g, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, o] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}bind1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, h, c, a, b. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, [a], b), m, u) = \operatorname{ebind}(h, c, [\operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(a, m, u)], \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(b, m, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}bind-\allowbreak{}body}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b, z. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}bind-\allowbreak{}dom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, h, a, b, c. \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ebind}(h, 1, [a], c) \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ebind}(h, 1, [b], c) \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, 1, [a], c), \operatorname{ebind}(h, 1, [b], c))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}bind-\allowbreak{}dom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, t, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rw\text{-}bind\text{-}dom}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}5}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j.\; ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(j, 5, \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}5}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j, x.\; (((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 5))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}goal-\allowbreak{}5}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, g, o, o_{2}. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (([2, g, o, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 5)) \wedge ([g, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, o] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}rewrite-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, s, c. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{rel\text{-}rewrite\text{-}1}(j, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}rewrite-\allowbreak{}hyp-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, s, c. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{rel\text{-}rewrite\text{-}hyp\text{-}1}(j, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{j-\allowbreak{}nth-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{j\text{-}nth}(t) \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{j-\allowbreak{}len-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{j\text{-}len}(t) \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{j-\allowbreak{}lb-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{j\text{-}lb}(t) \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}fun-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{mxw\_}, \operatorname{mxj\_}] \in (\operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \times \mathbb{N}).\; \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{mxw\_}, \operatorname{mxj\_}, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}app2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, k, h, a, b. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a, b]), k, u) = \operatorname{eapp}(h, [\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(a, k, u), \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(b, k, u)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{j-\allowbreak{}mac-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{j\text{-}mac}(t) \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}nth-\allowbreak{}reduce-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}nth\text{-}reduce\text{-}1}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}reduce-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}length\text{-}reduce\text{-}1}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}lambda-\allowbreak{}beta-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}lambda\text{-}beta\text{-}1}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}lambda-\allowbreak{}beta-\allowbreak{}hyp-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}lambda\text{-}beta\text{-}hyp\text{-}1}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}macete-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}macete\text{-}1}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}macete-\allowbreak{}hyp-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}macete\text{-}hyp\text{-}1}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}iota-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}iota}(p) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(25, 1, [], p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}iota-\allowbreak{}body}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, t, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{rw\text{-}desc\text{-}body}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), [1, g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iota}(a), \operatorname{enc\text{-}iota}(b)]) \wedge \\ \quad [1, g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iota}(a), \operatorname{enc\text{-}iota}(b)] \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [1, g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iota}(a), \operatorname{enc\text{-}iota}(b)] \in \operatorname{eqv}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}qeq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ((y \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}eq}(x, y)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(x, y)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}sep-\allowbreak{}body}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, t, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rw\text{-}sep\text{-}body}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}tbind-\allowbreak{}body}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, t, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rw\text{-}tbind\text{-}body}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}6}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j.\; ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(j, 6, \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}6}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j, x.\; (((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 6))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}goal-\allowbreak{}6}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, g, o, o_{2}. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (([2, g, o, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 6)) \wedge ([g, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, o] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{j-\allowbreak{}fb-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{j\text{-}fb}(t) \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}functoid-\allowbreak{}beta-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}functoid\text{-}beta\text{-}1}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/meta-ind-laws.scm}{theorem-library/meta-ind-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small meta-ind-laws.scm -- K2 PHASE 4: the admissibility of the kernel's set-formation rules and of the three induction rules over the core, the typing machinery an instance at a compound term needs, and (section J) the one phase-5 derivation that needs the OPEN calculator (docs/meta-k2-admissibility-2026-10-08.md, section ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s. \\ \quad (([a, b] = [a, b]) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}([a, b], s)) \Rightarrow ((a \in s) \wedge (b \in s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}sep-\allowbreak{}sethood}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}sep\text{-}sethood}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}big-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}sethood}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}big\text{-}union\text{-}sethood}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}sep-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}sep\text{-}mem\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}comp\text{-}mem\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}sep-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}sep}(a, p) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(22, 1, [a], p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(p) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(23, 1, [], p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}bu-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}bu}(a, p) \simeq \operatorname{ebind}(24, 1, [a], p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}sep-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}sep\text{-}mem\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}comp\text{-}mem\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wks-\allowbreak{}single}}{\vnbstmt{\forall e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}.\; ((1 \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(e)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}wks}(e) = \{1\}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, d, a. \\ \quad ((d \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((d \leq a) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(e))))) \Rightarrow (a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lcd-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}closes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}, x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (((x + 1) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(e)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}lcd}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, x, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}succ}(p) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(30, [p]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}succo-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}succo}(p) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(31, [p]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}ordlt-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}ordlt}(p, q) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(10, [\operatorname{econst}(7), p, q]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}limit}(p) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(10, [\operatorname{econst}(9), p]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}num-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}num}(k) = \operatorname{econst}((2 \cdot k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebind-\allowbreak{}args-\allowbreak{}stage}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, h, c, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}stage}(n)) \Rightarrow (a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ebind-\allowbreak{}args-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, a, b) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \Rightarrow (a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{comp-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}body-\allowbreak{}clt}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q, p.\; ((\operatorname{enc\text{-}all}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}imp}(q, p)) \in \mathit{clf}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(p) \in \mathit{clt}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}app1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, k, h, a_{1}. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a_{1} \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a_{1}]), k, u) = \operatorname{eapp}(h, [\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(a_{1}, k, u)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}app3}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, k, h, a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a_{1} \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((a_{2} \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (a_{3} \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{eapp}(h, [a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}]), k, u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eapp}(h, [\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(a_{1}, k, u), \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(a_{2}, k, u), \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(a_{3}, k, u)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maplk-\allowbreak{}nil}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, k.\; (((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{maplk}(\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u), [], k) = []))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, h, q, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nbg\text{-}ok}(q) \wedge ([h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(t, \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(q))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [h, \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(q, 0, t)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, h, q, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(q) \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nbg\text{-}ok}(q) \wedge \\ \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(t, \operatorname{enc\text{-}setc})] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \wedge \\ \quad [h, \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(q, 0, t)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(t, \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(q))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}name-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, h, n, m. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ([h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{efvar}(n), \operatorname{econst}(m))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{efvar}(n), \operatorname{enc\text{-}setc})] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}big-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{def\text{-}in\text{-}closed}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{rel\text{-}big\text{-}union\text{-}mem\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}fv-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, h, y.\; (((h \in g) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(h))) \Rightarrow (y \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ctx-\allowbreak{}fv-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h, y. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{ctx\text{-}add}(g, h)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (y \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g)) \vee (y \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}bind1-\allowbreak{}dom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, c, a, b, z. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(a)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{ebind}(h, c, [a], b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fv-\allowbreak{}ex-\allowbreak{}bu}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, x, z. \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}ex}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}and}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ebvar}(0), a), \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, b)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}bu}(a, b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}big-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}big\text{-}union\text{-}mem\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}inst}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b, t.\; (((\operatorname{enc\text{-}all}(b) \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (t \in \mathit{clt})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(b, 0, t) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}inst-\allowbreak{}ex}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b, t.\; (((\operatorname{enc\text{-}ex}(b) \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge (t \in \mathit{clt})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(b, 0, t) \in \mathit{clf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}transfinite-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}tfi} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{def\text{-}comp\text{-}closed}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}transfinite\text{-}induction\text{-}nbg}(t, s, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, h, x, m. \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{econst}(m))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}eq}(x, x)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}setc})] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}nn\text{-}ind} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}zero\text{-}nn} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}succ\text{-}nn} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{def\text{-}comp\text{-}closed}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{def\text{-}in\text{-}closed}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}nn\text{-}induction\text{-}nbg}(t, s, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}em}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, h, x. \\ \quad ((h \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}) \wedge (x \in \mathit{clf})) \Rightarrow ([h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}or}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}not}(x))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subst-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}name}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall y, e, v. \\ \quad ((y \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((e \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge (\operatorname{expr\text{-}lc}(v) \wedge \neg (y \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(e)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{expr\text{-}subst}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, 0, \operatorname{efvar}(y)), y, v) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(e, 0, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hyps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, s. \\ \quad (([a, b, c] = [a, b, c]) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}([a, b, c], s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \in s) \wedge ((b \in s) \wedge (c \in s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}tfi-\allowbreak{}3cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}tfi} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}limit\text{-}iff} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}ord\text{-}succ\text{-}above} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{def\text{-}comp\text{-}closed}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}tfi\text{-}3cases\text{-}nbg}(t, s, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}def-\allowbreak{}app}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}fun\text{-}app} \in t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{adm\text{-}def\text{-}strict\text{-}in\text{-}l}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{adm\text{-}def\text{-}strict\text{-}in\text{-}r}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{def\text{-}app}(t, s, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{pred-\allowbreak{}code-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{pred\text{-}code}(k) \Rightarrow (k \in \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clf-\allowbreak{}pred-\allowbreak{}arg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, i. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{eapp}(10, l) \in \mathit{clf}) \wedge ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(i, l) \in \mathit{clt} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}pred1-\allowbreak{}arg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, k, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pred\text{-}code}(k) \wedge ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}pred1}(\operatorname{econst}(k), s)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}eq}(s, s)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}pred1-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, k, s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{pred\text{-}code}(k) \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}pred1}(\operatorname{econst}(k), s)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}all}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}pred1}(\operatorname{econst}(k), \operatorname{ebvar}(0)), b))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(b, 0, s)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{def-\allowbreak{}pred-\allowbreak{}unfold-\allowbreak{}derived}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{def\text{-}pred\text{-}unfold}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}cr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b, y. \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}class\text{-}ext} \in t \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(a) \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(b) \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nbg\text{-}ok}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nbg\text{-}ok}(b) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y \in (\operatorname{ctx\text{-}fv}(g) \cup \operatorname{expr\text{-}fv}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ebvar}(0), \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(a)), \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ebvar}(0), \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(b)))))) \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(a, 0, \operatorname{efvar}(y)), \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(b, 0, \operatorname{efvar}(y)))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}qeq}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(a), \operatorname{enc\text{-}comp}(b))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eqv-\allowbreak{}desc-\allowbreak{}body}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, t, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rw\text{-}desc\text{-}body}(j, \operatorname{eqv}(t), x) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rw\text{-}univ})) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j.\; ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rw\text{-}closed}(j, 7, \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, j, x.\; (((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 7))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{eqv}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cr-\allowbreak{}goal-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, g, o, o_{2}. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (([2, g, o, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{rewr}(j, 7)) \wedge ([g, o_{2}] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [g, o] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}rewrite-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, s, c. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{rel\text{-}rewrite\text{-}7}(j, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}rewrite-\allowbreak{}hyp-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, j, s, c. \\ \quad ((j \subseteq \operatorname{eqv}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{rel\text{-}rewrite\text{-}hyp\text{-}7}(j, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}nth-\allowbreak{}reduce-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}nth\text{-}reduce\text{-}7}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}reduce-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}length\text{-}reduce\text{-}7}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}lambda-\allowbreak{}beta-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}lambda\text{-}beta\text{-}7}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}lambda-\allowbreak{}beta-\allowbreak{}hyp-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}lambda\text{-}beta\text{-}hyp\text{-}7}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}macete-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}macete\text{-}7}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{enc\text{-}length}(p) \simeq \operatorname{eapp}(16, [p]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}cartl-\allowbreak{}clf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, l. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (\forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (n \leq \operatorname{length}(l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}cartl}(x, l, n) \in \mathit{clf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}cartl-\allowbreak{}elim-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, x, l, k. \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}cartl}(x, l, n)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq k \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}nth}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}num}(k), x), \operatorname{nth}(k, l))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{enc-\allowbreak{}cartl-\allowbreak{}der}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, x, l. \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(l).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq k) \wedge (k \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}nth}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}num}(k), x), \operatorname{nth}(k, l))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}cartl}(x, l, n)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, a, b. \\ \quad ([g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}and}(a, b)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ([g, a] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \wedge ([g, b] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, h, x, y. \\ \quad ((t \subseteq \mathit{clf}) \wedge ((\operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t) \wedge ([h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, y)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}setc})] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}cartesian-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rel\text{-}cartesian\text{-}elim}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adm-\allowbreak{}cartesian-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, c. \\ \quad ((t \subseteq \mathit{clf}) \wedge ((\operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t) \wedge (\operatorname{rel\text{-}cartesian\text{-}intro}(t, s, c) \wedge \operatorname{hyps\text{-}in}(s, \operatorname{derivable}(t))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{idx-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k \leq n) \Rightarrow ((n - k) \in \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{idx-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{idx\text{-}list}(n) \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{idx\text{-}list}(n)) = n \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq n)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(i, \operatorname{idx\text{-}list}(n)) = \operatorname{ebvar}((n - i)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cchs-\allowbreak{}idx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x, a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{enc\text{-}cch}(x, a, n, k) \simeq \operatorname{cchs}(x, a, n, \operatorname{idx\text{-}list}(n), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cchs-\allowbreak{}expr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x, a, n, l. \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(a).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(a) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cchs}(x, a, n, l, k) \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maplk-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, l, x. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set})) \wedge (x \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{maplk}(\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u), l, x) \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{maplk}(\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u), l, x)) = \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(i, \operatorname{maplk}(\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u), l, x)) = \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nth}(i, l), x, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cchs-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}body}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, c. \\ \quad ((t \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge ((a \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}and}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ebvar}(0), a), c), 0, t) \simeq \operatorname{enc\text{-}and}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(t, a), \operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(c, 0, t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cchs-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x, a, n, l, u.; \forall d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mczu} \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(a).\; (\mathit{mczu} \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \leq \operatorname{length}(a) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{expr\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cchs}(x, a, n, l, k), d, u) \simeq \operatorname{cchs}(x, a, n, \operatorname{maplk}(\operatorname{open\text{-}fun}(u), l, (d + k)), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cchs-\allowbreak{}fwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, t, g, x, a, n.; \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}). \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(a).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(a) = n \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}cart}(a))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge (j \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}nth}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}num}(j), x), \operatorname{nth}(j, a))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(l) = n \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq n) \wedge ((j + k) \leq n))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, l) = \operatorname{enc\text{-}nth}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}num}(j), x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq n) \wedge (n < (j + k)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, l) = \operatorname{ebvar}((n - j))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cchs}(x, a, n, l, k) \in \mathit{clf} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{cchs}(x, a, n, l, k)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cchs-\allowbreak{}bwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, t, x, a, n.; \forall h \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set}, l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}). \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathit{clt} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{make\text{-}set}(a).\; (u \in \mathit{clt}) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(a) = n \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}cart}(a)) \in \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{length}(l) = n \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq n) \wedge (n < (j + k)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(j, l) = \operatorname{ebvar}((n - j))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq n) \wedge ((j + k) \leq n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nth}(j, l), \operatorname{nth}(j, a))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad [h, \operatorname{cchs}(x, a, n, l, k)] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [h, \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}cart}(a))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{der-\allowbreak{}cartesian-\allowbreak{}decompose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, x, a. \\ \quad t \subseteq \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ax\text{-}mem\text{-}set} \in t \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{ctx\text{-}set} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{length}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}cart}(a)) \in \mathit{clf} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{enc\text{-}cch}(x, a, \operatorname{length}(a), \operatorname{length}(a)) \in \mathit{clf} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [g, \operatorname{enc\text{-}iff}(\operatorname{enc\text{-}in}(x, \operatorname{enc\text{-}cart}(a)), \operatorname{enc\text{-}cch}(x, a, \operatorname{length}(a), \operatorname{length}(a)))] \in \operatorname{derivable}(t) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{nbg-\allowbreak{}walk-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nbg\text{-}walk}(p) \simeq \{z \in \operatorname{expr\text{-}set} : \forall v \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}).\; (((p \in v) \wedge \operatorname{nbg\text{-}closed}(v)) \Rightarrow (z \in v))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nbg-\allowbreak{}walk-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{expr\text{-}set}), x \in \operatorname{nbg\text{-}walk}(p). \\ \quad ((p \in s) \wedge \operatorname{nbg\text{-}closed}(s)) \Rightarrow (x \in s) \end{array}}}
