\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}minor-\allowbreak{}colcongr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x, y, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \neg (j = q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(y, i, j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{minor}(x, p, q, n) = \operatorname{minor}(y, p, q, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}r1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, s, x, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(s, \operatorname{mul}(r)(x, d)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(x, \operatorname{mul}(r)(s, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}c1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, s, x, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(s, \operatorname{mul}(r)(x, d)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(s, d), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}diag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(a, k, j), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (j + k)), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, k, j, n))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}diag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (k + j)), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, j, k, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, j, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}off}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, i, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (i = k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(a, i, j), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (j + k)), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, k, j, n))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}off}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, i, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (i = k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (i + j)), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, j, i, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, j, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adj-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a) \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adj-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, i, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{adj}(r, n, a), i, j) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (i + j)), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, j, i, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adj-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a), a) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a), \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mul-\allowbreak{}adj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a)) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a), \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{matscale-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, k, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, k, \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{matscale}(r, \operatorname{one}(r), x) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{matscale-\allowbreak{}matscale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, k, x, b, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, k, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matscale}(r, b, \operatorname{matscale}(r, d, x)) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, \operatorname{mul}(r)(b, d), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{matmul-\allowbreak{}matscale-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p, q, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, q)) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{matmul-\allowbreak{}matscale-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p, q, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, p), q) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ladet-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(x, b) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cramer-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a), b) = \operatorname{one}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{matscale}(r, b, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a))) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matscale}(r, b, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a)), a) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invertible-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, a) \Leftrightarrow \neg (\operatorname{det}(r, n, a) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr-adj-unit.scm}{theorem-library/ccr-adj-unit.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr-adj-unit.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-B4), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109b4/ccr-adj-unit.scm. Library: linear-algebra.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{det-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, a) \Leftrightarrow \exists b \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a), b) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-elem-gen.scm}{theorem-library/la-elem-gen.scm}
\noindent{\small la-elem-gen.scm -- elementary column matrices, column equivalence, the column-step proposition and linear-algebra 3.12 / 3.13 (LA-DET2, 2026-10-18).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}elementary}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, k, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \neg (k = l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}g-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}elementary}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}h-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}elementary}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c, u, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, u) = \operatorname{one}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(u, c) = \operatorname{one}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, n, c, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elementary-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elementary-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, v) \wedge ((\operatorname{matmul}(r, e, v) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n)) \wedge (\operatorname{matmul}(r, v, e) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \simeq \operatorname{intersection\text{-}of}(\{s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) : ((\operatorname{identmat}(r, n) \in s) \wedge \forall x \in s, e \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{matmul}(r, x, e) \in s)))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) : ((\operatorname{identmat}(r, n) \in s) \wedge \forall x \in s, e \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{matmul}(r, x, e) \in s)))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)))) \Rightarrow (p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r, n.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{identmat}(r, n) \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, e) \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, s.; \forall p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{identmat}(r, n) \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in s, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{matmul}(r, y, f) \in s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, q) \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elementary-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e))) \Rightarrow (e \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{matmul}(r, p, v) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n)) \wedge (\operatorname{matmul}(r, v, p) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, p, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, p) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, v) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r, f.; \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (\forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (f(k) = \operatorname{zero}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, f, \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, f.; \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad f(k) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, f, \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x, a, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \leq m \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad ((t + 1) \leq j) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq k \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l)), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}h-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x, a, c, k.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \leq m \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad ((t + 1) \leq j) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, n, c, k)), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}g-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x, a, c, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \leq m \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad ((t + 1) \leq j) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l)), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, b, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}elem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((t \leq m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}rows-\allowbreak{}zr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, t, x.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, x, i) \wedge ((t + 1) \leq j)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}csr-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x, a, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \leq m \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{agi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, \mathit{agi}, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, \mathit{agi}, j) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, x, i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, a, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}pivot}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad ((t + 1) \leq j) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq z \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(x, (t + 1), z) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, x, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(c, (t + 1), (t + 1)) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad ((t + 1) \leq j) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(a, (t + 1), (t + 1)) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, (t + 1), (t + 1)) = \operatorname{one}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}clear-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbb{N}, r, m, n, t, x, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad ((t + 1) \leq j) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, (t + 1), (t + 1)) = \operatorname{one}(r) \wedge \\ \quad s \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(x, i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{csa} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{entry}(c, \mathit{csa}, (t + 1)) = \operatorname{entry}(a, \mathit{csa}, (t + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{clj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{clj} \leq s) \wedge \neg (\mathit{clj} = (t + 1))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(c, (t + 1), \mathit{clj}) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, t, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, x, i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, x, c) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (t + 1)).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}colstep-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \mathbb{N}, r, m, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((t \leq m) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, c) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{column-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}reduced}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, c) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}rows-\allowbreak{}colstep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, c. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}column\text{-}step}(r, m, n, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{column-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists e.\; (\operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, e) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}column\text{-}step}(r, m, n, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}identity-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, \operatorname{identmat}(r, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laeg-\allowbreak{}reduced-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invertible-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, a) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, \operatorname{identmat}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invertible-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, a) \Leftrightarrow (a \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z6-col.scm}{theorem-library/la-z6-col.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z6-col.scm -- linear algebra Lemma 3.8 over a field, in column equivalence (LA-Z6, 2026-10-25).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}reduce-\allowbreak{}first-\allowbreak{}row}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(2, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \vee (\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, 1) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z-sdet.scm}{theorem-library/la-z-sdet.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z-sdet.scm -- subdeterminants under the elementary operations (linear algebra 3.29) and the invariance of their gcd over Z (3.31) (LA-Z, 2026-10-19).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{submatrix-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{submatrix}(a, s, p, q) \in \operatorname{mat}(s, s, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{submatrix-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, p, q, i, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{submatrix}(a, s, p, q), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(a, p(i), q(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{submatrix-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, p, q, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(a, p(i), q(j)) = \operatorname{entry}(b, c(i), d(j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{submatrix}(a, s, p, q) = \operatorname{submatrix}(b, s, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{carr}(r) : \exists p \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)), q \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)).\; (x = \operatorname{det}(r, s, \operatorname{submatrix}(a, s, p, q)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, s, \operatorname{submatrix}(a, s, p, q)) \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s). \exists p \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)), q \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)). \\ \quad x = \operatorname{det}(r, s, \operatorname{submatrix}(a, s, p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}tau-\allowbreak{}tau}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, l, y. \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \left(\text{if }(\left(\text{if }(y = k)\text{ then }l\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(y = l)\text{ then }k\text{ else }y\right)\right) = k)\text{ then }l\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(\left(\text{if }(y = k)\text{ then }l\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(y = l)\text{ then }k\text{ else }y\right)\right) = l)\text{ then }k\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(y = k)\text{ then }l\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(y = l)\text{ then }k\text{ else }y\right)\right)\right)\right) \\ \quad \quad =\; y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}injection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, q, k, l. \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \left(\text{if }(q(j) = k)\text{ then }l\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(q(j) = l)\text{ then }k\text{ else }q(j)\right)\right)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}replace-\allowbreak{}injection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, q, a, k. \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \neg (q(j) = k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }k\text{ else }q(w)\right)) \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, k, l, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l)), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l)), s) = \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}a}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, u, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(u, \operatorname{mul}(r)(v, w)) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(w, v), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}b}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, u, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(w, v), u) = \operatorname{add}(r)(u, \operatorname{mul}(r)(w, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}z}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, u, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(w, \operatorname{zero}(r)), u) = \operatorname{add}(r)(u, \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{zero}(r), u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}z0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, u, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u = \operatorname{add}(r)(u, \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{zero}(r), u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzs-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, u, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(u, \operatorname{mul}(r)(w, v)) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(w, v), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, l, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l)), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda}, b \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s), t \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((t = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \vee ((t = c) \vee (t = \operatorname{neg}(r)(c)))) \wedge (x = \operatorname{add}(r)(\mathit{sda}, \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, k, l, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, m, k, l), a), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, m, k, l), a), s) = \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, l, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, m, c, k, l), a), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda}, b \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s), t \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((t = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \vee ((t = c) \vee (t = \operatorname{neg}(r)(c)))) \wedge (x = \operatorname{add}(r)(\mathit{sda}, \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, n, c, k)), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda} \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; ((x = \mathit{sda}) \vee (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \mathit{sda}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, m, c, k), a), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda} \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; ((x = \mathit{sda}) \vee (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \mathit{sda}))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/zz-divides-basics.scm}{theorem-library/zz-divides-basics.scm}
\noindent{\small zz-divides-basics.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/la-z-gcd.scm, so that files of library algebra may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of la-z-gcd.scm's.  Loaded immediately before la-z-gcd.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v.\; (((u \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((u \cdot v) = 1))) \Rightarrow ((u = 1) \vee (u = -1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}antisym}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; ((\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(a, b) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(b, a)) \Rightarrow ((a = b) \vee (a = -b)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z-gcd.scm}{theorem-library/la-z-gcd.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z-gcd.scm -- the gcd of the s-th order subdeterminants is invariant under integral elementary operations (linear algebra 3.31) (LA-Z, 2026-10-19).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzg-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}g}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, c, y, t, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((t \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y), \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, z))) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \operatorname{add}(r)(y, \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzg-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}h}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, c, y, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (t \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}divisor-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, e.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, e), s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}divisor-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, e.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, e, a), s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, m, e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}divisor-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, c, q.; \forall a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)), x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, q), s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}divisor-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, c, p.; \forall a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)), x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, a), s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}divisor-\allowbreak{}equiv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, c, a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, b, s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}symmetric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, a, b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, b, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzg-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, x) \Rightarrow \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(d, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzg-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}zz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, y. \\ \quad ((d \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (x = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(d, y)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}gcd-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, s, a, b, d, e. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, s), d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, b, s), e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (d = e) \vee (d = -e) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cartesian-nth.scm}{theorem-library/cartesian-nth.scm}
\noindent{\small cartesian-nth.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/product-measure.scm, so that files of library core may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of product-measure.scm's.  Loaded immediately before ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cartesian-\allowbreak{}membership-\allowbreak{}nth}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, w. \\ \quad (w \in (a \times b)) \Leftrightarrow ((w = [\operatorname{nth}(1, w), \operatorname{nth}(2, w)]) \wedge ((\operatorname{nth}(1, w) \in a) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, w) \in b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/zz-number-theory.scm}{theorem-library/zz-number-theory.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/zz-number-theory.scm -- ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS NOTES ch. 1: division with remainder, the gcd, the Chinese remainder theorem (ALGNUM, bundles B1 and B4, 2026-10-26). Vocabulary: structure-library/zz-divisibility.scm (ZZ-DIVIDES, ZZ-IS-GCD, ZZ-COPRIME, ZZ-BEZOUT-SET), structure-library/zz-nt-vocab.scm ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, y, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, x) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, y) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (t \in \mathbb{Z})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, ((s \cdot x) + (t \cdot y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, m. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (n < m)))) \Rightarrow (((a \cdot n) + a) \leq (a \cdot m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}division-\allowbreak{}remainder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n, r \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b = ((a \cdot n) + r)) \wedge (r < a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}division-\allowbreak{}remainder-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, n, r, m, s. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b = ((a \cdot n) + r) \wedge \\ \quad r < a \wedge \\ \quad b = ((a \cdot m) + s) \wedge \\ \quad s < a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (n = m) \wedge (r = s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}floor-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((a \cdot n) \leq b) \wedge (b < ((a \cdot n) + a))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((((a \cdot n) \leq b) \wedge (b < ((a \cdot n) + a))) \wedge (((a \cdot m) \leq b) \wedge (b < ((a \cdot m) + a)))) \Rightarrow (n = m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}gcd-\allowbreak{}remainder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, n, r, d. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (b = ((a \cdot n) + r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, b, d) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, r, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}gcd-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}bezout-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, b, g))) \Rightarrow (g \in \operatorname{zz\text{-}bezout\text{-}set}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euclid-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}steps-\allowbreak{}halve}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b = ((a \cdot c) + d) \wedge \\ \quad d < a \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad a = ((d \cdot f) + g) \wedge \\ \quad g < d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (2 \cdot g) < a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, x, y.\; ((\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, x) \wedge (y \in \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, (x \cdot y)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, x) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(x, y)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}bezout}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(a, b) \Leftrightarrow \exists x, y \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (((x \cdot a) + (y \cdot b)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, m. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(a, m) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(b, m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}((a \cdot b), m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}crt-\allowbreak{}strong}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}). \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((i < k) \wedge ((j < k) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(n(i), n(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(n(i), m)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(n(i), q)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}). \exists x \in \mathbb{Z}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (i < k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(n(i), (x - a(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}chinese-\allowbreak{}remainder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (n \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((i < k) \wedge ((j < k) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(n(i), n(j)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}). \exists x \in \mathbb{Z}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (i < k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(n(i), (x - a(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}congruences}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n, c.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}). \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((i < k) \wedge ((j < k) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(n(i), n(j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(c(i), n(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \mathbb{Z}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (i < k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(n(i), ((c(i) \cdot x) - a(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}multiple-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((1 \leq m) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(m, x) \wedge ((x < m) \wedge (-m < x)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq m) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}residue}(k, m) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(m, (k - \operatorname{zz\text{-}residue}(k, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, r. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(m, (k - r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad r = \operatorname{zz\text{-}residue}(k, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}congruent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, r. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(m, (k - r)) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(k, m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(r, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(a, b))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(b, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(a, (b \cdot c))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, x. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(m, n) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(m, x) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(n, x)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}((m \cdot n), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}multiplicative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(m, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}((m \cdot n)) = (\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(m) \cdot \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z-elem.scm}{theorem-library/la-z-elem.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z-elem.scm -- over a euclidean ring an invertible matrix is a product of elementary matrices; over Z this is linear algebra 3.38 (LA-Z, 2026-10-19).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r))), \operatorname{neg}(r)(s)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \operatorname{one}(r)), s) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}four}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, \mathit{ler}, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((\mathit{ler} \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (t \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \mathit{ler}), \operatorname{mul}(r)(s, t)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, s), \operatorname{mul}(r)(\mathit{ler}, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, \mathit{ler}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((\mathit{ler} \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \operatorname{mul}(r)(\mathit{ler}, s)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \mathit{ler}), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, \mathit{ler}, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{ler} \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, s) = \operatorname{one}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\mathit{ler}, t) = \operatorname{one}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \mathit{ler}), \operatorname{mul}(r)(s, t)) = \operatorname{one}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, p), s) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{det-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}single}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, b, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; (\neg (j = w) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(b, w, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), b) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(b, w, w), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(b, w, w, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}zr-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, t.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((t \leq n) \wedge ((t + 1) \leq j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}cols-\allowbreak{}f}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, t, b, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \leq n \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(b, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq k \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l)), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}cols-\allowbreak{}g}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, t, b, c, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \leq n \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(b, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l)), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}cols-\allowbreak{}h}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, t, b, c, k.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \leq n \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(b, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, n, c, k)), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}euc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, q, b, \mathit{ler}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((q \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (\mathit{ler} \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(q, b), \mathit{ler}), \operatorname{mul}(r)(b, \operatorname{neg}(r)(q))) = \mathit{ler} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{lpn} \in \mathbb{N}, r, n, t, b, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), \mathit{agj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(b, i, \mathit{agj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, \mathit{agj}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad
