\quad \operatorname{entry}(b, \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) < j \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(b, (t + 1), (t + 1)) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gauge}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(b, (t + 1), (t + 1))) \leq \mathit{lpn} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), \mathit{agj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, q), i, \mathit{agj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, \mathit{agj}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, q), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, q), (t + 1), j) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\neg (c = (t + 1)) \wedge \neg (c = j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, q), (t + 1), c) = \operatorname{entry}(b, (t + 1), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, r, n, t, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(b, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(b, \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, q), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, q), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (((t + 1) < c) \wedge (c \leq k)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, q), (t + 1), c) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}z1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(u, \operatorname{mul}(r)(v, \operatorname{zero}(r))) = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}z2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(u, \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{neg}(r)(u), \operatorname{one}(r))) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, r, n, t, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, (t + 1), (t + 1)) = \operatorname{one}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rrc} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{rrc} = (t + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(c, (t + 1), \mathit{rrc}) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, p, c), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, p, c), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, p, c), (t + 1), (t + 1)) = \operatorname{one}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rrc} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{rrc} = (t + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, p, c), (t + 1), \mathit{rrc}) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{lci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (((t + 1) < \mathit{lci}) \wedge (\mathit{lci} \leq k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, p, c), \mathit{lci}, (t + 1)) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, t, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (t + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(u, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(u, \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, u), s) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p, q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (t + 1)), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, u), q), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (t + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, u), q), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, u), q)), s) = \operatorname{one}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lze-\allowbreak{}main-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \mathbb{N}, r, n, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, u), s) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad t \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p, q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, u), q), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), i, j) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{cgi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{cgj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, u), q), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n), \mathit{cgi}, \mathit{cgj}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, u), q)), s) = \operatorname{one}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euclidean-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, u), s) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euclidean-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, u) \Leftrightarrow (u \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}elementary-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, u) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists p, q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n). \\ \quad \quad u = \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, q) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/spans-transport-proof.scm}{theorem-library/spans-transport-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small spans-transport-proof.scm -- the SPANS-relativized generates-transport.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{spans-\allowbreak{}transport}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, u, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, u), a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-asm-b4.scm}{theorem-library/rake-asm-b4.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/rake-asm-b4.scm  (RB-4, rake-asm-b, 2026-10-12) ==================================================================== submodule-of-free-is-free (Cor 3.46, linear-algebra.tex cor:22195-45888-207248): over a euclidean ring, a submodule sm of a module}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}pad-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall t \in \mathbf{Set}, r, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(a) \wedge \\ \quad |t| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in r.\; (z \in t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in t.\; (g(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in t.\; (\neg (z \in r) \Rightarrow (g(z) = \operatorname{iden}(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(a, g, t) = \operatorname{finsum}(a, g, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}trunc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, k, c, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, m, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{mat}(m, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \quad \neg (j \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{entry}(c, 1, j), \operatorname{entry}(y, j, 1)) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, m, c, y) = \operatorname{lincomb}(d, k, c, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}entry-\allowbreak{}single}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, p, e, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\neg (j = i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(p, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, p, e), i, 1) = \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(e, i, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}entry-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}row}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, p, e, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(p, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, p, e), i, 1) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}matmul-\allowbreak{}entry-\allowbreak{}single}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, k, p, q, w, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, k, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\neg (i = l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(q, i, l) = \operatorname{zero}(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, q), w, l) = \operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, w, l), \operatorname{entry}(q, l, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}free}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, k, d, e, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{scal}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \leq m \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{scal}(a), m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; \neg (\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(a))) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(a, n, e) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(k, 1, \operatorname{vec}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(w, i, 1) = \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(e, i, 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(a, k, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}trunc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, k, y, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \leq m \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{mat}(m, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, m, y, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\neg (j \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(y, j, 1) = \operatorname{vzero}(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, k, \operatorname{block}(y, k, 1), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb4-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, a, b, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{scal}(d), m, n, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), m, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, w) \wedge (\operatorname{matact}(d, u, \operatorname{matact}(d, a, s)) = \operatorname{matact}(d, b, \operatorname{matact}(d, w, s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{submodule-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}free}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad (((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \leq n)) \wedge \exists w \in \operatorname{mat}(k, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; (\operatorname{spans}(d, k, w, m) \wedge \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, k, w))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z2-action.scm}{theorem-library/la-z2-action.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z2-action.scm -- linear algebra 3.43: the invertible matrices act freely and transitively on the free generating sequences (LA-Z2, 2026-10-23).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lza-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(s)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{add}(s)(a, \operatorname{neg}(s)(b)) = \operatorname{zero}(s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lza-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(d))(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), x)) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitrow-\allowbreak{}matmul-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, b, i, j. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge (j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, \operatorname{unitrow}(a, m, i), b), 1, j) = \operatorname{entry}(b, i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{row-\allowbreak{}matact-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, a, s, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \operatorname{unitrow}(\operatorname{scal}(d), m, i), a), s) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, a, s), i, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rel-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, r, a, s.; \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, r, s) = \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(r, 1, j) = \operatorname{entry}(a, 1, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rel-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}matact-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, s, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matact}(d, a, s) = \operatorname{matact}(d, b, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spans-\allowbreak{}coeff-\allowbreak{}matrix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, m, s, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad (n = 0) \Rightarrow (m = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, s, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{entry}(a, j, 1) \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; (a = \operatorname{matact}(d, c, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spans-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}transitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, a, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, s, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, a, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, b) \wedge (a = \operatorname{matact}(d, b, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}generating-\allowbreak{}action-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s)) \wedge \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}generating-\allowbreak{}action-\allowbreak{}free}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s) = \operatorname{matact}(d, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}generating-\allowbreak{}action-\allowbreak{}stabilizer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s) = s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}generating-\allowbreak{}action-\allowbreak{}transitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m) \wedge (a = \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z2-norm.scm}{theorem-library/la-z2-norm.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z2-norm.scm -- linear algebra 3.45: |det A| of a change of basis between a submodule F and the module E does not depend on the bases (LA-Z2, 2026-10-23).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzn-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b, c, d, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(b, e) = \operatorname{one}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(c, e), d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, s_{2}, a, b, m, c, m_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad s_{2} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, a, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, b, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, b) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad m_{2} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{matact}(d, c, s) \wedge \\ \quad b = \operatorname{matact}(d, m_{2}, s_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)).\; (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(d))(w, v) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m_{2}) = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(d))(w, \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}independent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, s_{2}, a, b, m, c, m_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad s_{2} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, a, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, b, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, b) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad m_{2} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{matact}(d, c, s) \wedge \\ \quad b = \operatorname{matact}(d, m_{2}, s_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, m_{2}) \rvert = \lvert \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, c) \rvert \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/prod-ring-succ.scm}{theorem-library/prod-ring-succ.scm}
\noindent{\small prod-ring-succ.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/la-z2-diag.scm, so that files of library algebra may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of la-z2-diag.scm's.  Loaded immediately before la-z2-diag.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzd-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)).\; (g(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, g, \operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1))) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, g, \operatorname{interval}(1, s)), g((s + 1))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z2-diag.scm}{theorem-library/la-z2-diag.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z2-diag.scm -- the uniqueness half of linear algebra 3.36: the gcd of the order-s subdeterminants of a diagonal matrix with the divisibility chain is b\_11 ... b\_ss, so two such matrices equivalent by integral elementary operations are equal (LA-Z2, 2026-10-23).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}injection-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, t, p. \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; (p(i) \leq t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad s \leq t \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzd-\allowbreak{}skip-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \left(\text{if }(u < a)\text{ then }u\text{ else }(u + 1)\right) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzd-\allowbreak{}skip-\allowbreak{}inj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, v. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\left(\text{if }(u < a)\text{ then }u\text{ else }(u + 1)\right) = \left(\text{if }(v < a)\text{ then }v\text{ else }(v + 1)\right))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzd-\allowbreak{}skp-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, p, a. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, m))) \wedge (a \in \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; p(\left(\text{if }(x < a)\text{ then }x\text{ else }(x + 1)\right))) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzd-\allowbreak{}skp-\allowbreak{}inj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, p, a. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)), \operatorname{interval}(1, m))) \wedge (a \in \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; p(\left(\text{if }(x < a)\text{ then }x\text{ else }(x + 1)\right))) \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzd-\allowbreak{}minor-\allowbreak{}submatrix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, p, q, b, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{minor}(\operatorname{submatrix}(a, (s + 1), p, q), b, c, s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{submatrix}(a, s, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; p(\left(\text{if }(x < b)\text{ then }x\text{ else }(x + 1)\right))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; q(\left(\text{if }(x < c)\text{ then }x\text{ else }(x + 1)\right)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}minor-\allowbreak{}divisible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbb{N}, r, m, n, d, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(r, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(d, j, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), y)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, s, \operatorname{submatrix}(d, s, p, q)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)), y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzd-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}injection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (s \leq m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; x) \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}leading-\allowbreak{}minor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, d, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(r, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \leq m \wedge \\ \quad s \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, s, \operatorname{submatrix}(d, s, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; x), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; x))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}sdet-\allowbreak{}gcd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, s. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \leq m \wedge \\ \quad s \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d, s), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, d, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (s + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad (s + 1) \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1)).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, (s + 1))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(d, (s + 1), (s + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbb{N}, m, n, d. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad s \leq m \wedge \\ \quad s \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (1 \leq s) \wedge (\operatorname{entry}(d, s, s) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}products-\allowbreak{}determine}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, a. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(a, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(a, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(a, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((s \leq m) \wedge (s \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(a, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; -\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(a, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, a. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(a, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(a, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(a, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{submatrix-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}diagonal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, k, n, s, x, d, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(r, n, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, s) \to \operatorname{interval}(1, k)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, s), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{submatrix}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, x, d), s, p, q) = \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{submatrix}(x, s, p, q), \operatorname{submatrix}(d, s, q, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}sdet-\allowbreak{}divisible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, k, n, s, x, d.; \forall \mathit{dvx} \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, k, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, x, d), s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(r, n, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(d, j, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), y)) \wedge \\ \quad s \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{dvx} = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda \mathit{pk} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{pk}, \mathit{pk})), \operatorname{interval}(1, s)), y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, a, b, c. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(a, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(a, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(a, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, c) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, b, d), c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d = a \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-ufd.scm}{theorem-library/gal-ufd.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-ufd.scm -- a Euclidean domain is a unique factorization domain (galois-theory notes, Corollary 1.6 and Proposition 1.8) (GALOIS, 2026-10-26). Destination: theorem-library/gal-ufd.scm, library algebra.  Vocabulary: catools-gal-vocab.scm, gal-ufd-vocab.scm; uses catools-gal-b1 (degree-proper-divisor, euclid-lemma).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}element}(s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}seq}(s, q, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, p, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, q, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{associated}(s, p, q(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}divisor-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, s, n.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}degree\text{-}function}(s, n) \wedge ((n(a) < b) \wedge (\neg (a = \operatorname{zero}(s)) \wedge \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(s, a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}element}(s, p) \wedge \exists d \in \operatorname{carr}(s).\; (a = \operatorname{mul}(s)(p, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{factorization-\allowbreak{}exists-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, s, n.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}degree\text{-}function}(s, n) \wedge ((n(a) < b) \wedge \neg (a = \operatorname{zero}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{gun} \in \mathbb{N}, p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{gun}) \to \operatorname{carr}(s)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}seq}(s, p, \mathit{gun}) \wedge (a = \operatorname{mul}(s)(u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{gun})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge (\neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(s)(a, c) = \operatorname{mul}(s)(b, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}transposition-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \exists h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, m), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)). \\ \quad h(m) = k \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}permute-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall \mathit{xs} \in \mathbf{Set}, h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathit{xs}, \mathit{xs}), q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge ((|\mathit{xs}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in \mathit{xs}.\; (q(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, q, \mathit{xs}) = \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, (\lambda y \in \mathit{xs}.\; q(h(y))), \mathit{xs}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bijection-\allowbreak{}extend-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)). \\ \quad (\lambda e \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \left(\text{if }(e = (n + 1))\text{ then }(n + 1)\text{ else }g(e)\right)) \\ \quad \in\; \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)), \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{factorization-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s, p.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, q \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, m) \to \operatorname{carr}(s)), u.; \forall v \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}seq}(s, p, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}seq}(s, q, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(s, v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(s)(u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) = \operatorname{mul}(s)(v, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, q, \operatorname{interval}(1, m))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad n = m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists s_{2} \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)). \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{associated}(s, p(i), q(\operatorname{s2}(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euclidean-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ufd}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ufd}(s))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z2-principal.scm}{theorem-library/la-z2-principal.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z2-principal.scm -- linear algebra 3.48: the principal sequence of a subgroup is uniquely determined (LA-Z2, 2026-10-23).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, m, s, s_{2}, a, m_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s_{2}, m_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = m_{2} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z3-smith.scm}{theorem-library/la-z3-smith.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z3-smith.scm -- linear algebra 3.36 (existence) and 3.37 in general: every integer matrix is equivalent, by integral elementary operations, to a diagonal matrix with non-negative diagonal entries forming a divisibility chain (LA-Z3, 2026-10-24).  Prefix lz3-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{smith-\allowbreak{}pivot-\allowbreak{}cross-\allowbreak{}minimal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, p, q, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}((p + 1), (q + 1), \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)), d \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(m, b, d) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, (p + 1), (q + 1), m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f = \operatorname{border}(a, \operatorname{entry}(f, 1, 1), \operatorname{submat}(f, p, q), p, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(f, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, i, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, (p + 1), (q + 1), f, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(f, 1, 1)) \leq \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(c, i, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{smith-\allowbreak{}pivot-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}block}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, p, q, m, i, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}((p + 1), (q + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad m = \operatorname{border}(r, \operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1), \operatorname{submat}(m, p, q), p, q) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c, a, b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(r, (p + 1), (q + 1), m, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad b \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(c, a, b) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{gauge}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1)) \leq \operatorname{gauge}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(c, a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, p) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{submat}(m, p, q), i, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1), y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lz3-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}injection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, i. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, 1).\; i) \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, 1), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{smith-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}divisor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, p, e, c, i, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, p, e) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj}. \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{dvi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge (\mathit{dvj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(p, \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj}) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(e, i, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{border-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}row}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, p, q, b, c, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{mat}(p, q, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, (p + 1), c, 1), \operatorname{border}(r, b, e, p, q)) = \operatorname{border}(r, \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, b), e, p, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{border-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, b, e. \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{mat}(p, q, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, q, e) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, p).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, q)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(e, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(e, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(e, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj}. \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{dvi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, p)) \wedge (\mathit{dvj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(b, \operatorname{entry}(e, \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (p + 1), (q + 1), \operatorname{border}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, b, e, p, q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1))) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{border}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, b, e, p, q), i, i)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{border}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, b, e, p, q), \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{border}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, b, e, p, q), j, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integer-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}equiv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, p. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, k, n, p, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, k, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integer-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}elementary}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m), v \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, u, a), v)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, u, a), v), i, i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, u, a), v), \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, u, a), v), j, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integer-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elem-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, b, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, a, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integer-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(b, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(b, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(b, j, j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spans-\allowbreak{}pad-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, d, m, k, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(k, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, k, w, m) \wedge \\ \quad k \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{mat}(j, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; \operatorname{spans}(d, j, a, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s, a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}exists-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s, a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s_{2}, m_{2}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s_{2}, m_{2}) \Rightarrow (a = m_{2})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rank-bound-proof.scm}{theorem-library/rank-bound-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small rank-bound-proof.scm -- Proposition 3.41 (algebraic-numbers.pdf ch.3 sec 8.2), the payoff of the whole Smith arc:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}generators}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, m, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{mat}(m, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, m, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq n \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/binomial-proof.scm}{theorem-library/binomial-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small binomial-proof.scm -- machine proof of the Binomial Theorem (SUM form), PROVEN by ordinary induction, IMPS-style (docs/algebra.t).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}expansion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(r), g \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum}(r, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(x, g((k - 1))), \operatorname{mul}(r)(y, g(k)))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{add}(r)(x, y), \operatorname{sum}(r, g, n)), \operatorname{mul}(r)(x, g(-1))), \operatorname{mul}(r)(y, g(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{binomial-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, \operatorname{add}(r)(x, y), n) = \operatorname{sum}(r, \operatorname{comb\text{-}kk}(r, x, y, n), (n + 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/zz-ring-arith.scm}{theorem-library/zz-ring-arith.scm}
\noindent{\small zz-ring-arith.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/la-z5-zzmod.scm, so that files of library algebra may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of la-z5-zzmod.scm's.  Loaded immediately before ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (y \in \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(x, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(y)) = (x + -y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, b.\; (((t \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(t, b) = (t \cdot b)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rr-zero-mul.scm}{theorem-library/rr-zero-mul.scm}
\noindent{\small rr-zero-mul.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/taylor-proof.scm, so that files of library core may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of taylor-proof.scm's.  Loaded immediately before taylor-proof.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \cdot v) = 0)}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/poly-is-ring-proof.scm}{theorem-library/poly-is-ring-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small poly-is-ring-proof.scm -- POLY(A) is a ring when A is a ring.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{poly}(a)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-poly.scm}{theorem-library/gal-poly.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-poly.scm -- F[x]: degree of a product, division with remainder, F[x] a Euclidean domain, a PID and a UFD, evaluation and roots (galois-theory notes, Proposition 1.9, Corollary 1.10, Proposition 1.43, Corollaries 1.45, 1.46, 1.48) (GALOIS B2, 2026-10-26). Destination: theorem-library/gal-poly.scm, library algebra.  ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f, g)(k) = \operatorname{add}(a)(f(k), g(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f)(k) = \operatorname{neg}(a)(f(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f, g) = \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), n, d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, f, n) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, g, d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, g), (n + d)) \end{array}}}
