\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}coef}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), n, d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, f, n) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, g, d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, g)((n + d)) = \operatorname{mul}(a)(f(n), g(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{field-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}deg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(a) \wedge (\neg (f = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(a))) \wedge \neg (g = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\neg (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f, g) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(a))) \wedge (\operatorname{deg}(a, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f, g)) = (\operatorname{deg}(a, f) + \operatorname{deg}(a, g)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{poly}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monomial-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a), e \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, \operatorname{monomial}(a, c, e), e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{deg-\allowbreak{}drop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall h \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, h, n) \wedge (h(n) = \operatorname{zero}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (h = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(a))) \vee (\operatorname{deg}(a, h) < n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}division-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall a, \mathit{pb} \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge ((\operatorname{deg}(k, a) < b) \wedge \neg (\mathit{pb} = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad a = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\mathit{pb}, s) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deg}(k, \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(a, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\mathit{pb}, s)))) < \operatorname{deg}(k, \mathit{pb}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}division-\allowbreak{}with-\allowbreak{}remainder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \neg (b = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s, r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((a = \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(b, s), r)) \wedge ((r = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k))) \vee (\operatorname{deg}(k, r) < \operatorname{deg}(k, b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}degree-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}degree-\allowbreak{}function}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}degree\text{-}function}(\operatorname{poly}(k), (\lambda z \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)).\; \operatorname{deg}(k, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euclidean-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}pid}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}pid}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}euclidean-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{poly}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}pid-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}ufd}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{is\text{-}pid}(\operatorname{poly}(k)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}ufd}(\operatorname{poly}(k))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}single-\allowbreak{}coef}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), n, d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (i = n) \Rightarrow (f(i) = \operatorname{zero}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, g)((n + d)) = \operatorname{mul}(a)(f(n), g(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}stable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(a), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{mul}(a)(p(k), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{deg}(a, p) + j) + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(a), (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{mul}(a)(p(k), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, k))), (\operatorname{deg}(a, p) + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, p, n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, p, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(a), (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{mul}(a)(p(k), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, k))), (n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(p, q), t) = \operatorname{add}(a)(\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, p, t), \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, q, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}single-\allowbreak{}low}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), n, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (i = n) \Rightarrow (f(i) = \operatorname{zero}(a))) \wedge (k < n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, g)(k) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}monomial-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}partial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a), e \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(a), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \operatorname{monomial}(a, c, e), s)(k), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (e + j)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{mul}(a)(c, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, e)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(a), (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{mul}(a)(s(k), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, k))), j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}monomial-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a), e \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(\operatorname{monomial}(a, c, e), s), t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{mul}(a)(c, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, e)), \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}x-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \operatorname{carr}(a), s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(\operatorname{x\text{-}minus}(a, l), s), t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{add}(a)(t, \operatorname{neg}(a)(l)), \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}degree-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{one}(a) = \operatorname{zero}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{x\text{-}minus}(a, l) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a))) \wedge (\neg (\operatorname{x\text{-}minus}(a, l) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(a))) \wedge (\operatorname{deg}(a, \operatorname{x\text{-}minus}(a, l)) = 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, p, 0)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, p, t) = p(0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, p, t) \in \operatorname{carr}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}x-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}divides}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)), l \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, l) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{divides}(\operatorname{poly}(k), \operatorname{x\text{-}minus}(k, l), p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}roots-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}most-\allowbreak{}degree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)), l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \quad (l(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, l(i)) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((l(i) = l(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq \operatorname{deg}(k, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}vanishing-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)), l \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, (\operatorname{deg}(k, p) + 1)), \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, a) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Leftrightarrow \forall b \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(b) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{infinite-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}injections}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \neg (|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{gin}.\; (\mathit{gin} \in \operatorname{injection}(\operatorname{interval}(1, n), s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(q), t) = \operatorname{neg}(a)(\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, q, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}determined-\allowbreak{}by-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \neg (|\operatorname{carr}(k)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (p = q) \Leftrightarrow \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, a) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, q, a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-interp.scm}{theorem-library/gal-interp.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-interp.scm -- Lagrange interpolation (galois-theory notes, Proposition 1.47, Corollary 1.49) and the root bound for x\textasciicircum{}d = 1 (Proposition 1.64, first sentence) (GALOIS, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/gal-interp.scm, library algebra. Load window: after gal-poly (and so after gal-ufd and the galois ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, f, n) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, g, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f, g), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, f, n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}vanishing-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}points}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (h(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{gnn} \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(k, \mathit{gnn}, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, \mathit{gnn}, h(i)) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \neg (t = h(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, \mathit{gnn}, t) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}interpolation-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k, h, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (h(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad (h(i) = h(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (v(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(k, p, m) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, h(i)) = v(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}interpolation-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k, h.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (h(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad (h(i) = h(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(k, p, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(k, q, m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, h(i)) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, q, h(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p = q \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, m.\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}le}(a, m) \simeq \{l \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)) : \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(a, l, m)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eval-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}points-\allowbreak{}bijective-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}distinct}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (h(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eval\text{-}at\text{-}points}(k, h, m) \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}le}(k, m), (\operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)) \to \operatorname{carr}(k))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (h(i) = h(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\lambda k \in \mathrm{OS}(n).\; (k + 1)) \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathrm{OS}(n), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}enumeration}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (|s| = n) \Rightarrow \exists h.\; (h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, n), s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}maps-\allowbreak{}are-\allowbreak{}polynomials}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(k)| = (m + 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda p \in \operatorname{poly\text{-}le}(k, m).\; (\lambda t \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, t))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}le}(k, m), (\operatorname{carr}(k) \to \operatorname{carr}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}monomial}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{poly}(a)) = \operatorname{monomial}(a, \operatorname{one}(a), 0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}monomial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a), e \in \mathbb{N}, t \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(a, \operatorname{monomial}(a, c, e), t) = \operatorname{mul}(a)(c, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(a, t, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unity-\allowbreak{}roots-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}most-\allowbreak{}d}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall d, m \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \quad (l(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(k, l(i), d) = \operatorname{one}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((l(i) = l(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq d \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-smith.scm}{theorem-library/gal-smith.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-smith.scm -- invariance of the gcd of the s-minors (galois-theory notes, Corollary 1.24) and the uniqueness of the Smith normal form (Proposition 1.27) over a Euclidean domain (GALOIS, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/gal-smith.scm, library algebra.  Load window: after la-z sdet files (sdet-divisor-equiv, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{mutual-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}associated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{divides}(s, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{divides}(s, b, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{associated}(s, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdet-\allowbreak{}gcd-\allowbreak{}associated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall m, n, g \in \mathbb{N}, a, b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(s)), d, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(s, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(s, \operatorname{sdet}(s, m, n, a, g), d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(s, \operatorname{sdet}(s, m, n, b, g), e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{associated}(s, d, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}gcd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(s)), g \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(s, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad g \leq m \wedge \\ \quad g \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(s, \operatorname{sdet}(s, m, n, d, g), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, g).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}propagates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, s.; \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(s)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad (k + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad (k + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, (\lambda \mathit{pk} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{pk}, \mathit{pk})), \operatorname{interval}(1, k)) = \operatorname{zero}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(d, (k + 1), (k + 1)) = \operatorname{zero}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{smith-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, a, d, \mathit{dd} \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(s)), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(s, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(s, m, n, a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(s, m, n, \mathit{dd}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dd}, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dd}, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(s, m, n, a, \mathit{dd}) \wedge \\ \quad (k + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad (k + 1) \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{associated}(s, \operatorname{entry}(d, (k + 1), (k + 1)), \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dd}, (k + 1), (k + 1))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-charpoly.scm}{theorem-library/gal-charpoly.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-charpoly.scm -- the characteristic polynomial of a companion matrix (galois-theory notes, Proposition 1.37) (GALOIS B6, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/gal-charpoly.scm, library linear-algebra.  Load window: after the determinant files (det-expand-row, det-1x1, det-upper-triangular, minor-entry), ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{companion-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}.; \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, v), i, j) = \left(\text{if }(j = v)\text{ then }\operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{av}(i))\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(i = (j + 1))\text{ then }\operatorname{one}(r)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(r)\right)\right) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{companion-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, v) \in \operatorname{mat}(v, v, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{char-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(v, v, \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, m, v) \in \operatorname{mat}(v, v, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(r))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, m, v), i, j) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(r))(\left(\text{if }(i = j)\text{ then }\operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{one}(r), 1)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(r))\right), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(r))(\operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{entry}(m, i, j), 0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}monomial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(r), e \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(r))(\operatorname{monomial}(r, c, e)) = \operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{neg}(r)(c), e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}monomial-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.; \forall e \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{zero}(r), e) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(r))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, v) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(r))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(r))(\operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{one}(r), 1), \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, (\lambda h \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{av}((h + 1))), v)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{av}(1), 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}sign}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, (\lambda o \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r))), \operatorname{interval}(1, v)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{char-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}companion-\allowbreak{}row1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((1 \leq v) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)), (v + 1)), 1, 1) = \operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{one}(r), 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)), (v + 1)), 1, (v + 1)) = \operatorname{monomial}(r, \operatorname{av}(1), 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\neg (j = 1) \wedge \neg (j = (v + 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)), (v + 1)), 1, j) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{char-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}companion-\allowbreak{}minor11}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((1 \leq v) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{minor}(\operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)), (v + 1)), 1, 1, v) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, (\lambda h \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{av}((h + 1))), v), v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{char-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}companion-\allowbreak{}corner-\allowbreak{}det}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((1 \leq v) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{poly}(r), v, \operatorname{minor}(\operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)), (v + 1)), 1, (v + 1), v)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(\operatorname{poly}(r)), \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(r))(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{poly}(r))), v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, v, 0) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{poly}(r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{companion-\allowbreak{}congruence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}, \mathit{bv}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{bv}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) = \operatorname{bv}(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, v) = \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{bv}, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}congruence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}, \mathit{bv}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{bv}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) = \operatorname{bv}(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, v) = \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{bv}, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{charpoly-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}companion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall \mathit{av} \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)) \to \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{char\text{-}poly}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)), (v + 1)) = \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-op.scm}{theorem-library/gal-op.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-op.scm -- a linear operator as an F[x]-module; cyclic vectors, the Krylov basis, the companion matrix and the minimum polynomial (galois-theory notes, section 7, Proposition 1.36) (GALOIS B6, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/gal-op.scm, library linear-algebra. Helper prefix go-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, k) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, \operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, b), k) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, a, k), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, b, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), a \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, \operatorname{act}(d)(c, a), k) = \operatorname{act}(d)(c, \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, a, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, t(w), k) = t(\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, d, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, \operatorname{vzero}(d), k) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall h \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(g, h, \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) = \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(g, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; h((k + 1))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, n), i, 1) = \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, (i - 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, n) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lincomb-\allowbreak{}krylov}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{entry}(c, 1, (k + 1)), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \Rightarrow (p(k) \in \operatorname{carr}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}stable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(d)(p(k), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), p) + j) + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(d)(p(k), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), p) + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(\operatorname{scal}(d), p, n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, w) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(d)(p(k), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, k))), (n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, w) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{vzero}(d)) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, x), \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{act}(d)(c, x)) = \operatorname{act}(d)(c, \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, d, t, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \forall i \in \mathrm{OS}(n).\; (g(i) \in \operatorname{vec}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), g, n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), (\lambda \mathit{gti} \in \mathbb{N}.\; t(g(\mathit{gti}))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}commutes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, t(w)) = t(\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}iter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, j)) = \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, w), j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathrm{OS}(n).\; (g(i) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathrm{OS}(n).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, g(i)) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), g, n)) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}kills-\allowbreak{}krylov-\allowbreak{}span}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge (\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, n))) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}free}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) : \exists c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; (x = \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, u))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, u) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), x \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \exists c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; (x = \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(d) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), x \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(d)(r, x) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(u, i, 1) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), m \in \mathbb{N}, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \forall i \in \mathrm{OS}(m).\; (g(i) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), g, m) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, n, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad k(\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, k, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{gpk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(d))(k(\mathit{gpk})), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, \mathit{gpk}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}low-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}span}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad k(\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, k, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \wedge \\ \quad i < \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, i) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}span}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad k(\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, k, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), x \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad k(\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, k, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t(x) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}iterates-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}span}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad k(\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, k, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, j) \in \operatorname{lin\text{-}span}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}generates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad k(\operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, k, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}vector}(d, t, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{annihilating-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}minimal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t, v, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}vector}(d, t, v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, k) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}minimal\text{-}poly}(d, t, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{gcra}.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x.; \forall a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, x), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}as\text{-}row}(a, n, j) \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{col-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{gcra}.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x.; \forall a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, x), j, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{col\text{-}as\text{-}row}(a, n, j), 1, k) = \operatorname{entry}(a, k, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}.; \forall x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (\forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (x = v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, v)(x) = \operatorname{one}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}low}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}.; \forall x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (\forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (x < v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, v)(x) = \operatorname{av}((x + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}high}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}.; \forall x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (\forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (v < x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, v)(x) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}deg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (\neg (\operatorname{one}(r) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, v).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{deg}(r, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, v)) = v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}monic}(r, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krylov-\allowbreak{}companion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall \mathit{nv} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \mathit{nv} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{nv}).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv}), v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv}), t, \operatorname{companion}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyclic-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}companion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t, v.; \forall \mathit{nv} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}vector}(d, t, v) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \mathit{nv} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{nv}).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv}), t, \operatorname{companion}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}minimal\text{-}poly}(d, t, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-op2.scm}{theorem-library/gal-op2.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-op2.scm -- the matrix of an operator in a basis is unique; (pq)(T) = p(T) q(T); nilpotent operators with a cyclic vector (galois-theory notes, Example 1.39); Cayley-Hamilton for an operator with a cyclic vector (GALOIS B6, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/gal-op2.scm, library linear-algebra. Load window: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{matrix-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), t, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, n, u, t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, n, u, t, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}hamilton-\allowbreak{}cyclic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t, v.; \forall \mathit{nv} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}vector}(d, t, v) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \mathit{nv} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{nv}).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv}), t, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{char\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), a, \mathit{nv}) = \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{char\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), a, \mathit{nv}), w) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}monomial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), e \in \mathbb{N}, w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{monomial}(\operatorname{scal}(d), c, e), w) = \operatorname{act}(d)(c, \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}padd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(p, q), w) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, w), \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, q, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(d), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, j), e) = \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, (j + e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}monomial-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}partial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), e \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \operatorname{monomial}(\operatorname{scal}(d), c, e), s)(k), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (e + j)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(d)(c, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(d)(s(k), \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, k))), j), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}monomial-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), e \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(\operatorname{monomial}(\operatorname{scal}(d), c, e), s), w) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(d)(c, \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, s, w), e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, d, t.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(\operatorname{scal}(d), p, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(p, q), w) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, q, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(p, q), w) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, q, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}vanishes-\allowbreak{}beyond}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), m, a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, m) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \wedge (m \leq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, a) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{field-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge (\neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge (\operatorname{act}(d)(c, x) = \operatorname{vzero}(d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nilpotent-\allowbreak{}least-\allowbreak{}index}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), a, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, k, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k(a) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < a) \Rightarrow (k(i) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, m) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, v, j) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \Rightarrow (m \leq j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nilpotent-\allowbreak{}annihilator-\allowbreak{}low}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k.; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nilpotent\text{-}op}(d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, k) \wedge \\ \quad i < \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k(i) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nilpotent-\allowbreak{}annihilator-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nilpotent\text{-}op}(d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k = \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)).\; \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}annihilating-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t, v, a, b. \\ \quad ((a = b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nilpotent-\allowbreak{}cyclic-\allowbreak{}vector}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t, v, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nilpotent\text{-}op}(d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}vector}(d, t, v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, k) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k = \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)).\; \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k), \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)), t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{companion}(\operatorname{scal}(d), (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k)).\; \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), \operatorname{deg}(\operatorname{scal}(d), k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}minimal\text{-}poly}(d, t, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{annihilating-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}divides}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), k.; \forall q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, q, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; (q = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(k, s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rr-mul-le-cancel.scm}{theorem-library/rr-mul-le-cancel.scm}
\noindent{\small rr-mul-le-cancel.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/primitive-uniform-limit.scm, so that files of library core may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of primitive-uniform-limit.scm's.  Loaded ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, c, m \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < c) \wedge ((a \cdot c) \leq (m \cdot c))) \Rightarrow (a \leq m))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccint-basics.scm}{theorem-library/ccint-basics.scm}
\noindent{\small ccint-basics.scm -- CCINT's membership law, PROVEN from its definition.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, x.\; ((x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \leq x) \wedge (x \leq b))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}elt-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (x \in \mathbb{R})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ivt-proof.scm}{theorem-library/ivt-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small ivt-proof.scm -- the INTERMEDIATE VALUE THEOREM, PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ivt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b, c. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, x) \wedge \\ \quad f(a) \leq c \wedge \\ \quad c \leq f(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((p \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge (f(p) = c)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/monotone-inverse.scm}{theorem-library/monotone-inverse.scm}
\noindent{\small monotone-inverse.scm -- MONOTONICITY VOCABULARY FOR REAL FUNCTIONS, and the EXISTENCE HALF of the inverse function theorem on a closed interval. Everything here is `modulo 0'.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strict-\allowbreak{}increase-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, s.; \forall u, v \in s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strictly\text{-}increasing\text{-}on}(f, s) \wedge (f(u) = f(v))) \Rightarrow (u = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b.; \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(f(a), f(b)). \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strictly\text{-}increasing\text{-}on}(f, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad (f(p) = y) \wedge \forall q \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; ((f(q) = y) \Rightarrow (p = q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}order}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strictly\text{-}increasing\text{-}on}(f, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge (f(u) < f(v))) \Rightarrow (u < v) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/sq-continuous.scm}{theorem-library/sq-continuous.scm}
