\noindent{\small sq-continuous.scm -- z |-$>$ z*z is a function RR -$>$ RR and is CONTINUOUS at every real point, PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sq-\allowbreak{}fun-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; (z \cdot z)) \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sq-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; (z \cdot z)), t)}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/sqrt-defined.scm}{theorem-library/sqrt-defined.scm}
\noindent{\small sqrt-defined.scm -- SQRT DEFINED by the intermediate value theorem, and the five supports that used to characterise it RETIRED as theorems.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq a) \Rightarrow \exists x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq x) \wedge ((x \cdot x) = a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad (((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (y \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge (((0 \leq x) \wedge (0 \leq y)) \wedge ((x \cdot x) = (y \cdot y)))) \Rightarrow (x = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 \leq a) \Rightarrow ((\sqrt{a} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq \sqrt{a}) \wedge ((\sqrt{a} \cdot \sqrt{a}) = a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}char}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq a)) \wedge (((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq x)) \wedge ((x \cdot x) = a))) \Rightarrow (\sqrt{a} = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq a) \Rightarrow ((\sqrt{a} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \sqrt{a})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq a) \Rightarrow ((\sqrt{a} \cdot \sqrt{a}) = a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\sqrt{(a \cdot a)} = \lvert a \rvert)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 \leq a) \wedge (a \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\sqrt{a} \leq \sqrt{b}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge (0 \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\sqrt{(a \cdot b)} = (\sqrt{a} \cdot \sqrt{b})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-magnitude.scm}{theorem-library/cc-magnitude.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-magnitude.scm -- the complex modulus, PROVEN from its definition.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \in \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (0 \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\sqrt{0} = 0}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, s.\; (((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq s) \wedge ((t \cdot t) \leq (s \cdot s))))) \Rightarrow (t \leq s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(z) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (z = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(-z) = \operatorname{magnitude}(z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(a) = \lvert a \rvert)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((a \cdot b)) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((a + b)) \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}(a) + \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-normed-field.scm}{theorem-library/cc-normed-field.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-normed-field.scm -- IS-NORMED-FIELD(CC-NORMED-FIELD), PROVED.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-metric-space-proof.scm}{theorem-library/cc-metric-space-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-metric-space-proof.scm -- IS-METRIC-SPACE(CC-MS), PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow ((a - b) \in \mathbb{C}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((a - b) = 0))) \Rightarrow (a = b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/complex-inner-product-laws.scm}{theorem-library/complex-inner-product-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small complex-inner-product-laws.scm -- what a sesquilinear form does in its SECOND argument, and the two expansion identities that follow.  All PROVEN modulo 0.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}conjugate-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{conjugate}(-a) = -\operatorname{conjugate}(a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(y, z)) = (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) + \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{act}(v)(a, y)) = (\operatorname{conjugate}(a) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{vzero}(v)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}expand-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) + \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) + (\operatorname{conjugate}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) + \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}expand-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, b, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(b, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(b, y))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(a)) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)) + ((a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b)) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y))) + (((b \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(a)) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y))) + ((b \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b)) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/inner-product-inequalities.scm}{theorem-library/inner-product-inequalities.scm}
\noindent{\small inner-product-inequalities.scm -- CAUCHY-SCHWARZ and MINKOWSKI at the INNER-PRODUCT level, over a COMPLEX-INNER-PRODUCT-SPACE.  Both PROVEN modulo 0.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}schwarz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y))) \leq (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}minkowski}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert \leq (\lVert x \rVert + \lVert y \rVert) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-ip-normed-ag.scm}{theorem-library/rake-ip-normed-ag.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-ip-normed-ag.scm -- rake batch 5b E: the induced norm of a complex inner product makes the additive group of its vectors a NORMED ABELIAN GROUP.  The support proved here is}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, x.\; (\lVert x \rVert \simeq \sqrt{\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x) \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vzero}(v), z) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x), z) = -\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/monotone-convergence-proof.scm}{theorem-library/monotone-convergence-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small monotone-convergence-proof.scm -- MONOTONE CONVERGENCE on RR, PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}monotone-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq f((k + 1))) \wedge (m \leq n)) \Rightarrow (f(m) \leq f(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}convergence-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq f((k + 1))) \wedge \exists d \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/comparison-test-proof.scm}{theorem-library/comparison-test-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small comparison-test-proof.scm -- THE COMPARISON TEST for real series, PROVEN, together with the two order lemmas it rests on and the readouts that make a real partial sum computable.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f.\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, 0) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, k) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \in \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \simeq \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f(k) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, (k + 1)) \simeq (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) + f(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}monotone-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, (k + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}termwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \leq g(n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}convergent-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}above}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq f((k + 1))) \wedge \operatorname{converges}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k))(j) \simeq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k)) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}).\; ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert f(n) \rvert) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{comparison-\allowbreak{}test}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((0 \leq f(n)) \wedge (f(n) \leq g(n))) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \lvert \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \rvert \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert f(n) \rvert), k) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/series-abs-triangle.scm}{theorem-library/series-abs-triangle.scm}
\noindent{\small series-abs-triangle.scm -- |Sum\_\{n$<$k\} f(n)| $<$= Sum\_\{n$<$k\} |f(n)|, PROVEN, and `abs(0) = 0', which the tree did not state.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = \lvert f(j) \rvert) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \rvert \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/series-block-abs.scm}{theorem-library/series-block-abs.scm}
\noindent{\small series-block-abs.scm -- THE BLOCK TRIANGLE INEQUALITY, in the form a Cauchy argument can use, and the NN gap lemma under it.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}triangle-\allowbreak{}block}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = \lvert f(j) \rvert) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, (m + d)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, m)) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, (m + d)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}triangle-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, m \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = \lvert f(j) \rvert) \wedge (m \leq k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, m)) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, m)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-finsum-typing-nn.scm}{theorem-library/rake-finsum-typing-nn.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-finsum-typing-nn.scm -- two NN typing leaves of the rake, PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(k, l) \in \mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{falling-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{falling}(n, m) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (((n - m) \in \mathbb{N}) \vee (\operatorname{falling}(n, m) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{falling-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{falling}(n, m) \in \mathbb{N})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-asm-2.scm}{theorem-library/rake-asm-2.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-asm-2.scm -- RAKE-ASM agent RA-2 (2026-10-12): elementary laws that stood as ASSUMPTIONS (add-axiom! / support), each proven here under its EXACT name and statement (copied character for character from its definition site).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}singleton}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(m)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{prod\text{-}ord}(m, f, 1) = f(0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}singleton}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(r)).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sum}(r, f, 1) = f(0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}singleton}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(g, f, 1) = f(0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(m)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{prod\text{-}ord}(m, f, n) \in \operatorname{carr}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(m)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{prod\text{-}ord}(m, f, n) \in \operatorname{carr}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sum}(r, f, n) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(r)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sum}(r, f, n) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}reduce-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(g, f, (k + 1)) = \operatorname{reduce}(\operatorname{opr}(g), f, (k + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}reduce}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(g)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(g, f, n) = \operatorname{reduce}(\operatorname{opr}(g), f, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mpow-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mpow}(m, \operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), n) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{mpow}(m, x, n), \operatorname{mpow}(m, y, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mpow-\allowbreak{}mult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(m), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mpow}(m, \operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), n) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{mpow}(m, x, n), \operatorname{mpow}(m, y, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r), f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum}(r, (\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, f(i))), n) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \operatorname{sum}(r, f, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r), f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(r)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum}(r, (\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, f(i))), n) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \operatorname{sum}(r, f, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, a), \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, a), \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}assoc-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, (j \cdot k), a) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, j, \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall j, k \in \mathbb{Z}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, (j \cdot k), a) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, j, \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{falling-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{falling}(0, (k + 1)) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{falling-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{falling}((n + 1), (k + 1)) = ((n + 1) \cdot \operatorname{falling}(n, k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{choose-\allowbreak{}times-\allowbreak{}factorial-\allowbreak{}all}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{choose}(n, m) \cdot \operatorname{factorial}(m)) = \operatorname{falling}(n, m))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{choose-\allowbreak{}times-\allowbreak{}factorial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (m \leq n) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{choose}(n, m) \cdot \operatorname{factorial}(m)) = \operatorname{falling}(n, m)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-char.scm}{theorem-library/gal-char.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-char.scm -- primes in Z dividing binomial coefficients, the characteristic of a field and the Frobenius map (galois-theory notes, Lemma 1.12, Proposition 1.14) (GALOIS B8, 2026-10-26). Destination: theorem-library/gal-char.scm, library algebra.  Load window: after catools-gal-b1 (two-element-ideal), the binomial ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{euclid-\allowbreak{}lemma-\allowbreak{}euclidean-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}element}(s, p) \wedge \operatorname{divides}(s, p, \operatorname{mul}(s)(a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, p, a) \vee \operatorname{divides}(s, p, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, x \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{divides}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, x) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}nat-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \Rightarrow ((p \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 < p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}nat-\allowbreak{}euclid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, (a \cdot b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, a) \vee \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad ((0 < p) \wedge ((0 < m) \wedge (m < p))) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}nat-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}factorial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge (i < p)) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, \operatorname{factorial}(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}binomial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge ((0 < i) \wedge (i < p))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, \operatorname{choose}(p, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{choose-\allowbreak{}above-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m < k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{choose}(m, k) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{characteristic-\allowbreak{}kills}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, p.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(r, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), p, a) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{characteristic-\allowbreak{}multiple-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, p.; \forall c \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(r, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), (p \cdot c), \operatorname{one}(r)) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{comb-\allowbreak{}kk-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(r), j, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((j + k) = m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{comb\text{-}kk}(r, x, y, m)(k) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \operatorname{choose}(m, k), \operatorname{one}(r)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, x, k), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, y, j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{choose-\allowbreak{}diagonal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{choose}(n, n) = 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}collapse-\allowbreak{}first}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (((0 < i) \wedge (i \leq n)) \Rightarrow (f(i) = \operatorname{zero}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum}(r, f, (n + 1)) = f(0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frobenius-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, p.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(r, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, \operatorname{add}(r)(x, y), p) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, x, p), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, y, p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}nilpotent-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(r) \wedge (\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, a, (n + 1)) = \operatorname{zero}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frobenius-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(r) \wedge (\operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(r, p) \wedge (\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, a, p) = \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, b, p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/zz-primes.scm}{theorem-library/zz-primes.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/zz-primes.scm -- PRIME FACTORISATION AND EUCLID'S LEMMA (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes, Props. 1.9, 1.10; ALGNUM, 2026-10-26).  Primes are galois's IS-PRIME-NAT (gal-char-vocab: p in NN and a prime element of ZZ-RING). zz-is-euclidean-domain       Z is a Euclidean domain in the galois-theory sense (degree ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}euclidean-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, x) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, -x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}element}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(\lvert p \rvert))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}nat-\allowbreak{}associated-\allowbreak{}equal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge \operatorname{associated}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, q))) \Rightarrow (p = q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, q. \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ntq} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (q(\mathit{ntq}) \in \mathbb{Z}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert q(i) \rvert), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \lvert \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, q, \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \rvert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (a(q) \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, a(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}factorization-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (1 \leq a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}, p. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p(i)) \wedge (a = \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}factorization-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, q. \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, k)) = \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, q, \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k = m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, k), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)). \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad q(s(i)) = p(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multiples-\allowbreak{}count}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, c. \\ \quad ((d \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (d \cdot c)) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, k)\}| = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\neg (d = 0) \wedge (\neg (d = 1) \wedge \neg (d = -1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}common-\allowbreak{}prime}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \neg (n = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(k, n) \Leftrightarrow \forall q.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(q, n)) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(q, k)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/series-linearity.scm}{theorem-library/series-linearity.scm}
\noindent{\small series-linearity.scm -- LINEARITY OF THE REAL PARTIAL SUM, in POINTWISE form.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g, h. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) = (f(k) + g(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, n) = (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c, f, h. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) = (c \cdot f(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, n) = (c \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}weighted-\allowbreak{}expansion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, y, g, w, p, q, s. \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad y \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (g(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (w(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) = (w(k) \cdot ((x \cdot g((k - 1))) + (y \cdot g(k))))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q(k) = (w((k + 1)) \cdot g(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(k) = (w(k) \cdot g(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(p, (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (x \cdot ((w(0) \cdot g(-1)) + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(q, n))) + (y \cdot (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(s, n) + (w(n) \cdot g(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}termwise-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq g(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/bernstein-basis.scm}{theorem-library/bernstein-basis.scm}
\noindent{\small bernstein-basis.scm -- the Bernstein basis polynomials, and the first of the two identities Proposition 5.4 of docs/calculus.pdf asks for.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, \operatorname{one}(r), n) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) \simeq \operatorname{sum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{binomial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, x, y. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum}(r, \operatorname{comb\text{-}kk}(r, x, y, n), (n + 1)) = \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, \operatorname{add}(r)(x, y), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x) \simeq \operatorname{comb\text{-}kk}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), x, (1 - x), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x) \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}partition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x), (n + 1)) = 1 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/bernstein-moments.scm}{theorem-library/bernstein-moments.scm}
\noindent{\small bernstein-moments.scm -- the moments of the Bernstein basis, and identity (76) of docs/calculus.pdf Proposition 5.4.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}((n + 1), x)(k) \\ \quad \quad =\; (x \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)((k - 1))) + ((1 - x) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (k < 0)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}above}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (n < k)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}weighted-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, w, p, q, s. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (w(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) = (w(k) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}((n + 1), x)(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q(k) = (w((k + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(k) = (w(k) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(p, ((n + 1) + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (x \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(q, (n + 1))) + ((1 - x) \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(s, (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}moment-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, h. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) = (k \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, (n + 1)) = (n \cdot x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}moment-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, h. \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) = ((k \cdot (k - 1)) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, (n + 1)) = ((n \cdot (n - 1)) \cdot (x \cdot x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}variance}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, h. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad h(k) = (((k - (n \cdot x)) \cdot (k - (n \cdot x))) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, (n + 1)) = ((n \cdot x) \cdot (1 - x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}variance-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, h. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (n = 0) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad h(k) = (((k - (n \cdot x)) \cdot (k - (n \cdot x))) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (/(1, n) \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, (n + 1))) \leq 1 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/series-cauchy-proof.scm}{theorem-library/series-cauchy-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small series-cauchy-proof.scm -- THE CAUCHY CRITERION FOR REAL SERIES, PROVEN.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}criterion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((d \leq m) \wedge (m \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lvert (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, m)) \rvert \leq s \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/dominated-convergence.scm}{theorem-library/dominated-convergence.scm}
\noindent{\small dominated-convergence.scm -- DOMINATED CONVERGENCE, PROVEN, in two forms: for real series (the content) and in ELL-ONE (the statement the user asked for), together with the twenty limit / partial-sum / complex-magnitude lemmas the two are assembled from.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, 0) \wedge (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, 0) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(j) = (f(j) + g(j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), v, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, v) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lvert f(n) \rvert \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert v \rvert \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}block-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((0 \leq f(i)) \wedge (f(i) \leq g(i))) \wedge (n \leq k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(j) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(j)(i)), 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d(j) = \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(u(j), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, d, 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(i)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, m \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(i)) \wedge (m \leq k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, m) \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (d \leq k) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, d)) \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dominated-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}series}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), u. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(j) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((0 \leq u(j)(i)) \wedge (u(j)(i) \leq g(i))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(j)(i)), 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(u(j), e(j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, e, 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}to}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, \operatorname{series\text{-}limit}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{series\text{-}limit}(f) \in \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f, g, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(i) = (f(i) + g(i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, k) = (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(i)) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall x \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, x) \leq d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(i) = (f(i) + g(i))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (v \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})(u, v) \simeq \operatorname{magnitude}((u - v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((p - q)) \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}(p) + \operatorname{magnitude}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((p - q)) = \operatorname{magnitude}((q - p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(p) \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}((p - q)) + \operatorname{magnitude}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), v \in \mathbb{C}, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s, v) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(s(n)) \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(v) \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), v \in \mathbb{C}, m \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s, v) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m(j) = \operatorname{magnitude}((s(j) - v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m, 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ell-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall y. \\ \quad (y \in \operatorname{ell\text{-}one}) \Leftrightarrow ((y \in \mathbb{C}^{\mathbb{N}}) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(y(k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ell-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}dominated-\allowbreak{}convergence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), x \in \mathbb{C}^{\mathbb{N}}, e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), s. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(j) \in \mathbb{C}^{\mathbb{N}}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(s(j)(k)) \leq a(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(j)(k)), x(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad e(j) = \operatorname{series\text{-}limit}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}((s(j)(k) - x(k))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (x \in \operatorname{ell\text{-}one}) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, e, 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-complete-proof.scm}{theorem-library/cc-complete-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-complete-proof.scm -- CC IS A COMPLETE METRIC SPACE.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (w \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((z - w)) = (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) - \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (w \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((z - w)) = (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) - \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \rvert \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\lvert \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) \rvert \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}im}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq (\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \rvert + \lvert \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) \rvert))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}dominated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \wedge \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lvert (p(m) - p(n)) \rvert \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((f(m) - f(n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}coords}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g, q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), v \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(f(n)) = g(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(f(n)) = q(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, q, \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/series-abs-converges.scm}{theorem-library/series-abs-converges.scm}
\noindent{\small series-abs-converges.scm -- ABSOLUTE CONVERGENCE IMPLIES CONVERGENCE, for real series.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = \lvert f(j) \rvert) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-magnitude-zero.scm}{theorem-library/cc-magnitude-zero.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-magnitude-zero.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/cc-series.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by five analysis files; CC arithmetic. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. cc-magnitude-zero}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{magnitude}(0) = 0}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-series.scm}{theorem-library/cc-series.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-series.scm -- THE COMPLEX SERIES LAYER: ordered partial sums in CC, and their convergence in CC-MS.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, 0) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, k) \in \mathbb{C} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \in \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \simeq \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (f(k) \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, (k + 1)) \simeq (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) + f(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = \operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k)) \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/poly-fn-laws.scm}{theorem-library/poly-fn-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small poly-fn-laws.scm -- laws of polynomial functions (CA-MONTEL "POLY", 2026-10-26).  Vocabulary: poly-fn-vocab.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix pfl-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cf-\allowbreak{}cons-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cf\text{-}cons}(b, c) \simeq (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b \cdot \operatorname{power}(0, k)) + ((1 - \operatorname{power}(0, k)) \cdot c(\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(k, 1)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cf-\allowbreak{}cons-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b \in \mathbb{C}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{cf\text{-}cons}(b, c)(0) = b)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cf-\allowbreak{}cons-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b \in \mathbb{C}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{cf\text{-}cons}(b, c)((j + 1)) = c(j))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cf-\allowbreak{}cons-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall b \in k, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cf\text{-}cons}(b, c) \in (\mathbb{N} \to k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}cons}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, b \in \mathbb{C}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{cf\text{-}cons}(b, c)(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad =\; b + (z \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}stable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + m)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}subring-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall z \in k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{power}(z, i) \in k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}subring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k), z \in k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n) \in k \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c, d, e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l, \mathit{pfbe}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (e(k) = ((l \cdot c(k)) + (\mathit{pfbe} \cdot d(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (e(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n) \\ \quad \quad =\; (l \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n)) + (\mathit{pfbe} \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f.; \forall g \in (a \to k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f) \wedge \forall z \in a.\; (g(z) = f(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall b \in k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (a \subseteq k)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}mulz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; (x \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}lin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f, g.; \forall l, e \in k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; ((l \cdot f(x)) + (e \cdot g(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) + g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f.; \forall l \in k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; (l \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (a \subseteq k)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}congr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c, d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(k) = d(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}ps}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, a.; \forall c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k), g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq k \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(x, j))), n) \cdot g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}ps}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, a.; \forall l, e \in k, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge ((a \subseteq k) \wedge \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(((l \cdot x) + e), j))), n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}affine}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, b, f, a.; \forall l, e \in k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, b, f) \wedge ((a \subseteq k) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (((l \cdot x) + e) \in b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; f(((l \cdot x) + e)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}ps}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, a, g.; \forall c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, g) \wedge \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(g(x), j))), n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}comp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, b, f, a, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (g(x) \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; f(g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}subring-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(\mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}subring-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(\mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}restrict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f, \mathit{pfaa}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f) \wedge (\mathit{pfaa} \subseteq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, \mathit{pfaa}, (\lambda x \in \mathit{pfaa}.\; f(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mono-le-limit.scm}{theorem-library/mono-le-limit.scm}
\noindent{\small mono-le-limit.scm -- A TERM OF A NONDECREASING CONVERGENT SEQUENCE IS AT MOST ITS LIMIT, and the corollary the product metric's zero law needs.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), \ell.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq f((k + 1))) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, \ell)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(m) \leq \ell \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), \ell.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(n)) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, \ell)) \Rightarrow (f(n) \leq \ell) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(n)) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, 0)) \Rightarrow (f(n) = 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/limit-arithmetic.scm}{theorem-library/limit-arithmetic.scm}
\noindent{\small limit-arithmetic.scm -- THE TWO LIMIT LAWS THE SERIES AND PRODUCT LANES WERE MISSING: `$<$=' carried across TWO limits, and the limit of a pointwise sum.  Plus the series readings of the second.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), v, a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \leq g(n)) \wedge (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, v) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad v \leq a \end{array}}}
