\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(d) \in ((\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)) \to \operatorname{vec}(d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(d) \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(d) \in ((\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)) \to \operatorname{vec}(d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}comm-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative}(\operatorname{vadd}(d), \operatorname{vec}(d)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}ident-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}identity}(\operatorname{vadd}(d), \operatorname{vzero}(d), \operatorname{vec}(d)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow \operatorname{has\text{-}inverses}(\operatorname{vadd}(d), \operatorname{vzero}(d), \operatorname{vneg}(d), \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(y, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{vneg}(d)(x), x) = \operatorname{vzero}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, b)) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{vneg}(d)(a), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, y, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{vec}(d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(z)) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, y, u, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{vec}(d)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(u, w))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(u)), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{vec}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{vneg}(d)(x), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{vneg}(d)(u))) = \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzq-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, r, x, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{vec}(d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{act}(d)(r, x), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{act}(d)(r, u))) = \operatorname{act}(d)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{qmod\text{-}rel}(d, m) \simeq \{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)) : (\operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{nth}(2, p))) \in m)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(b)) \in m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [a, b] \in \operatorname{qmod\text{-}rel}(d, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge ([a, b] \in \operatorname{qmod\text{-}rel}(d, m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(b)) \in m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}equivalence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equivalence}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}rel}(d, m), \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}setoid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}rel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{rel}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{qmod\text{-}rel}(d, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}related-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \operatorname{related}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), a, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(b)) \in m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}related-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(b)) \in m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{related}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), a) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), b)) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(b)) \in m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}lva-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{qma\_}, \operatorname{qmb\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{qma\_}, \operatorname{qmb\_}))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}lvn-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(a))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}lsc-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{act}(d)(r, a))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}lva-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects2}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{qma\_}, \operatorname{qmb\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{qma\_}, \operatorname{qmb\_})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}lvn-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}lsc-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{act}(d)(r, a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qmod\text{-}scale}(d, m, r) \in (\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}fun0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qmod\text{-}vadd}(d, m) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \times \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}fun0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qmod\text{-}vneg}(d, m) \in (\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qmod\text{-}act}(d, m) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \times \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{qmod\text{-}vadd}(d, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{vzero}(d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{qmod\text{-}vneg}(d, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \simeq \operatorname{qmod\text{-}act}(d, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), a), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall a \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), a)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, r, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qmod\text{-}scale}(d, m, r)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), a)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{act}(d)(r, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, r, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(r, \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), a)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(d, m), \operatorname{act}(d)(r, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}length}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{length}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) = 6) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \times \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \in (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \times \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}associative}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}identity}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)), \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}inverses}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}inverses}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)), \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(r, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)))(r, s), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}compat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)))(r, s), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(r, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}unital}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))), x) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{quotient-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(r, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ram-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)) \simeq r))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ram-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ram-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{add}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ram-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{zero}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ram-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{neg}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ram-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{mul}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a) \simeq \operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}).\; (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, y. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), x)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, x. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a))(r, \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), x)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(r, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, y. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), y) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(x, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(y)) \in \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, a)), x) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z3-dsum.scm}{theorem-library/la-z3-dsum.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z3-dsum.scm -- the direct sum of finitely many modules over one scalar ring is a module (LA-Z3, 2026-10-24).  Vocabulary: structure-library/la-z3-vocab (DIRECT-SUM, DSUM-VEC, DSUM-VADD, DSUM-VZERO, DSUM-VNEG, DSUM-ACT).  Prefix lzs-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \simeq \{v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{vec}(f(k)))) : \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (v(j) \in \operatorname{vec}(f(j)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{vec}(f(k)))). \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (g(j) \in \operatorname{vec}(f(j))) \Rightarrow (g \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f.; \forall g \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f). \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{vec}(f(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (g(j) \in \operatorname{vec}(f(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f, i, x. \\ \quad ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{vec}(f(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{vec}(f(k))) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vzero}(n, f) \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}fun0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vadd}(n, f) \in ((\operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \times \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)) \to \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}fun0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vneg}(n, f) \in (\operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \to \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dsum\text{-}act}(s, n, f) \in ((\operatorname{carr}(s) \times \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)) \to \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \simeq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \simeq \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \simeq \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vadd}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \simeq \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vzero}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \simeq \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vneg}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \simeq \operatorname{dsum\text{-}act}(s, n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(a, b) \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f.; \forall a \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(a) \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, r, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(r, a) \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, a, b, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(a, b)(i) = \operatorname{vadd}(f(i))(a(i), b(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, a, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(a)(i) = \operatorname{vneg}(f(i))(a(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, r, a, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(r, a)(i) = \operatorname{act}(f(i))(r, a(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(i) = \operatorname{vzero}(f(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}length}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) = 6 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}set2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \times \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \in (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \times \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}associative}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}identity}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)), \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}inverses}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}inverses}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)), \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(r, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f.; \forall r, a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)))(r, a), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(a, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}compat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f.; \forall r, a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)))(r, a), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(r, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(a, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}unital}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))), x) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{direct-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f.; \forall g \in \mathrm{Fun}(\operatorname{interval}(1, n)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (g(j) \in \operatorname{vec}(f(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, g, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(i) \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (g(j) = h(j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g = h \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z3-struct.scm}{theorem-library/la-z3-struct.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z3-struct.scm -- the first isomorphism theorem for modules, and linear algebra 3.49 (LA-Z3, 2026-10-24).  Vocabulary: structure-library/la-z3-vocab.  Prefix lzt-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{first-\allowbreak{}isomorphism-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(m, n, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(n).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (i(x) = y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; ((i(x) = \operatorname{vzero}(n)) \Leftrightarrow (x \in a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(m, a), n, \operatorname{descend}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(m, a), i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{class-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall q \in \operatorname{quotient}(s), a \in q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(s) \Rightarrow ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{class}(s, a) = q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{quotient-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}choice}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall q \in \operatorname{quotient}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(s) \Rightarrow (\varepsilon(q) \in q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzt-\allowbreak{}lc-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d))) \wedge (\operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coord-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad s) \\ \quad \quad =\; x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lincomb-\allowbreak{}coord}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lcc} \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, \mathit{lcc}, s))^{-1}(\operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s)) \\ \quad \quad =\; c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coord-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, x, y, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y)), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, j) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(d))(\operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, j), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(y), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coord-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, r, x, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\operatorname{act}(d)(r, x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, j) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(d))(r, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coord-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\operatorname{vzero}(d)), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, j) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coord-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, x, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\operatorname{vneg}(d)(x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, j) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(d))(\operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzt-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}modules}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}((\lambda \mathit{fmi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, \mathit{fmi}, \mathit{fmi})))(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}((\lambda \mathit{fmi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, \mathit{fmi}, \mathit{fmi})))(i)) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzt-\allowbreak{}ph-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a, x, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{phx} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (\lambda \mathit{phj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{entry}(m, \mathit{phj}, \mathit{phj}))), \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{phx}), 1, \mathit{phj}))))(x)(j) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{entry}(m, j, j))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzt-\allowbreak{}ph-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{entry}(m, j, j))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, j)))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzt-\allowbreak{}ph-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{entry}(m, j, j))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, j))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lincomb-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, c, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(s, j, 1) \in m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s) \in m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lincomb-\allowbreak{}matact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, c, m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s)) = \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{scal}(d), c, m), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c, g, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(r, n, n, g) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, c, g), 1, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(c, 1, j), \operatorname{entry}(g, j, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzt-\allowbreak{}ph-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{phx} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{entry}(m, j, j))), \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{phx}), 1, j))))(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i))))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; x \in a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzt-\allowbreak{}ph-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{phx} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{entry}(m, j, j))), \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{phx}), 1, j))))(x) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; w \end{array}}}
