\vnbentry{\texttt{quotient-\allowbreak{}by-\allowbreak{}diagonal-\allowbreak{}subgroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z4-free.scm}{theorem-library/la-z4-free.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z4-free.scm -- module homomorphisms and LINCOMB, isomorphisms of modules, the free module Z\textasciicircum{}n and its unit basis (LA-Z4, 2026-10-24).  Vocabulary: structure-library/la-z4-vocab (ZZ-POW, ZZ-UNITS, ZZ-ROW, MAP-SEQ) and la-z3-vocab (DIRECT-SUM, RING-AS-MODULE, IS-ISO-MODULE).  Prefix lzf-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{map-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, v, w, n, u. \\ \quad ((h \in (v \to w)) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, n, u) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{map-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, v, w, n, u, i. \\ \quad ((h \in (v \to w)) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, v)) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, n, u), i, 1) = h(\operatorname{entry}(u, i, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{map-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}block}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, v, w, m, k, u. \\ \quad ((h \in (v \to w)) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \leq m) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{mat}(m, 1, v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{block}(\operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, m, u), k, 1) = \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, k, \operatorname{block}(u, k, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzf-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, h, c, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(a, b, h) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)))) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h(\operatorname{lincomb}(a, n, c, u)) = \operatorname{lincomb}(b, n, c, \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, n, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h, n, c, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(a, b, h) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)))) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(a)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h(\operatorname{lincomb}(a, n, c, u)) = \operatorname{lincomb}(b, n, c, \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, n, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{iso-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(b, a, f^{-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{iso-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(b, c, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(a, c, \operatorname{compose}(g, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lincomb-\allowbreak{}single-\allowbreak{}support}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, c, u, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\neg (j = i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(u, j, 1) = \operatorname{vzero}(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, u) = \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{entry}(c, 1, i), \operatorname{entry}(u, i, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(a)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f), f(i), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)).\; x(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f, m, c, u, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(a)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, m, \operatorname{carr}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(m, 1, \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f), m, c, u)(i) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{lincomb}(f(i), m, c, \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, n, f)).\; x(i)), m, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n) \simeq \operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}((\lambda \mathit{zpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}((\lambda \mathit{zpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))(i)) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow (x(i) \in \mathbb{Z}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, y. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (x(i) = y(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(i) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k. \\ \quad (\lambda t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, k), 1, t)) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, k. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n), k, 1) = (\lambda t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, k), 1, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, k, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, k), 1, t))(i) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, k), 1, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, c, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, c, \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n))(i) = \operatorname{entry}(c, 1, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}row}(n, x) \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}row}(n, x), 1, i) = x(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, \operatorname{zz\text{-}row}(n, x), \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n)) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}generate}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{generates}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}free}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(a, b, h) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(a, \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : (h(x) = \operatorname{vzero}(b))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, w, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda \mathit{lcc} \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, \mathit{lcc}, s))^{-1}(x), w))(\operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, c, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}basis}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, w, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), w))(\operatorname{entry}(s, j, 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{entry}(w, j, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, w, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lex} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{lex}), w))(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)((\lambda \mathit{lex} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{lex}), w))(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lex} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{lex}), w))(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, w, r, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lex} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{lex}), w))(\operatorname{act}(d)(r, x)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lex} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(\mathit{lex}), w))(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), w))(\operatorname{vzero}(d)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vzero}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, m, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(m, n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, s))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{iso-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}generating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g, n, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(a, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(a, n, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(g, n, s) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{generates}(b, n, \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(g, n, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(b, n, \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(g, n, s)) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small ring-pow.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-E), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109e/ring-pow.scm. Library: linear-algebra.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n) \simeq \operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(r, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}((\lambda \mathit{rqpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r))(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}((\lambda \mathit{rqpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r))(i)) = r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r, n.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r, n.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) = r))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (x(i) = y(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(i) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(r, n, k), 1, t)) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}units}(r, n) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}units}(r, n), k, 1) = (\lambda t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(r, n, k), 1, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(r, n, k), 1, t))(i) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{unitrow}(r, n, k), 1, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n), n, c, \operatorname{ring\text{-}units}(r, n))(i) = \operatorname{entry}(c, 1, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x) \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{matmul-\allowbreak{}matscale-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}rect}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, k, p, q, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, k, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, p), q) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{matmul-\allowbreak{}matscale-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}rect}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, k, p, q, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, k, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, q)) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{transpose-\allowbreak{}matadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{matadd}(r, p, q), m, n) = \operatorname{matadd}(r, \operatorname{transpose}(p, m, n), \operatorname{transpose}(q, m, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{transpose-\allowbreak{}matscale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, c, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{matscale}(r, c, p), m, n) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, c, \operatorname{transpose}(p, m, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x, y, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(x, y)(i) = \operatorname{add}(r)(x(i), y(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, x, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(a, x)(i) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, x(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(x, y)) = \operatorname{matadd}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(a, x)) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, a, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, u), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, v), 1, n))), 1, 1) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{carr}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, x, y, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(x, y)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, z), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, z), 1, n))), 1, 1), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, z), 1, n))), 1, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, x, y, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, z), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(x, y)), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, z), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), 1, n))), 1, 1), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, z), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), 1, n))), 1, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, c, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(c, x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), 1, n))), 1, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ring-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, c, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(c, y)), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), 1, n))), 1, 1)) \end{array}}}

\operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, w), 1, n))), 1, 1), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, w), 1, n))), 1, 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, w), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(x, y)), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, w), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, x), 1, n))), 1, 1), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, w), \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), 1, n))), 1, 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rpfa} \in \operatorname{carr}(r), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(r, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(r, n))(\mathit{rpfa}, x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(r, n, y), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, c, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, c, \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n))(i) = \operatorname{entry}(c, 1, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}row}(n, x) \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}entry-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}row}(n, x), 1, i) = x(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, \operatorname{zz\text{-}row}(n, x), \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n)) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}generate-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{generates}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z4-dsum.scm}{theorem-library/la-z4-dsum.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z4-dsum.scm -- dropping trivial summands from a direct sum; Z/(1) is the zero module (LA-Z4, 2026-10-24).  Vocabulary: structure-library/la-z3-vocab (DIRECT-SUM, ZZ-MOD). Prefix lzu-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, l, i. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (k + l)) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((k + i) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \neg ((k + i) \leq k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}back}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, l, j. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (k + l)) \wedge ((j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge \neg (j \leq k)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(j, k) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l)) \wedge ((k + \operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(j, k)) = j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, i.\; (((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}((k + i), k) = i))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, j. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge (j \leq k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}drop-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, k, l, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (\operatorname{scal}(g(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (g(i) = f((k + i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), a \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)).\; (a = \operatorname{vzero}(f(i))) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{dpx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)).\; (\lambda \mathit{dpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{dpx}((k + \mathit{dpi}))))(x) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, l, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}drop-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, k, l, f, g, x, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(a)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(g(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (\operatorname{scal}(g(a)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (g(a) = f((k + a))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), b \in \operatorname{vec}(f(a)).\; (b = \operatorname{vzero}(f(a))) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{dpx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)).\; (\lambda \mathit{dpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{dpx}((k + \mathit{dpi}))))(x)(i) \\ \quad \quad =\; x((k + i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}drop-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, k, l, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (\operatorname{scal}(g(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (g(i) = f((k + i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), x \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)).\; (x = \operatorname{vzero}(f(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f), \operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, l, g), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{dpx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)).\; (\lambda \mathit{dpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{dpx}((k + \mathit{dpi}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}pad-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, k, l, f, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (\operatorname{scal}(g(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (g(i) = f((k + i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), x \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)).\; (x = \operatorname{vzero}(f(i))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, l, g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{dpy} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, l, g)).\; (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \left(\text{if }(j \leq k)\text{ then }\operatorname{vzero}(f(j))\text{ else }\operatorname{dpy}(\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(j, k))\right)))(y) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}drop-\allowbreak{}pad}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, k, l, f, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (\operatorname{scal}(g(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (g(i) = f((k + i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), x \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)).\; (x = \operatorname{vzero}(f(i))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, l, g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{dpx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)).\; (\lambda \mathit{dpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{dpx}((k + \mathit{dpi}))))((\lambda \mathit{dpy} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, l, g)).\; (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \left(\text{if }(j \leq k)\text{ then }\operatorname{vzero}(f(j))\text{ else }\operatorname{dpy}(\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(j, k))\right)))(y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzu-\allowbreak{}drop-\allowbreak{}inj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, k, l, f, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (\operatorname{scal}(g(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (g(i) = f((k + i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), x \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)).\; (x = \operatorname{vzero}(f(i))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda \mathit{dpx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)).\; (\lambda \mathit{dpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{dpx}((k + \mathit{dpi}))))(a) \\ \quad =\; (\lambda \mathit{dpx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)).\; (\lambda \mathit{dpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{dpx}((k + \mathit{dpi}))))(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dsum-\allowbreak{}drop-\allowbreak{}iso}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, k, l, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; (\operatorname{scal}(f(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (\operatorname{scal}(g(i)) = s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (g(i) = f((k + i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), x \in \operatorname{vec}(f(i)).\; (x = \operatorname{vzero}(f(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f), \operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, l, g), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{dpx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(s, m, f)).\; (\lambda \mathit{dpi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; \operatorname{dpx}((k + \mathit{dpi}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}mod-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}trivial}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(1)).\; (x = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(1)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z4-exist.scm}{theorem-library/la-z4-exist.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z4-exist.scm -- linear algebra 3.50, existence: a finitely generated abelian group is isomorphic to Z/(a\_1) + ... + Z/(a\_l) with invariant factors a\_1 | ... | a\_l, a\_i $>$= 0, a\_i /= 1 (LA-Z4, 2026-10-24).  Vocabulary: structure-library/la-z4-vocab (ZZ-POW, ZZ-UNITS, CYCLIC-SUM, IS-INVARIANT-FACTORS).  Prefix lzx-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzx-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}divides}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(1, z)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lzx-\allowbreak{}ones-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, m. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \psi \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(m, \psi, \psi)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \psi, j. \\ \quad \quad ((\psi \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (\psi \leq j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(m, \psi, \psi), \operatorname{entry}(m, j, j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; ((i \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\neg (i \leq k) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fg-\allowbreak{}abelian-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}structure-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(e) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(e))) \wedge \operatorname{generates}(e, n, u))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{N}, a, f. \\ \quad \quad \quad (l \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z4-schanuel.scm}{theorem-library/la-z4-schanuel.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z4-schanuel.scm -- Z\textasciicircum{}n computes componentwise; Z\textasciicircum{}(n+n) as pairs (SEQ-HEAD, SEQ-SHIFT, SEQ-JOIN); Schanuel's automorphism of Z\textasciicircum{}(n+n) (LA-Z4, 2026-10-24).  The device of the uniqueness half of 3.50 (la-z4-unique).  Vocabulary: structure-library/la-z4-vocab. Prefix lzc-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, y, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(x, y)(i) = \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(x(i), y(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(x)(i) = \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(x(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, x, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(r, x)(i) = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(r, x(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, z. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, z, i. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z)(i) = z(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, z. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, z) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, z, i. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, z)(i) = z((n + i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, l. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}join}(m, n, d, l) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}lo}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, l, j. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad j \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}join}(m, n, d, l)(j) = d(j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}hi}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, l, j. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (j \leq n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}join}(m, n, d, l)(j) = l(\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(j, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}join}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, l. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, \operatorname{seq\text{-}join}(m, n, d, l)) = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}join}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, l. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, \operatorname{seq\text{-}join}(m, n, d, l)) = l \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, z. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}join}(m, n, \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z), \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, z)) = z \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, v, w. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, v) = \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, v) = \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad v = w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, x, y. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, x), \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, x. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, r, x. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))(r, x)) = \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(r, \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m = (n + n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))) = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, x, y. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, x), \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, x. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, r, x. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (n + n)) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))(r, x)) = \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(r, \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m = (n + n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))) = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b, z. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b)(z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{seq\text{-}join}(m, n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, z), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(b(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, z), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(b(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z))))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b, z. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b)(z) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}head}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b, z. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b)(z)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, z), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(b(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b, z. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b)(z)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z), \\ \quad \quad \quad a(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(\operatorname{seq\text{-}shift}(n, z), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))(b(\operatorname{seq\text{-}head}(n, z)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b) \in (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b, z. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, b, a)(\operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b)(z)) = z \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m), \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schanuel-\allowbreak{}iso}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a, b. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (n + n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m), \operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(m), \operatorname{schanuel\text{-}map}(m, n, a, b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/la-z4-unique.scm}{theorem-library/la-z4-unique.scm}
\noindent{\small la-z4-unique.scm -- linear algebra 3.50, uniqueness: the invariant factors of a finitely generated abelian group are determined by it (LA-Z4, 2026-10-24).  Vocabulary: structure-library/la-z4-vocab.  Prefix lzy-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{free-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}lift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, y, x, i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(y, x, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{vec}(x).\; \exists c \in \operatorname{vec}(y).\; (i(c) = b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, x, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(y) = \operatorname{scal}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, y, m) \wedge \forall b \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (i(m(b)) = a(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}matact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, g, m, n, d, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(a, a, g) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a))) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matact}(a, d, \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(g, n, u)) = \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(g, m, \operatorname{matact}(a, d, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diag-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{diag\text{-}mat}(n, f) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diag-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f, i, j. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{Z})) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{diag\text{-}mat}(n, f), i, j) = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(f(i), \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n), i, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diag-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}diag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{Z})) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{diag\text{-}mat}(n, f), i, i) = f(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diag-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}diagonal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, \operatorname{diag\text{-}mat}(n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pad-\allowbreak{}ones-\allowbreak{}lo}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, l, f, j. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, l) \to \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad j \leq k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pad\text{-}ones}(m, k, f)(j) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pad-\allowbreak{}ones-\allowbreak{}hi}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, l, f, j. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, l) \to \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (j \leq k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pad\text{-}ones}(m, k, f)(j) = f(\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(j, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pad-\allowbreak{}ones-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, l, f. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m = (k + l)) \wedge (f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, l) \to \mathbb{Z})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pad\text{-}ones}(m, k, f) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, m) \to \mathbb{Z}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pad-\allowbreak{}ones-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, l, f.; \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, l) \to \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l).\; (0 \leq f(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{pad\text{-}ones}(m, k, f)(j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pad-\allowbreak{}ones-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k, l, f, i, j. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m = (k + l) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, l) \to \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ifi}, \mathit{ifj}. \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{ifi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l)) \wedge ((\mathit{ifj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l)) \wedge (\mathit{ifi} \leq \mathit{ifj}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(f(\mathit{ifi}), f(\mathit{ifj})) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{pad\text{-}ones}(m, k, f)(i), \operatorname{pad\text{-}ones}(m, k, f)(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}coord}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, j. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))) \wedge (j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}((\lambda c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n)))).\; \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, c, \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n)))^{-1}(x), \\ \quad \quad \quad 1, j) \\ \quad \quad =\; x(j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{Z})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{span}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), n, \operatorname{matact}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}pow}(n), \operatorname{diag\text{-}mat}(n, f), \operatorname{zz\text{-}units}(n))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (x(j) \in \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, f(j))) \end{array}}}
