\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s, g, h, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), h, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(g(z), h(z))), a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ms-compose-continuous.scm}{theorem-library/ms-compose-continuous.scm}
\noindent{\small compose.scm -- COMPOSITION OF CONTINUOUS MAPS BETWEEN METRIC SPACES, the global form.  Agent KIT-8, 2026-10-26. Destination: theorem-library/ (library analysis), right after the file proving ms-compose-continuous-at (theorem-library/ms-continuity-algebra.scm).  The POINTWISE theorems already exist and are NOT restated: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, u, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, m, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(m, u, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, u, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; g(f(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}dom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, d, m, u, f, g. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, m, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(m, u, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, u, (\lambda z \in d.\; g(f(z)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/riesz-markov-model.scm}{theorem-library/riesz-markov-model.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/riesz-markov-model.scm -- RIESZ-MARKOV, STAGE 1 (RM-1, 2026-10-10): the Cantor model K of a compact metric space and the map pi : K -$>$ s.  Vocabulary: structure-library/riesz-markov-model.scm. Source: the user's notes-63, concrete form (b).  Helper prefix: rmm-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.\; ((x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}two}) \Leftrightarrow ((x = 0) \vee (x = 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}two}.\; ((x = 0) \vee (x = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}makeset}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{rm\text{-}two} = \operatorname{make\text{-}set}([0, 1])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{rm\text{-}two} \subseteq \mathbb{R}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms}) \simeq \operatorname{rm\text{-}two})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}two}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms})(u, v) \simeq \lvert (u - v) \rvert)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}two}.\; ((\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms})(u, v) < 1) \Rightarrow (u = v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cantor-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cantor-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}) \simeq \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cantor-\allowbreak{}coord}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}), n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(n) \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}two})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{seq\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cantor-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cantor-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms} \simeq \operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms}), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}proj-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}). \\ \quad \operatorname{product\text{-}proj}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms}), n)(s) = s(n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{product\text{-}proj}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{rm\text{-}two\text{-}ms}), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}). \exists d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall b \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}).\; ((\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms})(s, b) \leq d) \Rightarrow (b(n) = s(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}). \exists d. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rab} \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}), i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms})(s, \mathit{rab}) \leq d) \wedge (i < b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rab}(i) = s(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, q(m)) < a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}centre-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow (q(\operatorname{nnfst}(n)) \in \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}rad-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\operatorname{recip}((\operatorname{nnsnd}(n) + 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, n, y. \\ \quad (y \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, n)) \Leftrightarrow ((y \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(s)(q(\operatorname{nnfst}(n)), y) \leq \operatorname{recip}((\operatorname{nnsnd}(n) + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}shell-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, n, y. \\ \quad (y \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}shell}(s, q, n)) \Leftrightarrow ((y \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{recip}((\operatorname{nnsnd}(n) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(s)(q(\operatorname{nnfst}(n)), y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}centre}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{nnsnd}(n) = j) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(s)(q(\operatorname{nnfst}(n)), x) < \operatorname{recip}((\operatorname{nnsnd}(n) + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}inside-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(s)(q(\operatorname{nnfst}(n)), x) < \operatorname{recip}((\operatorname{nnsnd}(n) + 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, n)) \wedge \neg (x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}shell}(s, q, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}strong-\allowbreak{}separation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \neg (x = y)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}shell}(s, q, n)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (y \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}shell}(s, q, m)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z.\; \neg ((z \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, n)) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}k-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, \mathit{es}. \\ \quad \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((\mathit{es} \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms})) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists y.\; \operatorname{rm\text{-}realizes}(s, q, \mathit{es}, n, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}k-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q) \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}realizes-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, \mathit{es}, b, a, y. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < a) \Rightarrow (b(i) = \operatorname{es}(i))) \wedge \operatorname{rm\text{-}realizes}(s, q, \mathit{es}, a, y)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}realizes}(s, q, b, a, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}k-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}). \\ \quad \neg (\mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall y.\; \neg \operatorname{rm\text{-}realizes}(s, q, \mathit{es}, n, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}k-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}k-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q) \in \mathbf{Set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}k-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}kms-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}kms-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)) \simeq \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}choice}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists w \in a.\; (w \in m(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to a).\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(k) \in m(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}address-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, \mathit{es}, y_{1}, y_{2}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge (\operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, y_{1}) \wedge \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, y_{2}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad y_{1} = y_{2} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}shell-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{rm\text{-}shell}(s, q, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}realizes-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, \mathit{es}, b, y.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}realizes}(s, q, \mathit{es}, b, y) \Rightarrow (y \in \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}address-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y.\; \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}address-\allowbreak{}eu}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, y) \wedge \forall z.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, z) \Rightarrow (y = z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}address-\allowbreak{}eu-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y. \\ \quad \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, z) \Rightarrow (y = z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, \operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(\mathit{es})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q), y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(\mathit{es}) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q) \in (\operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}code-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, x.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{rm\text{-}code}(s, q, x)(n) = 1) \Leftrightarrow (x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}ball}(s, q, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}code-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, x.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}code}(s, q, x) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rm\text{-}two}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cantor-\allowbreak{}pts-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rm\text{-}two}).\; (s \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}code-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}k}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rm\text{-}code}(s, q, x) \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}code-\allowbreak{}address}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \operatorname{rm\text{-}code}(s, q, x), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}code}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(\operatorname{rm\text{-}code}(s, q, x)) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q).\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(\mathit{es}) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}address-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, \mathit{es}, y.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}address}(s, q, \mathit{es}, y) \Rightarrow \operatorname{rm\text{-}address\text{-}below}(s, q, \mathit{es}, b, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, \mathit{es}, b, a, y. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < a) \Rightarrow (b(i) = \operatorname{es}(i))) \wedge \operatorname{rm\text{-}address\text{-}below}(s, q, b, a, y)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}address\text{-}below}(s, q, \mathit{es}, a, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}shrink}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q), a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall y. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}address\text{-}below}(s, q, \mathit{es}, n, y) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(\mathit{es}), y) \leq a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}kms-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q))(u, v) \simeq \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms})(u, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q), s, \operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, a, b, \mathit{es}. \\ \quad (\mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((\mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{es}(i) = a(i)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, a, b.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, a.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q), \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, a, b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, a.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q), \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, a, b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}kms-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q) \simeq \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cantor\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, u.; \forall \mathit{es} \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, \mathit{es}, k) \subseteq u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.; \forall \mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q), b.\; (\mathit{es} \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, \mathit{es}, b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmm-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rabasics-closed.scm}{theorem-library/rabasics-closed.scm}
\noindent{\small rabasics-closed.scm -- calculus.pdf 3.9, complex-analysis.pdf 1.9: a set A in a metric space X is closed iff every sequence of elements of A which converges, converges to an element of A.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a), l.\; (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, f, l) \Rightarrow (l \in a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}sequentially-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \Leftrightarrow \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a), l.\; (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, f, l) \Rightarrow (l \in a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca51-compact-laws.scm}{theorem-library/ca51-compact-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small ca51-compact-laws.scm -- compact SUBSETS of a metric space through cluster points (CA-51, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/ca51-compact-laws.scm, library analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc5-\allowbreak{}cluster-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a), c \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{cluster\text{-}point}(s, f, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cluster\text{-}point}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), f, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc5-\allowbreak{}cluster-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{cluster\text{-}point}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), f, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (c \in a) \wedge \operatorname{cluster\text{-}point}(s, f, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc5-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}cluster}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in a.\; \operatorname{cluster\text{-}point}(s, f, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc5-\allowbreak{}cluster-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a).\; \exists c \in a.\; \operatorname{cluster\text{-}point}(s, f, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc5-\allowbreak{}frequent-\allowbreak{}cluster}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k \leq j) \wedge (q(j) \in a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in a.\; \operatorname{cluster\text{-}point}(s, q, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc5-\allowbreak{}frequent-\allowbreak{}pigeonhole}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, y, q. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k \leq j) \wedge \exists i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq n) \wedge (q(j) \in y(i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (i \leq n) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k \leq j) \wedge (q(j) \in y(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq n) \Rightarrow (y(i) \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq n) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, y(i)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, \{\mathit{ucy} \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \exists \mathit{uci} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{uci} \leq n) \wedge (\mathit{ucy} \in y(\mathit{uci})))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, (a \cup b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad c \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, c)) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/product2-compact.scm}{theorem-library/product2-compact.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3c-prod.scm -- the product of two compact metric spaces is compact (PRODUCT2-MS, the max metric). Prefix cx-.  Library: analysis.  Destination: theorem-library/product2-compact.scm, after product2-laws. Route: sequential compactness, a subsequence in the first coordinate, then a further one in the second ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/categories.scm}{theorem-library/categories.scm}
\noindent{\small categories.scm -- FOUR CATEGORIES BESIDE THE DEFAULTS: Lipschitz, uniformly continuous and continuous maps of metric spaces, bounded linear maps of normed vector spaces; their laws, their Hom functors, and the inclusions.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((f \in (\operatorname{pts}(a) \to \operatorname{pts}(b))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}lipschitz\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (f \in (\operatorname{pts}(a) \to \operatorname{pts}(b))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((f \in (\operatorname{pts}(a) \to \operatorname{pts}(b))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((f \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(b))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, b) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}arrow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lipschitz\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lipschitz-\allowbreak{}arrow-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}arrow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}lipschitz\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}arrow-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}arrow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}arrow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lipschitz\text{-}arrow}(a, a, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{pts}(a))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, a, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{pts}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, a, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{pts}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}arrow}(a, a, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{vec}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}lipschitz\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}lipschitz\text{-}arrow}(b, c, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}lipschitz\text{-}arrow}(a, c, \operatorname{compose}(g, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(b, c, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, c, \operatorname{compose}(g, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(b, c, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, c, \operatorname{compose}(g, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}arrow}(b, c, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}arrow}(a, c, \operatorname{compose}(g, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}post-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(b, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(h, f)) \in (\operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(c, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(f, k)) \in (\operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}post-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(b, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(h, f)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(c, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(f, k)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}post-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(b, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(h, f)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(c, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(f, k)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}post-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(b, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(h, f)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(b) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(c, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(f, k)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hom\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hom\text{-}lipschitz}(a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hom\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{hom\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hom\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{hom\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear}(a, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/c-continuous-category.scm}{theorem-library/c-continuous-category.scm}
\noindent{\small c-continuous-category.scm -- THE CATEGORY OF COUNTABLY-METRISED SPACES AND CONTINUOUS MAPS: objects the C-METRIC-SPACEs, arrows the maps f : PTS(a) -$>$ PTS(b) continuous for the canonical metrics C-METRIC(a), C-METRIC(b).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}canonical-\allowbreak{}carrier}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((f \in (\operatorname{pts}(a) \to \operatorname{pts}(b))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(b, c, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, c, \operatorname{compose}(g, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, a, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{pts}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}post-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(b, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(h, f)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(a, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(c, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(a, b).\; \operatorname{compose}(f, k)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(a, b) \to \operatorname{hom\text{-}c\text{-}continuous}(c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}continuous\text{-}arrow}(a, a, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{pts}(a))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/diff-on-laws-2.scm}{theorem-library/diff-on-laws-2.scm}
\noindent{\small diff-on-laws-2.scm -- THE DERIVATIVE LAWS ON AN OPEN SET, over a normed field: uniqueness, the constant and the identity, the sum, the product and the chain rule.  Continues theorem-library/diff-on-laws.scm (batch 12-G), which proved the read-offs, the bridge `diff-at-iff-diff-on' and}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, d, t.; \forall c \in \operatorname{pts}(t), a \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, t, (\lambda z \in d.\; c), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}identity-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, d.; \forall a \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, s, (\lambda z \in d.\; z), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s, d, g, h, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), h, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\lambda z \in d.\; \operatorname{add}(k)(g(z), h(z))), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s, d, g, h, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), h, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\lambda z \in d.\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(g(z), h(z))), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, d, t, u, f, g, a. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, t, f, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(t, u, g, f(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, u, (\lambda z \in d.\; g(f(z))), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}transfer-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, d, c, g, f, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(t) \simeq c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, t, g, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (d \to c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in d.\; (f(y) = g(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, t, f, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}, c \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow ((\lambda x \in u.\; c) \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (u \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in u.\; x) \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}, f, g \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{add}(k)(f(x), g(x))) \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}, f, g \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(f(x), g(x))) \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(u) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (u = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}implies}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(u) = 0)) \Rightarrow (u = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}elements}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (h = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(h) < e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u.; \forall a \in u, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \exists h \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\neg (h = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(h) < e)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (b = a) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), u))(a, b) \leq r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(k) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{zero}(k)) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{add}(k)(u, \operatorname{neg}(k)(v)) = \operatorname{zero}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, v, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w) = \operatorname{mul}(k)(v, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, f, a, l, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \exists h \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\neg (h = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(h) < e)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad l = m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(k) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), u)) \Rightarrow (u \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(k), a \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; c), a, \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; x), a, \operatorname{one}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, f, g, a, l, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, l) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, g, a, m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{add}(k)(f(x), g(x))), a, \operatorname{add}(k)(l, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}z-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}, c \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow ((\lambda z \in u.\; c) \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}, f, g \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda v \in u.\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(f(v), g(v))) \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}v}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s, d, g, h, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), h, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\lambda v \in d.\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(g(v), h(v))), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, f, g, a, l, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, l) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, g, a, m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(f(x), g(x))), a, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{mul}(k)(l, g(a)), \operatorname{mul}(k)(m, f(a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}corestrict-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, \mathit{d2s}, f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{d2s} \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, t, f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(y) \in \mathit{d2s}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(t, \mathit{d2s}), f, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}z-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}, s, f.; \forall g \in (s \to \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \forall y \in u.\; (f(y) \in s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; g(f(z))) \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, s, f, g, a, l, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, s, g, f(a), m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; (f(y) \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; g(f(x))), a, \operatorname{mul}(k)(m, l)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/holomorphic-basics.scm}{theorem-library/holomorphic-basics.scm}
\noindent{\small holomorphic-basics.scm -- the COMPLEX side of IS-DIFF-ON / HOLOMORPHIC-ON.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (v \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(u, v) \simeq (u + v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (v \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(u, v) \simeq (u \cdot v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(u) \simeq -u)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (v \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(u, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(v)) \simeq (u - v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))(u, v) \simeq \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})(u, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, w))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}elements}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (h = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(h) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}ms}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, f.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}ms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in u.\; \exists l.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a, l) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/deriv-on-read-off.scm}{theorem-library/deriv-on-read-off.scm}
\noindent{\small deriv-on-read-off.scm -- DERIV-ON reads off IS-DIFF-ON. Batch 27-A follow-on, 2026-09-24.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{deriv-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, f, a, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \exists h \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\neg (h = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(h) < e)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a) = l \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a, l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a) = l \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/holomorphic-basics-2.scm}{theorem-library/holomorphic-basics-2.scm}
\noindent{\small holomorphic-basics-2.scm -- section 2.1 of the user's complex-analysis notes, finished: the constant and the identity are holomorphic on any open set, sums and products of holomorphic functions are holomorphic, and so is z |-$>$ z\textasciicircum{}n for every natural n.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}transfer-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, f, g, a, l. \\ \quad ((f \in (u \to \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, g, a, l) \wedge \forall x \in u.\; (f(x) \simeq g(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}transfer-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge ((f \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall x \in u.\; (f(x) \simeq g(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (m(x) \simeq (f(x) + g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (m(x) \simeq (f(x) \cdot g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall w \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (w(z) \simeq \operatorname{power}(z, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, w) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-reciprocal.scm}{theorem-library/cc-reciprocal.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-reciprocal.scm -- z |-$>$ 1/z: the punctured plane, the continuity of the reciprocal, its derivative, and the reciprocal and quotient rules for HOLOMORPHIC-ON.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w.\; ((w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0))) \Leftrightarrow ((w \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \neg (w = 0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)) \subseteq \mathbb{C}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)) \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}nf}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)).\; \operatorname{recip}(z)) \in (\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)) \to \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0))), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)).\; \operatorname{recip}(z)), \\ \quad \quad a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\neg (u = 0) \wedge \neg (v = 0)) \Rightarrow \neg ((u \cdot v) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (u = 0) \wedge \neg (v = 0)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}((u \cdot v)) = (\operatorname{recip}(u) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)), \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)).\; \operatorname{recip}(z)), \\ \quad \quad a, -\operatorname{recip}((a \cdot a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}recip}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)), (\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(0)).\; \operatorname{recip}(z)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, l, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a, l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; \neg (f(y) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; (q(y) \simeq \operatorname{recip}(f(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, q, a, -(l \cdot \operatorname{recip}((f(a) \cdot f(a))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; \neg (f(y) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; (q(y) \simeq \operatorname{recip}(f(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}quotient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; \neg (g(y) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; (q(y) \simeq /(f(y), g(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, q) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/poly-fn-roots.scm}{theorem-library/poly-fn-roots.scm}
\noindent{\small poly-fn-roots.scm -- division by z - a, the root bound, uniqueness of coefficients, degree, composition (CA-MONTEL "POLY-2", 2026-10-26).  Vocabulary: poly-fn-vocab.scm (+ the degree vocabulary below). Library: analysis.  Helper prefix pfr- in drafting; renamed pfr- with the copied helpers at the head.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}divide}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq k) \Rightarrow (d(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c((k + 1)) = (d(k) - (a \cdot d((k + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad c(0) = (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(a, j))), (n + 1)) - (a \cdot d(0))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(a, j))), (n + 1)) + ((z - a) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c, s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((i \leq n) \wedge ((j \leq n) \wedge (s(i) = s(j)))) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (i \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{pfj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(\mathit{pfj}) \cdot \operatorname{power}(s(i), \mathit{pfj}))), (n + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c(k) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), m \in \mathbb{N}, d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad a \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \exists s \in (\mathbb{N} \to a). \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (s(i) = s(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq k) \Rightarrow (d(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{pfj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(\mathit{pfj}) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, \mathit{pfj}))), n) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{pfj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d(\mathit{pfj}) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, \mathit{pfj}))), m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c(k) = d(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), m \in \mathbb{N}, d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c(n) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((m + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (d(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d(m) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((((n + m) + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (e(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (e((n + m)) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (m + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (e(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), ((n + m) + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}fn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}deg}(k, a, f, n) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(k, a, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, g.; \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}deg}(\mathbb{C}, a, f, n) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}deg}(\mathbb{C}, a, g, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}deg}(\mathbb{C}, a, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x))), (n + m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}deg-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, f.; \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad k \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \exists s \in (\mathbb{N} \to a). \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (s(i) = s(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}deg}(k, a, f, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}deg}(k, a, f, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad n = m \end{array}}}
