\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{field\text{-}as\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}field})) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{field\text{-}as\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}field})) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{field\text{-}as\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}field})) \simeq 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{field\text{-}as\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}field})) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{rff\_}, \operatorname{rfg\_}] \in (v \times v).\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{rff\_}(x) + \operatorname{rfg\_}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((v \times v) \to (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; 0) \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda f \in v.\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; -f(x))) \in (v \to (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{rfc\_}, \operatorname{rff\_}] \in (\mathbb{R} \times v).\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{rfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{rff\_}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\mathbb{R} \times v) \to (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{field\text{-}as\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v \in \mathbf{Set}.\; ((v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{rff\_}, \operatorname{rfg\_}] \in (v \times v).\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{rff\_}(x) + \operatorname{rfg\_}(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq (\lambda f \in v.\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; -f(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{rfc\_}, \operatorname{rff\_}] \in (\mathbb{R} \times v).\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{rfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{rff\_}(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad v \subseteq (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g \in v.\; ((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (f(x) + g(x))) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; 0) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall f \in v.\; ((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; -f(x)) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, f \in v.\; ((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (c \cdot f(x))) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{antiderivable\text{-}fns}(a, b) \simeq \{p \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) : \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(p, a, b)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, i. \\ \quad (i \in \operatorname{antiderivable\text{-}fns}(a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((i \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}fn\text{-}space}(\operatorname{antiderivable\text{-}fns}(a, b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/c-int.scm}{theorem-library/c-int.scm}
\noindent{\small c-int.scm -- docs/calculus.pdf CHAPTER 4, equation (64): the DEFINITE INTEGRAL of a continuous function, `C-INT'.  Rung 4.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivative}(f, i, a, b) \Rightarrow (\int_{a}^{b} i = (f(b) - f(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i, a, b.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \Rightarrow (\int_{a}^{b} i \in \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, c, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(c, a, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (i(x) + c(x))) = (\int_{a}^{b} i + \int_{a}^{b} c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, i, a, b. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (c \cdot i(x))) = (c \cdot \int_{a}^{b} i) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/c-int-oriented.scm}{theorem-library/c-int-oriented.scm}
\noindent{\small c-int-oriented.scm -- THE ORIENTED DEFINITE INTEGRAL, the sub-interval restriction of Def 4.6 (docs/calculus.pdf REMARK 4.9), and ADDITIVITY IN THE BOUNDS.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}asymm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((a < b) \Rightarrow \neg (b < a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}endpoints}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \Rightarrow ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}reverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, b, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}degenerate}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i, a.\; \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}anti}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \Rightarrow (\int_{a}^{b} i = \int_{a}^{b} i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}flip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \Rightarrow (\int_{b}^{a} i = -\int_{a}^{b} i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}none}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, b. \\ \quad (\neg \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \wedge \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, b, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} i = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}degenerate}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i, a.\; (\int_{a}^{a} i = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i, a, b.\; (\int_{a}^{b} i \in \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}reverse}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i, a, b.\; (\int_{b}^{a} i = -\int_{a}^{b} i)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivative-\allowbreak{}subinterval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, a, b, o, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivative}(f, i, a, b) \wedge ((o \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \leq o) \wedge ((o < c) \wedge (c \leq b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivative}(f, i, o, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}subinterval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, b, o, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \wedge ((o \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \leq o) \wedge ((o < c) \wedge (c \leq b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, o, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, p, q, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivative}(f, i, p, q) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{ccint}(p, q)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{ccint}(p, q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} i = (f(b) - f(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, p, q, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, p, q) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{ccint}(p, q)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{ccint}(p, q)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{ccint}(p, q))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{c} i = (\int_{a}^{b} i + \int_{b}^{c} i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, c) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a < b) \wedge (b < c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{c} i = (\int_{a}^{b} i + \int_{b}^{c} i) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/bernstein-ccint.scm}{theorem-library/bernstein-ccint.scm}
\noindent{\small bernstein-ccint.scm -- THEOREM 5.2 of docs/calculus.pdf moved off [0,1] and onto an arbitrary nondegenerate [a,b], by the affine change of variable}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall o, i.; \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(o, i).\; ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((o \leq t) \wedge (t \leq i)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, t. \\ \quad (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b))) \wedge (t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a + ((b - a) \cdot t)) \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}coaffine-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, x. \\ \quad (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b))) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((x - a) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((b - a))) \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, x. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a < b) \wedge (x \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a + ((b - a) \cdot ((x - a) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((b - a))))) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, m, t. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (t \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (c + (m \cdot x))), t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}approximation-\allowbreak{}ccint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, a, b, p. \\ \quad n \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, n, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{cap} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{cap} \leq d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lvert (n(c) - \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{compose}(n, (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (a + ((b - a) \cdot x)))), d, ((c - a) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((b - a))))) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; p \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-bolzano-weierstrass.scm}{theorem-library/rake-bolzano-weierstrass.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/rake-bolzano-weierstrass.scm ==================================================================== The eps-GRID FINITE COVER of a closed interval -- batch 8-E, item (1) -- and the scaled archimedean property it needs.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}archimedean-\allowbreak{}multiple}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.; \forall \mathit{xv} \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(v) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{nv} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\mathit{xv} \leq (\mathit{nv} \cdot v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}eps-\allowbreak{}grid-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}, \mathit{bv} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{ev}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{ev}) \wedge (\mathit{bv} \leq (\mathit{av} + (v \cdot \mathit{ev})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{cv}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}cover}(\mathit{cv}, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{av}, \mathit{bv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{uv} \in \mathit{cv}, \mathit{pv}, \mathit{qv} \in \mathit{uv}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{pv} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((\mathit{qv} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\lvert (\mathit{pv} - \mathit{qv}) \rvert \leq \mathit{ev})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}eps-\allowbreak{}grid-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, \mathit{bv} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{ev}. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{ev}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{cv}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}cover}(\mathit{cv}, \operatorname{ccint}(v, \mathit{bv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{uv} \in \mathit{cv}, \mathit{pv}, \mathit{qv} \in \mathit{uv}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{pv} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((\mathit{qv} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\lvert (\mathit{pv} - \mathit{qv}) \rvert \leq \mathit{ev})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}grid-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, \mathit{bv} \in \mathbb{R}, d. \\ \quad \forall \mathit{kv} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d(\mathit{kv})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists w. \forall \mathit{kv} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}cover}(w(\mathit{kv}), \operatorname{ccint}(v, \mathit{bv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{uv} \in w(\mathit{kv}), \mathit{pv}, \mathit{qv} \in \mathit{uv}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{pv} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((\mathit{qv} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\lvert (\mathit{pv} - \mathit{qv}) \rvert \leq d(\mathit{kv}))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-bolzano-weierstrass-2.scm}{theorem-library/rake-bolzano-weierstrass-2.scm}
\noindent{\small NOTE 2026-09-20 (batch 12-B).  Where this file says the tree has no metric SUBSPACE structure, that is history: SUBSPACE-MS(s, A) and RESTRICT(f, A) are defined in structure-library/metric-subspace.scm, their laws are in theorem-library/metric-subspace-laws.scm and compact-subspace.scm, and}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}convergent-\allowbreak{}subseq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, \mathit{hiv} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{hqv} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{ccint}(v, \mathit{hiv})). \exists \mathit{phv}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(\mathit{phv}) \wedge \exists \mathit{ptv} \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{subseq}(\mathit{hqv}, \mathit{phv}), \mathit{ptv})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}bolzano-\allowbreak{}weierstrass}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), \mathit{bdv} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall \mathit{iqv} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lvert v(\mathit{iqv}) \rvert \leq \mathit{bdv}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{phv}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(\mathit{phv}) \wedge \exists \mathit{ptv} \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{subseq}(v, \mathit{phv}), \mathit{ptv})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}block-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), \mathit{bdv} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{jqv} \in \mathrm{Inf}(\mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \forall \mathit{iqv} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lvert v(\mathit{iqv}) \rvert \leq \mathit{bdv}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{bqv} \in \mathrm{Inf}(\mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{bqv} \subseteq \mathit{jqv}) \wedge \exists \mathit{ptv} \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}along}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, v, \mathit{bqv}, \mathit{ptv}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-ascoli-diagonal.scm}{theorem-library/rake-ascoli-diagonal.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/rake-ascoli-diagonal.scm ==================================================================== ASCOLI-ARZELA, the last stretch -- batch 11-F.  Two theorems:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ascoli-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}diagonal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pointwise\text{-}bounded}(s, m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l.\; (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(l) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}on}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(m, l), q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ascoli-\allowbreak{}arzela-\allowbreak{}sequential}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pointwise\text{-}bounded}(s, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(m, l), g) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/bernstein-antiderivable.scm}{theorem-library/bernstein-antiderivable.scm}
\noindent{\small bernstein-antiderivable.scm -- EVERY BERNSTEIN APPROXIMANT IS ANTIDERIVABLE.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}degree-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}diag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, k. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k = 0))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(0, x)(k) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}degree-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}off}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, k. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (k = 0))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(0, x)(k) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, k, j. \\ \quad (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b))) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (j \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{power}(x, j) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k))), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, k, a, b. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k)), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}scaled-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, n, k, a, b. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (c \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(n, x)(k))), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, n, a, b. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\neg (n = 0) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}poly}(f, n, x)), a, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/antiderivable-affine-subst.scm}{theorem-library/antiderivable-affine-subst.scm}
\noindent{\small antiderivable-affine-subst.scm -- ANTIDERIVABILITY SURVIVES AN AFFINE CHANGE OF VARIABLE, and with it the rung-3 form of the Bernstein approximants.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}subst}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, k, m, p, q, a, b. \\ \quad i \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (m = 0) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad p < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(p, q).\; ((k + (m \cdot t)) \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((p < t) \wedge (t < q)) \Rightarrow ((a < (k + (m \cdot t))) \wedge ((k + (m \cdot t)) < b))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; i((k + (m \cdot x)))), p, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}subst-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, k, m, p, q. \\ \quad i \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < m \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad p < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, (k + (m \cdot p)), (k + (m \cdot q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; i((k + (m \cdot x)))), p, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{antiderivable-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}subst-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, k, m, p, q. \\ \quad i \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < m \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad p < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, (k + (m \cdot p)), (k + (m \cdot q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (a(x) \simeq i((k + (m \cdot x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(a, p, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}coordinate-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, n, a, b. \\ \quad ((g \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\neg (n = 0) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}poly}(g, n, ((x - a) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((b - a))))), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernstein-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}approximant-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, n, a, b. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\neg (n = 0) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{compose}(f, (\lambda c \in \mathbb{R}.\; (a + ((b - a) \cdot c)))), n, ((x - a) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((b - a))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad a, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/continuous-antiderivable.scm}{theorem-library/continuous-antiderivable.scm}
\noindent{\small continuous-antiderivable.scm -- RUNG 3, AND THE INTEGRAL THAT FOLLOWS.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(f, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}defined-\allowbreak{}for-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} f \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivative}(g, f, a, b) \wedge (\int_{a}^{b} f = (g(b) - g(a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, c, a, b. \\ \quad i \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, i, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (i(x) + c(x))) = (\int_{a}^{b} i + \int_{a}^{b} c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, i, a, b. \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, i, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (c \cdot i(x))) = (c \cdot \int_{a}^{b} i) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/c-int-change-of-variable.scm}{theorem-library/c-int-change-of-variable.scm}
\noindent{\small c-int-change-of-variable.scm -- CHANGE OF VARIABLES FOR `C-INT', in the INCREASING case, docs/calculus.pdf's substitution rule:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}variable-\allowbreak{}antiderivative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, i, p, r, a, q. \\ \quad p \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivative}(w, i, p(a), p(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, q).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((a < b) \wedge (b < q)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(p, b, r(b))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, q).\; (p(u) \in \operatorname{ccint}(p(a), p(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((a < b) \wedge (b < q)) \Rightarrow ((p(a) < p(b)) \wedge (p(b) < p(q)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivative}(\operatorname{compose}(w, p), (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (i(p(x)) \cdot r(x))), a, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}variable-\allowbreak{}antiderivable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, p, r, a, q. \\ \quad p \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, p(a), p(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, q).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((a < w) \wedge (w < q)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(p, w, r(w))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, q).\; (p(u) \in \operatorname{ccint}(p(a), p(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((a < w) \wedge (w < q)) \Rightarrow ((p(a) < p(w)) \wedge (p(w) < p(q)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (i(p(x)) \cdot r(x))), a, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}variable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, p, r, a, q. \\ \quad p \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, p(a), p(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, q).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((a < w) \wedge (w < q)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(p, w, r(w))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, q).\; (p(u) \in \operatorname{ccint}(p(a), p(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((a < w) \wedge (w < q)) \Rightarrow ((p(a) < p(w)) \wedge (p(w) < p(q)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{q} (\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (i(p(x)) \cdot r(x))) = \int_{p(a)}^{p(q)} i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}variable-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a, p, r, b, q. \\ \quad p \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b < q \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}(i, p(b), p(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(b, q).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((b < w) \wedge (w < q)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(p, w, r(w))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(b, q).\; (p(u) \in \operatorname{ccint}(p(b), p(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((b < w) \wedge (w < q)) \Rightarrow ((p(b) < p(w)) \wedge (p(w) < p(q)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (a(x) \simeq (i(p(x)) \cdot r(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{b}^{q} a = \int_{p(b)}^{p(q)} i \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/log.scm}{theorem-library/log.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/log.scm -- THE LOGARITHM, DEFINED AS AN INTEGRAL, and its basic laws.  The one that costs anything is the functional equation, and what it costs is a CHANGE OF VARIABLES.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.\; (\log\left(x\right) \simeq \int_{1}^{x} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.\; (\log\left(x\right) \in \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \log\left(x\right)) \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\log\left(1\right) = 0}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{recip-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}antiderivable-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < a) \wedge (a < b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antiderivable}((\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{recip-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \neg (m = 0))) \Rightarrow (({(m \cdot u)}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot m) = {u}^{\ast\!-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}ordered}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < m) \wedge ((0 < a) \wedge (a < b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{(m \cdot a)}^{(m \cdot b)} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \int_{a}^{b} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < m) \wedge ((0 < a) \wedge (0 < b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{(m \cdot a)}^{(m \cdot b)} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \int_{a}^{b} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{recip-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((w \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < u) \wedge ((0 < v) \wedge (0 < w)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{u}^{w} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \int_{u}^{v} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) + \int_{v}^{w} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < u) \wedge (0 < v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{u}^{v} (\lambda z \in \mathbb{R}.\; {z}^{\ast\!-1}) = (\log\left(v\right) - \log\left(u\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < x) \wedge (0 < y)))) \Rightarrow (\log\left((x \cdot y)\right) = (\log\left(x\right) + \log\left(y\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}strictly-\allowbreak{}increasing}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v.\; (((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < u) \wedge (u < v)))) \Rightarrow (\log\left(u\right) < \log\left(v\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < x) \wedge (x < 1)) \Rightarrow (\log\left(x\right) < 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}above-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((1 < x) \Rightarrow (0 < \log\left(x\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}recip}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow (\log\left({x}^{\ast\!-1}\right) = -\log\left(x\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}deriv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < c) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}((\lambda x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \log\left(x\right)), c, {c}^{\ast\!-1}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/r-exp.scm}{theorem-library/r-exp.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/r-exp.scm -- THE REAL EXPONENTIAL, DEFINED AS THE INVERSE OF THE LOGARITHM, and its laws.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{0 < \log\left(2\right)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}unbounded-\allowbreak{}above}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < b) \wedge ((n \cdot \log\left(2\right)) \leq \log\left(b\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}above-\allowbreak{}any}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < b) \wedge (y \leq \log\left(b\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}any}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists a \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < a) \wedge (\log\left(a\right) \leq y))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}surjective}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \wedge (\log\left(x\right) = y))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}injective-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < u) \wedge ((0 < v) \wedge (\log\left(u\right) = \log\left(v\right)))))) \Rightarrow (u = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\exp\left(y\right) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < \exp\left(y\right)) \wedge (\log\left(\exp\left(y\right)\right) = y)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\exp\left(y\right) \in \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; (0 < \exp\left(y\right))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}r-\allowbreak{}exp}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\log\left(\exp\left(y\right)\right) = y)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}char}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall y, x. \\ \quad ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < x) \wedge (\log\left(x\right) = y)))) \Rightarrow (\exp\left(y\right) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda y \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exp\left(y\right)) \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\exp\left(0\right) = 1}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}log}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow (\exp\left(\log\left(x\right)\right) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v.\; (((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (v \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow (\exp\left((u + v)\right) = (\exp\left(u\right) \cdot \exp\left(v\right))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}strictly-\allowbreak{}increasing}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v.\; (((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u < v))) \Rightarrow (\exp\left(u\right) < \exp\left(v\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v.\; (((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u \leq v))) \Rightarrow (\exp\left(u\right) \leq \exp\left(v\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\exp\left(-y\right) = {\exp\left(y\right)}^{\ast\!-1})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}global}}{\vnbstmt{\neg \forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\exp\left(\log\left(x\right)\right) = x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda y \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exp\left(y\right)), t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < c) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{recip}(c)) = c))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{deriv-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, \mathit{gm}, \mathit{am}, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(m, \mathit{am}, v) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{gm} \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{R}.\; (m(\operatorname{gm}(z)) = z) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{gm}(m(\mathit{am})) = \mathit{am} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \mathit{gm}, m(\mathit{am})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(\mathit{gm}, m(\mathit{am}), \operatorname{recip}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}log}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, w. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((w \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge (w = \log\left(c\right))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}((\lambda y \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exp\left(y\right)), w, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}deriv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}((\lambda y \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exp\left(y\right)), t, \exp\left(t\right))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca51-exhaustion.scm}{theorem-library/ca51-exhaustion.scm}
\noindent{\small ca51-exhaustion.scm -- Lemma 5.1 of the complex analysis notes: a separable locally compact metric space has an exhaustive sequence of compact sets (CA-51, 2026-10-26). Destination: theorem-library/ca51-exhaustion.scm, library analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{pts}(s), c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((\operatorname{dist}(s)(a, b) + d) \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, d) \subseteq \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}gap-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}((\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}(((n + 1) + 1))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lx5-\allowbreak{}least-\allowbreak{}radius}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, q(k), \operatorname{recip}((r(k) + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, q(k), \operatorname{recip}((j + 1))))) \Rightarrow (r(k) \leq j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lx5-\allowbreak{}pieces}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, q(k), \operatorname{recip}((r(k) + 1))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, x(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, y. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y \in x(n) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((y \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \exists i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(s)(q(i), y) \leq (\operatorname{recip}((r(i) + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}separable-\allowbreak{}exhaustion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(s, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}subspace-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (a \subseteq u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, u), a)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall a \in u, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, b) \subseteq u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, u), a, b) = \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}subspace-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{separable-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}full-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rpow-star.scm}{theorem-library/rpow-star.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/rpow-star.scm -- THE REAL POWER, DEFINED, with the base-zero conventions carried:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, s.\; ({x}^{s} \simeq \left(\text{if }(0 < x)\text{ then }\exp\left((s \cdot \log\left(x\right))\right)\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(0 < s)\text{ then }0\text{ else }1\right)\right))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.; \forall s \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow ({x}^{s} = \exp\left((s \cdot \log\left(x\right))\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < s) \Rightarrow ({0}^{s} = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{{0}^{0} = 1}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.; \forall s \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow ({x}^{s} \in \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.; \forall s \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow (0 < {x}^{s}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}rpow-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.; \forall s \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow (\log\left({x}^{s}\right) = (s \cdot \log\left(x\right))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow ({x}^{0} = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow ({x}^{1} = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, s, t. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{(s + t)} = ({x}^{s} \cdot {x}^{t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, s. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < x) \wedge (0 < y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {(x \cdot y)}^{s} = ({x}^{s} \cdot {y}^{s}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, s, t. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {{x}^{s}}^{t} = {x}^{(s \cdot t)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, s. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{-s} = {{x}^{s}}^{\ast\!-1} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}exp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, s, t. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((1 < x) \wedge (s < t))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{s} < {x}^{t} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, s. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < x) \wedge ((x < y) \wedge (0 < s)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{s} < {y}^{s} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb12-seq.scm}{theorem-library/mb12-seq.scm}
\noindent{\small mb12-seq.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf Appendix A.3.3, metrics on X\textasciicircum{}N: Proposition A.11 (convergence for the metric (414) is coordinatewise eventual equality), and below.  Agent ISOM (brief M-B1B2), 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{discrete-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{dsu\_}, \operatorname{dsv\_}] \in (x \times x).\; \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{dsu\_} = \operatorname{dsv\_})\text{ then }0\text{ else }1\right)) \in ((x \times x) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{discrete-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x)) \simeq x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{discrete-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{dsu\_}, \operatorname{dsv\_}] \in (x \times x).\; \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{dsu\_} = \operatorname{dsv\_})\text{ then }0\text{ else }1\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{discrete-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, u, v \in x. \\ \quad (u = v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x))(u, v) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u = v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x))(u, v) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{discrete-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, u, v \in x. \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x))(u, v) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x))(u, v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x))(u, v) \leq 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{discrete-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbf{Set}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{discrete-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, l. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge (l \in x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x), f, l) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq i) \Rightarrow (f(i) = l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}weight-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\lambda \mathit{sqk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, \mathit{sqk})))(k) = \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) = (2 \cdot (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}weight-\allowbreak{}summable}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, k))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}factors-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}sequence}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbf{Set}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}carrier-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x). \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{discrete\text{-}ms}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to x)), u \in (\mathbb{N} \to x). \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{seq\text{-}space\text{-}ms}(x), s, u) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (n \leq i) \Rightarrow (s(i)(k) = u(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{swap-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b, u \in x. \\ \quad (u = a) \Rightarrow ((\lambda w \in x.\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }b\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(w = b)\text{ then }a\text{ else }w\right)\right))(u) = b) \wedge \\ \quad (\neg (u = a) \wedge (u = b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in x.\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }b\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(w = b)\text{ then }a\text{ else }w\right)\right))(u) = a \wedge \\ \quad (\neg (u = a) \wedge \neg (u = b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in x.\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }b\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(w = b)\text{ then }a\text{ else }w\right)\right))(u) = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{swap-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in x. \\ \quad (\lambda w \in x.\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }b\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(w = b)\text{ then }a\text{ else }w\right)\right)) \in (x \to x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{swap-\allowbreak{}involution}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b, u \in x. \\ \quad (\lambda w \in x.\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }b\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(w = b)\text{ then }a\text{ else }w\right)\right))((\lambda w \in x.\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }b\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(w = b)\text{ then }a\text{ else }w\right)\right))(u)) \\ \quad =\; u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{swap-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in x. \\ \quad (\lambda w \in x.\; \left(\text{if }(w = a)\text{ then }b\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(w = b)\text{ then }a\text{ else }w\right)\right)) \in \mathrm{Bij}(x, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coord-\allowbreak{}permute-\allowbreak{}transitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, s, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to x). \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathrm{Bij}(x, x)). \\ \quad \operatorname{coord\text{-}permute}(x, g)(s) = a \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb12-ultra.scm}{theorem-library/mb12-ultra.scm}
\noindent{\small mb12-ultra.scm -- the weighted prefix ultrametric on X\textasciicircum{}N (construction-of-measures, Appendix A.3: (419), Propositions A.15 and A.16).  Helper prefix: mul-. Agent ISOM (brief M-B1B2), 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, a, s. \\ \quad ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge (s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, n) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (1 \leq \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge (s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, n) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (1 \leq \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s.; \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge (m \leq n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, m) \leq \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, a, s, b. \\ \quad a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (s(j) = b(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, n) = \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, b, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seqs-\allowbreak{}differ-\allowbreak{}somewhere}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, s, a. \\ \quad ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge ((a \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge \neg (s = a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (s(k) = a(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agree-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, s, a. \\ \quad ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge ((a \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge \neg (s = a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, a) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (s(\operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, a)) = a(\operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, a))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < \operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, a)) \Rightarrow (s(j) = a(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, s.\; (\operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, s) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s, b. \\ \quad a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (s = b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b) = \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, \operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, b))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, \operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, b))) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, s, \operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s, b. \\ \quad ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge (b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agree-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, s, a. \\ \quad ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge ((a \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge \neg (s = a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(s, a) = \operatorname{agree\text{-}length}(a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s, b. \\ \quad ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge (b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b) = \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, b, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s, b, c. \\ \quad a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b) \leq \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, c), \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{usu\_}, \operatorname{usv\_}] \in ((\mathbb{N} \to x) \times (\mathbb{N} \to x)).\; \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, \operatorname{usu\_}, \operatorname{usv\_})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (((\mathbb{N} \to x) \times (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ultra\text{-}seq\text{-}ms}(x, a)) \simeq (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ultra\text{-}seq\text{-}ms}(x, a)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{usu\_}, \operatorname{usv\_}] \in ((\mathbb{N} \to x) \times (\mathbb{N} \to x)).\; \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, \operatorname{usu\_}, \operatorname{usv\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{ultra\text{-}seq\text{-}ms}(x, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ultrametric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(\operatorname{ultra\text{-}seq\text{-}ms}(x, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}eventually-\allowbreak{}agrees}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, s, u. \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to x)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \mathit{cn} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{cn} \leq i) \Rightarrow (s(i)(k) = u(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{pn} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{pn} \leq a) \wedge (j < n)) \Rightarrow (s(a)(j) = u(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s, b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (s(j) = b(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b) \leq \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, b, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}large}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, s, b.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (s(k) = b(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, b, k)) \leq \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a.; \forall s, b \in (\mathbb{N} \to x). \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \in (x \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ultra\text{-}seq\text{-}ms}(x, a))(s, b) = \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}(a, s, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to x)), u \in (\mathbb{N} \to x). \\ \quad x \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in (\mathbb{N} \to x), m \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m < \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}(a, z, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ultra\text{-}seq\text{-}ms}(x, a), s, u) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \mathit{cn} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{cn} \leq i) \Rightarrow (s(i)(k) = u(k)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr1-ultrametric.scm}{theorem-library/ccr1-ultrametric.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr1-ultrametric.scm -- ULTRAMETRIC SPACES: CCR.pdf chapter 1, Propositions 1.2, 1.3, Corollary 1.4, Propositions 1.5 and 1.7.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ccr1-vocab.scm (SPHERE, EPS-REL, EPS-SETOID) and IS-ULTRAMETRIC (agent ISOM's, scratchpad/mb12/mb12-vocab.scm).  Agent CCR-B1, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26.  ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}ms}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}max}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z), \operatorname{dist}(s)(z, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y, z, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(z, y) \leq r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y, z, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(z, y) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) < r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}isosceles}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(z, y) < \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) = \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}nested}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, q) \subseteq \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}nested}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(s, b, q) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}equal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r) = \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}equal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r) = \operatorname{ball}(s, b, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sphere-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, c, r.\; (\operatorname{sphere}(s, c, r) \simeq \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (\operatorname{dist}(s)(c, y) = r)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sphere-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, r, y. \\ \quad (y \in \operatorname{sphere}(s, c, r)) \Leftrightarrow ((y \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(s)(c, y) = r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, \operatorname{sphere}(s, a, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{sphere}(s, a, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eps-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{eps\text{-}rel}(s, e) \simeq \{p \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(s)) : (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)) < e)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eps-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e, u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ([u, v] \in \operatorname{eps\text{-}rel}(s, e)) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(s)(u, v) < e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eps-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}equivalence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge (0 < e)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}equivalence}(\operatorname{eps\text{-}rel}(s, e), \operatorname{pts}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eps-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, e.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{eps\text{-}rel}(s, e) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eps-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, e.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{eps\text{-}setoid}(s, e)) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eps-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}rel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rel}(\operatorname{eps\text{-}setoid}(s, e)) \simeq \operatorname{eps\text{-}rel}(s, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eps-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}setoid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge (0 < e)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{eps\text{-}setoid}(s, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ultra-\allowbreak{}totally-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{totally\text{-}bounded}(s) \Leftrightarrow \forall e \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < e) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{eps\text{-}setoid}(s, e))| \in \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rpow-star-convexity.scm}{theorem-library/rpow-star-convexity.scm}
