\noindent{\small theorem-library/rpow-star-convexity.scm -- the two REAL inequalities of the axiomatic RPOW, proved for the DEFINED power RPOW-STAR (rpow-star.scm):}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}plus}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((1 + z) \leq \exp\left(z\right))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < w) \Rightarrow (\log\left(w\right) \leq (w - 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}jensen-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, s, t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < u) \wedge ((0 < v) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge ((0 < t) \wedge ((s + t) = 1))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((s \cdot \log\left(u\right)) + (t \cdot \log\left(v\right))) \leq \log\left(((s \cdot u) + (t \cdot v))\right) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{young-\allowbreak{}inequality-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, p, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < a) \wedge ((0 < b) \wedge ((1 < p) \wedge ((1 < q) \wedge ((/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \cdot b) \leq (/({a}^{p}, p) + /({b}^{q}, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bernoulli-\allowbreak{}rpow-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < (1 + x)) \wedge (1 \leq b)) \Rightarrow ((1 + (b \cdot x)) \leq {(1 + x)}^{b}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb12b-dim.scm}{theorem-library/mb12b-dim.scm}
\noindent{\small mb12b-dim.scm -- construction-of-measures Proposition 7.38 (existence and uniqueness of the self-similar dimension lambda: sum over w in X of a\_w\textasciicircum{}(-lambda) = 1).  Agent ISOM (brief M-B1B2, follow-up), 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: mdm-.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < b) \Rightarrow (({b}^{s} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < {b}^{s})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda s \in \mathbb{R}.\; {b}^{s}) \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda s \in \mathbb{R}.\; {b}^{s}), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}strict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, a, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 < b) \wedge (a < c)) \Rightarrow ({b}^{a} < {b}^{c}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 < m) \wedge ((m \leq b) \wedge (s \leq 0))) \Rightarrow ({b}^{s} \leq {m}^{s}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{self-\allowbreak{}similar-\allowbreak{}dimension}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad ((|x| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((2 \leq |x|) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda w \in x.\; {a(w)}^{-l}), x) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda w \in x.\; {a(w)}^{-b}), x) = 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b = l \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/functor-invariance.scm}{structure-library/functor-invariance.scm}
\noindent{\small functor-invariance.scm -- a construction that cannot see the functor.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group@abelian-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}monoid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{abelian\text{-}group\text{-}as\text{-}monoid}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{abelian\text{-}group\text{-}as\text{-}monoid}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group@dsum-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dsum\text{-}act}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(s), n, f) \simeq \operatorname{dsum\text{-}act}(s, n, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group@enum-\allowbreak{}fam}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, f, i, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{enum\text{-}fam}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), f, i, n) \simeq \operatorname{enum\text{-}fam}(g, f, i, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group@laurent-\allowbreak{}limc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}limc}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(k), s, j) \simeq \operatorname{laurent\text{-}limc}(k, s, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group@metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group@normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}abelian-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top@preimage}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{preimage}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), f, v) \simeq \operatorname{preimage}(s, f, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top@sup-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), t, f, g) \simeq \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, t, f, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trunc-\allowbreak{}metric@preimage}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{preimage}(\operatorname{trunc\text{-}metric}(s), f, v) \simeq \operatorname{preimage}(s, f, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trunc-\allowbreak{}metric@sup-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(\operatorname{trunc\text{-}metric}(s), t, f, g) \simeq \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, t, f, g)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/metric-top-proof.scm}{theorem-library/metric-top-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small metric-top-proof.scm -- the metric open sets form a topology.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}repack}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [\operatorname{pts}(d), \operatorname{dist}(d)] \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}([\operatorname{pts}(d), \operatorname{dist}(d)]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}([\operatorname{pts}(d), \operatorname{dist}(d)]) \simeq \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metrizable-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/metric-top-functorial-proof.scm}{theorem-library/metric-top-functorial-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small metric-top-functorial-proof.scm -- the Met -$>$ Top functor acts on morphisms.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}functorial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(a), \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(b), f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-bdd-metric.scm}{theorem-library/rake-bdd-metric.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-bdd-metric.scm -- the three asserted leaves still on the bill of `metrizable-iff-bounded-metrizable' (theorem-library/metrizable-bounded-proof.scm), PROVEN.  Statements copied VERBATIM from their support sites:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metrizable-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d) \simeq s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bdd-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bdd-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}bwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s), u)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bdd-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}fwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bdd-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}preserves-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/metrizable-compact-image.scm}{theorem-library/metrizable-compact-image.scm}
\noindent{\small metrizable-compact-image.scm -- THE CONTINUOUS IMAGE OF A COMPACT SPACE IS COMPACT, IN THE CATEGORY OF METRIZABLE TOPOLOGICAL SPACES, PROVED THROUGH SEQUENCES (the user's request, 2026-10-01: "in that category ... it can be done using sequences.  I like using sequences to prove things whenever}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}opens-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \Rightarrow ((u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d))) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(d, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(t), f) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(d, t, f) \wedge \operatorname{seq\text{-}compact}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(t, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{pts}(d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metrizable-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d) \simeq s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{seq\text{-}compact}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metrizable-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}sequential}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, d, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge ((\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d) \simeq s) \wedge (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(b) \simeq t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, t, f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; f \in (\operatorname{pts}(d) \to \operatorname{pts}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{pts}(d), q \in \operatorname{pts}(d)^{\mathbb{N}}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(d, q, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(b, \operatorname{compose}(f, q), f(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metrizable-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}ms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, t, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(a) \simeq t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(a, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a)) \simeq a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}opens}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a)) \simeq \{w \in \operatorname{power}(a) : \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; (w = (u \cap a))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(t), a) \simeq \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(t, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metrizable-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, t, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/metrizable-bounded-proof.scm}{theorem-library/metrizable-bounded-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small metrizable-bounded-proof.scm -- T1: a topological space is metrizable iff it is metrizable by a BOUNDED metric.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metrizable-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}metrizable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Leftrightarrow \exists d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d) \simeq s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ringoid-setoid-proof.scm}{theorem-library/ringoid-setoid-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small ringoid-setoid-proof.scm}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ringoid-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}equivalence}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}equivalence}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}rel}(r), \operatorname{carr}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ringoid-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}setoid}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-ringoid.scm}{theorem-library/rake-ringoid.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-ringoid.scm -- rq-add-computes: addition on R/I computes on classes.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{r6b-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}rel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rel}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{ringoid\text{-}rel}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r6b-\allowbreak{}related-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \operatorname{related}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(a, \operatorname{neg}(r)(b)) \in \operatorname{idl}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r6b-\allowbreak{}related-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (\operatorname{add}(r)(a, \operatorname{neg}(r)(b)) \in \operatorname{idl}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{related}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r6b-\allowbreak{}rq-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [a, b] \in (\operatorname{carr}(r) \times \operatorname{carr}(r)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{add}(r)(a, b))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r)) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r6b-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}respects2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects2}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [a, b] \in (\operatorname{carr}(r) \times \operatorname{carr}(r)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{add}(r)(a, b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rq-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}quotient\text{-}ring}(r))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), a), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{add}(r)(a, b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rake-ringoid-quotient.scm}{theorem-library/rake-ringoid-quotient.scm}
\noindent{\small rake-ringoid-quotient.scm -- MUL and NEG compute on R/I.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rmul-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b) \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rone-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(r) \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}radd-\allowbreak{}idem-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge (\operatorname{add}(r)(a, a) = a)) \Rightarrow (a = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rzero-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{zero}(r), b) = \operatorname{zero}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rmul-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \operatorname{zero}(r)) = \operatorname{zero}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rneg-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{neg}(r)(a), b) = \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rmul-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, \operatorname{neg}(r)(b)) = \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rdiff-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(u, v))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{add}(r)(a, \operatorname{neg}(r)(u)), b), \operatorname{mul}(r)(u, \operatorname{add}(r)(b, \operatorname{neg}(r)(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rq-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [a, b] \in (\operatorname{carr}(r) \times \operatorname{carr}(r)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r)) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}respects2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects2}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [a, b] \in (\operatorname{carr}(r) \times \operatorname{carr}(r)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rq-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}quotient\text{-}ring}(r))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), a), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{mul}(r)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}rq-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda a \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(a))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r7n-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), (\lambda a \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rq-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}quotient\text{-}ring}(r))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), a)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ringoid-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ringoid}(r) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}quotient\text{-}ring}(r)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/geometric-series.scm}{theorem-library/geometric-series.scm}
\noindent{\small geometric-series.scm -- THE GEOMETRIC MAJORANT, PROVEN, and the four small facts about powers it rests on.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\lvert \operatorname{power}(r, k) \rvert = \operatorname{power}(\lvert r \rvert, k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{geometric-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 - r) \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{power}(r, n)), k)) = (1 - \operatorname{power}(r, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq r) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{power}(r, k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{geometric-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (r = 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{power}(r, n)), k) = ((1 - \operatorname{power}(r, k)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((1 - r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{geometric-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq r) \wedge (r < 1)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{power}(r, n))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/complete-criterion.scm}{theorem-library/complete-criterion.scm}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}fs-\allowbreak{}ins}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, k \in \mathbf{Set}, f. \\ \quad ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\neg (k \in s) \wedge \forall z \in (s \cup \{k\}).\; (f(z) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, (s \cup \{k\})) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, s) + f(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}fs-\allowbreak{}lin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in \mathbb{R}, f, g, h. \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (g(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (h(z) = ((a \cdot f(z)) + (b \cdot g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), h, s) \\ \quad \quad =\; (a \cdot \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, s)) + (b \cdot \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall l, m \in \mathbb{R}.\; (0 \leq ((((l \cdot l) \cdot a) + (-(2 \cdot (l \cdot m)) \cdot c)) + ((m \cdot m) \cdot b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (c \cdot c) \leq (a \cdot b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}schwarz-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in (s \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (a(i) \cdot b(i))), s) \cdot \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (a(i) \cdot b(i))), s) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (a(i) \cdot a(i))), s) \cdot \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (b(i) \cdot b(i))), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}schwarz-\allowbreak{}sqrt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in (s \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (a(i) \cdot b(i))), s) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \sqrt{\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (a(i) \cdot a(i))), s)} \cdot \sqrt{\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (b(i) \cdot b(i))), s)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{minkowski-\allowbreak{}l2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in (s \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sqrt{\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; ((a(i) + b(i)) \cdot (a(i) + b(i)))), s)} \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \sqrt{\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (a(i) \cdot a(i))), s)} + \sqrt{\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; (b(i) \cdot b(i))), s)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}rpow-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{R}, r \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq x) \wedge (0 < r)) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{rpow}(x, r) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{rpow}(x, r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}rpow-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}, r \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (((0 \leq x) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge (\operatorname{rpow}(x, r) = 0))) \Rightarrow (x = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}rpow-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, c \in \mathbb{R}, r \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq x) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge (0 < r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rpow}((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(c)), r) = (\operatorname{rpow}(x, r) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{rpow}(c, r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}young0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \mathbb{Q}, u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 < p) \wedge ((1 < q) \wedge (((/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1) \wedge ((0 \leq u) \wedge (0 \leq v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (u \cdot v) \leq (/(\operatorname{rpow}(u, p), p) + /(\operatorname{rpow}(v, q), q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}young-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \mathbb{Q}, s, t, x, y \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 < p) \wedge ((1 < q) \wedge (((/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge ((0 < t) \wedge ((0 \leq x) \wedge (0 \leq y))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \cdot y \\ \quad \quad \leq\; ((((s \cdot t) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{rpow}(s, p))) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(p)) \cdot \operatorname{rpow}(x, p)) + ((((s \cdot t) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{rpow}(t, q))) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) \cdot \operatorname{rpow}(y, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb1-\allowbreak{}fs-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f. \\ \quad ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (0 \leq f(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad f(k) \leq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holder-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in (s \to \mathbb{R}), p, q \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 < p) \wedge ((1 < q) \wedge ((/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; \lvert (a(i) \cdot b(i)) \rvert), s) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{rpow}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; \operatorname{rpow}(\lvert a(i) \rvert, p)), s), /(1, p)) \cdot \operatorname{rpow}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in s.\; \operatorname{rpow}(\lvert b(i) \rvert, q)), s), /(1, q)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rps-finsum-mono-set.scm}{theorem-library/rps-finsum-mono-set.scm}
\noindent{\small rps-finsum-mono-set.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/measure-laws.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by sums-to-algebra; RR-POS-STAR finite sums. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, s.; \forall t \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|t| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((s \subseteq t) \wedge \forall z \in t.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, s) \leq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, t) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/measure-laws.scm}{theorem-library/measure-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small measure-laws.scm -- Chapter 1 of the measure notes (Thayer, Construction of Measures, Sec. 3-4): the elementary laws of a countably additive measure. Agent M-1 of the October roadmap (docs/roadmap-2026-10-03.md, line (b), decision 4).  Helper prefix mlw-.  25 theorems, every one `modulo 0'.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f.\; (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(0)) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}((n + 1))) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)), f(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \leq \operatorname{esum}(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}prefixes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \leq b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(f) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}termwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge ((g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq g(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}termwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge ((g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq g(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(f) \leq \operatorname{esum}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}support}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(((q + 1) + 1)) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(h) = \operatorname{eplus}(h(0), h(1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}finitely-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge ((\beta \in b) \wedge ((\alpha \cap \beta) = \emptyset)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u((\alpha \cup \beta)) = \operatorname{eplus}(u(\alpha), u(\beta)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge ((\beta \in b) \wedge (\alpha \subseteq \beta)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\alpha) \leq u(\beta) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bu-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f.\; (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(0), f(j)) = \emptyset)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bu-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, c.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to c). \\ \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}((k + 1)), f(j)) = (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j)) \cup f(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j)) \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjointify-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(f(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j)))) \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjointify-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, c, i, j. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to c)) \wedge ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(f(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(\mathit{uj}))))(i) \cap (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(f(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(\mathit{uj}))))(j)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \emptyset \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjointify-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, c. \\ \quad (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(f(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j))))(n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}countably-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \leq \operatorname{esum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(f(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjointify-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda c \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(f(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j))))(c))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathrm{OS}(n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(n), f(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to c), j \in \mathrm{OS}(n). \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(a) \subseteq f((a + 1))) \Rightarrow (f(j) \subseteq f(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}continuity-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(f(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge ((\beta \in b) \wedge ((\alpha \subseteq \beta) \wedge (u(\beta) \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}subtractive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge ((\beta \in b) \wedge ((\alpha \subseteq \beta) \wedge (u(\beta) \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\beta, \alpha)) = (u(\beta) - u(\alpha)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}continuity-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}above}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f((n + 1)) \subseteq f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad u(f(0)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, f(n))))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(f(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}pushforward}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, (\lambda \mathit{pb} \in c.\; u(\{x \in a : (f(x) \in \mathit{pb})\}))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/finsum-cm-ptwise-laws.scm}{theorem-library/finsum-cm-ptwise-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small finsum-cm-ptwise-laws.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/integral-laws.scm into library algebra, for the library gate: cited by l2-families-2, ccr6-f, ccr6-g; finite sums in a commutative monoid. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}iden-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) = \operatorname{iden}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(m, f, s) = \operatorname{iden}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (g(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (h(z) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(f(z), g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(m, h, s) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{finsum}(m, f, s), \operatorname{finsum}(m, g, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}pad-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall t \in \mathbf{Set}, r, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad |t| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in r.\; (z \in t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in t.\; (g(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in t.\; (\neg (z \in r) \Rightarrow (g(z) = \operatorname{iden}(m))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(m, g, t) = \operatorname{finsum}(m, g, r) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rps-finsum-le-ptwise.scm}{theorem-library/rps-finsum-le-ptwise.scm}
\noindent{\small rps-finsum-le-ptwise.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/integral-laws.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by l2-families-2; RR-POS-STAR finite sums. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f, g. \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (g(z) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \leq g(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, s) \leq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, s) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/integral-laws.scm}{theorem-library/integral-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small integral-laws.scm -- THE INTEGRAL OF A [0,+inf]-VALUED FUNCTION BY SIMPLE FUNCTIONS: the laws, proved from the definition, and the bricks they rest on. Agent M-2 of the October roadmap (week 2, scratchpad/triage/WEEK2.md; decision 4 of docs/roadmap-2026-10-03.md).  Helper prefixes ibk- (the}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(x, y) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (\operatorname{etimes}(0, x) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (\operatorname{etimes}(x, 0) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (\operatorname{etimes}(1, x) = x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(x, y) = \operatorname{etimes}(y, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, x, y. \\ \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{eplus}(x, y)) = \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{etimes}(c, x), \operatorname{etimes}(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, x, y. \\ \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge (((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge (x \leq y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(c, x) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(c, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}assoc-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge (0 \leq d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{etimes}(d, x)) = \operatorname{etimes}((c \cdot d), x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge (0 \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{eplus}(c, d), x) = \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{etimes}(c, x), \operatorname{etimes}(d, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall m \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq a) \wedge (a \leq b)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(a, m) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(b, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}remove-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall t \in \mathbf{Set}, k \in t, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge ((|t| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in t.\; (g(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(m, g, t) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{finsum}(m, g, \operatorname{difference}(t, \{k\})), g(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sep-\allowbreak{}fiber-\allowbreak{}insert-\allowbreak{}other}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, i, z. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \neg (i(x) = z)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{w \in (s \cup \{x\}) : (i(w) = z)\} = \{w \in s : (i(w) = z)\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sep-\allowbreak{}fiber-\allowbreak{}insert-\allowbreak{}same}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, i. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (i(x) \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{w \in (s \cup \{x\}) : (i(w) = i(x))\} = (\{w \in s : (i(w) = i(x))\} \cup \{x\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}fiber-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall s, t \in \mathbf{Set}, i, f, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}comm\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |t| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (i(z) \in t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in t.\; (q(z) \simeq \operatorname{finsum}(m, f, \{w \in s : (i(w) = z)\})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(m, f, s) = \operatorname{finsum}(m, q, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, s \in \mathbf{Set}, f, h. \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (h(z) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, h, s) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}preimage-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (\{x \in a : (k(x) = z)\} \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : (k(x) \in s)\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}preimage-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, k, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (\{x \in a : (k(x) = z)\} \in b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (g(z) = u(\{x \in a : (k(x) = z)\})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\{x \in a : (k(x) \in s)\}) = \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, f) \Rightarrow (\{x \in b : (a \leq f(x))\} \in c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, f) \Rightarrow (\{x \in b : (f(x) = a)\} \in c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s) \simeq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda y \in \operatorname{image}(s, a).\; \operatorname{etimes}(y, u(\{x \in a : (s(x) = y)\}))), \operatorname{image}(s, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) \simeq \operatorname{esup}(\{y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists s \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, s, f) \wedge (y = \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s))))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, f, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) \leq \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}partition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s.; \forall c \in \mathbf{Set}, k, h, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad |c| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in a.\; (k(z) \in c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in c.\; (\{x \in a : (k(x) = z)\} \in b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in c.\; (h(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in c.\; (0 \leq h(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in a.\; (s(z) = h(k(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in c.\; (g(z) = \operatorname{etimes}(h(z), u(\{x \in a : (k(x) = z)\}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s) = \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, t) \wedge \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, s, t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s) \leq \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, s) = \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}sup-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\{y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists s \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, s, f) \wedge (y = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, s))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{indicator-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, \alpha.; \forall x \in a.\; ((x \in \alpha) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)(x) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{indicator-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, \alpha.; \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in \alpha) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)(x) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{indicator-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, \alpha. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (\alpha \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}indicator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\alpha \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)) = u(\alpha) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}indicator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\alpha \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)) = u(\alpha) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}infinite-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge (u(\alpha) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha))) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, s, t)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s), \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, c, s)) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}range}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad u \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{image}(u, a)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{image}(u, a).\; (\{x \in a : (u(x) = z)\} \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, c, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, c, f)) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/esum-scale.scm}{theorem-library/esum-scale.scm}
\noindent{\small ==================================================================== theorem-library/esum-scale.scm -- MEASURE-5-A, 2026-10-10. Homogeneity of ESUM, and a scaled measure is a measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, d, g, h. \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad g \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (h(z) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(h) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{esum}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, d.; \forall f \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad (0 \leq c) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{esum}((\lambda z \in d.\; \operatorname{etimes}(c, f(z)))) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{esum}(f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (0 \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, (\lambda x \in b.\; \operatorname{etimes}(c, u(x)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/strand-messages-laws.scm}{theorem-library/strand-messages-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small strand-messages-laws.scm -- THE MESSAGES OF STRAND SPACES (the user's model, with ENCRYPTION): their laws. (\textasciitilde{}/notes/notes-60.txt item (a), the user's decision of 2026-10-06 16:40Z adding \{m\}\_k; the definitions are structure-library/strand-messages.scm.)}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lst-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l.\; (\operatorname{lst}(l) \simeq [1, l])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encr-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, y.\; (\operatorname{encr}(g, y) \simeq [2, g, y])}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encr-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, y, l.\; \neg (\operatorname{encr}(g, y) = \operatorname{lst}(l))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lst-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}encr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l, g, y.\; \neg (\operatorname{lst}(l) = \operatorname{encr}(g, y))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lst-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l, a.\; ((\operatorname{lst}(l) = \operatorname{lst}(a)) \Rightarrow (l = a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encr-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, y, u, z.\; ((\operatorname{encr}(g, y) = \operatorname{encr}(u, z)) \Rightarrow ((g = u) \wedge (y = z)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}token}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall a \in t.\; (a \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}keep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, n, m. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n))) \Rightarrow (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, n, l. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lst}(l) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, (n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}encr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, n, g, y. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n)) \wedge (y \in k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{encr}(g, y) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, (n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, 0).\; (m \in t)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, n, m. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, (n + 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n)).\; (m = \operatorname{lst}(l)) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n), y \in k.\; (m = \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, t, k, j, m. \\ \quad ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, j))) \Rightarrow (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, (j + d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.\; (\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \simeq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, n, m. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n))) \Rightarrow (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k).\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}msgs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall a \in t.\; (a \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, k.\; (((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (k \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.\; (((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (k \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}lists-\allowbreak{}are-\allowbreak{}lists}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)).\; (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{list-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}some-\allowbreak{}stage}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)). \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{list-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}msgs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)).\; (\operatorname{lst}(l) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encr-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}msgs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, g, y. \\ \quad ((g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge (y \in k)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{encr}(g, y) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lst-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}tuples-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall l \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{lst}(l) \in \operatorname{tuples}(\mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encr-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}tuples-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, y.\; (((g \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (y \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{encr}(g, y) \in \operatorname{tuples}(\mathbf{Set})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \Rightarrow (t \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall a \in t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \Rightarrow \neg (a \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((k \in t) \wedge (l \in \mathbf{Set}))) \Rightarrow \neg (k = \operatorname{lst}(l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encr-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}token}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, g, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((k \in t) \wedge ((g \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (y \in \mathbf{Set})))) \Rightarrow \neg (k = \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, c.; \forall m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k). \\ \quad \forall a \in t.\; (a \in c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)). \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(i, l) \in c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{lst}(l) \in c \wedge \\ \quad \forall g, y.\; (((g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge ((y \in k) \wedge (g \in c))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{encr}(g, y) \in c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \in c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k). \\ \quad m \in t \vee \\ \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)).\; (m = \operatorname{lst}(l)) \vee \\ \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k), y \in k.\; (m = \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{subterm\text{-}rel}(t, k) \simeq \{p \in (\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \times \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) : \forall q \in \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \times \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}subterm\text{-}closed}(t, k, q) \Rightarrow (p \in q))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}msgs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, b) \Rightarrow ((a \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall r \in \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \times \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))), a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subterm\text{-}closed}(t, k, r) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, b)) \Rightarrow ([a, b] \in r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall a \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, l, i. \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq i \wedge \\ \quad i \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{nth}(i, l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{lst}(l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}encr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, g, y. \\ \quad ((g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge ((y \in k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \end{array}}}
