\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, b. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((b = \operatorname{lst}(l)) \wedge \exists i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq i) \wedge ((i \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{nth}(i, l))))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k), y \in k.\; ((b = \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, b, c. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, b, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}token}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a.; \forall b \in t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, b))) \Rightarrow (a = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a.; \forall l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)). \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{lst}(l)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((a = \operatorname{lst}(l)) \vee \exists i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq i) \wedge ((i \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{nth}(i, l))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}encr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, g, y. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge ((y \in k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{encr}(g, y)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a = \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \vee \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad a \in t \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{lst}(l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq i) \wedge ((i \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{nth}(i, l)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}encr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad a \in t \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}other-\allowbreak{}key}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, h, a, y, b. \\ \quad t \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad b \in k \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y = b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, \operatorname{encr}(a, b), \operatorname{encr}(h, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, \operatorname{encr}(a, b), h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k). \\ \quad \operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, m) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, \operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, m) \leq j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, k.; \forall l \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{lst}(l) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((j + 1) \leq n) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, j)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, k, g, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((g \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\operatorname{encr}(g, y) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((j + 1) \leq n) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}stage}(t, k, j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}token}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.; \forall a \in t.\; (\operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, a) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, l, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))) \wedge ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, \operatorname{nth}(i, l)) + 1) \leq \operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, \operatorname{lst}(l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{msg-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}encr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, g, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge (y \in k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, g) + 1) \leq \operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}rank}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a = b) \vee ((\operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, a) + 1) \leq \operatorname{msg\text{-}rank}(t, k, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}antisym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, b, a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/strand-spaces.scm}{structure-library/strand-spaces.scm}
\noindent{\small strand-spaces.scm -- STRAND SPACES, NODES, BUNDLES ON THE USER'S MODEL (\textasciitilde{}/notes/notes-60.txt items (b)-(g); the user's decisions of 2026-10-06 recorded in scratchpad/triage/WEEK3.md, section S-2; the paper's sections 2.1-2.4 supply the THEOREMS, not the definitions: Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}strand-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}bundle-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/strand-space-laws.scm}{theorem-library/strand-space-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small strand-space-laws.scm -- STRAND SPACES, NODES, BUNDLES, CAUSAL PRECEDENCE: the laws, and the paper's Lemmas 2.7, 2.8, 2.9 on the user's model. (\textasciitilde{}/notes/notes-60.txt; the definitions are structure-library/strand-spaces.scm; the paper is Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, \textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, sections 2.2-2.4.)}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nodes-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nodes}(a) \simeq \{n \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{ids}(a)) : ((1 \leq \operatorname{nth}(1, n)) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(1, n) \leq \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n)))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}content-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{nth}(\operatorname{nth}(1, n), \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{nth}(\operatorname{nth}(1, n), \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{directed-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.\; (\operatorname{directed}(t, k) \simeq (\{\mathit{sent}, \mathit{received}\} \times \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strands-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k.\; (\operatorname{strands}(t, k) \simeq \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{directed}(t, k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{index-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n.\; ((\operatorname{index\text{-}of}(n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, n)) \wedge (\operatorname{id\text{-}of}(n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prec-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b) \simeq \{p \in (d \times d) : \forall q \in \operatorname{power}((d \times d)).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}prec\text{-}closed}(a, d, b, q) \Rightarrow (p \in q))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \simeq \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), \operatorname{bnodes}(c), \operatorname{bsend}(c)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{precedes}(c) \simeq (\operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \cup \{p \in (\operatorname{bnodes}(c) \times \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) : (\operatorname{nth}(1, p) = \operatorname{nth}(2, p))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strand-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tokens}(a) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ids}(a) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{keys}(a) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a) \in (\operatorname{ids}(a) \to \operatorname{strands}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{keys-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}tokens}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{keys}(a).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{tokens}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kinv-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{kinv}(a) \in (\operatorname{keys}(a) \to \operatorname{keys}(a))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kinv-\allowbreak{}involution}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{keys}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{kinv}(a)(\operatorname{kinv}(a)(y)) = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kinv-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, y, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{keys}(a)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{keys}(a)) \wedge (\operatorname{kinv}(a)(y) = \operatorname{kinv}(a)(z))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad y = z \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strand-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(b) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{ids}(b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(b)(a) \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{directed}(\operatorname{tokens}(b), \operatorname{keys}(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, n) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nth}(2, n) \in \operatorname{ids}(a) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{nth}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, n) \leq \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))) \wedge \\ \quad n = [\operatorname{nth}(1, n), \operatorname{nth}(2, n)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, k, a. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{ids}(b)) \wedge ((1 \leq k) \wedge (k \leq \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(b)(a)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [k, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \operatorname{nodes}(a)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{nodes}(a)) \wedge ((\operatorname{nth}(1, x) = \operatorname{nth}(1, y)) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, x) = \operatorname{nth}(2, y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{directed-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall d \in \operatorname{directed}(t, k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{nth}(1, d) = \mathit{sent}) \vee (\operatorname{nth}(1, d) = \mathit{received}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nth}(2, d) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \wedge \\ \quad d = [\operatorname{nth}(1, d), \operatorname{nth}(2, d)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}directed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(\operatorname{nth}(1, n), \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))) \in \operatorname{directed}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}content-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}msgs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n) \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(a, n) = \mathit{sent}) \vee (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(a, n) = \mathit{received}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sent-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}received}}{\vnbstmt{\neg (\mathit{sent} = \mathit{received})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}sent-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}received}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, n) \vee \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(a, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}sent-\allowbreak{}and-\allowbreak{}received}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, n.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, n) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(a, n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{node-\allowbreak{}content-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, k, d. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{nth}(1, n) = k) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(k, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))) = d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, d)) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ssb-\allowbreak{}irreflexive}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, n.\; \neg \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, n, n)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ssb-\allowbreak{}transitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, y, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, x, y) \wedge \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, y, z)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, x, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ssu-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}ssb}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, x, y.\; (\operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, x, y) \Rightarrow \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}upto}(a, x, y))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ssu-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nodes}(a).\; \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}upto}(a, x, x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ssu-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}upto}(a, x, y) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, x, y) \vee (x = y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sends-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}dirs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{sends\text{-}to}(a, x, y) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}received}(a, y) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, x) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}nodes-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{bnodes}(c) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}send-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{bsend}(c) \in \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{bnodes}(c) \times \operatorname{bnodes}(c)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}nodes-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.; \forall x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{bspace}(c))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{bnodes}(c)| \in \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}send-\allowbreak{}sends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge ([x, y] \in \operatorname{bsend}(c))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{sends\text{-}to}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}received-\allowbreak{}sender}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c.; \forall y \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), y)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x. \\ \quad \quad \quad ([x, y] \in \operatorname{bsend}(c)) \wedge \forall z.\; (([z, y] \in \operatorname{bsend}(c)) \Rightarrow (z = x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}ssb-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c.; \forall y \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c), x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), x, y)) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}acyclic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow \neg ([x, x] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), \operatorname{bnodes}(c), \operatorname{bsend}(c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pair-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}box}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, d, x, y. \\ \quad ((r \in \operatorname{power}((d \times d))) \wedge ([x, y] \in r)) \Rightarrow ((x \in d) \wedge (y \in d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}send-\allowbreak{}nodes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge ([x, y] \in \operatorname{bsend}(c))) \Rightarrow ((x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ps-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}box}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, b, x, y. \\ \quad ([x, y] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b)) \Rightarrow ((x \in d) \wedge (y \in d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ps-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, b.; \forall r \in \operatorname{power}((d \times d)), x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prec\text{-}closed}(a, d, b, r) \wedge ([x, y] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [x, y] \in r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ps-\allowbreak{}send}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, b, x, y. \\ \quad ((b \in \operatorname{power}((d \times d))) \wedge ([x, y] \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [x, y] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ps-\allowbreak{}ssb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, b, x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in d) \wedge ((y \in d) \wedge \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, x, y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [x, y] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ps-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, b, x, y, z. \\ \quad (([x, y] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b)) \wedge ([y, z] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [x, z] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge (([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \wedge ([y, z] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [x, z] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}irreflexive}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c, x.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow \neg ([x, x] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}send-\allowbreak{}precedes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge ([x, y] \in \operatorname{bsend}(c))) \Rightarrow ([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}ssb-\allowbreak{}precedes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), x, y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}intro-\allowbreak{}strict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge ([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c))) \Rightarrow ([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.; \forall x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c).\; ([x, x] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad ([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \vee ((x = y) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ps-\allowbreak{}last-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, b, x, y. \\ \quad ((d \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{power}((d \times d))) \wedge ([x, y] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z. \\ \quad \quad \quad ([z, y] \in b) \vee ((z \in d) \wedge \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, z, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (z = x) \vee ([x, z] \in \operatorname{prec\text{-}strict}(a, d, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge (([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c)) \wedge ([y, z] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [x, z] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}antisym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge (([x, y] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c)) \wedge ([y, x] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c)))) \Rightarrow (x = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{precedes}(c) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{precedes-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}order}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}partial\text{-}order}(\operatorname{bnodes}(c), \operatorname{precedes}(c)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}minimal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \forall x, y, z.\; ((([x, y] \in r) \wedge ([y, z] \in r)) \Rightarrow ([x, z] \in r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x.\; \neg ([x, x] \in r) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \exists w.\; (w \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s.\; \forall z \in s.\; \neg ([z, m] \in r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}minimal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge (\forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \exists w.\; (w \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s.\; \forall z \in s.\; \neg ([z, m] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}minimal-\allowbreak{}precedes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge (\forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \exists w.\; (w \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s. \forall z \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (z = m) \Rightarrow \neg ([z, m] \in \operatorname{precedes}(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}minimal-\allowbreak{}sent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), x) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad y \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in s \wedge \\ \quad n \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg ([z, n] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{originates-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall m. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, m, n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{originates-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, m, n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{originates-\allowbreak{}sent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, n) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{originates-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}earlier}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \wedge \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, m, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{originates-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \wedge \operatorname{originates}(a, u, m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m = n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}minimal-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), z)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg ([z, n] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), u, n) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/strand-ideals-laws.scm}{theorem-library/strand-ideals-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small strand-ideals-laws.scm -- IDEALS OF THE MESSAGE ALGEBRA: Propositions 6.3, 6.6, 6.7, 6.8, Lemma 6.4 and Proposition 6.9 of Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, "Strand spaces: proving security protocols correct" (\textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, section 6), on the user's model (notes-60 with encryption).  Vocabulary: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \simeq \{m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) : \forall q \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)).\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}key\text{-}ideal}(t, k, a, q) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (z \in q)) \Rightarrow (m \in q))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, m, i. \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}key\text{-}ideal}(t, k, a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \in i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}msgs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k, a, s.; \forall m \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s).\; (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, i.; \forall m \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s). \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}key\text{-}ideal}(t, k, a, i) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (z \in i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m \in i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s.; \forall x \in s. \\ \quad (x \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ideal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \forall y \in a.\; (y \in k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}key\text{-}ideal}(t, k, a, \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, k, s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k).\; (x \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, s, \operatorname{singleton}(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}singleton-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, s, i, x, m. \\ \quad t \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}key\text{-}ideal}(t, k, s, i) \wedge \\ \quad x \in i \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, s, \operatorname{singleton}(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \in i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\forall y \in a.\; (y \in k) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(x, s, \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, \operatorname{singleton}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}keys}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, s, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}key\text{-}ideal}(t, k, s, i) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}key\text{-}ideal}(t, k, \emptyset, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ideal-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, t, k, a, s. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ideal\text{-}stage}(t, k, a, s, i) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ideal-\allowbreak{}stage-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, t, k, a, s.; \forall z \in \operatorname{ideal\text{-}stage}(t, k, a, s, i). \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\forall y \in a.\; (y \in k) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}stages}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\forall y \in a.\; (y \in k) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(i, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, \emptyset, \operatorname{ideal\text{-}stage}(t, k, a, s, i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, x. \\ \quad t \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a.\; (y \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in s \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad x = \operatorname{lst}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(j, l) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s), y \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{encr}(h, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}decrypt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, h, y. \\ \quad t \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in a.\; (w \in k) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in s.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}msg}(t, k, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in s, g.\; \neg (u = \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{encr}(h, y) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}key}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, h, y. \\ \quad t \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in a.\; (w \in k) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in s.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}msg}(t, k, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in s, g.\; \neg (u = \operatorname{encr}(g, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{encr}(h, y) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad y \in a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, l. \\ \quad t \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in a.\; (w \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in s.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}msg}(t, k, u) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{lst}(l) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(j, l) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}minimal-\allowbreak{}entry-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, i, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n) \in i \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), z) \in i) \Rightarrow \neg ([z, n] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}entry\text{-}point}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n, i) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/strand-tokens-nn.scm}{theorem-library/strand-tokens-nn.scm}
\noindent{\small sb5-tokens.scm -- every subset of NN is a token set; a nonempty token set exists. Agent SB-5, 2026-10-26.  Destination: theorem-library/strand-tokens-nn.scm (library strand). Load window: after structure-library/strand-messages (IS-TOKEN-SET) and list-recursion (nn-not-a-list).  Helper prefix sbt-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}token-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; ((t \subseteq \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}token-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(\mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}nonempty-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\exists t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in t))}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/strand-adversary.scm}{structure-library/strand-adversary.scm}
\noindent{\small strand-adversary.scm -- THE ADVERSARY: its traces, the infiltrated strand space (The paper's Definitions 3.1 and 3.2, Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, \textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, section 3.1, on the user's model of notes-60 with ENCRYPTION (the user's decision of 2026-10-06 16:40Z): the binary C and S traces made n-ary, the ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}infiltrated-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/strand-adversary-bound.scm}{theorem-library/strand-adversary-bound.scm}
\noindent{\small strand-adversary-bound.scm -- THE ADVERSARY BOUND (the paper's Proposition 3.3 on the user's model with encryption): a token the adversary does not know, and which originates on no regular node of a bundle, is a subterm of the content of NO node of the bundle. (Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, \textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{text-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, p, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in p.\; (x \in \operatorname{tokens}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}text\text{-}trace}(a, p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in p \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flush-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}sent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}flush\text{-}trace}(a, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tee-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}tee\text{-}trace}(a, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{concat-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}concat\text{-}trace}(a, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{separate-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separate\text{-}trace}(a, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encrypt-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}encrypt\text{-}trace}(a, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{decrypt-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}decrypt\text{-}trace}(a, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(a, u, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adversary-\allowbreak{}node-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(p, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), u, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adversary-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, u.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), u, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adversary-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}adversary-\allowbreak{}nodes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, u.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), u, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sent-\allowbreak{}received-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{(\mathit{sent} \in \{\mathit{sent}, \mathit{received}\}) \wedge (\mathit{received} \in \{\mathit{sent}, \mathit{received}\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{directed-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k). \\ \quad ([\mathit{sent}, g] \in \operatorname{directed}(t, k)) \wedge ([\mathit{received}, g] \in \operatorname{directed}(t, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{separate-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{strands}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a)).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}separate\text{-}trace}(a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{concat-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{strands}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a)).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}concat\text{-}trace}(a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{encrypt-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}strand}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, k, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{keys}(a)) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [[\mathit{received}, k], [\mathit{received}, m], [\mathit{sent}, \operatorname{encr}(m, k)]] \in \operatorname{strands}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}encrypt\text{-}trace}(a, [[\mathit{received}, k], [\mathit{received}, m], [\mathit{sent}, \operatorname{encr}(m, k)]]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{decrypt-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}strand}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, k, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(a) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{keys}(a)) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [[\mathit{received}, \operatorname{kinv}(a)(k)], [\mathit{received}, \operatorname{encr}(m, k)], [\mathit{sent}, m]] \in \operatorname{strands}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}decrypt\text{-}trace}(a, [[\mathit{received}, \operatorname{kinv}(a)(k)], [\mathit{received}, \operatorname{encr}(m, k)], [\mathit{sent}, m]]) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/nsl.scm}{structure-library/nsl.scm}
\noindent{\small nsl.scm -- THE NEEDHAM-SCHROEDER-LOWE PROTOCOL ON THE USER'S STRAND MODEL: names, public keys, the initiator's and the responder's strands, NSL spaces. (Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, \textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, section 5: the paper's Definition 5.1 and the term-algebra specialisation that precedes it; the model is ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}pk-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/nsl.scm}{theorem-library/nsl.scm}
\noindent{\small nsl.scm -- THE NEEDHAM-SCHROEDER-LOWE PROTOCOL ON THE USER'S STRAND MODEL: the responder's guarantee (agreement, Proposition 5.2) and the secrecy of both nonces, the injectivity of the initiator's strand, the initiator's agreement (Propositions 5.8, 5.10, 5.13, 5.14). (Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pk-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{names}(p) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pubkey}(p) \in (\operatorname{names}(p) \to \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{names}(p).\; (x \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{names}(p).\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{names}(p)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{names}(p)) \wedge (\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(x) = \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(y)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{three-\allowbreak{}strand-\allowbreak{}node}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(a)) \wedge (\operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(a)(\operatorname{nth}(2, n)) = [b, c, d])) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{nth}(1, n) = 1) \wedge ((\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, b)) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, b)))) \vee \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{nth}(1, n) = 2) \wedge ((\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, c)) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, c)))) \vee \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{nth}(1, n) = 3) \wedge ((\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, d)) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(a, n) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{three-\allowbreak{}strand-\allowbreak{}nodes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, a, c, d, f. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{ids}(b)) \wedge (\operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(b)(a) = [c, d, f])) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [1, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(b, [1, a]) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(b, [1, a]) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad [2, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(b, [2, a]) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, d)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(b, [2, a]) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, d)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad [3, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(b, [3, a]) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(2, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{node\text{-}dir}(b, [3, a]) \simeq \operatorname{nth}(1, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{init-\allowbreak{}strand-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}strand}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, s, a, b, c, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad s \in \operatorname{strands}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resp-\allowbreak{}strand-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}strand}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}resp\text{-}strand}(p, s, a, b, c, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad s \in \operatorname{strands}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{init-\allowbreak{}strand-\allowbreak{}nodes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(a), b, c, d, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [1, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [1, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [1, a]) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, b]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad [2, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [2, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [2, a]) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, f, c]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad [3, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [3, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [3, a]) = \operatorname{encr}(f, \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resp-\allowbreak{}strand-\allowbreak{}nodes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}resp\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(a), b, c, d, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [1, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [1, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [1, a]) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, b]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad [2, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [2, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [2, a]) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, f, c]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad [3, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [3, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [3, a]) = \operatorname{encr}(f, \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}encr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((g \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (y \in \mathbf{Set}))) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{encr}(g, y) \in t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{token-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}lst}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, l.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge (l \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{lst}(l) \in t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}flat-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, d, w, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in d.\; (x \in t) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, w, \operatorname{lst}(l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (w = \operatorname{lst}(l)) \vee (w \in d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}flat-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}list}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, d, w, l, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in d.\; (x \in t) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, w, \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(l), y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (w = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(l), y)) \vee ((w = \operatorname{lst}(l)) \vee (w \in d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subterm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}flat-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}token}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, d, w, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (z \in t) \wedge \\ \quad x \in d \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, w, \operatorname{encr}(x, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (w = \operatorname{encr}(x, y)) \vee (w \in d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}content}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \{d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) : \neg (d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) = \operatorname{encr}(x, k) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\{d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) : \neg (d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))\}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(l), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}subterm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{encr}(g, y) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}subterm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{lst}(m), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}key}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), y, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adversary-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}loss}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, m, x, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(p, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), [1, \operatorname{nth}(2, m)], m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), [1, \operatorname{nth}(2, m)]) = \operatorname{lst}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \operatorname{lst}(l)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (1 \leq q) \wedge ((q \leq \operatorname{length}(l)) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) = \operatorname{nth}(q, l))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), [1, \operatorname{nth}(2, m)]) = \operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adversary-\allowbreak{}sent-\allowbreak{}source}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, m, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(p, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), w, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), w, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x)) \vee \\ \quad \quad w = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad w \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) = \operatorname{lst}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq \operatorname{length}(l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists x. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x, m) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x) = \operatorname{nth}(i, l)) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists h.; \exists k \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) = \operatorname{encr}(h, k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x, m) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x) = h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}send-\allowbreak{}content}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge ((\operatorname{bspace}(c) = d) \wedge ([a, b] \in \operatorname{bsend}(c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(d, a) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(d, b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}minimal-\allowbreak{}sent-\allowbreak{}back}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y.\; ((([x, y] \in \operatorname{bsend}(c)) \wedge (y \in s)) \Rightarrow (x \in s)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg ([z, n] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}minimal-\allowbreak{}earlier}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, a, s, u, b, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = a \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(a, u, b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(a, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad [x, n] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(a, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}key-\allowbreak{}secret}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, y.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), y, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}source}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, a, l, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq q \wedge \\ \quad q \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), a) = \operatorname{nth}(q, l) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad [x, a] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{lst}(l), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad [z, a] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}adversary-\allowbreak{}loss}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, m, x, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(y) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad [z, m] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}resp-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}resp\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), d, [2, s]) \end{array}}}
