\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}init-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, t, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(t), a, b, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), c, [1, t]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}init-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a, b, c, d, f, g, a_{2}, b_{2}, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), f) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(a), c, d, f, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(b), a_{2}, b_{2}, f, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}lemma-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, a]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, w, b]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), d, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, a]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, w, b]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg ([z, g] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}initiator-\allowbreak{}secrecy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f.; \forall m \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), d, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, a]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m)) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, w, b]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}initiator-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}sent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f.; \forall m \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m) = d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nsl-\allowbreak{}initiator-\allowbreak{}agreement}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}resp\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(t), a, b, d, f) \wedge ([2, t] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/flat-regular-laws.scm}{theorem-library/flat-regular-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small flat-regular-laws.scm -- THE NSL ARGUMENT, ONCE, OVER ANY PUBLIC-KEY SPACE WHOSE REGULAR CONTENTS ARE FLAT (IS-FLAT-REGULAR, structure-library/flat-regular.scm).  Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, \textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, section 5: the lemmas behind Lemmas 5.3, 5.4, 5.6 (and, for the original protocol, 5.9), stated for a ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}content}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \{d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) : \neg (d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) = \operatorname{encr}(x, k) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\{d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) : \neg (d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))\}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(l), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}subterm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{encr}(g, y) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}subterm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{lst}(m), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}key}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), y, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}key-\allowbreak{}secret}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, y.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), y, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}source}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, a, l, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq q \wedge \\ \quad q \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), a) = \operatorname{nth}(q, l) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad [x, a] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{lst}(l), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad [z, a] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}adversary-\allowbreak{}loss}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, m, x, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(y) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad [z, m] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resp-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}nodes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(a) = [[\mathit{received}, b], [\mathit{sent}, c], [\mathit{received}, d]] \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [1, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [1, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [1, a]) = b \wedge \\ \quad \quad [2, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [2, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [2, a]) = c \wedge \\ \quad \quad [3, a] \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}received}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [3, a]) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), [3, a]) = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}resp-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s) \\ \quad =\; [[\mathit{received}, a], [\mathit{sent}, \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), c)], [\mathit{received}, \operatorname{encr}(f, d)]] \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), f, \operatorname{lst}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), f, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), f, [2, s]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}lemma-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s) \\ \quad =\; [[\mathit{received}, a], [\mathit{sent}, \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), d)], [\mathit{received}, \operatorname{encr}(g, f)]] \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(d) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (g \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, \operatorname{lst}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), d), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), d), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg ([z, h] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{flat-\allowbreak{}lemma-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}6}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f, g.; \forall h \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s) \\ \quad =\; [[\mathit{received}, a], [\mathit{sent}, \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), d)], [\mathit{received}, \operatorname{encr}(g, f)]] \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(d) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (g \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, \operatorname{lst}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), d), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), g, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), d), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg ([z, h] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), k, h) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), k) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(b), d))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/nso-laws.scm}{theorem-library/nso-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small nso-laws.scm -- THE ORIGINAL NEEDHAM-SCHROEDER PROTOCOL: Lemma 5.9 of Thayer, Herzog, Guttman (\textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, section 5.3): "In the original Needham-Schroeder protocol, a node n1 precedes n2 on the same regular strand t, and term(n1) = \{Na Nb\}\_KA."  Version 2 (agent SB-2, 2026-10-26): the theorems are ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}content}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge ((n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \{d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) : \neg (d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) = \operatorname{encr}(x, k) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\{d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) : \neg (d \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))\}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}(l), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}flat}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}flat\text{-}regular}(p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}subterm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{encr}(g, y) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}subterm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{lst}(m), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}key}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), y, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}key-\allowbreak{}secret}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, y.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), y, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}source}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, a, l, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq q \wedge \\ \quad q \leq \operatorname{length}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), a) = \operatorname{nth}(q, l) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (l \in \operatorname{tuples}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad [x, a] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{lst}(l), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad [z, a] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}adversary-\allowbreak{}loss}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, m, x, g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x, m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(y) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), x)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad [z, m] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}resp-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}resp\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), d, [2, s]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}lemma-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, f]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, f]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg ([z, g] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nso-\allowbreak{}lemma-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}9}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f.; \forall g \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nso\text{-}resp\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), f, \\ \quad \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, f]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, f]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)), \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg ([z, g] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p), g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), h) = \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([d, f]), \operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)) \end{array}}}

\Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}text\text{-}trace}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p), x) = h) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))), k \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) = h \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x, m) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x) = \operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{same\text{-}strand\text{-}before}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x, m) \wedge (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), x) = \operatorname{encr}(h, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tokens-\allowbreak{}are-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, s.; \forall u \in s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (z \in t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}msg}(t, k, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}decrypt-\allowbreak{}atoms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, h, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in a.\; (w \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in t) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{encr}(h, y) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}honest}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a.\; (y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)).\; ((y \in s) \vee (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))(y) \in a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}honest}(p, c, \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), a, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{text-\allowbreak{}node-\allowbreak{}content}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}text\text{-}trace}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p), \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))(\operatorname{nth}(2, m))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}token}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in a.\; (w \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in t \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a.\; (y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)).\; ((y \in s) \vee (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))(y) \in a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg (z \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists m \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), m) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(p, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}entry\text{-}point}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), n, \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), a, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}adversary-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, a, s.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c), g, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a.\; (y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)).\; ((y \in s) \vee (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))(y) \in a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg (z \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}entry\text{-}point}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), n, \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), a, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(p, n) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), \operatorname{encr}(g, y), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}subterms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, t_{0}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge ((k \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (t_{0} \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, k, \operatorname{singleton}(t_{0})) = \{w \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) : \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(t, k, t_{0}, w)\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adversary-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}ideals}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, u.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), u, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/otway-rees.scm}{structure-library/otway-rees.scm}
\noindent{\small otway-rees.scm -- THE OTWAY-REES PROTOCOL ON THE USER'S STRAND MODEL (Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, \textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, section 7.1, Definitions 7.1 and 7.3). DEFINITIONS ONLY; the laws are in theorem-library/otway-rees-laws.scm.  Agent SB-3, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26.  Destination: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}sk-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/otway-rees-laws.scm}{theorem-library/otway-rees-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small otway-rees-laws.scm -- THE OTWAY-REES PROTOCOL: Lemma 7.2, Theorem 7.4, Propositions 7.5, 7.6, Corollary 7.7 (Thayer, Herzog, Guttman, \textasciitilde{}/docs/jcs\_strand\_spaces.pdf, section 7), on the user's model. Vocabulary: structure-library/otway-rees.scm.  Agent SB-3, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26.  Destination: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sk-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}strand\text{-}space}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ltkey}(p) \in (\operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \to \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p).\; (x \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p).\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p)) \wedge (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x) = \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(y)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad x = y \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x)) = \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}init-\allowbreak{}resp-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, n, m, k, c, d, f, q, r, h, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}init}(p, s, a, b, n, m, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}resp}(p, s, c, d, f, q, r, h, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}init-\allowbreak{}serv-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, n, m, k, c, d, f, g, h, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}init}(p, s, a, b, n, m, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, s, c, d, f, g, h, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}resp-\allowbreak{}serv-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, n, m, k, h, g, c, d, f, q, r, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}resp}(p, s, a, b, n, m, k, h, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, s, c, d, f, q, r, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{key-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}atoms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k, a, s, h, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}token\text{-}set}(t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in a.\; (w \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in t) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(t, k) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{encr}(h, y) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (h \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(t, k, a, s)) \wedge (y \in a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}serv-\allowbreak{}key-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, d, m, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, c, d, m, k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), k, [2, s]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}session-\allowbreak{}key-\allowbreak{}secrecy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, v, a, b, d, f, m, k.; \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(v), a, b, d, f, m, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(a) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(b) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), z) \in \operatorname{key\text{-}ideal\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))), \{\mathit{orv} \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) : \neg (\mathit{orv} \in \{w \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) : ((w = \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(a)) \vee ((w = \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(b)) \vee (w = k)))\})\}, \operatorname{singleton}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}ltkey-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, x, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}ltkey-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}adversary-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, x.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c), g \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(g, \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}ltkey-\allowbreak{}injective-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, x, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p)) \wedge (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x) = \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(z))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = z \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}regular-\allowbreak{}encr-\allowbreak{}shapes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, x, n, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{msg\text{-}set}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(h, \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x)), n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}text}(p, a) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))) \wedge (h = \operatorname{lst}([a, b]))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists a, c, d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}text}(p, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}text}(p, c) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p)) \wedge (h = \operatorname{lst}([a, c, x, d]))))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists a, c, d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}text}(p, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}text}(p, c) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p)) \wedge (h = \operatorname{lst}([a, c, d, x]))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}init-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, t, a, b, n, m, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}init}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(t), a, b, n, m, k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), n, [1, t]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}resp-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, t, a, b, n, m, k, h, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}resp}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(t), a, b, n, m, k, h, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), n, [2, t]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}77-\allowbreak{}server}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, x, n, c, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([c, k]), \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(x)), n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, n) = 2 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists a, b, d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{nth}(2, n)), a, x, b, c, d, k) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists f, b, d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{nth}(2, n)), x, f, c, b, d, k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), k, [2, \operatorname{nth}(2, n)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}77-\allowbreak{}initiator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, c, d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([c, d, a, b]), \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(a)), n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, n) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}init}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{nth}(2, n)), a, b, c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), c, [1, \operatorname{nth}(2, n)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}77-\allowbreak{}responder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n, c, d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), n) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([c, d, a, b]), \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(b)), n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, n) = 2 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists f, g, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}resp}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{nth}(2, n)), a, b, c, d, f, g, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), c, [2, \operatorname{nth}(2, n)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bundle-\allowbreak{}subterm-\allowbreak{}originates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, a, u, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = a \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(a), \operatorname{keys}(a), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(a, z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c).\; \operatorname{originates}(a, u, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}initiator-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}source}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, m, k, h, g, d, f, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}init}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, c, m, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([c, f, u, v]), \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(a)), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (f = m) \wedge ((u = a) \wedge (v = b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}responder-\allowbreak{}nonce-\allowbreak{}source}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, a, b, c, m, k, h, g, d, f, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}resp}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, c, m, k, h, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p), d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{sk\text{-}names}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), \operatorname{encr}(\operatorname{lst}([c, f, u, v]), \operatorname{ltkey}(p)(b)), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (f = m) \wedge ((u = a) \wedge (v = b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}initiator-\allowbreak{}guarantee}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, m, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), d) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(a) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(b) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}init}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, m, k) \wedge \\ \quad [2, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (r \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}ids}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad [2, r] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists g, h, n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}resp}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(r), a, b, f, m, g, h, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (v \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}ids}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad [2, v] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(v), a, b, d, f, m, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{or-\allowbreak{}responder-\allowbreak{}guarantee}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, m, k, h, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)), d) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(a) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ltkey}(p)(b) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}resp}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, m, k, h, g) \wedge \\ \quad [3, s] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (i \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}ids}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad [1, i] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f, n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}init}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(i), a, b, f, m, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (v \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}ids}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad [2, v] \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}or\text{-}serv}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{sk\text{-}inf}(p)))(v), a, b, f, d, m, k) \end{array}}}
