\vnbentry{\texttt{subadd-\allowbreak{}reg-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), x \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (0 \leq g(x)) \wedge \\ \quad g(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), z)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{max}(g(x), \operatorname{max}(g(y), g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (((1/2 \cdot g(x)) \leq \operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x)) \wedge (\operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x) \leq g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mprod-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall u, w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < k) \Rightarrow (u(i) = w(i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mprod}(m, u, k) = \operatorname{mprod}(m, w, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fact-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}concat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in \mathbb{N}, b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(m)), c \in \mathbb{N}, d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(m)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (0 \leq g(x)) \wedge \\ \quad g(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), z)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{max}(g(x), \operatorname{max}(g(y), g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(b(i))), a) + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(d(i))), c) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{fact\text{-}sums}(m, g, \operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{mprod}(m, b, a), \operatorname{mprod}(m, d, c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subadd-\allowbreak{}reg-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (0 \leq g(x)) \wedge \\ \quad g(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), z)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{max}(g(x), \operatorname{max}(g(y), g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, \operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y)) \leq (\operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x) + \operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/tg-vocab.scm}{structure-library/tg-vocab.scm}
\noindent{\small tg-vocab.scm -- topological groups (topological-vector-space.pdf Appendix A.3, TB-11). DEFINITIONS ONLY.  Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26 (new definitions, the user's to confirm).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tg-struct.scm}{theorem-library/tg-struct.scm}
\noindent{\small tg-struct.scm -- the structure TOP-GROUP and the group topologies: the underlying space and group of a topological group (the typing obligations of the two constructed functors), the bridge IS-TOP-GROUP(G) =$>$ IS-GROUP-TOPOLOGY(space, group), and the way back, IS-GROUP-TOPOLOGY(s, g) =$>$ IS-TOP-GROUP(MAKE-TOP-GROUP(s, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}topology}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{opr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{iden}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{inv}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}topology}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{topology}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{opens}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(s, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}functorial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}group}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(b), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}functorial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}group}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(a), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(b), f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tg-group.scm}{theorem-library/tg-group.scm}
\noindent{\small tg-group.scm -- group algebra the topological-group work needs (right identity, right inverse, inverse of an inverse, inverse of a product) and the monoid underlying a group. Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: tgg-.  Library: algebra (GRP-MONOID: tg-vocab).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, \operatorname{inv}(s)(a)) = \operatorname{iden}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, \operatorname{iden}(s)) = a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(a)) = a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inv}(s)(\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, b)) = \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(b), \operatorname{inv}(s)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(s)(\operatorname{iden}(s)) = \operatorname{iden}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grp-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{grp\text{-}monoid}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grp-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{grp\text{-}monoid}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{opr}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grp-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{grp\text{-}monoid}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{iden}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grp-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}monoid}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(\operatorname{grp\text{-}monoid}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}carr-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(s) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}mid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(a), b), \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(b), c)) = \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(a), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}translate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, y)), \operatorname{opr}(s)(a, x)) = \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(y), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(v), u) = \operatorname{iden}(s))) \Rightarrow (u = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall y, p \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(s)(y, \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{inv}(s)(y), p)) = p) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/top-groups.scm}{theorem-library/top-groups.scm}
\noindent{\small tg-top.scm -- what continuity of (x, y) |-$>$ x y\textasciicircum{}-1 gives in a topological group: the inverse and the left translates of an open set are open, and an open neighbourhood of e contains a symmetric open V with V V V inside it.  Plus the local criterion for openness. Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: tgt-.  Library: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in u.\; \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((a \in w) \wedge (w \subseteq u)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (v \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}parts-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(s) = \operatorname{carr}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(g), w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{inv}(g)(b)) \in w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (b \in v) \wedge \forall p \in u, q \in v.\; (\operatorname{opr}(g)(p, \operatorname{inv}(g)(q)) \in w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) = \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)), w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(a, \operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(b)) \in w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((b \in v) \wedge \forall p \in u, q \in v.\; (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p, \operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(q)) \in w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \Rightarrow (\{z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (\operatorname{inv}(g)(z) \in w)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) : (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(z) \in w)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}translate-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g), w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (\operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), z) \in w)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}translate-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)), w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) : (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(a), z) \in w)\} \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}sym-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{iden}(g) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pp}, q \in v.\; (\operatorname{opr}(g)(\mathit{pp}, q) \in w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}sym-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pp}, q \in v.\; (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\mathit{pp}, q) \in w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}sym-\allowbreak{}triple-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{iden}(g) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{tp}, q, r \in v.\; (\operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(\mathit{tp}, q), r) \in w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}sym-\allowbreak{}triple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{tp}, q, r \in v. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\mathit{tp}, q), r) \in w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}nbhd-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{opens}(s)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in q(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{opens}(s)). \\ \quad \quad \quad a(0) = \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{qk} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{iden}(g) \in a(\mathit{qk}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in a(\mathit{qk}).\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in a(\mathit{qk})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{tp}, \mathit{tq}, r \in a((\mathit{qk} + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(\mathit{tp}, \mathit{tq}), r) \in a(\mathit{qk}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a((\mathit{qk} + 1)) \subseteq q(\mathit{qk}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}nbhd-\allowbreak{}sequence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in q(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))). \\ \quad \quad \quad s(0) = \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{qk} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in s(\mathit{qk}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in s(\mathit{qk}).\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p) \in s(\mathit{qk})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{tp}, \mathit{tq}, r \in s((\mathit{qk} + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\mathit{tp}, \mathit{tq}), r) \in s(\mathit{qk}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad s((\mathit{qk} + 1)) \subseteq q(\mathit{qk}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{half-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{power}(1/2, k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)) \wedge (\operatorname{power}(1/2, (k + 1)) = (1/2 \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{half-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}anti}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{power}(1/2, k) \leq \operatorname{power}(1/2, j)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{half-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a \leq \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)) \Rightarrow (a \leq 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{opens}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad a(0) = \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{iden}(g) \in a(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in a(k).\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in a(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, r \in a((k + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(p, q), r) \in a(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(s, x) \simeq \operatorname{einf}(\{r \in \mathbb{R} : \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((x \in s(k)) \wedge (r = \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}decreasing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a((k + 1)) \subseteq a(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}nested}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall k, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \wedge (k \leq j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a(j) \subseteq a(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad \{r \in \mathbb{R} : \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((x \in s(k)) \wedge (r = \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)))\} \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (x \in s(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(s, x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(s, x)) \wedge (\operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(s, x) \leq \operatorname{power}(1/2, k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}last-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \wedge \neg (x \in a(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((x \in a(q)) \wedge (\neg (x \in a((q + 1))) \wedge ((q + 1) \leq k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}exact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \wedge ((x \in a(q)) \wedge \neg (x \in a((q + 1)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, x) = \operatorname{power}(1/2, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}char}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \wedge (\operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, x) \leq \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in a(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, \operatorname{iden}(g)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, x) = \operatorname{power}(1/2, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}triple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y), z)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, x), \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, y), \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, s, x) \simeq \operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(\operatorname{grp\text{-}monoid}(g), (\lambda z \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(s, z)), x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, x) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad (1/2 \cdot \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, x)) \leq \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, x) \leq \operatorname{bk\text{-}gauge}(a, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, c.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, c, \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b)) \leq (\operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, c, a) + \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{bmx\_}, \operatorname{bmy\_}] \in (\operatorname{carr}(g) \times \operatorname{carr}(g)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{bmy\_}), \operatorname{bmx\_})) + \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{bmx\_}), \operatorname{bmy\_}))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{carr}(g) \times \operatorname{carr}(g)) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{bmx\_}, \operatorname{bmy\_}] \in (\operatorname{carr}(g) \times \operatorname{carr}(g)).\; (\operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{bmy\_}), \operatorname{bmx\_})) + \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{bmx\_}), \operatorname{bmy\_}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a))(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(y), x)) + \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(x), y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}f-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bk\text{-}f}(g, a, \operatorname{iden}(g)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z \in a(k)) \Rightarrow (z = \operatorname{iden}(g))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}invariant}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a), g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, b.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, z \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, b) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), z) \in b(((k + 1) + 1))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, b))(a, z) \leq \operatorname{power}(1/2, (k + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}nbhd-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, b.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, z \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, b))(a, z) < \operatorname{power}(1/2, (k + 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), z) \in b(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}topology}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z \in a(k)) \Rightarrow (z = \operatorname{iden}(g))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in w) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{fk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(\mathit{fk}) \subseteq w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (u \in \operatorname{opens}(s)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{birkhoff-\allowbreak{}kakutani-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(s) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}countable\text{-}nbhd\text{-}base}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(d) = \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}invariant}(d, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d)) = \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{birkhoff-\allowbreak{}kakutani}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}countable\text{-}nbhd\text{-}base}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(d) = \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}invariant}(d, \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d)) = \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}pseudometric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, b.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g), r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, b) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, b), a, r) \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, b.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, b))(a, a) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bk-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, b.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(g), z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, b), a, \operatorname{power}(1/2, (k + 1))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (z \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), z) \in b(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}pseudometrics-\allowbreak{}define-\allowbreak{}topology-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall a \in u. \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, b) \wedge \exists r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, b), a, r) \subseteq u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}pseudometrics-\allowbreak{}define-\allowbreak{}topology}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall a \in u. \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), s), a, r) \subseteq u) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/top-product.scm}{theorem-library/top-product.scm}
\noindent{\small tych.scm -- THE PRODUCT TOPOLOGY OF AN ARBITRARY FAMILY, its projections and universal property, and TYCHONOFF'S THEOREM for arbitrary products, from zorn-lemma (Alexander's argument, specialised to the subbasic constraints of the product).  Agent TYCH (worker-08), 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}pts-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f) \simeq \{\mathit{tpx} \in (x \to \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, x, \operatorname{pts}(f(j)))) : \forall i \in x.\; (\operatorname{tpx}(i) \in \operatorname{pts}(f(i)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}constr-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(x, f) \simeq \{b \in (x \times \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, x, \operatorname{opens}(f(j)))) : (\operatorname{nth}(2, b) \in \operatorname{opens}(f(\operatorname{nth}(1, b))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, b) \simeq \{y \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f) : \forall c \in b.\; (y(\operatorname{nth}(1, c)) \in \operatorname{nth}(2, c))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}pts-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, z. \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (z \in (x \to \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, x, \operatorname{pts}(f(j))))) \wedge \forall i \in x.\; (z(i) \in \operatorname{pts}(f(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}constr-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, z. \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(x, f) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((z \in (x \times \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, x, \operatorname{opens}(f(j))))) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, z) \in \operatorname{opens}(f(\operatorname{nth}(1, z))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, b, z. \\ \quad (z \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f)) \wedge \forall c \in b.\; (z(\operatorname{nth}(1, c)) \in \operatorname{nth}(2, c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}sets}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(x, f) \in \mathbf{Set})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)) \simeq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}opens}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)) \simeq \{u \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f)) : \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, u)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}anti}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, a, b. \\ \quad (a \subseteq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, b) \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{card-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.\; ((|x| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}tprod-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, u) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; u \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in u. \exists \mathit{tpf}. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{tpf} \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(x, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\mathit{tpf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad w \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, \mathit{tpf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, \mathit{tpf}) \subseteq u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, \emptyset))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}whole}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, (u \cap v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge \forall o \in m.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, o)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tprod\text{-}open}(x, f, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, m, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge ((b \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(x, f)) \wedge (|b| \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, b) \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tproj-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, i, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge ((i \in x) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tproj}(x, f, i)(y) = y(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tproj-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge (i \in x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f), f(i), \operatorname{tproj}(x, f, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, b, z, f, a, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(z) \to \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z, b(k), (\lambda q \in \operatorname{pts}(z).\; f(q)(k))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(z) \wedge \\ \quad c \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(x, b) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |c| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{tpc} \in c.\; (f(a)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{tpc})) \in \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{tpc})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(z). \\ \quad \quad \quad (a \in w) \wedge \forall p \in w, \mathit{tpc} \in c.\; (f(p)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{tpc})) \in \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{tpc})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, z, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z) \wedge (f \in (\operatorname{pts}(z) \to \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z, \operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, a), f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z, a(k), (\lambda q \in \operatorname{pts}(z).\; f(q)(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, t, g) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \forall q \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (h(q) = g(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, t, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}induced-\allowbreak{}map}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, z, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in x.\; (a(k) \in (\operatorname{pts}(z) \to \operatorname{pts}(f(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z, f(k), a(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z, \operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f), (\lambda q \in \operatorname{pts}(z).\; (\lambda m \in x.\; a(m)(q)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in x, p \in \operatorname{pts}(z). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tproj}(x, f, k)((\lambda q \in \operatorname{pts}(z).\; (\lambda m \in x.\; a(m)(q)))(p)) = a(k)(p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}induced-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, z, a, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in x.\; (a(k) \in (\operatorname{pts}(z) \to \operatorname{pts}(f(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(z) \to \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(x, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in x, p \in \operatorname{pts}(z).\; (\operatorname{tproj}(x, f, k)(h(p)) = a(k)(p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h = (\lambda q \in \operatorname{pts}(z).\; (\lambda m \in x.\; a(m)(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{chain-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h.; \forall f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \exists \mathit{tph}.\; (\mathit{tph} \in h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in h.\; ((a \subseteq b) \vee (b \subseteq a)) \wedge \\ \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad f \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(v, h, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in h.\; (f \subseteq d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{has-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}subcover-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}finite\text{-}subcover}(s, c) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists g.\; ((g \subseteq c) \wedge ((|g| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(v, g, v) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{alexander-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\forall u \in a.\; (u \in \operatorname{opens}(s)) \wedge \neg \operatorname{has\text{-}finite\text{-}subcover}(s, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m. \\ \quad \quad \quad a \subseteq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad m \subseteq \operatorname{opens}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{has\text{-}finite\text{-}subcover}(s, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (w \in m) \Rightarrow \operatorname{has\text{-}finite\text{-}subcover}(s, (m \cup \{w\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}outside}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((m \subseteq \operatorname{opens}(s)) \wedge ((w \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}finite\text{-}subcover}(s, (m \cup \{w\}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k_{2}. \\ \quad \quad \quad k_{2} \subseteq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad |k_{2}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\neg (y \in w) \Rightarrow (y \in \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(v, k_{2}, v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tychonoff-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, m, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{tpi} \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(f(\mathit{tpi})) \wedge \\ \quad m \subseteq \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{has\text{-}finite\text{-}subcover}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f), m) \wedge \\ \quad i \in x \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{pts}(f(i)). \forall v_{5} \in \operatorname{opens}(f(i)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, \{[i, v_{5}]\}) \in m) \Rightarrow \neg (e \in v_{5}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tprod-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}constraint-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f, m, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge \\ \quad m \subseteq \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(x, f) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |b| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall c_{8} \in b. \exists k_{2}. \\ \quad \quad k_{2} \subseteq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad |k_{2}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (y \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, \{c_{8}\})) \Rightarrow (y \in \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(v, k_{2}, v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k_{3} \in \operatorname{power}(m). \\ \quad \quad \quad |k_{3}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (y \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(x, f, b)) \Rightarrow (y \in \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(v, k_{3}, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tychonoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(x, f) \wedge \forall i \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(f(i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(x, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, t, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) = y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/singleton-is-set.scm}{theorem-library/singleton-is-set.scm}
\noindent{\small singleton-is-set.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/ca-lft-plane.scm, so that files of library core may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of ca-lft-plane.scm's.  Loaded immediately before ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{singleton-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{singleton}(y) \in \mathbf{Set})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg2-setprod.scm}{theorem-library/cg2-setprod.scm}
\noindent{\small cg2-setprod.scm -- set products and set powers in a group: V\textasciicircum{}k inside the carrier, V\textasciicircum{}k V inside V\textasciicircum{}(k+1), and the union H of the V\textasciicircum{}k is a subgroup when V is symmetric and contains e (compact-groups notes, Prop 5.8, the algebraic part: "for any set E such that E = E\textasciicircum{}-1, the union of the E\textasciicircum{}k is clearly a subgroup").}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{set\text{-}prod}(g, a, b) \simeq \{z \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \exists x \in a, y \in b.\; (z = \operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((x \in a) \wedge (y \in b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y) \in \operatorname{set\text{-}prod}(g, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b.; \forall z \in \operatorname{set\text{-}prod}(g, a, b). \\ \quad (z \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \exists x \in a, y \in b.\; (z = \operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, v.; \forall z \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, 0).\; (z = \operatorname{iden}(g))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, 0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, g, v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v, k, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, (k + 1))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (z \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \exists x \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k), y \in v.\; (z = \operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v, k, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k)) \wedge (y \in v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y) \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, (k + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, g, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k) \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v, k, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((\operatorname{iden}(g) \in v) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, (k + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, v.\; (\operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \simeq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v, k, z. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k))) \Rightarrow (z \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v.; \forall z \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v). \exists k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g))) \Rightarrow (v \subseteq \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}mult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v, z, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)) \wedge (y \in v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(z, y) \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}prod}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, g, v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v), y \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y) \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, g, v.; \forall y \in \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inv}(g)(y) \in \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}subgroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/frechet-metric.scm}{theorem-library/frechet-metric.scm}
\noindent{\small frechet-metric.scm -- a seminormed space with a COUNTABLE separating family of seminorms as a METRIC space: Thayer, "Analise Funcional e Teoria Espectral", Ch. 8 s.4, Props. 8.24-8.26 (pp. 254-256).  Batch TVS-1, 2026-10-10. Vocabulary: structure-library/frechet-metric.scm (FR-C-SPACE, FR-METRIC-SPACE,}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, a.\; ((\operatorname{vec}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}c\text{-}space}(m, a)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(m)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}dists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{vec}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dists}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}c\text{-}space}(m, a)) \simeq (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda [\operatorname{fru\_}, \operatorname{frv\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \operatorname{vec}(m)).\; a(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{fru\_}, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{frv\_})))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}dists-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, k, x, y. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{vec}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dists}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}c\text{-}space}(m, a))(k)(x, y) \simeq a(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, m, p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, m, p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow (p \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, m, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow (0 \leq p(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}subadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, p.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow (p(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) \leq (p(x) + p(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, m, p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow (p(\operatorname{vzero}(m)) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow (p(\operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)) = p(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, m, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow (a \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, a(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}separates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k)(x) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}c\text{-}space}(m, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric}(s))(x, y) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dists}(s)(k)(x, y) < a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}head-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s), b \in \mathbb{N}, e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((0 \leq e) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dists}(s)(j)(x, y) < e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))(k) \cdot \operatorname{min}(1, \operatorname{dists}(s)(k)(x, y)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad b) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y.; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 0 \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))(k) \cdot \operatorname{min}(1, \operatorname{dists}(s)(k)(x, y))))(i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))(k) \cdot \operatorname{min}(1, \operatorname{dists}(s)(k)(x, y))))(i) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dists}(s)(j)(x, y) < l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric}(s))(x, y) \leq a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a))(x, y) < l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad a(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) < s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq b) \Rightarrow (a(j)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) < l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a))(x, y) \leq s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}eventually}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, u, l. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq a)) \Rightarrow (u(j)(i)(a) < l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \mathbb{N}. \forall j, i, a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((j \leq b) \wedge ((t \leq i) \wedge (t \leq a))) \Rightarrow (u(j)(i)(a) < l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, q, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), q, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(m, a, q, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}conv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, q, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge ((q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m))) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(m, a, q, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), q, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}cauchy}(m, a, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \operatorname{fr\text{-}cauchy}(m, a, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, q, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge ((q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m))) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), q, b) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(m, a, q, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), q) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{fr\text{-}cauchy}(m, a, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}frechet-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, m, a) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}congr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dists}(s)(k)(x, y) = \operatorname{dists}(s)(k)(a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric}(s))(x, y) = \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric}(s))(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}translation-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, x, y, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (r \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, r), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, r)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a))(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric}(m, a)(x, y) \simeq \operatorname{series\text{-}limit}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (/(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (k + 1))) \cdot \operatorname{min}(1, a(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)))))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, c, f, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), g, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(f(n), g(n))), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, t, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(c, d, t) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(c)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vadd}(c)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(c)(b))) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(t(a), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(t(b))) \end{array}}}
