\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}ti-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(a) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(b) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, r. \\ \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (r \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, r), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, r)) = \operatorname{dist}(a)(x, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, r. \\ \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (r \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(b)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, r), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, r)) = \operatorname{dist}(b)(x, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(a, q, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(b, q, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(a, b, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{vec}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}metrics-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}equivalent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(t) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, r. \\ \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (r \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(t)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, r), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, r)) = \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q, b. \\ \quad \quad ((q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m))) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(t, q, b) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(m, a, q, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), t, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{vec}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(t, \operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{vec}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, p.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow (p(\operatorname{act}(m)(a, x)) = (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(a) \cdot p(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, m, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(d)), b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)), l \in \operatorname{carr}(d), x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d), s, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), b, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(m)(s(n), b(n))), \operatorname{act}(m)(l, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow (t(\operatorname{vzero}(a)) = \operatorname{vzero}(b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, t.; \forall m \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow (t(\operatorname{act}(a)(m, x)) = \operatorname{act}(b)(m, t(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, t.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(a)), m \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(a, b, q, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(c, d, (\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; t(q(i))), t(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) < l)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) < 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\operatorname{one}(d)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}ladder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, d.; \forall c, b \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge ((1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c)) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(d)(c, b) = \operatorname{one}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fsc}, \mathit{fsb} \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsc}) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsb})) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsc}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (1 + ((n \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c)) - n)) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsc}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 < u) \wedge ((0 < v) \wedge ((v < u) \wedge (u \leq (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsc}) \cdot v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(s) \cdot v) < u) \wedge (u \leq (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c) \cdot (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(s) \cdot v))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 < u) \wedge ((0 < v) \wedge (((\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsb}) \cdot v) < u) \wedge (u \leq v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(s) \cdot v) < u) \wedge (u \leq (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c) \cdot (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(s) \cdot v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}bracket}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall c, b \in \operatorname{carr}(d), u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge ((1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c)) \wedge ((\operatorname{mul}(d)(c, b) = \operatorname{one}(d)) \wedge ((0 < u) \wedge (0 < v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(s) \cdot v) < u) \wedge (u \leq (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c) \cdot (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(s) \cdot v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}lin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frm-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}nontrivially-\allowbreak{}valued}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/frechet-open-mapping-proof.scm}{theorem-library/frechet-open-mapping-proof.scm}
\noindent{\small frechet-open-mapping-proof.scm -- the OPEN MAPPING THEOREM for Frechet spaces and its bounded-inverse corollary: Thayer, "Analise Funcional e Teoria Espectral", Ch. 8 s.4, Thm 8.30, proved by the roadmap of exercise 8.9 (a)-(i).  Batch TVS-2A, 2026-10-11/12.  Helper prefix: fom-.  Every theorem here is proven modulo 0; ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, m, x. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m(i)(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq b) \Rightarrow (m(i)(x) < p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, d, m, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y.; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a))(x, y) < l) \wedge (i \leq k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad a(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) < s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ladder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, d.; \forall c, b \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge ((1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c)) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(d)(c, b) = \operatorname{one}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fsc}, \mathit{fsb} \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{mul}(d)(\mathit{fsc}, \mathit{fsb}) = \operatorname{one}(d)) \wedge ((1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsc})) \wedge ((1 + ((n \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c)) - n)) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\mathit{fsc})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge ((0 \leq r) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g, a \in \operatorname{carr}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(d)(g, a) = \operatorname{one}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(g) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(a)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(g) \cdot r) < l \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall z \in \operatorname{closure}(s, a), o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(o)) \Rightarrow \exists t \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(z, t) < o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}baire-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{pts}(s), e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (y \in e(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((\operatorname{dist}(s)(c, z) < r) \Rightarrow (z \in \operatorname{closure}(s, e(j))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}back}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall w, c \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(w, c), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(c)) = w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}quad}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall p, q, a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(q)), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(b)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(a)), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(q, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall y, a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b))) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(b)), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}m1}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}m2}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(a) = \operatorname{scal}(b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow (t \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(b))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, t.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow (t(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(b)(t(x), t(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, p.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow (p(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(u, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(v))) \leq (p(u) + p(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m.; \forall g, a \in \operatorname{carr}(d), z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(d)(g, a) = \operatorname{one}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(g, \operatorname{act}(m)(a, z)) = z \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < c) \wedge (a < b)) \Rightarrow ((c \cdot a) < (c \cdot b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}baire-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (y = t(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fnb} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{feta}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{feta}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(c), k \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq \mathit{fnb}) \Rightarrow (f(i)(z) < \mathit{feta})) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fx} \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq n) \Rightarrow (b(j)(\mathit{fx}) < l)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq k) \Rightarrow (f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(c)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(c)(t(\mathit{fx})))) < h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}a-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{recip}(((a + k) + 1)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{recip}(((a + k) + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{recip}(((a + (k + 1)) + 1)) < \operatorname{recip}(((a + k) + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}a-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}(((a + k) + 1)) \leq d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}telescope}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \mathbb{N}, d, m, a, f, v, b.; \forall k, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (j \leq (v + i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad a(j)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(f((i + 1)), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(f(i)))) < (\operatorname{recip}(((b + i) + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}(((b + (i + 1)) + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad k \leq l \wedge \\ \quad j \leq (v + k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(j)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(f(l), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(f(k)))) \leq (\operatorname{recip}(((b + k) + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}(((b + l) + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}fr-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, n, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{fr\text{-}ball}(m, a, n, s) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k \leq n) \Rightarrow (a(k)(x) < s))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad p(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(b))) = p(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fom-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fnb} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{feta}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{feta}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(c), k \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq \mathit{fnb}) \Rightarrow (f(i)(z) < \mathit{feta})) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq n) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) < l)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq k) \Rightarrow (f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(c)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(c)(t(x)))) < h)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}lin\text{-}map}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}mapping-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (y = t(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}lin\text{-}map}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}mapping-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(c, a, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(t(x)) = x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; (t(g(y)) = y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(c, f, a, b, g) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-metric-lemmas.scm}{theorem-library/ba-metric-lemmas.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-metric-lemmas.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1B), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1b-1109/ba-metric-lemmas.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall c \in \operatorname{pts}(s), d \in \mathbb{R}, f, l.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, f, l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b \leq n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(s)(c, f(n)) \leq d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(c, l) \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closure-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall o.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(o) \Rightarrow \exists y \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) < o)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{closure}(s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lipschitz-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), c \in \mathbb{R}, a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(s, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, p \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(f(x), f(p)) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, p))) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in a.\; (f(p) \in \operatorname{closure}(s, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(x) \in \operatorname{closure}(s, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/frechet-banach-steinhaus.scm}{theorem-library/frechet-banach-steinhaus.scm}
\noindent{\small frechet-banach-steinhaus.scm -- Thayer, "Analise Funcional e Teoria Espectral", Ch. 8 s.4, pp. 256-257: Thm 8.29 (closed graph bis) and Thm 8.32 (Banach-Steinhaus bis, exercise 8.10).  Batch TVS-2B, 2026-10-11/12.  Vocabulary (Def. 8.31, the equicontinuity of 8.32): structure-library/frechet-banach-steinhaus.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}dom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, c, s, d, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(b) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{vec}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, i. \\ \quad \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad c(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(b)(d(i), \operatorname{vneg}(b)(h))) \leq f(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(s(i), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(g))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(a, f, s, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(b, c, d, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}dom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, c, s, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(b) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (j \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad c(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(b)(d(i), \operatorname{vneg}(b)(d(j)))) \leq f(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(s(i), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(s(j)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}cauchy}(a, f, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}cauchy}(b, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, c, d, s, g, h, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(b) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{vec}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, i. \\ \quad \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad f(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(s(i), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(h))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; c(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(s(i), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(h))) + d(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(b)(g(i), \operatorname{vneg}(b)(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(a, c, s, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(b, d, g, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(a, f, s, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge (t \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})). \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad g(k)(x) = (b(k)(x) + f(k)(t(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(k)(x) = (b(k)(x) + f(k)(t(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, a, g(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(k)(x) = (b(k)(x) + f(k)(t(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}frechet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}closed\text{-}graph}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(k)(x) = (b(k)(x) + f(k)(t(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, a, (\lambda v \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}closed\text{-}graph}(a, b, c, f, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}baire-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{vec}(a), p. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b), m, p) \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b), \{\mathit{bx} \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \forall \mathit{bi} \in g.\; (f(k)(h(\mathit{bi})(\mathit{bx})) \leq n)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)), y) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, k, y, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b))(y, z) \leq e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(k)(t(y)) \leq (f(k)(t(z)) + s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, x, g, k, n, z.; \forall j \in x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (x \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, g(i)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b), \{\mathit{bx} \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \forall \mathit{bi} \in x.\; (f(k)(g(\mathit{bi})(\mathit{bx})) \leq n)\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(k)(g(j)(z)) \leq n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, f, g, h, t.; \forall c, b \in \operatorname{carr}(d), k, m, l, n.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, g, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, g, t) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(d)(c, b) = \operatorname{one}(d) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq m) \Rightarrow (f(j)(x) < l)) \Rightarrow (h(k)(t(x)) \leq n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq m) \Rightarrow (f(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(k)(t(x)) \leq (((\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c) \cdot n) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l)) \cdot r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fbs-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, h(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in g, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq m) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) < l)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(h(i)(x)) \leq n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{frechet-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}steinhaus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, h(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}equicont}(a, b, c, f, g, h) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{semigroup-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semigroup}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(s)(\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, b), c) = \operatorname{opr}(s)(a, \operatorname{opr}(s)(b, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}nrm-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nrm}(s) \in (\operatorname{carr}(s) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}nrm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(s) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{nrm}(s)(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}nrm-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(s) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{nrm}(s)(a) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (a = \operatorname{iden}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}nrm-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nrm}(s)(\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, b)) \leq (\operatorname{nrm}(s)(a) + \operatorname{nrm}(s)(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{injection-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.; \forall i \in \operatorname{injection}(x, y).\; (i \in (x \to y))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qq-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}ring})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}archimedean-\allowbreak{}floor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (0 \leq s)) \Rightarrow \exists w \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((s < (w \cdot r)) \wedge (((w \cdot r) - r) \leq s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{totally-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}subseq-\allowbreak{}rad}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{totally\text{-}bounded}(s) \wedge \operatorname{null\text{-}rr\text{-}seq}(d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i.\; (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(f, i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{summable-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(f(k), f((k + 1))) \leq d(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges}(s, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sums-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{dom}(f) \to \operatorname{carr}(p)), a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(p). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{sums\text{-}to}(p, f, a) \wedge \operatorname{sums\text{-}to}(p, f, b))) \Rightarrow (a = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb2-\allowbreak{}nrm-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f, g, d.; \forall w \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (g(z) = \operatorname{nrm}(p)(f(z))) \wedge \\ \quad |w| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad w \subseteq d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, w) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nrm}(p)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(p), f, w)) \leq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb2-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f, g, d.; \forall a, c \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (g(z) = \operatorname{nrm}(p)(f(z))) \wedge \\ \quad |a| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |c| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in c.\; \neg (z \in a) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq d \wedge \\ \quad c \subseteq d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, (a \cup c)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, a) + \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(p))(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(p), f, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(p), f, (a \cup c))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb2-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f, g, d.; \forall a, b \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (g(z) = \operatorname{nrm}(p)(f(z))) \wedge \\ \quad |a| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |b| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq b \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(p))(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(p), f, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(p), f, b)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, b) - \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb2-\allowbreak{}esum-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g \in (\operatorname{dom}(g) \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), l. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{esum}(g) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((|t| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((t \subseteq \operatorname{dom}(g)) \wedge (\operatorname{esum}(g) < (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, t) + l)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb2-\allowbreak{}choice-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g \in (\operatorname{dom}(g) \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), d. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{esum}(g) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad s(n) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad |s(n)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad s(n) \subseteq \operatorname{dom}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(g) < (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, s(n)) + d(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{absolute-\allowbreak{}summable-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}summable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{dom}(f) \to \operatorname{carr}(p)). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(p))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}absolutely\text{-}summable}(p, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}summable}(p, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}nary-\allowbreak{}plus-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, x, y, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad w + x + y + z \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{reduce}((\lambda [\operatorname{rbp\_}, \operatorname{rbq\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{rbp\_} + \operatorname{rbq\_})), \operatorname{fam\text{-}of\text{-}list}([w, x, y, z]), 4) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}nary-\allowbreak{}plus-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x, y, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad v + w + x + y + z \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{reduce}((\lambda [\operatorname{rbp\_}, \operatorname{rbq\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{rbp\_} + \operatorname{rbq\_})), \operatorname{fam\text{-}of\text{-}list}([v, w, x, y, z]), 5) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}nary-\allowbreak{}times-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (x \cdot y) = \operatorname{reduce}((\lambda [\operatorname{rbp\_}, \operatorname{rbq\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{rbp\_} \cdot \operatorname{rbq\_})), \operatorname{fam\text{-}of\text{-}list}([x, y]), 2) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}nary-\allowbreak{}times-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad x \cdot y \cdot z \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{reduce}((\lambda [\operatorname{rbp\_}, \operatorname{rbq\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{rbp\_} \cdot \operatorname{rbq\_})), \operatorname{fam\text{-}of\text{-}list}([x, y, z]), 3) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}nary-\allowbreak{}times-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, x, y, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad w \cdot x \cdot y \cdot z \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{reduce}((\lambda [\operatorname{rbp\_}, \operatorname{rbq\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{rbp\_} \cdot \operatorname{rbq\_})), \operatorname{fam\text{-}of\text{-}list}([w, x, y, z]), 4) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}nary-\allowbreak{}times-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}list-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x, y, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad v \cdot w \cdot x \cdot y \cdot z \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{reduce}((\lambda [\operatorname{rbp\_}, \operatorname{rbq\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{rbp\_} \cdot \operatorname{rbq\_})), \operatorname{fam\text{-}of\text{-}list}([v, w, x, y, z]), 5) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}fibre-\allowbreak{}count}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, g, t \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|g| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\forall y \in t.\; (p(y) \in g) \wedge \forall c \in g.\; (|\{x \in t : (p(x) = c)\}| = m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |t| = (m \cdot |g|) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}injection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, c, f. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{injection}(d, c)) \wedge (a \subseteq d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; f(x)) \in \operatorname{injection}(a, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}b}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, g, v. \\ \quad ((b \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (v \in c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in (a \cup \{b\}).\; \left(\text{if }(z = b)\text{ then }v\text{ else }g(z)\right))(b) = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}b}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, g, v.; \forall w \in a. \\ \quad ((b \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\neg (b \in a) \wedge (g \in (a \to c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in (a \cup \{b\}).\; \left(\text{if }(z = b)\text{ then }v\text{ else }g(z)\right))(w) = g(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}injection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, g, v. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\neg (b \in a) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{injection}(a, c)) \wedge ((v \in c) \wedge \neg (v \in \operatorname{image}(g, a))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in (a \cup \{b\}).\; \left(\text{if }(z = b)\text{ then }v\text{ else }g(z)\right)) \in \operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}restrict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, g, v. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\neg (b \in a) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{injection}(a, c)) \wedge ((v \in c) \wedge \neg (v \in \operatorname{image}(g, a))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; (\lambda z \in (a \cup \{b\}).\; \left(\text{if }(z = b)\text{ then }v\text{ else }g(z)\right))(x)) = g \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, g, f. \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; f(x)) = g \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (f(b) \in c) \wedge \neg (f(b) \in \operatorname{image}(g, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}recover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, g, f. \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in a) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{injection}(a, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; f(x)) = g \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f = (\lambda z \in (a \cup \{b\}).\; \left(\text{if }(z = b)\text{ then }f(b)\text{ else }g(z)\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, g, m. \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |a| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |c| = (|a| + m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{injection}(a, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{difference}(c, \operatorname{image}(g, a))| = m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}fibre-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, g. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\neg (b \in a) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{injection}(a, c)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{rbc} \in \operatorname{difference}(c, \operatorname{image}(g, a)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda z \in (a \cup \{b\}).\; \left(\text{if }(z = b)\text{ then }\mathit{rbc}\text{ else }g(z)\right))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{difference}(c, \operatorname{image}(g, a))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \{x \in \operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c) : ((\lambda f \in \operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c).\; (\lambda \mathit{rsx} \in a.\; f(\mathit{rsx})))(x) = g)\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}fibre-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, m, g. \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in a) \wedge \\ \quad |a| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |c| = (|a| + m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{injection}(a, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\{x \in \operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c) : ((\lambda f \in \operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c).\; (\lambda \mathit{rsx} \in a.\; f(\mathit{rsx})))(x) = g)\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}injection-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((|a| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (|c| \in \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{injection}(a, c)| \in \mathbb{N} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{injection-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}recurrence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b, m. \\ \quad \neg (b \in a) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |a| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |c| = (|a| + m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{injection}((a \cup \{b\}), c)| = (m \cdot |\operatorname{injection}(a, c)|) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb5-\allowbreak{}count-\allowbreak{}falling-\allowbreak{}aux}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (m \leq n) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{injection}(\mathrm{OS}(m), \mathrm{OS}(n))| = \operatorname{falling}(n, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{injection-\allowbreak{}count-\allowbreak{}falling}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (m \leq n) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{injection}(\mathrm{OS}(m), \mathrm{OS}(n))| = \operatorname{falling}(n, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{permutation-\allowbreak{}recurrence}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (|\operatorname{permutations}((n + 1))| = ((n + 1) \cdot |\operatorname{permutations}(n)|))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/primitive-glue.scm}{theorem-library/primitive-glue.scm}
\noindent{\small primitive-glue.scm -- PRIMITIVES ON ADJACENT INTERVALS GLUE (batch 22-C).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{clamp-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((x \leq a) \wedge (a \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{clamp}(a, b, x) = a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{clamp-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((a \leq b) \wedge (b \leq x)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{clamp}(a, b, x) = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}interior-\allowbreak{}congruence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, \mathit{ppsi}, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, i, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{ppsi} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b).\; (i(y) \simeq \operatorname{ppsi}(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, \mathit{ppsi}, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}glue}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, b \in \mathbb{R}, d, h, k, m.; \forall g, f \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad a < c \wedge \\ \quad c < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(d, h, a, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(k, m, c, b) \wedge \\ \quad d(c) = k(c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, c).\; (g(t) \simeq d(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, b).\; (g(t) \simeq k(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, c).\; (f(t) \simeq h(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}(c, b).\; (f(t) \simeq m(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g, f, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}constant-\allowbreak{}piece}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}, f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}), a, k \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((u < v) \wedge \forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((u < t) \wedge (t < v)) \Rightarrow (f(t) = a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}((\lambda s \in \operatorname{ccint}(u, v).\; (k + (a \cdot (s - u)))), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{ccint}(u, v)), u, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{step-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}primitive-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p, a, b.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}partition}(p, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(0, n). \\ \quad \quad (i < n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \forall t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p(i) < t) \wedge (t < p((i + 1)))) \Rightarrow (f(t) = c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g, \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{step-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}primitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}step\text{-}fn}(f, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g, \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)), a, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/pw-int-laws-3.scm}{theorem-library/pw-int-laws-3.scm}
\noindent{\small pw-int-laws-3.scm -- LINEARITY over the reals as ONE law, the COMPLEX scalar, and the additivity of the complex integral over adjacent intervals.  Continues theorem-library/pw-int-laws-2.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pw-\allowbreak{}antiderivative-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{R}, f, w, i, \mathit{ppsi}.; \forall h, \mathit{pchi} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, i, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(w, \mathit{ppsi}, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (h(y) \simeq ((c \cdot f(y)) + (d \cdot w(y)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (\operatorname{pchi}(y) \simeq ((c \cdot i(y)) + (d \cdot \operatorname{ppsi}(y)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(h, \mathit{pchi}, a, b) \wedge (\int_{a}^{b} \mathit{pchi} = ((c \cdot \int_{a}^{b} i) + (d \cdot \int_{a}^{b} \mathit{ppsi})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}complex-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, i, \mathit{pchi}.; \forall w \in \mathbb{C}, f, \mathit{paw}. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{pchi} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (\operatorname{pchi}(y) \simeq (w \cdot i(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(\mathit{paw}, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} \mathit{pchi} = (w \cdot \int_{a}^{b} i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}adjacent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall v \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b), i, f, w. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(w, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} i = (\int_{a}^{v} \operatorname{restrict}(i, \operatorname{ccint}(a, v)) + \int_{v}^{b} \operatorname{restrict}(i, \operatorname{ccint}(v, b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/primitive-uniform-limit.scm}{theorem-library/primitive-uniform-limit.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/primitive-uniform-limit.scm -- Dieudonne (8.6.4) on a compact interval [a,b], with COUNTABLE exceptional sets: A UNIFORM LIMIT OF PRIMITIVES IS A PRIMITIVE.  Batch 22-B, 2026-09-23.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{countable-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall u \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(d(k)) \wedge \forall y \in u.\; \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (y \in d(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}lipschitz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g_{1}, f_{1}, g_{2}, f_{2}.; \forall m \in \mathbb{R}, x, y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{1}, f_{1}, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{2}, f_{2}, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (\lvert (\operatorname{f1}(x) - \operatorname{f2}(x)) \rvert \leq m) \wedge \\ \quad x < y \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert ((\operatorname{g1}(y) - \operatorname{g2}(y)) - (\operatorname{g1}(x) - \operatorname{g2}(x))) \rvert \leq (m \cdot (y - x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g_{1}, f_{1}, g_{2}, f_{2}.; \forall m \in \mathbb{R}, x, y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{1}, f_{1}, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{2}, f_{2}, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (\lvert (\operatorname{f1}(x) - \operatorname{f2}(x)) \rvert \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert ((\operatorname{g1}(y) - \operatorname{g2}(y)) - (\operatorname{g1}(x) - \operatorname{g2}(x))) \rvert \leq (m \cdot \lvert (y - x) \rvert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}, m, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R})). \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(m(k), c(k), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((n \leq k) \wedge (n \leq l)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (c(k)(x) - c(l)(x)) \rvert \leq s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m(k)(a) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{pufc} \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; m(k)(x)), \operatorname{pufc}(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \mathit{pufc}, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}, m, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R})), \mathit{pufc} \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}), t \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b), v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(m(k), c(k), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((n \leq k) \wedge (n \leq l)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (c(k)(x) - c(l)(x)) \rvert \leq s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; m(k)(x)), \operatorname{pufc}(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}(m(k), t, c(k)(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k)(t)), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(\mathit{pufc}, t, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}, m, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R})), f \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(m(k), c(k), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow (\lvert (c(k)(x) - f(x)) \rvert \leq s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m(k)(a) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g, f, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; m(k)(x)), g(x)) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small dual-nvs.scm -- THE DUAL OF A REAL NORMED VECTOR SPACE IS A NORMED VECTOR SPACE. Agent DUAL-FIX, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/dual-nvs.scm.  Library: analysis. Helper prefix: dnv-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}blf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.; \forall f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \Rightarrow (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, x, y. \\ \quad ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) = (f(x) + f(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, r, x. \\ \quad ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x)) = (r \cdot f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}({m}^{*})(f, g) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (f(x) + g(x)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}({m}^{*})(f) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; -f(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}({m}^{*}) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (f(x) + g(x))) \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (r \cdot f(x))) \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (f(x) + g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (r \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}
