\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, p, q. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \leq (a + b)) \wedge ((a \leq p) \wedge (b \leq q)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \leq (p + q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (f(x) + g(x)))(w) \rvert \leq ((\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) + \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, g)) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; -f(x))(w) \rvert \leq (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; 0)(w) \rvert \leq (0 \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (r \cdot f(x)))(w) \rvert \leq ((\lvert r \rvert \cdot \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f)) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (f(x) + g(x))) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; -f(x)) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow ((\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; 0) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (r \cdot f(x))) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}({m}^{*})(f, g) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}({m}^{*})(r, f) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}({m}^{*})(f) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}({m}^{*}) \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}({m}^{*})(f, g)(x) = (f(x) + g(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}({m}^{*})(r, f)(x) = (r \cdot f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}({m}^{*})(f)(x) = -f(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}({m}^{*})(x) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(\operatorname{vadd}({m}^{*})(f, g)) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(f) + \operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f = \operatorname{vzero}({m}^{*}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \wedge (f = \operatorname{vzero}({m}^{*})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(f) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (f = \operatorname{vzero}({m}^{*})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 \leq a) \wedge \neg (a = 0)) \Rightarrow (0 < a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lvert r \rvert \cdot \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f)) \leq \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (r \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(\operatorname{act}({m}^{*})(r, f)) = (\lvert r \rvert \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}({m}^{*}) \in ((\operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \times \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}({m}^{*}) \in ((\mathbb{R} \times \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}({m}^{*}) \in (\operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*}) \in (\operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-bidual.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-bidual.scm}
\noindent{\small bidual.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Prop 3.31: for a normed space E the canonical map iota\_E : E -$>$ E** is an isometry.  Agent DUAL-FIX, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-bidual.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix: bdl-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \leq b) \wedge ((b \leq c) \wedge (c \leq d))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}sublinear-\allowbreak{}view}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sublinear}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \operatorname{vnrm}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}view-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m)) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}view}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), s, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}view}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \operatorname{vec}(m), f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}seed-\allowbreak{}dominated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v, f.; \forall z \in \operatorname{line}(m, v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{line}(m, v), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{line}(m, v), f) \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}sided-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (g(a) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert g(w) \rvert \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norming-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge ((\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, g) \leq 1) \wedge (g(x) = \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({x})(f) = f(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({x}) \in (\operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}({m}^{*}, \iota_{m}({x})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}({m}^{*}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert \iota_{m}({x})(w) \rvert \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}({m}^{*})(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}bidual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({x}) \in \operatorname{vec}({{m}^{*}}^{*}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}isometry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}({{m}^{*}}^{*})(\iota_{m}({x})) = \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)}) = \operatorname{vadd}({{m}^{*}}^{*})(\iota_{m}({x}), \iota_{m}({y})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bidual-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x)}) = \operatorname{act}({{m}^{*}}^{*})(r, \iota_{m}({x})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/norm-attained-general.scm}{theorem-library/norm-attained-general.scm}
\noindent{\small norm-attained-general.scm -- the norm-attaining functional WITHOUT a finite-dimension hypothesis, and the two theorems that cited the finite-dimensional one, restated without it as NEW theorems beside the old. Agent DUAL-FIX, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/norm-attained-general.scm.  Library: analysis. Load ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}attained-\allowbreak{}by-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}nvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge ((\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, g) \leq 1) \wedge (g(x) = \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}sup-\allowbreak{}nvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall f. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lvert f(x) \rvert \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(x) \rvert \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x) \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vector-\allowbreak{}taylor-\allowbreak{}remainder-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}nvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, x, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{R} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a < x \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{taylor\text{-}differentiable\text{-}v}(m, f, a, x, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad b < x \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{factorial}((n + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(f(x), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{taylor\text{-}poly\text{-}v}(m, f, a, x, n)))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{nth\text{-}deriv\text{-}v}(m, f, (n + 1))(b)) \cdot \operatorname{power}((x - a), (n + 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc2-rn-basics.scm}{theorem-library/calc2-rn-basics.scm}
\noindent{\small calc2-rn-basics.scm -- the read-offs of RN(n) (structure-library/rn-vocab.scm). CALC-2, 2026-10-19.  Helper prefix: c2b-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{rn}(n)) \simeq (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, y, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((y \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(x, y)(i) = (x(i) + y(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, x, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, x)(i) = (r \cdot x(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(x)(i) = -x(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, i.\; (((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(i) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(x) \simeq \operatorname{rn\text{-}maxabs}(x, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{rn}(n)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}same}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, i.\; (((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, i)(i) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}other}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, i, j. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \neg (j = i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, i)(j) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, y. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (y \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(x, y) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, x) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(x) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n)) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, i) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc2-rn-norm.scm}{theorem-library/calc2-rn-norm.scm}
\noindent{\small calc2-rn-norm.scm -- the sup norm of RN(n): RN-MAXABS laws.  CALC-2, 2026-10-19.  Prefix c2n-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}maxabs-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, v. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (k \leq n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{rn\text{-}maxabs}(v, k) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{rn\text{-}maxabs}(v, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}maxabs-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, v, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((k \leq n) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (i \leq k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert v(i) \rvert \leq \operatorname{rn\text{-}maxabs}(v, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}maxabs-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, v, c. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\lvert v(j) \rvert \leq c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}maxabs}(v, k) \leq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, v. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(v) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}coord}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, v, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert v(i) \rvert \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, v, c. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\lvert v(j) \rvert \leq c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(v) \leq c \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc2-rn-nvs.scm}{theorem-library/calc2-rn-nvs.scm}
\noindent{\small calc2-rn-nvs.scm -- RN(n) is a real normed vector space.  CALC-2, 2026-10-19.  Prefix c2v-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u, w, z. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad w \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad z \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u, w), z) = \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(w, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u, w. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (w \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u, w) = \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(w, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u) = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u, \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n))) = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u), u) = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u)) = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, u, w. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (w \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u, w)) = \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, u), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, s, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))((r + s), u) = \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, u), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(s, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, s, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))((r \cdot s), u) = \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(s, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(1, u) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{max}((c \cdot a), (c \cdot b)) = (c \cdot \operatorname{max}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}maxabs-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, v, r. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((v \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (k \leq n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}maxabs}(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, v), k) = (\lvert r \rvert \cdot \operatorname{rn\text{-}maxabs}(v, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, r, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, u)) = (\lvert r \rvert \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u, w. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (w \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u, w)) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u) + \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(u) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (u = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, k) \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k, j. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (j \leq k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, k)(j) = x(j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k, j. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \neg (j \leq k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, k)(j) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, 0) = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{rn}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}full}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, n) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k + 1) \leq n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, (k + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, k), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(x((k + 1)), \operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, (k + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, k, t. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad (k + 1) \leq n \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \lvert t \rvert \leq \lvert x((k + 1)) \rvert \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, x, k), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(t, \operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, (k + 1))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(x) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc2-segment.scm}{theorem-library/calc2-segment.scm}
\noindent{\small calc2-segment.scm -- the one-variable facts the coordinate segments need.  CALC-2, 2026-10-19. Prefix c2s-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}derivs-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}ccint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall o, i, f, h. \\ \quad o \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad i \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{ccint}(o, i) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(o, i).\; (h(y) = f(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(o, i).\; \exists l.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}(f, x, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}on}(h, \operatorname{ccint}(o, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mean-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}inequality-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall o, i, f, l, d. \\ \quad o \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad i \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad o < i \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(o, i). \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}(f, x, a) \wedge (\lvert (a - l) \rvert \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert ((f(i) - f(o)) - (l \cdot (i - o))) \rvert \leq (d \cdot (i - o)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{has-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}eps-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, c, r, l. \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}((c - r), (c + r)).\; (g(t) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}((c - r), (c + r)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lvert (t - c) \rvert < d) \Rightarrow (\lvert ((g(t) - g(c)) - ((t - c) \cdot l)) \rvert \leq (e \cdot \lvert (t - c) \rvert)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}(g, c, l) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc2-dirderiv.scm}{theorem-library/calc2-dirderiv.scm}
\noindent{\small calc2-dirderiv.scm -- the local directional derivative HAS-DIR-DERIV over a normed vector space: moving the base point along the direction.  CALC-2, 2026-10-19.  Prefix c2d-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{has-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, b, e, t, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, \operatorname{act}(m)(t, e)), e, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}curve}(m, f, b, e), t, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{has-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, b, e, \mathit{dlam}, l, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{dlam} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (\lvert t \rvert \leq \lvert \mathit{dlam} \rvert) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, \operatorname{act}(m)(t, e)), e, d) \wedge (\lvert (d - l) \rvert \leq c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert ((f(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, \operatorname{act}(m)(\mathit{dlam}, e))) - f(b)) - (\mathit{dlam} \cdot l)) \rvert \leq (c \cdot \lvert \mathit{dlam} \rvert) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc2-prop229.scm}{theorem-library/calc2-prop229.scm}
\noindent{\small calc2-prop229.scm -- calculus.pdf Prop. 2.29: continuous partial derivatives give the first-order estimate on E = R\textasciicircum{}n with the sup norm.  CALC-2, 2026-10-19.  Prefix c29-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq n))) \Rightarrow \exists c.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge ((c \cdot n) \leq e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}partials-\allowbreak{}estimate-\allowbreak{}trunc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, u, f, p, a, c, r. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(\operatorname{rn}(n), f, x, \operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, i), p(i)(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p(i), x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), a, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad d < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall e \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(e) \leq d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lvert ((f(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(a, \operatorname{rn\text{-}trunc}(n, e, k))) - f(a)) - \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (e(\mathit{cfi}) \cdot p(\mathit{cfi})(a))), \operatorname{interval}(1, k))) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; k \cdot (c \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}partials-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u, f, p, a, s. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(\operatorname{rn}(n), f, x, \operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, i), p(i)(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p(i), x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{rn}(n)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(c) \leq b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lvert ((f(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(a, c)) - f(a)) - \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (c(i) \cdot p(i)(a))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(c) \cdot s \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc2-prop228.scm}{theorem-library/calc2-prop228.scm}
\noindent{\small calc2-prop228.scm -- calculus.pdf Prop. 2.28 on E = R\textasciicircum{}n with the sup norm: partial derivatives defined and continuous on the open set U give the directional derivative in every direction eta at every x in U, d\_eta f(x) = sum\_i eta\_i d\_(e\_i) f(x), linear in eta and continuous in x.  Derived from Prop. 2.29 ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}partials-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, p, x, e, t. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (p(i)(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(t, e)(i) \cdot p(i)(x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; t \cdot \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (e(i) \cdot p(i)(x))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}partials-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}deriv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u, f, p.; \forall x \in u, a \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{rn}(n)). \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(\operatorname{rn}(n), f, x, \operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, i), p(i)(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p(i), x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(\operatorname{rn}(n), f, x, a, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (a(i) \cdot p(i)(x))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}partials-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, p, x, e, z, r, s. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad z \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (p(i)(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(r, e), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{rn}(n))(s, z))(i) \cdot p(i)(x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (r \cdot \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (e(i) \cdot p(i)(x))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) + (s \cdot \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (z(i) \cdot p(i)(x))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) + g(x))), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (c \cdot f(x))), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, s, n, h, t, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (h(i) \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h(i), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (t(i) \cdot h(i)(y))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}partials-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, u, f, p.; \forall a \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), x \in u. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(\operatorname{rn}(n), f, x, \operatorname{rn\text{-}unit}(n, i), p(i)(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p(i), x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda y \in u.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (a(i) \cdot p(i)(y))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad x) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rb2-dir.scm}{theorem-library/rb2-dir.scm}
\noindent{\small rb2-dir.scm -- calculus.pdf Lemmas 2.25, 2.26 and Prop. 2.27 for the LOCAL directional derivative HAS-DIR-DERIV over a normed vector space, f defined on an open set U.  Helper prefix r2d-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ldir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, b, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, a, b, l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ldir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, a, b) = l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{has-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, b, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, a, b, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, a, \operatorname{act}(m)(k, b), (k \cdot l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{has-\allowbreak{}dir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, f, b, i, p, q, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, b, p(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, i, q(x)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, q, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, a, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, i), (p(a) + q(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}formula}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, f, a, i, p, q.; \forall x \in u, r, s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, a, p(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, i, q(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p, x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, q, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, a), \operatorname{act}(m)(s, i)), ((r \cdot p(x)) + (s \cdot q(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{span2-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{span2}(m, a, i) \simeq \{v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r, s \in \mathbb{R}.\; (v = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, a), \operatorname{act}(m)(s, i)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{span2-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}coeffs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, i, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(b, a), \operatorname{act}(m)(c, i)), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(d, a), \operatorname{act}(m)(f, i))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((b + d), a), \operatorname{act}(m)((c + f), i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{span2-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}coeffs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, i, c, r, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (s \in \mathbb{R})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(c, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, a), \operatorname{act}(m)(s, i))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((c \cdot r), a), \operatorname{act}(m)((c \cdot s), i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dir-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, f, a, i, p, q.; \forall x \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, a, p(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, i, q(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, p, x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), u), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, q, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{span2}(m, a, i).\; \operatorname{has\text{-}dir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, b, \operatorname{ldir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{span2}(m, a, i), (\lambda b \in \operatorname{span2}(m, a, i).\; \operatorname{ldir\text{-}deriv}(m, f, x, b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rank-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b. \\ \quad (\langle \cdot \mid {a} \rangle {b} \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \operatorname{act}(w)(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, a), b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{onb-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{onb\text{-}sets}(v) \simeq \{o \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(v)) : \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, o, (\lambda e \in o.\; e))\}) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{canon-\allowbreak{}onb-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{canon\text{-}onb}(v) \simeq \varepsilon(\operatorname{onb\text{-}sets}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, i, e, t. \\ \quad (\sum_{i \in {i}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 \simeq \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in i.\; (\lVert t(e(k)) \rVert \cdot \lVert t(e(k)) \rVert)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}ops-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (HS({v}, {w}) \simeq \{t \in L({v}, {w}) : \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, t)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}ops-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, z. \\ \quad (z \in HS({v}, {w})) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in L({v}, {w})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\lVert {t} \rVert_{HS} \simeq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in {\operatorname{canon\text{-}onb}(v)}} \lVert {t} {(\lambda e \in \operatorname{canon\text{-}onb}(v).\; e)}_i \rVert^2}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, u, t. \\ \quad (\langle {u} \mid {t} \rangle_{HS} \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}family\text{-}sum}((\lambda e \in \operatorname{canon\text{-}onb}(v).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(u(e), t(e))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}ops-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad (T({v}) \simeq \{t \in L({v}, {v}) : \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}ops-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, z. \\ \quad (z \in T({v})) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, z)) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small hilbert-projection.scm -- HILBERT SPACES: the parallelogram law, K-perp, the orthogonal projection theorem (Prop. 2.19), the Riesz representation theorem (Thm. 2.22) and the density criterion (Cor. 2.21).  All PROVEN modulo 0. Agent HILBERT-1, 2026-10-10 (scratchpad/triage/HILBERT-1.md).  Vocabulary:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v) \simeq \operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, s.\; ({s}^{\perp} \simeq \{p \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall k \in s.\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(p, k) = 0)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, z. \\ \quad (z \in {s}^{\perp}) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \forall k \in s.\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(z, k) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cips}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vneg}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; \sqrt{\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)) = -\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}parallelogram-\allowbreak{}ip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) + \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)) + (2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}parallelogram}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert \cdot \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert) + (\lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)) \rVert \cdot \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)) \rVert) \\ \quad \quad =\; (2 \cdot (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert x \rVert)) + (2 \cdot (\lVert y \rVert \cdot \lVert y \rVert)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}pythagoras}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert \cdot \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert x \rVert) + (\lVert y \rVert \cdot \lVert y \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{C}.\; (((a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(a)) = 0) \Rightarrow (a = 0))}}
