\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}orth-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, w, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a.\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, w) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, w) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}orth}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, s, z, k.\; (((z \in {s}^{\perp}) \wedge (k \in s)) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(z, k) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow ({s}^{\perp} \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, {s}^{\perp}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), {s}^{\perp}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}nonempty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (\exists e.\; (e \in k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a \leq \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists q \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(q, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(q, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \leq (a + \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a \leq \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists q \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(q, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(q, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \leq (a + \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}midpoint-\allowbreak{}estimate-\allowbreak{}midpoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i, a, p_{1}, p_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m_{1}, m_{2} \in k.\; (\operatorname{act}(v)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(m_{1}, m_{2})) \in k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in k. \\ \quad \quad a \leq \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \wedge \\ \quad p_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad p_{2} \in k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(p_{2})), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(p_{2}))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (((2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)))) + (2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))))) - (4 \cdot a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}midpoint-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i, a, p_{1}, p_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in k. \\ \quad \quad a \leq \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \wedge \\ \quad p_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad p_{2} \in k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(p_{2})), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(p_{2}))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (((2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)))) + (2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))))) - (4 \cdot a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}midpoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m_{1}, m_{2} \in k.\; (\operatorname{act}(v)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(m_{1}, m_{2})) \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in k. \forall \mathit{hdp} \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in k. \forall \mathit{hdp} \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}variational}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(w, w) \leq \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(w, \operatorname{act}(v)(t, e)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(w, \operatorname{act}(v)(t, e))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(w, e) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k, b \in {k}^{\perp}.\; (i = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}decomposition-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a_{1}, a_{2}, b_{1}, b_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad b_{1} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad b_{2} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, b_{1}) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, b_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a_{1} = a_{2}) \wedge (b_{1} = b_{2}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)) \in {k}^{\perp}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a(x) \in k) \wedge (\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a(x))) \in {k}^{\perp}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \Rightarrow (a \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{hpk}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, \mathit{hpk}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a(x), a(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{act}(v)(c, x)) = \operatorname{act}(v)(c, a(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert a(x) \rVert \leq \lVert x \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}fixes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(y) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}idempotent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(a(x)) = a(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}laws}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = (f(x) + f(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\operatorname{act}(v)(c, x)) = (c \cdot f(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (f(\operatorname{vzero}(v)) = 0) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) = -f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x \in \operatorname{preimage}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), f, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 0))) \Leftrightarrow (f(x) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, \operatorname{preimage}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), f, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{preimage}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), f, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}separates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e_{1}, e_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{1}) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{2})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e_{1} = e_{2} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \leq (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert e \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \leq (c \cdot \lVert x \rVert)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert e \rVert \leq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{riesz-\allowbreak{}representation-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; ((x \in k) \Leftrightarrow (f(x) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \forall \mathit{hrx} \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\mathit{hrx}) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\mathit{hrx}, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{riesz-\allowbreak{}representation-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{riesz-\allowbreak{}representation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert e \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (c \cdot \lVert x \rVert))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert e \rVert \leq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{riesz-\allowbreak{}representation-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, e_{1}, e_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{1})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{2})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e_{1} = e_{2} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, x, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), a)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y))) \leq e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y))) \leq e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) = \operatorname{vec}(v)) \Leftrightarrow \forall z \in {k}^{\perp}.\; (z = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small theorem-library/rake-asm-b3.scm -- RAKE-ASM-B, agent RB-3 (2026-10-12).  Prefix rb3-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)) = \mathbb{C} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r, s \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r, s) = (r + s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r, s \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r, s) = (r \cdot s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(m)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r, s \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)((r + s), x) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(m)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r, s \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)((r \cdot s), x) = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{act}(m)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}tuple6}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}. \\ \quad ((a_{2} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{3} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{4} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a_{5} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (a_{6} \in \mathbf{Set}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}]) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}]) \simeq a_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}]) \simeq a_{3}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}]) \simeq a_{4}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}]) \simeq a_{5}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}]) \simeq a_{6}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{length}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}, a_{6}]) = 6 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}mr-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(r) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vec}(r) = \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(r) = \operatorname{vadd}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(r) = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(r) = \operatorname{vneg}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{act}(r)(a, x) = \operatorname{act}(m)(a, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}mr-\allowbreak{}sublinear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(r) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vec}(r) = \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(r) = \operatorname{vadd}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(r) = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vneg}(r) = \operatorname{vneg}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{act}(r)(a, x) = \operatorname{act}(m)(a, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sublinear}(r, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}mr-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(r) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vec}(r) = \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(r) = \operatorname{vadd}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(r) = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vneg}(r) = \operatorname{vneg}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{act}(r)(a, x) = \operatorname{act}(m)(a, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(r, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}mr-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, s, f.; \forall a \in (s \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(r) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vec}(r) = \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(r) = \operatorname{vadd}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(r) = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vneg}(r) = \operatorname{vneg}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{act}(r)(b, x) = \operatorname{act}(m)(b, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (a(z) \simeq \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(r, s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}re}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, \mathit{ray} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \mathit{ray})) = (n(x) + n(\mathit{ray}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(a(y)) = n(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rax}, \mathit{ray} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{rax}, \mathit{ray})) = (n(\mathit{rax}) + n(\mathit{ray}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) = (a(x) + a(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}rhom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), r \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rax}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{rax}, y)) = (n(\mathit{rax}) + n(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rhr} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(\mathit{rhr}, \mathit{rhx})) = (\mathit{rhr} \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x)) = (r \cdot a(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}ihom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rax}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{rax}, y)) = (n(\mathit{rax}) + n(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, x)) = (+i \cdot a(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}abhom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), \alpha, b \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rax}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{rax}, y)) = (n(\mathit{rax}) + n(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{act}(m)((\alpha + (+i \cdot b)), x)) = ((\alpha + (+i \cdot b)) \cdot a(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}chom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), b \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rax}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{rax}, y)) = (n(\mathit{rax}) + n(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{act}(m)(b, x)) = (b \cdot a(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}klinear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) = (n(x) + n(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}decomp}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}, w.\; ((w = (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) + (+i \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z)))) \Rightarrow (w = z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}i}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(+i) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(+i) = 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}extends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), s.; \forall f \in (s \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) = (n(x) + n(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{eix} \in s.\; (f(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{eix})) = (+i \cdot f(\mathit{eix}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{erx} \in s.\; (n(\mathit{erx}) = \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(f(\mathit{erx}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}conjugate}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) = (z \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(z)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}conjugate}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{conjugate}(z)) = \operatorname{magnitude}(z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cf-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall n \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), a \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{C}), p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, \mathit{ray} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \mathit{ray})) = (n(x) + n(\mathit{ray}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{rhx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{rhx})) = (r \cdot n(\mathit{rhx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cvy} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(\mathit{cvy}) \simeq (n(\mathit{cvy}) + (-n(\operatorname{act}(m)(+i, \mathit{cvy})) \cdot +i))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{bx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (n(\mathit{bx}) \leq p(\mathit{bx})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(a(y)) \leq p(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hahn-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge \\ \quad (d = \operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \vee (d = \operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(f(x)) \leq p(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, a) \wedge (\operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(a(x)) \leq p(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}pgt-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.; \forall g \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{pseudo\text{-}gauge\text{-}top}(m, g)) \simeq g)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}pgt-\allowbreak{}opens}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall g \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{pseudo\text{-}gauge\text{-}top}(m, g)) \simeq \{u \in \operatorname{power}(g) : \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, u)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, y, x \in g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(m(n))(y, x) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}pseudo}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}pseudometric}(\operatorname{dist}(m(n)), g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}og-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, (u \cap v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}og-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in w.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in w.\; (a \subseteq g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, w, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}og-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, \emptyset) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}og-\allowbreak{}full}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \wedge (g \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{pseudo\text{-}gauge\text{-}top}(m, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}og-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g, u.; \forall y \in u, x \in g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(m(n))(y, x) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}metrizable-\allowbreak{}hausdorff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; [\mathbb{N}, (\lambda [\operatorname{za\_}, \operatorname{zb\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}).\; 0)]), \\ \quad \mathbb{N}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}witness}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}gauge\text{-}countable}(\operatorname{pseudo\text{-}gauge\text{-}top}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; [\mathbb{N}, (\lambda [\operatorname{za\_}, \operatorname{zb\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}).\; 0)]), \mathbb{N})) \wedge \\ \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{pseudo\text{-}gauge\text{-}top}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; [\mathbb{N}, (\lambda [\operatorname{za\_}, \operatorname{zb\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}).\; 0)]), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gauge-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}metrizable-\allowbreak{}witness}}{\vnbstmt{\exists s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}gauge\text{-}countable}(s) \wedge \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}tuple2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (b \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{pts}([a, b]) \simeq a) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}([a, b]) \simeq b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}pms-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{dq}. \\ \quad ((q \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((\mathit{dq} \in ((q \times q) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pseudometric}(\mathit{dq}, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}space}([q, \mathit{dq}]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}pseudo}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}pseudometric}(\operatorname{dist}(d), \operatorname{pts}(d)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}fam1-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}((\lambda \mathit{zn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; [\operatorname{pts}(d), \operatorname{dist}(d)])(n)) \simeq \operatorname{dist}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(d, u) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; [\operatorname{pts}(d), \operatorname{dist}(d)]), \operatorname{pts}(d), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}mgc-\allowbreak{}fwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}gauge\text{-}countable}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w, x, y.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{pts}(s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (w(n) \cdot \operatorname{min}(1, \operatorname{dists}(s)(n)(x, y))) \leq \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w))(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(w, k) \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dists}(s)(n)(x, y) < r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w))(x, y) \leq (r + e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}tuple2d}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (b \in \mathbf{Set})) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{pts}([a, b]) \simeq a) \wedge (\operatorname{dists}([a, b]) \simeq b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in g. \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(m(k))(u, v) = 0) \Rightarrow (u = v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}([g, (\lambda \mathit{zk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{dist}(m(\mathit{zk})))]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}haus-\allowbreak{}sep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, g.; \forall u, v \in g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pseudo\text{-}gauge\text{-}top}(m, g) \simeq s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(m(k))(u, v) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}cm-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w, m, g, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}c\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(w, k) \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq k) \Rightarrow (w(k) \leq w(n))) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(s) \simeq g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dists}(s)(n) \simeq \operatorname{dist}(m(n))) \wedge \\ \quad u \subseteq g \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{c\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w), u) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}gauge}(m, g, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}dyadic-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1)))), k) \leq 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}dyadic-\allowbreak{}antitone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (a \leq k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))(k) \leq (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1))))(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rb3-\allowbreak{}mgc-\allowbreak{}bwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}family}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pseudo\text{-}gauge\text{-}top}(m, g) \simeq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metrizable-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}gauge\text{-}countable}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}metrizable-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}gauge-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d) \simeq s)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}gauge\text{-}countable}(s) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small ba-laws.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1-1109/ba-laws.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}pin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(a) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)) = \mathbb{C}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(a) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a) \in ((\operatorname{vec}(a) \times \operatorname{vec}(a)) \to \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(a) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(a) \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(a))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a) \in ((\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)) \times \operatorname{vec}(a)) \to \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(a) \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a} \in ((\operatorname{vec}(a) \times \operatorname{vec}(a)) \to \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}associative}(\operatorname{vadd}(a), \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative}(\operatorname{vadd}(a), \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}ident}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}identity}(\operatorname{vadd}(a), \operatorname{vzero}(a), \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}inverses}(\operatorname{vadd}(a), \operatorname{vzero}(a), \operatorname{vneg}(a), \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}associative}(\cdot_{a}, \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(a)(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(a))(r, s), x) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(a)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(a))(r, s), x) = \operatorname{act}(a)(r, \operatorname{act}(a)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (x = \operatorname{vzero}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x)) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y)) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) + \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(x, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, z)) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\cdot_{a}(x, y), \cdot_{a}(x, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y), z) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\cdot_{a}(x, z), \cdot_{a}(y, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), y) = \operatorname{act}(a)(r, \cdot_{a}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
