\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)([l, x], [r, y]) \\ \quad \quad =\; [(l \cdot r), \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(l, y), \operatorname{act}(a)(r, x)), \cdot_{a}(x, y))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)([1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a)([l, x], [r, y])) \leq (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)([l, x]) + \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)([r, y])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}submult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)([l, x], [r, y])) \leq (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)([l, x]) \cdot \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)([r, y])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c, l \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a)(c, [l, x])) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)([l, x])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vzero}(a)) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{a}(\operatorname{vzero}(a), y) = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{a}(y, \operatorname{vzero}(a)) = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, \operatorname{vzero}(a)) = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{vzero}(a), y) = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(1, y) = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(r, \operatorname{vzero}(a)) = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)([1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)], [r, y]) = [r, y] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bun-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)([r, y], [1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) = [r, y] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(v) \simeq (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{vec}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)([1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)], u) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)(u, [1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) = u) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-norming-functional.scm}{theorem-library/cc-norming-functional.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-norming-functional.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1D), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1d-1109/cc-norming-functional.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(a) = -a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m), a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \wedge (\operatorname{act}(m)(a, y) = \operatorname{act}(m)(b, y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \cdot p(y)) = (b \cdot p(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, y, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (u = \operatorname{act}(m)(c, y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\iota\, t.\;((t \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \exists q \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((u = \operatorname{act}(m)(q, y)) \wedge (t = (q \cdot p(y)))))) = (c \cdot p(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, y, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (u = \operatorname{act}(m)(c, y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (w = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}coef}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, y.; \forall u \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (w = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))\}. \\ \quad (u \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (u = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (w = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}seed-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (w = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda u \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (w = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))\}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\iota\, t.\;((t \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \exists q \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((u = \operatorname{act}(m)(q, y)) \wedge (t = (q \cdot p(y)))))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnf-\allowbreak{}seed-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m), x \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (w = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})((\lambda u \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (w = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))\}.\; (\iota\, t.\;((t \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \exists q \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((u = \operatorname{act}(m)(q, y)) \wedge (t = (q \cdot p(y)))))))(x)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; p(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}norming-\allowbreak{}functional}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, f) \wedge (\forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq p(x)) \wedge (f(y) = p(y)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-maximal-ideal.scm}{theorem-library/ba-maximal-ideal.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-maximal-ideal.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1D), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1d-1109/ba-maximal-ideal.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}antisym}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, q.\; (((p \subseteq q) \wedge (q \subseteq p)) \Rightarrow (p = q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad q \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(a) \in q \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in q.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y) \in q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in q.\; (\operatorname{act}(a)(z, x) \in q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), x \in q.\; (\cdot_{a}(y, x) \in q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), x \in q.\; (\cdot_{a}(x, y) \in q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q. \\ \quad q \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(a) \in q \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in q.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y) \in q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in q.\; (\operatorname{act}(a)(z, x) \in q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), x \in q.\; (\cdot_{a}(y, x) \in q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), x \in q.\; (\cdot_{a}(x, y) \in q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}proper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, q) \wedge (1_{a} \in q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad q = \operatorname{vec}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}grd-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, j, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, j) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, q) \wedge \\ \quad j \subseteq q \wedge \\ \quad \neg (1_{a} \in q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad q \in \{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}grd-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, j.; \forall q \in \{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, q) \wedge ((j \subseteq q) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}porel-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, j, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, j) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\} \wedge \\ \quad p \subseteq q \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [p, q] \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{w \in (\{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\} \times \{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\}) : (\operatorname{nth}(1, w) \subseteq \operatorname{nth}(2, w))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bmx-\allowbreak{}porel-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, j, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, j) \wedge \\ \quad [p, q] \\ \quad \in\; \{w \in (\{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\} \times \{i \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge ((j \subseteq i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i)))\}) : (\operatorname{nth}(1, w) \subseteq \operatorname{nth}(2, w))\} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p \subseteq q \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, j. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, j) \wedge \neg (j = \operatorname{vec}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, m) \wedge (j \subseteq m)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/kal-laws.scm}{theorem-library/kal-laws.scm}

\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(a)(x) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(a) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{a}(x, y) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y), z) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{vzero}(a), x) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, \operatorname{vzero}(a)) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(a)(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r, s \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)((r + s), x) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(a)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r, s \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)((r \cdot s), x) = \operatorname{act}(a)(r, \operatorname{act}(a)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(1, x) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kal-\allowbreak{}cna-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(0, x) = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}uv-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ([0, \operatorname{vzero}(a)] \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}typ-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a) \in ((\operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a) \times \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}typ-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vneg}(a) \in (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}typ-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a) \in ((\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}typ-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a) \in (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}typ-\allowbreak{}vmul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a) \in ((\operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a) \times \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \simeq [0, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vneg}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kuc-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vmul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)} \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}complex-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/inclusion-exclusion.scm}{theorem-library/inclusion-exclusion.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/inclusion-exclusion.scm -- THE INCLUSION-EXCLUSION PRINCIPLE (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes, Prop. 1.20 and Cor. 1.21; ALGNUM, bundle B2, 2026-10-26). inclusion-exclusion          PROP. 1.20: for a finite index set I, a finite set X and sets A\_k (k in I): card\{x in X : x in no A\_k\} = sum over F in POWER(I) of ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{inclusion-\allowbreak{}exclusion-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{x \in s : \forall k \in \emptyset.\; \neg (x \in f(k))\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{ief} \in \operatorname{power}(\emptyset).\; (\operatorname{power}(-1, |\mathit{ief}|) \cdot |\{x \in s : \forall k \in \mathit{ief}.\; (x \in f(k))\}|)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(\emptyset)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inclusion-\allowbreak{}exclusion-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, s, v. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((|a| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (v \in \mathbf{Set}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{x \in a : \forall k \in s.\; \neg (x \in f(k))\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; |\{x \in a : \forall k \in (s \cup \{v\}).\; \neg (x \in f(k))\}| + |\{x \in \{y \in a : (y \in f(v))\} : \forall k \in s.\; \neg (x \in f(k))\}| \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inclusion-\allowbreak{}exclusion-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, s, i, v. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((i \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((|i| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \neg (v \in i)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{ief} \in \operatorname{power}((i \cup \{v\})).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(-1, |\mathit{ief}|) \cdot |\{x \in s : \forall k \in \mathit{ief}.\; (x \in f(k))\}|), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}((i \cup \{v\}))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), (\lambda \mathit{ief} \in \operatorname{power}(i).\; (\operatorname{power}(-1, |\mathit{ief}|) \cdot |\{x \in s : \forall k \in \mathit{ief}.\; (x \in f(k))\}|)), \operatorname{power}(i)) - \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), (\lambda \mathit{ief} \in \operatorname{power}(i).\; (\operatorname{power}(-1, |\mathit{ief}|) \cdot |\{x \in \{y \in s : (y \in f(v))\} : \forall k \in \mathit{ief}.\; (x \in f(k))\}|)), \operatorname{power}(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inclusion-\allowbreak{}exclusion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|i| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|s| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{x \in s : \forall k \in i.\; \neg (x \in f(k))\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{ief} \in \operatorname{power}(i).\; (\operatorname{power}(-1, |\mathit{ief}|) \cdot |\{x \in s : \forall k \in \mathit{ief}.\; (x \in f(k))\}|)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inclusion-\allowbreak{}exclusion-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|i| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|s| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{x \in s : \exists k \in i.\; (x \in f(k))\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{ief} \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{power}(i), \{\emptyset\}).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(-1, \operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(|\mathit{ief}|, 1)) \cdot |\{x \in s : \forall k \in \mathit{ief}.\; (x \in f(k))\}|), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{power}(i), \{\emptyset\})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/euler-phi-product.scm}{theorem-library/euler-phi-product.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/euler-phi-product.scm -- PROP. 1.19 (EULER'S PRODUCT FORMULA) (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes, ch. 1; ALGNUM, 2026-10-27).  phi(n) = n prod\_\{p | n\} (1 - 1/p), by the notes' route through inclusion-exclusion (1.20). prime-nat-divides-prime, prime-set-product      P\_F = prod\_\{p in F\} p for a finite set F of ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}nat-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}prime}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(q, p))) \Rightarrow (q = p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall p \in f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda \mathit{nzp} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \mathit{nzp}), f) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda \mathit{nzp} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \mathit{nzp}), f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall p \in f.\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda \mathit{nzp} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \mathit{nzp}), f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(q, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda \mathit{nzp} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \mathit{nzp}), f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad q \in f \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in f.\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda \mathit{nzp} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \mathit{nzp}), f), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}ones}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in f.\; (z \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda o \in \mathbb{N}.\; 1), f) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall p \in f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda a \in \mathbb{N}.\; -\operatorname{recip}(a)), f) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{power}(-1, |f|) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda \mathit{nzp} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \mathit{nzp}), f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}multiples-\allowbreak{}count}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in f.\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda \mathit{nzp} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \mathit{nzp}), f) \cdot |\{x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : \forall k \in f.\; (x \in (\lambda \mathit{nzf} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \{m \in \mathbb{Z} : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\mathit{nzf}, m)\})(k))\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}coprime-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (1 \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(k, n)\} \\ \quad \quad =\; \{x \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : \forall \mathit{iek} \in \{d \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(d) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, n))\}.\; \neg (x \in (\lambda f \in \mathbb{N}.\; \{m \in \mathbb{Z} : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(f, m)\})(\mathit{iek}))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (1 \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n) \\ \quad \quad =\; n \cdot \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda q \in \{d \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(d) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, n))\}.\; (1 - \operatorname{recip}(q))), \{d \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(d) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, n))\}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-power-add.scm}{theorem-library/cc-power-add.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-power-add.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/cc-exp.scm, so that files of library analysis may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of cc-exp.scm's.  Loaded immediately before cc-exp.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{power}(z, (m + n)) = (\operatorname{power}(z, m) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, n)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/fekete.scm}{theorem-library/fekete.scm}
\noindent{\small fekete.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1C), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1c-1109/fekete.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{fek-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{R}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((0 < k) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow ({\operatorname{power}(k, n)}^{{n}^{\ast\!-1}} = k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fek-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, k \in \mathbb{R}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq x) \wedge ((0 < k) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge (x \leq \operatorname{power}(k, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{{n}^{\ast\!-1}} \leq k \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fek-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, k \in \mathbb{R}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq x) \wedge ((0 < k) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge ({x}^{{n}^{\ast\!-1}} < k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x < \operatorname{power}(k, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fek-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}mult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in \mathbb{N}, l \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq l(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq a) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow (l((a + n)) \leq (l(a) \cdot l(n)))) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad l((m \cdot (p + 1))) \leq \operatorname{power}(l(m), (p + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fek-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, l \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq l(n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((1 \leq d) \wedge \forall r \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((r \leq m) \Rightarrow (l(r) \leq d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fek-\allowbreak{}eventually}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq l(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b, a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq b) \wedge (1 \leq a)) \Rightarrow (l((b + a)) \leq (l(b) \cdot l(a)))) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad l(m) < 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n_{0} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n_{0} \leq n) \Rightarrow (l(n) \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fek-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), k \in \mathbb{R}, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq l(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b, a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq b) \wedge (1 \leq a)) \Rightarrow (l((b + a)) \leq (l(b) \cdot l(a)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad l(m) < \operatorname{power}(k, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n_{0} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n_{0} \leq n) \Rightarrow (l(n) \leq \operatorname{power}(k, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fekete-\allowbreak{}lemma}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), v \in \mathbb{R}, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq l(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m, a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq m) \wedge (1 \leq a)) \Rightarrow (l((m + a)) \leq (l(m) \cdot l(a)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq k) \Rightarrow (v \leq {l(k)}^{{k}^{\ast\!-1}})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq k) \wedge ({l(k)}^{{k}^{\ast\!-1}} < (v + s))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(n) = {l((n + 1))}^{{(n + 1)}^{\ast\!-1}}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, v) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/phi-growth.scm}{theorem-library/phi-growth.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/phi-growth.scm -- LEMMA 1.24, PROP. 1.25, COR. 1.26 (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes, ch. 1; ALGNUM, 2026-10-27): the growth of phi. nn-power-closed, rr-power-ge-one, rr-power-mono-exp, rr-power-mono-le, rr-power-ge-base   natural powers prime-divides-prime-power, prime-decomposition(-bounded), ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, x \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{power}(x, k) \in \mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((1 \leq x) \Rightarrow (1 \leq \operatorname{power}(x, k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}exp}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((1 \leq x) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{power}(x, k) \leq \operatorname{power}(x, (k + d))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{N}, q, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(r) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(r, \operatorname{power}(q, a)))) \Rightarrow (r = q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}decomposition-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge (n \leq k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a, m \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((n = (\operatorname{power}(q, a) \cdot m)) \wedge \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(q, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prime-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a, m \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((n = (\operatorname{power}(q, a) \cdot m)) \wedge \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(q, m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coprime-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{N}, q.; \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q) \wedge \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(q, m)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(m, \operatorname{power}(q, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fun-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}initial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (1 \leq m) \wedge \forall l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq l) \wedge (l \leq k)) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(l) \rvert \leq m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((1 \leq x) \wedge (1 \leq a)) \Rightarrow (x \leq \operatorname{power}(x, a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j, k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((1 \leq x) \wedge (k \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{power}(x, k) \leq \operatorname{power}(x, j)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multiplicative-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \mathbb{R}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}multiplicative}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p.; \forall \mathit{mbk} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge (b < \operatorname{power}(p, \mathit{mbk}))) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(\operatorname{power}(p, \mathit{mbk})) \rvert \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad \forall l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq l) \wedge (l \leq (b + 1))) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(l) \rvert \leq a)) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad n \leq k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert f(n) \rvert \leq \operatorname{power}(a, (|\{t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, b) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(t) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(t, n))\}| + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multiplicative-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}multiplicative}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge (b < \operatorname{power}(p, k))) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) \rvert \leq 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mbb} \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq n) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(n) \rvert \leq \mathit{mbb})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq n) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(\operatorname{power}(p, (j + 1))) = (\operatorname{power}(p, (j + 1)) \cdot (1 - \operatorname{recip}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}ratio-\allowbreak{}multiplicative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}multiplicative}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k = 0)\text{ then }0\text{ else }(\operatorname{rpow}(k, e) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(k)))\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}ratio-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \mathbb{Q}, y \in \mathbb{R}, j \in \mathbb{N}, p. \\ \quad ((0 < t) \wedge ((0 < y) \wedge ((\operatorname{rpow}(y, t) = 2) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge (y \leq \operatorname{power}(p, (j + 1))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{rpow}(\operatorname{power}(p, (j + 1)), (1 - t)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(\operatorname{power}(p, (j + 1))))) \leq 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}ratio-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad (0 < t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (1 \leq n) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{rpow}(n, (1 - t)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n))) \leq b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}lower-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad (0 < d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < c) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq n) \Rightarrow ((c \cdot \operatorname{rpow}(n, (1 - d))) \leq \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}ratio-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad (0 < d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{rpow}((k + 1), (1 - d)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}((k + 1))))), 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rr-pos-star-order-lemmas.scm}{theorem-library/rr-pos-star-order-lemmas.scm}
\noindent{\small rr-pos-star-order-lemmas.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/integral-convergence.scm, so that files of library analysis may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of integral-convergence.scm's.  Loaded ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}total}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; ((x \leq y) \vee (y \leq x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (\neg (x < y) \Rightarrow (y \leq x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}floor-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, r. \\ \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r)) \Rightarrow \exists f \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((f \cdot r) \leq c) \wedge (c < ((f \cdot r) + r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, q, g \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < g) \wedge ((0 < q) \wedge ((l \cdot \operatorname{recip}(g)) < q))) \Rightarrow ((l \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) < g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}div-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, q, g \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < g) \wedge ((l \cdot \operatorname{recip}(g)) < q)) \Rightarrow (l < (q \cdot g)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rps-lt-le-trans.scm}{theorem-library/rps-lt-le-trans.scm}
\noindent{\small rps-lt-le-trans.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-30 (wave-2 integration) out of theorem-library/integral-convergence.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by ch4a-coef (complex-analysis); an RR-POS-STAR order fact. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((x < y) \wedge (y \leq z)) \Rightarrow (x < z) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/esup-lt-witness.scm}{theorem-library/esup-lt-witness.scm}
\noindent{\small esup-lt-witness.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/integral-convergence.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by haar-fixed-point; ESUP. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. esup-lt-witness}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}witness}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (a < \operatorname{esup}(s))) \Rightarrow \exists y \in s.\; (a < y) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/integral-convergence.scm}{theorem-library/integral-convergence.scm}
\noindent{\small integral-convergence.scm -- MEASURABLE FUNCTIONS CLOSED UNDER +, *, sup and lim inf; APPROXIMATION BY SIMPLE FUNCTIONS; MONOTONE CONVERGENCE; ADDITIVITY OF THE INTEGRAL; FATOU'S LEMMA; DOMINATED CONVERGENCE.  Agent M-3 of the October roadmap (week 3, scratchpad/triage/WEEK3.md).  Helper prefix icv-.  Every theorem ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall y \in s, a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (a < y)) \Rightarrow (a < \operatorname{esup}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}tails}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall l \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq l) \Rightarrow (\{x \in a : (l < f(x))\} \in b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}sup-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (g(x) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(n)(x)), \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}sup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}guarded-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, f, p, s.; \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, c, f) \Rightarrow (\{x \in a : ((p \in s) \wedge (f(x) < b))\} \in c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}lower-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, f, s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, c, f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : \forall p \in s.\; (b \leq f(p)(x))\} \in c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, s, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (g(x) = \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(n)(x)), s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}liminf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}grid-\allowbreak{}between}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge (a < b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a < (k \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))) \wedge ((k \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) < b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}grid-\allowbreak{}row}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g, l, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((k \cdot r) < f(x)) \wedge ((l - (k \cdot r)) < g(x)))\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}eplus-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (h(x) = \operatorname{eplus}(f(x), g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}eplus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}div-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, f, g \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < g) \wedge (l < (f \cdot g))) \Rightarrow ((l \cdot \operatorname{recip}(g)) < f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}grid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, q, f, g \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq l) \wedge ((0 < q) \wedge ((q < f) \wedge ((l \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) < g)))) \Rightarrow (l < (f \cdot g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}cell}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g, l, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (q \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : ((0 < q) \wedge ((q < f(x)) \wedge ((l \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) < g(x))))\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}row}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g, l, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((0 < (k \cdot r)) \wedge (((k \cdot r) < f(x)) \wedge ((l \cdot \operatorname{recip}((k \cdot r))) < g(x))))\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (h(x) = \operatorname{etimes}(f(x), g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}etimes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, f, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}eplus-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v.; \forall l \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(n) \leq u((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (v(n) \leq v((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{eplus}(u(n), v(n)) \leq l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(u, \mathbb{N})), \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(v, \mathbb{N}))) \leq l \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}esup-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, h, a.; \forall l \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\mathbb{N} \to (s \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(n)(z) \leq h((n + 1))(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (a(z) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda m \in \mathbb{N}.\; h(m)(z)), \mathbb{N}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, h(n), s) \leq l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, a, s) \leq l \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}partition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, k, h, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in a.\; (k(z) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (\{x \in a : (k(x) = z)\} \in b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (h(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (0 \leq h(z)) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in a.\; (t(z) = h(k(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, l \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < c) \wedge (c < 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(c, u) \leq l)) \Rightarrow (u \leq l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \mathbb{R}, m \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad (0 \leq w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(w, \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(m, \mathbb{N}))) \leq \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{etimes}(w, m(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s, c, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{image}(s, a).\; ((\{\mathit{six} \in a : (s(\mathit{six}) = y)\} \cap t) \in b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = \left(\text{if }(x \in t)\text{ then }(c \cdot s(x))\text{ else }0\right)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, f) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda y \in \operatorname{image}(s, a).\; \operatorname{etimes}((c \cdot y), u((\{\mathit{six} \in a : (s(\mathit{six}) = y)\} \cap t)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mct-\allowbreak{}simple-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, f(n), f((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, s, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s) \leq \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}convergence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, f(n), f((n + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fatou}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, f)) \leq \operatorname{eliminf}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}grid-\allowbreak{}max}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, y \in \mathbb{R}, m \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad ((0 < d) \wedge ((a \subseteq \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \in a) \wedge ((y < ((m \cdot d) + d)) \wedge \forall k \in a.\; ((k \cdot d) \leq y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\mathit{sk} \cdot d)), a)) = (m \cdot d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grid-\allowbreak{}staircase-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad m \in \{q \in \mathbb{N} : (((q \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) \leq x) \wedge ((q \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) \leq n))\} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (k \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{q \in \mathbb{N} : (((q \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) \leq x) \wedge ((q \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) \leq n))\})) \\ \quad =\; m \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((z \leq x) \wedge (z \leq n)) \Rightarrow (z < ((m \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) + \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}guarded-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, f, a, b, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(c, d, f) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in c : (((a < b) \wedge (b \leq g)) \wedge (b \leq f(x)))\} \in d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grid-\allowbreak{}staircase-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (k \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{q \in \mathbb{N} : (((q \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) \leq f(x)) \wedge ((q \cdot \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) \leq n))\})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}simple-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, c(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, c(n), c((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, c)(x) = f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}eplus-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(n) \leq u((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (v(n) \leq v((n + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda a \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{eplus}(u(a), v(a))), \mathbb{N})) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(u, \mathbb{N})), \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(v, \mathbb{N}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}eplus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, s, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)) = \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f), \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}row}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, v, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, v) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((v(x) < (k \cdot r)) \wedge ((k \cdot r) < u(x)))\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : (v(x) < u(x))\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda x \in a.\; c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}part}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow (\{p \in a : (u(p) \in \mathbb{R})\} \in b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, u) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \{p \in a : (u(p) \in \mathbb{R})\})) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in b \wedge \\ \quad u(c) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in c) \Rightarrow (d(x) \leq f(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, d) \leq \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{difference-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, v.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad ((\lambda \mathit{dx} \in a.\; \left(\text{if }(u(\mathit{dx}) \in \mathbb{R})\text{ then }(u(\mathit{dx}) - v(\mathit{dx}))\text{ else }0\right))(x) \simeq \left(\text{if }(u(x) \in \mathbb{R})\text{ then }(u(x) - v(x))\text{ else }0\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, v) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (v(x) \leq u(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda \mathit{dx} \in a.\; \left(\text{if }(u(\mathit{dx}) \in \mathbb{R})\text{ then }(u(\mathit{dx}) - v(\mathit{dx}))\text{ else }0\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (v(x) \leq u(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, u) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, (\lambda \mathit{dx} \in a.\; \left(\text{if }(u(\mathit{dx}) \in \mathbb{R})\text{ then }(u(\mathit{dx}) - v(\mathit{dx}))\text{ else }0\right))), \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, v)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{elimsup-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(n) \leq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{elimsup}(a) \leq b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eliminf-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}elimsup}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}).\; (\operatorname{eliminf}(a) \leq \operatorname{elimsup}(a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{einf-\allowbreak{}reflection-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, a, b.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(n) \leq c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = (c - a(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{etail}(a, m)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{etail}(b, m)) = (c - \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{etail}(a, m)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eliminf-\allowbreak{}reflection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, a, b. \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(n) \leq c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = (c - a(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{elimsup}(a) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\operatorname{eliminf}(b) = (c - \operatorname{elimsup}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dominated-\allowbreak{}convergence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, c(n), g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(n)(x)), f(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, c(n))), \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/caratheodory.scm}{theorem-library/caratheodory.scm}
\noindent{\small caratheodory.scm -- THE CARATHEODORY CONSTRUCTION, PROVEN. Agent MEASURE-1, 2026-10-07 (scratchpad/triage/MEASURE-1.md).  Library: measure.  Helper prefix cth-.  16 theorems, every one `modulo 0'.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{difference-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, b.\; (\operatorname{difference}(u, b) \simeq \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inter-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, u) \cap e) = (a \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(e, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, u), e) = \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, (u \cup e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \emptyset) = a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{union-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, e.\; (a = ((a \cap e) \cup \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, e)))}}
