\vnbentry{\texttt{inter-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}ambient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, m, e. \\ \quad (t \subseteq m) \Rightarrow ((t \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(m, e)) = \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(t, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}ambient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, m, e. \\ \quad (t \subseteq m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(t, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(m, e)) = (t \cap e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inter-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, m.\; ((t \subseteq m) \Rightarrow ((t \cap m) = t))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, m.\; ((t \subseteq m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(t, m) = \emptyset))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{outer-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}binary-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, \alpha, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{power}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u((\alpha \cup b)) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(u(\alpha), u(b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{outer-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, \alpha, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{power}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\alpha) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(u((\alpha \cap s)), u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\alpha, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{caratheodory-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge ((s \subseteq a) \wedge (u(s) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, u, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{caratheodory-\allowbreak{}superadditive-\allowbreak{}suffices}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \forall \alpha \in \operatorname{power}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(u((\alpha \cap s)), u(\operatorname{difference}(\alpha, s))) \leq u(\alpha) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, u, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{caratheodory-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, u, f, \alpha. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u))) \wedge (\alpha \in \operatorname{power}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\alpha) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; u((\alpha \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(f(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j)))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathrm{OS}(n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\alpha, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(n), f(j))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{caratheodory-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{caratheodory-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u), \operatorname{res}(u, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/outer-measure-construction.scm}{theorem-library/outer-measure-construction.scm}
\noindent{\small outer-measure-construction.scm -- METHOD I OUTER MEASURES; the outer measure of a measure, its Caratheodory measure, completeness and the completion; Lebesgue outer measure on the line as an instance. Agent MEASURE-2, 2026-10-08 (scratchpad/triage/MEASURE-2.md).  Library:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cover-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, b) \simeq \{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists \mathit{cvs} \in (\mathbb{N} \to s).\; ((b \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{cvs}(n))) \wedge (v = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; m(\operatorname{cvs}(k))))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cover-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, s, m, b.\; (\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, b) \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cover-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m, b.; \forall v \in \operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, b). \exists \mathit{cvs} \in (\mathbb{N} \to s). \\ \quad (b \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{cvs}(n))) \wedge (v = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; m(\operatorname{cvs}(k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cover-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m, b, q. \\ \quad ((m \in (s \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge ((q \in (\mathbb{N} \to s)) \wedge (b \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, q(n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; m(q(k)))) \in \operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m.; \forall b \in \operatorname{power}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, s, m)(b) = \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}, s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, s, m) \in (\operatorname{power}(a) \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{einf-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}witness}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (\operatorname{einf}(s) < a)) \Rightarrow \exists y \in s.\; (y < a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}forall-\allowbreak{}eps}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq y) \wedge \forall s.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow (x \leq \operatorname{eplus}(y, s)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \leq y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eplus-\allowbreak{}swap4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{eplus}(a, b), \operatorname{eplus}(c, d)) = \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{eplus}(a, c), \operatorname{eplus}(b, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge (g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{eplus}(f(k), g(k))), \mathrm{OS}(n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, \mathrm{OS}(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge (g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{eplus}(f(k), g(k)))) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{esum}(f), \operatorname{esum}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dyadic-\allowbreak{}eps-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, (i + 1))))) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < (\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, (i + 1)))))(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dyadic-\allowbreak{}eps-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{N}, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, (i + 1))))), \mathrm{OS}(a)) \\ \quad \quad =\; s \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1)))), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dyadic-\allowbreak{}eps-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{esum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, (i + 1)))))) \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trinum-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s \leq \operatorname{trinum}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}unpair-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{nnfst}(v) \leq v) \wedge (\operatorname{nnsnd}(v) \leq v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}fiber-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, p, f, g. \\ \quad s \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |t| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (p(z) \in t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in t.\; (g(z) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in t.\; (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \{w \in s : (p(w) = z)\}) \leq g(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, s) \leq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}flatten-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, l, b. \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad l \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (l(m) = a(\operatorname{nnfst}(m))(\operatorname{nnsnd}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(i) = \operatorname{esum}(a(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(l) \leq \operatorname{esum}(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq \operatorname{esum}(f))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(a, s, m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, \emptyset)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m, b, t. \\ \quad ((m \in (s \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge (b \subseteq t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, b)) \leq \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(a, s, m) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, f(k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(a, s, m) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, s, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}single}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, m, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(a, s, m) \wedge ((c \in s) \wedge (b \subseteq c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, s, m, b)) \leq m(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}premeasure}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, o.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(a, b, o))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cover-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}dominates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(a, b, o, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{oda} \in b.\; ((s \subseteq \mathit{oda}) \wedge (o(\mathit{oda}) \leq y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{einf}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists \mathit{osa} \in b.\; ((s \subseteq \mathit{osa}) \wedge (v = o(\mathit{osa})))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}extends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (c \in b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(c) = o(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (c \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, f(n)))) \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}attained}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge (\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in b.\; ((s \subseteq z) \wedge (o(z) = \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s) = 0) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in b.\; ((s \subseteq y) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(y, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{caratheodory-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u), \operatorname{res}(u, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}caratheodory-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}extends-\allowbreak{}completion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge ((c \in b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (c \cup s) \in \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)))((c \cup s)) = o(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{esum}(f) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in b.\; ((s \subseteq y) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(y, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}completion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{ofa} \in b, \mathit{ofb}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, \mathit{ofb}) \wedge (s = (\mathit{ofa} \cup \mathit{ofb}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}premeasure}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))), \\ \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}ccint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = (b - a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb-conull.scm}{theorem-library/mb-conull.scm}
\noindent{\small mb-conull.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf Prop. 2.9: conull sets are closed under countable intersections, and a (measurable) superset of a conull set is conull. Agent M-B, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/mb-conull.scm.  Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{conull-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}conull}(a, b, u, f(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}conull}(a, b, u, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, f(n))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conull-\allowbreak{}superset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}conull}(a, b, u, \alpha) \wedge ((\beta \in b) \wedge (\alpha \subseteq \beta)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}conull}(a, b, u, \beta) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb-complete.scm}{theorem-library/mb-complete.scm}
\noindent{\small mb-complete.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf Prop. 3.2: a measure is complete iff "for every A, B subset X, if A (triangle) B is mu-null and A in A then B in A". Agent M-B, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/mb-complete.scm.  Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sym-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sym\text{-}difference}(a, b) \simeq (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, b) \cup \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(b, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{null-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \mathit{nsa}, \mathit{nsb}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \mathit{nsa}) \wedge (\mathit{nsb} \subseteq \mathit{nsa})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \mathit{nsb}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{null-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}omega}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \mathit{nsa}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \mathit{nsa})) \Rightarrow (\mathit{nsa} \subseteq a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complete-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}symdiff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad \quad \quad \alpha \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \beta \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \operatorname{sym\text{-}difference}(\alpha, \beta)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \alpha \in b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \beta \in b \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb-outer.scm}{theorem-library/mb-outer.scm}
\noindent{\small mb-outer.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf Lemma 4.5 (countable form) and Prop. 4.13. Agent M-B, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/mb-outer.scm.  Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{outer-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}disjoint-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, f, \mathit{ta}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((f(i) \cap f(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{ta} \in \operatorname{power}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u((\mathit{ta} \cap \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n)))) = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u((\mathit{ta} \cap f(n))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (s \subseteq a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), s) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall \mathit{ta} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad (o(\mathit{ta}) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)((\mathit{ta} \cap s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\mathit{ta}, s))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; o(\mathit{ta}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/real-integral.scm}{theorem-library/real-integral.scm}
\noindent{\small real-integral.scm -- THE INTEGRAL OF A REAL-VALUED FUNCTION (MEASURE-4-C, 2026-10-10).  Vocabulary: structure-library/real-integral.scm (POS-PART, NEG-PART, ABS-FN, IS-REAL-MEASURABLE-FN, IS-INTEGRABLE, RINTEGRAL).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, f.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f) \simeq (\lambda x \in a.\; \left(\text{if }(0 \leq f(x))\text{ then }f(x)\text{ else }0\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neg-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, f.\; (\operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f) \simeq (\lambda x \in a.\; \left(\text{if }(0 \leq f(x))\text{ then }0\text{ else }-f(x)\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, f.\; (\operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f) \simeq (\lambda x \in a.\; \lvert f(x) \rvert))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) \simeq (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)) - \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, f.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \simeq \left(\text{if }(0 \leq f(x))\text{ then }f(x)\text{ else }0\right))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neg-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, f.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \simeq \left(\text{if }(0 \leq f(x))\text{ then }0\text{ else }-f(x)\right))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, f.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f)(x) \simeq \lvert f(x) \rvert)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}eplus-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}q}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, c.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, b, c)(x) \simeq \operatorname{eplus}(b(x), c(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}q}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, c.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, b, c)(x) \simeq \operatorname{etimes}(b(x), c(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}q}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, k, g.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, k, g)(x) \simeq \operatorname{etimes}(k, g(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{part-\allowbreak{}values-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}), x \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \wedge \\ \quad f(x) = (\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) - \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \lvert f(x) \rvert = (\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) + \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f) \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neg-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f) \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f) \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{part-\allowbreak{}values-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}), x \in a. \\ \quad (0 \leq f(x)) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) = f(x)) \wedge (\operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{part-\allowbreak{}values-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}), x \in a. \\ \quad \neg (0 \leq f(x)) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) = -f(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, c, d. \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (c(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (d(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = (c(x) - d(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neg-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, c, d. \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (c(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (d(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = (c(x) - d(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (c(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (d(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = (c(x) - d(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, c) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, d) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) = (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, c) - \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}fn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; 0)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, k, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f) = \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f), \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}fn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)), \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integrable-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f)) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) + g(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) + g(x)))) = (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) + \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (c \cdot f(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (c \cdot f(x)))) = (c \cdot \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in s) \Rightarrow (f(x) \leq g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) \leq \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) \leq g(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) \leq \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) \rvert \leq \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (0 \leq f(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}ae-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in s) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, g) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, g) = \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}restrict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge (c \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{indicator}(a, c)(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{indicator}(a, c)(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f), \operatorname{indicator}(a, c))) - \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f), \operatorname{indicator}(a, c)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in b. \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{indicator}(a, c)(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \{\mathit{nx} \in a : (f(\mathit{nx}) < 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}tails}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f.; \forall l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow (\{x \in a : (l < f(x))\} \in b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}tails}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge ((f \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall l \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\{x \in a : (l < f(x))\} \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}tails}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge ((f \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall l \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\{x \in a : (l < f(x))\} \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}tails}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Leftrightarrow \forall l \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\{x \in a : (l < f(x))\} \in b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/monotone-class.scm}{theorem-library/monotone-class.scm}
\noindent{\small monotone-class.scm -- MONOTONE CLASSES: Prop. 1.11 and the monotone class theorem (Thm. 1.13).  Agent MEASURE-2, 2026-10-08 (scratchpad/triage/MEASURE-2.md).  Library: measure.  Helper prefix mcl-. 12 theorems, every one `modulo 0', no oracle.  Vocabulary:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, \alpha. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge (\alpha \in b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \alpha) \in b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge (\beta \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\alpha \cup \beta) \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge (\beta \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\alpha \cap \beta) \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}whole-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \Rightarrow ((a \in b) \wedge (\emptyset \in b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j)) \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}monotone-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \mathbb{N}, f(k)) \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}generated-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{monotone\text{-}class\text{-}generated}(a, e) \simeq \{\mathit{mca} \in \operatorname{power}(a) : \forall b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{power}(a)).\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, b) \wedge (e \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{mca} \in b))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, c) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{power}(a))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}generated-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, e, \alpha. \\ \quad \alpha \in \operatorname{monotone\text{-}class\text{-}generated}(a, e) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((\alpha \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge \forall b.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, b) \wedge (e \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow (\alpha \in b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}generated-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}monotone-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, e. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, \operatorname{monotone\text{-}class\text{-}generated}(a, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}section}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, m) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, \{e \in \operatorname{power}(a) : ((d \cup e) \in m)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}section}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, \{c \in \operatorname{power}(a) : (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, c) \in m)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monotone-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, c) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, e) \wedge (e \subseteq c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(a, e) \subseteq c \end{array}}}
