The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of lebesgue-interval-length.scm's.  Loaded ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{subset-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; ((s \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow (s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R})))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/lebesgue-interval-length.scm}{theorem-library/lebesgue-interval-length.scm}
\noindent{\small lebesgue-interval-length.scm -- THE LEBESGUE OUTER MEASURE OF AN INTERVAL IS ITS LENGTH.  Agent MEASURE-3-B, 2026-10-09 (scratchpad/triage/MEASURE-3-B.md). Library: measure.  Helper prefix lil-.  No definition, no support, no stamp.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s) \simeq \operatorname{esup}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : ((v = 0) \vee \exists x, y \in s.\; ((x \leq y) \wedge (v = (y - x))))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; ((a \subseteq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(a) \leq \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}extend}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, w, z. \\ \quad b \subseteq \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq b \wedge \\ \quad w \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad w \leq z \wedge \\ \quad w \in b \wedge \\ \quad z \in b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (x \leq w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(a), (z - w)) \leq \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}widen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : \exists u \in s.\; (((z - u) < r) \wedge ((u - z) < r))\}) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s), \operatorname{eplus}(r, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}range}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, m, n. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (m \leq n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(m)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}bump}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, f, g, c. \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(q) \leq g(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{eplus}(f(k), c) \leq g(k) \wedge \\ \quad k < n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)), c) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}center-\allowbreak{}half}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, r, w. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((w \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < d) \wedge (((d + d) = r) \wedge (((t - d) < w) \wedge (w \leq (t + d))))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((w - t) < r) \wedge ((t - w) < r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}widened-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, e. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq b \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, s(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (b - a) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda \mathit{lnn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : \exists u \in s(\mathit{lnn}).\; (((z - u) < (e \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, (\mathit{lnn} + 1))))) \wedge ((u - z) < (e \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, (\mathit{lnn} + 1))))))\}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq b \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, s(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (b - a) \leq \operatorname{esum}((\lambda \mathit{lkn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s(\mathit{lkn})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \subseteq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(a) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}ccint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (b - a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(\operatorname{singleton}(x)) \\ \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(\emptyset) \\ =\; 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}between}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq b \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq ((s \cup \operatorname{singleton}(a)) \cup \operatorname{singleton}(b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; (b - a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}ooint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(\operatorname{ooint}(a, b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (b - a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}coint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(\operatorname{coint}(a, b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (b - a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}ocint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))(\operatorname{ocint}(a, b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (b - a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}length-\allowbreak{}translate-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : ((z - c) \in s)\}) \leq \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translate-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, c. \\ \quad ((i \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \mathbb{R} : ((z - c) \in i)\} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}translate-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : ((z - c) \in s)\}) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}translate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : ((z - c) \in s)\}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/metric-outer-measure.scm}{theorem-library/metric-outer-measure.scm}
\noindent{\small metric-outer-measure.scm -- METRIC OUTER MEASURES: separated sets, the layers of a closed set, Borel sets are measurable; Lebesgue outer measure on the line is metric. Agent MEASURE-3-A, 2026-10-09 (scratchpad/triage/MEASURE-3-A.md).  Library: measure. Helper prefix mom-.  58 theorems, every one `modulo 0' (oracles ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, s) \simeq \operatorname{einf}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists z \in s.\; (v = \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, z))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, a, b) \simeq \operatorname{einf}(\{w \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists x \in a, y \in b.\; (w = \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, s.; \forall r \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (r \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, z)) \Rightarrow (r \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, s, r.; \forall z \in s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \wedge \\ \quad r \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad r \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall x \in a, y \in b.\; (r \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, a, b) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge ((b \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, a, b) = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall x \in a, y \in b.\; (r \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, a, s) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, b, s) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, (a \cup b), s) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, s(k), s(l)) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(n), s(j))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda a \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(s(a))), \mathrm{OS}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{moj} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (n \leq \mathit{moj}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(n), s(j)), s(\mathit{moj})) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, s.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, s(k), s(l)) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(n), s(j))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda a \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(s(a))), \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}separated-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, s(k), s(l)) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, s(n))) = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(s(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}distrib}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, c \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((c \cdot (a + 1)) = ((a \cdot c) + c))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}((\operatorname{recip}((j + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}(((j + 1) + 1))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (l \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x \in \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \forall z \in l.\; (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{pts}(m). \\ \quad \forall z \in l.\; (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, z)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l, k, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((l \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \leq n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\} \\ \quad \quad \subseteq\; \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (l \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m))) \Rightarrow \neg (x \in l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, l) \wedge \neg (x \in l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x \in \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad l \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((j + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\} \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y \in \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}(((j + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{recip}((j + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}(((j + 1) + 1))) \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}even-\allowbreak{}odd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(q) = f((2 \cdot q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(q) = f(((2 \cdot q) + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}((2 \cdot n))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, \mathrm{OS}(n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, h, \mathrm{OS}(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}even-\allowbreak{}odd-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(q) = f((2 \cdot q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(q) = f(((2 \cdot q) + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(f) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{esum}(g), \operatorname{esum}(h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge ((g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) \leq f((n + j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, g, \mathrm{OS}(k))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}((n + k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), s. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{esum}(f) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) \leq f((n + j))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{esum}(g) \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{pts}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, l) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x \in l) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x \in \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad x \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((((n + j) + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{\mathit{mex} \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}(((n + j) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, \mathit{mex}, l))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}sep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad l \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((j + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in b. \\ \quad \quad ((y \in \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \neg (y \in \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}(((j + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, a, b) = 0) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, b, a) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}even-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, l.; \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}((\lambda q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u((a \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((((2 \cdot q) + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}, \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot q) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; u((a \cap \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}odd-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, l.; \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}((\lambda q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u((a \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}(((((2 \cdot q) + 1) + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}, \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((((2 \cdot q) + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; u((a \cap \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}layers-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\} \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}(((n + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad \quad \quad u((a \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(m), l))) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; u((a \cap \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\operatorname{pts}(m), u, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(m, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\operatorname{pts}(m), u, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(m) \simeq \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \{u \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) : \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(m, u)\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}caratheodory-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u.; \forall s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\operatorname{pts}(m), u, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ray}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \leq b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x \leq c)\}) = \operatorname{ccint}(a, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}all}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (b \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x \leq c)\}) = \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}ray}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c \leq x)\}) = \operatorname{ccint}(c, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}all}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \leq a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c \leq x)\}) = \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (b < a)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) = \emptyset) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{empty-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ray}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\emptyset \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x \leq c)\}) = \emptyset \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{empty-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}ray}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\emptyset \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c \leq x)\}) = \emptyset \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}intervals}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}cut}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad ((s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (s \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x \leq c)\}) \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals} \wedge \\ \quad \quad (s \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c \leq x)\}) \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}((\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))((s \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x \leq c)\})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))((s \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c \leq x)\}))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}superadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{eplus}(f(k), g(k)) \leq h(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{esum}(f), \operatorname{esum}(g)) \leq \operatorname{esum}(h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, u, v. \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad u \subseteq (s \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x \leq c)\}) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq (s \cap \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c \leq x)\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(v)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \\ \quad \quad \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x \leq c)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \\ \quad \quad \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c \leq x)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}sep-\allowbreak{}meets}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (s \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in s : \exists y \in c.\; (y \in s)\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}separating-\allowbreak{}sets}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, a, b) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\operatorname{pts}(m), u, s) \wedge ((a \subseteq s) \wedge \forall y \in b.\; \neg (y \in s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grid-\allowbreak{}cell-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (0 \leq x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : ((n \cdot r) \leq \mathit{mhx})\}, \{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (((n \cdot r) + r) \leq \mathit{mhx})\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grid-\allowbreak{}cell-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}nonpos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (x \leq 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (\mathit{mhx} \leq -(n \cdot r))\}, \{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (\mathit{mhx} \leq -((n \cdot r) + r))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grid-\allowbreak{}cell-\allowbreak{}close-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : ((n \cdot r) \leq \mathit{mhx})\}, \{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (((n \cdot r) + r) \leq \mathit{mhx})\}) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : ((n \cdot r) \leq \mathit{mhx})\}, \{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (((n \cdot r) + r) \leq \mathit{mhx})\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert (x - y) \rvert < r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{grid-\allowbreak{}cell-\allowbreak{}close-\allowbreak{}nonpos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (\mathit{mhx} \leq -(n \cdot r))\}, \{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (\mathit{mhx} \leq -((n \cdot r) + r))\}) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (\mathit{mhx} \leq -(n \cdot r))\}, \{\mathit{mhx} \in \mathbb{R} : (\mathit{mhx} \leq -((n \cdot r) + r))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert (x - y) \rvert < r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))), \\ \quad \quad s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x < c)\} \\ \quad \in\; \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \{x \in \mathbb{R} : (c < x)\} \\ \quad \in\; \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}intervals-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ooint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{coint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ocint}(a, b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/metric-finite-subcover.scm}{theorem-library/metric-finite-subcover.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/metric-finite-subcover.scm -- a closed set of a compact metric space covered by countably many open sets is covered by finitely many of them. Library: analysis.  MOVED 2026-10-20 (the wiring of CALC-3) from theorem-library/riesz-markov-cantor.scm (library measure), where RM-2 proved it as}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}subcover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(m, q(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x \in q(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall x \in a.\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n < f) \wedge (x \in q(n))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cont-fns-laws.scm}{theorem-library/cont-fns-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/cont-fns-laws.scm -- CONT-FNS(s) and CLOPEN-SETS(s) of a metric space s: the membership laws, closure of CONT-FNS under pointwise sums and scalar multiples, and a function constant on an open set around a is continuous at a.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, h. \\ \quad (h \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \Leftrightarrow ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \Leftrightarrow ((u \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, u.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, u)) \Rightarrow (u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, u) \wedge (u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall h \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, f. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (c \cdot f(x))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) + g(x))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, h, a, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, w) \wedge ((a \in w) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall y \in w.\; (h(y) = h(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/riesz-markov-cantor.scm}{theorem-library/riesz-markov-cantor.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/riesz-markov-cantor.scm -- RIESZ-MARKOV, STAGE 2 (RM-2, 2026-10-10): a positive linear functional on the continuous functions of the Cantor model K is integration against a measure.  Vocabulary: structure-library/positive-functional.scm (CONT-FNS, IS-POSITIVE-FUNCTIONAL,}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}indicator-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b \in \mathbf{Set}, a.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a) \in (b \to \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}indicator-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, a.; \forall x \in b. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq \operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(x)) \wedge (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(x) \leq 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}indicator-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; (\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, a, b.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, a, b) \in \mathbf{Set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}clopen}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, q, a.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, a, b) \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}indicator-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, a.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)), \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, a, b)) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}compl-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, (u \cup v)) = (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, u) \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}compl-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, (u \cap v)) = (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, u) \cup \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, v. \\ \quad (u \subseteq a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{difference}(u, v) = (u \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, v)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, (u \cup v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}compl}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u) \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (u \cap v) \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (u \cup v) \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u, v. \\ \quad ((u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{difference}(u, v) \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}whole}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\emptyset \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{pts}(s) \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \subseteq \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) + g(x)))) = (m(f) + m(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, c, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (c \cdot f(x)))) = (c \cdot m(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) \leq g(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m(f) \leq m(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, f, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) \leq (a(x) + b(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m(f) \leq (m(a) + m(b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, f, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((a(x) + b(x)) \leq f(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (m(a) + m(b)) \leq m(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}ind-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}ind-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, c, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), (c \cap a))) + m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{difference}(c, a))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}ind-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, a, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), a)) \leq (m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{difference}(a, c))) + m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}ind-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \emptyset)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}ind-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \wedge \\ \quad (u \cap v) = \emptyset \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), (u \cup v))) = (m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)) + m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}rps-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq x) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}mu0-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge (u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{rcu} \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \mathit{rcu})))(u) = m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}fseq-\allowbreak{}laws}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge (q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cvk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)))(q(\mathit{cvk}))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cvk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)))(q(\mathit{cvk})))(k) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), q(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, s, m, b.; \forall a \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n < q) \wedge (x \in b(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), a)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)))(b(k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathrm{OS}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, q, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, q(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), a)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)))(q(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}premeasure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s), (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{power}(a).\; (x \subseteq a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}clopen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s), (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u))))(a) \\ \quad \quad =\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}clopen-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s), (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s), (\lambda \mathit{rcu} \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; \vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}same}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, e, p, b. \\ \quad ((e \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, e, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, p, b) = \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, e, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}saturated-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, w.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((w \subseteq \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)) \wedge \forall y \in w, z \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, y, b).\; (z \in w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}saturated-\allowbreak{}clopen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, w.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((w \subseteq \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)) \wedge \forall y \in w, z \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, y, b).\; (z \in w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad w \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, u, b, x. \\ \quad x \in \{e \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q) : (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, e, b) \subseteq u)\} \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q)) \wedge (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, x, b) \subseteq u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}clopen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, u.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \{e \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q) : (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, e, b) \subseteq u)\} \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}w}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \{e \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q) : (\operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, e, k) \subseteq u)\})(n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g, c. \\ \quad ((g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(m)) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(m, \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (g(x) < c)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g, c. \\ \quad ((g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(m)) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(m, \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (c < g(x))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(m) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq d) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(m).\; (\lvert g(x) \rvert \leq d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, e, n, b. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (n \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, e, b) \subseteq \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, e, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}level}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, g, a. \\ \quad ((g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q))) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{N}. \forall x \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}k}(s, q), y \in \operatorname{rm\text{-}cyl}(s, q, x, l). \\ \quad \quad \quad \lvert (g(y) - g(x)) \rvert \leq a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmc-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}integrable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad u(a) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall l \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\{c \in a : (l < f(c))\} \in b) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\lvert f(x) \rvert \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/integral-unique.scm}{theorem-library/integral-unique.scm}
\noindent{\small integral-unique.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/md/md-unique.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, w, y.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad ((s(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq s(x)) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq y) \wedge (\neg (y \in w) \wedge (w \in \mathbf{Set})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \left(\text{if }(s(x) \in (w \cup \{y\}))\text{ then }s(x)\text{ else }0\right) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\left(\text{if }(s(x) \in w)\text{ then }s(x)\text{ else }0\right), \operatorname{etimes}(y, \left(\text{if }(x \in \{\mathit{gx} \in a : (s(\mathit{gx}) = y)\})\text{ then }1\text{ else }0\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, j, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow (j(f) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mda} \in b.\; (j(\operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{mda})) = u(\mathit{mda})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad j(\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)) = \operatorname{eplus}(j(f), j(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (0 \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad j(\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, c, f)) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, j(f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad j(s) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, j, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mdf}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{mdf}) \Rightarrow (j(\mathit{mdf}) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mda} \in b.\; (j(\operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{mda})) = u(\mathit{mda})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mda} \in b. \\ \quad \quad (u(\mathit{mda}) = 0) \Rightarrow (j(\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{mda}))) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mdf}, g. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{mdf}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad j(\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, \mathit{mdf}, g)) = \operatorname{eplus}(j(\mathit{mdf}), j(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mdf}.; \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{mdf}) \wedge (0 \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad j(\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, c, \mathit{mdf})) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, j(\mathit{mdf})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mdf}, g. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{mdf}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, \mathit{mdf}, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad j(\mathit{mdf}) \leq j(g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mdcf} \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})). \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{mdcf}(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, \operatorname{mdcf}(n), \operatorname{mdcf}((n + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad j(\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, \mathit{mdcf})) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; j(\operatorname{mdcf}(n))), \mathbb{N})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad j(f) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) \end{array}}}
