\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}ms}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}intervals-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals} \subseteq \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow (u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = (b - a))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}lebesgue-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, p, q, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow (u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = (b - a))) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad p \leq q \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{ccint}(p, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}exhaust}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, s, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ccint}((0 - n), n) \in a) \wedge \\ \quad s \in a \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u((s \cap \operatorname{ccint}((0 - n), n))) \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow (u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = (b - a))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))))(s) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/lebesgue-translation-invariant.scm}{theorem-library/lebesgue-translation-invariant.scm}
\noindent{\small ==================================================================== theorem-library/lebesgue-translation-invariant.scm -- MEASURE-5-A, 2026-10-10. A translation-invariant Borel measure on the line with 0 $<$ mu([0, 1]) = k $<$ +inf is k times Lebesgue measure on the Borel sets.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{translate-\allowbreak{}ccint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) + c) = \operatorname{ccint}((a + c), (b + c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, (b - a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}points-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(x, x)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{null-\allowbreak{}points-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, c, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (u(\operatorname{ccint}(x, x)) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq c \wedge \\ \quad c \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = \operatorname{eplus}(u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, c)), u(\operatorname{ccint}(c, b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq s \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, (s + t))) = \operatorname{eplus}(u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, s)), u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translation-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, m)) = m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translation-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, t)) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translation-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, (j \cdot s))) = (j \cdot u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translation-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, t)) = t \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translation-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}ccint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = (b - a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translation-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}lebesgue}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))))(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lebesgue-\allowbreak{}translation-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, k, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = k \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{etimes}(k, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))))(s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/doubling-functions.scm}{theorem-library/doubling-functions.scm}
\noindent{\small doubling-functions.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/mf/mf-mi1.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{boundedly-\allowbreak{}equivalent-\allowbreak{}symmetric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}boundedly\text{-}equivalent}(i, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}boundedly\text{-}equivalent}(a, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{doubling-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}boundedly-\allowbreak{}equivalent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}boundedly\text{-}equivalent}(i, a) \wedge \\ \quad a(0) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, q \in \mathit{nnreal}.\; ((r \leq q) \Rightarrow (a(r) \leq a(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{doubling-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}boundedly-\allowbreak{}equivalent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}boundedly\text{-}equivalent}(i, a) \wedge \\ \quad i(0) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad a(0) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, q \in \mathit{nnreal}.\; ((r \leq q) \Rightarrow (i(r) \leq i(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, q \in \mathit{nnreal}.\; ((r \leq q) \Rightarrow (a(r) \leq a(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/method-ii.scm}{theorem-library/method-ii.scm}
\noindent{\small mh-method2.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf section 2.4: the method II construction. Prop 4.23: METHOD-II(m, C, p) is a metric outer measure.  Helper prefix mh2-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{diam-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, a.\; (\operatorname{diam}(m, a) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diam-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.\; (\operatorname{diam}(m, \emptyset) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diam-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a.; \forall x, y \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y) \leq \operatorname{diam}(m, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}premeasure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \{\mathit{mha} \in s : (\operatorname{diam}(m, \mathit{mha}) \leq l)\}, \operatorname{restrict}(a, \{\mathit{mha} \in s : (\operatorname{diam}(m, \mathit{mha}) \leq l)\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}outer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, l.; \forall b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, l)(b) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{cover\text{-}sums}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \{\mathit{mha} \in s : (\operatorname{diam}(m, \mathit{mha}) \leq l)\}, \operatorname{restrict}(a, \{\mathit{mha} \in s : (\operatorname{diam}(m, \mathit{mha}) \leq l)\}), b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}antitone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \leq c) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, c)(d) \leq \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, b)(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a.; \forall b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, s, a)(b) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists d \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge (v = \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, d)(b)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, b, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, l)(b) \leq \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, s, a)(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, c, b. \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \wedge \\ \quad \forall l.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, l)(c) \leq b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, s, a)(c) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, s, a.; \forall b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)).\; (\operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, s, a)(b) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{union-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{power}(x)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{power}(x))) \Rightarrow ((a \cup b) \in \operatorname{power}(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, l, r, b, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq l \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad l < r \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b, y \in c.\; (r \leq \operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, l)(b), \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, l)(c)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, l)((b \cup c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, s, a)(b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, a, \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))(b)), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, s, a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb4-sieve.scm}{theorem-library/mb4-sieve.scm}
\noindent{\small mb4-sieve.scm -- construction of measures, Proposition 5.6 (M-B4, 2026-10-26): in a complete metric space a decreasing sequence of closed nonempty sets whose diameters tend to 0 meets in exactly one point (the notes' proof of 5.6: for each infinite sequence z the sets S\_\{z|n\} of a sieve are such a sequence, so S\_z is a ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{diam-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{diam}(s, a) \simeq \operatorname{esup}(\{r \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists x, y \in a.\; (r = \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nested-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}intersection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists x.\; (x \in a(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a((n + 1)) \subseteq a(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mcbn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mcbn} \leq n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{diam}(s, a(n)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \in a(n)) \wedge \forall q \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q \in a(n)) \Rightarrow (q = p))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rr-lt-pos-inf.scm}{theorem-library/rr-lt-pos-inf.scm}
\noindent{\small rr-lt-pos-inf.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-30 (wave-2 integration) out of theorem-library/lp-inequalities.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by ch4a-coef (complex-analysis); an extended-real order fact. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (x < \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/signed-measure-laws.scm}{theorem-library/signed-measure-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small signed-measure-laws.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/mf/mf-fa.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-pv.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-pv2.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-neg.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-fin.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-fin2.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-fin3.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(x, y) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}stable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, x.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq k) \Rightarrow (x(k) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, (m + d)) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}eventually}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq k) \Rightarrow (x(k) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (a \leq n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, n) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, l.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(x, l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq k) \Rightarrow (x(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad l = \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pad2-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, \alpha, b. \\ \quad ((\emptyset \in a) \wedge ((\alpha \in a) \wedge ((b \in a) \wedge ((\alpha \cap b) = \emptyset)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((g(i) \cap g(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g(0) = \alpha \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g(1) = b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((2 \leq k) \Rightarrow (g(k) = \emptyset)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n)) = (\alpha \cup b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((g(i) \cap g(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((2 \leq k) \Rightarrow (g(k) = \emptyset)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n))) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(u(g(0)), u(g(1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}fa}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \alpha, \beta. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((\alpha \in b) \wedge ((\beta \in b) \wedge ((\alpha \cap \beta) = \emptyset)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u((\alpha \cup \beta)) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(u(\alpha), u(\beta)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, u.; \forall a \in b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a) \simeq \operatorname{esup}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists e \in b.\; ((e \subseteq a) \wedge (u(e) = v))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, u, a. \\ \quad \{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists e \in b.\; ((e \subseteq a) \wedge (u(e) = v))\} \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b, u.; \forall a \in b.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u) \in (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, u, a, e. \\ \quad ((u \in (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}star})) \wedge ((a \in b) \wedge ((e \in b) \wedge (e \subseteq a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(e) \leq \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, u, a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in c) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \forall e \in c.\; ((e \subseteq a) \Rightarrow (u(e) \leq b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\emptyset) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, u, a, b. \\ \quad ((u \in (c \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}star})) \wedge ((a \in c) \wedge ((b \in c) \wedge (a \subseteq b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a) \leq \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, u, a. \\ \quad ((u \in (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}star})) \wedge (a \in b)) \Rightarrow (u(a) \leq \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjoint-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}subsets}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, e, f. \\ \quad (((a \cap b) = \emptyset) \wedge ((e \subseteq a) \wedge (f \subseteq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (e \cap f) = \emptyset \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{union-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, e, f. \\ \quad ((e \subseteq a) \wedge (f \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow ((e \cup f) \subseteq (a \cup b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}superadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, u, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(c, d, u) \wedge ((a \in d) \wedge ((b \in d) \wedge ((a \cap b) = \emptyset)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(d, u)(a), \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(d, u)(b)) \leq \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(d, u)((a \cup b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}).\; (\operatorname{esum}(f) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inter-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; ((a \cap b) \subseteq b)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inter-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; ((a \cap b) \subseteq a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}eplus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((a \leq c) \wedge (b \leq d)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(a, b) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, y. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((y \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \leq y(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, n) \leq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, y, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{intersect-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, e, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad e \in b \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((f(i) \cap f(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((h(i) \cap h(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) \subseteq f(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, h(n)) = e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}esum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((f(i) \cap f(j)) = \emptyset) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(f(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, n, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((f(i) \cap f(j)) = \emptyset) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(n), f(\mathit{uj})) \cap f(n)) = \emptyset \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(n), f(j)) \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(a, \mathbb{N}, f(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}prefix-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((f(i) \cap f(j)) = \emptyset) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda c \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(f(c))), \mathrm{OS}(n)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(n), f(\mathit{uj}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}countably-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((f(i) \cap f(j)) = \emptyset) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(f(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}.\; (\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(x) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(0) = 0}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}.\; ((\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(x) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \Rightarrow (x = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}.\; ((\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(x) = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf}) \Rightarrow (x = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}back}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}.\; ((\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}up}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge (\neg (a = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \wedge \neg (b = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(\operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(a, b)) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(a), \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}down}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge (\neg (a = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf}) \wedge \neg (b = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(\operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(a, b)) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(a), \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}flip}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < -b))) \Rightarrow (b < \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}flip}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (-b < a))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(a) < b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (x(k) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, n) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (x(k) = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, n) = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}negate-\allowbreak{}up}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, y. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (y(k) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(x(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (x(k) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(y, n) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(\operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}negate-\allowbreak{}down}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, y. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (y(k) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(x(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (x(k) = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(y, n) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(\operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}negate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(x, l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(y, n) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(\operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(y, \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b, u.; \forall a \in b.\; (\operatorname{signed\text{-}neg}(b, u)(a) \simeq \operatorname{ext\text{-}neg}(u(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (u \in (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{signed\text{-}neg}(b, u) \in (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}signed-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, \operatorname{signed\text{-}neg}(b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neg-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}above-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x \leq n)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge (0 \leq a))) \Rightarrow (b \leq \operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(b, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge (0 \leq a))) \Rightarrow (b \leq \operatorname{ext\text{-}add}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, x.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq x(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, m) \leq \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(x, (m + d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}unbounded-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, l. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(k) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq x(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b \leq x(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(x, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad l = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inter-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \cap b) = \emptyset) \Rightarrow ((b \cap a) = \emptyset) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, c. \\ \quad ((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}star}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \leq x) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})))) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}unbounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((g(i) \cap g(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq u(g(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cb} \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\mathit{cb} \leq u(g(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n))) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge ((q \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q((k + 1)) \subseteq q(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow ((c(i) \cap c(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(k) = \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(q(k), q((k + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}telescope}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, u, q, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; \neg (u(\alpha) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q((k + 1)) \subseteq q(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (k \leq u(q(k))) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(k) = \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(q(k), q((k + 1)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{smn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(c(\mathit{smn}))), n) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{smn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(c(\mathit{smn}))), n) = (u(q(0)) - u(q(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}decreasing-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; \neg (u(\alpha) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q((k + 1)) \subseteq q(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (k \leq u(q(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(q(0)) = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (\neg (x = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \{\mathit{su} \in b : (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, c)(\mathit{su}) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \{\mathit{su} \in b : (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, c)(\mathit{su}) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (y \subseteq u) \wedge (((k + 1) \leq c(y)) \vee ((k + 1) \leq c(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, y)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((c \in b) \wedge (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(c) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(0) = c \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(f(k)) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f((k + 1)) \subseteq f(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((k + 1) \leq u(f((k + 1)))) \vee ((k + 1) \leq u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(f(k), f((k + 1))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall c \in b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \forall \alpha \in b.\; \neg (u(\alpha) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(c) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/lp-inequalities.scm}{theorem-library/lp-inequalities.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/lp-inequalities.scm -- POWERS IN [0,+inf], HOELDER AND MINKOWSKI, FUNCTIONS EQUAL ALMOST EVERYWHERE.  MEASURE-4-B, 2026-10-10.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, p.\; ({t}^{p} \simeq \left(\text{if }(t = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\text{ then }\operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}\text{ else }{t}^{p}\right))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ep-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f. \\ \quad (I_{p}({f}) \simeq {\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}epow}(a, f, p))}^{\operatorname{recip}(p)}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; ({\operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}}^{p} = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \mathbb{R}, p.\; ({t}^{p} \simeq {t}^{p})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < p) \Rightarrow ({0}^{p} = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ({1}^{p} = 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < t) \Rightarrow (({t}^{p} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < {t}^{p})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge (0 < p)) \Rightarrow (({t}^{p} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq {t}^{p})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < p) \Rightarrow ({t}^{p} \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < p) \wedge (s < t)) \Rightarrow ({s}^{p} < {t}^{p}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < p) \wedge (s \leq t)) \Rightarrow ({s}^{p} \leq {t}^{p}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}epow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < a) \wedge (0 < b)) \Rightarrow ({{t}^{a}}^{b} = {t}^{(a \cdot b)}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; ({t}^{1} = t)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < p) \Rightarrow (({{t}^{p}}^{\operatorname{recip}(p)} = t) \wedge ({{t}^{\operatorname{recip}(p)}}^{p} = t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < p) \wedge ({t}^{p} = 0)) \Rightarrow (t = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < p) \wedge ({t}^{p} = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})) \Rightarrow (t = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}etimes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, u \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < c) \wedge (0 < p)) \Rightarrow ({\operatorname{etimes}(c, u)}^{p} = \operatorname{etimes}({c}^{p}, {u}^{p})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}epow-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), p \in \mathbb{R}, x \in a. \\ \quad (0 < p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}epow}(a, f, p)(x) = {f(x)}^{p}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}epow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}epow}(a, f, p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}eplus-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, g.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad ((f(x) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (g(x) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)(x) = \operatorname{eplus}(f(x), g(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, g.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad ((f(x) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (g(x) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, f, g)(x) = \operatorname{etimes}(f(x), g(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, f.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad ((c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (f(x) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, c, f)(x) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{young-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d \in \mathbb{R}, u, v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < c) \wedge ((0 < d) \wedge ((1 < p) \wedge ((1 < q) \wedge ((/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}((c \cdot d), \operatorname{etimes}(u, v)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{etimes}((\operatorname{recip}(p) \cdot {c}^{p}), {u}^{p}), \operatorname{etimes}((\operatorname{recip}(q) \cdot {d}^{q}), {v}^{q})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{young-\allowbreak{}extended}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 < p) \wedge ((1 < q) \wedge ((/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(a, b) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{recip}(p), {a}^{p}), \operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{recip}(q), {b}^{q})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{R}, m \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (((0 < c) \wedge (\operatorname{etimes}(c, m) = 0)) \Rightarrow (m = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}markov}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, h, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(c, u(\{x \in a : (c \leq h(x))\})) \leq \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, h) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\{x \in a : (0 < h(x))\}) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ep-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad I_{p}({f}) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\{x \in a : (0 < f(x))\} \in b) \wedge (u(\{x \in a : (0 < f(x))\}) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}ae-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in b \wedge \\ \quad u(c) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in c) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = g(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}ae-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) < \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\{x \in a : (f(x) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\} \in b) \wedge (u(\{x \in a : (f(x) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\}) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hoelder}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g.; \forall p, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < p \wedge \\ \quad 1 < q \wedge \\ \quad (/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, f, g)) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(I_{p}({f}), I_{q}({g})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conjugate-\allowbreak{}exponent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (1 < p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (p \cdot \operatorname{recip}((p - 1))) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 1 < (p \cdot \operatorname{recip}((p - 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (/(1, p) + /(1, (p \cdot \operatorname{recip}((p - 1))))) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad ((p - 1) \cdot (p \cdot \operatorname{recip}((p - 1)))) = p \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ep-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad I_{1}({h}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (1 < p) \Rightarrow ({t}^{p} = \operatorname{etimes}({t}^{(p - 1)}, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{eplus}(x, y)) = \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{etimes}(c, x), \operatorname{etimes}(c, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}eplus-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {\operatorname{eplus}(u, v)}^{p} \leq \operatorname{etimes}({2}^{p}, \operatorname{eplus}({u}^{p}, {v}^{p})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{minkowski}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g.; \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge (1 \leq p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad I_{p}({\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)}) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(I_{p}({f}), I_{p}({g})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/lp-seminorm.scm}{theorem-library/lp-seminorm.scm}
\noindent{\small lp-seminorm.scm -- THE L\textasciicircum{}p SEMINORM: the seminorm laws (MEASURE-4-C, 2026-10-10).  Vocabulary: structure-library/lp-seminorm.scm (LP-NORM = EP-NORM of ABS-FN).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f. \\ \quad (\|{f}\|_{p} \simeq I_{p}({\operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f)})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) + g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) - g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ep-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (c(x) \leq d(x)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad I_{p}({c}) \leq I_{p}({d}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ep-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, k, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq k) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad I_{p}({\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, k, h)}) = \operatorname{etimes}(k, I_{p}({h})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (c \cdot f(x)))}\|_{p} = \operatorname{etimes}(\lvert c \rvert, \|{f}\|_{p}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) + g(x)))}\|_{p} \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{eplus}(\|{f}\|_{p}, \|{g}\|_{p}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (f(\mathit{sx}) - g(\mathit{sx})))}\|_{p} = 0 \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in s) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \end{array}}}

The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. etimes-real-in}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq x) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq y)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{etimes}(x, y) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{etimes}(x, y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/lp-convergence.scm}{theorem-library/lp-convergence.scm}
\noindent{\small lp-convergence.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/md/md-lp.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (\forall r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (x \leq r)) \Rightarrow (x = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{econverges-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}eventually-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq a(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b \leq k) \Rightarrow (a(k) \leq r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}(a, 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}econverges-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q. \\ \quad ((a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq a(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}(a, 0) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < q))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; {a(k)}^{q}), 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, u, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(c, d, u) \wedge ((a \in d) \wedge ((b \in d) \wedge ((u(a) = 0) \wedge (u(b) = 0))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((a \cup b) \in d) \wedge (u((a \cup b)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}hypotheses-\allowbreak{}common-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists c. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, c) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in c) \Rightarrow (\lvert s(k)(x) \rvert \leq g(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in c) \Rightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(x)), f(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mda} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad u(\mathit{mda}) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in \mathit{mda}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lvert s(k)(x) \rvert \leq g(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(x)), f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \leq y))) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, p. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((\lvert a \rvert \leq c) \wedge ((\lvert b \rvert \leq c) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {\lvert (a - b) \rvert}^{p} \leq \operatorname{etimes}({2}^{p}, {\lvert c \rvert}^{p}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{econverges-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}epow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, l, p. \\ \quad ((u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, u, l) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\lvert (u(k) - l) \rvert}^{p}), 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}epow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, h. \\ \quad (\|{h}\|_{p} \simeq {\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}epow}(a, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, h), p))}^{\operatorname{recip}(p)}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\|{h}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R}) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}epow}(a, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, h), p)) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}dominated-\allowbreak{}convergence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, s, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, s(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \|{g}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists c. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, c) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in c) \Rightarrow (\lvert s(k)(x) \rvert \leq g(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in c) \Rightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(x)), f(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{f}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \|{(\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (s(k)(\mathit{sx}) - f(\mathit{sx})))}\|_{p}), 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-fekete.scm}{theorem-library/ba-fekete.scm}

\vnbentry{\texttt{baf-\allowbreak{}el-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{(m + n)} = \cdot_{a}({x}^{m}, {x}^{n}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}submult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({x}^{(m + n)}) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({x}^{m}) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({x}^{n})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spectral-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({x}^{(n + 1)})}^{{(n + 1)}^{\ast\!-1}}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \rho({x})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/product-measure.scm}{theorem-library/product-measure.scm}
\noindent{\small ==================================================================== theorem-library/product-measure.scm -- PRODUCT SIGMA-ALGEBRAS, SECTIONS, DYNKIN'S PI-LAMBDA THEOREM, and FUBINI'S THEOREM for non-negative functions. Agent FUBINI-1, 2026-10-10 (scratchpad/triage/FUBINI-1.md).  Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{power-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c, a.; \forall b \in \operatorname{power}(c).\; (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(b, a) \in \operatorname{power}(c))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dynkin-\allowbreak{}generated-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{dynkin\text{-}generated}(a, e) \simeq \{\mathit{dga} \in \operatorname{power}(a) : \forall b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{power}(a)).\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, b) \wedge (e \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{dga} \in b))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dynkin-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, d) \Rightarrow (d \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{power}(a))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dynkin-\allowbreak{}generated-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, e, \alpha. \\ \quad \alpha \in \operatorname{dynkin\text{-}generated}(a, e) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((\alpha \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge \forall b.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, b) \wedge (e \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow (\alpha \in b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dynkin-\allowbreak{}generated-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}dynkin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, e. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, \operatorname{dynkin\text{-}generated}(a, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dynkin-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}section}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, d) \wedge (s \in d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, \{e \in \operatorname{power}(a) : ((s \cap e) \in d)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dynkin-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pi\text{-}system}(d)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dynkin-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}lambda}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}pi\text{-}system}(p) \wedge (p \subseteq d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(a, p) \subseteq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pair-\allowbreak{}cartesian-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, u, v.\; (([u, v] \in (a \times b)) \Leftrightarrow ((u \in a) \wedge (v \in b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, a, x.\; (\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, a, x) \simeq \{y \in s : ([x, y] \in a)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, a, y.\; (\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, a, y) \simeq \{x \in s : ([x, y] \in a)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, a, x, z.\; ((z \in \operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, a, x)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in s) \wedge ([x, z] \in a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, a, y, z.\; ((z \in \operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, a, y)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in s) \wedge ([z, y] \in a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \simeq \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}((s \times b), \operatorname{rectangles}(s, a, b, c))) \end{array}}}
