\vnbentry{\texttt{rectangles-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rectangles}(s, a, b, c) \simeq \{r \in \operatorname{power}((s \times b)) : \exists \mathit{rca} \in a, \mathit{rcb} \in c.\; (r = (\mathit{rca} \times \mathit{rcb}))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rectangles-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, r. \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{rectangles}(s, a, b, c) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((r \in \operatorname{power}((s \times b))) \wedge \exists \mathit{rca} \in a, \mathit{rcb} \in c.\; (r = (\mathit{rca} \times \mathit{rcb}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cartesian-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c. \\ \quad ((b \in \operatorname{power}(s)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (b \times c) \in \operatorname{power}((s \times a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cartesian-\allowbreak{}intersection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((a \times b) \cap (c \times d)) = ((a \cap c) \times (b \cap d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rectangle-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rectangles}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge ((d \in a) \wedge (f \in c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (d \times f) \in \operatorname{rectangles}(s, a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rectangles-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}system}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pi\text{-}system}(\operatorname{rectangles}(s, a, b, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rectangle-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}sigma}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge ((d \in a) \wedge (f \in c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (d \times f) \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, d, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \wedge (x \in s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section}(b, d, x) \in c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, d, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \wedge (y \in b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, d, y) \in a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fn-\allowbreak{}x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, f, x.; \forall z \in s.\; (\operatorname{fn\text{-}x\text{-}section}(s, f, x)(z) \simeq f([x, z]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fn-\allowbreak{}y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, f, y.; \forall z \in s.\; (\operatorname{fn\text{-}y\text{-}section}(s, f, y)(z) \simeq f([z, y]))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fn-\allowbreak{}x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, f, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \wedge \\ \quad x \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{fn\text{-}x\text{-}section}(b, f, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fn-\allowbreak{}y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, f, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \wedge \\ \quad y \in b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{fn\text{-}y\text{-}section}(s, f, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, x. \\ \quad ((b \subseteq s) \wedge (x \in a)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, (a \times b), x) = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, x. \\ \quad \neg (x \in a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, (a \times b), x) = \emptyset) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, y. \\ \quad ((a \subseteq s) \wedge (y \in b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, (a \times b), y) = a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, y. \\ \quad \neg (y \in b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, (a \times b), y) = \emptyset) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}congruence-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge ((g \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = g(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) \simeq \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}congruence-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge ((g \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = g(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b.; \forall x \in s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b)(x) \simeq u(\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(a, b, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b.; \forall y \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b)(y) \simeq u(\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, b, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, f) \in (s \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f) \in (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}rectangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge ((g \in c) \wedge (d(g) \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, (f \times g))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, (f \times g))) = \operatorname{etimes}(d(g), u(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}rectangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge ((g \in c) \wedge (u(f) \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, (f \times g))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, (f \times g))) = \operatorname{etimes}(u(f), d(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}rectangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge ((g \in c) \wedge ((u(f) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (d(g) \in \mathbb{R})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, (f \times g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, x. \\ \quad (a \subseteq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, a, x) \subseteq \operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, b, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, y. \\ \quad (a \subseteq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, a, y) \subseteq \operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, b, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(b, a), x) = \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, b, x), \operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, a, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(b, a), y) = \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, b, y), \operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, a, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \subseteq g \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (d(\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(b, g, z)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, g)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(g, f))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, f)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(g, f))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, g)) - \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \subseteq g \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in b.\; (u(\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, g, z)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, g)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(g, f))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(g, f))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, g)) - \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \subseteq g \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (d(\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(b, g, z)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in b.\; (u(\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, g, z)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, g)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(g, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, f(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(g, \mathbb{N}, f(g)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(g, \mathbb{N}, f(g)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, f(n)))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(g, \mathbb{N}, f(g)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(g, \mathbb{N}, f(g)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f(n)))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, f(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(g, \mathbb{N}, f(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cut}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, (a \cap (b \times c)), x) \subseteq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cut}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, (a \cap (b \times c)), y) \subseteq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}cut}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, h, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in a \wedge \\ \quad g \in c \wedge \\ \quad u(f) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d(g) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad h \in a \wedge \\ \quad k \in c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, ((h \times k) \cap (f \times g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}cut-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in a \wedge \\ \quad g \in c \wedge \\ \quad u(f) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d(g) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, (h \cap (f \times g))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in s.\; (d(\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(b, (h \cap (f \times g)), z)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in b.\; (u(\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(s, (h \cap (f \times g)), z)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, (h \cap (f \times g)))) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}rectangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in a \wedge \\ \quad g \in c \wedge \\ \quad u(f) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d(g) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, (h \cap (f \times g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, u, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(c, d, u) \wedge ((a \in d) \wedge ((b \in d) \wedge ((u(a) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u(b) \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u((a \cup b)) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(f(n)) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), f(j))) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}increasing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(g(n)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(n) \subseteq g((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \mathbb{N}, g(k)) = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cartesian-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((a \subseteq c) \wedge (b \subseteq d)) \Rightarrow ((a \times b) \subseteq (c \times d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}sets}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}finsum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, d, s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq d \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in s.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, m(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda v \in d.\; m(v)(x)), s))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda v \in d.\; m(v)(x)), s))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda v \in d.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, m(v))), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}simple-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, u, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(c, d, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}((a \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(a, b, c, d), s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(c, d, u, \operatorname{fn\text{-}x\text{-}section}(c, s, x)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda v \in \operatorname{image}(s, (a \times c)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(v, u(\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(c, \{\mathit{fx} \in (a \times c) : (s(\mathit{fx}) = v)\}, x)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(s, (a \times c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}simple-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, s, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}((a \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(a, b, c, d), s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{fn\text{-}y\text{-}section}(a, s, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda v \in \operatorname{image}(s, (a \times c)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(v, u(\operatorname{y\text{-}section}(a, \{x \in (a \times c) : (s(x) = v)\}, y)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(s, (a \times c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, u, f.; \forall x \in s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, b, u, f)(x) \simeq \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{fn\text{-}x\text{-}section}(a, f, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, f.; \forall y \in b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)(y) \simeq \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{fn\text{-}y\text{-}section}(s, f, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, u, f) \in (s \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f) \in (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, f, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}((a \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(a, b, c, d), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(a, c, d, f, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(a, b, u, c, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(a, c, d, f, s)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(c, d, f, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(a, b, u, c, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}sup-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)(x) \simeq \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(n)(x)), \mathbb{N}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to ((s \times b) \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), g(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}((s \times b), g(n), g((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in (s \times b).\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}((s \times b), g)(w) = f(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, g(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, g(n)))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{y-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to ((s \times b) \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), g(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}((s \times b), g(n), g((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in (s \times b).\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}((s \times b), g)(w) = f(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, g(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, g(n)))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fubini}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}esup-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad \operatorname{esum}(f) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, f, \mathrm{OS}(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}esum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g(v)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (h(x) = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda v \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(v)(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, h) = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda v \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d.; \forall f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c). \\ \quad (\operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)(f) \simeq \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, d, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{x-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, x.\; (\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(s, \emptyset, x) = \emptyset)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}symmetric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)(f) = \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/l2c-b.scm}{theorem-library/l2c-b.scm}
\noindent{\small l2c-b.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-L2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/l2/l2c-b.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow (f \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{xsi-\allowbreak{}indicator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \wedge (x \in s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, \operatorname{indicator}((s \times b), f))(x) = d(\operatorname{x\text{-}section}(b, f, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{xsi-\allowbreak{}eplus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), g) \wedge \\ \quad x \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}((s \times b), f, g))(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)(x), \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, g)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{xsi-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, d, g, f, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, d, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, d), f) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad x \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, d, g, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}((s \times b), c, f))(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, d, g, f)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, f, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}((a \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(a, b, c, d), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}((a \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(a, b, c, d), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(a, b, u, c, d, f), s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(a, c, d, f, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tonelli-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d), f) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tonelli-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}y}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d), f) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/esup-product.scm}{theorem-library/esup-product.scm}
\noindent{\small ==================================================================== theorem-library/esup-product.scm -- THE ESUP PRODUCT LAW in [0, +inf], THE INTEGRAL OF c f FOR c = +inf, and THE PRODUCT MEASURE OF A RECTANGLE WITH ARBITRARY (possibly infinite) SIDES.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rps-\allowbreak{}monotone-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \leq f((k + 1))) \wedge (m \leq n)) \Rightarrow (f(m) \leq f(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, w \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad (s \leq t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(s, w) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(t, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, s, t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad ((p \leq q) \wedge (s \leq t)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(p, s) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(q, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, m \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad \operatorname{etimes}(w, \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(m, \mathbb{N}))) \leq \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{etimes}(w, m(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(n) \leq u((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (v(n) \leq v((n + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda a \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{etimes}(u(a), v(a))), \mathbb{N})) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(u, \mathbb{N})), \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(v, \mathbb{N}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(k) = k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(g, \mathbb{N})) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}nn-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) = \operatorname{etimes}(k, t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(h, \mathbb{N})) = \operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}homogeneous-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(a, c, f)) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}rectangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge (g \in c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)((f \times g)) = \operatorname{etimes}(u(f), d(g)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/l2c-c.scm}{theorem-library/l2c-c.scm}
\noindent{\small l2c-c.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-L2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/l2/l2c-c.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f.; \forall \alpha \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow (\{x \in a : (\alpha < f(x))\} \in b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}first}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b, c, d, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(c, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, b, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, b, c, d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in (s \times c).\; a(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}pullback-\allowbreak{}second}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, c, d, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(c, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(c, d, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, c, d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in (s \times c).\; b(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}tensor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, d, f, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, c, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(d, f, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times d), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, c, d, f), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in (s \times d).\; \operatorname{etimes}(a(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)), b(\operatorname{nth}(2, w))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{xsi-\allowbreak{}tensor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, d, f, u, a, b, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, c, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(d, f, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(d, f, u) \wedge \\ \quad x \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, d, f, u, (\lambda w \in (s \times d).\; \operatorname{etimes}(a(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)), b(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)))))(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{etimes}(a(x), \operatorname{integral}(d, f, u, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tonelli-\allowbreak{}tensor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, u, d, f, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(d, f, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(d, f, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, c, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(d, f, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}((s \times d), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, c, d, f), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, c, u, d, f, g), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in (s \times d).\; \operatorname{etimes}(a(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)), b(\operatorname{nth}(2, w))))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{integral}(s, c, u, a), \operatorname{integral}(d, f, g, b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/hausdorff-measure.scm}{theorem-library/hausdorff-measure.scm}
\noindent{\small mh-hausdorff.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf ch. 4 section 4: Hausdorff measures. Props 4.32, 4.38 (comparison for comparable metrics), 4.53 (Hausdorff dimension), 4.54 (local dimension), 4.55 (restriction to a subspace).  Needs mh-vocab and mh-method2.  Helper prefix mhh-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{einf-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, k, b. \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in s.\; (b \leq \operatorname{etimes}(k, v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b \leq \operatorname{etimes}(k, \operatorname{einf}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}compare}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, p, d, c, k, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pts}(b) = \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(b), \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(b)), d) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)).\; (\operatorname{diam}(m, a) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{diam}(b, a))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)).\; (p(a) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(k, d(a))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), p)(s) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(k, \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(b, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(b)), d)(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diam-\allowbreak{}compare}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, c, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pts}(b) = \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(m).\; (\operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{dist}(b)(x, y))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{diam}(m, a) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{diam}(b, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}pm-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b.; \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}pm}(m, b)(a) \simeq {\operatorname{diam}(m, a)}^{b}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}pm-\allowbreak{}premeasure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}pm}(m, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, \operatorname{hausdorff}(m, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}compare}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, c, b, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pts}(a) = \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(m).\; (\operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{dist}(a)(x, y))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < b \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hausdorff}(m, b)(s) \leq \operatorname{etimes}({c}^{b}, \operatorname{hausdorff}(a, b)(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{phi-\allowbreak{}pm-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(m, i)(a) \simeq \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{diam}(m, a) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\text{ then }\operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}\text{ else }i(\operatorname{diam}(m, a))\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{phi-\allowbreak{}pm-\allowbreak{}premeasure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(m, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{doubling-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, i, l.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad i \in (\mathit{nnreal} \to \mathit{nnreal}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mhr} \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < \mathit{mhr}) \Rightarrow (i((2 \cdot \mathit{mhr})) \leq (l \cdot i(\mathit{mhr})))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i((\operatorname{power}(2, n) \cdot r)) \leq (\operatorname{power}(l, n) \cdot i(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{doubling-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i.; \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \wedge (0 < c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k) \wedge \forall r \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq r) \Rightarrow (i((c \cdot r)) \leq (k \cdot i(r)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}compare}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, c, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pts}(a) = \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(m).\; (\operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{dist}(a)(x, y))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}phi}(m, i)(s) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(k, \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}phi}(a, i)(s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/hausdorff-dimension.scm}{theorem-library/hausdorff-dimension.scm}
\noindent{\small mh-dim.scm -- Hausdorff dimension (construction-of-measures.pdf, 4.3): Prop 4.53 and its corollary (uniqueness of the dimension), Prop 4.54.  Prefix mhd-.  Library: measure. Loads after mh-vocab.scm, mh-method2.scm, mh-hausdorff.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{mhd-\allowbreak{}rpow-\allowbreak{}key}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, l, o, m. \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < t) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \leq l) \wedge ((o \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (o < m))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ({l}^{(o - m)} \cdot {t}^{m}) \leq {t}^{o} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mhd-\allowbreak{}epow-\allowbreak{}key}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, l, o, m. \\ \quad ((t \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < l) \wedge ((t \leq l) \wedge ((o \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < o) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (o < m)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}({l}^{(o - m)}, {t}^{m}) \leq {t}^{o} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, b, d, k, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(\operatorname{pts}(m), s, b) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in s.\; ((\operatorname{diam}(m, a) \leq d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{etimes}(k, b(a)) \leq p(a))) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(k, \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, b, d)(c)) \leq \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, s, p, d)(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{hausdorff}(m, a) \simeq \operatorname{method\text{-}ii}(m, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}pm}(m, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, d, o, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge ((o \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < o) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((o < a) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}({d}^{(o - a)}, \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}pm}(m, a), d)(s)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}pm}(m, o), d)(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mhd-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, a. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < p) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < q) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < a)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge ((d \leq a) \wedge ({d}^{p} \leq q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < a) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{hausdorff}(m, a)(s)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}pm}(m, a), d)(s) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}infinite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, o, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad o \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < a \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{hausdorff}(m, a)(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hausdorff}(m, o)(s) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}dim-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff\text{-}dim}(m, s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff\text{-}dim}(m, s, b)) \Rightarrow \neg (a < b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}dim-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff\text{-}dim}(m, s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff\text{-}dim}(m, s, b)) \Rightarrow (a = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}dim-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \exists \mathit{mhx}.\; (\mathit{mhx} \in \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff\text{-}dim}(m, \operatorname{ball}(m, x, r), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff\text{-}dim}(m, \operatorname{pts}(m), a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/hausdorff-restrict.scm}{theorem-library/hausdorff-restrict.scm}
\noindent{\small mh-restrict.scm -- restriction of Hausdorff measure to a subspace (construction-of-measures.pdf, 4.4, Prop 4.55).  Prefix mhr-.  Library: measure. Loads after mh-vocab.scm, mh-method2.scm, mh-hausdorff.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{diam-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(m)(x, y) \leq \operatorname{dist}(b)(x, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{diam}(m, a) \leq \operatorname{diam}(b, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diam-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \subseteq b) \wedge (b \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{diam}(m, a) \leq \operatorname{diam}(m, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}diam}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge (a \subseteq s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{diam}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s), a) = \operatorname{diam}(m, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{phi-\allowbreak{}pm-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, i, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \wedge ((a \subseteq b) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(m, i)(a) \leq \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(m, i)(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{phi-\allowbreak{}pm-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge (a \subseteq s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s), i)(a) \simeq \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(m, i)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}subspace-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, i, d, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \wedge ((s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq d) \wedge (a \subseteq s)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(m, i), d)(a) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s), \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s))), \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s), i), d)(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{method-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}delta-\allowbreak{}subspace-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, i, d, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \wedge ((s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq d) \wedge (a \subseteq s)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s), \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s))), \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s), i), d)(a) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{method\text{-}ii\text{-}delta}(m, \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)), \operatorname{phi\text{-}pm}(m, i), d)(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hausdorff-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}doubling}(i) \wedge ((s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge (a \subseteq s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}phi}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(m, s), i)(a) = \operatorname{hausdorff\text{-}phi}(m, i)(a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/sip-vocab.scm}{structure-library/sip-vocab.scm}
\noindent{\small sip-vocab.scm -- SEMI-INNER-PRODUCT SPACES (SIP-1, 2026-10-18).  Vocabulary only.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}semi-\allowbreak{}inner-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/sip-a.scm}{theorem-library/sip-a.scm}
\noindent{\small sip-a.scm -- SEMI-INNER-PRODUCT SPACES: the laws, Cauchy-Schwarz for a semidefinite form, the null vectors, the setoid, and the quotient pre-Hilbert space. (SIP-1, 2026-10-18; STOP POINT A of scratchpad/triage/SIP-1.md.)  All PROVEN modulo 0.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}pin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(v) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(v)) = \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(v) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v} \in ((\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) = \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), z) = (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, z) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x), y) = (a \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(y, z)) = (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{act}(v)(a, y)) = (a \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vzero}(v), y) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{vzero}(v)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x), y) = -\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)) = -\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}expand-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v), a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(b, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(b, y))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((a \cdot a) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)) + ((2 \cdot (a \cdot b)) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y))) + ((b \cdot b) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}schwarz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \leq (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}orth}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) = 0)) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) = 0) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(a, x)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{sip\text{-}null}(v) \simeq \{n \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(n, n) = 0)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) = 0)) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{sip\text{-}null}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sip\text{-}null}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}subspace}(v, \operatorname{sip\text{-}null}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sip\text{-}rel}(v) \simeq \{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, p))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, p)))) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [a, b] \in \operatorname{sip\text{-}rel}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ([a, b] \in \operatorname{sip\text{-}rel}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b))) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}equivalence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}equivalence}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}rel}(v), \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}setoid}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}rel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{rel}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{sip\text{-}rel}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}related-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{related}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b))) = 0 \end{array}}}
