\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}related-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{related}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), b) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b))) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{sip\text{-}qvadd}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{sip\text{-}qvneg}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{sip\text{-}qact}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}rip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)} \simeq \operatorname{sip\text{-}qrip}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lva-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_}))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lvn-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lrp-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)).\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v))) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lsc-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{act}(v)(r, a))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}respects-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, u, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(u)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(u))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) = \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(u, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lva-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects2}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lvn-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lsc-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), (\lambda a \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{act}(v)(r, a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}lrp-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects2}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), (\lambda [\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)).\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{sqa\_}, \operatorname{sqb\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, a \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sip\text{-}qscale}(v, r)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{act}(v)(r, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), b)) = \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sip\text{-}qscale}(v, r) \in (\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, a \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(r, \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{act}(v)(r, a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(r, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)))(r, s), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(s, x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(x, y) = \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(y, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(x, y), z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(x, z) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(y, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))(a, x), y) = (a \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(x, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)}(x, x) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}hilbert}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{phs-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) = 0)) \Rightarrow (x = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}inverses-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}inverses}(\operatorname{vadd}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(v), \operatorname{vneg}(v), \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sipq-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v) \simeq [\operatorname{scal}(v), \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)), \operatorname{sip\text{-}qvadd}(v), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(v)), \operatorname{sip\text{-}qvneg}(v), \operatorname{sip\text{-}qact}(v), \operatorname{sip\text{-}qrip}(v)]) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small sip-b.scm -- THE COMPLEX STRUCTURE BY J (SIP-1, 2026-10-18; STOP POINT B of scratchpad/triage/SIP-1.md).  All PROVEN modulo 0.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}isometric-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}antisym-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall o \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}antisymmetric\text{-}op}(v, o) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}square\text{-}minus\text{-}id}(v, o))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}isometric\text{-}op}(v, o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}antisym-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}isometric-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall o \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}isometric\text{-}op}(v, o) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}square\text{-}minus\text{-}id}(v, o))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antisymmetric\text{-}op}(v, o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{phs-\allowbreak{}square-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}antisym-\allowbreak{}isometric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall o \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}antisymmetric\text{-}op}(v, o) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}isometric\text{-}op}(v, o))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}square\text{-}minus\text{-}id}(v, o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (J_{v} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(v, J_{v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}square}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}square\text{-}minus\text{-}id}(v, J_{v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}antisym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}antisymmetric\text{-}op}(v, J_{v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad J_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(J_{v}(x), J_{v}(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad J_{v}(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x)) = \operatorname{act}(v)(a, J_{v}(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad J_{v}(J_{v}(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}antisym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(J_{v}(x), y) = -\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, J_{v}(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (J_{v}(x) \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, p, q, r, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(p, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(q, J_{v}(x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(s, J_{v}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)((p + r), x), \operatorname{act}(v)((q + s), J_{v}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, p, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(v)(t, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(p, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(q, J_{v}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)((t \cdot p), x), \operatorname{act}(v)((t \cdot q), J_{v}(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cact}(v)(-1, x) = \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csip-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}i}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cact}(v)(-+i, x) = \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ses-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(x, y) \in \mathbb{C} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ses-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), z) = (f(x, z) + f(y, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ses-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{cact}(v)(a, x), y) = (a \cdot f(x, y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ses-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(x, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(y, z)) = (f(x, y) + f(x, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ses-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(k, y)) = (\operatorname{conjugate}(k) \cdot f(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ses-\allowbreak{}expand}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(c, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(c, y))) \\ \quad \quad =\; ((f(x, x) + (\operatorname{conjugate}(c) \cdot f(x, y))) + (c \cdot f(y, x))) + ((c \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(c)) \cdot f(y, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ses-\allowbreak{}polarization}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 4 \cdot f(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) - f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))) + (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))))) - (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)))))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}four-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}.\; (((4 \cdot a) = (4 \cdot b)) \Rightarrow (a = b))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{onb-\allowbreak{}bessel-\allowbreak{}partial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, e.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v), w \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad |w| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad w \subseteq a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad w) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{summable-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}net}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{dom}(f) \to \operatorname{carr}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad |n| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad n \subseteq \operatorname{dom}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall a, b \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad |a| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad n \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{dom}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad |b| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad n \subseteq b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{dom}(f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(p))(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(p), f, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(p), f, b)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad <\; s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}summable}(p, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{onb-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, e.; \forall x, l \in \operatorname{vec}(v), p \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{sums\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v), (\lambda k \in a.\; \operatorname{act}(v)(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k)), e(k))), l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(l, e(p)) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{onb-\allowbreak{}expansion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, e.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, a, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sums\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v), (\lambda k \in a.\; \operatorname{act}(v)(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k)), e(k))), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{onb-\allowbreak{}residual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, e.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v), w \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad |w| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad w \subseteq a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in a.\; \operatorname{act}(v)(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k)), e(k))), w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in a.\; \operatorname{act}(v)(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k)), e(k))), w)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) + -\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda k \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k))))), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{parseval-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, e.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, a, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k)))))) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}summable-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}summable-\allowbreak{}cn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{dom}(f) \to \operatorname{carr}(p)). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(p))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}absolutely\text{-}summable}(p, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}summable}(p, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \emptyset))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, \mathit{na}, \mathit{nb}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \mathit{na}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \mathit{nb}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, (\mathit{na} \cup \mathit{nb})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ae\text{-}rel}(a, b, u, f) \simeq \{p \in (f \times f) : \exists n \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, n) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nth}(1, p)(x) = \operatorname{nth}(2, p)(x))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, u, s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f.; \forall \mathit{af}, g \in f, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{af}(x) = g(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [\mathit{af}, g] \in \operatorname{ae\text{-}rel}(a, b, u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, \mathit{af}, g. \\ \quad ([\mathit{af}, g] \in \operatorname{ae\text{-}rel}(a, b, u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, n) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{af}(x) = g(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}equivalence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (f \subseteq (a \to \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equivalence}(\operatorname{ae\text{-}rel}(a, b, u, f), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ae-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}setoid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (f \subseteq (a \to \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ae\text{-}setoid}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integrable-\allowbreak{}dominated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\lvert f(x) \rvert \leq \lvert h(x) \rvert) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integrable-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, h. \\ \quad ((f \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((h \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = h(x)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, h) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, h) = \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \simeq \{f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot f(x)))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot f(x))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u). \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}valued-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (u(x) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}esup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, l. \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq a(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) \leq a((k + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(a, \mathbb{N})) = l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, a, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}fn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}step\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda x \in a.\; (u(x) - v(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}parts-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, x. \\ \quad ((f \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (x \in a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \leq \lvert f(x) \rvert \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) \leq \lvert f(x) \rvert \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) - \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x)) = f(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{approximant-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, h, n, x. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in a.\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)(b) = h(b)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(n)(x) \leq h(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{approximant-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, h, x. \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, b \in a.\; (f(n)(b) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, f(n), f((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in a.\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)(b) = h(b)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in a \wedge \\ \quad h(x) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(n)(x)), h(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{step-\allowbreak{}functions-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}lp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \|{f}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}step\text{-}fn}(a, b, s(k)) \wedge (\|{s(k)}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (s(k)(x) - f(x)))}\|_{p}), 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}eliminf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, l. \\ \quad ((u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq u(k)) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, u, l)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq l) \wedge (\operatorname{eliminf}(u) = l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \{p \in a : (h(p) \in \mathbb{R})\}), h)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (h(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \{p \in a : (h(p) \in \mathbb{R})\}), h)(x) = h(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (h(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \{p \in a : (h(p) \in \mathbb{R})\}), h)(x) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{parts-\allowbreak{}lipschitz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, g, x. \\ \quad ((f \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((g \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (x \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) - \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, g)(x)) \rvert \leq \lvert (f(x) - g(x)) \rvert \wedge \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, f)(x) - \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, g)(x)) \rvert \leq \lvert (f(x) - g(x)) \rvert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}telescope}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, x.; \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R}))) \wedge ((x \in a) \wedge (n \leq m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (s(m)(x) - s(n)(x)) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert (s((k + 1))(x) - s(k)(x)) \rvert), m) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert (s((k + 1))(x) - s(k)(x)) \rvert), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})), x \in a. \\ \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert (s((k + 1))(x) - s(k)(x)) \rvert) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert (s((k + 1))(x) - s(k)(x)) \rvert), n) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert (s((k + 1))(x) - s(k)(x)) \rvert), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, s(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{rdk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert (s((\mathit{rdk} + 1))(x) - s(\mathit{rdk})(x)) \rvert), n))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq a(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) \leq a((k + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) \leq b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(a, \mathbb{N})) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, a, \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}(a, \mathbb{N}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, b, c, d. \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad b \in a \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \lvert (s((k + 1))(b) - s(k)(b)) \rvert), n) \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m, q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((f \leq m) \wedge (f \leq q)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (s(m)(b) - s(q)(b)) \rvert \leq d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}liminf-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, f)(x) \simeq \operatorname{eliminf}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(n)(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, b. \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad b \in a \wedge \\ \quad \forall c. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m, q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((d \leq m) \wedge (d \leq q)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (s(m)(b) - s(q)(b)) \rvert \leq c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, (\lambda \mathit{rpk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, s(\mathit{rpk}))))(b) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, (\lambda \mathit{rqk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, s(\mathit{rqk}))))(b) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(b)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, (\lambda \mathit{rpk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, s(\mathit{rpk}))))(b) - \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, (\lambda \mathit{rqk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, s(\mathit{rqk}))))(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}rapid-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, s, p, d, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, s(k)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (s((k + 1))(x) - s(k)(x)))}\|_{p} \leq d(k) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(d, n) \leq c) \wedge \\ \quad \|{s(0)}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \|{f}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (s(k)(x) - f(x)))}\|_{p}), 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{half-\allowbreak{}geometric-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{power}(1/2, n))(k) = \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)) \wedge \\ \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{power}(1/2, (k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{power}(1/2, k)) \wedge \\ \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{power}(1/2, n)), q) \leq 2) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, p, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, v) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \wedge \\ \quad \|{u}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \|{v}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (u(x) - v(x)))}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (u(x) - v(x)))}\|_{p} \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \|{u}\|_{p} + \|{v}\|_{p} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, s(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\|{s(k)}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m, q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((d \leq m) \wedge (d \leq q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (s(m)(x) - s(q)(x)))}\|_{p} \leq c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \|{f}\|_{p} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (s(k)(x) - f(x)))}\|_{p}), 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb-completion.scm}{theorem-library/mb-completion.scm}
\noindent{\small mb-completion.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf Prop. 3.3 (the completion of a measure) and the countable union of null sets it rests on.  Agent M-B, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/mb-completion.scm.  Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{null-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(a))) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, f(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u) \simeq \{s \in \operatorname{power}(a) : \exists \mathit{cpa} \in b, n \in \operatorname{power}(a).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, n) \wedge (s = (\mathit{cpa} \cup n)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \simeq \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, u), \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, x. \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((x \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge \exists \mathit{cpa} \in b, n \in \operatorname{power}(a).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, n) \wedge (x = (\mathit{cpa} \cup n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, u.\; (\operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u) \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((c \in b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (c \cup s) \in \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((c \in b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, b, u)((c \cup s)) = u(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}extends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (c \in b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, b, u)(c) = u(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (c \in b)) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}cara}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cara-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, b, u)(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, u), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, u)))(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u), \operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u), \operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c.; \forall x \in \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, b, u), c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in b.\; (c(d) = u(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c(x) = \operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, b, u)(x) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb-restrict.scm}{theorem-library/mb-restrict.scm}
\noindent{\small mb-restrict.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf Prop. 3.4: "If nu is a complete countably additive measure on B, then for any sigma-subalgebra A of B, nu extends the completion of nu restricted to A".  Agent M-B, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/mb-restrict.scm.  Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}restrict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, c) \wedge (c \subseteq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, c, \operatorname{res}(u, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{completion-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, c) \wedge (c \subseteq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, c, \operatorname{res}(u, c)) \subseteq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complete-\allowbreak{}extends-\allowbreak{}completion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c.; \forall x \in \operatorname{completion\text{-}sigma}(a, c, \operatorname{res}(u, c)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, c) \wedge (c \subseteq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(x) = \operatorname{completion\text{-}measure}(a, c, \operatorname{res}(u, c))(x) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-minkowski.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-minkowski.scm}
\noindent{\small minkowski.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Prop 2.29: the Minkowski functional of a symmetric, absorbing, convex subset of a real vector space is a seminorm.  Agent DUAL-FIX, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-minkowski.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix: mkw-. Needs: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)((r \cdot s), x) = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{act}(m)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)((r + s), x) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(m)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(1, x) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(0, x) = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, x.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vzero}(m), x) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, y, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad y \in s \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(t, y) \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x) \simeq \{r \in \mathbb{R} : ((0 < r) \wedge \exists y \in s.\; (x = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x, r, y. \\ \quad ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge ((y \in s) \wedge (x = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad r \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x.; \forall r \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x). \\ \quad (r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge \exists y \in s.\; (x = \operatorname{act}(m)(r, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}glb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, z)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, z).\; (\operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, z)) \leq w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, z).\; (b \leq w) \Rightarrow (b \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s.; \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (p_{s}(z) \simeq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq c) \wedge (a \leq b))))) \Rightarrow ((c \cdot a) \leq (c \cdot b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < a) \wedge (0 < b)))) \Rightarrow (0 < (a \cdot b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}div-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge ((c \cdot a) \leq b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a \leq (\operatorname{recip}(c) \cdot b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}div}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge (a \leq (\operatorname{recip}(c) \cdot b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (c \cdot a) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}div-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge (b \leq (c \cdot a)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{recip}(c) \cdot b) \leq a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}div}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge ((\operatorname{recip}(c) \cdot b) \leq a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad b \leq (c \cdot a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(\operatorname{recip}(c), \operatorname{act}(m)(c, x)) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x, c, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (c \cdot r) \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{act}(m)(c, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad r \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad r \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, x, y, r, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in a \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, a, x) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, a, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (r + s) \in \operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, a, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y))) \leq (\operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x)) + \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{act}(m)(c, x))) = (c \cdot \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{vzero}(m))) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, x))) \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, x))) = \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mink-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x, \ell. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \ell \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{act}(m)(\ell, x))) = (\lvert \ell \rvert \cdot \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{minkowski-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p_{s}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-extension.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-extension.scm}
\noindent{\small sxt.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Lemma 4.20: a seminorm p on a subspace E of F, dominated by a seminorm q of F, extends to a seminorm p\textasciitilde{} of F with p\textasciitilde{} $<$= q, namely p\textasciitilde{}(y) = inf \{ p(v) + q(w) : v in E, w in F, y = v + w \}. Agent DUAL-FIX, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-extension.scm.  ...}\par
