\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, y, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y), z) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, x.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vneg}(m)(x), x) = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(c, d)) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, c), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vneg}(m)(v), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(v, w)) = w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}nz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = 0) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(\operatorname{recip}(c), \operatorname{act}(m)(c, x)) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (0 \leq q(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}subadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, q, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad q(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) \leq (q(x) + q(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, q, \ell, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \ell \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad q(\operatorname{act}(m)(\ell, x)) = (\lvert \ell \rvert \cdot q(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad q(\operatorname{vzero}(m)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}p-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, s, p, x.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge (x \in s)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq p(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}p-\allowbreak{}subadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge ((x \in s) \wedge (y \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad p(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) \leq (p(x) + p(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}p-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, \ell, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge ((\ell \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad p(\operatorname{act}(m)(\ell, x)) = (\lvert \ell \rvert \cdot p(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}p-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p(\operatorname{vzero}(m)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, y) \simeq \{t \in \mathbb{R} : \exists v \in s, w \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; ((y = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(v, w)) \wedge (t = (p(v) + q(w))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, y, v, w. \\ \quad ((p \in (s \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((q \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((v \in s) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(v, w)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (p(v) + q(w)) \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, y.; \forall t \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, y). \\ \quad ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \exists v \in s, w \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; ((y = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(v, w)) \wedge (t = (p(v) + q(w))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}glb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (p(x) \leq q(x)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, z)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, z). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, z)) \leq w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, z).\; (b \leq w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q.; \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext}(m, s, p, q)(z) \simeq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}q}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (p(x) \leq q(x)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, y)) \leq q(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}extends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmx} \in s.\; (p(\mathit{dmx}) \leq q(\mathit{dmx})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, x)) = p(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (p(x) \leq q(x)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, x, y, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmx} \in s.\; (p(\mathit{dmx}) \leq q(\mathit{dmx})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, x) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y))) \leq (a + b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmx} \in s.\; (p(\mathit{dmx}) \leq q(\mathit{dmx})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, x)) + \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, x, \ell, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmx} \in s.\; (p(\mathit{dmx}) \leq q(\mathit{dmx})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \ell \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lvert \ell \rvert \cdot t) \in \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, \operatorname{act}(m)(\ell, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, x, \ell. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmx} \in s.\; (p(\mathit{dmx}) \leq q(\mathit{dmx})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \ell \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, \operatorname{act}(m)(\ell, x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \lvert \ell \rvert \cdot \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sxt-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, x, \ell. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmx} \in s.\; (p(\mathit{dmx}) \leq q(\mathit{dmx})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \ell \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, \operatorname{act}(m)(\ell, x))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \lvert \ell \rvert \cdot \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seminorm-\allowbreak{}extension}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (p(x) \leq q(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext}(m, s, p, q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext}(m, s, p, q), p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext}(m, s, p, q)(y) \leq q(y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-top.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-top.scm}
\noindent{\small tb-top.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Def 1.3 / Prop 1.4: the topology of a separating family of seminorms is a vector space topology.  Agent TB-01, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-top.scm.  Library: analysis. Helper prefix: tbt-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, x, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sn\text{-}ball}(m, f, a, x, s) \simeq \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \forall i \in a.\; (f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x))) \leq s)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, x, s, y. \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{sn\text{-}ball}(m, f, a, x, s) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \forall i \in a.\; (f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x))) \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, x, f.\; ((\operatorname{vec}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(m)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}opens}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{vec}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \simeq \{u \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(m)) : \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, u)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, x, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, \emptyset))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}whole}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, x, f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, \operatorname{vec}(m)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, b, g, x, c, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq g \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \leq h \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sn\text{-}ball}(m, f, g, x, c) \subseteq \operatorname{sn\text{-}ball}(m, f, b, x, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, (u \cap v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, f, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \forall w \in a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, x, f, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, a, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-tvs.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-tvs.scm}
\noindent{\small tb-tvs.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Prop 1.4: the topology of a separating family of seminorms is a vector space topology (Hausdorff; addition and scalar multiplication continuous). Agent TB-01, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-seminorm-tvs.scm (after tvs-seminorm-top). Library: analysis.  Helper ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}oball-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, x, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sn\text{-}oball}(m, f, a, x, r) \simeq \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists e \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge \forall i \in a.\; ((f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x))) + e) \leq r))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}oball-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, x, r, y. \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{sn\text{-}oball}(m, f, a, x, r) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge \forall i \in a.\; ((f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x))) + e) \leq r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}oball-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, b, x, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |b| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sn\text{-}open}(m, a, f, \operatorname{sn\text{-}oball}(m, f, b, x, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}oball-\allowbreak{}center}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, b, x, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge ((b \subseteq a) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{sn\text{-}oball}(m, f, b, x, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}oball-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, b, x, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge ((b \subseteq a) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sn\text{-}oball}(m, f, b, x, r) \subseteq \operatorname{sn\text{-}ball}(m, f, b, x, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}oball-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, b, x, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |b| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sn\text{-}oball}(m, f, b, x, r) \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}basic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, u, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, a, f))) \wedge (x \in u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{snf} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((|\mathit{snf}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((\mathit{snf} \subseteq a) \wedge \exists e.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge (\operatorname{sn\text{-}ball}(m, f, \mathit{snf}, x, e) \subseteq u)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}hausdorff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f, \mathit{tvx}, y, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{tvx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{tvx}, y) \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{tvx} \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (y \in w) \wedge \forall a \in v, b \in w.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b) \in u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, x.; \forall b \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((|b| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (b \subseteq a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{bm} \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq \mathit{bm}) \wedge \forall i \in b.\; (f(i)(x) \leq \mathit{bm})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sntop-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f, r, \mathit{tvx}, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{tvx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{tvx}) \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{tvd}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{tvd}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{tvx} \in w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)), a \in w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(s, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r))) < \mathit{tvd}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(s, a) \in u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seminorm-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}tvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(d, m, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-rn.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-rn.scm}
\noindent{\small tb-rn.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Cor 1.5: R\textasciicircum{}n is a topological vector space (and, on the way, every normed vector space is one, with the topology of its norm).  Agent TB-01, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-rn.scm, after tvs-seminorm-tvs and the R\textasciicircum{}n files (rn-is-normed-vector-space). Library: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \operatorname{vnrm}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \{0\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}tvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(m)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}tvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), \{0\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-continuity.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-continuity.scm}
\noindent{\small tb-cont.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Prop 1.12 / Cor 1.13: a linear map between spaces with separating families of seminorms is continuous iff every q\_j(Tx) is bounded by C max(p\_i1(x), ..., p\_ik(x)). Agent TB-01, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-continuity.scm (after tvs-seminorm-tvs). Library: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}combine}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t.; \forall g \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \\ \quad |g| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq x_{2} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in g, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t.; \forall j \in x_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-single-bound.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-single-bound.scm}
\noindent{\small tvs-single-bound.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-OT1), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/baot1-1109/tvs-single-bound.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}single-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists i \in x_{1}, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq c) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{f1}(i)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-functional.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-functional.scm}
\noindent{\small tb-func.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Cor 1.13: a linear functional f on a space whose topology is defined by a family of seminorms is continuous iff |f(x)| $<$= C max(p\_i1(x), ..., p\_in(x)). Agent TB-01, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-functional.scm (after tvs-continuity, tvs-rn). Library: analysis. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})(v) = \lvert v \rvert)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}) \simeq \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{functional-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, x, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(m, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists \mathit{sbf} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |\mathit{sbf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{sbf} \subseteq x \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{sbx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m), t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge \forall i \in \mathit{sbf}.\; (a(i)(\mathit{sbx}) \leq t)) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(\mathit{sbx}) \rvert \leq (c \cdot t)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-extremal.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-extremal.scm}
\noindent{\small tb-extremal.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Prop 2.40: extremal subsets are transitive, closed under intersections (with nonempty intersection) and under inverse images by linear maps. Agent TB-01, 2026-10-26.  DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-extremal.scm (after sip-hilbert-vocab, the tvs vocabulary).  Library: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{extremal-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, c, b, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, c, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, b, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, c, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extremal-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(v) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (x \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (x \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall l \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, f(l), a(l)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall l \in x.\; (w \in f(l))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall l \in x.\; (w \in f(l))\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall l \in x.\; (w \in a(l))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extremal-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}preimage}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, f, b, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(c) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(d, b, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : (f(w) \in b)\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(c, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : (f(w) \in b)\}, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : (f(w) \in a)\}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-hahn-banach-convex.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-hahn-banach-convex.scm}
\noindent{\small hbc.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Cor 2.36: Hahn-Banach for a convex dominating functional, by CITING the sublinear Hahn-Banach (hbs-hahn-banach-sublinear) -- no Zorn here.  Agent DUAL-FIX, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-hahn-banach-convex.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix: hbc-. Needs: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x) \simeq \{r \in \mathbb{R} : \exists t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < t) \wedge (p(\operatorname{act}(m)(t, x)) \leq (t \cdot r)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x, r, t. \\ \quad ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < t) \wedge (p(\operatorname{act}(m)(t, x)) \leq (t \cdot r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad r \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x.; \forall r \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x). \\ \quad (r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \exists t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < t) \wedge (p(\operatorname{act}(m)(t, x)) \leq (t \cdot r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}elem-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}p-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p(x) \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}glb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, z)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, z).\; (\operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, z)) \leq w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, z).\; (b \leq w) \Rightarrow (b \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p.; \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{homog\text{-}minorant}(m, p)(z) \simeq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}p}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x)) \leq p(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}minorant-\allowbreak{}dominates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmz} \in s.\; (f(\mathit{dmz}) \leq p(\mathit{dmz})) \wedge \\ \quad z \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad r \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, \operatorname{vzero}(m))) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x, c, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (c \cdot r) \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, \operatorname{act}(m)(c, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unscale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x, c, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, \operatorname{act}(m)(c, x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{recip}(c) \cdot r) \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, \operatorname{act}(m)(c, x))) = (c \cdot \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x, y, r, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (r + a) \in \operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y))) \leq (\operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, x)) + \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{homog\text{-}set}(m, p, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}minorant-\allowbreak{}sublinear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sublinear}(m, \operatorname{homog\text{-}minorant}(m, p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hahn-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \leq p(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{vec}(m), a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(x) \leq p(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-kernel-closed.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-kernel-closed.scm}
\noindent{\small tkr.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Prop 2.11: a nontrivial linear functional on a real topological vector space is continuous iff its kernel f\textasciicircum{}-1(0) is closed.  Agent DUAL-FIX, 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-kernel-closed.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix: tkr-. Needs: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, w \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})(v, w) = (v + w))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})(v) = -v)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})))) \wedge \\ (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})))) \simeq \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})))), y \in u. \exists e. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge \forall v \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\lvert (v - y) \rvert \leq e) \Rightarrow (v \in u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \{v \in \mathbb{R} : \neg (v = 0)\} \\ \in\; \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, r, x, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x) \in u))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (x \in w) \wedge \forall s \in \mathbb{R}, a \in w.\; ((\lvert (s - r) \rvert < d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(m)(s, a) \in u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}translate-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, w, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, a)) \in w)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}dilate-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, c, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{opens}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : (\operatorname{act}(m)(c, x) \in w)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fker-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, f, z.\; ((z \in \operatorname{fker}(m, f)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (f(z) = 0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; ((v \in \{\mathit{nzv} \in \mathbb{R} : \neg (\mathit{nzv} = 0)\}) \Leftrightarrow ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \neg (v = 0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, f, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(t), \operatorname{fker}(m, f)) \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad f(a) = s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w) \wedge \forall z \in w.\; (\lvert f(z) \rvert \leq s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (f(a) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{fker}(m, f)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{fker}(m, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{functional-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (f(a) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{fker}(m, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-geometric-hb.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-geometric-hb.scm}
\noindent{\small geo.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf TB-2a (geometric Hahn-Banach): Cor 2.15, Prop 2.13, Prop 2.12, Cor 2.14, by the ANALYTIC route -- the gauge of an open convex set and the sublinear Hahn-Banach -- instead of the notes' (maximal subspaces by Zorn, the closure of H, quotients E/H, connectedness of E \textbackslash{} \{0\}), which ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, b) \in a)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, b) \in a)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}absorbing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gauge-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, w, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w \wedge \\ \quad x \in w \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, w, x)) < 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gauge-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, w, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x \in w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, w, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gauge-\allowbreak{}sublinear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, w) \wedge (\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sublinear}(m, p_{w}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(a, v) = \operatorname{act}(m)(b, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}submodule-\allowbreak{}rmod}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, \operatorname{line}(m, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{line}(m, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}coef}(m, v, u) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u = \operatorname{act}(m)(\operatorname{line\text{-}coef}(m, v, u), v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v, u, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad u = \operatorname{act}(m)(c, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}coef}(m, v, u) = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}seed-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{line}(m, v), (\lambda u \in \operatorname{line}(m, v).\; \operatorname{line\text{-}coef}(m, v, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}seed-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}v}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda u \in \operatorname{line}(m, v).\; \operatorname{line\text{-}coef}(m, v, u))(v) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}seed-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}gauge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, w, v.; \forall u \in \operatorname{line}(m, v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, w, v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lnu} \in \operatorname{line}(m, v).\; \operatorname{line\text{-}coef}(m, v, \mathit{lnu}))(u) \leq p_{w}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}sided}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, f, n.; \forall s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in n \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in n.\; (f(w) \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{bw} \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in \mathit{bw}) \wedge \forall z \in \mathit{bw}.\; (\lvert f(z) \rvert \leq s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w) \wedge \forall z \in w.\; (\lvert f(z) \rvert \leq s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}functional}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a_{0}.\; (a_{0} \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (0 < f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(y, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, y)) = \operatorname{vzero}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, t, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(u, a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, b)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(u, c), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, d)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(u, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, c))), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fker-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, \operatorname{fker}(m, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}hyperplane-\allowbreak{}through-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a_{0}.\; (a_{0} \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg (z \in a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{gx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (g(\mathit{gx}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{fker}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{fker}(m, g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{fker}(m, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}cone-\allowbreak{}misses-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in c, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x) \in c)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (e \in c) \wedge \\ \quad \exists d_{1}, d_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(a, d_{1}), \operatorname{act}(m)(b, d_{2})) = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \Rightarrow ((a = 0) \wedge (b = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge (\exists v \in s.\; \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \wedge \forall \mathit{vx} \in s.\; \neg (\mathit{vx} \in c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sumset-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sumset}(m, a, p) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists z \in p.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, z)) \in a)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sumset-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (p \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sumset}(m, a, p) \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sumset-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \operatorname{sumset}(m, a, p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kernel-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, \{z \in s : (f(z) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{positive-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \{z \in s : (0 < f(z))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extend-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}functional}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \exists \mathit{af} \in a.\; (\mathit{af} \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in a.\; ((z \in s) \Rightarrow (0 < f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, g, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (0 < g(x)) \end{array}}}
