\vnbentry{\texttt{positive-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}vanishing-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a_{0}.\; (a_{0} \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg (z \in a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{fker}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (0 < g(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-product-line.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-product-line.scm}
\noindent{\small prod.scm -- THE PRODUCT TOPOLOGICAL VECTOR SPACE E x R, and topological-vector-space.pdf Prop 2.35 (the strict epigraph of a continuous convex functional is open and convex). Agent TVS-NEXT (worker-08), 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/tvs-product-line.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix: ptv-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pv-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}vadd}(m)(x, \mathit{qx}) = [\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})), (\operatorname{nth}(2, x) + \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx}))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pv-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}vneg}(m)(x) = [\operatorname{vneg}(m)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x)), -\operatorname{nth}(2, x)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pv-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, \mathit{px}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{px} \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}act}(m)(x, \mathit{px}) = [\operatorname{act}(m)(x, \operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{px})), (x \cdot \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{px}))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)) \simeq (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)) \simeq \operatorname{pv\text{-}vadd}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)) \simeq [\operatorname{vzero}(m), 0]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)) \simeq \operatorname{pv\text{-}vneg}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)) \simeq \operatorname{pv\text{-}act}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pv-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}vadd}(m) \in (((\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \times (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R})) \to (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pv-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}vneg}(m) \in ((\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \to (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pv-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}act}(m) \in ((\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)) \times (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R})) \to (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}associative}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}identity}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)), \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}inverses}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}inverses}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)), \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)), \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(r, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)))(r, s), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(r, x), \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}compat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)))(r, s), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(r, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}unital}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m))), x) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rmod-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, v, c, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pt\text{-}box}(t, v, c, e) \simeq \{z \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \times \mathbb{R}) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, z) \in v) \wedge (\lvert (\operatorname{nth}(2, z) - c) \rvert < e))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, v, c, e, z. \\ \quad (z \in \operatorname{pt\text{-}box}(t, v, c, e)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \times \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((\operatorname{nth}(1, z) \in v) \wedge (\lvert (\operatorname{nth}(2, z) - c) \rvert < e))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, \emptyset))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}whole}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, (\operatorname{pts}(t) \times \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((a \subseteq b) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((f \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (d \leq f)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pt\text{-}box}(t, a, c, d) \subseteq \operatorname{pt\text{-}box}(t, b, c, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, (u \cap v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \forall w \in m.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, m, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)) \simeq (\operatorname{pts}(t) \times \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}opens}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)) \simeq \{u \in \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{pts}(t) \times \mathbb{R})) : \operatorname{is\text{-}pt\text{-}open}(t, u)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pt-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, v, c, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pt\text{-}box}(t, v, c, e) \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}hausdorff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, x, y, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad y \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}vadd}(m)(x, y) \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)). \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (y \in w) \wedge \forall a \in v, b \in w.\; (\operatorname{pv\text{-}vadd}(m)(a, b) \in u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, r, x, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}act}(m)(r, x) \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad x \in w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)), a \in w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(s, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r))) < d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pv\text{-}act}(m)(s, a) \in u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}tvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m), \operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}halfline-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \{v \in \mathbb{R} : (v < c)\} \\ \quad \in\; \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}comb-\allowbreak{}strict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h, a, b, p, q. \\ \quad ((h \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq h) \wedge ((h \leq 1) \wedge ((p < a) \wedge (q < b))))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((h \cdot q) + ((1 - h) \cdot p)) < ((h \cdot b) + ((1 - h) \cdot a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strict-\allowbreak{}epigraph-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{strict\text{-}epigraph}(m, p) \simeq \{w \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \times \mathbb{R}) : (p(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)) < \operatorname{nth}(2, w))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strict-\allowbreak{}epigraph-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{strict\text{-}epigraph}(m, p) \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}top}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}rmod}(m), \operatorname{strict\text{-}epigraph}(m, p)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/nets.scm}{structure-library/nets.scm}
\noindent{\small nets-vocab.scm -- DIRECTED SETS, NETS AND SUBNETS in a topological space; Cauchy nets and completeness in a topological vector space (topological-vector-space.pdf Def 4.1).  Definitions only.  Agent NETS (worker-08), 2026-10-26 (NEW DEFINITIONS, the user's to confirm).  DESTINATION: structure-library/nets.scm. Library: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}directed-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/nets.scm}{theorem-library/nets.scm}
\noindent{\small nets.scm -- directed sets, nets, subnets, net convergence in a topological space, the metric and sequence bridges, Cauchy nets and completeness in a topological vector space (Def 4.1), and the parts of TB-10 / TB-12 that need nothing but nets.  Agent NETS (worker-08), 2026-10-26. DESTINATION: theorem-library/nets.scm.  ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ds-\allowbreak{}nonempty}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \Rightarrow \exists n.\; (n \in \operatorname{pts}(d)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ds-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.; \forall a \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \Rightarrow ([a, a] \in \operatorname{dleq}(d)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ds-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{pts}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge (([a, b] \in \operatorname{dleq}(d)) \wedge ([b, c] \in \operatorname{dleq}(d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [a, c] \in \operatorname{dleq}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ds-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{pts}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; (([a, c] \in \operatorname{dleq}(d)) \wedge ([b, c] \in \operatorname{dleq}(d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eventually-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}eventually\text{-}in}(d, x, u) \wedge (u \subseteq v)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}eventually\text{-}in}(d, x, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eventually-\allowbreak{}and}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, x, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}eventually\text{-}in}(d, x, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}eventually\text{-}in}(d, x, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}eventually\text{-}in}(d, x, (u \cap v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{net-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, x, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{pts}(d) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; (x(j) = a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subnet-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, x, a, e, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subnet}(d, x, e, y) \wedge (y \in (\operatorname{pts}(e) \to \operatorname{pts}(t))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, e, y, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{net-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, x, a, w, f, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, w, f) \wedge \\ \quad y \in (\operatorname{pts}(d) \to \operatorname{pts}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; (y(j) = f(x(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(w, d, y, f(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{net-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, x, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, a) \wedge \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}net-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, d, x, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{pts}(d) \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{pts}(s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), d, x, a) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall e.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}eventually\text{-}in}(d, x, \operatorname{ball}(s, a, e))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}directed-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nn\text{-}directed}) \simeq \mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}directed-\allowbreak{}dleq}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{dleq}(\operatorname{nn\text{-}directed}) \simeq \{p \in (\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}) : (\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \leq \operatorname{nth}(2, p))\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}directed-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (([m, n] \in \operatorname{dleq}(\operatorname{nn\text{-}directed})) \Leftrightarrow (m \leq n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nn-\allowbreak{}directed-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}directed-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(\operatorname{nn\text{-}directed})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}net}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, f, l) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), \operatorname{nn\text{-}directed}, f, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x) = \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, x, y, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y)) \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (y \in w) \wedge \forall p \in v, q \in w.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(q)) \in u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}convergent-\allowbreak{}net-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, d, x, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}net}(m, t, d, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tvs-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}subnet-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, d, x, e, y, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}net}(m, t, d, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subnet}(d, x, e, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, e, y, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{net-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, x, l, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \wedge (\operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, d, x, l) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; (x(i) \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad l \in a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}subset}(m, t, \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}subset}(m, t, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adherent-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}net}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((l \in u) \Rightarrow \exists q \in u.\; (q \in a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n, x. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in (\operatorname{pts}(n) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{pts}(n).\; (x(i) \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, n, x, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complete-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}subset}(m, t, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}net-\allowbreak{}limits-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}net\text{-}limits}(t, e) \simeq \{f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) : \exists d \in \operatorname{directed\text{-}set}, p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge ((p \in (\operatorname{pts}(d) \to e)) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), d, (\lambda l \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; p(l)(x)), f(x))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}limits-\allowbreak{}equicontinuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous\text{-}t}(t, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous\text{-}t}(t, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}net\text{-}limits}(t, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{directed-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}common-\allowbreak{}index}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, r.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w, i, k. \\ \quad \quad (([w, i] \in r) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{pts}(d)) \wedge ([i, k] \in \operatorname{dleq}(d)))) \Rightarrow ([w, k] \in r) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in s.\; \exists j \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; ([u, j] \in r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; \forall v \in s.\; ([v, m] \in r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{equicontinuous-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}unif}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, e, d, p, f, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous\text{-}t}(t, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{pts}(d) \to e) \wedge \\ \quad f \in e \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), d, (\lambda l \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; p(l)(x)), f(x)) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}unif\text{-}conv\text{-}on}(d, p, f, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{singleton-\allowbreak{}subspace-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, \{x\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unif-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}pointwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, e, d, p, f, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}directed\text{-}set}(d) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{pts}(d) \to e) \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad x \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}unif\text{-}conv\text{-}on}(d, p, f, k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{net\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), d, (\lambda l \in \operatorname{pts}(d).\; p(l)(x)), f(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-alaoglu.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-alaoglu.scm}
\noindent{\small tb6.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf TB-6, the parts Tychonoff unblocks: compactness of pointwise-bounded, pointwise-closed sets of real functions (the engine of Prop 3.25), Banach-Alaoglu (Cor 3.27) for the polar of a neighbourhood of 0 in a real TVS, and Prop 3.29 (the dual unit ball of a normed space).  The weak* ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}inclusion-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a), t, (\lambda q \in a.\; q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}into-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, t, f) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, b) \wedge (b \subseteq a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(s, b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(s, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a) \simeq [a, \{w \in \operatorname{power}(a) : \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; (w = (u \cap a))\}]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge (b \subseteq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, a), b) \simeq \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \simeq \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}lines}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, b. \\ \quad ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (b \in (f \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{ccint}(-b(n), b(n))))) \\ \quad \quad \subseteq\; \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, b. \\ \quad ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (b \in (f \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{ccint}(-b(n), b(n))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{ccint}(-b(n), b(n)))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda p \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{ccint}(-b(n), b(n))))).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pointwise-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}intervals}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, b, a. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad b \in (f \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f, g \in a.\; (\lvert g(y) \rvert \leq b(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{ccint}(-b(n), b(n))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}factors-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, b.; \forall i \in f. \\ \quad ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (b \in (f \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}((\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{ccint}(-b(n), b(n))))(i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pointwise-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, b, a. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad b \in (f \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f, g \in a.\; (\lvert g(y) \rvert \leq b(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, x, c, e. \\ \quad ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((x \in f) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((e \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < e))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{preimage}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tproj}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, c, e)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, x, c, e, h. \\ \quad ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((x \in f) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{preimage}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tproj}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, c, e)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \lvert (c - h(x)) \rvert < e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, a. \\ \quad ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \wedge ((a \in f) \wedge (1 < g(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((g \in w) \wedge \forall h \in w.\; ((h \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \wedge (1 < h(a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, a, b, c. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in f \wedge \\ \quad b \in f \wedge \\ \quad c \in f \wedge \\ \quad \neg (g(c) = (g(a) + g(b))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))). \\ \quad \quad \quad g \in w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall h \in w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((h \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \wedge \neg (h(c) = (h(a) + h(b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}homogeneous-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, a, c, r. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in f \wedge \\ \quad c \in f \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (g(c) = (r \cdot g(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))). \\ \quad \quad \quad g \in w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall h \in w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (h \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \wedge \neg (h(c) = (r \cdot h(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{top\text{-}dual}(m, t) \simeq \{f \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), f))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{polar}(m, t, a) \simeq \{f \in \operatorname{top\text{-}dual}(m, t) : \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) \leq 1)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weak-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m, t) \simeq \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \operatorname{top\text{-}dual}(m, t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, z. \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{top\text{-}dual}(m, t) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; z \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, z) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a, z. \\ \quad (z \in \operatorname{polar}(m, t, a)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \operatorname{top\text{-}dual}(m, t)) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (z(x) \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fun-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(a, (\lambda n \in a.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(a, (\lambda n \in a.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, v, w, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w \wedge \\ \quad w \subseteq v \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in v.\; (f(x) \leq 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((v \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge ((\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w) \wedge (w \subseteq v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\varepsilon(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, v, x)) + \varepsilon(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, v, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, x))))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m), g \in \operatorname{polar}(m, t, v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \lvert g(y) \rvert \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\varepsilon(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, v, x)) + \varepsilon(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, v, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, x)))))(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \simeq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}failure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, v, w, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w \wedge \\ \quad w \subseteq v \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists a \in v.\; (1 < g(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (g(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b)) = (g(a) + g(b))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists r \in \mathbb{R}, a \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (g(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, a)) = (r \cdot g(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g \in \operatorname{polar}(m, t, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge ((v \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge ((\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in w) \wedge (w \subseteq v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \operatorname{polar}(m, t, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{banach-\allowbreak{}alaoglu}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists \mathit{b6v} \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((\operatorname{vzero}(m) \in \mathit{b6v}) \wedge (\mathit{b6v} \subseteq v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m, t), \operatorname{polar}(m, t, v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}nbhd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, a, k. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in f \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad k < \lvert g(a) \rvert \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))). \\ \quad \quad \quad g \in w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall h \in w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (h \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \wedge (k < \lvert h(a) \rvert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.\; (\operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \simeq \{f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m) : (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \leq 1)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}weak-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{dual\text{-}weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m) \simeq \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \operatorname{dual\text{-}vec}(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; f \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\lvert f(x) \rvert \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}failure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists a \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(a) < \lvert g(a) \rvert) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (g(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b)) = (g(a) + g(b))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists r \in \mathbb{R}, a \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (g(\operatorname{act}(m)(r, a)) = (r \cdot g(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}weak-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})) \simeq \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in \mathbf{Set}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}family}(f, (\lambda x \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fun-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (f \in (a \to \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(a, (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, x. \\ \quad ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda \mathit{bgx} \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})))) \wedge (x \in f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda \mathit{bgx} \in f.\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}))), a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), (\lambda c \in a.\; c(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-top-continuity.scm}{theorem-library/cc-top-continuity.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-top-continuity.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1F), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1f-1109/cc-top-continuity.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(s), e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), a) \wedge (0 < e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \in w) \wedge \forall q \in w.\; ((q \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((a(p) - a(q))) < e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(s), e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \in w) \wedge \forall q \in w.\; ((q \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((a(p) - a(q))) < e)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), (\lambda v \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), (\lambda v \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (a(v) + b(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}equalizer-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(s, \{p \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (a(p) = b(p))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, p, q, m, k, t, e. \\ \quad u \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad v \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad e \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(u) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(q) \leq k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((u - p)) \leq t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((v - q)) \leq t \wedge \\ \quad ((m + k) \cdot t) \leq e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((u \cdot v) - (p \cdot q))) \leq e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), (\lambda v \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (a(v) \cdot b(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}separate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, h, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in h.\; (a(c) = b(c)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a(p) = b(p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((p \in w) \wedge (w \subseteq \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), h))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/top-power-compact.scm}{theorem-library/top-power-compact.scm}
\noindent{\small top-power-compact.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1F), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1f-1109/top-power-compact.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{confined-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, t, k. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; (k(y) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(n)))) \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{confined-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, t, k. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; (k(y) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(n)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; t)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(n))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda p \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(n)))).\; p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{confined-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, t, k, a. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; (k(y) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(y))) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f, g \in a.\; (g(y) \in k(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{confined-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, t, k, a. \\ \quad f \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; (k(y) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, k(y))) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{tprod\text{-}pts}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f, g \in a.\; (g(y) \in k(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; t)), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(f, (\lambda n \in f.\; t)), a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/subseq-fun-typing.scm}{theorem-library/subseq-fun-typing.scm}
\noindent{\small subseq-fun-typing.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-27 (integration of the 10-26/27 wave) out of theorem-library/ca6-hurwitz.scm, so that files of library analysis may cite them (the library gate). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of ca6-hurwitz.scm's.  Loaded immediately before ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{subseq-\allowbreak{}fun-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i. \\ \quad ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a)) \wedge \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{subseq}(f, i) \in (\mathbb{N} \to a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-alaoglu-separable.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-alaoglu-separable.scm}
\noindent{\small tb6s.scm -- topological-vector-space.pdf Remark 3.30: the SEPARABLE Banach-Alaoglu theorem by the METRIC route. For a normed space with a dense sequence (x\_n), the dual unit ball B* carries the metric d(f, g) = sum\_n 2\textasciicircum{}-(n+1) rho(f(x\_n), g(x\_n)) (PRODUCT-METRIC of the intervals [-||x\_n||, ||x\_n||], pulled back); its ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, j.\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{pullback\text{-}ms}(t, s, j)) \simeq s)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}slot}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, j. \\ \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{pullback\text{-}ms}(t, s, j)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{pbu\_}, \operatorname{pbv\_}] \in (s \times s).\; \operatorname{dist}(t)(j(\operatorname{pbu\_}), j(\operatorname{pbv\_})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, j, u, v. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((u \in s) \wedge (v \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{pullback\text{-}ms}(t, s, j))(u, v) \simeq \operatorname{dist}(t)(j(u), j(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad j \in (s \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((j(x) = j(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{pullback\text{-}ms}(t, s, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}to}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, j, q, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad j \in (s \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((j(x) = j(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{pullback\text{-}ms}(t, s, j), q, a) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(t, \operatorname{compose}(j, q), j(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, z, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) = (f(z) - f(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}lipschitz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, z, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (f(z) - f(y)) \rvert \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbi-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m))) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dbi}(m, s)(n) \simeq \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(-\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(s(n)), \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(s(n))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbi-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s)) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{seq\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s)(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}carrier-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}(s) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{pts}(s(n))))) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(n) \in \operatorname{pts}(s(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbj-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, f, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m))) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dbj}(m, s)(f)(n) = f(s(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbj-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dbj}(m, s) \in (\operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \to \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbj-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dbj}(m, s)(x) = \operatorname{dbj}(m, s)(y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{product\text{-}metric}(s) \simeq \operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; /(1, \operatorname{power}(2, (n + 1)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbi-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s))) \simeq \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)) \simeq \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s) \simeq \operatorname{pullback\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s)), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m), \operatorname{dbj}(m, s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbj-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, k, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{dbj}(m, s), a)(k)(n) = a(k)(s(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbj-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m))) \wedge ((a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m))) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{dbj}(m, s), a)(k)(n)) = (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(s(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbj-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, f, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{dbi}(m, s)(n), (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{dbj}(m, s), a)(k)(n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dbj}(m, s)(f)(n)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(s(n))), f(s(n))) \end{array}}}
