\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{dk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(\mathit{dk})))) < \mathit{deps}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s), a, f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(s(n))), f(s(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(z)), l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m). \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(z)), f(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}limits-\allowbreak{}everywhere}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a.; \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dz} \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{dk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{dz}, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(\mathit{dk})))) < \mathit{deps}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(s(n))), l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(z)), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dbj-\allowbreak{}diagonal-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, b, k, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{subseq}(\operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{dbj}(m, s), a), b)(k)(n) = \operatorname{subseq}(a, b)(k)(s(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}coord}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, k, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a(k)(s(n)) \in \operatorname{ccint}(-\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(s(n)), \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(s(n)))) \wedge (a(k)(s(n)) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}subseq-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s), \operatorname{subseq}(a, i), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}pointwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a, f, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dz} \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{dk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{dz}, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(\mathit{dk})))) < \mathit{deps}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s), a, f) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(z)), f(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqn-\allowbreak{}unfold-\allowbreak{}b6s}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (a^{\mathbb{N}} \simeq (\mathbb{N} \to a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}evaluation-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dz} \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{dz}, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda e \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m).\; e(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}identity-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m).\; i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}constraint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, z, c, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [z, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, c, r)] \in \operatorname{tprod\text{-}constr}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, o, b, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad o \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(\operatorname{vec}(m), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda j \in \mathrm{OS}(b).\; [s(j), \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, o(s(j)), l)]), \mathrm{OS}(b))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}centre}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, o, b, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad o \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad o \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(\operatorname{vec}(m), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda j \in \mathrm{OS}(b).\; [s(j), \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, o(s(j)), l)]), \mathrm{OS}(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}coord}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, o, b, l, g, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad o \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad g \\ \quad \in\; \operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(\operatorname{vec}(m), \\ \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{b6j} \in \mathrm{OS}(b).\; [s(\mathit{b6j}), \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, o(s(\mathit{b6j})), l)]), \mathrm{OS}(b))) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \mathrm{OS}(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert (o(s(j)) - g(s(j))) \rvert < l \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}box}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, u, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s), u) \wedge \\ \quad o \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{tprod\text{-}box}(\operatorname{vec}(m), (\lambda n \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})), \operatorname{image}((\lambda j \in \mathrm{OS}(b).\; [s(j), \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, o(s(j)), \operatorname{recip}((b + 1)))]), \mathrm{OS}(b))) \cap \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dual-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}topology-\allowbreak{}agrees}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{banach-\allowbreak{}alaoglu-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m), \mathit{deps}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(s(k)))) < \mathit{deps}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)) \simeq \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall u. \\ \quad \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}ball\text{-}ms}(m, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{banach-\allowbreak{}alaoglu-\allowbreak{}separable-\allowbreak{}metrizable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metrizable\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{dual\text{-}weak\text{-}star\text{-}top}(m), \operatorname{dual\text{-}unit\text{-}ball}(m))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cvx-alg.scm}{theorem-library/cvx-alg.scm}
\noindent{\small cvx-alg.scm -- the regrouping identity for convex combinations in a real normed vector space, and the bounds on its coefficients: the algebra under "the join of a convex set to a point is convex" and "the convex hull is convex" (compact-groups notes, Lemma 1.12). Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: cva-.  Library: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}regroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, c, a, s, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad ((1 - (((1 - s) \cdot d) + (s \cdot f))) \cdot (1 - g)) = ((1 - s) \cdot (1 - d)) \wedge \\ \quad ((1 - (((1 - s) \cdot d) + (s \cdot f))) \cdot g) = (s \cdot (1 - f)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - s), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - d), b), \operatorname{act}(m)(d, a))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(s, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - f), c), \operatorname{act}(m)(f, a)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - (((1 - s) \cdot d) + (s \cdot f))), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - g), b), \operatorname{act}(m)(g, c))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)((((1 - s) \cdot d) + (s \cdot f)), a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cvx-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq x) \wedge (0 \leq y)))) \Rightarrow (0 \leq (x \cdot y)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cvx-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c, x.\; (((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq c) \wedge (x \leq 1)))) \Rightarrow ((c \cdot x) \leq c))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}regroup-\allowbreak{}coefficients}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq s) \wedge ((s \leq 1) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((a \leq 1) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge (b \leq 1))))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq (((1 - s) \cdot a) + (s \cdot b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (((1 - s) \cdot a) + (s \cdot b)) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad m \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad ((1 - (((1 - s) \cdot a) + (s \cdot b))) \cdot (1 - m)) = ((1 - s) \cdot (1 - a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad ((1 - (((1 - s) \cdot a) + (s \cdot b))) \cdot m) = (s \cdot (1 - b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cvx-hull.scm}{theorem-library/cvx-hull.scm}
\noindent{\small cvx-hull.scm -- the join of a convex set to a point is convex; the convex hull (the finite convex combinations, CONV-HULL) contains E, lies in VEC, is convex and lies in every convex set containing E (compact-groups notes, Lemma 1.12, the convexity half). Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: cvh-.  Library: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{conv\text{-}join}(m, c, a) \simeq \{z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \exists y \in c, t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq t) \wedge ((t \leq 1) \wedge (z = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), y), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a.; \forall z \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}join}(m, c, a). \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists y \in c, t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq t) \wedge ((t \leq 1) \wedge (z = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), y), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, y, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in c \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), y), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)) \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}join}(m, c, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \operatorname{conv\text{-}join}(m, c, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, n) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e, n, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, (n + 1)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, n), y \in e, t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 \leq t) \wedge ((t \leq 1) \wedge (z = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), x), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, y)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e, n, x, y, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, n) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in e \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), x), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, y)) \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, (n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, n) \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, e.\; (\operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e) \simeq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e, k, z. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (z \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, k))) \Rightarrow (z \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e.; \forall z \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e). \exists k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (e \subseteq \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e) \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(1, u), \operatorname{act}(m)(0, y)) = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, m, e.; \forall u \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e), w \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, k), s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((0 \leq s) \wedge (s \leq 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - s), u), \operatorname{act}(m)(s, w)) \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, m, e, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge (e \subseteq a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, k) \subseteq a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, k) \wedge (e \subseteq k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e) \subseteq k \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/sip-d1.scm}{theorem-library/sip-d1.scm}
\noindent{\small sip-d1.scm -- REAL HILBERT SPACES BY THE COMPLEXIFICATION ROUTE: the norm and metric of a pre-Hilbert space, completeness of the complexification, the orthogonal projection onto a closed subspace, and the complex corollary.  (SIP-D, 2026-10-19; scratchpad/triage/SIP-D.md.)  All PROVEN modulo 0.  Vocabulary:}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}rip-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) = \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}minkowski}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y))} \leq (\sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)} + \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v) \simeq \operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}carrier}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vneg}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nrm}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v))(x) = \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}phs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))) \simeq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))) \simeq [\operatorname{vzero}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(v)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(x, \mathit{qx}) \\ \quad \quad =\; [\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx}))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(x) = [\operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x)), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))}(x, \mathit{qx}) \\ \quad \quad =\; ((\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx}))) - (+i \cdot (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x)), \operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))}(x, x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{nth}(1, x)) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{nth}(2, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, z, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(z, x) \\ \quad \quad =\; [\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z), \operatorname{nth}(1, x)), \operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x)))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z), \operatorname{nth}(2, x)), \operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z), \operatorname{nth}(1, x)))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complexify-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cphs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cips}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (\mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))))(x, \mathit{qx}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \sqrt{(\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx}))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})))) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx}))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx})))))} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}comp1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (\mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))))(x, \mathit{qx}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}comp2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (\mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx})) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))))(x, \mathit{qx}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (\mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))))(x, \mathit{qx}) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})) + \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}dominated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, \mathit{tm}, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\mathit{tm}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(\mathit{tm})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\mathit{tm})(g(m), g(n)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(s)(f(m), f(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\mathit{tm}, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}dominated-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t_{1}, t_{2}, f, g_{1}, g_{2}, l, l_{1}, l_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(t_{1}, g_{1}, l_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(t_{2}, g_{2}, l_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(f(n), l) \leq (\operatorname{dist}(t_{1})(\operatorname{g1}(n), l_{1}) + \operatorname{dist}(t_{2})(\operatorname{g2}(n), l_{2})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, f, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complexify-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complexify-\allowbreak{}hilbert}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad ({s}^{\perp} \simeq \{p \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall k \in s.\; (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(p, k) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, z. \\ \quad (z \in {s}^{\perp}) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \forall k \in s.\; (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(z, k) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}orth}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, s, z, k.\; (((z \in {s}^{\perp}) \wedge (k \in s)) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(z, k) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow ({s}^{\perp} \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, {s}^{\perp}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complexify-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)), (k \times k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complexify-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}comp1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k.; \forall z \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))), (k \times k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, z) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complexify-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}comp2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k.; \forall z \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))), (k \times k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(2, z) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complexify-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))), (k \times k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)) \in {k}^{\perp}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k, b \in {k}^{\perp}.\; (x = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}decomposition-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a_{1}, a_{2}, b_{1}, b_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad b_{1} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad b_{2} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, b_{1}) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, b_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a_{1} = a_{2}) \wedge (b_{1} = b_{2}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}pythagoras}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, a, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(m, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(m, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(m, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(m, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(m, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k. \forall b \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, x, a_{1}, a_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in k. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in k. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a_{1} = a_{2} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a(x) \in k) \wedge (\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a(x))) \in {k}^{\perp}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \Rightarrow (a \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{srpk}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, \mathit{srpk}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a(x), a(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{act}(v)(c, x)) = \operatorname{act}(v)(c, a(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}fixes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge (y \in k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a(y) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}idempotent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(a(x)) = a(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, o.; \forall z \in {k}^{\perp}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad o \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antisymmetric\text{-}op}(v, o) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{sjk} \in k.\; (o(\mathit{sjk}) \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad o(z) \in {k}^{\perp} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}commutes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, o.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(v, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}antisymmetric\text{-}op}(v, o) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{sjk} \in k.\; (o(\mathit{sjk}) \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(o(x)) = o(a(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in s \wedge \\ \quad b \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}variational-\allowbreak{}closest}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a.; \forall d \in s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) \leq 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, \mathit{qx}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (\mathit{qx} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v))}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(x, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(\mathit{qx})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(x, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(\mathit{qx}))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx}))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{qx})))) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx}))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, x), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{qx})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxw-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}midpoint-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s.; \forall m_{1}, m_{2} \in (s \times s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(v)))(m_{1}, m_{2})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (s \times s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in s. \forall b \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}variational-\allowbreak{}necessary}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a.; \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) \leq 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}closest-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}variational}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall d \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) \leq 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/sip-quotient-complete.scm}{theorem-library/sip-quotient-complete.scm}
\noindent{\small sip-quotient-complete.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-30 (wave-2 integration) out of theorem-library/l2-hilbert.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by real-riesz (analysis); a semi-inner-product-space fact. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad \quad \forall b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m, q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((c \leq m) \wedge (c \leq q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(m), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(s(q))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(m), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(s(q))))} \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \forall b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (c \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(n), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(n), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)))} \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{structure-library/cnvs-vocab.scm}{structure-library/cnvs-vocab.scm}
\noindent{\small cnvs-vocab.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CNVS), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/cnvs-1109/cnvs-vocab.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}complex-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}complex-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (s \in \mathbf{Set}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/l2-hilbert.scm}{theorem-library/l2-hilbert.scm}
\noindent{\small l2-hilbert.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/md/me-l2.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{epow-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq t) \Rightarrow ({t}^{2} = (t \cdot t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}times-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\lvert a \rvert \cdot \lvert a \rvert) = (a \cdot a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}lp-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(f, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(g)), \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(f, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(g)))} \\ \quad \quad =\; \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) - g(x)))}\|_{2} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}lp2-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \Leftrightarrow (\|{f}\|_{2} \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall d. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m, q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((f \leq m) \wedge (f \leq q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u)}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(s(m), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(s(q))), \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(s(m), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(s(q))))} \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u)). \forall d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (f \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u)}(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(s(n), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(s(n), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, u))(a)))} \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}hilbert}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/l2c-a.scm}{theorem-library/l2c-a.scm}
\noindent{\small l2c-a.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-L2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/l2/l2c-a.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}sip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)))) \simeq (\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)) \times \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a_{1}, a_{2}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{1}), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{2})] \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)))) \simeq [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(v)), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(v))]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a_{1}, a_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad x = [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{1}), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{2})] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a_{1}, a_{2}, b_{1}, b_{2}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((a_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((b_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))))([\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{1}), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{2})], \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), b_{1}), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), b_{2})]) \\ \quad \quad =\; [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, b_{1})), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, b_{2}))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, z, a_{1}, a_{2}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((a_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v))))(z, \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{1}), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{2})]) \\ \quad \quad =\; [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z), a_{1}), \operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a_{2})))), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z), a_{2}), \operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z), a_{1})))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cxq-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a_{1}, a_{2}, b_{1}, b_{2}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((a_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((b_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(v)))}([\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{1}), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), a_{2})], \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), b_{1}), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(v), b_{2})]) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(a_{1}, b_{1}) + \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(a_{2}, b_{2})) + (+i \cdot (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(a_{2}, b_{1}) - \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(a_{1}, b_{2}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u}) \simeq \operatorname{csip\text{-}cips}(\operatorname{complexify}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}quotient}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u})) \simeq (\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))) \times \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), c), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), d)] \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u})). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c, d \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u). \\ \quad \quad \quad x = [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), c), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), d)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u})}([\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), c), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), d)], \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), f), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), g)]) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (c(x) \cdot f(x)))) + \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (d(x) \cdot g(x))))) + (+i \cdot (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (d(x) \cdot f(x)))) - \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (c(x) \cdot g(x)))))) \end{array}}}
