\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}ae}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), f) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), g) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, n) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in n) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/real-riesz.scm}{theorem-library/real-riesz.scm}
\noindent{\small real-riesz.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/md/me-rz.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}riesz-\allowbreak{}representation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = (f(x) + f(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\operatorname{act}(v)(r, x)) = (r \cdot f(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \forall \mathit{rzx} \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\mathit{rzx}) = \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\mathit{rzx}, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sip-\allowbreak{}riesz-\allowbreak{}representation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad \quad \forall c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m, q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((d \leq m) \wedge (d \leq q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(m), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(s(q))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(m), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(s(q))))} \leq c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \forall c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (d \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(n), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(s(n), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)))} \leq c \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = (f(x) + f(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\operatorname{act}(v)(r, x)) = (r \cdot f(x))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\lvert f(x) \rvert \leq (b \cdot \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \forall \mathit{rzx} \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(\mathit{rzx}) = \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\mathit{rzx}, e)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/push-forward.scm}{theorem-library/push-forward.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/push-forward.scm -- Borel preimages under a continuous map, the push-forward of a measure, and the change of variables formula (RM-3B, 2026-10-10).  Vocabulary: structure-library/push-forward.scm (PUSH-FORWARD). Source: Thayer, Construction of Measures, Prop. 1.19 and Ch. 2 s. 7,}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}push-\allowbreak{}forward-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, b, u, h) \simeq (\lambda \mathit{pwb} \in b.\; u(\{x \in a : (h(x) \in \mathit{pwb})\}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}push-\allowbreak{}forward-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, u, h.; \forall b \in c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, h)(b) \simeq u(\{x \in a : (h(x) \in b)\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}preimage-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge ((a_{2} \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (h \in (a \to a_{2})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a_{2}, \{e \in \operatorname{power}(a_{2}) : (\{x \in a : (h(x) \in e)\} \in b)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \Rightarrow (u \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}preimage}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, h, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, h) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (h(x) \in b)\} \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, h) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), \operatorname{pts}(t), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t), h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}enlarge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, c, h, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, d) \wedge (b \subseteq d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, d, a_{2}, c, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}push-\allowbreak{}forward-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, \operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, f, h.; \forall x \in a.\; ((\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))(x) \simeq f(h(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, a_{2}, d, f, h. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((h \in (a \to a_{2})) \wedge (f \in (a_{2} \to d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z))) \in (a \to d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}fn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, c, h, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}simple-\allowbreak{}change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}variables}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, h, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda z \in a.\; s(h(z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a_{2}, c, \operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, h), s) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, (\lambda z \in a.\; s(h(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}variables}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, h, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a_{2}, c, \operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, h), f) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}comp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, a_{2}.; \forall f \in (a_{2} \to \mathbb{R}), h \in (a \to a_{2}), v \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z))))(v) = (\lambda z \in a.\; \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a_{2}, f)(h(z)))(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}comp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, a_{2}.; \forall f \in (a_{2} \to \mathbb{R}), h \in (a \to a_{2}), v \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z))))(v) = (\lambda z \in a.\; \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a_{2}, f)(h(z)))(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, c, h, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}integrable-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, h, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a_{2}, c, \operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, h), f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pfw-\allowbreak{}change-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}variables-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, h, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a_{2}, c, \operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, h), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a_{2}, c, \operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, h), f) = \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(h(z)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/lp-measure-isomorphism.scm}{theorem-library/lp-measure-isomorphism.scm}
\noindent{\small lp-measure-isomorphism.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/md/md-iso.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}preserving-\allowbreak{}push-\allowbreak{}forward}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, d, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mib} \in c.\; (d(\mathit{mib}) = u(\{x \in a : (t(x) \in \mathit{mib})\})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{push\text{-}forward}(a, c, u, t) = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{comp-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}preserving-\allowbreak{}lp-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, d, t, f, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mib} \in c.\; (d(\mathit{mib}) = u(\{x \in a : (t(x) \in \mathit{mib})\})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))}\|_{p} = \|{f}\|_{p} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a_{2}, b, u, f, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, b, f) \wedge (m \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a_{2} : (m < \lvert f(x) \rvert)\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{comp-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}preserving-\allowbreak{}level-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, d, t, f, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mib} \in c.\; (d(\mathit{mib}) = u(\{x \in a : (t(x) \in \mathit{mib})\})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\{\mathit{lix} \in a : (m < \lvert (\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))(\mathit{lix}) \rvert)\}) = d(\{\mathit{lix} \in a_{2} : (m < \lvert f(\mathit{lix}) \rvert)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{comp-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}preserving-\allowbreak{}linf-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, c, d, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, a_{2}, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mib} \in c.\; (d(\mathit{mib}) = u(\{x \in a : (t(x) \in \mathit{mib})\})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, c, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))) = \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a_{2}, c, d, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}isomorphism-\allowbreak{}lp-\allowbreak{}isomorphism}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, a_{2}, d, h, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, d, h) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measure\text{-}isomorphism}(a, b, u, a_{2}, d, h, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, d, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (1 \leq p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \|{(\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))}\|_{p} = \|{f}\|_{p} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, (\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))) = \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a_{2}, d, h, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall f, g \in (a_{2} \to \mathbb{R}), c \in \mathbb{R}, x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda z \in a.\; (\lambda y \in a_{2}.\; (f(y) + (c \cdot g(y))))(t(z)))(x) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; (\lambda z \in a.\; f(t(z)))(x) + (c \cdot (\lambda z \in a.\; g(t(z)))(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a_{2}, d, f) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (g(x) = f(t(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb4-borel-subspace.scm}{theorem-library/mb4-borel-subspace.scm}
\noindent{\small mb4-borel-subspace.scm -- construction of measures, Proposition 5.2: the Borel sets of a subspace are the traces of the Borel sets (M-B4, 2026-10-26).  Library: measure.  Helper prefixes mbk- (the kit copied from theorem-library/push-forward.scm, pfw- renamed) and mbs-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{mbs-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, y.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (y \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (e \cap y) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mbs-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}trace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, y.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, y)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (y \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s).\; (b = (e \cap y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, y, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (y \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, y))) \Leftrightarrow \exists e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s).\; (b = (e \cap y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb4-borel-product.scm}{theorem-library/mb4-borel-product.scm}
\noindent{\small mb4-borel-product.scm -- construction of measures, Proposition 5.3: for separable metric spaces X, Y the Borel sets of X x Y (the max metric, PRODUCT2-MS) are the product sigma-algebra of the Borel sets (M-B4, 2026-10-26).  Library: measure.  Helper prefixes mbk- (kit copied from push-forward.scm) and mbp-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{mbp-\allowbreak{}rect-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t.; \forall a \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \times b) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mbp-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t.; \forall e \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), \operatorname{pts}(t), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mbp-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}sigma}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, e.; \forall \mathit{mpa} \in e.\; ((\mathit{mpa} \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{mpa} \in \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(a, e)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mbp-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t), u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), \operatorname{pts}(t), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mbp-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), \operatorname{pts}(t), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) = \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), \operatorname{pts}(t), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb4-sigma-finite.scm}{theorem-library/mb4-sigma-finite.scm}
\noindent{\small mb4-sigma-finite.scm -- construction of measures, Proposition 7.7 (M-B4, 2026-10-26): a Borel measure on a separable metric space whose balls of radius r $<$ r0 have finite measure (inequality (192)) is sigma-finite: the balls of a fixed radius r $<$ r0 around a dense sequence cover X.  Library: measure.  Helper prefix ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ball-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (r < a)) \Rightarrow ((0 < u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r))) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb4-separable-measure.scm}{theorem-library/mb4-separable-measure.scm}
\noindent{\small mb4-separable-measure.scm -- construction of measures, Corollary 7.6 (M-B4, 2026-10-26): under the assumptions of Proposition 7.1 with r0 = +inf (every ball has finite positive measure, and for each radius the measures of the balls of that radius are uniformly comparable), X is separable.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ball-\allowbreak{}packing-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall b \in \operatorname{pts}(s), d \in \mathbb{R}, h.; \forall c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(k) \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < k) \Rightarrow ((h + h) < \operatorname{dist}(s)(c(j), c(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a \leq u(\operatorname{ball}(s, c(k), h))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (u(\operatorname{ball}(s, b, (d + (h + h)))) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ball-\allowbreak{}greedy-\allowbreak{}net}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall b \in \operatorname{pts}(s), d \in \mathbb{R}, l, h, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad (h + h) < l \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ball}(s, b, (d + l))) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (a \leq u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, h))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)). \forall p \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, d). \exists i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad p \in \operatorname{ball}(s, f(i), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow ((0 < u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r))) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((c \cdot u(\operatorname{ball}(s, y, r))) \leq u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/measure-ch1-algebras.scm}{theorem-library/measure-ch1-algebras.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/measure-ch1-algebras.scm -- ALGEBRAS OF SETS: atoms, finite unions, rectangles of R\textasciicircum{}n (M-A, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26).  Vocabulary: structure-library/measure-ch1-vocab.scm. Source: Thayer, Construction of Measures, ch. 1 s. 1.  Helper prefix: ma-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}meet-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (s \subseteq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{y \in a : \forall \mathit{mmb} \in s.\; (y \in \mathit{mmb})\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{atoms-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{atoms}(a) \simeq \{t \in a : \operatorname{is\text{-}atom}(a, t)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{atoms-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b, a.\; ((a \in \operatorname{atoms}(b)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}atom}(b, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}atom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge (|b| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{y \in a : \forall \mathit{mmb} \in \{c \in b : (x \in c)\}.\; (y \in \mathit{mmb})\} \in \operatorname{atoms}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad x \in \{y \in a : \forall \mathit{mmb} \in \{c \in b : (x \in c)\}.\; (y \in \mathit{mmb})\} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{mqb} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad (x \in \mathit{mqb}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in a : \forall \mathit{mmb} \in \{c \in b : (x \in c)\}.\; (y \in \mathit{mmb})\} \subseteq \mathit{mqb} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{atoms-\allowbreak{}pairwise-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(c, d) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{atoms}(d)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{atoms}(d)) \wedge \neg (a = b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \cap b) = \emptyset \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebra-\allowbreak{}atom-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c.; \forall a \in c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(b, c) \wedge (|c| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((a = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, \{s \in \operatorname{atoms}(c) : (s \subseteq a)\}, u)) \wedge (a = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, \operatorname{atoms}(c), (a \cap u)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}atoms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(c, d) \wedge (|d| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{atoms}(d) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{atoms}(d)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((a \in \operatorname{atoms}(d)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{atoms}(d)) \wedge \neg (a = b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (a \cap b) = \emptyset \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a \in d. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((a = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, \{s \in \operatorname{atoms}(d) : (s \subseteq a)\}, u)) \wedge (a = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, \operatorname{atoms}(d), (a \cap u)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{big-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, \emptyset, w) = \emptyset}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{big-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}singleton-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, \{x\}, w) = x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{big-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, (f \cup g), w) = (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, f, w) \cup \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, g, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i) \simeq \{u \in \operatorname{power}(a) : \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}.\; ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((f \subseteq i) \wedge (u = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, f, w))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (f \subseteq i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, f, w) \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall s \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i). \\ \quad ((s \in \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}.\; ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((f \subseteq i) \wedge (s = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(w, f, w))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow (\emptyset \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, i.; \forall a \in i. \\ \quad ((b \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(b))) \Rightarrow (a \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(b, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i, s, t. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a)) \wedge ((s \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i)) \wedge (t \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (s \cup t) \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, i, a, t. \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mia}, \mathit{mib}.\; (((\mathit{mia} \in i) \wedge (\mathit{mib} \in i)) \Rightarrow ((\mathit{mia} \cap \mathit{mib}) \in i)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in i \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(b, i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a \cap t) \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(b, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i, s, t. \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mia}, b.\; (((\mathit{mia} \in i) \wedge (b \in i)) \Rightarrow ((\mathit{mia} \cap b) \in i)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (s \cap t) \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall s \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i). \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mia}, b.\; (((\mathit{mia} \in i) \wedge (b \in i)) \Rightarrow ((\mathit{mia} \cap b) \in i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mia} \in i.\; (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \mathit{mia}) \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, s) \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq \operatorname{power}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mia}, b.\; (((\mathit{mia} \in i) \wedge (b \in i)) \Rightarrow ((\mathit{mia} \cap b) \in i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mia} \in i.\; (\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \mathit{mia}) \in \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}(a, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(\mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(a)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}((s \cap a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, i, k. \\ \quad (j(i) \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : \forall y \in j(i).\; ((i = k) \Rightarrow (z < y))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}above-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j, i, k. \\ \quad (j(i) \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : \forall y \in j(i).\; ((i = k) \Rightarrow (y < z))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interval-\allowbreak{}outside-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}above}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(s) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \neg (x \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in s.\; (x < y) \vee \forall y \in s.\; (y < x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, j. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, j) \simeq \{x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) : \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (x(i) \in j(i))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}rectangles-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n) \simeq \{r \in \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) : \exists j \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R})).\; (\forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(j(i)) \wedge (r = \operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, j)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n.\; ((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, x, j. \\ \quad (x \in \operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, j)) \Leftrightarrow ((x \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (x(i) \in j(i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}box-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n, j.\; (\operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, j) \in \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n.; \forall j \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R})). \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(j(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, j) \in \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n.; \forall r \in \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n). \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \exists j \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R})). \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(j(i)) \wedge (r = \operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}rectangles-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \cap b) \in \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}rectangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, j, k. \\ \quad ((j \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}))) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(j(i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, (\lambda \mathit{mki} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \{z \in \mathbb{R} : \forall y \in j(\mathit{mki}).\; ((\mathit{mki} = k) \Rightarrow (z < y))\})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}ray-\allowbreak{}above-\allowbreak{}rectangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, j, k. \\ \quad ((j \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}))) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(j(i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, (\lambda \mathit{mki} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \{z \in \mathbb{R} : \forall y \in j(\mathit{mki}).\; ((\mathit{mki} = k) \Rightarrow (y < z))\})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}rectangles-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n.\; (\operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n) \subseteq \operatorname{power}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}rectangle-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, j \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R})). \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}interval}(j(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}), \operatorname{rn\text{-}box}(n, j)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}), \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}rectangles-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}unions-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finite\text{-}unions}((\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{R}), \operatorname{rn\text{-}rectangles}(n))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/measure-ch1-pullback.scm}{theorem-library/measure-ch1-pullback.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/measure-ch1-pullback.scm -- THE PULLBACK SIGMA-ALGEBRA AND THE PULLBACK MEASURE (M-A, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26).  Vocabulary: structure-library/measure-ch1-vocab.scm (PULLBACK-SIGMA, PULLBACK-MEASURE).  Source: Thayer, Construction of Measures, ch. 1, Prop. 1.14 and Prop. 1.22. Helper prefix: ma-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f) \simeq \{\mathit{mpa} \in \operatorname{power}(a) : \exists \mathit{mpb} \in b.\; (\mathit{mpa} = \{x \in a : (f(x) \in \mathit{mpb})\})\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, f, a. \\ \quad (a \in \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(b, c, f)) \Leftrightarrow ((a \in \operatorname{power}(b)) \wedge \exists \mathit{mpb} \in c.\; (a = \{x \in b : (f(x) \in \mathit{mpb})\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a_{2}, b) \wedge (f \in (a \to a_{2}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a_{2}, b) \wedge (f \in (a \to a_{2}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f), a_{2}, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}smallest}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, f, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a_{2}, b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to a_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, c, a_{2}, b, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f) \subseteq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a_{2}, b) \wedge (f \in (a \to a_{2}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f), a_{2}, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall c. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, c, a_{2}, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f) \subseteq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, b, f, u) \simeq (\lambda m \in \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f).\; u(\operatorname{image}(f, m)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{image-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f.\; (\operatorname{image}(f, \emptyset) = \emptyset)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{image-\allowbreak{}preimage-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}surjection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, a_{2}.; \forall f \in (a \to a_{2}), b. \\ \quad (\forall y \in a_{2}.\; \exists x \in a.\; (f(x) = y) \wedge (b \subseteq a_{2})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(f, \{\mathit{mpx} \in a : (f(\mathit{mpx}) \in b)\}) = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{image-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) \simeq \operatorname{image}(f, g(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n))) = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, h(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, a_{2}, f, u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(b, c, f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, u) \wedge ((f \in (b \to a_{2})) \wedge \forall y \in a_{2}.\; \exists x \in b.\; (f(x) = y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{image}(f, a) \in c) \wedge (\operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(b, c, f, u)(a) = u(\operatorname{image}(f, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, a_{2}, f, u.; \forall b \in c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, u) \wedge ((f \in (a \to a_{2})) \wedge \forall y \in a_{2}.\; \exists x \in a.\; (f(x) = y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, c, f, u)(\{\mathit{mpx} \in a : (f(\mathit{mpx}) \in b)\}) = u(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, f, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, b, u) \wedge ((f \in (a \to a_{2})) \wedge \forall y \in a_{2}.\; \exists x \in a.\; (f(x) = y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, b, f, u) \in (\operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f) \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, a_{2}, f, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, b, u) \wedge ((f \in (a \to a_{2})) \wedge \forall y \in a_{2}.\; \exists x \in a.\; (f(x) = y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, b, f), \operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, b, f, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, a_{2}, f, u, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to a_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a_{2}.\; \exists x \in a.\; (f(x) = y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, c, f), d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in c.\; (d(\{\mathit{mpx} \in a : (f(\mathit{mpx}) \in b)\}) = u(b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d = \operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, c, f, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pullback-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}exists-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, a_{2}, f, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a_{2}, c, u) \wedge ((f \in (a \to a_{2})) \wedge \forall y \in a_{2}.\; \exists x \in a.\; (f(x) = y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, c, f), \operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, c, f, u)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b \in c.\; (\operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, c, f, u)(\{\mathit{mpx} \in a : (f(\mathit{mpx}) \in b)\}) = u(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{pullback\text{-}sigma}(a, c, f), d) \wedge \forall b \in c.\; (d(\{\mathit{mpx} \in a : (f(\mathit{mpx}) \in b)\}) = u(b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad d = \operatorname{pullback\text{-}measure}(a, c, f, u) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/measure-ch1-vitali.scm}{theorem-library/measure-ch1-vitali.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/measure-ch1-vitali.scm -- NO TRANSLATION-INVARIANT MEASURE ON ALL SUBSETS OF R (VITALI) (M-A, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26).  Source: Thayer, Construction of Measures, ch. 1, Prop. 1.23. Vocabulary: TRANSLATE (structure-library/lebesgue-translate.scm).  Helper prefix: ma- (kit), mv- (Vitali).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (x - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}symm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad y \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad (y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (x - y) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}d-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, z. \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad y \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad (x - y) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \wedge \\ \quad (y - z) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (x - z) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \wedge (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}d}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, j. \\ \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (j \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{recip}((j + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, j. \\ \quad ((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{recip}((i + 1)) = \operatorname{recip}((j + 1))))) \Rightarrow (i = j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad (a - b) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists \mathit{mva}, \mathit{mvb}, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mva} - \mathit{mvb}) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - a) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists \mathit{mva}, \mathit{mvb}, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mva} - \mathit{mvb}) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\} \\ \quad \quad =\; \{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - b) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists \mathit{mva}, \mathit{mvb}, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mva} - \mathit{mvb}) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}choice}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}) \\ \quad \in\; \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \wedge \\ \quad (\varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}) - x) \\ \quad \in\; \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\} \wedge \\ \quad \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}) \\ \quad \in\; \{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists \mathit{mvx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - \mathit{mvx}) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}constant-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < c) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) = c)) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{esum}(f) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{translate-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, c.\; ((s + c) \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}case}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (u((s + t)) = u(s)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}))\}) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}case}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (u((s + t)) = u(s)) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (0 < u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}choice-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}))\}) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \\ \quad \quad \leq\; u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \{d \in \mathbb{R} : \exists a, b, c \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a - b) = ((c + 1) \cdot d))\})\}))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}d}}{\vnbstmt{\neg \exists u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge (\forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (u((s + t)) = u(s)) \wedge ((0 < u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1))) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R}))))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/measure-ch1-vitali-q.scm}{theorem-library/measure-ch1-vitali-q.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/measure-ch1-vitali-q.scm -- VITALI (Prop. 1.23) WITH Q, AS THE NOTES PROVE IT (2026-10-26). The same proof as measure-ch1-vitali.scm, with the equivalence x == y iff x - y in QQ (the notes' (13)), QQ enumerated by qq-enumerated (theorem-library/qq-countable.scm, through the primitive generation axioms). ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((x - x) \in \mathbb{Q})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}symm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q}))) \Rightarrow ((x - y) \in \mathbb{Q}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, z. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((z \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (((x - y) \in \mathbb{Q}) \wedge ((y - z) \in \mathbb{Q}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x - z) \in \mathbb{Q} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i, j.\; (((i \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (j \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{recip}((j + 1)) - \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))) \in \mathbb{Q}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a - b) \in \mathbb{Q}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - a) \in \mathbb{Q})\} = \{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - b) \in \mathbb{Q})\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}choice}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q})\}) \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \wedge \\ \quad (\varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q})\}) - x) \in \mathbb{Q} \wedge \\ \quad \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q})\}) \\ \quad \in\; \{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists \mathit{mvx} \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - \mathit{mvx}) \in \mathbb{Q})\}))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}case}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (u((s + t)) = u(s)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q})\}))\}) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}case}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (u((s + t)) = u(s)) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (0 < u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q})\}))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}choice-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q})\}))\}) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq u(\{h \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : \exists x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (h = \varepsilon(\{y \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) : ((y - x) \in \mathbb{Q})\}))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vitali-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\neg \exists u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), u) \wedge (\forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{R}), t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (u((s + t)) = u(s)) \wedge ((0 < u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1))) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \in \mathbb{R}))))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/riesz-markov.scm}{theorem-library/riesz-markov.scm}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/riesz-markov-compact.scm}{theorem-library/riesz-markov-compact.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/riesz-markov-compact.scm -- RIESZ-MARKOV on a compact metric space (RM-3A follow-up, 2026-10-10).  Prefix rmz-.  Source: the user's notes-63, form (b).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmz-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q.; \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)).\; f(\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(z))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmz-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow ((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; 1) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmz-\allowbreak{}lm-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, x.; \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)).\; f(\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(z))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)) : \exists \mathit{rzf} \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s).\; (g = (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)).\; \operatorname{rzf}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(z))))\} \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\lambda g \in \{g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)) : \exists \mathit{rzf} \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s).\; (g = (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)).\; \operatorname{rzf}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(z))))\}.\; x((\lambda \mathit{rzx} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; g(\operatorname{rm\text{-}code}(s, q, \mathit{rzx})))))((\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)).\; f(\operatorname{rm\text{-}pi}(s, q)(z)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; x(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmz-\allowbreak{}riesz-\allowbreak{}markov-\allowbreak{}dense}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) = x(f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmz-\allowbreak{}riesz-\allowbreak{}markov}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) = a(f))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-power-series-laws.scm}{theorem-library/cc-power-series-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-power-series-laws.scm -- COMPLEX POWER SERIES: THE RADIUS OF CONVERGENCE (Prop 2.7) AND WHAT FOLLOWS FROM IT, as the notes state them. Batch 25-A, 2026-09-24.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x, y \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{power}((x \cdot y), k) = (\operatorname{power}(x, k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(y, k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}conv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), s, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) < s) \wedge ((0 \leq r) \wedge ((r \cdot s) < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(k)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}div}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), s, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad 0 \leq s \wedge \\ \quad s < \operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq (r \cdot s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(k)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq r) \Rightarrow \exists s \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < s) \wedge ((r \cdot s) < 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}infinite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}recip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) = \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}root}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf} \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) = \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{elimsup}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))}^{{j}^{\ast\!-1}}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) \simeq \operatorname{esup}(\{r \in \mathbb{R} : ((0 \leq r) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(k)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, k)))))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}origin}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d.; \forall z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, d).\; ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq d))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{power}(z, k)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s.; \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq m) \wedge (\forall x \in s.\; (u(x) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(u(x)) \leq m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(u, s) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(u, s)) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(u, s) \leq m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq d) \wedge (d < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (d < t) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(k)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(t, k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}normally-\allowbreak{}convergent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq d) \wedge (d < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, d).\; (f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), d \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, d). \\ \quad ((0 \leq d) \wedge (d < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}((f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}block-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, m \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = \operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))) \wedge (m \leq k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) - \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, m))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = \operatorname{magnitude}(f(j))) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}to}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}(f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}(f) \in \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), d \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, d). \\ \quad ((0 \leq d) \wedge (d < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), d \in \mathbb{R}, e. \\ \quad ((0 \leq d) \wedge ((d < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, d). \\ \quad \quad \quad (n \leq m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k)))) - \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), m))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, m \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{power}(x, k), m) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{power}(x, m), k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}geom-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq q) \wedge (q < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq b) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(k, m) \cdot \operatorname{power}(q, k)) \leq b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), c \in \mathbb{R}, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(k)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) = (c \cdot f(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}conv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), c \in \mathbb{R}, m \in \mathbb{N}, t, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) = (f(k) \cdot g(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(g(k)) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{power}(k, m))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad d < t \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(k)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(t, k)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(d, k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), c \in \mathbb{R}, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) = (f(k) \cdot g(k))) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(g(k)) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{power}(k, m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) \leq \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/series-domination.scm}{theorem-library/series-domination.scm}
\noindent{\small series-domination.scm -- SHIFTING AND EVENTUAL DOMINATION FOR REAL SERIES. Batch 26-A, 2026-09-24.  The two lemmas the batch-25 report named as standing in the way of Proposition 2.10 (theorem-library/cc-power-series-deriv.scm):}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = f((j + 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, (k + 1)) = (f(0) + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(j)) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(j) = f((j + 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(f) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}dominated-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq f(j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq g(j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq j) \Rightarrow (f(j) \leq g(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \leq (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, k)) \end{array}}}
