\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, k, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, (k \cap f))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb35-regular.scm}{theorem-library/mb35-regular.scm}
\noindent{\small mb35-regular.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 section 2: approximation of Borel measures on metric spaces by closed, open and compact sets (M-B35 / B3, 2026-10-26).  Library: measure.  Helper prefix mr-. Closed and open sets are IS-CLOSED / IS-OPEN; no CLOSURE, no INTERIOR.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \leq (u(f(k)) + s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \Rightarrow (a \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}layer-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, l.; \forall z \in l, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (l \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}inner-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge \\ \quad a(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge ((f \subseteq u) \wedge (a(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, f)) \leq b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, (a \cup b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to c), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a(n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), a(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)), b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge \\ \quad a(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f, u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq g(n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad g(n) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, f)) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f, u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(c, \mathbb{N}, g(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(c, \mathbb{N}, g(c)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, f)) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge ((a(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f, u. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge ((f \subseteq e) \wedge ((e \subseteq u) \wedge (a(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, f)) \leq b))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge ((a(\operatorname{pts}(s)) = 1) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f, u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq e \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, f)) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (a(u) - b) \leq a(e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a(e) \leq (a(f) + b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall v \in b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, (\lambda r \in b.\; u((r \cap v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, c(n)) \wedge (a(c(n)) \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(d, \mathbb{N}, c(d)) = \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \\ \quad a(e) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge ((e \subseteq u) \wedge (a(u) \leq (a(e) + b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}regular}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, a(n)) \wedge (u(a(n)) \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(b, \mathbb{N}, a(b)) = \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(e) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{einf}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists \mathit{mru} \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, \mathit{mru}) \wedge ((e \subseteq \mathit{mru}) \wedge (v = u(\mathit{mru}))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}compare-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \Rightarrow (b(u) \leq a(u))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, c(n)) \wedge (a(c(n)) \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(d, \mathbb{N}, c(d)) = \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b(e) \leq a(e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{regular-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}tight}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}measure}(s, u) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists k \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)).\; ((k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge (v = u(k))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, g, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge ((u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n))) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n))) \leq (u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(m), g(j))) + s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tight-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}full-\allowbreak{}balls}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(i, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{ball}(s, x(i), r))) = u(\operatorname{pts}(s)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad (k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \leq (u(k) + a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tight-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}regular}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \leq (u(k) + a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}measure}(s, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polish-\allowbreak{}probability-\allowbreak{}regular}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) = 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}measure}(s, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{regular-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}separable-\allowbreak{}support}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) = 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}measure}(s, u) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, e)) \wedge (u(e) = 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/radon-nikodym.scm}{theorem-library/radon-nikodym.scm}
\noindent{\small radon-nikodym.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/md/md-rn.scm, scratchpad/md/me-rn.scm, scratchpad/md/me-rn2.scm, scratchpad/md/me-rn3.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{density-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}absolutely-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, f, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absolutely\text{-}continuous}(a, b, u, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mma} \in b.\; (u(\mathit{mma}) \leq c(\mathit{mma})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, u, s) \leq \operatorname{simple\text{-}integral}(a, c, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mma} \in b.\; (u(\mathit{mma}) \leq c(\mathit{mma})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, h) \leq \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}fn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\|{\operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, g)}\|_{p} \simeq \|{g}\|_{p}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}integrable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((u(a) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, g)) \leq (\sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)}(g, g)} \cdot \sqrt{u(a)}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}dominated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge ((c(a) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \forall \mathit{mma} \in b.\; (u(\mathit{mma}) \leq c(\mathit{mma}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (d(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, d, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{etimes-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}commute}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad ((a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(a, \operatorname{etimes}(c, b)) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{etimes}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measure-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, (\lambda \mathit{rsa} \in b.\; \operatorname{eplus}(u(\mathit{rsa}), c(\mathit{rsa})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{scale-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}indicator-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge (a \in c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}scale}(b, \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}, \operatorname{indicator}(b, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esup-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}.\; (\operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda u \in \mathbb{N}.\; c), \mathbb{N})) = c)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}etimes-\allowbreak{}sup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, h, f. \\ \quad a \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad h \in (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, f(n), f((n + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, h, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{etimes}(h(x), f(k)(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{density-\allowbreak{}change}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, u, h, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, h, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, h, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{recip-\allowbreak{}compare}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, t.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < t))) \Rightarrow ((a < \operatorname{recip}(t)) \Leftrightarrow ((a \cdot t) < 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}recip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (h(x) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda \mathit{rrx} \in a.\; \left(\text{if }(0 < h(\mathit{rrx}))\text{ then }\operatorname{recip}(h(\mathit{rrx}))\text{ else }0\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{radon-\allowbreak{}nikodym-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad u(a) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c(a) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absolutely\text{-}continuous}(a, b, u, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, q, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{increasing-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall j, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m(k) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (m(k) \subseteq m((k + 1))) \wedge (k \leq j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad m(k) \subseteq m(j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}common-\allowbreak{}partition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (i = j) \Rightarrow ((d(i) \cap d(j)) = \emptyset) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, d(n)) = a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{sfn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(d(\mathit{sfn})) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{sfn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(d(\mathit{sfn})) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rn-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}piece}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absolutely\text{-}continuous}(a, b, u, c) \wedge \\ \quad v \in b \wedge \\ \quad u(v) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c(v) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u((\mathit{rna} \cap v)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}), \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, \operatorname{indicator}(a, v), q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{radon-\allowbreak{}nikodym-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absolutely\text{-}continuous}(a, b, u, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, q, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{radon-\allowbreak{}nikodym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absolutely\text{-}continuous}(a, b, u, c) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, q, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/l1-dual.scm}{theorem-library/l1-dual.scm}
\noindent{\small l1-dual.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/md/me-du1.scm, scratchpad/md/me-du2.scm, scratchpad/md/me-du3.scm, scratchpad/md/me-du4.scm, scratchpad/md/me-du5.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{linf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}essential-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((0 \leq \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f)) \wedge (u(\{x \in a : (\operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) < \lvert f(x) \rvert)\}) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, g. \\ \quad (g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \Leftrightarrow ((g \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbf{Set}, b, u.\; (\operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \in \mathbf{Set})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}pairing-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f.; \forall g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u). \\ \quad (\operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, f)(g) \simeq \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad u(\{x \in a : (m < \lvert f(x) \rvert)\}) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (f(\mathit{sx}) \cdot g(\mathit{sx})))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, (\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (f(\mathit{sx}) \cdot g(\mathit{sx}))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; m \cdot \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}pairing-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, \operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, f), \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{linf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, u, f.\; (\operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{indicator-\allowbreak{}l1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((p \in b) \wedge (u(p) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{indicator}(a, p) \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, \operatorname{indicator}(a, p))) = u(p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{indicator}(a, p)) = u(p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{positive-\allowbreak{}excess-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, d, p, u, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad p \in b \wedge \\ \quad d(p) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; ((x \in p) \Rightarrow (c < u(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in p) \Rightarrow (u(x) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, d, u) \leq (c \cdot d(p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d(p) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{linf-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}indicators}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in b. \\ \quad \quad (u(q) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{indicator}(a, q)(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \lvert \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{indicator}(a, q)(x)))) \rvert \leq (c \cdot u(q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) \leq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}pairing-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, \operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, f), c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) \leq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}functionals-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, f, h.; \forall i \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, f, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u).\; ((g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \Rightarrow (c(g) = f(g))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c(i) = f(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (u(a) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}onto-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((u(a) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, f, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{ldf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{ldf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, \mathit{ldf}) \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u).\; (f(g) = \operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, \mathit{ldf})(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (k = m) \Rightarrow (h(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, h, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \leq h(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (n \leq m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, h, \mathrm{OS}(n)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}term}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}), m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (k = m) \Rightarrow (h(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{esum}(h) = h(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{density-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, (\lambda \mathit{dma} \in b.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, h, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{dma}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}weight}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (t(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (0 < t(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, t) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weight-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, w, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (w(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (0 < w(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad c(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, w, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, h)) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}(a, (\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (h(\mathit{sx}) \cdot w(\mathit{sx}))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, h)) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}(a, (\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (h(\mathit{sx}) \cdot w(\mathit{sx}))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, c, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, h)) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{abs\text{-}fn}(a, (\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (h(\mathit{sx}) \cdot w(\mathit{sx}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weight-\allowbreak{}rintegral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, w, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (w(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (0 < w(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad c(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, w, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, c, h) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (h(\mathit{sx}) \cdot w(\mathit{sx})))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, c, h) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, c, h) = \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (h(\mathit{sx}) \cdot w(\mathit{sx})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l1-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, f, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{ldf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{ldf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, \mathit{ldf}) \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u).\; (f(g) = \operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, \mathit{ldf})(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{linf-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}l1-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(a, b, u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall f. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, \operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, f), \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall f, c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, \operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, f), c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, f) \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall f, c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}l1\text{-}functional}(a, b, u, f, c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{ldf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{ldf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{linf\text{-}norm}(a, b, u, \mathit{ldf}) \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall g \in \operatorname{l1\text{-}set}(a, b, u).\; (f(g) = \operatorname{l1\text{-}pairing}(a, b, u, \mathit{ldf})(g)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/jordan-decomposition.scm}{theorem-library/jordan-decomposition.scm}
\noindent{\small jordan-decomposition.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/mf/mf-jordan.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-tv.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{neg-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, u, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a) \simeq \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, \operatorname{signed\text{-}neg}(b, u))(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neg-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall \alpha \in b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \forall \alpha \in b.\; \neg (u(\alpha) = \operatorname{neg\text{-}inf})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R}) \vee \\ \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; (\operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{signed-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, u, a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \wedge ((a \in c) \wedge ((e \in c) \wedge ((e \subseteq a) \wedge (u(a) \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((u(e) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, e)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u(a) = (u(e) + u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, e)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{jordan-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, u, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \wedge ((a \in c) \wedge ((u(a) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a) \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a) \leq (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a) - u(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{jordan-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, u, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \wedge ((a \in c) \wedge ((u(a) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a) \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a) \leq (u(a) + \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{jordan-\allowbreak{}decomposition-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, u.; \forall a \in c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(a) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}sub}(\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a), \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{jordan-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, \operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(c, u)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in c.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R}) \vee \\ \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in c.\; (\operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(c, u)(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a \in c. \\ \quad \quad \quad u(a) = \operatorname{ext\text{-}sub}(\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a), \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(c, u)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{total-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}measure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, \operatorname{total\text{-}variation}(b, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b, c, a.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge (a \in c)) \Rightarrow (a \subseteq b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{total-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, u.; \forall a \in b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{total\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a) \simeq \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a), \operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(b, u)(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{total-\allowbreak{}variation-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}signed\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{total\text{-}variation\text{-}norm}(a, b, u) \in \mathbb{R} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall \alpha \in b.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; (\operatorname{neg\text{-}variation}(b, u)(\alpha) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rr-square-facts.scm}{theorem-library/rr-square-facts.scm}
\noindent{\small rr-square-facts.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/complex-measure-laws.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by the Hilbert-family files; RR arithmetic. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, t. \\ \quad ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq l) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq t)))) \Rightarrow ((l < \sqrt{t}) \Leftrightarrow ((l \cdot l) < t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}square-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((x \cdot x) = 0) \Rightarrow (x = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}square-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq a) \wedge (a \leq b)))) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot a) \leq (b \cdot b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}square-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}imp-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((a \cdot a) \leq (b \cdot b)))))) \Rightarrow (a \leq b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-bh.scm}{theorem-library/ba-bh.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-bh.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-BH), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/babh-1109/ba-bh.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{proj-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}orthogonal-\allowbreak{}projection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, E_{k}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{proj-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad E_{k} = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{proj-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(v, v, E_{k}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{minimizer-\allowbreak{}orthogonal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in k \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in k. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)) \in {k}^{\perp} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orthogonal-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i, a_{1}, a_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a_{1})) \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a_{2})) \in {k}^{\perp} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a_{1} = a_{2} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}range-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\mathrm{ran}\,{t} \simeq \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(w) : \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (y = t(x))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}range-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, y. \\ \quad (y \in \mathrm{ran}\,{t}) \Leftrightarrow ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (y = t(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{proj-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}range}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathrm{ran}\,{E_{k}} = k \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {{k}^{\perp}}^{\perp} = k \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow (\lVert x \rVert \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \lVert x \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert x \rVert) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}vector}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (\lVert x \rVert = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = \operatorname{vzero}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\lVert \operatorname{vzero}(v) \rVert = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, c, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{act}(v)(c, x) \rVert = (\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \lVert x \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}ops-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (L({v}, {w}) \simeq \{t \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) : \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}op}(v, w, t)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}ops-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (t \in L({v}, {w})) \Leftrightarrow ((t \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}op}(v, w, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, w.; \forall t \in L({v}, {w}).\; (t \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w.; \forall t \in L({v}, {w}). \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 \leq m) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\lVert t(x) \rVert \leq (m \cdot \lVert x \rVert)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, x, y. \\ \quad ((t \in L({v}, {w})) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(w)(t(x), t(y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\lVert t(x) \rVert \leq (m \cdot \lVert x \rVert)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opnorm-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert {t} \rVert \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \lVert {t} \rVert \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\lVert t(x) \rVert \leq (\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert x \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq d) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\lVert t(x) \rVert \leq (d \cdot \lVert x \rVert))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert {t} \rVert \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opnorm-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert {t} \rVert \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opnorm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \lVert {t} \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opnorm-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert t(x) \rVert \leq (\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert x \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (m \cdot \lVert x \rVert)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, m, y.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{box} \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\lVert t(\mathit{box}) \rVert \leq (m \cdot \lVert \mathit{box} \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(x), y)) \leq ((m \cdot \lVert y \rVert) \cdot \lVert x \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(x), y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(x), y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad ({t}^{*} \simeq (\lambda y \in \operatorname{vec}(w).\; (\iota\, z.\;((z \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(x), y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, z)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge ((t \in L({v}, {w})) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(w))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {t}^{*}(y) \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(x), y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, {t}^{*}(y))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}ip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(x), y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, {t}^{*}(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {t}^{*} \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v), y \in \operatorname{vec}(w).\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(x), y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, g(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {t}^{*} = g \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, m, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\lVert t(x) \rVert \leq (m \cdot \lVert x \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert {t}^{*}(y) \rVert \leq (m \cdot \lVert y \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(w, v, {t}^{*}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {t}^{*} \in L({w}, {v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}opnorm-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert {{t}^{*}} \rVert \leq \lVert {t} \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}involutive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {{t}^{*}}^{*} = t \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t, x. \\ \quad ((s \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge ((t \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}{t}(x) = s(t(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (1(x) = x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}{t} \in L({v}, {v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (1 \in L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}comp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {{s}{t}}^{*} = {{t}^{*}}{{s}^{*}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow ({1}^{*} = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opnorm-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert {{s}{t}} \rVert \leq (\lVert {s} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert {{{t}^{*}}{t}} \rVert = (\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(w)(t(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, w, t.\; (\ker {t} \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : (t(x) = \operatorname{vzero}(w))\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, y. \\ \quad (y \in \ker {t}) \Leftrightarrow ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (t(y) = \operatorname{vzero}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\ker {t} \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{projection-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}symmetric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, e) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(e(x), y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{projection-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}idempotent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, e) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e(e(x)) = e(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{projection-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}kills-\allowbreak{}complement}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, e) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(e(x)))) = \operatorname{vzero}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{projection-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}fixes-\allowbreak{}range}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, e) \wedge (k \in \mathrm{ran}\,{e}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e(k) = k \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{projection-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}range-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathrm{ran}\,{e} = {\ker {e}}^{\perp} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{projection-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}range-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, \mathrm{ran}\,{e}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \mathrm{ran}\,{e})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{projection-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}proj-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}range}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad E_{\mathrm{ran}\,{e}} = e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vzero}(v)) = \operatorname{vzero}(w) \end{array}}}
