\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)) \simeq L({v}, {w})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)) \simeq \operatorname{bop\text{-}vadd}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)) \simeq 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)) \simeq \operatorname{bop\text{-}vinv}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}nrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{nrm}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)) \simeq \operatorname{bop\text{-}vnrm}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad s \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bop\text{-}vadd}(v, w)(s, t) = {s} + {t} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}vinv-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bop\text{-}vinv}(v, w)(t) = -{t} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {w})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bop\text{-}vnrm}(v, w)(t) = \lVert {t} \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}length}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{length}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)) = 5 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, f, g, l, \ell, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(m, g, \ell) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(f(n), l) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{dist}(m)(g(n), \ell))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, f, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, \mathit{tm}, f, g, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\mathit{tm}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(\mathit{tm})) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\mathit{tm})(g(m), g(n)) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{dist}(s)(f(m), f(n)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\mathit{tm}, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, l, a, b, n_{0}. \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, g, l) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad n_{0} \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n_{0} \leq n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(s)(g(n), a) \leq b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(l, a) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ipms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(a, b) = \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b)) \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad s \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)))(s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \lVert {{s} + {-{t}}} \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}pt-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, s, t, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad s \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))(s(x), t(x)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \lVert x \rVert \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)))(s, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ipms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, a, b, c, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{vec}(w)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))(\operatorname{vadd}(w)(a, b), \operatorname{vadd}(w)(c, e)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))(a, c) + \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))(b, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ipms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, c, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(w))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))(\operatorname{act}(w)(c, a), \operatorname{act}(w)(c, b)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to L({v}, {w})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, f, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to L({v}, {w})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda q \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(q)(x)) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, f, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), f) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), (\lambda q \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(q)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, f, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), f) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \varepsilon(\{q \in \operatorname{vec}(w) : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), (\lambda \mathit{kq} \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(\mathit{kq})(x)), q)\}) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{q \in \operatorname{vec}(w) : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), (\lambda \mathit{kq} \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(\mathit{kq})(x)), q)\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v) \in ((L({v}, {v}) \times L({v}, {v})) \to L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vneg}(v) \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v) \in ((\mathbb{C} \times L({v}, {v})) \to L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vnrm}(v) \in (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vmul}(v) \in ((L({v}, {v}) \times L({v}, {v})) \to L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vstar-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vstar}(v) \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v)(s, t) = {s} + {t} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vneg}(v)(t) = -{t} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, c, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(c, t) = {c}\,{t} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vnrm}(v)(t) = \lVert {t} \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vmul}(v)(s, t) = {s}{t} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vstar-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vstar}(v)(t) = {t}^{*} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}associative}(\operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v), L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative}(\operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v), L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}ident}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}identity}(\operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v), 0, L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}inverses}(\operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v), 0, \operatorname{bh\text{-}vneg}(v), L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}associative}(\operatorname{bh\text{-}vmul}(v), L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), x, y \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(r, \operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v)(\operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(r, x), \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), x \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))(r, s), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v)(\operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(r, x), \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), x \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))(r, s), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(r, \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), x) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{bh\text{-}vnrm}(v)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{bh\text{-}vnrm}(v)(x) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (x = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), x \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bh\text{-}vnrm}(v)(\operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v)(r, x)) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) \cdot \operatorname{bh\text{-}vnrm}(v)(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cba}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), L({v}, {v}), \operatorname{bh\text{-}vadd}(v), 0, \operatorname{bh\text{-}vneg}(v), \operatorname{bh\text{-}act}(v), \operatorname{bh\text{-}vnrm}(v), \operatorname{bh\text{-}vmul}(v)]) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bo2-\allowbreak{}onf-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, e.; \forall i, j \in x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, x, e) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 1 < \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(e(i), e(j)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{orthonormal-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, x, e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(x) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (0 \leq f(x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (0 \leq g(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, (\lambda \mathit{sqx} \in a.\; \sqrt{g(\mathit{sqx})})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{alg-\allowbreak{}polar-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, p, q. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (((p \cdot p) = ((a \cdot a) + (b \cdot b))) \wedge ((p \cdot q) = 1)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (((a \cdot q) \cdot (a \cdot q)) + ((b \cdot q) \cdot (b \cdot q))) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}pointwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, p, q, r, i. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad p = \sqrt{((a \cdot a) + (b \cdot b))} \wedge \\ \quad q = \left(\text{if }(0 < p)\text{ then }\operatorname{recip}(p)\text{ else }0\right) \wedge \\ \quad r = ((a \cdot q) + (1 - (p \cdot q))) \wedge \\ \quad i = (b \cdot q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq p \wedge \\ \quad \quad (p \cdot p) = ((a \cdot a) + (b \cdot b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad (p \cdot r) = a \wedge \\ \quad \quad (p \cdot i) = b \wedge \\ \quad \quad ((r \cdot r) + (i \cdot i)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}functions-\allowbreak{}exist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, e, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, e) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p, u, \mathit{iu}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \mathit{iu}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (0 \leq p(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; ((p(x) \cdot p(x)) = ((e(x) \cdot e(x)) + (m(x) \cdot m(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; ((p(x) \cdot u(x)) = e(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; ((p(x) \cdot \operatorname{iu}(x)) = m(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (((u(x) \cdot u(x)) + (\operatorname{iu}(x) \cdot \operatorname{iu}(x))) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, g. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((g \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(p, \left(\text{if }(0 \leq g)\text{ then }g\text{ else }0\right)) = \left(\text{if }(0 \leq (p \cdot g))\text{ then }(p \cdot g)\text{ else }0\right) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, g. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((g \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(p, \left(\text{if }(0 \leq g)\text{ then }0\text{ else }-g\right)) = \left(\text{if }(0 \leq (p \cdot g))\text{ then }0\text{ else }-(p \cdot g)\right) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}congruence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge ((g \in (a \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = g(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) \simeq \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, p, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq f \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq g \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a = (c - d) \wedge \\ \quad b = (f - g) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq p \wedge \\ \quad (p \cdot p) = ((a \cdot a) + (b \cdot b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p \leq ((c + d) + (f + g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complex-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a + (+i \cdot b)) = 0))) \Rightarrow ((a = 0) \wedge (b = 0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}parts-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) = 1) \Rightarrow ((\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \rvert \leq 1) \wedge (\lvert \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) \rvert \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\forall h, q.\; (((h \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\lvert q \rvert \leq 1))) \Rightarrow (\lvert (h \cdot q) \rvert \leq \lvert h \rvert))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complex-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{complex\text{-}integral}(a, b, c, u) \simeq (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, c, (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u(x)))) + (+i \cdot \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, c, (\lambda x \in a.\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u(x))))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complex-\allowbreak{}parts-\allowbreak{}equal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a + (+i \cdot b)) = (c + (+i \cdot d))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a = c) \wedge (b = d) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}schwarz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x)))) \cdot \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot g(x)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot f(x)))) \cdot \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (g(x) \cdot g(x)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{kernel-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, u, k, i. \\ \quad (\int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {i}(y)\, d{u}(y) \simeq (\lambda x \in s.\; (\left(\text{if }(\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, b, u, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}((s \times a), (\lambda w \in (s \times a).\; (k(w) \cdot i(\operatorname{nth}(2, w))))))(x) \in \mathbb{R})\text{ then }\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, b, u, \operatorname{pos\text{-}part}((s \times a), (\lambda w \in (s \times a).\; (k(w) \cdot i(\operatorname{nth}(2, w))))))(x)\text{ else }0\right) - \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, b, u, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}((s \times a), (\lambda w \in (s \times a).\; (k(w) \cdot i(\operatorname{nth}(2, w))))))(x) \in \mathbb{R})\text{ then }\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, b, u, \operatorname{neg\text{-}part}((s \times a), (\lambda w \in (s \times a).\; (k(w) \cdot i(\operatorname{nth}(2, w))))))(x)\text{ else }0\right)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kernel-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, k, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(b, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {i}(y)\, d{d}(y) \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in s.\; (\int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {i}(y)\, d{d}(y)(\mathit{lx}) \cdot \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {i}(y)\, d{d}(y)(\mathit{lx})))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{integral}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d), (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in (s \times b).\; (k(\mathit{lx}) \cdot k(\mathit{lx})))) \cdot \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in b.\; (i(\mathit{lx}) \cdot i(\mathit{lx})))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(s, a, u, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in b.\; (\operatorname{fn\text{-}x\text{-}section}(b, k, x)(\mathit{lx}) \cdot i(\mathit{lx})))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {i}(y)\, d{d}(y)(x) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{rintegral}(b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in b.\; (\operatorname{fn\text{-}x\text{-}section}(b, k, x)(\mathit{lx}) \cdot i(\mathit{lx})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kernel-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}ae}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, d, f, g, m, k, u, w, h, a, b, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(f, g, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(f, g, m) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times f), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, c, f, g), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, c, d, f, g, m)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(f, g, m) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(f, g, m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(f, g, m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(f, g, m, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in f.\; (\neg (y \in n) \Rightarrow (h(y) = ((a \cdot u(y)) + (b \cdot w(y))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{en}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(s, c, d, \mathit{en}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in \mathit{en}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{m}(y)(x) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; (a \cdot \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {u}(y)\, d{m}(y)(x)) + (b \cdot \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {w}(y)\, d{m}(y)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kernel-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}ae-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, d, f, k, u, h, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, c, d), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, b, c, d, f)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(c, d, f, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in c.\; (\neg (y \in g) \Rightarrow (h(y) = u(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(s, a, b, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{f}(y)(x) = \int {k}(\cdot, y)\, {u}(y)\, d{f}(y)(x) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u}))([\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), c), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), d)], \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), f), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), g)]) \\ \quad \quad =\; [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(c, f)), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(d, g))] \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, h, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(b, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad T_{{f} + i {g}}([\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, d)), h), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(b, c, d)), k)]) \\ \quad \quad =\; [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u)), \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {f}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{d}(y), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {g}(\cdot, y)\, {k}(y)\, d{d}(y)))), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u)), \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {f}(\cdot, y)\, {k}(y)\, d{d}(y), \int {g}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{d}(y)))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad T_{{f} + i {g}} \in (\operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d})) \to \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({s}, {u}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, z, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d})) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad T_{{f} + i {g}}(\operatorname{vadd}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d}))(z, w)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({s}, {u}))(T_{{f} + i {g}}(z), \\ \quad \quad \quad T_{{f} + i {g}}(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, \gamma, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad \gamma \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad T_{{f} + i {g}}(\operatorname{act}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d}))(\gamma, z)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({s}, {u}))(\gamma, T_{{f} + i {g}}(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}hilbert-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({a}, {u})}([\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), c), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), d)], \\ \quad \quad \quad [\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), c), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u)), d)]) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (c(x) \cdot c(x)))) + \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (d(x) \cdot d(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (p(x) \cdot \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(f)(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; -\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (p(x) \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in a.\; (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(f)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(a, b, u))(f)(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow (((a + (+i \cdot b)) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a + (+i \cdot b)))) = ((a \cdot a) + (b \cdot b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{kernel-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}cschwarz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, h, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(b, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(s, a, u, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (x \in n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in (s \times b).\; (f(\mathit{lx}) \cdot f(\mathit{lx}))))(x) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in (s \times b).\; (g(\mathit{lx}) \cdot g(\mathit{lx}))))(x) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {f}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{d}(y), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {g}(\cdot, y)\, {k}(y)\, d{d}(y)))(x) \cdot \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {f}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{d}(y), \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {g}(\cdot, y)\, {k}(y)\, d{d}(y)))(x)) + (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {f}(\cdot, y)\, {k}(y)\, d{d}(y), \int {g}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{d}(y))(x) \cdot \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{l2\text{-}space}(s, a, u))(\int {f}(\cdot, y)\, {k}(y)\, d{d}(y), \int {g}(\cdot, y)\, {h}(y)\, d{d}(y))(x)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in (s \times b).\; (f(\mathit{lx}) \cdot f(\mathit{lx}))))(x) + \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in (s \times b).\; (g(\mathit{lx}) \cdot g(\mathit{lx}))))(x)) \cdot (\operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in b.\; (h(\mathit{lx}) \cdot h(\mathit{lx})))) + \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in b.\; (k(\mathit{lx}) \cdot k(\mathit{lx}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{l2-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}square-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, d, f, h, c, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, h) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad g \in b \wedge \\ \quad u(g) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \neg (x \in g) \Rightarrow ((((d(x) \cdot d(x)) + (f(x) \cdot f(x))) \leq (h(x) \cdot c)) \wedge (h(x) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in a.\; (d(\mathit{lx}) \cdot d(\mathit{lx})))) + \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, (\lambda \mathit{lx} \in a.\; (f(\mathit{lx}) \cdot f(\mathit{lx})))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, h) \cdot c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({s}, {u})}(T_{{f} + i {g}}(z), \\ \quad \quad \quad T_{{f} + i {g}}(z)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{integral}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d), (\lambda x \in (s \times b).\; (f(x) \cdot f(x)))) + \operatorname{integral}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d), (\lambda x \in (s \times b).\; (g(x) \cdot g(x))))) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d})}(z, z) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cl2-integral-operator-bounded.scm}{theorem-library/cl2-integral-operator-bounded.scm}
\noindent{\small cl2-integral-operator-bounded.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-L2C), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/l2c/kc-d.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d}), L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({s}, {u}), T_{{f} + i {g}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cl2-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{l2\text{-}set}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(L^2_{\mathbb{C}}({b}, {d})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert T_{{f} + i {g}}(z) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \sqrt{(\operatorname{integral}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d), (\lambda x \in (s \times b).\; (f(x) \cdot f(x)))) + \operatorname{integral}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d), (\lambda x \in (s \times b).\; (g(x) \cdot g(x)))))} \cdot \lVert z \rVert \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/complex-measure-polar.scm}{theorem-library/complex-measure-polar.scm}
\noindent{\small complex-measure-polar.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/mf/mf-c5.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-c6.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-c7.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-c8.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}density}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, p, g, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (p(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = (p(x) \cdot g(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, o, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, (\lambda \mathit{dma} \in b.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, p, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{dma})))), g) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, o, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{indicator-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge (a \in c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{indicator}(b, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{four-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}measures-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists o. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; (c(\alpha) \leq o(\alpha)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; (d(\alpha) \leq o(\alpha)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; (f(\alpha) \leq o(\alpha)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; (g(\alpha) \leq o(\alpha)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}part}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, o, p, u, d, f, g, h, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in b.\; (p(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in b.\; (d(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in b.\; (f(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(b, c, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(b, c, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in c. \\ \quad \quad g(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(b, c, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(b, d, \operatorname{indicator}(b, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in c. \\ \quad \quad h(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(b, c, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(b, f, \operatorname{indicator}(b, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b.\; ((p(x) \cdot u(x)) = (d(x) - f(x))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(b, c, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{dma} \in c.\; \operatorname{integral}(b, c, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(b, p, \operatorname{indicator}(b, \mathit{dma})))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cix} \in b.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(\mathit{cix}) \cdot u(\mathit{cix})))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (g(a) - h(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}density}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, d, f, g, h, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (d(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad g(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, d, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad h(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, f, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad c \in b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, o, (\lambda \mathit{hx} \in a.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(a, c)(\mathit{hx}) \cdot (d(\mathit{hx}) - f(\mathit{hx}))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, o, (\lambda \mathit{hx} \in a.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(a, c)(\mathit{hx}) \cdot (d(\mathit{hx}) - f(\mathit{hx}))))) = (g(c) - h(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}support}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, u, b, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, c, u) \wedge ((b \in c) \wedge ((u(b) = 0) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, c, g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, c, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(a, b)(x) \cdot g(x)))) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}sets-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, o, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{bb} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, o, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{bb})(x)))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, \{\mathit{nzx} \in a : \neg (f(\mathit{nzx}) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}total-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, p, c, d, f, g, h, k, m, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in a.\; (p(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in a.\; (c(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in a.\; (d(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in a.\; (f(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in a.\; (g(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad h(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, c, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad k(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, d, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad m(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, f, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad n(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, g, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (p(x) \leq ((c(x) + d(x)) + (f(x) + g(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, p, \operatorname{indicator}(a, a))) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}decomposition-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b.\; ((v(\alpha) = 0) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \alpha)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(c(x)) = 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \alpha \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad u(\alpha) = \operatorname{complex\text{-}integral}(a, b, v, (\lambda \mathit{cux} \in a.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)(\mathit{cux}) \cdot c(\mathit{cux})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rintegral-\allowbreak{}density-\allowbreak{}hyp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, u, h, g, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in a.\; (h(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, h, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = (h(x) \cdot g(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, o, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, g) = \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, o, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{density-\allowbreak{}integrable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, u, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (h(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in b. \\ \quad \quad u(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, h, \operatorname{indicator}(a, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad u(a) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, o, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}density-\allowbreak{}re}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, o, d, h, u, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in b.\; (h(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in c. \\ \quad \quad d(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(b, c, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(b, h, \operatorname{indicator}(b, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad d(b) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(u(x)) = 1) \wedge \\ \quad a \in c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(b, c, o, (\lambda \mathit{ux} \in b.\; (h(\mathit{ux}) \cdot (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(\mathit{ux}) \cdot \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u(\mathit{ux})))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(b, c, d, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cix} \in b.\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((\lambda \mathit{cux} \in b.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(\mathit{cux}) \cdot u(\mathit{cux})))(\mathit{cix})))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{rintegral}(b, c, o, (\lambda \mathit{ux} \in b.\; (h(\mathit{ux}) \cdot (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(\mathit{ux}) \cdot \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u(\mathit{ux})))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}density-\allowbreak{}im}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, o, d, h, u, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rnx} \in b.\; (h(\mathit{rnx}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rna} \in c. \\ \quad \quad d(\mathit{rna}) = \operatorname{integral}(b, c, o, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(b, h, \operatorname{indicator}(b, \mathit{rna}))) \wedge \\ \quad d(b) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(u(x)) = 1) \wedge \\ \quad a \in c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(b, c, o, (\lambda \mathit{ux} \in b.\; (h(\mathit{ux}) \cdot (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(\mathit{ux}) \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u(\mathit{ux})))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rintegral}(b, c, d, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cix} \in b.\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((\lambda \mathit{cux} \in b.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(\mathit{cux}) \cdot u(\mathit{cux})))(\mathit{cix})))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{rintegral}(b, c, o, (\lambda \mathit{ux} \in b.\; (h(\mathit{ux}) \cdot (\operatorname{indicator}(b, a)(\mathit{ux}) \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u(\mathit{ux})))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polar-\allowbreak{}decomposition-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}measure}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) = 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(g(x)) = 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \alpha \in b. \\ \quad \quad u(\alpha) = \operatorname{complex\text{-}integral}(a, b, c, (\lambda \mathit{cux} \in a.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)(\mathit{cux}) \cdot f(\mathit{cux})))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \alpha \in b. \\ \quad \quad u(\alpha) = \operatorname{complex\text{-}integral}(a, b, d, (\lambda \mathit{cux} \in a.\; (\operatorname{indicator}(a, \alpha)(\mathit{cux}) \cdot g(\mathit{cux})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\forall \alpha \in b.\; (c(\alpha) = d(\alpha)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, c, \{\mathit{ux} \in a : \neg (f(\mathit{ux}) = g(\mathit{ux}))\})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rr-nonneg-below-all-zero.scm}{theorem-library/rr-nonneg-below-all-zero.scm}
\noindent{\small rr-nonneg-below-all-zero.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/mb35-souslin.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by three CCR ch.3 files; RR order. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq x) \wedge \forall s.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow (x \leq s))) \Rightarrow (x = 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb35-souslin.scm}{theorem-library/mb35-souslin.scm}
\noindent{\small mb35-souslin.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 sections 1.3-1.4: Souslin sets (M-B35 / B5, 2026-10-26).  Vocabulary: mb35-souslin-vocab.scm.  Library: measure.  Helper prefixes mr- (copied from mb35-regular.scm) and msn-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}sieve-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sieve}(s, v) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; v \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (b \leq n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{diam}(s, v(\operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n)))) \leq e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad v(\operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}((n + 1)))) \subseteq v(\operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists p.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \in v(\operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nstar-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\mathit{nstar} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}nstar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \in (\mathrm{OS}(n) \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge (\operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \in \mathit{nstar})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{restrict}(w, \mathrm{OS}(n)) = \operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n))) \wedge (k < n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad w(k) = z(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k < n) \Rightarrow (w(k) = z(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(w, \mathrm{OS}(n)) = \operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prefix-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((m \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{restrict}(w, \mathrm{OS}(n)) = \operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(w, \mathrm{OS}(m)) = \operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad 0) \\ \quad \quad =\; x(z(0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad k) \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad k), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad x(z((k + 1)))) \\ \quad \quad \quad <\; \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (k + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; x(z((k + 1))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), k), x(z((k + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (k + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}close}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad k), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (k + 1))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) \end{array}}}
