\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), m, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad m), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (m + j))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; ((2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, m))) - (2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, (m + j))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z, w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((\operatorname{restrict}(w, \mathrm{OS}(n)) = \operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n))) \wedge (k < n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(w(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(w((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(w((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(w((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad k) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rho-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) < s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), k, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (k \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad k), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad m)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \varepsilon(\{l \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), n)), l)\}) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \varepsilon(\{l \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), n)), l)\})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad m), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \varepsilon(\{l \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{dc\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{pts}(s), x(z(0)), (\lambda [\operatorname{mqk\_}, \operatorname{mqu\_}] \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{pts}(s)).\; \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (((\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1))))) \vee (\neg (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\operatorname{mqu\_}, x(z((\operatorname{mqk\_} + 1)))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, \operatorname{mqk\_}))) \wedge (y = \operatorname{mqu\_})))\}), n)), l)\})) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(2, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polish-\allowbreak{}baire-\allowbreak{}surjection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f) \wedge (\operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) = \operatorname{pts}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{complete-\allowbreak{}separable-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}polish-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e, t, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, e), h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{image}(h, \operatorname{pts}(t)) = e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polish-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \exists z.\; (z \in u))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}baire-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f) \wedge (\operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) = e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}baire-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \Leftrightarrow \exists f.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f) \wedge (\operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) = e)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-baire.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-baire.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-baire.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5: the Baire space N\textasciicircum{}N as a Polish metric space, and the necessity half of Proposition 5.14 (M-B67, 2026-10-26).  Vocabulary: mb67-vocab.scm (BAIRE-MS, SND-ITER, BAIRE-CODE) over scratchpad/mb12 (ULTRA-SEQ-MS and its laws, M-B1B2).  Library: measure. Helper prefixes ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < u) \wedge (u < v)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}(v) < \operatorname{recip}(u)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}wt-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{(((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall w \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2)(w) = 2))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}wt-\allowbreak{}gt-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 < (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2)(w))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, y, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), y, n) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad (n + 1) \leq \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), y, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), y, n) = \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), a, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall y \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), y, (n + 1)) = (\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), y, n) \cdot 2) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}) \simeq (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})(x, y) = \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), x, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), x, y) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{prefix\text{-}dist}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (x(j) = y(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})(x, y) \leq \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}close-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})(x, y) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), c, n))) \wedge (j \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x(j) = y(j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}delta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), c, (n + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), c, (n + 1))) \\ \quad <\; \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), c, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}div}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), m \in \mathbb{R}. \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad m < \operatorname{prefix\text{-}prod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; 2), z, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}, s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{converges}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}, s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{snd-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, k) \in \mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{snd-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, (k + 1)) = \operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{nnsnd}(m), k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}code-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{baire\text{-}code}(m) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{baire\text{-}code}(m)(k) = \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}code-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, j)) = z(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}polish}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{seq\text{-}tail}(z) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{seq\text{-}tail}(z)(j) = z((j + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}cons-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{seq\text{-}cons}(k, v) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge ((\operatorname{seq\text{-}cons}(k, v)(0) = k) \wedge (\operatorname{seq\text{-}tail}(\operatorname{seq\text{-}cons}(k, v)) = v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}proj-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{seq\text{-}proj}(k, z) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{seq\text{-}proj}(k, z)(j) = z(\operatorname{nnpair}(k, j)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nnpair-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, j, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnpair}(k, j) < \operatorname{nnpair}(k, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}unproj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})). \exists z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}proj}(k, z) = v(k) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-souslin.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-souslin.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-souslin.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 sections 1.4-1.4.1 (M-B67, 2026-10-26): the necessity half of Proposition 5.14 (so 5.14 as an IFF), Corollary 5.15, Proposition 5.16, Corollary 5.17. Vocabulary: mb35-souslin-vocab.scm (IS-SOUSLIN, IS-BAIRE-CONTINUOUS), mb67-vocab.scm (BAIRE-MS, SEQ-TAIL, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}subspace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f) \wedge (\operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) = e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, e), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}polish-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, e), h) \wedge (\operatorname{image}(h, \operatorname{pts}(t)) = e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}polish-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, e), h) \wedge (\operatorname{image}(h, \operatorname{pts}(t)) = e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, i, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(t, \operatorname{image}(i, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{mxk}, \mathbb{N}, e(\mathit{mxk}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}choice}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to ((\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) \to \operatorname{pts}(s))). \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, g(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{image}(g(k), (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})) = e(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}proj-\allowbreak{}prefix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z, w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{restrict}(w, \mathrm{OS}(\operatorname{nnpair}(k, n))) = \operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(\operatorname{nnpair}(k, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(\operatorname{seq\text{-}proj}(k, w), \mathrm{OS}(n)) = \operatorname{restrict}(\operatorname{seq\text{-}proj}(k, z), \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}intersection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \{p \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall \mathit{mxk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \in e(\mathit{mxk}))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \{p \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall \mathit{mxk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \in e(\mathit{mxk}))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}polish-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\exists x.\; (x \in f(k)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, f(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}co-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), f(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), f(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}polish-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-lusin.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-lusin.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-lusin.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 section 1.5 (M-B67, 2026-10-26): Lusin sets. lusin-is-souslin           (after Definition 5.19) a Lusin set is Souslin lusin-closed, lusin-open   nonempty closed and nonempty open subsets of a Polish space are Lusin (the base cases of Corollary 5.21)}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in f))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \exists z.\; (z \in u))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}inter-\allowbreak{}disjoint-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b).\; (\{q \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q \in g(n))\} \in b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, x \in g(i).\; ((x \in g(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(a, \mathbb{N}, g(a)) \in b \wedge \\ \quad \forall u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \Rightarrow (u \in b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \subseteq b \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-standard.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-standard.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-standard.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 sections 1.7-1.8 (M-B67, 2026-10-26): countably separated measurable spaces. graph-measurable                 Lemma 5.33 countably-separated-of-injection Proposition 5.36, sufficiency}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, a, b, c, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(b, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{graph\text{-}of}(s, b, i) \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{countably-\allowbreak{}separated-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}injection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b, z, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, b, \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(s, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polish-\allowbreak{}standard-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}generators}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad c \subseteq \operatorname{power}(b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (s \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in c.\; (\{x \in s : (f(x) \in e)\} \in a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, a, b, \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(b, c), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{countably-\allowbreak{}separated-\allowbreak{}embeds-\allowbreak{}baire}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(s, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, b, \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}), i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{countably-\allowbreak{}separated-\allowbreak{}embeds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(s, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, b, \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{countably-\allowbreak{}separated-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(s, b) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists z. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, b, \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-prod2.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-prod2.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-prod2.scm -- the product of two Polish spaces is Polish (M-B67, 2026-10-26); X x N\textasciicircum{}N Polish (for 5.38). product2-complete, product2-separable, product2-polish, product2-baire-polish Library: measure.  Helper prefixes mr- (copied) and mpq-. Load window: after mb67-baire (baire-ms-polish), mb4-vocab (IS-POLISH), the ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}polish}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}baire-\allowbreak{}polish}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba1i-unit-banach.scm}{theorem-library/ba1i-unit-banach.scm}
\noindent{\small ba1i-unit-banach.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1I), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1i-1109/ba1i-unit-banach.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a))))([l, x], [r, y]) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{magnitude}((l - r)) + \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}dom1-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(a))))([l, x], [r, y]) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a))))([l, x], [r, y]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}dom2-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall l \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{C}, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a))))([l, x], [r, y]) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(a))))([l, x], [r, y]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}dom1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(a))))(p, q) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a))))(p, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}dom2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a))))(p, q) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(a))))(p, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{nag\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cna\text{-}as\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}complex-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ([1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)] \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \simeq [0, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vneg}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vmul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{\operatorname{unitization}(a)} \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1u-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (1_{\operatorname{unitization}(a)} \simeq [1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}na-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a) \simeq [\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a), [0, \operatorname{vzero}(a)], \operatorname{unit\text{-}vneg}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}unital-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{unitization}(a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba1i-unit-star.scm}{theorem-library/ba1i-unit-star.scm}

\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{unitization}(a) \simeq [\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a), [0, \operatorname{vzero}(a)], \operatorname{unit\text{-}vneg}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a), \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a), [1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \simeq [0, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vneg}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vmul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\cdot_{\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)} \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (1_{\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)} \simeq [1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{b1s-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vstar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ({}^{*_{\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)}} \simeq \operatorname{unit\text{-}istar}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unitization-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}involutive-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-prod.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-prod.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-prod.scm -- countable products of metric spaces (M-B67, 2026-10-26): PRODUCT-METRIC-W of a sequence of metric spaces with a summable weight preserves completeness, separability, hence Polishness. product-coord-le, product-coord-cauchy, product-complete, product-separable, product-polish Library: measure.  Helper ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}(s), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge \operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (w(n) \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s(n)))(x(n), y(n))) \leq \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w))(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}coord-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w, u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w), u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(s(n), (\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(j)(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s(n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w.; \forall x, q \in \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}(s), t \in \mathbb{N}, l, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq l \wedge \\ \quad l \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k < t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s(k)))(x(k), q(k)) \leq l)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (t \leq k) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(w, k) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(w, t)) \leq c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w))(x, q) \leq ((l \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(w, t)) + c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s(n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}polish}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{summable\text{-}weight}(w) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s(n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(\operatorname{product\text{-}metric\text{-}w}(s, w)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-sum.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-sum.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-sum.scm -- countable disjoint sums of metric spaces (M-B67, 2026-10-26): SUM-MS(ts) is a metric space, complete when every summand is, separable when every summand is; hence Polish. sum-pts-unfold, sum-pts-parts, sum-pts-intro, sum-ms-pts, sum-ms-dist-slot, sum-dist-value, sum-pts-is-set, sum-ms-is-metric-space, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}pts-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s) \simeq \{p \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{pts}(s(k)))) : (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) \in \operatorname{pts}(s(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}pts-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall p \in \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((\operatorname{nth}(2, p) \in \operatorname{pts}(s(\operatorname{nth}(1, p)))) \wedge (p = [\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)]))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}pts-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{pts}(s(k)).\; ([k, x] \in \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}slot}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{smu\_}, \operatorname{smv\_}] \in (\operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s) \times \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s)).\; \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{smu\_}) = \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{smv\_}))\text{ then }\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{smu\_}))))(\operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{smu\_}), \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{smv\_}))\text{ else }1\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s))(u, v) \simeq \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{nth}(1, u) = \operatorname{nth}(1, v))\text{ then }\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s(\operatorname{nth}(1, u))))(\operatorname{nth}(2, u), \operatorname{nth}(2, v))\text{ else }1\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}pts-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}same}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(1, u) = \operatorname{nth}(1, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s))(u, v) = \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s(\operatorname{nth}(1, u))))(\operatorname{nth}(2, u), \operatorname{nth}(2, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{nth}(1, u) = \operatorname{nth}(1, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s))(u, v) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{smu\_}, \operatorname{smv\_}] \in (\operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s) \times \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{smu\_}) = \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{smv\_}))\text{ then }\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{bdd\text{-}metric}(s(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{smu\_}))))(\operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{smu\_}), \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{smv\_}))\text{ else }1\right)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s) \times \operatorname{sum\text{-}pts}(s)) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s(n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s(n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}polish}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ms\text{-}sequence}(s) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s(n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ms}(s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-lusin2.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-lusin2.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-lusin2.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 section 1.5 (M-B67, 2026-10-26): Lusin sets are closed under countable disjoint unions and countable intersections (Proposition 5.20); the Borel subsets of a Polish space are Lusin (Corollary 5.21). lusin-disjoint-union      5.20, unions (members Lusin or empty; ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}disjoint-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\exists x.\; (x \in e(k)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, e(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{mbx} \in e(i).\; ((\mathit{mbx} \in e(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, e(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, e(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}intersection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, e(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \{p \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall \mathit{mxk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \in e(\mathit{mxk}))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, \{p \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall \mathit{mxk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \in e(\mathit{mxk}))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}polish-\allowbreak{}lusin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-sep.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-sep.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-sep.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 section 1.6 (M-B67, 2026-10-26): the separation theorem. cyl-unfold, upd-facts, cyl-agree, cyl-zero, cyl-split, borel-separated-union separation-step, souslin-separation (Proposition 5.25), and its corollaries The proof is the Baire-space form of the notes' argument: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyl-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cyl}(w, n) \simeq \{z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) : \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (z(j) = w(j)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{upd-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{upd}(w, n, m) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{upd}(w, n, m)(j) = w(j))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{upd}(w, n, m)(j) = m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyl-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (w(j) = v(j))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cyl}(w, n) = \operatorname{cyl}(v, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyl-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}).\; (\operatorname{cyl}(w, 0) = (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyl-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cyl}(w, n) = \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(m, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{cyl}(\operatorname{upd}(w, n, m), (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}separated-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, a(k), b(l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, a(n)), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, b(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyl-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{cyl}(w, n) \subseteq (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{image-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f \in ((\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(w, n)) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{image-\allowbreak{}cyl-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(w, n)) \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(m, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(\operatorname{upd}(w, n, m), (n + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}separated-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((c \subseteq a) \wedge ((d \subseteq b) \wedge \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, a, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{separation-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f, g \in ((\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), u, v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \neg \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(u, n)), \operatorname{image}(g, \operatorname{cyl}(v, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q_{1}, q_{2} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(\operatorname{upd}(u, n, q_{1}), (n + 1))), \operatorname{image}(g, \operatorname{cyl}(\operatorname{upd}(v, n, q_{2}), (n + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyl-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})). \\ \quad \forall \mathit{lqn}, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < \mathit{lqn}) \Rightarrow (p((\mathit{lqn} + 1))(j) = p(\mathit{lqn})(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lyj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; p((\mathit{lyj} + 1))(\mathit{lyj})) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cyl}((\lambda \mathit{lyj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; p((\mathit{lyj} + 1))(\mathit{lyj})), n) = \operatorname{cyl}(p(n), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}distinct-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g.; \forall y, z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, g) \wedge \neg (f(y) = g(z))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(y, n)), \operatorname{image}(g, \operatorname{cyl}(z, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{baire-\allowbreak{}separation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})).\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{image}(g, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})), \operatorname{image}(g, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}separation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, b) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; \neg (x \in b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}empty-\allowbreak{}separation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists \mathit{mbx}.\; (\mathit{mbx} \in a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists \mathit{mbx}.\; (\mathit{mbx} \in b) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \neg (x \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in e) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists x.\; (x \in e) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}disjoint-\allowbreak{}envelopes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\exists \mathit{mbx}.\; (\mathit{mbx} \in a(k)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, a(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in a(k).\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (x \in a(l))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) \subseteq e(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in e(k).\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (x \in e(l))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-ls.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-ls.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-ls.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 sections 1.6-1.7 (M-B67, 2026-10-26): Borel partitions of a separable space into small pieces (Proposition 5.28) and the Lusin-Souslin theorem (Proposition 5.30: an injective continuous image of a Polish space is Borel), with Corollary 5.31 (in a Polish space the Borel ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}piece-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), r.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(k), r), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), r))(j))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}piece-\allowbreak{}disjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), r.; \forall k, a \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(k), r), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), r))(j))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(a), r), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(a), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), r))(j)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}piece-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), r.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad x \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(k), r), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), r))(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}piece-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), r.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x, a \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(k), r), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), r))(j))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, a) < (r + r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{code-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \mathbb{N}, w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, j)) = w(j))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mcm} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{mcm} < m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \forall \mathit{mcj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mcj} < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(\mathit{mcm}, \mathit{mcj})) = \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, \mathit{mcj})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}cell-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \{\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{pts}(t) : (\forall \mathit{mcm} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mcm} < m) \Rightarrow \neg \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(\mathit{mcm}, j)) = \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, j))))) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))))(\mathit{uj}))))))\} \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t) \end{array}}}

\operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))))(\mathit{uj}))))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}cell-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad x \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \{\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{pts}(t) : (\forall \mathit{mcm} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mcm} < m) \Rightarrow \neg \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(\mathit{mcm}, j)) = \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, j))))) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))))(\mathit{uj}))))))\} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{mpj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mpj} < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, \mathit{mpj})) = w(\mathit{mpj}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}cell-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), n, m \in \mathbb{N}, x, a \in \{\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{pts}(t) : (\forall \mathit{mcm} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mcm} < m) \Rightarrow \neg \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(\mathit{mcm}, j)) = \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, j))))) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))))(\mathit{uj}))))))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, a) < (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) + \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \end{array}}}
