\vnbentry{\texttt{nbhd-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(o))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \exists \mathit{nba} \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\mathit{nba}, y) < o)\} \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}envelopes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), s, h.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, a(n)) < b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, s, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(x) = h(c)) \Rightarrow (x = c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(h, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{pts}(t) : (\forall \mathit{mcm} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mcm} < m) \Rightarrow \neg \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(\mathit{mcm}, j)) = \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, j))))) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, a(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, a(\mathit{mbj}), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))))(\mathit{uj}))))))\}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; g(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in g(k).\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (x \in g(l))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}envelopes-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}levels}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), s, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, a(n)) < b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, s, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(x) = h(c)) \Rightarrow (x = c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s))). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(h, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{pts}(t) : (\forall \mathit{mcm} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mcm} < m) \Rightarrow \neg \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(\mathit{mcm}, j)) = \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, j))))) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{mcx} \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, a(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{snd\text{-}iter}(m, i))), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, a(\mathit{mbj}), \operatorname{recip}((i + 1))))(\mathit{uj}))))))\}) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; g(n)(m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in g(n)(k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (x \in g(n)(l)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, s, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, a \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(x) = h(a)) \Rightarrow (x = a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(h, \operatorname{pts}(t)) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}into-\allowbreak{}subspace-\allowbreak{}ambient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e, t, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, e), h))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, s, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}borel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polish-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}lusin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)) \Leftrightarrow (\exists x.\; (x \in e) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lusin-\allowbreak{}souslin-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(p), s, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(p, b), s, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, a \in b.\; ((i(x) = i(a)) \Rightarrow (x = a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(i, b) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-s38.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-s38.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-s38.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 section 1.9 (M-B67, 2026-10-27): Proposition 5.38, Souslin sets of a Polish space are exactly the Souslin sets of families of CLOSED sets (sieves or not). Sufficiency: Z = \{(x, z) : x in S(z|n) for all n\} is closed in X x N\textasciicircum{}N (Polish), and the Souslin set is its first ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, v) \simeq \{p \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \exists z \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}).\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \in v(\operatorname{restrict}(z, \mathrm{OS}(n))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall v \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge \forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, v(p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{w \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})) : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{nth}(1, w) \in v(\operatorname{restrict}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w), \mathrm{OS}(n))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}souslin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall v \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, v(p)) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist0-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \\ \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall e \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{m38a} \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(y, \mathit{m38a}) < e))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, t(p)) \wedge (\operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, t) = e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{souslin-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists x.\; (x \in e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, t(p)) \wedge (\operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, t) = e) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-b32.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-b32.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-b32.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 sections 1.7-1.8 (M-B67, 2026-10-27): Theorem 5.32 (an injective Borel map of a Polish space into a separable metric space maps Borel sets to Borel sets) and its consequences 5.34 and 5.37.  The core is borel-injection-image: for X, Z Polish and theta: X -$>$ Z ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{separable-\allowbreak{}countably-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(\operatorname{pts}(p), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{graph\text{-}of}(a, b, f) \simeq \{p \in (a \times b) : (f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p)) = \operatorname{nth}(2, p))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{borel-\allowbreak{}injection-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, z, h.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(\operatorname{pts}(a), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a), \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{pts}(a).\; ((h(x) = h(c)) \Rightarrow (x = c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(h, b) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{injective-\allowbreak{}borel-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, i.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(\operatorname{pts}(a), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a), \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{pts}(a).\; ((i(x) = i(c)) \Rightarrow (x = c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(i, b) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{standard-\allowbreak{}injection-\allowbreak{}images}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, i.; \forall d \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, a, b, c, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, f \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(f)) \Rightarrow (x = f)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(i, d) \in c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{restrict-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, e.\; (\operatorname{restrict\text{-}sigma}(a, e) \simeq \{\mathit{rsa} \in a : (\mathit{rsa} \subseteq e)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{restrict-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall e \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(e, \operatorname{restrict\text{-}sigma}(a, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{standard-\allowbreak{}measurable-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall b \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(s, a) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(b, \operatorname{restrict\text{-}sigma}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{standard-\allowbreak{}injection-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}standard}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, a, b, c, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, d \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(d)) \Rightarrow (x = d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(\operatorname{image}(i, s), \operatorname{restrict\text{-}sigma}(c, \operatorname{image}(i, s))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb67-s35.scm}{theorem-library/mb67-s35.scm}
\noindent{\small mb67-s35.scm -- construction of measures, chapter 5 section 1.8 (M-B67, 2026-10-27): Proposition 5.35, a countable disjoint union of standard Borel spaces is standard.  The witnesses (Polish spaces T(k) and isomorphisms F(k)) are chosen by global choice; the union is carried by G([k, x]) = [k, F(k)(x)] onto SUM-MS(T), ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{disjoint\text{-}sum\text{-}set}(s) \simeq \{p \in (\mathbb{N} \times \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \mathbb{N}, s(k))) : (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) \in s(\operatorname{nth}(1, p)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{sum\text{-}sigma}(s, a) \simeq \{\mathit{sga} \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{disjoint\text{-}sum\text{-}set}(s)) : \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\{y \in s(k) : ([k, y] \in \mathit{sga})\} \in a(k))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall p \in \operatorname{disjoint\text{-}sum\text{-}set}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((\operatorname{nth}(2, p) \in s(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))) \wedge (p = [\operatorname{nth}(1, p), \operatorname{nth}(2, p)])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in s(k).\; ([k, x] \in \operatorname{disjoint\text{-}sum\text{-}set}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(i) \in \mathbf{Set}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{disjoint\text{-}sum\text{-}set}(s) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sum-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s(j), a(j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{disjoint\text{-}sum\text{-}set}(s), \operatorname{sum\text{-}sigma}(s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{standard-\allowbreak{}disjoint-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbf{Set}). \\ \quad \forall h \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(s(h), a(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}standard\text{-}borel}(\operatorname{disjoint\text{-}sum\text{-}set}(s), \operatorname{sum\text{-}sigma}(s, a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rr-not-lt-ge.scm}{theorem-library/rr-not-lt-ge.scm}
\noindent{\small rr-not-lt-ge.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/ccr2-nv.scm into library core, for the library gate: cited by ccr4c-finite-char (algebra); RR order. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. rr-not-lt-ge}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\neg (a < b) \Rightarrow (b \leq a))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr2-nv.scm}{theorem-library/ccr2-nv.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr2-nv.scm -- NON-ARCHIMEDEAN VALUED FIELDS AND DOMAINS: CCR.pdf Propositions 1.9, 1.17, 2.4, 2.6, 2.10, 2.11, 2.12 (and what follows when time allows).  Vocabulary: structure-library/ccr2-vocab.scm. Agent CCR-B2, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26.  Destination: theorem-library/ccr2-nv.scm.  Library: analysis. Helper prefix ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}normed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{carr}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y)) \leq \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x), \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{zero}(k) = \operatorname{one}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\neg (y = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) = \operatorname{one}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{one}(k)) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((a \leq 1) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((b \leq 1) \wedge ((a \cdot b) = 1))))) \Rightarrow (a = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{carr}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(k) \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(k) \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x, y \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y) \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x, y \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(k)(x) \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}normed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{carr}(k) : (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq 1)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a) \simeq \{x \in a : \exists y \in a.\; (\operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) = \operatorname{one}(k))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \simeq \{x \in a : (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < 1)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}principal-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, g) \simeq \{x \in a : \exists m \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(m, g))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal2-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h) \simeq \{x \in a : \exists m, n \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{mul}(k)(m, g), \operatorname{mul}(k)(n, h)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, r.\; (\operatorname{nv\text{-}ball}(k, a, r) \simeq \{x \in a : (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq r)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}divisibility}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x, y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y)) \Rightarrow \exists l \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(l, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((a = 1) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot b) = b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}principal-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall g \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (g \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}generators-\allowbreak{}associate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall g, h \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, g) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, h))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (g = \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, a.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n) \in a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in a, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n) \in a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = 1) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad n < m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, m)))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = 1)) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow ((x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a)) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, i.; \forall x \in i.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \Rightarrow (x \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, i.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(k) \in i))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i.; \forall x, y \in i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y) \in i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, i.; \forall x \in i.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(k)(x) \in i))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i.; \forall r \in a, x \in i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(k)(r, x) \in i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a).\; (x \in a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(k)(x) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall r \in a, x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(k)(r, x) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}proper}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}proper-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}maximal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i.; \forall x \in i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in i)) \Rightarrow (i \subseteq \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pid-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pid-\allowbreak{}principal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in a.\; (i = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pid-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}generator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in a.\; (\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < b) \wedge ((a \cdot b) = b)) \Rightarrow (a = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}units-\allowbreak{}transitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall p, y \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (y = \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal2-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, g, h.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h).\; (x \in a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal2-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall g, h \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal2-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall g, h \in a, x, y \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal2-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall g, h \in a, x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(k)(x) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal2-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall g, h, r \in a, x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(k)(r, x) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal2-\allowbreak{}ideal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall g, h \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, \operatorname{nv\text{-}ideal2}(k, a, g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, b, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq l) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge ((b \leq c) \wedge ((c = (l \cdot b)) \wedge (l \leq 1))))) \Rightarrow (l = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}pid-\allowbreak{}principal-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall c \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, c) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}ball}(k, a, \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pid-\allowbreak{}integers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}decay}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq r) \wedge ((r < 1) \wedge (0 < t))) \Rightarrow \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{power}(r, k) < t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}principal-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall g \in a, x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}uniformizer-\allowbreak{}factorization}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall l \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (l = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \quad \quad l = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}uniformizer-\allowbreak{}exponent-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall b, c \in \mathbb{N}, u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad b \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, b), u) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, c), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}uniformizer-\allowbreak{}factorization-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall b, c \in \mathbb{N}, u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, b), u) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, c), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (b = c) \wedge (u = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}factorization}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \quad \quad x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e), u) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e)) = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{one}(k), \operatorname{neg}(k)(x)) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}multiples-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(k, a, g) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{carr}(k) : \exists m \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(m, g))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}uniformizer-\allowbreak{}pid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, e.; \forall x \in e.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{carr}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, e.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(k) \in e))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, e.; \forall x, y \in e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y) \in e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, e.; \forall x \in e.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(k)(x) \in e))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, e.; \forall r \in a, x \in e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(k)(r, x) \in e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}multiple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, e.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(k), y \in e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in a.\; (y = \operatorname{mul}(k)(t, \operatorname{mul}(k)(b, w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}principal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (e = \operatorname{carr}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (e = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(k, a, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}dominance}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y)) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall q \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in q.\; ((f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(f(z)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)), f, q)) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall q \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in q.\; ((f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(f(z)) < b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)), f, q)) < b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((a < 1) \wedge (b \leq 1)))) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot b) < 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((a \leq 1) \wedge (b < 1)))) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot b) < 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((a \leq 1) \wedge (b \leq 1)))) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot b) \leq 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}gauss-\allowbreak{}content-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{finsupp}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content\text{-}one}(k, p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content\text{-}one}(k, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content\text{-}one}(k, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((0 \leq c) \wedge ((a \leq c) \wedge (b \leq d))))) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot b) \leq (c \cdot d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((a < c) \wedge ((b \leq d) \wedge (0 < d))))) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot b) < (c \cdot d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge ((a \leq c) \wedge ((b < d) \wedge (0 < c))))) \Rightarrow ((a \cdot b) < (c \cdot d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}content-\allowbreak{}multiplicative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{finsupp}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}), c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge ((0 < d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, p, c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, q, d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, p, q), (c \cdot d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}content-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{finsupp}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}), c, d \in \mathbb{R}, i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, p, c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, q, d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{monalg\text{-}add}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, p, q)(i)) \leq \operatorname{max}(c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}decay-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, r, s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq q) \wedge ((q < 1) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge (0 < s)))) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(q, n) \cdot r) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}scaling-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}, t, g \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(t) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(g)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a), \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda v \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a)).\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(t, v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}balls-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, b \in \operatorname{carr}(k), c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{zero}(k), a))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{zero}(k), c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, b \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{zero}(k), a))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) < 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}uniformizer-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, d)) < 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e), u) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, j)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; j \leq e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}negative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k), e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a), b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e)) = u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, b), x) \in a) \Leftrightarrow (e \leq b) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ban-\allowbreak{}ms}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ban-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ban-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a))(u, v) = \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(u, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(v))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}low}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{tq}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (\forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge (j < \mathit{bq}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{tq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}finsupp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{tq}) \in \operatorname{finsupp}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}trunc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{nq}, \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{nq} \leq (\mathit{tq} + \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(\mathit{nq}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{tq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{tq}))(\mathit{nq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, r \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j \leq \mathit{tq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = r(j)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{tq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, r, \mathit{tq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, r, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{gr} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{tq}, \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (r(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gr}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j \leq \mathit{tq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = r(j))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j \leq \mathit{tq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{gr}(j))) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{nq} \leq (\mathit{tq} + \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(\mathit{nq}) = \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, r, \mathit{gr})(\mathit{nq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}vanish}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad j < (\mathit{bq} + \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{fq}.; \forall \mathit{bq}, \mathit{cq}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge ((\mathit{cq} \leq \mathit{bq}) \wedge (j < \mathit{cq}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{cq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{bq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{bq} \leq \mathit{cq}) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}monalg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \simeq \operatorname{monalg\text{-}add}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}monalg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q) \simeq \operatorname{monalg\text{-}one}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}.; \forall \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(\mathit{jq}) \simeq \operatorname{add}(q)(\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{jq}), \operatorname{gq}(\mathit{jq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q, \mathit{fq}.; \forall \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}neg}(q, \mathit{fq})(\mathit{jq}) \simeq \operatorname{neg}(q)(\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{jq})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.; \forall \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)(\mathit{jq}) \simeq \operatorname{zero}(q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}low}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{bq}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((\mathit{bq} \leq 0) \wedge (j < \mathit{bq}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q)(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{fq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q), \mathit{fq}) = \mathit{fq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{hq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}), \mathit{hq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{hq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{hq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{hq})) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{hq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{hq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}), \mathit{hq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{hq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{gq}, \mathit{fq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q), \mathit{fq}) = \mathit{fq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}neg}(q, \mathit{fq}), \mathit{fq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)) \simeq \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{lrf\_}, \operatorname{lrg\_}] \in (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q) \times \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)).\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \operatorname{lrf\_}, \operatorname{lrg\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{lrf\_}, \operatorname{lrg\_}] \in (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q) \times \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)).\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{lrf\_}, \operatorname{lrg\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)) \simeq (\lambda f \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q).\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}neg}(q, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)) \simeq \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)) \simeq \operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}commutative-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)))}}
