\noindent{\small ccr1109a3-laurent-val.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-A3), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109a3/ccr1109a3-laurent-val.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}vanish2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{pq}, r, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{pq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad j < (\mathit{pq} + r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}single}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{pq}, r, \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad (\mathit{pq} + r) = \mathit{nq} \wedge \\ \quad \forall s, \mathit{qs} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad (((s + \mathit{qs}) = \mathit{nq}) \wedge \neg (s = \mathit{pq})) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{fq}(s) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \vee (\operatorname{gq}(\mathit{qs}) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(\mathit{nq}) = \operatorname{mul}(q)(\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{pq}), \operatorname{gq}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}lowest}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{pq}, r \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{pq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})((\mathit{pq} + r)) = \operatorname{mul}(q)(\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{pq}), \operatorname{gq}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{fq}(r) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \mathit{oq} = r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{fq}.; \forall \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (\neg (\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}ord}(q, \mathit{fq}) = \mathit{oq} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}ord}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \neg (\mathit{fq} = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq}, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{gq}(r) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{oq} + r) \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})((\mathit{oq} + r)) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < (\mathit{oq} + r)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq}, r, s.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{gq}(r) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(s) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{cq} \leq \mathit{oq} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{cq} \leq r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \mathit{cq} \leq s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(q) \wedge (\neg (\mathit{fq} = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)) \wedge \neg (\mathit{gq} = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}ord}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})) = (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ord}(q, \mathit{fq}) + \operatorname{laurent\text{-}ord}(q, \mathit{gq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q), \mathit{gq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}anti-\allowbreak{}exp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{sq}, \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < q) \wedge ((q < 1) \wedge (\mathit{sq} \leq \mathit{tq}))) \Rightarrow ({q}^{\mathit{tq}} \leq {q}^{\mathit{sq}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q, \mathit{rq}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge \neg (\mathit{fq} = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) = {\mathit{rq}}^{\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ord}(q, \mathit{fq})}) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})) = (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) \cdot \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{gq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})) \leq \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{gq})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr1109a3-laurent-field.scm}{theorem-library/ccr1109a3-laurent-field.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr1109a3-laurent-field.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-A3), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109a3/ccr1109a3-laurent-field.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq}.; \forall \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq})(\mathit{jq}) \simeq \left(\text{if }(\mathit{jq} = \mathit{tq})\text{ then }\mathit{cq}\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(q)\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq}) \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq})(\mathit{tq}) = \mathit{cq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (j < \mathit{tq})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq}) \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{bq}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{bq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad j < \mathit{bq} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{kq}.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(\mathit{kq}), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(\mathit{kq}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\mathit{kq}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(\mathit{kq}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, q) \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(\mathit{kq}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (j < -\mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(\mathit{kq}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, q)(j) = \operatorname{zero}(\mathit{kq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (\mathit{jq} \leq (\mathit{mq} + -\mathit{oq}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, (\mathit{mq} + 1))(\mathit{jq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, \mathit{mq})(\mathit{jq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}stable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((\mathit{mq} \leq b) \wedge (\mathit{jq} \leq (\mathit{mq} + -\mathit{oq})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, b)(\mathit{jq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, \mathit{mq})(\mathit{jq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q)(\mathit{jq}) \simeq \left(\text{if }(\mathit{jq} = 0)\text{ then }\operatorname{one}(q)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(q)\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q)(0) = \operatorname{one}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}off}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \neg (\mathit{jq} = 0)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q)(\mathit{jq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}top}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq}))((\mathit{oq} + \mathit{tq})) = \operatorname{mul}(q)(\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}), \mathit{cq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}low}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq}, \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (\forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge (\mathit{nq} < (\mathit{oq} + \mathit{tq})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq}))(\mathit{nq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{kq}.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(\mathit{kq}), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(\mathit{kq}), \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\mathit{kq}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(\mathit{kq}))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(\mathit{kq})(\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}), \mathit{aq}) = \operatorname{one}(\mathit{kq}) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{nq} \leq q \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(\mathit{kq}, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(\mathit{kq}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, q))(\mathit{nq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(\mathit{kq})(\mathit{nq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}ser-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}ser}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq})(\mathit{jq}) \simeq \left(\text{if }(-\mathit{oq} \leq \mathit{jq})\text{ then }\operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, (\mathit{jq} + \mathit{oq}))(\mathit{jq})\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(q)\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}ser-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}ser}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}) \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}ser-\allowbreak{}low}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (j < -\mathit{oq})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}ser}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq})(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}ser-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}ser}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}) \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}ser-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), b \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (j \leq (b + -\mathit{oq}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}ser}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq})(j) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}pre}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq}, b)(j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \simeq \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{zz\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}ser-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{oq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{aq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{oq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(q)(\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{oq}), \mathit{aq}) = \operatorname{one}(q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}inv\text{-}ser}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{oq}, \mathit{aq})) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{one}(q) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (\mathit{fq} = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \simeq \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \simeq \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \simeq \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \simeq \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \simeq \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}fnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (0 < \mathit{rq})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \simeq (\lambda f \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}ring}(q)).\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}view-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, j) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}matscale-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{carr}(k), p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, p), q) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}matscale-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{carr}(k), p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, q)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (0 \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, m, n, \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, n), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, m, n.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(k), b \in \mathbb{R}, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(c) \leq 1) \wedge ((0 \leq b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, m, n, a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, m, n, \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, a), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}nvint-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.; \forall c \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k).\; ((c \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(c) \leq 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}nvint-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(c) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \simeq \operatorname{intersection\text{-}of}(\{s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) : ((\operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \in s) \wedge ((\operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \in s) \wedge (\forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, m) \in s) \wedge (\forall x, y \in s.\; (\operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, y) \in s) \wedge \forall x \in s, c \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k).\; (\operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, x) \in s)))))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}fam-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) : ((\operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \in s) \wedge ((\operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \in s) \wedge (\forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, m) \in s) \wedge (\forall x, y \in s.\; (\operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, y) \in s) \wedge \forall x \in s, c \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k).\; (\operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, x) \in s)))))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}mult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, m) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m)) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, q) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), p, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, p) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), s.; \forall p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \in s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, m) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; (\operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, y) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s, c \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, x) \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, 0) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, (j + 1)) = \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, \operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n), p) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, c.; \forall p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded\text{-}by}(k, n, m, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, n, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, \operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, j)), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m)) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, q) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{zkk} \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, p, \mathit{zkk}) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, c.; \forall p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded\text{-}by}(k, n, m, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded\text{-}by}(k, n, p, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (m \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zalg-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(i) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}poly\text{-}eval}(k, n, p, m) \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(i) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, \operatorname{mat\text{-}poly\text{-}eval}(k, n, p, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}zalg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall p \in \operatorname{zpoly\text{-}alg}(k, n, m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, m)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, n, l, x, j. \\ \quad ((q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, l, x)) \wedge (j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}of}(q, n, j) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, n, l, x, j, i. \\ \quad ((q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, l, x)) \wedge ((j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l)) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{col\text{-}of}(q, n, j), i, 1) = \operatorname{entry}(q, i, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, l, p, q.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, l). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))) \wedge ((q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, l, \operatorname{carr}(a))) \wedge (1 \leq n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, q), i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{col\text{-}of}(q, n, j)), i, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}column}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c, o.; \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{zkr} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, \mathit{zkr}) \wedge \\ \quad o \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, o, o) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; ((o < k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(c, k, k) = \operatorname{one}(r))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, k, o) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}or-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{zkr} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, \mathit{zkr}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(c, e, e) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \vee (c = \operatorname{identmat}(r, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}last-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{zkr} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{col\text{-}step\text{-}row}(r, n, c, \mathit{zkr}) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(c, e, e) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists o \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{entry}(c, o, o) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; ((o < k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(c, k, k) = \operatorname{one}(r)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}col-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{col\text{-}of}(\operatorname{zeromat}(r, n, n), n, j) = \operatorname{zeromat}(r, n, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}mm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{matmul}(r, p, \operatorname{zeromat}(r, n, n)) = \operatorname{zeromat}(r, n, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (\operatorname{det}(r, n, b) = \operatorname{zero}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (e = \operatorname{zeromat}(r, n, 1)) \wedge (\operatorname{matmul}(r, b, e) = \operatorname{zeromat}(r, n, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b) = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (e = \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, e) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, l, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((l \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, l, \operatorname{carr}(r))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{zeromat}(r, m, n), p) = \operatorname{zeromat}(r, m, l) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}commute-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{zkk} \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, \operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, \mathit{zkk})) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, \mathit{zkk}), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}krylov-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{krylov\text{-}mat}(k, n, m, i) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}krylov-\allowbreak{}column}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, i.; \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}of}(\operatorname{krylov\text{-}mat}(k, n, m, i), n, j) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, m, (j - 1)), i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cq4-\allowbreak{}commutant-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, b, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, b) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (e = \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, e) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b = \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}commutant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b) = \operatorname{zero}(k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b = \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cd7-\allowbreak{}unif-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c_{0} \in \mathbb{N}, k, n, m, s, a, l, b. \\ \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{N}. \exists c \in \mathbb{N}. \forall d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (c \leq d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))(\left(\text{if }((\operatorname{nnfst}(t) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (\operatorname{nnsnd}(t) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)))\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(s(a(d)), \operatorname{nnfst}(t), \operatorname{nnsnd}(t))\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(k)\right), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad l(t)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{N}. \forall t, d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((t \leq c_{0}) \wedge (c \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))(\left(\text{if }((\operatorname{nnfst}(t) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (\operatorname{nnsnd}(t) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)))\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(s(a(d)), \operatorname{nnfst}(t), \operatorname{nnsnd}(t))\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(k)\right), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad l(t)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; b \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cd7-\allowbreak{}read}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}, s, a.; \forall l \in \operatorname{product\text{-}carrier}((\lambda t \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))), b \in \mathbb{N}, i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\forall b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, m, s(b), 1) \wedge \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))(\left(\text{if }((\operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{nnpair}(i, j)) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (\operatorname{nnsnd}(\operatorname{nnpair}(i, j)) \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)))\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(s(a(b)), \operatorname{nnfst}(\operatorname{nnpair}(i, j)), \operatorname{nnsnd}(\operatorname{nnpair}(i, j)))\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(k)\right), \\ \quad \quad \quad l(\operatorname{nnpair}(i, j))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(s(a(b)), i, j), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matof}(n, m, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cd7i\_}, \operatorname{cd7j\_}] \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \times \operatorname{interval}(1, m)).\; l(\operatorname{nnpair}(\operatorname{cd7i\_}, \operatorname{cd7j\_})))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad i, j)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, m, s(a), 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, m, b, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (d \leq a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}close}(k, n, m, s(i(a)), b, c) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n, m.; \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(k), a.; \forall c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, m, a, c) \wedge ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y) \cdot c) \leq d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, m, \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, a), d) \end{array}}}
