\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((1 \leq n) \wedge ((0 \leq r) \wedge (r \leq 1))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{power}(r, n) \leq r))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}argmax}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i_{0}, j_{0} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(a, i, j)) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(a, i_{0}, j_{0})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, n, a, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall q \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in q. \\ \quad \quad ((a(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge ((b(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(a(z), \operatorname{neg}(k)(b(z)))) \leq r))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)), a, q), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(k)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)), b, q)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}close-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, m, e, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq e \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}close}(k, n, n, a, b, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, n, m, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}close}(k, n, n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, m), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, m), \\ \quad \quad \quad (e \cdot c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}close-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, m, e, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq e \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}close}(k, n, n, a, b, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, n, m, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}close}(k, n, n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, b), \\ \quad \quad \quad (c \cdot e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}mpow-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, x, a) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}unbounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)), c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\neg \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, x) \wedge (0 \leq c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}, i, l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad c < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}power}(k, n, x, j), i, l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}commute}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p, m, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, p) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, p), m) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{carr}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, p) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cd8-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, m.; \forall a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, x)) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, n, y, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, m) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, y)) \cdot (a + 1)) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(y, i, j)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, x)) \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, m)) \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}ultra-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), c, a) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, c) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b)) \\ \quad \leq\; \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, b))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, a) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, a) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, p) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, b) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, p) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, b))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4x-ext.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4x-ext.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4x-ext.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-C2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109c2/ccr4x-ext.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{map-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, h, g, a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, s). \\ \quad ((h \in (s \to s)) \wedge ((g \in (s \to s)) \wedge ((a \in (s \to s)) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (a(z) = g(h(z)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(a, n, u) = \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(g, n, \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, n, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{map-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}ident}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall h \in (s \to s), n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, s). \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (h(z) = z) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(h, n, u) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u.; \forall t \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, t) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(t, n, u) = \operatorname{matact}(d, \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, t), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u.; \forall t \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)), m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(t, n, u) = \operatorname{matact}(d, m, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, t) = m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, t, s, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (r(z) = s(t(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, r) = \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, t), \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u.; \forall r \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (r(z) = z) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, r) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mult-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall i \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mult\text{-}op}(f, i) \in (\operatorname{carr}(f) \to \operatorname{carr}(f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mult-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall i, w \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mult\text{-}op}(f, i)(w) = \operatorname{mul}(f)(i, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall i \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, \operatorname{mult\text{-}op}(f, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall i \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, i) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{map\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{mult\text{-}op}(f, i), n, u) = \operatorname{matact}(d, \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, i), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall i, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, \operatorname{mul}(f)(i, a)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, a), \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, \operatorname{one}(f)) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall i \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, i) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall i, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, \operatorname{mul}(f)(i, a)) = (\operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, i) \cdot \operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, \operatorname{one}(f)) = 1) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{matact-\allowbreak{}matadd-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, a, b, u.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{scal}(d), a, b), u), i, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, a, u), i, 1), \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, b, u), i, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, t, s, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (r(z) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(t(z), s(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, r) = \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, t), \operatorname{op\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{matact-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}ident-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{scal}(d), c, \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n)), u), i, 1) = \operatorname{act}(d)(c, \operatorname{entry}(u, i, 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ext-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall l \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, \operatorname{act}(d)(l, \operatorname{one}(f))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), l, \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(r), g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; (g(z) = c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(r, g, \operatorname{interval}(1, s)) = \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, c, s) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s, t \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, s), \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, t)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, s))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, t)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}valuation}(f, (\lambda v \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; \operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, v))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall l \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, \operatorname{act}(d)(l, \operatorname{one}(f))) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(l), n) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}full}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall h \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, \operatorname{mult\text{-}mat}(d, n, u, f, h)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}valuation}(f, (\lambda v \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; \operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, v))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall l \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ext\text{-}abs}(k, f, d, n, u, \operatorname{act}(d)(l, \operatorname{one}(f))) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(l), n) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}ultrametric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}irreducible\text{-}mat}(k, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, m) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), m, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, b))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cf4-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, m.; \forall a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in m.\; (y \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in m. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, x)) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}mat\text{-}bound}(k, n, n, b, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in m. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, y) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b)) \cdot (a + 1)) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(b, i, j)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}fam}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in m.\; (y \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in m. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), b, y) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, b) = \operatorname{zero}(k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad b = \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, n) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in m. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), y, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, x)) \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}power\text{-}bounded}(k, n, x) \end{array}}}

(y \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cfb} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in m. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \mathit{cfb}, y) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cg5-\allowbreak{}row-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f, d, n, u.; \forall e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}fin\text{-}ext}(k, f, d, n, u) \wedge \neg (e = \operatorname{zeromat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n, 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matact}(d, \operatorname{transpose}(e, n, 1), u), 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}def}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k), e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e) \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, \operatorname{max}(-e, 0))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, \operatorname{max}(e, 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k), e \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e) = \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, -j) \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, -j), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, j)) = \operatorname{one}(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}8}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \mathbb{Z}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e), u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}8-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall b, l \in \mathbb{Z}, u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, b), u) = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, l), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (b = l) \wedge (u = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}remark-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}9}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}fractions-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}explicit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w, x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(k)(x, v) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}fractions-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}maximal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, p.; \forall x \in p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow (x \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(k) \in p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a, p.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(k) \in p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, p.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in p.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(y))) < 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, p.; \forall x, y \in p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(y))) < 1)) \Rightarrow (x = y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall z \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in p, d \in a.\; (z = \operatorname{add}(k)(b, \operatorname{mul}(k)(d, w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall b, c \in p, d, f \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(b, \operatorname{mul}(k)(d, w)) = \operatorname{add}(k)(c, \operatorname{mul}(k)(f, w)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (b = c) \wedge (d = f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall b \in p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) = 1 \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small ccr4x-series.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-C), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109c/ccr4x-series.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}char}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{Z}, s, t \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge ((s + -t) = e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, t)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e), w) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (e + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e), \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, -e)) = \operatorname{one}(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w), e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w, a, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, a, n, 0) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w, a, n.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, a, n, (m + 1)) \simeq \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, a, n, m), \operatorname{mul}(k)(a((n + m)), \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (n + m))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k, w.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(k)), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, a, n, m) \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}def}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall z \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{nv\text{-}digit}(k, p, z) \in p) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(z, \operatorname{neg}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}digit}(k, p, z)))) < 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall z \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in a.\; (z = \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}digit}(k, p, z), \operatorname{mul}(k)(w, d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}sequence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall y \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((f(0) = y) \wedge \forall s \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(s) = \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}digit}(k, p, f(s)), \operatorname{mul}(k)(w, f((s + 1)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}expand-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k, a, w, p.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to a), b \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(k)), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad f(s) = \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}digit}(k, p, f(s)), \operatorname{mul}(k)(w, f((s + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b((n + j)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}digit}(k, p, f(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, n), f(0)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, b, n, m), \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (n + m)), f(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}17}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, -n), x) \in a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}17-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}, b.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w.; \forall e, f \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e), \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, f)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (e + f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (e + 1))) = (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e)) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, k, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((w \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) \leq 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (e + j))) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ultra-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u, v, z \in \operatorname{carr}(k), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(u, \operatorname{neg}(k)(v))) \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(v, \operatorname{neg}(k)(z))) \leq r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(u, \operatorname{neg}(k)(z))) \leq r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \mathbb{N}, k, a, w, p.; \forall b \in (\mathbb{Z} \to p), n \in \mathbb{Z}, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, b, n, (m + l)), \operatorname{neg}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, b, n, m)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (n + m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall b \in (\mathbb{Z} \to p), n \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\lambda \mathit{nem} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, b, n, \mathit{nem})), x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, b, n, m)))) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, (n + m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pad-\allowbreak{}psum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k, a, w, p.; \forall b \in (\mathbb{Z} \to p), l \in \mathbb{Z}, d \in \mathbb{N}, n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad (l + d) = n \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((z < n) \Rightarrow (b(z) = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, b, l, (d + m)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}psum}(k, w, b, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}pad}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p, b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall l \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad l \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, l, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}same-\allowbreak{}start}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, k, a, w, p, c, d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, c, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, d, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad j < b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c((n + j)) = d((n + j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p, b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, c.; \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall z \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, c, m, x) \wedge \\ \quad n \leq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b(z) = c(z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}17-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k), b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, c.; \forall m, z \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, c, m, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b(z) = c(z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}17-\allowbreak{}full}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}, b.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, c.; \forall m, z \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, c, m, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(z) = c(z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y) \leq (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x))) \vee (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}remark-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}9-\allowbreak{}accumulation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}accumulation\text{-}point}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \{v \in \mathbb{R} : \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (v = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x))\}, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c = 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr-kn-norms.scm}{theorem-library/ccr-kn-norms.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr-kn-norms.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-E), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109e/ccr-kn-norms.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}8-\allowbreak{}kn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u_{1}, u_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}norm\text{-}on}(k, \operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n), u_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}norm\text{-}on}(k, \operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n), u_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), n)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((l \cdot \operatorname{u1}(x)) \leq \operatorname{u2}(x)) \wedge (\operatorname{u2}(x) \leq (u \cdot \operatorname{u1}(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc3-uniform.scm}{theorem-library/calc3-uniform.scm}
\noindent{\small calc3-uniform.scm -- calculus.pdf Prop 3.22 and Cor 3.23: UNIFORM CONTINUITY OFF A COMPACT SET.  Agent CALC-3, 2026-10-19.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \wedge ((k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \wedge \forall x \in k, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(t)(f(x), f(y)) \leq a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), k)), t, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{constant-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists v.\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\neg (x \in k) \Rightarrow (f(x) = v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/isom-uc.scm}{theorem-library/isom-uc.scm}
\noindent{\small isom-uc.scm -- calculus.pdf Proposition 3.21: if X is compact, every continuous f : X --$>$ Y is uniformly continuous.  Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{carrier-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/isom-equicont.scm}{theorem-library/isom-equicont.scm}
\noindent{\small isom-equicont.scm -- calculus.pdf Proposition 3.33: on a compact metric space, pointwise and uniform convergence agree for an equicontinuous sequence of functions into ANY metric space.  Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{uniform-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}ptwise\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{equicont-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, m, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, t, m) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}ptwise\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{equicont-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, m, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, t, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}ptwise\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{equicontinuous-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}sequence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous\text{-}set}(s, t, a) \wedge (m \in (\mathbb{N} \to a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, t, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{equicont-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, m, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous\text{-}set}(s, t, a) \wedge (m \in (\mathbb{N} \to a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}ptwise\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/isom-supdist.scm}{theorem-library/isom-supdist.scm}
\noindent{\small isom-supdist.scm -- the sup distance between two functions into a metric space, boundedness of a compact metric space, and the group of isometries of a compact metric space as a metric space (calculus.pdf ch. 3 sec. 8, the metric (54)). Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge (g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(t)(f(x), g(x)) \leq \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, t, f, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge (g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, t, f, g) \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, g, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(f(x), g(x)) \leq b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, t, f, g) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, t, f, g)) \wedge (\operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, t, f, g) \leq b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq b) \wedge \forall x, y.\; (((x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \simeq \{f \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{pts}(s)) : \operatorname{is\text{-}isometry}(s, s, f)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, i. \\ \quad (i \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \Leftrightarrow ((i \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}isometry}(s, s, i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall i \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s).\; (i \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{imu\_}, \operatorname{imv\_}] \in (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \times \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, \operatorname{imu\_}, \operatorname{imv\_})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \times \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{imu\_}, \operatorname{imv\_}] \in (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \times \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)).\; \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, \operatorname{imu\_}, \operatorname{imv\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s))(u, v) \simeq \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, u, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/isom-group.scm}{theorem-library/isom-group.scm}
\noindent{\small isom-group.scm -- calculus.pdf Propositions 3.37 and 3.38: the group of isometries of a compact metric space, with the sup metric, is compact, and in it uniform and pointwise convergence agree.  Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \subseteq (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}equicontinuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (m \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, s, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}isometry-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((m \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s))) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}ptwise\text{-}to}(s, s, m, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad g \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}to}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, m, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t))) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}ptwise\text{-}to}(s, t, m, g) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(t, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; m(k)(x)), g(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((m \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s))) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s), m, g) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly\text{-}to}(s, s, m, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s))) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s), a, g) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(x)), g(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}subseq-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \exists g.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}ptwise\text{-}to}(s, s, \operatorname{subseq}(f, a), g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/isom2-group.scm}{theorem-library/isom2-group.scm}
\noindent{\small isom2-group.scm -- the isometries of a metric space onto itself form a GROUP under composition, and for a compact space the sup metric makes it a compact METRIC GROUP (calculus.pdf ch. 3 sec. 8, after Prop 3.37: "In fact, Gamma is a compact metric group").  Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow ((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; u(v(x))) \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow ((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; x) \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (u^{-1} \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}grp-\allowbreak{}opr-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{igu\_}, \operatorname{igv\_}] \in (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \times \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{igu\_}(\operatorname{igv\_}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \times \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}grp-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s).\; i^{-1}) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \end{array}}}
