\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}grp-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s)) \simeq \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}grp-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{igu\_}, \operatorname{igv\_}] \in (\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s) \times \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)).\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{igu\_}(\operatorname{igv\_}(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}grp-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s)) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}grp-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s)) \simeq (\lambda i \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s).\; i^{-1})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}grp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, v, p, q \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; u(v(x))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; p(q(x)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, u, p) + \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, v, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall u, w \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, u^{-1}, w^{-1}) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{sup\text{-}dist}(s, s, w, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}gm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s), \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}gm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s), \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mg-struct.scm}{theorem-library/mg-struct.scm}
\noindent{\small mg-struct.scm -- the structure METRIC-GROUP and the group metrics (in the pattern of tb11/tg-struct.scm): the typing and functoriality obligations of METRIC-GROUP-MS and METRIC-GROUP-GROUP, the bridge IS-METRIC-GROUP(G) =$>$ IS-GROUP-METRIC(space, group), the way back IS-GROUP-METRIC(ms, g) =$>$ ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}functorial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(a), \operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(b), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}functorial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(a, b, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}group}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(a), \operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(b), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g), \operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{opr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{iden}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{inv}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}gdist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{gdist}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(s, g)) \simeq \operatorname{dist}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{make-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}metric}(s, g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(s, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s), \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(\operatorname{make\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s), \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mb12-metric.scm}{theorem-library/mb12-metric.scm}
\noindent{\small mb12-metric.scm -- construction-of-measures.pdf Appendix A.3 (metric odds and ends): A.6 (a compact set and a disjoint closed set are at positive distance), and more below. Agent ISOM (brief M-B1B2), 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}distance}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, k, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k.\; \neg (x \in f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(s, k, f) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lipschitz-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}balls}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((\operatorname{pts}(t) = \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq (k \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(t, x, r) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(s, x, (k \cdot r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lipschitz-\allowbreak{}lower-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}balls}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((\operatorname{pts}(t) = \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((k \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(s, x, (k \cdot r)) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(t, x, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lipschitz-\allowbreak{}equivalent-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}balls}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((\operatorname{pts}(t) = \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((a \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq (k \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(s, x, (a \cdot r)) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(t, x, r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(t, x, r) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(s, x, (k \cdot r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, o)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), o)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, k, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq (u \cup v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad b \subseteq v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad k = (a \cup b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg1-basic.scm}{theorem-library/cg1-basic.scm}
\noindent{\small cg1-basic.scm -- compact-groups notes, chapter 1 (CG-1): balls are sets in any structure with a set of points; a metric group is a topological group; Isom(X) is a topological group (Proposition 1.6).  Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: cgb-.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ball-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, x, r.\; ((\operatorname{pts}(s) \in \mathbf{Set}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}metric}(s, p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)), \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)), \operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{isometry-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(\operatorname{make\text{-}top\text{-}group}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s)), \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}grp}(s))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg1-conn.scm}{theorem-library/cg1-conn.scm}
\noindent{\small cg1-conn.scm -- connectedness in topological spaces and the connected component of a topological group (compact-groups notes, Lemma 5.7 and Proposition 5.8). Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: cgc-.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}continuity-\allowbreak{}preimage-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(s), \mathit{lw} \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad (f(z) \in \mathit{lw}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((z \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (f(q) \in \mathit{lw})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{preimage}(s, f, w) \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{image-\allowbreak{}connected-\allowbreak{}t}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(s), w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad (f(z) \in w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((z \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (f(q) \in w)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{union-\allowbreak{}connected-\allowbreak{}t}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, b) \wedge ((p \in a) \wedge (p \in b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, (a \cup b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{connected-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x) \simeq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(c, \{c \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, c) \wedge (x \in c))\}, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{connected-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x.; \forall y \in \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x). \exists c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, c) \wedge ((x \in c) \wedge (y \in c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{connected-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, c) \wedge ((x \in c) \wedge (y \in c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{singleton-\allowbreak{}connected-\allowbreak{}t}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, \operatorname{singleton}(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{connected-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}self}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{connected-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{connected-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}map}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), y \in \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(s), w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \quad (f(z) \in w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((z \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (f(q) \in w)) \wedge \\ \quad f(x) \in \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(y) \in \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg1-group.scm}{theorem-library/cg1-group.scm}
\noindent{\small cg1-group.scm -- the connected component of the identity of a topological group is a normal subgroup (compact-groups notes, Lemma 5.7, the algebraic half; "closed" needs CLOSURE). Inversion, left translation and conjugation are locally continuous self-maps; each maps the component into itself ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inversion-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in \operatorname{pts}(s), w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\forall \mathit{vw} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(\mathit{vw}) = \operatorname{inv}(g)(\mathit{vw})) \wedge (f(z) \in w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((z \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (f(q) \in w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inversion-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \to \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))), z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)), w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{vw} \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)).\; (f(\mathit{vw}) = \operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\mathit{vw})) \wedge \\ \quad f(z) \in w \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (z \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (f(q) \in w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}translation-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g), f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in \operatorname{pts}(s), w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\forall \mathit{vw} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(\mathit{vw}) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \mathit{vw})) \wedge (f(z) \in w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((z \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (f(q) \in w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}translation-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)), f \in (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \to \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))), z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)), w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{vw} \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad f(\mathit{vw}) = \operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(a, \mathit{vw}) \wedge \\ \quad f(z) \in w \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (z \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (f(q) \in w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}conjugation-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(g), f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), z \in \operatorname{pts}(s), w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{vw} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(\mathit{vw}) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, \mathit{vw}), \operatorname{inv}(g)(u))) \wedge \\ \quad f(z) \in w \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{lu} \in \operatorname{opens}(s).\; ((z \in \mathit{lu}) \wedge \forall q \in \mathit{lu}.\; (f(q) \in w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}conjugation-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)), f \in (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \to \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))), z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)), w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{vw} \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad f(\mathit{vw}) = \operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(u, \mathit{vw}), \operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(u)) \wedge \\ \quad f(z) \in w \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{lu} \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (z \in \mathit{lu}) \wedge \forall q \in \mathit{lu}.\; (f(q) \in w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normal\text{-}subgroup}(g, \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}subgroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normal\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{opens}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \neg (z \in h)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) : \neg (z \in h)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}connected-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge ((h \in \operatorname{opens}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, h)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h = \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}connected-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h = \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg2-top.scm}{theorem-library/cg2-top.scm}
\noindent{\small cg2-top.scm -- Proposition 5.8 of the compact-groups notes: for an open V containing e with V = V\textasciicircum{}-1, the union H of the powers V\textasciicircum{}k is an open subgroup; when V is also connected, H is the connected component of e (and so connected).  Each result is proved for a group topology (s, g) under NAME-gt and restated for the ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{opens}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{set\text{-}prod}(g, a, v) \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in v)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \in \operatorname{opens}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}contains-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{opens}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g)) \subseteq h \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}contains-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \subseteq h \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}powers-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, s, g, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (v \subseteq \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k) \subseteq \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge ((\operatorname{iden}(g) \in v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \subseteq \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}powers-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge ((\operatorname{iden}(g) \in v) \wedge \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)) \wedge (\operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) \in \operatorname{opens}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}powers-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}subgroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), v)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), v) \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}powers-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{iden}(g) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v) = \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}powers-\allowbreak{}component}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), v) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg2-compact.scm}{theorem-library/cg2-compact.scm}
\noindent{\small cg2-compact.scm -- Corollary 5.9 of the compact-groups notes: in a COMPACT topological group, for an open V containing e with V = V\textasciicircum{}-1, the powers V\textasciicircum{}k stabilise: H = V\textasciicircum{}m for some m; when V is also connected, V\textasciicircum{}m is the connected component of e.  The notes' proof ("the sequence V\textasciicircum{}k is non-decreasing; by compactness of H ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, g, v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((v \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((\operatorname{iden}(g) \in v) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, k) \subseteq \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, (k + d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{set-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{opens}(s)) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, (k + 1)) \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}powers-\allowbreak{}stabilize-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \wedge ((\operatorname{iden}(g) \in v) \wedge \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, m) = \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(g, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}powers-\allowbreak{}stabilize}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), v, m) = \operatorname{powers\text{-}union}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{iden}(g) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(g)(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{set\text{-}power}(g, v, m) = \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, \operatorname{iden}(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}component-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in v.\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))(p) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{set\text{-}power}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), v, m) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cvx-tb.scm}{theorem-library/cvx-tb.scm}
\noindent{\small cvx-tb.scm -- Lemma 1.12 of the compact-groups notes: the convex hull of a totally bounded subset of a real normed vector space is totally bounded.  Route: the join of a totally bounded set to a point is totally bounded (a net of the set times a grid of [0, 1]); the hull of a finite set is totally bounded (induction on ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}totally-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}classes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(m, a) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((f \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(m)) \wedge \forall p \in a.\; \exists c \in f.\; (\operatorname{dist}(m)(c, p) < r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, z, a, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (t \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), z), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), x), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}coefficient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, t, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - u), f), \operatorname{act}(m)(u, a)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), f), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)((u - t), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(f)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, z, a, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (t \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), x), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), z), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \lvert (1 - t) \rvert \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(z, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}coefficient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, t, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (u \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), f), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - u), f), \operatorname{act}(m)(u, a))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \lvert (u - t) \rvert \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(a, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}distance}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((f \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (f \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 \leq d) \wedge \forall \mathit{bdf} \in f.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(a, \mathit{bdf}) \leq d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{join-\allowbreak{}net-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, y, f, a, t, u, o, l, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad u \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad u \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t < (u + l) \wedge \\ \quad o \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq l \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(f, y) < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(a, f) \leq d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - u), f), \operatorname{act}(m)(u, a)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), y), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, a))) \\ \quad \quad <\; o + (l \cdot d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}grid-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, k, t. \\ \quad ((l \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 < ((k \cdot l) + l)) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq t) \wedge (t \leq 1))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i \in \mathrm{OS}((k + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((i \cdot l) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (((i \cdot l) \leq t) \wedge (t < ((i \cdot l) + l))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}totally-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), \operatorname{conv\text{-}join}(m, c, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{totally-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), b) \wedge (a \subseteq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{totally-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), \emptyset) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{totally-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), s) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), (s \cup \{a\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, y, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(0, y), \operatorname{act}(m)(1, a)) = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}same-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (s \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - s), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(s, a)) = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}join-\allowbreak{}with-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, (\operatorname{conv\text{-}join}(m, c, a) \cup \{a\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}totally-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((|a| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}second-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, x, z, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (t \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, z)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, x)), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}second-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, x, z, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (t \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, z))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \lvert t \rvert \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(z, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}totally-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-extreme.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-extreme.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-extreme.scm -- the extreme points of the convex hull of E lie in E (compact-groups notes, Lemma 1.13, its algebraic core: eqs. (10)-(11) of the proof.  The closures of the notes' statement -- "a closed set whose CLOSED convex hull is A" -- are skipped: CLOSURE). Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: ce4-.  ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}level}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, m, e, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e), x) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}level}(m, e, k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}points-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e), x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in e \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/krein-milman.scm}{theorem-library/krein-milman.scm}
\noindent{\small krein-milman.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-KM), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/bakm-1109/krein-milman.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}points-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, s.\; (\operatorname{extreme\text{-}points}(m, s) \simeq \{z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, s, z)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{closed\text{-}conv\text{-}hull}(m, t, e) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) : \forall c \in \mathbf{Set}.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, c) \wedge (e \subseteq c))) \Rightarrow (x \in c))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}points-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, z. \\ \quad (z \in \operatorname{extreme\text{-}points}(m, s)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, s, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, e, z. \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}conv\text{-}hull}(m, t, e) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, c) \wedge (e \subseteq c))) \Rightarrow (z \in c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}extremal-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, b, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, b, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, a, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, a, e. \\ \quad ((b \subseteq a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, a, e) \wedge (e \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, b, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extremal-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}singleton-\allowbreak{}extreme}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, f, a) \wedge (\forall p, q \in f.\; (p = q) \wedge (e \in f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, a, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}intersection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, (a \cap b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (v \in \operatorname{opens}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (u \cup v) \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}directed-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in d.\; (u \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists u.\; (u \in d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in d.\; \exists c \in d.\; ((a \subseteq c) \wedge (b \subseteq c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; \exists u \in d.\; (x \in u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in d.\; (s \subseteq u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}hausdorff-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge ((s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}meet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a.\; (a \in h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in h.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in h.\; (a \subseteq s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in h.\; \exists z.\; (z \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in h.\; ((a \subseteq b) \vee (b \subseteq a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in s.\; \forall a \in h.\; (p \in a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}superlevel-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, s, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \{h \in s : (c \leq g(h))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}attained}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in s.\; \forall w \in s.\; (g(w) \leq g(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{max-\allowbreak{}face-\allowbreak{}extremal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g, s, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad p \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in s.\; (g(w) \leq g(p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, \{h \in s : (g(p) \leq g(h))\}, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}combination}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, t, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(u, a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, b))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(u, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, a)), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, x)) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, z), \operatorname{act}(m)(-1, z)) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}separation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, v, a, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in v \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c_{0}.\; (c_{0} \in c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in c.\; \neg (z \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{kgz} \in c.\; (f(\mathit{kgz}) < f(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}separation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, u, a, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}convex\text{-}tvs}(m, t) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c_{0}.\; (c_{0} \in c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in c.\; \neg (z \in u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{kgz} \in c.\; (f(\mathit{kgz}) < f(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extremal-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \exists z_{0}.\; (z_{0} \in s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, s, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extremal-\allowbreak{}meet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in h.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, a, s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in \{b \in s : \forall a \in h.\; (b \in a)\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, \{b \in s : \forall a \in h.\; (b \in a)\}, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}meet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, s) \wedge \forall a \in h.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \{b \in s : \forall a \in h.\; (b \in a)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}separates-\allowbreak{}points}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}convex\text{-}tvs}(m, t) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \neg (x = y)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f(y) < f(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}face-\allowbreak{}above}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, s, f, g, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, f, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad g) \wedge \\ \quad x \in f \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{kfm}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \mathit{kfm}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(m, \mathit{kfm}, s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{kfm} \subseteq f \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists e.\; (e \in \mathit{kfm}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathit{kfm}.\; (g(x) \leq g(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}convex\text{-}tvs}(m, t) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z_{0}.\; (z_{0} \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}extreme\text{-}point}(m, s, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, e, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge ((c \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, c) \wedge (e \subseteq c))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}conv\text{-}hull}(m, t, e) \subseteq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow (e \subseteq \operatorname{closed\text{-}conv\text{-}hull}(m, t, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \operatorname{closed\text{-}conv\text{-}hull}(m, t, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{closed\text{-}conv\text{-}hull}(m, t, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}points-\allowbreak{}nonempty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}convex\text{-}tvs}(m, t) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z_{0}.\; (z_{0} \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{extreme\text{-}points}(m, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{krein-\allowbreak{}milman}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}convex\text{-}tvs}(m, t) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(t, s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad s = \operatorname{closed\text{-}conv\text{-}hull}(m, t, \operatorname{extreme\text{-}points}(m, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rmod-\allowbreak{}combination-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, a, b, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, b)), \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x))), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}oball-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, f, b, x, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, a, f) \wedge ((b \subseteq a) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \operatorname{sn\text{-}oball}(m, f, b, x, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seminorm-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, x, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}convex\text{-}tvs}(m, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/haar-fixed-point.scm}{theorem-library/haar-fixed-point.scm}
\noindent{\small haar-fixed-point.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent HAAR-C), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/haarc-1109/haar-fixed-point.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}combination}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, y, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, b)), y) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; ((1 - t) \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(a, y)) + (t \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(b, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, y, t, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad o \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(a, y) \leq o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(b, y) \leq o \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, b)), y) \leq o \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, c)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}subspace-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}top}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(s), \operatorname{pts}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}meet-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a.\; (a \in h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in h.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in h.\; \exists z.\; (z \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in h.\; ((a \subseteq b) \vee (b \subseteq a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \forall a \in h.\; (p \in a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}meet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \forall a \in h.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \{u \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall b \in h.\; (u \in b)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}meet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{kca} \in h.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \mathit{kca}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, \{u \in a : \forall b \in h.\; (u \in b)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invariant-\allowbreak{}ccs-\allowbreak{}minimal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}ccs}(m, a, s, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}ccs}(m, a, s, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}ccs}(m, a, s, c) \wedge (c \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow (b \subseteq c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}cap-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a), b) \wedge \\ \quad o \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{z \in b : \forall y \in b.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(z, y) \leq o)\}) \end{array}}}
