\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}diameter-\allowbreak{}sup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a)) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in b.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(x, y) \leq d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq e) \wedge (e < d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists x, y \in b.\; (e < \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}net}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a)) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a), b) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in b.\; \exists c \in f.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(c, p) \leq d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}net-\allowbreak{}average}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, b, a, d.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, b) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in b) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d < a \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in b.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(x, y) \leq a) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in b, \mathit{hvd} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < \mathit{hvd} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{hvd} \leq (a - d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in s, \mathit{hvy} \in b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(c, \mathit{hvy}) \leq d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(u, \mathit{hvy}) \leq (a - \mathit{hvd}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invariant-\allowbreak{}ccs-\allowbreak{}minimal-\allowbreak{}diameter-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, s, b.; \forall x, y \in b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}affine\text{-}isometry\text{-}group}(m, a, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}ccs}(m, a, s, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}ccs}(m, a, s, c) \wedge (c \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow (b \subseteq c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(x, y) \leq 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}isometry-\allowbreak{}fixed-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), a)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}affine\text{-}isometry\text{-}group}(m, a, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in a.\; \forall g \in s.\; (g(w) = w) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-cosets.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-cosets.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-cosets.scm -- a compact topological group is the union of finitely many left cosets of an open subgroup (compact-groups notes, Lemma 5.33: "G/H is finite"; stated without the quotient G/H, and needing neither the invariant metric nor normality of H). Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: cc4-.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pts-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}cosets-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts\text{-}left\text{-}cosets}(s, g, h) \simeq \{u \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)) : \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; (u = \{z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : (\operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(x), z) \in h)\})\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}finitely-\allowbreak{}many-\allowbreak{}cosets-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{opens}(s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((f \subseteq \operatorname{pts\text{-}left\text{-}cosets}(s, g, h)) \wedge ((|f| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, f, u) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}finitely-\allowbreak{}many-\allowbreak{}cosets}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq \operatorname{pts\text{-}left\text{-}cosets}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, f, u) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-opg.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-opg.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-opg.scm -- one-parameter groups (compact-groups notes, sec. 5.4, Proposition 5.36, the uniqueness half): two one-parameter groups extending the same group segment are equal. Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: co4-.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}idempotent-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(g)(x, x) = x))) \Rightarrow (x = \operatorname{iden}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, v) = \operatorname{iden}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u = \operatorname{inv}(g)(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{one-\allowbreak{}parameter-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}multiples}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, l, a, b.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{R} \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{R} \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{oqr}, u \in \mathbb{R}.\; (a((\mathit{oqr} + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(a(\mathit{oqr}), a(u))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{oqr}, u \in \mathbb{R}.\; (b((\mathit{oqr} + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(b(\mathit{oqr}), b(u))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 \leq t) \wedge (t \leq l)) \Rightarrow (a(t) = b(t))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad r \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(((n \cdot l) + r)) = b(((n \cdot l) + r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{one-\allowbreak{}parameter-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, l, i, a, b.; \forall t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}segment}(s, g, l, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(s, g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(s, g, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (a(t) = i(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (b(t) = i(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(t) = b(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{one-\allowbreak{}parameter-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, a, b.; \forall t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}segment}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), l, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (a(t) = i(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (b(t) = i(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(t) = b(t) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-gpow.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-gpow.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-gpow.scm -- powers x\textasciicircum{}n (n in NN) in a group: typing, commuting with what commutes with x, and x\textasciicircum{}(m+n) = x\textasciicircum{}m x\textasciicircum{}n.  For the extension of a one-parameter group segment (Prop. 5.36). Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: gp4-.  Library: algebra.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{carr}(g))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, n) \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}commute}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(g)(y, x) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(x, y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(y, \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, n)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, n), y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, x, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (m \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, (m + n)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, m), \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-seg.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-seg.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-seg.scm -- the algebra of a one-parameter group segment phi on [0, al] (compact-groups notes, Prop. 5.36): phi(0) = e; phi(r) phi(al - r) = phi(al) = phi(al - r) phi(r); phi(r) commutes with c = phi(al) and its powers; phi(r1) phi(r2) = c phi(r1 + r2 - al) past al. Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: sg4-.  ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i(0) = \operatorname{iden}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}complement}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gsr}, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{gsr} + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((\mathit{gsr} + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(\mathit{gsr}), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad r \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i((l - r))) = i(l)) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(g)(i((l - r)), i(r)) = i(l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}commutes-\allowbreak{}with-\allowbreak{}end}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gsr}, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{gsr} + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((\mathit{gsr} + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(\mathit{gsr}), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad r \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(l)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(l), i(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}overflow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad a \leq l \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad b \leq l \wedge \\ \quad l \leq (a + b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(a), i(b)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(l), i(((a + b) - l))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-rep.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-rep.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-rep.scm -- the extension psi of a group segment phi (Prop. 5.36): every real t has exactly one representation t = n al + r (n in NN, 0 $<$= r $<$ al) on its side of 0, so OPG-REP(t, y) holds for exactly one y, and OPG-VAL(t) is that y. Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26.  Helper prefix: rp4-.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{representation-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad b < l \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad d < l \wedge \\ \quad ((a \cdot l) + b) = ((c \cdot l) + d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a = c) \wedge (b = d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; \operatorname{opg\text{-}rep}(g, l, i, t, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, t, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}rep}(g, l, i, t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}rep}(g, l, i, t, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, t, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}rep}(g, l, i, t, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, t) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, t) \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \operatorname{opg\text{-}rep}(g, l, i, t, \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, t)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-hom.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-hom.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-hom.scm -- the extension psi of a group segment is a homomorphism R -$>$ G (Prop. 5.36): first on t $>$= 0 (psi(n al + r) = c\textasciicircum{}n phi(r), the overflow of phi past al), then on all of R through psi(t) = psi(-t)\textasciicircum{}-1 for t $<$ 0. Agent ISOM, 2026-10-26/27.  Helper prefix: hm4-.  Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g, x.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{carr}(g))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, 1) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}interchange}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{carr}(g) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{carr}(g) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(g) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{carr}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(b, c) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(c, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b), \operatorname{opr}(g)(c, d)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, c), \operatorname{opr}(g)(b, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, n, r, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gsr}, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{gsr} + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((\mathit{gsr} + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(\mathit{gsr}), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad r < l \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t = ((n \cdot l) + r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, t) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{gpow}(g, i(l), n), i(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, (a + b)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, a), \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}solve-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (a = \operatorname{opr}(g)(b, c)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (b = \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{inv}(g)(c))) \wedge (c = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(b), a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}quotient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{inv}(g)(b))) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(b, \operatorname{inv}(g)(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(b), a)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}negative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t < 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, t) = \operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, (0 - t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, (a + b)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, a), \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-ext.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-ext.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-ext.scm -- Proposition 5.36, existence: the extension psi = OPG-EXT(g, al, phi) of a group segment phi is a one-parameter group (continuous: at t by continuity at 0, translated; at 0 by phi's continuity at 0 on the right and, through the inverse, on the left) and agrees with phi on [0, al].  Proved for a group ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}ext}(g, l, i) \in (\mathbb{R} \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}ext}(g, l, i)(t) = \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}extends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r, u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l). \\ \quad \quad ((r + u) \leq l) \Rightarrow (i((r + u)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(i(r), i(u))) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}ext}(g, l, i)(t) = i(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, l, i.; \forall t \in \mathbb{R}, w \in \operatorname{opens}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}segment}(s, g, l, i) \wedge (\operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, t) \in w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall v \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\lvert (v - t) \rvert < d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(g, l, i, v) \in w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{one-\allowbreak{}parameter-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}exists-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, l, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}segment}(s, g, l, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(s, g, a) \wedge \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (a(t) = i(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{one-\allowbreak{}parameter-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}segment}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), l, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (a(t) = i(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opg-\allowbreak{}val-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i.; \forall t \in \mathbb{R}, w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}segment}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), l, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), l, i, t) \in w \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall v \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\lvert (v - t) \rvert < d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opg\text{-}val}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), l, i, v) \in w))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cg4-local.scm}{theorem-library/cg4-local.scm}
\noindent{\small cg4-local.scm -- local homomorphisms (compact-groups notes, Definition 5.37, Proposition 5.38): the composite of local homomorphisms f : G -$>$ H (on V) and h : H -$>$ K (on V\_H) is a local homomorphism on V' = \{ x in V : f(x) in V\_H \}, with W' = \{ x in W : f(x) in W\_H \}. Agent ISOM, 2026-10-27.  Helper prefix: lc4-.  ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}homomorphism-\allowbreak{}composite-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, g, m, v, f, n, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(g, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}hom}(a, b, c, d, v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}hom}(c, d, g, m, n, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p, k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}hom}(a, b, g, m, p, k) \wedge \forall x \in p.\; (k(x) = h(f(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}homomorphism-\allowbreak{}composite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, v, f, d, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}hom}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(a), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(b), v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}hom}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(b), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(c), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(c), d, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g, k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}hom}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(a), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(c), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(c), g, k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in g.\; (k(x) = h(f(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/group-zpow.scm}{theorem-library/group-zpow.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/group-zpow.scm -- THE GROUP KIT: integer powers, element orders, the direct product; PROP. 1.36 (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes, ch. 1; ALGNUM, 2026-10-27).  Built on worker-04's GPOW (natural powers).  No topology. group-right-cancel, zpow-nat, zpow-neg-nat, zpow-type, zpow-succ, zpow-add-nat, zpow-sub-nat, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (a = \operatorname{opr}(g)(b, c))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{inv}(g)(c)) = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, n) = \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (0 - n)) = \operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k) \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (k + 1)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k), x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (m + n)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, m), \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (m - n)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, m), \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (0 - n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (m + n)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, m), \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (0 - k)) = \operatorname{inv}(g)(\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v.\; (((u \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (v \in \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(u, v) = (u + v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring})(u) = -u)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), g, q) \wedge (q(1) = x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad q(n) = \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}cyclic-\allowbreak{}universal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), g, i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad i(1) = x \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}), g, f) \wedge (f(1) = x)) \Rightarrow (f = i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (p = \operatorname{opr}(g)(p, q))) \Rightarrow (q = \operatorname{iden}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}period}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \leq b) \wedge (\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, a) = \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, (b - a)) = \operatorname{iden}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}period-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq d) \wedge (\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, d) = \operatorname{iden}(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{element-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists o.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}multiple-\allowbreak{}period-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, d) = \operatorname{iden}(g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (d \cdot c)) = \operatorname{iden}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}multiple-\allowbreak{}period}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{gpow}(g, x, d) = \operatorname{iden}(g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (d \cdot c)) = \operatorname{iden}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{element-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d) \wedge (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k) = \operatorname{iden}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{element-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}divides}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k) = \operatorname{iden}(g)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{generator-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, \operatorname{iden}(s)) = a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(s)(a, \operatorname{inv}(s)(a)) = \operatorname{iden}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y)) \simeq (\operatorname{carr}(x) \times \operatorname{carr}(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{gpp\_}, \operatorname{gpq\_}] \in ((\operatorname{carr}(x) \times \operatorname{carr}(y)) \times (\operatorname{carr}(x) \times \operatorname{carr}(y))).\; [\operatorname{opr}(x)(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{gpp\_}), \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{gpq\_})), \operatorname{opr}(y)(\operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{gpp\_}), \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{gpq\_}))])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y)) \simeq [\operatorname{iden}(x), \operatorname{iden}(y)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y)) \simeq (\lambda p \in (\operatorname{carr}(x) \times \operatorname{carr}(y)).\; [\operatorname{inv}(x)(\operatorname{nth}(1, p)), \operatorname{inv}(y)(\operatorname{nth}(2, p))])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}opr-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(x)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{carr}(y)) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{carr}(x)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{carr}(y))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y))([a, b], [c, d]) = [\operatorname{opr}(x)(a, c), \operatorname{opr}(y)(b, d)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(x)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y))([a, b]) = [\operatorname{inv}(x)(a), \operatorname{inv}(y)(b)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}prod}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x, y, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(x)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gpow}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y), [a, b], n) = [\operatorname{gpow}(x, a, n), \operatorname{gpow}(y, b, n)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}prod}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, x, y, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(x)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{carr}(y))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y), [a, b], k) = [\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(x, a, k), \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(y, b, k)] \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4c-finite-char.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4c-finite-char.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4c-finite-char.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-C4), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109c4/ccr4c-finite-char.scm. Library: algebra.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ag-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}gpow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, n, b) = \operatorname{gpow}(g, b, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ag-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}period}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, n, b) = \operatorname{iden}(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), (j \cdot k), \operatorname{one}(r)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), k, \operatorname{one}(r)), \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), j, \operatorname{one}(r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), 0, \operatorname{one}(r)) = \operatorname{zero}(r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), (n + 1), \operatorname{one}(r)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), n, \operatorname{one}(r)), \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}domain-\allowbreak{}characteristic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integral\text{-}domain}(r) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(r)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(r, p) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}nf}(k, s)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{snu\_}, \operatorname{snv\_}] \in (s \times s).\; \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{snu\_}, \operatorname{snv\_}))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}nf}(k, s)) \simeq \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, s.; \forall x \in s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n) \in s \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}coset-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{left\text{-}coset}(g, a, h) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \exists y \in h.\; (x = \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, y))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}cosets-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{left\text{-}cosets}(g, h) \simeq \{c \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{carr}(g)) : \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; (c = \operatorname{left\text{-}coset}(g, a, h))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b)) = b) \wedge (\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), b)) = b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}coset-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, h, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge ((h \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (y \in h)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, y) \in \operatorname{left\text{-}coset}(g, a, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}coset-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{carr}(g)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{left\text{-}coset}(g, a, h))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{left\text{-}coset}(g, b, h) = \operatorname{left\text{-}coset}(g, a, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lagrange}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| = (|h| \cdot |\operatorname{left\text{-}cosets}(g, h)|) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{generated-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{generated\text{-}subgroup}(g, x) \simeq \{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{carr}(g)).\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, s) \wedge (x \in s)) \Rightarrow (y \in s))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{generated-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}subgroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{carr}(g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, \operatorname{generated\text{-}subgroup}(g, x)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{generated\text{-}subgroup}(g, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lagrange-\allowbreak{}element-\allowbreak{}order}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{carr}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(|\operatorname{generated\text{-}subgroup}(g, x)|, |\operatorname{carr}(g)|) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(C({s})) \simeq \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(C({s})) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(C({s}))(f, g) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) + g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(C({s}))(r, f) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (r \cdot f(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(C({s}))(f) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; -f(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(C({s})) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}readoff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(f) \simeq \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(C({s}))(f, g) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(C({s}))(r, f) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(C({s}))(f) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(C({s})) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(C({s}))(f, g)(x) = (f(x) + g(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r, f, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(C({s}))(r, f)(x) = (r \cdot f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(C({s}))(f)(x) = -f(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(C({s}))(x) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ms}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) + g(x))) \rVert_{\infty} \leq (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} + \lVert g \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (r \cdot f(x))) \rVert_{\infty} \leq (\lvert r \rvert \cdot \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lvert r \rvert \cdot \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \leq \lVert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (r \cdot f(x))) \rVert_{\infty} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f = (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\lVert (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; 0) \rVert_{\infty} = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(\operatorname{vadd}(C({s}))(f, g)) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(f) + \operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(\operatorname{act}(C({s}))(r, f)) = (\lvert r \rvert \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(C({s}))(f) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (f = \operatorname{vzero}(C({s}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(C({s})) \in ((\operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \times \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \to \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(C({s})) \in ((\mathbb{R} \times \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \to \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(C({s})) \in (\operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \to \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}typing}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(C({s})) \in (\operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(C({s})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge ((g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (f(x) - g(x)) \rvert \leq \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({s})))(f, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\lvert (f(x) - g(x)) \rvert \leq b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({s})))(f, g) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \subseteq (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({s}))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{gdist}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{opr}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{inv}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{iden}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}opr-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b) \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inv}(g)(a) \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}iden-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(g) \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), y)) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{inv}(g)(a), \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, y)) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, b, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b), y) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{opr}(g)(b, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(\operatorname{iden}(g), y) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(y, \operatorname{iden}(g)) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u, v, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))(u, p) \leq d) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))(v, q) \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))(\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, v), \operatorname{opr}(g)(p, q)) \leq e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}ltrans-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; h(\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, x))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}precomp-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, i, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((i \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; f(i(x))) \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}precomp-\allowbreak{}affine}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, i, u, v, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; u(i(x))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; v(i(x))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{vadd}(C({s}))(\operatorname{act}(C({s}))((1 - t), u), \operatorname{act}(C({s}))(t, v))(i(x))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(C({s}))(\operatorname{act}(C({s}))((1 - t), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; u(i(x)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(C({s}))(t, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; v(i(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}precomp-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, i, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; f(i(x))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; g(i(x))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({s})))((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; f(i(x))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; g(i(x)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({s})))(f, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ck-\allowbreak{}precomp-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, i, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (i(x) = y) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda \mathit{hix} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; f(i(\mathit{hix}))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda \mathit{hix} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; g(i(\mathit{hix}))) \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({s})))((\lambda \mathit{hix} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; f(i(\mathit{hix}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{hix} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; g(i(\mathit{hix})))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({s})))(f, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}lmul-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, x)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \to \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mg-\allowbreak{}lmul-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{hqx} \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \mathit{hqx}))(x) = y \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{nvs-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}comb-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, c, d, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), a), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, b)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)((1 - t), c), \operatorname{act}(m)(t, d))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; ((1 - t) \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(a, c)) + (t \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m))(b, d)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, u) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; k)) = k \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}lip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, a, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, a) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a(u) - a(v)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)})))(u, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}hull-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u, f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(C({\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)}), \operatorname{image}((\lambda a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; f(\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, x)))), \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(w) = u(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u, f, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad w \\ \quad \in\; \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(C({\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)})), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(C({\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda a \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; f(\operatorname{opr}(g)(a, x)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(w) = u(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(f) = \int_{g} {f} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, u) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)).\; f(\operatorname{opr}(g)(x, b)))) = u(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{haar\text{-}integral}(g) \simeq (\iota\, u.\;\operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, u)))}}
