\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}haar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}haar\text{-}integral}(g, \operatorname{haar\text{-}integral}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{haar-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g)) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{haar\text{-}integral}(g)(f) = \int_{g} {f} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/qag-laws.scm}{theorem-library/qag-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small qag-laws.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ccrpr/qag-laws.scm. Library: linear-algebra.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{opr}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{iden}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)) \simeq \operatorname{inv}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{azk\_}, \operatorname{aza\_}] \in (\mathbb{Z} \times \operatorname{carr}(g)).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, \operatorname{azk\_}, \operatorname{aza\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)) \in ((\mathbb{Z} \times \operatorname{carr}(g)) \to \operatorname{carr}(g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{agm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g))(k, a) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ag-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ag-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, h.; \forall a \in h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, n, a) \in h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ag-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, a \in h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k, a) \in h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ag-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}submodule}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{quotient-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}abelian-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}carr-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}opr-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}iden-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \simeq \operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \simeq \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \simeq \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; (c = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}opr-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \simeq \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), \operatorname{iden}(g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), \operatorname{inv}(g)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), b) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{opr}(g)(a, \operatorname{inv}(g)(b)) \in h \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}gpow-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, h.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gpow}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a), n) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), \operatorname{gpow}(g, a, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}iden-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, h.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gpow}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a), n) = \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{gpow}(g, a, n) \in h \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}coset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a) = \operatorname{left\text{-}coset}(g, a, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qag-\allowbreak{}carr-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}cosets}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) = \operatorname{left\text{-}cosets}(g, h) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cyclic-product.scm}{theorem-library/cyclic-product.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/cyclic-product.scm -- PROPS. 1.38 and 1.39 (two groups) (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes, ch. 1; ALGNUM, 2026-10-27). cyclic-product-generator   1.39 for two groups: (x1, x2) generates G1 x G2 iff card G1, card G2 are prime to each other (x1, x2 generators of the finite groups G1, G2) zpow-one, zpow-zpow(-nat)  ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyclic-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}generator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(b) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(a)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(b)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(a, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(b, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(a, b), [c, d]) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(|\operatorname{carr}(a)|, |\operatorname{carr}(b)|) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, 1) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}zpow-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k), m) = \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (k \cdot m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}zpow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, k \in \mathbb{Z}, g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k), m) = \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, (k \cdot m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{generator-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), n.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, n) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(k, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zpow-\allowbreak{}residue}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq r) \wedge ((r \leq d) \wedge (\operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k) = \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, r)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gpow-\allowbreak{}injective-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}order}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad a \leq d \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad b \leq d \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, a) = \operatorname{gpow}(g, x, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{generator-\allowbreak{}count}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, y)\}| = \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(|\operatorname{carr}(g)|) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/group-orders.scm}{theorem-library/group-orders.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/group-orders.scm -- GAUSS'S IDENTITY, THE PARTITION BY ORDERS, LEMMA 5.44 (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes; ALGNUM, 2026-10-27).  Sums are FINSUMs in C (as inclusion-exclusion). card-disjoint-family       card of the union of a finite disjoint family = sum of the cards zz-gcd-pos-exists, zz-gcd-pos-unique, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{card-\allowbreak{}disjoint-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbf{Set}, f. \\ \quad |i| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{fi} \in i.\; ((f(\mathit{fi}) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (|f(\mathit{fi})| \in \mathbb{N})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in i, w \in f(a).\; ((w \in f(b)) \Rightarrow (a = b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, i, f(u))| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda c \in i.\; |f(c)|), i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}gcd-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \neg (b = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq g) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, b, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad ((g \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((1 \leq g) \wedge ((1 \leq h) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(g, h))))) \Rightarrow (g \leq h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}gcd-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g, h. \\ \quad ((g \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((1 \leq g) \wedge ((1 \leq h) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, b, g) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, b, h)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad g = h \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}gcd-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, j, e. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((j \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((e \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (1 \leq c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}((c \cdot j), (c \cdot e), c) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(j, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gauss-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, d. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge ((1 \leq d) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : \exists g \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq g) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(k, n, g) \wedge ((g \cdot d) = n)))\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gauss-\allowbreak{}phi-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (1 \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda d \in \{\mathit{gd} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\mathit{gd}, n)\}.\; \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(d)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{\mathit{gd} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\mathit{gd}, n)\}) \\ \quad \quad =\; n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}subgroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, \{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \exists k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (y = \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{powers-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \exists k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (y = \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k))\} \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \exists k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (y = \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, k))\}| = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{element-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}divides-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, |\operatorname{carr}(g)|) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{element-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad d = e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{order-\allowbreak{}partition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda d \in \{\mathit{gd} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, |\operatorname{carr}(g)|) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\mathit{gd}, |\operatorname{carr}(g)|)\}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad |\{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, y, d)\}|), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{\mathit{gd} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, |\operatorname{carr}(g)|) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\mathit{gd}, |\operatorname{carr}(g)|)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}termwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b. \\ \quad ((|i| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall \mathit{mi} \in i.\; ((a(\mathit{mi}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b(\mathit{mi}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a(\mathit{mi}) \leq b(\mathit{mi}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), a, i) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), b, i) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), a, i) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), b, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subset-\allowbreak{}card-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall b \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|b| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \subseteq b) \wedge (|b| \leq |a|))) \Rightarrow (a = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{order-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}coprime}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, \operatorname{group\text{-}zpow}(g, x, r), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(r, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{order-\allowbreak{}count-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g), d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, d) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hd} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (1 \leq \mathit{hd}) \Rightarrow (|\{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (\operatorname{gpow}(g, y, \mathit{hd}) = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}| \leq \mathit{hd}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\{\mathit{oy} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, \mathit{oy}, d)\}| \leq |\{k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, d) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(k, d)\}| \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{order-\allowbreak{}count-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hd} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (1 \leq \mathit{hd}) \Rightarrow (|\{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (\operatorname{gpow}(g, y, \mathit{hd}) = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}| \leq \mathit{hd}) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\{\mathit{oy} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, \mathit{oy}, d)\}| \leq \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{phiset-\allowbreak{}card-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (1 \leq n) \Rightarrow (1 \leq |\{k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) : \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(k, n)\}|) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{order-\allowbreak{}card-\allowbreak{}generator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(g, x, |\operatorname{carr}(g)|))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}cyclic-\allowbreak{}criterion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (1 \leq d) \Rightarrow (|\{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (\operatorname{gpow}(g, y, d) = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}| \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, x) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/group-family-product.scm}{theorem-library/group-family-product.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/group-family-product.scm -- THE PRODUCT OF A FINITE FAMILY OF GROUPS and PROP. 1.39 for m groups (ALGEBRAIC-NUMBERS notes, ch. 1; ALGNUM, 2026-10-27).  G\_1 x ... x G\_m is GROUP-FAMPROD(gf, m), the iterated GROUP-PROD from TRIV-GROUP; (x\_1, ..., x\_m) is GROUP-FAMTUPLE(xf, m) (group-zpow-vocab). ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{triv-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}group})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triv-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}group}) \simeq \{0\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triv-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}group}) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triv-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}card}}{\vnbstmt{|\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}group})| = 1}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triv-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}generator}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}group}, 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}famprod-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, f, a. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(f(i)) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(f(i))| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(f(i), a(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{group\text{-}famprod}(f, m)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{group\text{-}famprod}(f, m))| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{group\text{-}famtuple}(a, m) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{group\text{-}famprod}(f, m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}generator-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, u, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(y) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{carr}(x) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{carr}(y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(x, y), [u, w]) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(x, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}famprod-\allowbreak{}card-\allowbreak{}divisible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, f, a.; \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gi} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq \mathit{gi}) \wedge (\mathit{gi} \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(f(\mathit{gi})) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(f(\mathit{gi}))| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(f(\mathit{gi}), a(\mathit{gi}))) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq i \wedge \\ \quad i \leq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(|\operatorname{carr}(f(i))|, |\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{group\text{-}famprod}(f, m))|) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{group-\allowbreak{}famprod-\allowbreak{}card-\allowbreak{}coprime}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, f, a.; \forall b \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(f(i)) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(f(i))| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(f(i), a(i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq \mathit{ci}) \wedge (\mathit{ci} \leq m)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(|\operatorname{carr}(f(\mathit{ci}))|, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(|\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{group\text{-}famprod}(f, m))|, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyclic-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}generator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, f, a. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(f(i)) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(f(i))| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(f(i), a(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(\operatorname{group\text{-}famprod}(f, m), \operatorname{group\text{-}famtuple}(a, m)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall b, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((1 \leq b) \wedge ((b \leq m) \wedge ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq m) \wedge \neg (b = j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(|\operatorname{carr}(f(b))|, |\operatorname{carr}(f(j))|) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/calc3-extension.scm}{theorem-library/calc3-extension.scm}
\noindent{\small calc3-extension.scm -- calculus.pdf Prop 3.26: A UNIFORMLY CONTINUOUS FUNCTION ON A DENSE SUBSPACE, WITH VALUES IN A COMPLETE SPACE, HAS A UNIQUE UNIFORMLY CONTINUOUS EXTENSION.  Agent CALC-3, 2026-10-19.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{dense-\allowbreak{}meets-\allowbreak{}every-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b)) \Rightarrow \exists c \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, c) < b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}along-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, f.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), t, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}limit\text{-}along}(s, t, a, f, x, f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}along-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, h, x, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, t, h, x) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \forall z \in a.\; (h(z) = f(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}limit\text{-}along}(s, t, a, f, x, h(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}along-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, f, x, b, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}limit\text{-}along}(s, t, a, f, x, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}limit\text{-}along}(s, t, a, f, x, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}along-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), t, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}limit\text{-}along}(s, t, a, f, x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}dense}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), t, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(a, g, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, h) \wedge \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(a, h, f)) \Rightarrow (h = g) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/pw-int-order.scm}{theorem-library/pw-int-order.scm}
\noindent{\small pw-int-order.scm -- ORDER PROPERTIES OF THE PIECEWISE INTEGRAL.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}total}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}), u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, x) \wedge \\ \quad u < v \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}(u, v).\; \exists l.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(h, t, l) \wedge (0 \leq l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(u) \leq h(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, h \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}), u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, x) \wedge \\ \quad u < v \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}(u, v). \\ \quad \quad \neg (t \in s) \Rightarrow \exists l.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(h, t, l) \wedge (0 \leq l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(u) \leq h(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pw-\allowbreak{}nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}, h \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}), s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}on}(h, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \neg (t \in s) \Rightarrow \exists l.\; (\operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}(h, t, l) \wedge (0 \leq l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(a) \leq h(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in (\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}), u, v \in \mathbb{R}, s. \\ \quad u < v \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(u, v).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(s) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}(u, v). \\ \quad \quad \neg (t \in s) \Rightarrow \exists l.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(h, t, l) \wedge (0 \leq l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(u) \leq h(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nondecreasing-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}countable-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}, h \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}), s. \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}on}(h, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(s) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \neg (t \in s) \Rightarrow \exists l.\; (\operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}(h, t, l) \wedge (0 \leq l)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(a) \leq h(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pw-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, i, a, b) \wedge \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (0 \leq i(y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \int_{a}^{b} i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pw-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, w, \mathit{ppsi}, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, i, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(w, \mathit{ppsi}, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (i(y) \leq \operatorname{ppsi}(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} i \leq \int_{a}^{b} \mathit{ppsi} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pw-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, w, s, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, i, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(w, s, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (s(y) \simeq \lvert i(y) \rvert) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert \int_{a}^{b} i \rvert \leq \int_{a}^{b} s \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-magnitude-sq.scm}{theorem-library/cc-magnitude-sq.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-magnitude-sq.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/cc-int-estimate.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by cc-real-bound; CC arithmetic. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. cc-magnitude-sq}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) = ((\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \cdot \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) + (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-int-estimate.scm}{theorem-library/cc-int-estimate.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-int-estimate.scm -- THE NOTES' ESTIMATE (45).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}inner-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(w) \cdot \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) + (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w) \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z))) \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}(w) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, f, w, s, h, a, b. \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(w, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(h, s, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (s(y) \simeq \operatorname{magnitude}(i(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\int_{a}^{b} i) \leq \int_{a}^{b} s \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/line-int-laws.scm}{theorem-library/line-int-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small line-int-laws.scm -- THE LAWS OF THE INTEGRAL ALONG A ROAD, for a road and a CONTINUOUS f, with no primitive in the statement. Batch 24-A, 2026-09-23.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, m, c, a, b, g_{1}, g_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{1}, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((f(m(t)) \cdot c(t)))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{2}, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((f(m(t)) \cdot c(t)))), a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = ((\operatorname{g1}(b) - \operatorname{g1}(a)) + ((\operatorname{g2}(b) - \operatorname{g2}(a)) \cdot +i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g, m, c, a, b.; \forall h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) \simeq (f(z) + g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(h, m, c, a, b) = (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(g, m, c, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b.; \forall \mathit{lic} \in \mathbb{C}, h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) \simeq (\mathit{lic} \cdot f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(h, m, c, a, b) = (\mathit{lic} \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}opposite-\allowbreak{}road}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b, g, d. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{pay} \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (g(\mathit{pay}) \simeq m(((a + b) - \mathit{pay}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{pay} \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (d(\mathit{pay}) \simeq (-1 \cdot c(((a + b) - \mathit{pay})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, g, d, a, b) = (-1 \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{road-\allowbreak{}restrict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b.; \forall v, \mathit{lidv} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge ((a \leq v) \wedge ((v < \mathit{lidv}) \wedge (\mathit{lidv} \leq b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(v, \mathit{lidv})), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(v, \mathit{lidv})), v, \mathit{lidv}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}congruence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, \mathit{ppsi}, a, b, g_{1}, g_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{1}, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(g_{2}, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{ppsi} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (i(y) \simeq \operatorname{ppsi}(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} i = \int_{a}^{b} \mathit{ppsi} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}adjacent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b.; \forall v \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(a, v)), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(a, v)), a, v) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(v, b)), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(v, b)), v, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{right-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}within-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h, w, x, l, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}right\text{-}limit\text{-}within}(f, w, x, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}right\text{-}limit\text{-}within}(g, w, x, k) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (w \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in w.\; (h(z) \simeq \operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) + (g(z) \cdot +i)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}right\text{-}limit\text{-}within}(h, w, x, \operatorname{magnitude}((l + (k \cdot +i)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}within-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h, w, x, l, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}limit\text{-}within}(f, w, x, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}limit\text{-}within}(g, w, x, k) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (w \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in w.\; (h(z) \simeq \operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) + (g(z) \cdot +i)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}limit\text{-}within}(h, w, x, \operatorname{magnitude}((l + (k \cdot +i)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{regulated-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, h, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(f, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(g, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (h(z) \simeq \operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) + (g(z) \cdot +i)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(h, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b.; \forall \mathit{liab} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{liy} \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{liab}(\mathit{liy}) \simeq (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(m(\mathit{liy}))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(c(\mathit{liy})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b)) \leq \int_{a}^{b} \mathit{liab} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/line-int-reparam.scm}{theorem-library/line-int-reparam.scm}
\noindent{\small line-int-reparam.scm -- THE AFFINE CHANGE OF PARAMETER (the notes' (48), affine case) AND THE SEGMENT LEMMAS OF GOURSAT'S DEFINITION-FREE HALF. Batch 29-A, 2026-09-25.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}ccint-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d). \\ \quad ((0 < l) \wedge (((m + (l \cdot c)) = a) \wedge ((m + (l \cdot d)) = b))) \Rightarrow ((m + (l \cdot z)) \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}ooint-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ooint}(c, d). \\ \quad ((0 < l) \wedge (((m + (l \cdot c)) = a) \wedge ((m + (l \cdot d)) = b))) \Rightarrow ((m + (l \cdot z)) \in \operatorname{ooint}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}solve}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b), q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < l) \wedge (((m + (l \cdot c)) = a) \wedge (((m + (l \cdot d)) = b) \wedge ((z - m) = (q \cdot l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (q \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d)) \wedge ((m + (l \cdot q)) = z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad ((0 < l) \wedge (((m + (l \cdot c)) = a) \wedge ((m + (l \cdot d)) = b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (((z - m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l)) \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d)) \wedge ((m + (l \cdot ((z - m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l)))) = z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, m, z \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < l) \Rightarrow ((((m + (l \cdot z)) - m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l)) = z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, f.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{R}), t \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d). \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (g(z) \simeq f((m + (l \cdot z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, (m + (l \cdot t))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(c, d)), \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, f.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}on}(f, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (g(z) \simeq f((m + (l \cdot z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}on}(g, \operatorname{ccint}(c, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, e. \\ \quad ((0 < l) \wedge (((m + (l \cdot c)) = a) \wedge (((m + (l \cdot d)) = b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(e) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; ((v - m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l))), e)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; ((v - m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l))), e) \subseteq \operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}image}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, e.; \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d). \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (t \in \operatorname{image}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; ((v - m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l))), e)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg ((m + (l \cdot t)) \in e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{affine-\allowbreak{}reparam-\allowbreak{}regulated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, f.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad c < d \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(f, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (g(z) \simeq f((m + (l \cdot z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regulated\text{-}on}(g, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pw-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}subst}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, f, i.; \forall h, s \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad c < d \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, i, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (h(z) \simeq f((m + (l \cdot z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (s(z) \simeq (l \cdot i((m + (l \cdot z))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(h, s, c, d) \wedge (\int_{c}^{d} s = \int_{a}^{b} i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}subst}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, i, \mathit{lrpb}, f, w. \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad c < d \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{lrpb} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (\operatorname{lrpb}(z) \simeq (l \cdot i((m + (l \cdot z))))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(w, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(i(t))), a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{c}^{d} \mathit{lrpb} = \int_{a}^{b} i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}reparam}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, f, r. \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (r(z) \simeq f((m + (l \cdot z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(r, c, d) \subseteq \operatorname{trace}(f, a, b)) \wedge (\operatorname{trace}(f, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{trace}(r, c, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{road-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}reparam}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, l, m \in \mathbb{R}, f, g, r, k. \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot c)) = a \wedge \\ \quad (m + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad c < d \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(f, g, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in (\operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (r(z) \simeq f((m + (l \cdot z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d).\; (k(z) \simeq (l \cdot g((m + (l \cdot z))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(r, k, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}affine-\allowbreak{}reparam}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b.; \forall \mathit{lrpc}, d, l, \mathit{lrpm} \in \mathbb{R}, r, k. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad (\mathit{lrpm} + (l \cdot \mathit{lrpc})) = a \wedge \\ \quad (\mathit{lrpm} + (l \cdot d)) = b \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{lrpc} < d \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{lrpc}, d) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in (\operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{lrpc}, d) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{lrpc}, d).\; (r(z) \simeq m((\mathit{lrpm} + (l \cdot z)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{lrpc}, d).\; (k(z) \simeq (l \cdot c((\mathit{lrpm} + (l \cdot z))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, r, k, \mathit{lrpc}, d) = \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b.; \forall c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((m \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a \leq c) \wedge (d \leq b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(c, d)), c, d) \subseteq \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall z_{0}, w \in \mathbb{C}, t \in \operatorname{ooint}(0, 1). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot w))), 0, 1) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot w))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; w), 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot (t \cdot w)))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (t \cdot w)), 0, 1) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((z_{0} + (t \cdot w)) + (x \cdot ((1 - t) \cdot w)))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((1 - t) \cdot w)), 0, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall z_{0}, w \in \mathbb{C}, n \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot w))), 0, 1) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{lrpy} \in \operatorname{trace}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot w))), 0, 1). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{lrpy})) \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot w))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; w), 0, 1)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{magnitude}(w) \cdot n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}reverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall z_{0}, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot w))), 0, 1) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((z_{0} + w) + (x \cdot (-1 \cdot w)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (-1 \cdot w)), 0, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; -1 \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (z_{0} + (x \cdot w))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; w), 0, 1) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/goursat.scm}{theorem-library/goursat.scm}
\noindent{\small goursat.scm -- CAUCHY-GOURSAT FOR A TRIANGLE AND CAUCHY ON A CONVEX SET (complex-analysis.pdf ch. 3, s. 3.2: Lemma 3.4, Lemma 3.5, Prop 3.6, Cor 3.7, Prop 3.8, Cor 3.9, all for f holomorphic on the whole open set).  Batch 30, 2026-09-25.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) \simeq \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), \operatorname{seg\text{-}deriv}(a, b), 0, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) \simeq ((\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, b, c)) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, c, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mid-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(x, y) \simeq ((x + y) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(2)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}bridge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, p, w. \\ \quad ((a = p) \wedge ((b - a) = w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (p + (x \cdot w)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}bridge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, w. \\ \quad ((b - a) = w) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{seg\text{-}deriv}(a, b) \simeq (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}bridge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b, p, w. \\ \quad ((a = p) \wedge ((b - a) = w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) \simeq \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (p + (x \cdot w))), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; w), 0, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}bridge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, p, w. \\ \quad ((a = p) \wedge ((b - a) = w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \simeq \operatorname{trace}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (p + (x \cdot w))), 0, 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}road}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), \operatorname{seg\text{-}deriv}(a, b), 0, 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{in-\allowbreak{}transport-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y, s.\; (((x \in s) \wedge (x = y)) \Rightarrow (y \in s))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b)(t) = (a + (t \cdot (b - a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad (a + (t \cdot (b - a))) \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, z \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1). \exists t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad z = (a + (t \cdot (b - a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, z. \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \exists l, m, n \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \quad (((l + m) + n) = 1) \wedge (z = (((l \cdot a) + (m \cdot b)) + (n \cdot c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, l, m, n \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1), z. \\ \quad ((((l + m) + n) = 1) \wedge (z = (((l \cdot a) + (m \cdot b)) + (n \cdot c)))) \Rightarrow (z \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall x, y \in u, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \Rightarrow ((x + (t \cdot (y - x))) \in u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge ((a \in u) \wedge (b \in u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \subseteq u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge ((a \in u) \wedge ((b \in u) \wedge (c \in u)))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}vertices-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (a \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}trace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c). \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(x, y), 0, 1) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}hull}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, x, y, z \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c). \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(x, y, z) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mid-\allowbreak{}affine}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(x, y) = (x + (1/2 \cdot (y - x)))) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(x, y) = (y + (1/2 \cdot (x - y)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mid-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}trace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(x, y) \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(x, y), 0, 1)) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(x, y) \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(y, x), 0, 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}mid-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c). \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(x, y) \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}conv3}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(b, c), 0, 1) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, 1) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(a, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, b), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, c)) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, b), b, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(b, c)) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, c), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(b, c), c) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, b), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(b, c), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, c)) \subseteq \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) \in \mathbb{C} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}degenerate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall z \in u. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, z, z) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}reverse-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, b, a) = (-1 \cdot \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, c \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(a, b), 0, 1) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) = (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, c) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}subdivision}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; ((\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, b), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, c)) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, b), b, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(b, c))) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, c), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(b, c), c)) + \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, b), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(b, c), \operatorname{cc\text{-}mid}(a, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c)) \leq (((\operatorname{magnitude}((b - a)) + \operatorname{magnitude}((c - b))) + \operatorname{magnitude}((a - c))) \cdot m) \end{array}}}
