\vnbentry{\texttt{termwise-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}integrals}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, u, m, c, a, b, f. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(j) \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f(j), y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(j)(w)), k)) \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(j)(w)), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(j)(w)), k)), m, c, a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f(j), m, c, a, b)), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}termwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, c, a, b, f, g. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(j) \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f(j), y) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{twy} \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(j)(\mathit{twy})), k) - g(\mathit{twy}))) \leq s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f(j), m, c, a, b)), \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(g, m, c, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}to}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), x. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(s, x) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}(s) = x) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4a-outer.scm}{theorem-library/ch4a-outer.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4a-outer.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4a/ch4a-outer.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{out-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}rev}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), y \in u. \\ \quad ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\forall x \in u.\; \neg (x = z) \wedge \forall x \in u.\; (h(x) \simeq \operatorname{recip}((z - x))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), h, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{outer-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}series}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((x - c)) \leq r) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad r < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), m, d, a, b) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((z - c)), (k + 1))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - w)))), m, d, a, b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cauchy-integral-formula.scm}{theorem-library/cauchy-integral-formula.scm}
\noindent{\small cauchy-integral-formula.scm -- CAUCHY WITH AN EXCEPTIONAL POINT ON A DISC, THE WINDING NUMBER OF A CIRCLE INSIDE IT, THE CAUCHY INTEGRAL FORMULA ON A DISC, THEOREM 3.35 (HOLOMORPHIC =$>$ ANALYTIC) AND THE HOLOMORPHY OF THE DERIVATIVE. (complex-analysis.pdf ch. 3: Cor 3.9 with one exceptional point, Example 3.13 /}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cif-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{difference}(v, \operatorname{singleton}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}except}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, x, v, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad x \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(v) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq v \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}except}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, x.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, m, d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad x \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, d, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cif-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), \\ \quad \quad (\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{recip}((v - c))), \\ \quad \quad w, -(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - c)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cif-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}, w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), \\ \quad \quad (\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((v - c)), (j + 1))), \\ \quad \quad w, (-(j + 1) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), ((j + 1) + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cif-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}, m, d, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c))) \wedge (m(b) = m(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((v - c)), ((j + 1) + 1))), m, d, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad (0 \leq r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - c)) = r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r)((2 \cdot \pi)) = \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r)(0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}inside}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi), z) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}formula-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}formula-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}restrict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}analytic-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, f.; \forall c \in u.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow f \text{ is analytic at } c)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-magnitude-i.scm}{theorem-library/cc-magnitude-i.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-magnitude-i.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/cauchy-estimates.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by cnvs-a; CC arithmetic. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. cc-magnitude-i}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}i}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{magnitude}(+i) = 1}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cnvs-a.scm}{theorem-library/cnvs-a.scm}
\noindent{\small cnvs-a.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CNVS), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/cnvs-1109/cnvs-a.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(v) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (J_{v} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(v) \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}nvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}([\operatorname{scal}(v), \operatorname{vec}(v), \operatorname{vadd}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(v), \operatorname{vneg}(v), \operatorname{act}(v), \operatorname{vnrm}(v)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(v, J_{v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}square}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}square\text{-}minus\text{-}id}(v, J_{v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}cact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(c, x)) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(v)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbs-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cnvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbs-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}banach\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{cnvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}view-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{cnvs\text{-}as\text{-}nvs}(v)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}nvs-\allowbreak{}view-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}pin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{cnvs\text{-}as\text{-}nvs}(v)) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}pin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(v) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad J_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(J_{v}(x), J_{v}(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad J_{v}(\operatorname{act}(v)(a, x)) = \operatorname{act}(v)(a, J_{v}(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (J_{v}(J_{v}(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}jop-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (J_{v}(x) \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, p, q, r, s, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(p, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(q, J_{v}(x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(s, J_{v}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)((p + r), x), \operatorname{act}(v)((q + s), J_{v}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, p, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(v)(t, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(p, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(q, J_{v}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)((t \cdot p), x), \operatorname{act}(v)((t \cdot q), J_{v}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(v)(-q, x) = \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(q, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}jop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, p, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad J_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(p, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(q, J_{v}(x)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(-q, x), \operatorname{act}(v)(p, J_{v}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cact}(v)(z, x) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z), x), \operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z), J_{v}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}pt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cact}(v)(z, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cact}(v) \in ((\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cact}(v)(z, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(z, x), \operatorname{cact}(v)(z, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cact}(v)((z + w), x) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(z, x), \operatorname{cact}(v)(w, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}cact-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cact}(v)((z \cdot w), x) = \operatorname{cact}(v)(z, \operatorname{cact}(v)(w, x)) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small cnvs-comp.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CNVS2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/cnvs2-1109/cnvs2-comp.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w, s, t, x. \\ \quad ((t \in (\operatorname{vec}(u) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge ((s \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w))) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}{t}(x) = s(t(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(u).\; (1(x) = x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge ((t \in (\operatorname{vec}(u) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (s \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}{t} \in (\operatorname{vec}(u) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \Rightarrow (1 \in (\operatorname{vec}(u) \to \operatorname{vec}(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(u, v) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(v, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {s}{t} \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(u, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cnvs-\allowbreak{}opnorm-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(u, v) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(v, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}opnorm}(u, w, {s}{t}) \leq (\operatorname{cnvs\text{-}opnorm}(v, w, s) \cdot \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}opnorm}(u, v, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \Rightarrow (1 \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(u, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w, z, r, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(u) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \to \operatorname{vec}(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {{r}{s}}{t} = {r}{{s}{t}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in (\operatorname{vec}(u) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {1}{t} = t \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge (t \in (\operatorname{vec}(u) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {t}{1} = t \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w, r, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(u, v) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(v, w) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(v, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {\operatorname{cbop\text{-}sum}(v, w, r, s)}{t} = \operatorname{cbop\text{-}sum}(u, w, {r}{t}, {s}{t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cbop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, w, r, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(v, w) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(u, v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{cnvs\text{-}bounded\text{-}ops}(u, v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {r}{\operatorname{cbop\text{-}sum}(u, v, s, t)} = \operatorname{cbop\text{-}sum}(u, w, {r}{s}, {r}{t}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cauchy-estimates.scm}{theorem-library/cauchy-estimates.scm}
\noindent{\small cauchy-estimates.scm -- THE CIRCLE'S LENGTH, CAUCHY'S ESTIMATES, THE DERIVATIVE FORMULA, LIOUVILLE AND THE FUNDAMENTAL THEOREM OF ALGEBRA. (complex-analysis.pdf ch. 3: Prop 3.40 / Cor 3.42 through the coefficients, Prop 3.47 and Cor 3.48 (Cauchy's estimates, Liouville); ch. 1, 1.5 (the fundamental theorem of algebra).)}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}road-\allowbreak{}length}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 \leq r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{road\text{-}length}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) = ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}constant-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i))) = \operatorname{recip}((2 \cdot \pi))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}estimate-\allowbreak{}circle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r, d \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; d \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}estimate-\allowbreak{}center}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c)) \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}coefficients-\allowbreak{}radius}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad g(k) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad o < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}coefficient-\allowbreak{}series}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad g(k) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cpsk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(\mathit{cpsk}) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), \mathit{cpsk})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}derivative-\allowbreak{}formula}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r, o \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, o))^{(k)}(c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{factorial}(k) \cdot (\operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}estimate-\allowbreak{}derivative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r, o, d \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, o))^{(k)}(c)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{factorial}(k) \cdot (d \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cie-\allowbreak{}squeeze}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, k, a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq a) \wedge ((0 \leq k) \wedge \forall q \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((a < q) \Rightarrow (x \leq (k \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \leq 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}entire-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall d \in \mathbb{R}, a \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f) \wedge \forall y \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \mathbb{C}, f, a, 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{liouville}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall d \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f) \wedge \forall y \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polynomial-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, (\lambda w \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(w, k))), j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polynomial-\allowbreak{}growth-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(p(k))), (j + 1)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(p(k))), (j + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (1 \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(w, k))), (j + 1))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(p(k))), (j + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(w), j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fundamental-\allowbreak{}theorem-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (p((m + 1)) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), ((m + 1) + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/principal-part.scm}{theorem-library/principal-part.scm}
\noindent{\small principal-part.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-pp.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{ppa}, c, d, f, a, b. \\ \quad \mathit{ppa} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(d, f, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(d, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad d(b) = d(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ppa}((j + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (j + 1)))), (m + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ppa}((j + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (j + 1)))), (m + 1))), \\ \quad \quad \quad d, f, a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ppa}(1) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((v - c)), 1)), d, f, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{ppa}, c, m, d, a, b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \mathit{ppa} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ppa}((j + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (j + 1)))), n)), m, d, a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ppa}(1) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(m, d, a, b, c) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca1-matrix-rep.scm}{theorem-library/ca1-matrix-rep.scm}
\noindent{\small ca1-matrix-rep.scm -- THE COMPLEX NUMBERS AS 2-BY-2 REAL MATRICES (complex-analysis.pdf, Proposition 1.3).  Agent CA-1, 2026-10-19.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat22-\allowbreak{}literal-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.; \forall a, b, c, d \in x.\; ([[a, b], [c, d]] \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat22-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, x). \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(p, 1, 1) = \operatorname{entry}(q, 1, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(p, 1, 2) = \operatorname{entry}(q, 1, 2) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(p, 2, 1) = \operatorname{entry}(q, 2, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(p, 2, 2) = \operatorname{entry}(q, 2, 2) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p = q \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}entries}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b), 1, 1) = a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b), 1, 2) = b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b), 2, 1) = -b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b), 2, 2) = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b) \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}matmul-\allowbreak{}2x2-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), p, q) \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}matadd-\allowbreak{}2x2-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), p, q) \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}matmul-\allowbreak{}2x2-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{R}), i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, 2). \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), p, q), i, k) \\ \quad =\; (\operatorname{entry}(p, i, 1) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(q, 1, k)) + (\operatorname{entry}(p, i, 2) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(q, 2, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}matadd-\allowbreak{}2x2-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{R}), i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, 2). \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), p, q), i, k) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{entry}(p, i, k) + \operatorname{entry}(q, i, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(c, d)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(((a \cdot c) - (b \cdot d)), ((a \cdot d) + (b \cdot c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(c, d)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}((a + c), (b + d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), c, \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}((c \cdot a), (c \cdot b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(a, b) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(c, d)) \Rightarrow ((a = c) \wedge (b = d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(z) \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z), \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}((z + w)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(z), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}((z \cdot w)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(z), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}((c \cdot z)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), c, \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(1) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep} \in (\mathbb{C} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrices})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep} \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrices})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}representation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep} \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrices}) \wedge \\ \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}((z + w)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matadd}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(z), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(w)) \wedge \\ \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}((z \cdot w)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(z), \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(w)) \wedge \\ \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(1) = \operatorname{identmat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2) \wedge \\ \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}((c \cdot z)) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{matscale}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), c, \operatorname{cc\text{-}matrix\text{-}rep}(z)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca1-alg-closed.scm}{theorem-library/ca1-alg-closed.scm}
\noindent{\small ca1-alg-closed.scm -- C IS ALGEBRAICALLY CLOSED, IN THE NOTES' FORM, AND THE GROWTH ESTIMATE (6)-(7) OF ITS PROOF (complex-analysis.pdf, Theorem 1.15).  Agent CA-1, 2026-10-19.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}algebraically-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((1 \leq n) \wedge \neg (p(n) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}polynomial-\allowbreak{}lower-\allowbreak{}growth}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), m \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z) \wedge \\ \quad 2 \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(p(k))), (m + 1)) \\ \quad \leq\; \operatorname{magnitude}(p((m + 1))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(z) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(p((m + 1))) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), (m + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), ((m + 1) + 1))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/poly-fn-holomorphic.scm}{theorem-library/poly-fn-holomorphic.scm}
\noindent{\small poly-fn-holomorphic.scm -- complex analysis: a polynomial function on an open set is holomorphic and its derivative is a polynomial function (CA-MONTEL "POLY", 2026-10-26).  Library: complex-analysis. The helpers below are copied from poly-fn-laws.scm (each proof file has its own environment).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, \mathbb{C}, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \mathbb{C}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(x, j))), n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad w, d(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}fn\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, u, d) \wedge \forall w \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w, d(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}fta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((1 \leq n) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}poly\text{-}deg}(\mathbb{C}, \mathbb{C}, f, n)) \Rightarrow \exists z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (f(z) = 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/winding-number-integer.scm}{theorem-library/winding-number-integer.scm}
\noindent{\small winding-number-integer.scm -- THE WINDING NUMBER IS AN INTEGER (complex-analysis.pdf ch. 3, Proposition 3.27, first half), with the two pieces of road calculus it rests on. Agent CA-5 of week 3 of the October roadmap, 2026-10-04. Definitions: structure-library/winding-number.scm (WINDING, by the integral (73)).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{road-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, d, f, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(d, f, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (((c(t) \cdot d(t)) + (m(t) \cdot f(t))) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (m(b) \cdot d(b)) = (m(a) \cdot d(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}primitive-\allowbreak{}road}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(h, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (f(m(t)) \cdot c(t))), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = (h(b) - h(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}number-\allowbreak{}integer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge ((m(b) = m(a)) \wedge \neg (z \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, z) = k) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/winding-number-components.scm}{theorem-library/winding-number-components.scm}
\noindent{\small winding-number-components.scm -- THE WINDING NUMBER IS LOCALLY CONSTANT OFF THE TRACE, CONSTANT ON A CONNECTED SET OFF THE TRACE, AND 0 ON THE UNBOUNDED COMPONENT (complex-analysis.pdf ch. 3: Proposition 3.27, second half; Corollary 3.30). Agent CA-5 of week 3 of the October roadmap, 2026-10-04.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, d, a, b.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b).\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((y - c))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, d, a, b, z) = \operatorname{winding}(m, d, a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge ((m(b) = m(a)) \wedge \neg (z \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{wcz} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{wcz} \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)) \wedge (\operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, \mathit{wcz}) = \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}constant-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b, \mathit{wca}.; \forall p, q \in \mathit{wca}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{wca}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{wca}.\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, p) = \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}unbounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, d, a, b.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{wca}.; \forall u, p \in \mathit{wca}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{wca}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{wca}.\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, d, a, b, p) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}juxta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m_{1}, d, m_{2}, f, a, b, c.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m_{1}, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m_{2}, f, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{m1}(b) = \operatorname{m2}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z \in \operatorname{trace}(m_{1}, a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z \in \operatorname{trace}(m_{2}, b, c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(\operatorname{juxta}(m_{1}, m_{2}, a, b, c), \operatorname{juxta}(d, f, a, b, c), a, c, z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{winding}(m_{1}, d, a, b, z) + \operatorname{winding}(m_{2}, f, b, c, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}opposite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b, \mathit{prgb}, \mathit{prdb}.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{prgb} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{prdb} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (\operatorname{prgb}(y) \simeq m(((a + b) - y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (\operatorname{prdb}(y) \simeq (-1 \cdot c(((a + b) - y)))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(\mathit{prgb}, \mathit{prdb}, a, b, z) = (-1 \cdot \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, z)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cauchy-centre-mean-value.scm}{theorem-library/cauchy-centre-mean-value.scm}
\noindent{\small cauchy-centre-mean-value.scm -- THE INTEGRAL FORMULA AT THE CENTRE, THE MEAN VALUE PROPERTY, THE MEAN VALUE INEQUALITY, THE MAXIMUM MODULUS PRINCIPLE ON A DISC (complex-analysis.pdf 3.7 at z = c; 3.8: equation (92), Definition 3.54, Proposition 3.55 in its disc form).  Agent CA-4 of week 2 of the October roadmap}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), v.; \forall w \in v. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{restrict}(h, v), w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), h, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}quotient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), q, y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), \operatorname{restrict}(q, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in u.\; ((f(x) - f(c)) = (q(x) \cdot (x - c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}punctured-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, \mathit{cmvbr} \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (r < \mathit{cmvbr})) \Rightarrow ((y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{cmvbr})) \wedge \neg (y = c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}formula-\allowbreak{}centre}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, \mathit{cmvbr} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge ((r < \mathit{cmvbr}) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{cmvbr}) \subseteq u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - c)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}mean-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, \mathit{cmvbr} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge ((r < \mathit{cmvbr}) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{cmvbr}) \subseteq u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(c) = (\operatorname{recip}((2 \cdot \pi)) \cdot \int_{0}^{(2 \cdot \pi)} (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; f((c + (r \cdot \exp (+i \cdot t)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pw-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, h, a, b.; \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}primitive}(f, h, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}on}(h, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (0 \leq h(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \int_{a}^{b} h = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(t) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, \mathit{cmvbr} \in \mathbb{R}, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < \mathit{cmvbr} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{cmvbr}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f((c + (r \cdot \exp (+i \cdot t)))) = f(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximum-\allowbreak{}modulus-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}mean-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, \mathit{cmvbr}, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < \mathit{cmvbr} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{cmvbr}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c)) \leq m \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mvp-max.scm}{theorem-library/mvp-max.scm}
\noindent{\small mvp-max.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/calint2/mvp-max.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{mvp-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, \mathit{cmvbr} \in \mathbb{R}, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < \mathit{cmvbr} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{cmvbr}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f((c + (r \cdot \exp (+i \cdot t)))) = f(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mvp-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(c) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mvp-modulus.scm}{theorem-library/mvp-modulus.scm}
\noindent{\small mvp-modulus.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/calint2/mvp-modulus.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{connected-\allowbreak{}clopen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b.; \forall p \in b, q \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall y \in a.\; ((y \in \operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \Rightarrow (y \in b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \neg (x \in b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall y \in a.\; ((y \in \operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \Rightarrow \neg (y \in b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad q \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mvp-\allowbreak{}maximum-\allowbreak{}modulus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/morera.scm}{theorem-library/morera.scm}
\noindent{\small morera.scm -- MORERA'S THEOREM AND LOCALLY UNIFORM LIMITS OF HOLOMORPHIC FUNCTIONS (complex-analysis.pdf 3.6: Proposition 3.43, Proposition 3.44), both CONDITIONAL on "the derivative of a holomorphic function is holomorphic" (Corollary 3.37). Agent CA-4 of week 2 of the October roadmap (scratchpad/triage/WEEK2.md), ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), v.; \forall a \in v, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, v, \operatorname{restrict}(f, v), a, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}segments-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}triangles}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mrta}, \mathit{mrtb}, \mathit{mrtc} \in u. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(\mathit{mrta}, \mathit{mrtb}, \mathit{mrtc}) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, \mathit{mrta}, \mathit{mrtb}, \mathit{mrtc}) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, c) = (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, b, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}primitive-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}triangles}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall o \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z, f(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{morera-\allowbreak{}conditional}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall v, g, d. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad d \in (v \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in v.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, v, g, z, d(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
