\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}conditional}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall v, g, d. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad d \in (v \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in v.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, v, g, z, d(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mrlz} \in u. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{mrlz}, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{mrlz}, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(y) - f(y))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{deriv-\allowbreak{}holomorphic-\allowbreak{}bridge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, d. \\ \quad \forall u, f. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, g) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (v \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in v.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, v, g, z, d(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{morera-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall u, f. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall u, f. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(y) - f(y))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{morera}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(y) - f(y))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gamma-function.scm}{theorem-library/gamma-function.scm}
\noindent{\small gamma-function.scm -- THE IMPROPER INTEGRAL ON (0, +inf), THE GAMMA FUNCTION, ITS CONVERGENCE ON THE RIGHT HALF-PLANE, ITS HOLOMORPHY (PROPOSITION 3.59), GAMMA(1) = 1 AND GAMMA(z + 1) = z GAMMA(z), GAMMA(n + 1) = n!. (complex-analysis.pdf ch. 3, section 3.9: (96)-(101), Definition 3.58, Proposition 3.59.)}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{right-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}road}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (a < b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}((\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; t), (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; 1), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}trace}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a < b) \wedge (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}((\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; t), a, b) \subseteq u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, b. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} f = \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; t), (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; 1), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, b. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} f \in \mathbb{C} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, b.; \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad a < c \wedge \\ \quad c < b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} f = (\int_{a}^{c} f + \int_{c}^{b} f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}compare-\allowbreak{}primitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, r, c, a, b. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, c) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), r, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, c, z, r(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gmy} \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{gmy})) \leq \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(r(\mathit{gmy}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\int_{a}^{b} f) \leq \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((c(b) - c(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{right-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}slit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall y \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}. \\ \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(y) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(y) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (y = 0) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \{\mathit{cxsu} \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(\mathit{cxsu}) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\mathit{cxsu}) \leq 0))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}, \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < d) \wedge (0 < r)) \Rightarrow \exists x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \wedge ((x < d) \wedge (x < r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}above-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; \exists x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((m < x) \wedge (r < x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{improper-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \forall r, q \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < r) \wedge (r < q)) \Rightarrow (\int_{r}^{q} f \in \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \forall r_{1}, r_{2}, q_{1}, q_{2}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad r_{1} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad r_{2} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad q_{1} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad q_{2} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < r_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad r_{1} < d \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < r_{2} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad r_{2} < d \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad m < q_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad m < q_{2} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad r_{1} < q_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad r_{2} < q_{2} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\int_{r_{1}}^{q_{1}} f - \int_{r_{2}}^{q_{2}} f)) \leq e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l.\; \operatorname{improper\text{-}int\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{improper-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, l, r, q, t. \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ipr}, \mathit{ipq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad ((0 < \mathit{ipr}) \wedge (\mathit{ipr} < \mathit{ipq})) \Rightarrow (\int_{\mathit{ipr}}^{\mathit{ipq}} f \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{improper\text{-}int\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < q \wedge \\ \quad \forall r_{2}, q_{2} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad ((0 < r_{2}) \wedge ((r_{2} < r) \wedge (q < q_{2}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\int_{r_{2}}^{q_{2}} f - \int_{r}^{q} f)) \leq t \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((l - \int_{r}^{q} f)) \leq t \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{improper-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, l_{1}, l_{2}. \\ \quad \forall r, q \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < r) \wedge (r < q)) \Rightarrow (\int_{r}^{q} f \in \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{improper\text{-}int\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{improper\text{-}int\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad l_{1} = l_{2} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{improper-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, l. \\ \quad \forall r, q \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < r) \wedge (r < q)) \Rightarrow (\int_{r}^{q} f \in \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{improper\text{-}int\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_0^{\infty} f = l \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\exp v) = \exp \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((u \leq v) \Rightarrow (\exp u \leq \exp v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < x) \Rightarrow (\exp \log\left(x\right) = x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\log\left(\exp x\right) = x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)(t)) = \exp (((\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) - 1) \cdot \log\left(t\right)) - t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((1 \leq t) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \log\left(t\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, a, t. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < a) \wedge ((a \leq \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge ((0 < t) \wedge (t \leq 1))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)(t)) \leq \exp ((a - 1) \cdot \log\left(t\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}large}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, b, a, t. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad (b - 1) \leq a \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq t \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)(t)) \leq \exp ((a \cdot (\log\left((2 \cdot a)\right) - 1)) - (1/2 \cdot t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccint-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}locint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, r, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (r < q)) \Rightarrow (\int_{r}^{q} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, a, b, c. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a \leq \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < b \wedge \\ \quad b < c \wedge \\ \quad c \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\int_{b}^{c} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)) \leq (\exp (a \cdot \log\left(c\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}large}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, b, a, c, d. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad (b - 1) \leq a \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad c < d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\int_{c}^{d} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)) \leq (2 \cdot \exp ((a \cdot (\log\left((2 \cdot a)\right) - 1)) - (1/2 \cdot c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < u) \wedge (u \leq v)) \Rightarrow (\log\left(u\right) \leq \log\left(v\right)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((e \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge (0 < e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < d) \wedge ((d \leq 1) \wedge ((\exp (s \cdot \log\left(d\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(s)) \leq e))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, r, d. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge (r \leq d)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\exp (s \cdot \log\left(r\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(s)) \leq (\exp (s \cdot \log\left(d\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{exp-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}infinity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, e. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((e \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((2 \cdot \exp (k - (1/2 \cdot m))) \leq e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{exp-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, m, x. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (m \leq x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (2 \cdot \exp (k - (1/2 \cdot x))) \leq (2 \cdot \exp (k - (1/2 \cdot m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, a, d, b, c. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a \leq \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < b \wedge \\ \quad b < d \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \wedge \\ \quad c < d \wedge \\ \quad d \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\int_{b}^{1} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z) - \int_{c}^{1} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \exp (a \cdot \log\left(d\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}large-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, b, a, m, c, d. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad (b - 1) \leq a \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad m < c \wedge \\ \quad m < d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\int_{1}^{c} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z) - \int_{1}^{d} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot \exp ((a \cdot (\log\left((2 \cdot a)\right) - 1)) - (1/2 \cdot m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{improper\text{-}int\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z), \Gamma(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}combination}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, b, p, q.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad a \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a, y) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad p < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(p, q) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad b \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), b, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in u.\; (h(v) \simeq (a(v) + (c \cdot b(v)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), h, y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \int_{p}^{q} h = (\int_{p}^{q} a + (c \cdot \int_{p}^{q} b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}expansion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, a, t. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(x)(t) - \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(a)(t)) - ((x - a) \cdot (\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(a)(t) \cdot \log\left(t\right)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(a)(t) \cdot ((\exp ((x - a) \cdot \log\left(t\right)) - 1) - ((x - a) \cdot \log\left(t\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, t. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < p) \wedge ((p \leq t) \wedge (t \leq q)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert \log\left(t\right) \rvert \leq (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, p, q, t. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((t \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < p) \wedge ((p \leq t) \wedge (t \leq q))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(a)(t)) \leq \exp (\lvert (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(a) - 1) \rvert \cdot (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}integrand-\allowbreak{}quadratic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, p, q, t. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad p \leq t \wedge \\ \quad t \leq q \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((x - a)) \cdot (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert)) \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(x)(t) - \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(a)(t)) - ((x - a) \cdot (\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(a)(t) \cdot \log\left(t\right))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\exp (\lvert (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(a) - 1) \rvert \cdot (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert)) \cdot ((\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert) \cdot (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert))) \cdot (\operatorname{magnitude}((x - a)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((x - a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}truncation-\allowbreak{}quadratic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x, p, q. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad p < q \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((x - a)) \cdot (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert)) \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((\int_{p}^{q} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(x) - \int_{p}^{q} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(a)) - ((x - a) \cdot \int_{p}^{q} (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; ((\exp ((a - 1) \cdot \log\left(w\right)) \cdot \exp -w) \cdot \log\left(w\right)))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (q - p) \cdot ((\exp (\lvert (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(a) - 1) \rvert \cdot (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert)) \cdot ((\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert) \cdot (\lvert \log\left(p\right) \rvert + \lvert \log\left(q\right) \rvert))) \cdot (\operatorname{magnitude}((x - a)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((x - a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}truncation-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < p) \wedge (p < q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; \int_{p}^{q} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}truncation-\allowbreak{}error}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, b, c, a, l, h. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < b \wedge \\ \quad b \leq \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \leq c \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq a \wedge \\ \quad (c - 1) \leq a \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad l \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq h \wedge \\ \quad l < h \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\Gamma(z) - \int_{l}^{h} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\exp (b \cdot \log\left(l\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(b)) + (2 \cdot \exp ((a \cdot (\log\left((2 \cdot a)\right) - 1)) - (1/2 \cdot h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}, \\ \quad (\lambda x \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; \Gamma(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}derivative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, r, c, a, b. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), r, y) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, c, z, r(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \int_{a}^{b} r = (c(b) - c(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\Gamma(1) = 1}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}derivative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{hbz} \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}, \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; -(\exp (z \cdot \log\left(w\right)) \cdot \exp -w)), \\ \quad \quad \mathit{hbz}, \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; (\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}((z + 1))(w) + (-z \cdot \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)(w))))(\mathit{hbz})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}plain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((e \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge (0 < e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 < d) \wedge ((d \leq 1) \wedge \forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < t) \wedge (t \leq d)) \Rightarrow (\exp (s \cdot \log\left(t\right)) \leq e)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}recursion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \Rightarrow (\Gamma((z + 1)) = (z \cdot \Gamma(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}factorial}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\Gamma((n + 1)) = \operatorname{factorial}(n))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-exhaust-radius-decrease.scm}{theorem-library/cc-exhaust-radius-decrease.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-exhaust-radius-decrease.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-10-30 (wave-2 integration) out of theorem-library/ca5-function-spaces.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by measurable-maps-metric (measure); a fact about 1/(n+1). The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}radius}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}decrease}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{recip}(((n + 1) + 1)) < \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \wedge (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq 1))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/measurable-maps-metric.scm}{theorem-library/measurable-maps-metric.scm}
\noindent{\small measurable-maps-metric.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/mf/mf-mc1.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-mc2.scm, scratchpad/mf/mf-mc3.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sep-\allowbreak{}exists-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}sigma}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x \in g(k))\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sep-\allowbreak{}forall-\allowbreak{}family-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}sigma}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge (g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{x \in a : \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x \in g(k))\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}nbhd-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(o))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \exists \mathit{nba} \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(\mathit{nba}, y) < o)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}preimage}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, c, f, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), c(n)) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k)(x)), f(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \{\mathit{mfx} \in a : (f(\mathit{mfx}) \in u)\} \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, c, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), c(n)) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k)(x)), f(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, c, f, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, s, c, f) \wedge ((h \in (a \to s)) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = h(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, s, c, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, x, c, y, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, s, x, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, c, y, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, (s \times c), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, x, c, y), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{mfpx} \in a.\; [f(\mathit{mfpx}), g(\mathit{mfpx})])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{measurable-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}combination}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, i, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, s), s, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), (\lambda x \in a.\; i([f(x), g(x)]))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjointed-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}sigma}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, e, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge ((e \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge (k \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(e(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), e(j))) \in b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjointed-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, e, x, k, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad e \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad j \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(e(k), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(k), e(\mathit{uj}))) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(e(j), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(\mathit{uj}, \mathrm{OS}(j), e(\mathit{uj}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k = j \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disjointed-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, e, x, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge ((e \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (x \in e(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(e(m), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(m), e(j)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{step-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}approximation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), f) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}step\text{-}map}(a, b, s, g) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(f(x), g(x)) < c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{step-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(a, b, \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{pts}(s))). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}step\text{-}map}(a, b, s, c(n)) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(f(x), c(n)(x)) < \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/local-measure.scm}{theorem-library/local-measure.scm}
\noindent{\small local-measure.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/mf/mf-mg1.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}monotone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o, a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge ((e \in d) \wedge ((a \in d) \wedge (a \subseteq e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad o(a) \leq o(e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, e, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge ((e \in c) \wedge ((d \in (\mathbb{N} \to c)) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, d(n)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad o(e) \leq \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; o(d(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}premeasure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge (\emptyset \in c)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}premeasure}(a, c, o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}extends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge ((\emptyset \in c) \wedge (e \in c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, c, o)(e) = o(e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}measurable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge ((\emptyset \in c) \wedge (s \in b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, c, o), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}outer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge \\ \quad \emptyset \in c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in c.\; (u(e) = o(e)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \leq \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, c, o)(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}extensions-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, u, d, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in c.\; (u(e) = o(e)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in c.\; (d(e) = o(e)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n))) = d(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, g(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}extension}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge (\emptyset \in c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, \operatorname{restrict}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, c, o), b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall e \in c.\; (\operatorname{restrict}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, c, o), b)(e) = o(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}sigma}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, a)) \Rightarrow (a \in c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}member}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge (e \in c)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(c, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}inter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o, a, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, a) \wedge (s \in c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, (a \cap s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge ((h \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(c, h(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(c, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, h(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, n, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(b, c, o, n) \wedge ((m \in b) \wedge (m \subseteq n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(b, c, o, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}empty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge (\emptyset \in c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(b, c, o, \emptyset) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, o, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(a, b, c, o) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(b, c, o, f(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(b, c, o, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}sigma-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}outer-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge \\ \quad \emptyset \in d \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(b, d, o)(a) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{essential-\allowbreak{}witness-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o, s, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge \\ \quad \emptyset \in d \wedge \\ \quad s \in c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, \operatorname{difference}(s, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, f) \wedge \\ \quad f \subseteq s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, \operatorname{difference}(s, f)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(b, d, o)(a) \leq \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(b, d, o)(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{essential-\allowbreak{}witness-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o, s, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge \\ \quad \emptyset \in d \wedge \\ \quad s \in c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, \operatorname{difference}(s, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, f) \wedge \\ \quad f \subseteq s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, \operatorname{difference}(s, f)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(b, d, o)(a) = \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(b, d, o)(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sigma-\allowbreak{}union-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}union}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, f, o, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(c, d, f, o) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(f, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(f, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(f, (a \cup b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{essential-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}extension}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge \\ \quad \emptyset \in d \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in d.\; (u(e) = o(e)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in c \wedge \\ \quad u(s) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, a) \wedge ((a \subseteq s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, \operatorname{difference}(s, a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}measure-\allowbreak{}min-\allowbreak{}extension}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c, d, o. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}measure}(b, c, d, o) \wedge (\emptyset \in d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall e \in d.\; (m(e) = o(e)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall u.; \forall s \in c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, u) \wedge \forall e \in d.\; (u(e) = o(e))) \Rightarrow (m(s) \leq u(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s \in c, a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, a) \wedge ((a \subseteq s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, \operatorname{difference}(s, a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad m(s) = \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(b, d, o)(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s \in c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg \exists \mathit{mma} \in c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}union\text{-}of}(d, \mathit{mma}) \wedge ((\mathit{mma} \subseteq s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}null}(c, d, o, \operatorname{difference}(s, \mathit{mma})))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad m(s) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca5-function-spaces.scm}{theorem-library/ca5-function-spaces.scm}
\noindent{\small ca5-function-spaces.scm -- CHAPTER 5 OF THE COMPLEX ANALYSIS NOTES (FUNCTION SPACES), FIRST PART: the exhaustion of an open subset of CC by compact sets (Lemma 5.1), the sup seminorms on it, and the topology of Proposition 5.2. Agent CA-5, 2026-10-14.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca5-function-spaces.scm}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n) \simeq \{z \in \mathbb{C} : ((\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \subseteq u))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, n, z. \\ \quad (z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \subseteq u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, y. \\ \quad (y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \Leftrightarrow ((y \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - c)) < r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n) \subseteq u)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((a - c)) \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}((a - b)) + \operatorname{magnitude}((b - c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}centre}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < r) \Rightarrow (c \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}interior}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n) \subseteq \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (r \leq q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (a \leq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, a) \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}covers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{not-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}witness}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b.\; (\neg (a \subseteq b) \Rightarrow \exists x \in a.\; \neg (x \in b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}exhaustive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge ((p \subseteq u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}bolzano-\allowbreak{}weierstrass}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(h(i)) \leq d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \exists l \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{subseq}(h, a), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(i) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad l \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}exhaust}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 \leq m) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s.; \forall x \in s. \\ \quad \forall y \in s.\; (g(y) \in \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(g(x)) \leq \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(g, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}compacta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(z) - f(z))) \leq s) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/removable-singularities.scm}{theorem-library/removable-singularities.scm}
\noindent{\small removable-singularities.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3f-rem.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}mag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, a, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(z) - g(a))) < s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}mag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(z) - g(a))) < s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{removable-\allowbreak{}singularity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), f) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; (g(z) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{riemann-\allowbreak{}removable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; (g(z) = f(z)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{removable-\allowbreak{}extension-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, g, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in u \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), k, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; (g(z) = k(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(c) = k(c) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/power-series-coef-bound.scm}{theorem-library/power-series-coef-bound.scm}
\noindent{\small power-series-coef-bound.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-coef.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{power-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}coefficient-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, a, r, m.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(q) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - a)) = r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cpsk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q(\mathit{cpsk}) \cdot \operatorname{power}((y - a), \mathit{cpsk}))))) \leq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(q(k)) \leq (m \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4a-laurent.scm}{theorem-library/ch4a-laurent.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4a-laurent.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4a/ch4a-laurent.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{annulus-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{annulus}(a, m, p) \simeq \{z \in \mathbb{C} : ((m < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - a))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < p))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{annulus-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{C}, m, p \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{annulus}(a, m, p))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{annulus-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, m, p \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{annulus}(a, m, p). \\ \quad (0 < m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\neg ((y - a) = 0) \wedge (((y - a) \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, p)) \wedge (\operatorname{recip}((y - a)) \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, \operatorname{recip}(m))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}assembly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, m, p \in \mathbb{R}, b, n. \\ \quad 0 < m \wedge \\ \quad m < p \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, p), b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, \operatorname{recip}(m)), n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, m, p), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{annulus}(a, m, p).\; (b((x - a)) + (\operatorname{recip}((x - a)) \cdot n(\operatorname{recip}((x - a))))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, m, p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad 0 < m \wedge \\ \quad m < p \wedge \\ \quad p < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{recip}(m) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(-(k + 1)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, m, p), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{annulus}(a, m, p).\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(c, a, x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/weierstrass-convergence.scm}{theorem-library/weierstrass-convergence.scm}
\noindent{\small weierstrass-convergence.scm -- UNIFORM CONVERGENCE ON COMPACT SUBSETS AND PROPOSITION 3.44 OF complex-analysis.pdf (with Weierstrass's complement: the derivatives converge too).  Agent CA-AC, 2026-10-14. Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-ac-vocab.scm (UNIF-ON-COMPACTA, new; the user's to confirm).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r.; \forall z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad (z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \leq r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mem-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \leq r) \Rightarrow (z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}parts-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \leq r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \rvert \leq (\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(c) \rvert + r)) \wedge (\lvert \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) \rvert \leq (\lvert \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(c) \rvert + r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}subseq-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, g, q, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{subseq}(b, g), q) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq j) \Rightarrow (\lvert (b(g(j)) - q) \rvert \leq e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unif-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compacta-\allowbreak{}locally}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, f.; \forall z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(y) - f(y))) \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compacta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}cover-\allowbreak{}by-\allowbreak{}balls}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall h \in (s \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s)) \wedge \forall x \in s.\; (0 < h(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((p \subseteq s) \wedge ((|p| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall y \in s.\; \exists x \in p.\; (y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, x, h(x))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{locally-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compacta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, l. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(k)(y) - l(y))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, g, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}derivatives}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{wcvk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, m(\mathit{wcvk}), w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/analytic-continuation.scm}{theorem-library/analytic-continuation.scm}
\noindent{\small analytic-continuation.scm -- PROPOSITION 2.12 (PRINCIPLE OF ANALYTIC CONTINUATION) AND COROLLARY 2.13 (FINITELY MANY ZEROS IN A CLOSED BALL) OF complex-analysis.pdf. Agent CA-AC, 2026-10-14.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-ac-vocab.scm (ZEROS-ACCUMULATE-AT, new; the user's to confirm).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zeros-\allowbreak{}accumulate-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall h \in (v \to \mathbb{C}), a \in v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in v. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), h, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(v, h, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(a) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}zeros}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (t(k) = 0) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, l)) \Rightarrow (l = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\neg (t = 0) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{power}(t, n) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, v, h.; \forall a \in v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, h) \wedge \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(v, h, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, q) \wedge \forall x \in v.\; (h(x) = (\operatorname{power}((x - a), n) \cdot q(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}coefficients}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}
