\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}zeros-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge ((\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (f(z) = 0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}identity-\allowbreak{}principle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(z) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{analytic-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \forall b \in u.\; f \text{ is analytic at } b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{analytic-\allowbreak{}continuation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in u.\; f \text{ is analytic at } b \wedge \\ \quad \exists a \in u.\; \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{analytic-\allowbreak{}zeros-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in u.\; f \text{ is analytic at } b \wedge \\ \quad \exists e \in u.\; \neg (f(e) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\{z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = 0)\}| \in \mathbb{N} \end{array}}}

Agent CA-5, 2026-10-14.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca5-function-spaces.scm (CC-CONT-FNS, CC-HOL-FNS, CC-FN-MODULE, CC-EXHAUST-SEMINORMS); the Frechet ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; -x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \simeq \{f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) : \forall y \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, h. \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), h, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v)) \simeq v)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (v \times v).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbf{Set}.\; (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v)) \simeq (\lambda z \in u.\; 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v)) \simeq (\lambda a \in v.\; (\lambda z \in u.\; -a(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times v).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u).\; ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow (a \in (u \to \mathbb{C})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + b(z))) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow ((\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow ((\lambda z \in u.\; (c \cdot a(z))) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow ((\lambda z \in u.\; -a(z)) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}assoc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))((\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(a, b), \\ \quad \quad \quad c) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(a, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(b, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(b, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))((\lambda z \in u.\; 0), a) \\ \quad \quad =\; a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(a, (\lambda z \in u.\; 0)) \\ \quad \quad =\; a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\mathit{cfa}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))((\lambda \mathit{cfa} \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; -\operatorname{cfa}(z)))(a), \\ \quad \quad \quad a) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\mathit{cfa}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(a, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cfa} \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; -\operatorname{cfa}(z)))(a)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u), r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(r, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))(a, b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))((\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(r, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(r, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}distrib-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u), r, s \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))((\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_}))(r, s), \\ \quad \quad \quad a) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lambda [\operatorname{cfa\_}, \operatorname{cfb\_}] \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfa\_}(z) + \operatorname{cfb\_}(z))))((\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(r, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}compat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u), r, s \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))((\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_}))(r, s), \\ \quad \quad \quad a) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(r, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}unital}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cfc\_}, \operatorname{cfa\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)).\; (\lambda z \in u.\; (\operatorname{cfc\_} \cdot \operatorname{cfa\_}(z))))(1, a) \\ \quad \quad =\; a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + b(z))), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(a, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) + \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(b, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}((\lambda z \in u.\; (c \cdot a(z))), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(a, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}seminorms-\allowbreak{}separate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \neg (a = (\lambda z \in u.\; 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (\operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(a, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}seminorms-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}seminorms-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, v) \simeq (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda a \in v.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(a, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) - b(z))) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + -b(z))) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)))(a, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)))(b))) \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) - b(z))), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}cauchy}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cfi})(z)), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}function}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cfz} \in u.\; \varepsilon(\{l \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cfi})(\mathit{cfz})), l)\})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cfi})(z)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cfz} \in u.\; \varepsilon(\{l \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cfi})(\mathit{cfz})), l)\}))(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \leq i) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - (\lambda \mathit{cfz} \in u.\; \varepsilon(\{l \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cfi})(\mathit{cfz})), l)\}))(z))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in u, o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, o) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, o). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - g(z))) \leq b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}frechet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \simeq \{f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) : \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, h.\; ((h \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)) \Leftrightarrow ((h \in (u \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h)))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(a))(z) = -z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u, z \in \mathbb{C}, v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)((u + -z), v) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(u, v), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(z, v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, z, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a}), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r, q \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(r, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(q))) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(q, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}common}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall p, q, r \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(q)), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(r, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(q)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(a)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u, z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x))) = \operatorname{act}(a)((u + -z), 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resolvent-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z, u \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1})) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{act}(a)((u + -z), \cdot_{a}({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}, {\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(1, v) = v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\neg (z = 0) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{act}(a)(z, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{shift-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}outside-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < \operatorname{magnitude}(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}spectrum-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad (\sigma({x}) \simeq \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spectrum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \sigma({x}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(0, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bas-\allowbreak{}characters-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{characters}(a) \simeq \{c \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{C}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, c) \wedge (\forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (c(\cdot_{a}(x, y)) = (c(x) \cdot c(y))) \wedge (c(1_{a}) = 1)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{character-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a), u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, u)) \Rightarrow \neg (c(u) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{character-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(c(x)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall y \in i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 1_{a} \in i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall y \in i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(y))) < 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 1_{a} \in i \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bbi-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}fix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))}^{-1} \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \cdot_{a}(x, {\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))}^{-1})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bbi-\allowbreak{}fix-\allowbreak{}expand}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (v = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \cdot_{a}(x, v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(v, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, x))) = \cdot_{a}(x, \cdot_{a}(x, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neumann-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))}^{-1}) \leq \operatorname{recip}((1 - \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{neumann-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, x)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((1 - \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bbi-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)({b}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({v}^{-1})) \\ \quad \quad =\; \cdot_{a}({v}^{-1}, \cdot_{a}(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(v, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(b)), {b}^{-1})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inverse-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({b}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({v}^{-1}))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(v))) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({b}^{-1})) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({v}^{-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inverse-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(v))) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({b}^{-1})) \leq 1/2 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, v) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({v}^{-1}) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({b}^{-1})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inverse-\allowbreak{}lipschitz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(v))) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({b}^{-1})) \leq 1/2 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({b}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({v}^{-1}))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(v))) \cdot (2 \cdot (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({b}^{-1}) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({b}^{-1}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{inverse-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, b) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(v))) \leq l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, v) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({b}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({v}^{-1}))) \leq s)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bic-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall q \in i, x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, q) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bic-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bic-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)(z, x) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bic-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(y, x) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{left-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}all}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, j. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, j) \wedge (1_{a} \in j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad j = \operatorname{vec}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), i) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-resolvent.scm}{theorem-library/ba-resolvent.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-resolvent.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1B), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1b-1109/ba-resolvent.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{brv-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ({1_{a}}^{-1} = 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{brv-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\neg (z = 0) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {\operatorname{act}(a)(z, u)}^{-1} = \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{recip}(z), {u}^{-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{brv-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \neg (z = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x) = \operatorname{act}(a)(z, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{recip}(z), x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{brv-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \neg (z = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{recip}(z), x)) = (\operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resolvent-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \wedge ((2 \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resolvent-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z + -u)) \leq l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1}))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resolvent-\allowbreak{}derivative}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z + -u)) \leq l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)((u + -z), \cdot_{a}({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1}, {\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1}))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; s \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((z + -u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resolvent-\allowbreak{}laurent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < \operatorname{magnitude}(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{recip}(z), \sum_{k < n} {\operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{recip}(z), x)}^{k})), \\ \quad \quad \quad {\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-gelfand-mazur.scm}{theorem-library/ba-gelfand-mazur.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-gelfand-mazur.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1B), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1b-1109/ba-gelfand-mazur.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}mazur-\allowbreak{}spectrum-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \sigma({x}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\neg (y = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{scalar-\allowbreak{}embedding-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a}) = \operatorname{act}(a)(w, 1_{a}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z = w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}mazur-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}nonempty-\allowbreak{}spectrum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\neg (y = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; \exists z.\; (z \in \sigma({x})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (x = \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}transform-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(\cdot_{a}(x, y))(c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c) \cdot \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(y)(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}transform-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y))(c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c) + \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(y)(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}transform-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(z, x))(c) = (z \cdot \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}transform-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(1_{a})(c) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}transform-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{quot-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{quot\text{-}norm}(a, i, x) \simeq \operatorname{einf}(\{w \in \mathbb{R} : \exists y \in i.\; (w = \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(y))))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ba-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall y \in i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{quot-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{quot\text{-}norm}(a, i, x) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{quot-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \neg (1_{a} \in i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{quot\text{-}norm}(a, i, 1_{a}) = 1 \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qna-\allowbreak{}lvm-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{bqnx\_}, \operatorname{bqny\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \times \operatorname{vec}(a)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \cdot_{a}(\operatorname{bqnx\_}, \operatorname{bqny\_}))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qna-\allowbreak{}lvm-\allowbreak{}respects}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{respects2}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{bqnx\_}, \operatorname{bqny\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \times \operatorname{vec}(a)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \cdot_{a}(\operatorname{bqnx\_}, \operatorname{bqny\_})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qna\text{-}vmul}(a, i) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)) \times \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i))) \to \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qna-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qna\text{-}vmul}(a, i)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \cdot_{a}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)), u \in c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in c.\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(u) < (\operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c) + s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}greatest}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)), t, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < t \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in c.\; (b \leq (t \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(u))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b \leq (t \cdot \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c, d \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i))(c, d)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c) + \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}submult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c, d \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, \operatorname{qna\text{-}vmul}(a, i)(c, d)) \leq (\operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c) \cdot \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)), m \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i))(m, c)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{magnitude}(m) \cdot \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, c) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{coset-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}quot-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{coset\text{-}norm}(a, i, \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), x)) = \operatorname{quot\text{-}norm}(a, i, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qba-\allowbreak{}vone-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qna\text{-}vmul}(a, i)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), 1_{a}), c) = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qba-\allowbreak{}vone-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qna\text{-}vmul}(a, i)(c, \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), 1_{a})) = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qba-\allowbreak{}vone-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}na}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qna\text{-}vmul}(a, i)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), 1_{a}), x) = x \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{spectral-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad (\rho({x}) \simeq \operatorname{einf}(\{w \in \mathbb{R} : \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq n) \wedge (w = {\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({x}^{n})}^{{n}^{\ast\!-1}}))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spectral-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\rho({x}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \rho({x})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsr-\allowbreak{}el-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {\operatorname{act}(a)(c, x)}^{n} = \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{power}(c, n), {x}^{n}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsr-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({x}^{n})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{shift-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}beyond-\allowbreak{}spectral-\allowbreak{}radius}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\rho({x}) < \operatorname{magnitude}(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spectrum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}spectral-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \sigma({x}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq \rho({x})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resolvent-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \sigma({x}))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}ccsa-\allowbreak{}ucsa}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}ccsa-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{a}(x, y) = \cdot_{a}(y, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}ucsa-\allowbreak{}uiba}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}ucsa-\allowbreak{}cstar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x)) = (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)) = \mathbb{C}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}vstar-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ({}^{*_{a}} \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {}^{*_{a}}(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)({}^{*_{a}}(x), {}^{*_{a}}(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {}^{*_{a}}(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x)) = \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{conjugate}(r), {}^{*_{a}}(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}invol}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ({}^{*_{a}}({}^{*_{a}}(x)) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {}^{*_{a}}(\cdot_{a}(x, y)) = \cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), {}^{*_{a}}(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({}^{*_{a}}(x)) = \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}view-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a) \simeq [\operatorname{scal}(a), \operatorname{vec}(a), \operatorname{vadd}(a), \operatorname{vzero}(a), \operatorname{vneg}(a), \operatorname{act}(a), \operatorname{vnrm}(a), \cdot_{a}, 1_{a}]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uiba-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}uba}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vneg}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{act}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}vmul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)} \simeq \cdot_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}uu-\allowbreak{}vone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (1_{\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)} \simeq 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ({}^{*_{a}}(1_{a}) = 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}characters-\allowbreak{}view}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{characters}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(c(x)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcs-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, e, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((l \cdot l) + ((e + t) \cdot (e + t))) \leq (c + (t \cdot t))) \Rightarrow (e = 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca5-montel.scm}{theorem-library/ca5-montel.scm}
\noindent{\small ca5-montel.scm -- CHAPTER 5 OF THE COMPLEX ANALYSIS NOTES, section 5.2: BOUNDED SETS OF HOLOMORPHIC FUNCTIONS, Proposition 5.8 (equicontinuity) and MONTEL'S THEOREM (Theorem 5.7 / Corollary 5.19 for sequences).  Agent CA-5, 2026-10-14.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}holomorphic-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall y \in \mathbb{C}, q, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (2 \cdot q)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cmy} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (2 \cdot q)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{cmy})) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, y)) \leq (m \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}holomorphic-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}centre}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, q, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (3 \cdot q)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (3 \cdot q)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(c))) \leq ((m \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}equicontinuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a.; \forall b \in u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall f \in a, z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - b)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(b))) < s))) \end{array}}}
