\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}unif-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q, t, s. \\ \quad a \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a), q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a.\; (t(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((t(k)(y) - t(k)(x))) < s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \ell \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cmk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(t(\mathit{cmk})(q(j)))), \ell) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(t(i)(z)) - \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(t(j)(z))) \rvert < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}unif-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q, t, s. \\ \quad a \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a), q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a.\; (t(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((t(k)(y) - t(k)(x))) < s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \ell \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cmk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(t(\mathit{cmk})(q(j)))), \ell) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(t(i)(z)) - \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(t(j)(z))) \rvert < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}unif-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q, t, s. \\ \quad a \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a), q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a.\; (t(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((t(k)(y) - t(k)(x))) < s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \ell \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cmk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; t(\mathit{cmk})(q(j))), \ell) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((t(i)(z) - t(j)(z))) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}diagonal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, d. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; (s(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists a \in \mathbb{R}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(s(k)(z)) \leq a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \ell \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cmk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(i(\mathit{cmk}))(d(j))), \ell) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}seqs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall p \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{N}, q \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C})). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, (n + a))), q(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}u}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \mathbb{N}, q \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, (n + a))), q(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), (\lambda m \in \mathbb{N}.\; q(\operatorname{nnfst}(m))(\operatorname{nnsnd}(m)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}montel-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}montel-\allowbreak{}subsequence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{subseq}(s, a)(i)(z) - \operatorname{subseq}(s, a)(j)(z))) < b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}montel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \operatorname{subseq}(s, i), g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fr-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}unif-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compacta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}hol}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, s(k), w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca5-series.scm}{theorem-library/ca5-series.scm}
\noindent{\small ca5-series.scm -- CHAPTER 5 OF THE COMPLEX ANALYSIS NOTES, section 5.3: DIFFERENTIATION AS A LINEAR OPERATOR, Lemma 5.21, Proposition 5.22 and the linearity half of Proposition 5.20. Agent CA-5, 2026-10-14.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}quarter}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{recip}((((4 \cdot n) + 3) + 1)) = (1/4 \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}inside}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (1/2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))) \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, ((4 \cdot n) + 3)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cmy} \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, ((4 \cdot n) + 3)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{cmy})) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, y)) \leq (m \cdot (4 \cdot (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}derived-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}normally-\allowbreak{}convergent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda z \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(i), z))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}convergence-\allowbreak{}pointwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s.; \forall z \in s. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, y \in s.\; (g(i)(y) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}convergence-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s, a. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, y \in s.\; (g(i)(y) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, s) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z))) - \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z)), n))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sums-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w)), n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad z, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{cdi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(\mathit{cdi}), z)), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w)))), z) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cdi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(\mathit{cdi}), z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda w \in u.\; ((a \cdot f(w)) + (b \cdot g(w)))), z) \\ \quad \quad =\; (a \cdot \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z)) + (b \cdot \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca6-hurwitz.scm}{theorem-library/ca6-hurwitz.scm}
\noindent{\small ca6-hurwitz.scm -- CHAPTER 5 OF THE COMPLEX ANALYSIS NOTES (\textasciitilde{}/docs/complex-analysis.pdf), the rest of sections 5.2-5.3: COROLLARY 5.19 (pointwise limits of bounded sequences), HURWITZ (Proposition 5.23 and Remark 5.24), INJECTIVE LIMITS (Proposition 5.25), and PROPOSITION 5.20 AS AN OPERATOR (D : f |-$>$ f' a continuous ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}unif-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compacta-\allowbreak{}pointwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s.; \forall h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; (s(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cpk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cpk})(z)), h(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}subseq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, i.; \forall z \in u, w. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; (s(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cpk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cpk})(z)), w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cpk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{subseq}(s, i)(\mathit{cpk})(z)), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}unif-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}agree}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s.; \forall h, g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; (s(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cpk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cpk})(z)), g(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h = g \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, b, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, b) \wedge (a \subseteq b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}subseq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N})) \wedge \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(\operatorname{subseq}(s, i), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}montel-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(z)), g(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)) \wedge \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hurwitz-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, q \in \mathbb{R}, a \in \mathbb{C}, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q).\; \neg (g(y) = a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < m \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (m \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((g(y) - a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((g(c) - a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hurwitz-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, q \in \mathbb{R}, a \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q).\; (\neg (y = c) \Rightarrow \neg (f(y) = a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 < m) \wedge \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (m \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((f(y) - a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hurwitz-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, c \in u, p, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad f(c) = a \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (((x \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, p)) \wedge \neg (x = c)) \Rightarrow \neg (f(x) = a)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow \exists z \in u.\; ((z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \wedge (s(k)(z) = a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hurwitz-\allowbreak{}eventually}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, c \in u, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists \mathit{hcc} \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (f(z) = \mathit{hcc}) \wedge \\ \quad f(c) = a \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{hzz} \in u.\; ((\mathit{hzz} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \wedge (s(k)(\mathit{hzz}) = a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hurwitz-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), a \in \mathbb{C}, f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; \neg (s(k)(z) = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hurwitz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; \neg (s(k)(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hurwitz-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z, w \in u.\; ((s(k)(z) = s(k)(w)) \Rightarrow (z = w)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \\ \quad \quad \forall z, w \in u.\; ((f(z) = f(w)) \Rightarrow (z = w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + b(z))) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; -a(z)) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (c \cdot a(z))) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + -b(z))) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall v \in \mathbf{Set}, a, b \in v, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + b(z))) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \in v \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; -a(z)) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (c \cdot a(z))) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in v.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + -b(z))) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, v)(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v))(a, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, v))(b))) \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) - b(z))), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fr-\allowbreak{}conv-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall \mathit{fva}, \mathit{fvb} \in \mathbf{Set}, s.; \forall f \in \mathit{fva}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{fva} \subseteq (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in \mathit{fva}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + b(z))) \in \mathit{fva}) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \in \mathit{fva} \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathit{fva}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; -a(z)) \in \mathit{fva}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in \mathit{fva}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (c \cdot a(z))) \in \mathit{fva}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in \mathit{fva}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + -b(z))) \in \mathit{fva}) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{fvb} \subseteq (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in \mathit{fvb}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + b(z))) \in \mathit{fvb}) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \in \mathit{fvb} \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathit{fvb}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; -a(z)) \in \mathit{fvb}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in \mathit{fvb}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (c \cdot a(z))) \in \mathit{fvb}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in \mathit{fvb}.\; ((\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + -b(z))) \in \mathit{fvb}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(i) \in \mathit{fva}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (s(i) \in \mathit{fvb}) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \mathit{fvb} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \mathit{fva}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \mathit{fva}), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \mathit{fvb}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \mathit{fvb}), s, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + b(z))) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; 0) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; -a(z)) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; (c \cdot a(z))) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in u.\; (a(z) + -b(z))) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}lin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-connected.scm}{theorem-library/ca-connected.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-connected.scm -- connected sets (CA-MONTEL "CONN", 2026-10-26).  No theorem of the tree concluded IS-CONNECTED of any set before this file.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}clopen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q.; \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \forall v \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((v \in p) \vee (v \in q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \neg ((v \in p) \wedge (v \in q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \quad (s \in p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((\lvert (u - s) \rvert < d) \Rightarrow (u \in p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \quad (s \in q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall u \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((\lvert (u - s) \rvert < d) \Rightarrow (u \in q)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \in p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t \in p \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}segment-\allowbreak{}clopen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; (((x + (t \cdot (y - x))) \in u) \vee ((x + (t \cdot (y - x))) \in v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; \neg (((x + (t \cdot (y - x))) \in u) \wedge ((x + (t \cdot (y - x))) \in v)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad y \in u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in u. \\ \quad ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge \forall y \in u, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((c + (t \cdot (y - c))) \in u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{identity-\allowbreak{}principle-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, f.; \forall a, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), f) \wedge \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), f, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(z) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{identity-\allowbreak{}principle-\allowbreak{}plane}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall a, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f) \wedge \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(\mathbb{C}, f, a)) \Rightarrow (f(z) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hurwitz-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r))), f \in (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; \neg (s(k)(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{hcc} \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = \mathit{hcc}) \vee \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hurwitz-\allowbreak{}plane}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(\mathbb{C})), f \in (\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}.\; \neg (s(k)(z) = 0) \wedge \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(\mathbb{C}, s, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; \neg (f(z) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(\{z \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z))\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \{z \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z))\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}slit-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/mvp-bounded.scm}{theorem-library/mvp-bounded.scm}
\noindent{\small mvp-bounded.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/calint2/mvp-bounded.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, g.; \forall b \in \mathbb{R}, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad a \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \forall r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \exists y \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in a \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in a.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq b) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall y \in a.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((x - y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow (\lvert (g(x) - g(y)) \rvert \leq s))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(n) \in a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l \in a. \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mxn} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\mathit{mxn} \leq k) \Rightarrow (\lvert (g(h(i(k))) - g(l)) \rvert \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}max}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, g.; \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad k \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \forall r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \exists y \in k.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in k \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in k.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq b) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (k \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall y \in k.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((x - y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow (\lvert (g(x) - g(y)) \rvert \leq s))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c.\; (c \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k.\; \forall z \in k.\; (g(z) \leq g(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, f, x, s. \\ \quad w \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall y \in w.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((x - y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(x) - f(y))) \leq s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closure-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}sequence-\allowbreak{}free-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \exists y \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closure-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, d.; \forall z \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{continuous-\allowbreak{}constant-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c.; \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, x) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (f(z) = c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(x) = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}boundary-\allowbreak{}nonempty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in u, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b.\; (b \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mvp-\allowbreak{}maximum-\allowbreak{}modulus-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall d, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, \operatorname{restrict}(f, u)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(w)) \leq m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in u, z \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(w)) = m) \Rightarrow (f(z) = f(w)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-montel-compact.scm}{theorem-library/ca-montel-compact.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-montel-compact.scm -- Theorem 5.7 of the complex analysis notes in SET form (CA-MONTEL, 2026-10-26)}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}montel-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}montel-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))), \\ \quad \quad a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/rb2-path.scm}{theorem-library/rb2-path.scm}
\noindent{\small rb2-path.scm -- path-connectedness in a metric space (vocabulary IS-PATH-CONNECTED, rb2-vocab). path-connected-implies-connected  IS-PATH-CONNECTED(s, A) =$>$ IS-CONNECTED(s, A) cc-convex-path-connected          IS-CONVEX-CC(A) =$>$ IS-PATH-CONNECTED(CC-MS, A) rr-convex-path-connected          IS-CONVEX-RR(A) =$>$ ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{path-\allowbreak{}connected-\allowbreak{}implies-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}path\text{-}connected}(s, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(s, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in a, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow ((x + (t \cdot (y - x))) \in a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}path\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}path\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca51-cc.scm}{theorem-library/ca51-cc.scm}
\noindent{\small ca51-cc.scm -- Lemma 5.1 for CC and its open subsets (CA-51, 2026-10-26). Destination: theorem-library/ca51-cc.scm, library complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall p \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}separable}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}exhaustion}}{\vnbstmt{\exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}exhaustion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall p \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}exhaust-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}exhaustion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch3a-maxmod.scm}{theorem-library/ch3a-maxmod.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3a-maxmod.scm -- the maximum modulus principle on a connected open set (Proposition 3.55 of the complex analysis notes, holomorphic form) (CH3-A, 2026-10-26). Destination: theorem-library/ch3a-maxmod.scm, library complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ball-\allowbreak{}zeros-\allowbreak{}accumulate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge ((\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r) \subseteq u) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r).\; (g(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, g, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximum-\allowbreak{}modulus-\allowbreak{}connected}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch3a-estimates.scm}{theorem-library/ch3a-estimates.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3a-estimates.scm -- Cauchy's estimates with the full radius (Corollary 3.48 of the complex analysis notes) (CH3-A, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/ch3a-estimates.scm, library complex-analysis (the real lemma rr-le-of-power-bounds is analysis vocabulary only).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}nth-\allowbreak{}deriv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f^{(k)}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, v, a, o, i \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq v) \wedge ((0 < o) \wedge ((o < i) \wedge \forall r \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((o < r) \wedge (r < i)) \Rightarrow ((v \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, k)) \leq a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (v \cdot \operatorname{power}(i, k)) \leq a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}estimates-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, m, o \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, o))^{(k)}(c)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{factorial}(k) \cdot (m \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch3a-schwarz.scm}{theorem-library/ch3a-schwarz.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3a-schwarz.scm -- the maximum of |g| on a compact set, removable points, and Schwarz's lemma (Proposition 3.57 and Lemma 10.11 of the complex analysis notes) (CH3-A, 2026-10-26). Destination: theorem-library/ch3a-schwarz.scm, library complex-analysis. Helper prefix csw-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}modulus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g.; \forall y \in u, s. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall b \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((b - y)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(b) - g(y))) \leq s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}modulus-\allowbreak{}max}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), k.; \forall a \in k. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in k.\; \forall z \in k.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(g(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(g(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}removable-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), \operatorname{restrict}(g, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schwarz-\allowbreak{}quotient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), f) \wedge \\ \quad f(0) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) < 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (f(w) = (q(w) \cdot w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(q(w)) \leq 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schwarz-\allowbreak{}lemma}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), f) \wedge \\ \quad f(0) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) < 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\neg (a = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(a)) = \operatorname{magnitude}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (f(z) = (r \cdot z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disc-\allowbreak{}automorphism-\allowbreak{}rotation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}holomorphic\text{-}automorphism}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), i^{-1}) \wedge \\ \quad i(0) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (i(z) = (r \cdot z)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-spectrum-nonempty.scm}{theorem-library/ba-spectrum-nonempty.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-spectrum-nonempty.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1D), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1d-1109/ba-spectrum-nonempty.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}uam-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}uam-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}uam-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{act}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}uam-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uba-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), \operatorname{vnrm}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}cl-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}cl-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y)) = (f(x) + f(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}cl-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{act}(a)(z, x)) = (z \cdot f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vneg}(a)(w)) = -f(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}klin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uba-\allowbreak{}norming-\allowbreak{}functional}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(v)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f(y) = \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{resolvent-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), f, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(v)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; f({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, w, x)}^{-1}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsn-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}spectrum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \neg \exists q.\; (q \in \sigma({x}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spectrum-\allowbreak{}nonempty}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \exists q.\; (q \in \sigma({x})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}mazur}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\neg (y = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (x = \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch3a-growth.scm}{theorem-library/ch3a-growth.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3a-growth.scm -- entire functions of polynomial growth are polynomials (Proposition 3.53 of the complex analysis notes) (CH3-A, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/ch3a-growth.scm, library complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{entire-\allowbreak{}polynomial-\allowbreak{}growth}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, f.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f) \wedge \forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq ((a \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), m)) + b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (m + 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch3a-factor.scm}{theorem-library/ch3a-factor.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3a-factor.scm -- complete factorization of a complex polynomial (Proposition 3.51 of the complex analysis notes) (CH3-A, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/ch3a-factor.scm, library complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}congr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, h. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < n) \Rightarrow (g(i) = h(i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}(g, n) \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}(h, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(i) \in \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}(g, n) \in \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}factorization}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \neg (c(n) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; c(n) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z - a(i))), n) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-lft-plane.scm}{theorem-library/ca-lft-plane.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-lft-plane.scm -- the point at infinity, the extended plane C u \{oo\}, and the values of LFT(a, b, c, d) and HOMOG-POINT(u, v) (complex-analysis.pdf s. 1.6, eq. (8) and (9)). CA-LFT, 2026-10-19.  Library: complex-analysis.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-lft-vocab.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; \neg (z = \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x.\; ((x \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}) \Leftrightarrow ((x \in \mathbb{C}) \vee (x = \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}hat}}{\vnbstmt{\mathbb{C} \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}hat}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{cc\text{-}inf} \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}hat}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}div-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\neg (y = 0) \Rightarrow ((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(y)) \in \mathbb{C}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}pole}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (c = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)(\operatorname{cc\text{-}inf}) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (c = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)(\operatorname{cc\text{-}inf}) = (a \cdot \operatorname{recip}(c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}pole}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (((c \cdot z) + d) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)(z) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (((c \cdot z) + d) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)(z) = (((a \cdot z) + b) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(((c \cdot z) + d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(u, 0) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\neg (v = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(u, v) = (u \cdot \operatorname{recip}(v))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}hat}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(u, v) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d) \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-lft-compose.scm}{theorem-library/ca-lft-compose.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-lft-compose.scm -- homogeneous coordinates and the composition of linear fractional transformations (complex-analysis.pdf Prop. 1.18, the computation in its proof). CA-LFT, 2026-10-19.  Library: complex-analysis.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-lft-vocab.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((((x \cdot y) = 0) \wedge \neg (y = 0)) \Rightarrow (x = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}div-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}back}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, v \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\neg (v = 0) \Rightarrow (((u \cdot \operatorname{recip}(v)) \cdot v) = u))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}div-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (y = 0) \wedge \neg (w = 0)) \Rightarrow (((x \cdot w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((y \cdot w))) = (x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}nondegenerate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, u, v \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \wedge \neg ((u = 0) \wedge (v = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg ((((a \cdot u) + (b \cdot v)) = 0) \wedge (((c \cdot u) + (d \cdot v)) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, u, v \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \wedge \neg ((u = 0) \wedge (v = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)(\operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(u, v)) = \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(((a \cdot u) + (b \cdot v)), ((c \cdot u) + (d \cdot v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}. \exists u, v \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg ((u = 0) \wedge (v = 0)) \wedge (w = \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(u, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, f, g, h, k \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \wedge \neg (((f \cdot k) - (g \cdot h)) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (((((a \cdot f) + (b \cdot h)) \cdot ((c \cdot g) + (d \cdot k))) - (((a \cdot g) + (b \cdot k)) \cdot ((c \cdot f) + (d \cdot h)))) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, f, g, h, k \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \wedge \neg (((f \cdot k) - (g \cdot h)) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d), \operatorname{lft}(f, g, h, k)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{lft}(((a \cdot f) + (b \cdot h)), ((a \cdot g) + (b \cdot k)), ((c \cdot f) + (d \cdot h)), ((c \cdot g) + (d \cdot k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\neg (r = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(r, 0, 0, r) = \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/th3-compact.scm}{theorem-library/th3-compact.scm}
\noindent{\small th3-compact.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-A), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/th3-compact.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{strictly-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; i(a(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{converges-\allowbreak{}reindex-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, i, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, a, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = a(i(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, b, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{converges-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, a, l) \wedge ((b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = a(n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, b, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ipc-\allowbreak{}op}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, a, b, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), a, l) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = t(a(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), b, t(l)) \end{array}}}
