\vnbentry{\texttt{ipc-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, a, b, c, \mathit{la}, \mathit{lb}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), a, \mathit{la}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), b, \mathit{lb}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(n) = \operatorname{vadd}(w)(a(n), b(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), c, \operatorname{vadd}(w)(\mathit{la}, \mathit{lb})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ipc-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, c, a, b, \mathit{la}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), a, \mathit{la}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = \operatorname{act}(w)(c, a(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), b, \operatorname{act}(w)(c, \mathit{la})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lVert f(q) \rVert \leq 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{phq}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(\mathit{phq}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{lq}. \forall \mathit{bq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(w)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{bq}(q) = t(f(\operatorname{phq}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{lq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lVert f(q) \rVert \leq 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{phq}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(\mathit{phq}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{lq}. \forall \mathit{bq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(w)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{bq}(q) = t(f(\operatorname{phq}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{lq}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, w, t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \Rightarrow (t \in L({v}, {w})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, {s} + {t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, c, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, {c}\,{t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, {s}{t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, f, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lVert f(q) \rVert \leq r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{phq}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(\mathit{phq}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{lq}. \forall \mathit{bq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(w)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{bq}(q) = t(f(\operatorname{phq}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), \mathit{bq}, \mathit{lq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge (s \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, {t}{s}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}eigenvalue-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad t(x) = \operatorname{act}(v)(c, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad c = \operatorname{conjugate}(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}eigenvectors-\allowbreak{}orthogonal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, a, b, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b = \operatorname{conjugate}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t(x) = \operatorname{act}(v)(a, x) \wedge \\ \quad t(y) = \operatorname{act}(v)(b, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}eigenvalue-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}ev}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}eigenvalue}(v, t, c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c = \operatorname{conjugate}(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}eigenspaces-\allowbreak{}orthogonal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, a, b, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}eigenvalue}(v, t, b) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad x \in N_{a}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad y \in N_{b}({t}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, f, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lVert f(q) \rVert \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{iq}, \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{iq} < \mathit{jq}) \Rightarrow (d \leq \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(w)(t(f(\mathit{iq})), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(t(f(\mathit{jq})))) \rVert) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \mathit{falsity} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}eigen-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, e, \ell, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge \\ \quad e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \ell \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lVert e(n) \rVert = 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < j) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(e(i), e(j)) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{en} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (t(e(\mathit{en})) = \operatorname{act}(v)(\ell(\mathit{en}), e(\mathit{en}))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ln} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(\ell(\mathit{ln}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \mathit{falsity} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}eigen-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \lVert x \rVert \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(t(t(x)), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)((\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert), x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(t(t(x)), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)((\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert), x)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (((\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert) \cdot (\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert)) - ((\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(t(x), t(x)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/th3a2-compact.scm}{theorem-library/th3a2-compact.scm}
\noindent{\small th3a2-compact.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-A2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/a2/th3a2-compact.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{subseq-\allowbreak{}ptwise-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, i, p, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(g, i), p) \wedge ((b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = g(i(n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, b, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ptwise-\allowbreak{}subseq-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, i, p, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, b, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(n) = g(i(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(g, i), p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}bolzano-\allowbreak{}weierstrass-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(h(i)) \leq d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{C}. \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q(\mathit{nq}) = h(a(\mathit{nq}))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, q, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}block-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), b \in \mathrm{Inf}(\mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \forall i. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \exists p \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(\operatorname{subseq}(h, i), a), p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \beta \in \mathrm{Inf}(\mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\beta \subseteq b) \wedge \exists p \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}along}(s, h, \beta, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diagonal-\allowbreak{}subseq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, i. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \exists p \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(\operatorname{subseq}(f(k), i), a), p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists p \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(f(k), b), p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}subseq-\allowbreak{}hyp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, f, g, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lVert f(q) \rVert \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(n) = t(f(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w), \operatorname{subseq}(\operatorname{subseq}(g, i), a), p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to L({v}, {w})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, a(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists q \in \mathbb{N}. \forall \mathit{xq} \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lVert \mathit{xq} \rVert \leq 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(w)(t(\mathit{xq}), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(a(q)(\mathit{xq}))) \rVert \leq s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, {t}^{*}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rank-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle \cdot \mid {a} \rangle {b}(x) = \operatorname{act}(w)(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, a), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rank-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle \cdot \mid {a} \rangle {b} \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rank-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle \cdot \mid {a} \rangle {b} \in L({v}, {w}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ipms-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, c, d, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(w))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(w))(\operatorname{act}(w)(c, x), \operatorname{act}(w)(d, x)) = (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((c - d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rank-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, \langle \cdot \mid {a} \rangle {b}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \simeq k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{tsbx\_}, \operatorname{tsby\_}] \in (k \times k).\; \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{tsbx\_}, \operatorname{tsby\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \simeq \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \simeq (\lambda x \in k.\; \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{tsbc\_}, \operatorname{tsbx\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times k).\; \operatorname{act}(v)(\operatorname{tsbc\_}, \operatorname{tsbx\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}ip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)} \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{tsbx\_}, \operatorname{tsby\_}] \in (k \times k).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{tsbx\_}, \operatorname{tsby\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge ((a \in k) \wedge (b \in k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k))(a, b) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (a \in k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k))(a) \simeq \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, c, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (a \in k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k))(c, a) \simeq \operatorname{act}(v)(c, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge ((a \in k) \wedge (b \in k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)}(a, b) \simeq \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cips}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (a \in k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lVert a \rVert \simeq \lVert a \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge ((a \in k) \wedge (b \in k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)))(a, b) = \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v))(a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}hilbert}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k.\; (t(x) \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(t, k) \in L({\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)}, {\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k)}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k.\; (t(x) \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k), \operatorname{restrict}(t, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k.\; (t(x) \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k), \operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, k), \operatorname{restrict}(t, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, t.; \forall x \in {k}^{\perp}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k.\; (t(x) \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t(x) \in {k}^{\perp} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k.\; (t(x) \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, {k}^{\perp}), \operatorname{restrict}(t, {k}^{\perp})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}cips-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}hilbert}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}cips}(v, {k}^{\perp})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sq-\allowbreak{}eigen-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, z, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad t(t(z)) = \operatorname{act}(v)((m \cdot m), z) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}eigenvalue}(v, t, l) \wedge ((l = m) \vee (l = -m))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}finsum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(a, b, h) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (g(z) = h(f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(\operatorname{finsum}(a, f, s)) = \operatorname{finsum}(b, g, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{eval-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(w)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda t \in L({v}, {w}).\; t(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, s, p, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in s.\; (p(y) \in L({v}, {w})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), p, s)(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(w)), (\lambda k \in s.\; p(k)(x)), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}rank-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}rank\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/th3a3-spectral.scm}{theorem-library/th3a3-spectral.scm}
\noindent{\small th3a3-spectral.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-A3), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/a3/th3a3-spectral.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{opnorm-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad e \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lVert x \rVert \leq 1) \wedge ((\lVert {t} \rVert - e) < \lVert t(x) \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}defect-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, x, r, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \lVert x \rVert \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq k \wedge \\ \quad (((2 \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert) \cdot (\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert)) \cdot k) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad (\lVert {t} \rVert - ((r \cdot r) \cdot k)) < \lVert t(x) \rVert \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(t(t(x)), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)((\lVert {t} \rVert \cdot \lVert {t} \rVert), x))) \rVert \leq r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{opnorm-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \lVert {t} \rVert \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \lVert g(n) \rVert \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lVert {t} \rVert - ((\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \cdot k)) < \lVert t(g(n)) \rVert \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \lVert {t} \rVert < (2 \cdot \lVert t(g(n)) \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}eigenvalue}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (t = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}eigenvalue}(v, t, l) \wedge ((l = \lVert {t} \rVert) \vee (l = -\lVert {t} \rVert)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}eigenvector}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}eigenvalue}(v, t, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}eigen-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t.; \forall x \in {\{z \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; (z \in N_{c}({t}))\}}^{\perp}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x = \operatorname{vzero}(v) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/zero-order-laws.scm}{theorem-library/zero-order-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small zero-order-laws.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch6/zero-order-laws.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, 0) \Leftrightarrow \neg (f(a) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pow-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{power}((x - c), d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; (x - c)), c, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g, a, m, n.; \forall k \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, g, a, n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; (k(y) = (f(y) \cdot g(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, k, a, (m + n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}higher}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, m.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \wedge ((m < n) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg \forall y \in u.\; (f(y) = (\operatorname{power}((y - a), n) \cdot k(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, m, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, n)) \Rightarrow (m = n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(u, f, a) = m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{count-\allowbreak{}hits-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s, z.\; (\operatorname{count\text{-}hits}(s, z, n) \in \mathbb{N})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}orders-\allowbreak{}coefficients}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, q) \wedge \forall x \in u.\; (f(x) = (\operatorname{power}((x - c), n) \cdot q(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}orders-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, q) \wedge \forall x \in u.\; (f(x) = (\operatorname{power}((x - c), n) \cdot q(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge ((\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (f(z) = 0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \exists w \in u.\; \neg (f(w) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch3b-const.scm}{theorem-library/ch3b-const.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3b-const.scm -- complex-analysis.pdf ch. 3: two holomorphic logarithms of the same function differ by a constant 2 pi i n on a connected open set, and the uniqueness of the principal branch of log (Cor 3.24).  Agent ISOM (brief CH3-B), 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}mag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(a))) < s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{exp-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\exp a = \exp b) \Rightarrow (\exp (a - b) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{exp-\allowbreak{}equal-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, h.; \forall p, q \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = \exp h(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (g(p) - h(p)) = (g(q) - h(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{exp-\allowbreak{}equal-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}i}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, h.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = \exp h(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (g(z) = (h(z) + (n \cdot ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}branch}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad g(1) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \quad \exp g(z) = z \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(z) = \log\left(z\right) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}exists-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \exists g. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad g(1) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \quad \exp g(z) = z \wedge \\ \forall g.; \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad g(1) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \quad \exp g(z) = z \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(z) = \log\left(z\right) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch3b-log.scm}{theorem-library/ch3b-log.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3b-log.scm -- complex-analysis.pdf: logarithms and n-th roots of a nonvanishing holomorphic function on a CONVEX open set (the convex forms of Prop 3.22 and Cor 3.25), and Lemma 6.19 (a nowhere-zero entire function is an exponential).  Agent ISOM (brief CH3-B), 2026-10-26.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}connected-\allowbreak{}constant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall p, q \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z, 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(p) = f(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{exp-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, w \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{power}(\exp w, n) = \exp (n \cdot w))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall g, h.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp h(z) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (g(z) = (h(z) + (n \cdot ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(\mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{entire-\allowbreak{}nonvanishing-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}exp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, g) \wedge \forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (f(z) = \exp g(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge (\forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}convex-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n, g, h.; \forall b \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(h(z), n) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(a, n) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) = (a \cdot g(z)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4a-circle.scm}{theorem-library/ch4a-circle.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4a-circle.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4a/ch4a-circle.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{power}((w - c), k)), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{recip}((w - c))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (0 < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), ((j + 1) + 1))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4a-coef.scm}{theorem-library/ch4a-coef.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4a-coef.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4a/ch4a-coef.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}before}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (j = n) \Rightarrow (t(j) = 0)) \wedge (k \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(t, k) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}after}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (j = n) \Rightarrow (t(j) = 0)) \wedge (n < m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(t, m) = t(n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}single-\allowbreak{}term}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (j = n) \Rightarrow (t(j) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(t, t(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{C}, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (x = 0) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{power}(x, j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(x), j)) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{C}, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (x = 0) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{power}(x, j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(x), (j + 1))) = \operatorname{recip}(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}excess}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{C}, j, t \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (x = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{power}(x, j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(x), (((j + 1) + 1) + t))) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(x), ((t + 1) + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}x-\allowbreak{}excess}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{C}, m, t \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (x = 0) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{power}(x, (m + t)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(x), m)) = \operatorname{power}(x, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}monomial-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (0 < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{power}((w - c), j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (j + 1)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}monomial-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, j, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge \neg (m = (j + 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{power}((w - c), j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), m))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lc-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}mid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq o) \wedge (o < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((o < t) \wedge (t < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}termwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, c, a, b.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), o \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{lczf}, \mathit{lcwf} \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq o \wedge \\ \quad o < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \mathit{lczf}, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{lczf}(x)) \leq o) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \mathit{lcwf}, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{lczf}(w), k)))) \cdot \operatorname{lcwf}(w))) \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{lczf}(w), k)))) \cdot \operatorname{lcwf}(w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{lck} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(\mathit{lck}) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{lczf}(w), \mathit{lck}) \cdot \operatorname{lcwf}(w))), m, c, a, b))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda \mathit{lck} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(\mathit{lck}) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{lczf}(w), \mathit{lck}) \cdot \operatorname{lcwf}(w))), m, c, a, b))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{lczf}(w), k)))) \cdot \operatorname{lcwf}(w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad m, c, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coefficients}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{lcc} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}), c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{lcc}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{recip}(r) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{lcc}(-(k + 1)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lcc}(n) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(\mathit{lcc}, c, w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (n + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lcc}(-(n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(\mathit{lcc}, c, w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), n))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cps-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), c, q, x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge ((0 < q) \wedge (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(k)) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(q), k))) \wedge (x < q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/catools-nthlocal.scm}{theorem-library/catools-nthlocal.scm}
\noindent{\small catools-nthlocal.scm -- derivatives are local; Cauchy's estimates as the notes state them (CA-TOOLS, 2026-10-26).  Destination: theorem-library/catools-nthlocal.scm, library complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nth-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, u, f, v.; \forall z \in v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge (v \subseteq u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{restrict}(f, v)^{(k)}(z) \\ \quad \quad =\; f^{(k)}(z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cauchy-\allowbreak{}estimates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, m \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f^{(k)}(c)) \leq (\operatorname{factorial}(k) \cdot (m \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}seminorms-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u))(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)))(a, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)))(b))) \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)))(a, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)))(b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hol-\allowbreak{}fns-\allowbreak{}frechet}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}}
