\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}acc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}({v} \oplus {w}) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}acc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}({v} \oplus {w}) \simeq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}acc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}({v} \oplus {w}) \simeq \operatorname{hsum\text{-}vadd}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}acc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}({v} \oplus {w}) \simeq [\operatorname{vzero}(v), \operatorname{vzero}(w)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}acc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}({v} \oplus {w}) \simeq \operatorname{hsum\text{-}vneg}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}acc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}({v} \oplus {w}) \simeq \operatorname{hsum\text{-}act}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}acc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{{v} \oplus {w}} \simeq \operatorname{hsum\text{-}ip}(v, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{{v} \oplus {w}}([a, b], [c, d]) = (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(a, c) + \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(b, d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}({v} \oplus {w})([a, b], [c, d]) = [\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, c), \operatorname{vadd}(w)(b, d)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}({v} \oplus {w})([a, b]) = [\operatorname{vneg}(v)(a), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(b)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, k, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}({v} \oplus {w})(k, [a, b]) = [\operatorname{act}(v)(k, a), \operatorname{act}(w)(k, b)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hsum\text{-}vadd}(v, w) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (((\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w)) \times (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w))) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hsum\text{-}vneg}(v, w) \in ((\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w)) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hsum\text{-}act}(v, w) \in ((\mathbb{C} \times (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w))) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hsum\text{-}ip}(v, w) \in (((\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w)) \times (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(w))) \to \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {v} \oplus {w} \in \mathbf{Set} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{relation-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}ext}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c. \\ \quad b \subseteq (s \times a) \wedge \\ \quad c \subseteq (s \times a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ugc} \in s, d \in a.\; (([\mathit{ugc}, d] \in b) \Leftrightarrow ([\mathit{ugc}, d] \in c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{relation-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c. \\ \quad ((b \subseteq (s \times a)) \wedge \forall \mathit{ugc} \in s, d \in a.\; (([\mathit{ugc}, d] \in b) \Rightarrow ([\mathit{ugc}, d] \in c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad b \subseteq c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {g}^{*} \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}j-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad J{g} \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {g}^{-1} \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad C({g}) \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}^{\perp} \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow ({g}^{*} \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}j-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, g.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (J{g} \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow ({g}^{-1} \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}graph-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (C({g}) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow ({s}^{\perp} \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}j-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ([a, b] \in J{g}) \Leftrightarrow ([b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)] \in g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ([a, b] \in {g}^{-1}) \Leftrightarrow ([b, a] \in g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [a, b] \in {g}^{*} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c, d \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad ([c, d] \in g) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(c, b) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(d, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [a, b] \in {s}^{\perp} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c, d \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad ([c, d] \in s) \Rightarrow ((\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(a, c) + \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(b, d)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x, y.\; (((x \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((x + -y) = 0))) \Rightarrow (x = y))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}j-\allowbreak{}perp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {g}^{*} = J{{g}^{\perp}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}j}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {g}^{*} = {J{g}}^{\perp} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}via-\allowbreak{}j}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {g}^{*} = {J{g}}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \quad {g}^{*} = J{{g}^{\perp}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k)}^{\perp} = {k}^{\perp} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{perp-\allowbreak{}perp-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {{k}^{\perp}}^{\perp} = \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ([c, d] \in g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(+i, c), d), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(-+i, c), d)] \in C({g}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, c, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (d \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(+i, c), d) \rVert = \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{act}(v)(-+i, c), d) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(c, d) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(d, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}isometric-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}symmetric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}graph}(v, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}isometric\text{-}graph}(v, C({g})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}symmetric-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}isometric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}graph}(v, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}isometric\text{-}graph}(v, C({g})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}graph}(v, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}symmetric-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}isometric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}graph}(v, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}symmetric\text{-}graph}(v, g) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}isometric\text{-}graph}(v, C({g})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, h, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad h \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [a, b] \in C({h}) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; [\operatorname{act}(v)(-+i, \operatorname{act}(v)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b)))), \operatorname{act}(v)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b))] \\ \quad \quad \in\; h \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad C({{g}^{*}}) = {{C({g})}^{*}}^{-1} \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{compact-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}margin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u. \\ \quad ((k \subseteq u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists e.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge \forall z \in k.\; (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, e) \subseteq u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pasting-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, a, x, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), t, \operatorname{restrict}(f, a), y) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{cmb} \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, \mathit{cmb}) \leq d) \wedge (\mathit{cmb} \in a)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{dist}(t)(f(x), f(\mathit{cmb})) \leq b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pasting-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, f, a, b.; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((x \in a) \vee (x \in b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), t, \operatorname{restrict}(f, a), y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in b.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, b), t, \operatorname{restrict}(f, b), y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, t, f, z) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}radial-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, y \in \mathbb{C}, s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq s) \wedge (s \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((c + (s \cdot (y - c))) - c)) = (s \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((y - c))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((y - (c + (s \cdot (y - c))))) = ((1 - s) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((y - c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (0 < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{closed-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}margin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \subseteq u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mvr} \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((r < \mathit{mvr}) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{mvr}) \subseteq u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}has-\allowbreak{}mean-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}property}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, f.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}maximum-\allowbreak{}modulus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(a) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/good-approx.scm}{theorem-library/good-approx.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3c-ga.scm -- Proposition 3.12 of complex-analysis.pdf: the integrals of a holomorphic f agree along a good approximation.  Prefix cg-.  Library: complex-analysis. Destination: theorem-library/good-approx.scm, after ch3c-vocab (structure-library/ca-homotopy-vocab).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s, c, e. \\ \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, e).\; (p(w) \in s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{restrict}(p, \operatorname{ccint}(c, e)), c, e) \subseteq s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}primitive-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, s, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(s) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad z \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (s \to \mathbb{C}). \forall p, d, c, e. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, d, c, e) \wedge (\operatorname{trace}(p, c, e) \subseteq s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, d, c, e) = (g(p(e)) - g(p(c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{good-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}piece}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, s, m, c, o, d, a, b, \mathit{cgc}, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(s) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(o, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{cgc} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad e \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a \leq \mathit{cgc} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{cgc} < e \wedge \\ \quad e \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{cgc}, e).\; ((m(w) \in s) \wedge (o(w) \in s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{cgc}, e)), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{cgc}, e)), \mathit{cgc}, e) - \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(o, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{cgc}, e)), \operatorname{restrict}(d, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{cgc}, e)), \mathit{cgc}, e)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, o(e), m(e)) - \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, o(\mathit{cgc}), m(\mathit{cgc}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{restricted-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b, \mathit{cgc}, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{cgc} \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad e \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < \mathit{cgc} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{cgc} < e \wedge \\ \quad e \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(a, e)), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(a, e)), a, e) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(a, \mathit{cgc})), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(a, \mathit{cgc})), a, \mathit{cgc}) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{cgc}, e)), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{cgc}, e)), \mathit{cgc}, e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{increasing-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}from-\allowbreak{}start}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, n, q. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k < n) \Rightarrow (q(k) < q((k + 1)))) \wedge (j \leq n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (q(0) \leq q(j)) \wedge ((1 \leq j) \Rightarrow (q(0) < q(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{increasing-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, j, n, q. \\ \quad j \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k < n) \Rightarrow (q(k) < q((k + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad j \leq m \wedge \\ \quad m \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad q(j) \leq q(m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{good-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, u, f, m, c, o, d, a, b, n, q, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(o, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(o, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad o(a) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad q(0) = a \wedge \\ \quad q(n) = b \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hmk} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{hmk} < n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad q(\mathit{hmk}) < q((\mathit{hmk} + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s(\mathit{hmk})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(s(\mathit{hmk})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad s(\mathit{hmk}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ccint}(q(\mathit{hmk}), q((\mathit{hmk} + 1))).\; ((m(w) \in s(\mathit{hmk})) \wedge (o(w) \in s(\mathit{hmk}))) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq k \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(m, \operatorname{ccint}(a, q(k))), \operatorname{restrict}(c, \operatorname{ccint}(a, q(k))), a, q(k)) - \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{restrict}(o, \operatorname{ccint}(a, q(k))), \operatorname{restrict}(d, \operatorname{ccint}(a, q(k))), a, q(k))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, o(q(k)), m(q(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{good-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, o, d, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(o, d, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, m, o, a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, o, d, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{const-\allowbreak{}road}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, a, b. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}((\lambda q \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; c), (\lambda q \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; 0), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{const-\allowbreak{}road-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge ((c \in u) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a < b))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, (\lambda q \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; c), (\lambda q \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; 0), a, b) = 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/poly-road.scm}{theorem-library/poly-road.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3c-poly.scm -- polygonal roads on a partition, and Example 3.11 of complex-analysis.pdf. Prefix cp-.  Library: complex-analysis.  Destination: theorem-library/poly-road.scm. Loads after ch3c-vocab (AFF-SEG, AFF-DER, POLY-ROAD, POLY-DER) and ch3c-ga.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{aff-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}road}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, c, d. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c < d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{aff\text{-}seg}(p, q, c, d), \operatorname{aff\text{-}der}(p, q, c, d), c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{aff-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}ends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, c, d. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c < d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{aff\text{-}seg}(p, q, c, d)(c) = p) \wedge (\operatorname{aff\text{-}seg}(p, q, c, d)(d) = q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{aff-\allowbreak{}seg-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, c, d, s, z. \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c < d \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(s) \wedge \\ \quad p \in s \wedge \\ \quad q \in s \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{ccint}(c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{aff\text{-}seg}(p, q, c, d)(z) \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}road-\allowbreak{}facts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, n, q, a. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cgk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{cgk} < n) \Rightarrow (q(\mathit{cgk}) < q((\mathit{cgk} + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad m < n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, a, m), \operatorname{poly\text{-}der}(q, a, m), q(0), q((m + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, h \in \operatorname{ccint}(q(k), q((k + 1))). \\ \quad \quad \quad (k \leq m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, a, m)(h) \simeq \operatorname{aff\text{-}seg}(a(k), a((k + 1)), q(k), q((k + 1)))(h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}piece-\allowbreak{}locate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, n, q.; \forall h \in \operatorname{ccint}(q(0), q((m + 1))). \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cgk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{cgk} < n) \Rightarrow (q(\mathit{cgk}) < q((\mathit{cgk} + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad m < n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k \leq m) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{ccint}(q(k), q((k + 1))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{good-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}polygon}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, a, b, m, q, d, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}path}(c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(c, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad q(0) = a \wedge \\ \quad q((m + 1)) = b \wedge \\ \quad d(0) = c(a) \wedge \\ \quad d((m + 1)) = c(b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (k < (m + 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad q(k) < q((k + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(s(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad s(k) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad d(k) \in s(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad d((k + 1)) \in s(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ccint}(q(k), q((k + 1))).\; (c(w) \in s(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, d, m), \operatorname{poly\text{-}der}(q, d, m), a, b) \wedge \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, c, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, d, m), a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{path-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, a, b, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}path}(m, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lvert (x - y) \rvert \leq d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(x) - m(y))) \leq e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uniform-\allowbreak{}grid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, d. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((a < b) \wedge (0 < d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}, h \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < h) \wedge ((h \leq d) \wedge ((a + ((m + 1) \cdot h)) = b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polygonal-\allowbreak{}good-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}path}(m, a, b) \wedge (\operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r, q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(r, q, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, m, r, a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, b, m, q, c, s. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad q(0) = a \wedge \\ \quad q((m + 1)) = b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (k < (m + 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad ((q(k) < q((k + 1))) \wedge ((\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c(k), s) \subseteq u) \wedge (c((k + 1)) \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c(k), s)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, c, m), a, b) \subseteq u \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/homotopy.scm}{theorem-library/homotopy.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3c-hom.scm -- homotopy (complex-analysis.pdf 3.3.2): 3.16, 3.17, 3.18, 3.20, 3.31 (and 3.15). Prefix ch-.  Library: complex-analysis.  Destination: theorem-library/homotopy.scm. The rectangle [0, 1] x [a, b] is Q(a, b) = PRODUCT2-MS(SUBSPACE-MS(RR-MS, [0, 1]), SUBSPACE-MS(RR-MS, [a, b])).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rect-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, y, z. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad y \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad z \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)), \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b))))(y, z) \simeq \operatorname{max}(\lvert (\operatorname{nth}(1, y) - \operatorname{nth}(1, z)) \rvert, \lvert (\operatorname{nth}(2, y) - \operatorname{nth}(2, z)) \rvert)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rect-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, x. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad f \in ((\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\lvert (\operatorname{nth}(1, x) - \operatorname{nth}(1, y)) \rvert \leq d) \wedge (\lvert (\operatorname{nth}(2, x) - \operatorname{nth}(2, y)) \rvert \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((f(x) - f(y))) \leq e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)), \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rect-\allowbreak{}unif}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f, e. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad f \in ((\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)), \operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{ccint}(a, b))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y, z \in (\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1) \times \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\lvert (\operatorname{nth}(1, y) - \operatorname{nth}(1, z)) \rvert \leq d) \wedge (\lvert (\operatorname{nth}(2, y) - \operatorname{nth}(2, z)) \rvert \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((f(y) - f(z))) \leq e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopic-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}path}(m, a, b) \wedge (\operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, m, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopic-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, o, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, o, a, b) \Rightarrow \operatorname{homotopic}(u, o, m, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopic-\allowbreak{}trans}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, o, q, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, o, a, b) \wedge \operatorname{homotopic}(u, o, q, a, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, q, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}comb-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((f \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (g \in \mathbb{R})))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((a + (f \cdot (b - a))) - (c + (g \cdot (d - c)))) = ((a - c) + ((g \cdot ((b - a) - (d - c))) + ((f - g) \cdot (b - a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, w. \\ \quad ((s \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) \wedge (w \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s \cdot w)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}change-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (d \in \mathbb{C})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((a - b) - (c - d))) \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}((a - c)) + \operatorname{magnitude}((b - d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \mathbb{C}, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall c \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\lvert c \rvert \leq d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((c \cdot w)) \leq e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{good-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}homotopic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, o, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, m, o, a, b) \Rightarrow \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, o, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{good-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}balls}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, a, b, m, q, d, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}path}(c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(c, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad q(0) = a \wedge \\ \quad q((m + 1)) = b \wedge \\ \quad d(0) = c(a) \wedge \\ \quad d((m + 1)) = c(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (k < (m + 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad q(k) < q((k + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, d(k), s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad d((k + 1)) \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, d(k), s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ccint}(q(k), q((k + 1))).\; (c(w) \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, d(k), s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, d, m), \operatorname{poly\text{-}der}(q, d, m), a, b) \wedge \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, c, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, d, m), a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopy-\allowbreak{}polygon-\allowbreak{}chain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, o, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, o, a, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{chm}, n \in \mathbb{N}, q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), \mathit{chxq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (j \leq (n + 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, \operatorname{chxq}(j), \mathit{chm}), \operatorname{poly\text{-}der}(q, \operatorname{chxq}(j), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, m, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, \operatorname{chxq}(0), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (j \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, \operatorname{chxq}(j), \mathit{chm}), \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, \operatorname{chxq}((j + 1)), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, o, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(q, \operatorname{chxq}((n + 1)), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopy-\allowbreak{}chain-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, u, f, m, c, a, b, \mathit{chm}, n, \mathit{chtq}, \mathit{chxq}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (j \leq (n + 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(\mathit{chtq}, \operatorname{chxq}(j), \mathit{chm}), \operatorname{poly\text{-}der}(\mathit{chtq}, \operatorname{chxq}(j), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, m, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(\mathit{chtq}, \operatorname{chxq}(0), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (j \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{good\text{-}approx}(u, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(\mathit{chtq}, \operatorname{chxq}(j), \mathit{chm}), \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(\mathit{chtq}, \operatorname{chxq}((j + 1)), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \wedge \\ \quad q \leq (n + 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{poly\text{-}road}(\mathit{chtq}, \operatorname{chxq}(q), \mathit{chm}), \operatorname{poly\text{-}der}(\mathit{chtq}, \operatorname{chxq}(q), \mathit{chm}), a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopy-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, o, d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(o, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, o, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, o, d, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{null-\allowbreak{}homotopic-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, m, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopic-\allowbreak{}traces}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, o, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, o, a, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u) \wedge (\operatorname{trace}(o, a, b) \subseteq u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homotopy-\allowbreak{}winding}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, m, c, o, d, a, b. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(o, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{homotopic}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(z)), m, o, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, z) = \operatorname{winding}(o, d, a, b, z) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4a-straight.scm}{theorem-library/ch4a-straight.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4a-straight.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4a/ch4a-straight.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{straight-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}homotopic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, o, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}path}(m, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}path}(o, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad o(a) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad o(b) = m(b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b), s \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1).\; ((m(t) + (s \cdot (o(t) - m(t)))) \in u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{homotopic}(u, m, o, a, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4a-annulus.scm}{theorem-library/ch4a-annulus.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4a-annulus.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4a/ch4a-annulus.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}values}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a, b, s. \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; (p(t) \in s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{trace}(p, a, b) \subseteq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lerp-\allowbreak{}between}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((x \leq y) \wedge ((0 \leq m) \wedge (m \leq 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x \leq (y + (m \cdot (x - y)))) \wedge ((y + (m \cdot (x - y))) \leq y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}interval-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq p) \wedge ((p \leq 1) \wedge ((0 \leq q) \wedge (q \leq 1)))) \Rightarrow ((0 \leq (p \cdot q)) \wedge ((p \cdot q) \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{annulus-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad ((a \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow (z \in u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4a-expansion.scm}{theorem-library/ch4a-expansion.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4a-expansion.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4a/ch4a-expansion.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in u, q \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) = r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), q, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; ((f(x) - f(z)) = (q(x) \cdot (x - z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(q, \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) + (f(z) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda \mathit{wnw} \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(z)).\; \operatorname{recip}((\mathit{wnw} - z))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}difference}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a, b \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{lxb} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad ((a \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{lxb} \in u) \wedge \\ \quad a < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot f(z) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) - \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}expansion-\allowbreak{}annulus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a, b \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{lxb} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad ((a \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{lxb} \in u) \wedge \\ \quad a < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((z - c)), (k + 1))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - w)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot f(z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) + \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - w)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}free}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a, b \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{lxb} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad ((a \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{lxb} \in u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}expansion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a, b, o \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a < o \wedge \\ \quad o < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{lxb} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad ((a \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{lxb} \in u) \wedge \\ \quad a < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o), c, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, s), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, s), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, s), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, s), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot s) \cdot (m \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(s), (k + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, s), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, s), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, s), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot s) \cdot (m \cdot \operatorname{power}(s, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coefs-\allowbreak{}radii}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{C}.\; (((0 < \operatorname{magnitude}((b - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((b - c)) < r)) \Rightarrow (b \in u)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (p < r) \Rightarrow (p < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(m) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coefs-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o) \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}integrands}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}sup-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o, m \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k)) \leq ((o \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(o), (k + 1))) \cdot m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1))) \leq ((o \cdot \operatorname{power}(o, k)) \cdot m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g, h.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) \simeq (f(z) + g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(k) = (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k) + \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(g, c, o)(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(-(k + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1)) + \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(g, c, o)(-(k + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbb{C}, u, f, h.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) \simeq (s \cdot f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(k) = (s \cdot \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(-(k + 1)) = (s \cdot \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}punctured-\allowbreak{}expansion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r, o \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r), f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, a, o), a, z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}punctured-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, f \in (\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r).\; (f(x) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(c, a, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((p < r) \Rightarrow (p < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k))))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}(m) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(-(k + 1))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}punctured-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (f \in (\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r) \to \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r), f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists c \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((p < r) \Rightarrow (p < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (0 < m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}(m) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(-(k + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r).\; (f(x) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(c, a, x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{lk-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \\ \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda z \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}lin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}, q \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda z \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(z))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, a, o)(q))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(L({v})) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(L({v})) \simeq \operatorname{bh\text{-}vneg}(v)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(L({v})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}sn-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}module}) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}))}}
