\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sot\text{-}pf}(v) \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sot\text{-}pf}(v)(x)(t) = \lVert t(x) \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), \operatorname{sot\text{-}pf}(v)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}separating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{sot\text{-}pf}(v)(x)(t) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), \operatorname{vec}(v), \operatorname{sot\text{-}pf}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}tvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), L({v})_{s}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v) \in ((\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \to (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, p, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v)(p)(t) = \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(t(\operatorname{nth}(1, p)), \operatorname{nth}(2, p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v)([x, y])(t) = \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(t(x), y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), \operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v)(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}separating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)).\; (\operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v)(p)(t) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)), \operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}tvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), L({v})_{w}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}optop-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{norm\text{-}optop\text{-}pf}(v) \in (\{0\} \to (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{R})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}optop-\allowbreak{}pf-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((k \in \{0\}) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{norm\text{-}optop\text{-}pf}(v)(k)(t) = \lVert {t} \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}optop-\allowbreak{}seminorm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (k \in \{0\})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), \operatorname{norm\text{-}optop\text{-}pf}(v)(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}optop-\allowbreak{}separating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \{0\}.\; (\operatorname{norm\text{-}optop\text{-}pf}(v)(k)(t) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}optop-\allowbreak{}seminorm-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), \{0\}, \operatorname{norm\text{-}optop\text{-}pf}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}optop-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}tvs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, L({v}), L({v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}id-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(L({v}), L({v}), \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(L({v}, {v}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(L({v}), L({v}), (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}{t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(L({v}), L({v}), (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {t}{s})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{norm-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}sot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v}), L({v})_{s}, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(L({v}, {v}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}wot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{s}, L({v})_{w}, \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(L({v}, {v}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}sot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{s}, L({v})_{s}, (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}{t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}right-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}wot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{w}, L({v})_{w}, (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}{t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}sot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{s}, L({v})_{s}, (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {t}{s})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}wot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{w}, L({v})_{w}, (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {t}{s})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vec-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \omega_{{i},{a}} \in (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vec-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \omega_{{i},{a}}(t) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(t(i), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vec-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}linear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(L({v}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}module}, \omega_{{i},{a}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vec-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}wot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{w}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}top}, \omega_{{i},{a}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vec-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}sot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{s}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}top}, \omega_{{i},{a}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{op\text{-}dual}(v, u) \simeq \{f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{C}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(L({v}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}module}, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}top}, f))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weak-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{weak\text{-}dual}(v) \simeq \{f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{C}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(L({v}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}module}, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{w}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}top}, f))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strong-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (L_{\bullet}({v}) \simeq \operatorname{op\text{-}dual}(v, L({v})_{s}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vec-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}weak-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \omega_{{i},{a}} \in \operatorname{weak\text{-}dual}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{vec-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}strong-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \omega_{{i},{a}} \in L_{\bullet}({v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weak-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}strong-\allowbreak{}dual}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{weak\text{-}dual}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in L_{\bullet}({v}) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small ch4b-residues.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4b/ch4b-residues.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{md-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), \\ \quad \quad (\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((v - a)), (j + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{md-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}road-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, j \in \mathbb{N}, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((v - a)), ((j + 1) + 1))), p, q, s, t) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{md-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}exact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), (\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; 0), p, q, s, t) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, g. \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d_{0} \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, q, s, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((z - a)), n) \cdot g(z)) = (h(z) + ((d_{0} \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - a))) + f(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{residue-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}integral}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, d, h, \mathit{mdf}, f.; \forall o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), \mathit{mdf}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mdf}, p, q, s, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - a))) + \operatorname{mdf}(z))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; f(w)), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, o), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(a, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{residue-\allowbreak{}property-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, x, y. \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 < p) \wedge (p < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad x \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, p), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; f(w)), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, p), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(a, p), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 < p) \wedge (p < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, p), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; f(w)), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, p), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(a, p), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{residue-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}property}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a.; \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 < p) \wedge (p < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad x \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, p), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; f(w)), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, p), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(a, p), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}(f, a) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}(f, a) \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mdf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), \mathit{mdf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mdf}, p, q, s, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((\operatorname{residue}(f, a) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - a))) + \operatorname{mdf}(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fun-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, f, z, t.\; (((f \in (a \to b)) \wedge (f(z) = t)) \Rightarrow (z \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{residue-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, d, h, \mathit{mdf}, f. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), \mathit{mdf}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mdf}, p, q, s, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - a))) + \operatorname{mdf}(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}(f, a) = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{residue-\allowbreak{}theorem-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s.; \forall b \in u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, (s \cup \{b\})), f) \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, b, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(b)), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(b))) \wedge (p(t) = p(\mathit{mds})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, b, r), \operatorname{singleton}(b)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - b))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in s. \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e)), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e))) \wedge (p(t) = p(\mathit{mds})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), \operatorname{singleton}(e)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - e))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall e \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e)), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e))) \wedge (p(t) = p(\mathit{mds})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), \operatorname{singleton}(e)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad g(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - e))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}(g, e) = \operatorname{residue}(f, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, (s \cup \{b\})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad p(t) = p(\mathit{mds}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(g, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) + ((((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot \operatorname{residue}(f, b)) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rt-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \simeq \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{residue-\allowbreak{}theorem-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, e \in \mathbf{Set}, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |e| = n \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, e), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mqe} \in e. \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{mqe}, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{mqe})), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{mqe}))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, s, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{mqe}, r), \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{mqe})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - \mathit{mqe}))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, e) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, q, s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{residue}(f, x) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{residue-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall e \in \mathbf{Set}, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |e| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, e), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mqe} \in e.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, \mathit{mqe}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, e) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, q, s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{residue}(f, x) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad e) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4b-mero.scm}{theorem-library/ch4b-mero.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4b-mero.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4b/ch4b-mero.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}modulus}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), y \in u. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall b \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((b - y)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(b) - g(y))) \leq s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{riemann-\allowbreak{}removable-\allowbreak{}singularity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, a) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pole-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}meromorphic-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, a, n.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, a, n) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{removable-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}meromorphic-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}cases}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, a) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, a, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{casorati-\allowbreak{}weierstrass}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in u, f.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, v \in \mathbb{C}, e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}essential\text{-}singularity}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad 0 < e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < r) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - v)) < e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}poles-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, f, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in s.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, e) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |(s \cap k)| \in \mathbb{N} \end{array}}}

The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. union-subset-both}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{union-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}both}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, c.\; (((a \subseteq c) \wedge (b \subseteq c)) \Rightarrow ((a \cup b) \subseteq c))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/esum-tonelli.scm}{theorem-library/esum-tonelli.scm}
\noindent{\small esum-tonelli.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-B), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/b/th3b-esum.scm. Library: measure.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, f, g. \\ \quad ((f \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge ((g \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \forall z \in d.\; (f(z) \leq g(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(f) \leq \operatorname{esum}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}superadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (\operatorname{eplus}(f(z), g(z)) \leq h(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{esum}(f), \operatorname{esum}(g)) \leq \operatorname{esum}(h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, b, g, t, a.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad g \in (x \to (b \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (b \to (x \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in x, j \in b.\; (t(j)(i) = g(i)(j)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (x \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in x.\; (a(i) = \operatorname{esum}(g(i))) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq x \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, a, s) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda \mathit{tbj} \in b.\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, t(\mathit{tbj}), s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}swap-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, c, g, t, a, b. \\ \quad g \in (x \to (c \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (c \to (x \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in x, j \in c.\; (t(j)(i) = g(i)(j)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (x \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in x.\; (a(i) = \operatorname{esum}(g(i))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (c \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in c.\; (b(j) = \operatorname{esum}(t(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(a) \leq \operatorname{esum}(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, c, g, t, a, b. \\ \quad g \in (x \to (c \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (c \to (x \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in x, j \in c.\; (t(j)(i) = g(i)(j)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (x \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in x.\; (a(i) = \operatorname{esum}(g(i))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (c \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in c.\; (b(j) = \operatorname{esum}(t(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(a) = \operatorname{esum}(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}subadditive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (h(z) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(f(z), g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}(h) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{esum}(f), \operatorname{esum}(g)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/hilbert-schmidt.scm}{theorem-library/hilbert-schmidt.scm}
\noindent{\small hilbert-schmidt.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-B), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/b/th3b-hs.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w.; \forall t \in L({v}, {w}), x, e, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(w, a, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in x.\; (\lVert t(e(k)) \rVert \cdot \lVert t(e(k)) \rVert))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda k \in a.\; (\lVert {t}^{*}(f(k)) \rVert \cdot \lVert {t}^{*}(f(k)) \rVert))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}independent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w.; \forall t \in L({v}, {w}), x, e, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 = \sum_{i \in {a}} \lVert {t} {b}_i \rVert^2 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w.; \forall t \in L({v}, {w}), x, e, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(w, a, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \sum_{i \in {a}} \lVert {{t}^{*}} {f}_i \rVert^2 = \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}any-\allowbreak{}basis}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, x, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(w, v, {t}^{*}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{canon-\allowbreak{}onb-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}onb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, \operatorname{canon\text{-}onb}(v), (\lambda e \in \operatorname{canon\text{-}onb}(v).\; e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}any-\allowbreak{}basis}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w.; \forall t \in L({v}, {w}), x, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lVert {t} \rVert_{HS} \simeq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2}) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vzero}(v)) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{vzero}(v)) = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(v)(0, x) = \operatorname{vzero}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(v))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(v)(1, x) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trunc-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x, e, t, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad e \in (x \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \subseteq x \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in q.\; \langle \cdot \mid {e(k)} \rangle {t(e(k))}), q) \\ \quad \quad \in\; K({v}, {w}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trunc-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x, e, t, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad e \in (x \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \subseteq x \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in q.\; \langle \cdot \mid {e(k)} \rangle {t(e(k))}), q) \\ \quad \quad \in\; L({v}, {w}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trunc-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x, e, t, q, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \subseteq x \wedge \\ \quad z \in q \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), (\lambda k \in q.\; \langle \cdot \mid {e(k)} \rangle {t(e(k))}), q)(e(z)) \\ \quad \quad =\; t(e(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trunc-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}basis-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x, e, t, q, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \subseteq x \wedge \\ \quad z \in x \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z \in q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), (\lambda k \in q.\; \langle \cdot \mid {e(k)} \rangle {t(e(k))}), q)(e(z)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vzero}(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, x, e, t, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}family}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \subseteq x \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {{t} + {-{\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), (\lambda k \in q.\; \langle \cdot \mid {e(k)} \rangle {t(e(k))}), q)}}} {e}_i \rVert^2 \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda z \in x.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \left(\text{if }(z \in q)\text{ then }0\text{ else }(\lambda \mathit{kqk} \in x.\; (\lVert t(e(\mathit{kqk})) \rVert \cdot \lVert t(e(\mathit{kqk})) \rVert))(z)\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, x, e, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |q| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad q \subseteq x \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{xq} \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lVert \mathit{xq} \rVert \leq 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(w)(t(\mathit{xq}), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{bop\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v, w)), (\lambda k \in q.\; \langle \cdot \mid {e(k)} \rangle {t(e(k))}), q)(\mathit{xq}))) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, w, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, x, e, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(w, a, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esum}((\lambda \mathit{tbw} \in (x \times a).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(e(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{tbw}))), f(\operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{tbw})))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{w}(t(e(\operatorname{nth}(1, \mathit{tbw}))), f(\operatorname{nth}(2, \mathit{tbw})))))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/th3-eigen-normalized.scm}{theorem-library/th3-eigen-normalized.scm}
\noindent{\small th3-eigen-normalized.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent TH3-SORT), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/th3-1109/sort/th3-eigen-normalized.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sa-\allowbreak{}eigen-\allowbreak{}normalized}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{tnix}, e, m. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, \mathit{tnix}, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad m \in (\mathit{tnix} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathit{tnix}.\; ((m(i) = \operatorname{conjugate}(m(i))) \wedge (t(e(i)) = \operatorname{act}(v)(m(i), e(i)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{sums\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v), (\lambda k \in \mathit{tnix}.\; \operatorname{act}(v)((m(k) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e(k))), e(k))), t(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad |\{i \in \mathit{tnix} : (0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(m(i)))\}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathrm{OS}(|\{i \in \mathit{tnix} : (0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(m(i)))\}|), \{i \in \mathit{tnix} : (0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(m(i)))\}). \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((n + 1) < |\{i \in \mathit{tnix} : (0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(m(i)))\}|) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(m(h((n + 1)))) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(m(h(n))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (|\{i \in \mathit{tnix} : (0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(m(i)))\}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathbb{N}, \{i \in \mathit{tnix} : (0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(m(i)))\}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(m(h((n + 1)))) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(m(h(n)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(m(h(n))) < d)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/sc-primitive.scm}{theorem-library/sc-primitive.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3d-sc.scm -- CH3-D: consequences of simple connectedness (complex analysis, notes ch. 3). Proposition 3.21: a function holomorphic on a simply connected open set has a primitive. The primitive is F(z) = the integral of f along any road in u from a base point to z: the value does not depend on the road (3.20 on the ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sc-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}independent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, g, a, b, o, h, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, g, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(o, h, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(o, c, d) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad o(c) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad o(d) = m(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, g, a, b) = \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, o, h, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{segment-\allowbreak{}primitive-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m.; \forall w \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r).\; (m(y) = (m(z) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, z, y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, m, w, f(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{road-\allowbreak{}extend-\allowbreak{}segment}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c, z, w, m, d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad m(a) = c \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = z \wedge \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad w \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(z, w), 0, 1) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda}, \mathit{sdb} \in \mathbb{R}, g, \mathit{sdd} \in (\operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{sda}, \mathit{sdb}) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(g, \mathit{sdd}, \mathit{sda}, \mathit{sdb}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(g, \mathit{sda}, \mathit{sdb}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g(\mathit{sda}) = c \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g(\mathit{sdb}) = w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, g, \mathit{sdd}, \mathit{sda}, \mathit{sdb}) = (\operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, d, a, b) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, z, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sc-\allowbreak{}reach}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a.; \forall q \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge (a \in u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{sda}, b \in \mathbb{R}, g, d \in (\operatorname{ccint}(\mathit{sda}, b) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(g, d, \mathit{sda}, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(g, \mathit{sda}, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g(\mathit{sda}) = a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g(b) = q \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, g, d, \mathit{sda}, b) = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sc-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}segment-\allowbreak{}primitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge (a \in u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \forall z \in u. \exists \mathit{sdr}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{sdr}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, \mathit{sdr}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, \mathit{sdr}).\; (r(y) = (r(z) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, z, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sc-\allowbreak{}primitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall o \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z, f(z))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/sc-log-roots.scm}{theorem-library/sc-log-roots.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3d-log.scm -- CH3-D: Proposition 3.22 and Corollary 3.25 on a SIMPLY CONNECTED open set. The proofs are those of the convex forms (scratchpad/ch3b/ch3b-log.scm, agent ISOM), with the primitive of f'/f taken from 3.21 (sc-primitive) instead of cauchy-convex-primitive, and the connectedness of u read off ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}sc-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}sc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall g, h.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp h(z) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (g(z) = (h(z) + (n \cdot ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}sc-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}sc-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n, g, h.; \forall b \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(h(z), n) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(a, n) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) = (a \cdot g(z)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/riemann-reduction.scm}{theorem-library/riemann-reduction.scm}
\noindent{\small ch3d-rm.scm -- CH3-D: Proposition 10.16 and Corollary 10.17 (the reduction step of the Riemann mapping theorem).  An open simply connected u missing a point a carries a bounded simple (injective) holomorphic function, and a simple holomorphic map into the open unit disc whose image contains 0.  The notes take a ball ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sc-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \neg (a \in u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z, w \in u.\; ((h(z) = h(w)) \Rightarrow (z = w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(h(z)) \leq m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sc-\allowbreak{}simple-\allowbreak{}into-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\neg (a \in u) \wedge (v \in u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z, w \in u.\; ((k(z) = k(w)) \Rightarrow (z = w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(k(z)) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists y \in u.\; (k(y) = 0) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/algnum-countable.scm}{theorem-library/algnum-countable.scm}
\noindent{\small theorem-library/algnum-countable.scm -- THE ALGEBRAIC NUMBERS OVER A COUNTABLE SUBRING OF C ARE COUNTABLE (ALGNUM, algebraic-numbers bundle B7, 2026-10-26).  Source: Thayer, algebraic-numbers notes, Cor. 4.23 (the countability half).  Vocabulary: structure-library/algnum-vocab.scm; POLY-2 (poly-fn-vocab.scm, cf-cons-*, ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{complex-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}injective-\allowbreak{}tuple-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to s). \\ \quad \quad \neg \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((i \leq n) \wedge ((j \leq n) \wedge (q(i) = q(j)))) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}roots-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(\{z \in \mathbb{C} : (\neg (c(n) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) = 0))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{polynomials-\allowbreak{}below-\allowbreak{}countable}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}subring}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countable}(\{p \in (\mathbb{N} \to k) : \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (p(\mathit{pfk}) = 0))\}) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{det-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}pencil-\allowbreak{}polynomial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, b, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge ((b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, k)) \wedge (e \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad c(n) = \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), n, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matof}(n, n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{cpi\_}, \operatorname{cpj\_}] \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \times \operatorname{interval}(1, n)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(b, \operatorname{cpi\_}, \operatorname{cpj\_}) + (z \cdot \operatorname{entry}(e, \operatorname{cpi\_}, \operatorname{cpj\_}))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{am-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}kills-\allowbreak{}generators}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, m, g, r.; \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)). \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)). \\ \quad \quad r \cdot g(i) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; (\operatorname{entry}(m, i, j) \cdot g(j))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (n + 1), \operatorname{matof}((n + 1), (n + 1), (\lambda [\operatorname{cpi\_}, \operatorname{cpj\_}] \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \times \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))).\; (\operatorname{entry}(m, \operatorname{cpi\_}, \operatorname{cpj\_}) + (r \cdot \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matof}((n + 1), (n + 1), (\lambda [\operatorname{cqi\_}, \operatorname{cqj\_}] \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \times \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))).\; \left(\text{if }(\operatorname{cqi\_} = \operatorname{cqj\_})\text{ then }-1\text{ else }0\right))), \operatorname{cpi\_}, \operatorname{cpj\_})))))) \cdot g(k) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, b, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, g) \simeq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (b(j) \cdot g(j))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}monic-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, v, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(a, v, m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad n \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad c(n) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, j))), (n + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, a, b, g. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, a, g) + \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, g) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (a(j) + b(j))), g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, a, b, g. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge (g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, g)) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (a \cdot b(j))), g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}coefficients}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, g. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; 0), g) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, g, i. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \left(\text{if }(j = i)\text{ then }1\text{ else }0\right)), g) = g(i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}as-\allowbreak{}lincomb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, b, c, r. \\ \quad ((b \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (k \leq b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, b).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, b).\; c(\operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(i, 1)))(j) \cdot (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, b).\; \operatorname{power}(r, \operatorname{nn\text{-}minus}(i, 1)))(j)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, k)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{pfj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(\mathit{pfj}) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, \mathit{pfj}))), k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invariant-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}relation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, g, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((g + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad c(g) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, j))), (g + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(a, v, g) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{invariant-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}algebraic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to \mathbb{C})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, \\ \quad \quad \quad \{v \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{amb} \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to a).\; (v = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(b, \mathit{amb}, u))\}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad u \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to \{v \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{amb} \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to a).\; (v = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(b, \mathit{amb}, u))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}span-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, o.; \forall v \in \{\mathit{amvv} \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{amb} \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to a).\; (\mathit{amvv} = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(b, \mathit{amb}, u))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad o \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, b). \\ \quad \quad (o \cdot u(t)) \in \{\mathit{amvv} \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{amb} \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to a).\; (\mathit{amvv} = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(b, \mathit{amb}, u))\} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (o \cdot v) \in \{\mathit{amvv} \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{amb} \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, b) \to a).\; (\mathit{amvv} = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(b, \mathit{amb}, u))\} \end{array}}}
