\vnbentry{\texttt{product-\allowbreak{}generators-\allowbreak{}exist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, n, m, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, m) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{apn} \in \mathbb{N}, u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{apn}) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{apn}). \exists i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad u(t) = (g(i) \cdot h(j)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \exists b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{apn}) \to a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (g(i) \cdot h(j)) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(\mathit{apn}, b, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lincomb-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v, n, b, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, w) \in v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{module-\allowbreak{}preimage-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge ((a \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, \{q \in \mathbb{C} : ((q \cdot c) \in v)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fg-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}generator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge \exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}, g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{amv} \in v. \exists b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{amv} = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \neg (g(k) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{module-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}invariance}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, v, n, g, m, h, w.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to v) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amv} \in v. \exists b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to a). \\ \quad \quad \mathit{amv} = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, m) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), \mathit{apm} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((g(l) \cdot h(\mathit{apm})) \in w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (r \cdot (g(i) \cdot h(j))) \in w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, (r + s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, (r \cdot s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, -r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}element}}{\vnbstmt{\forall b, a.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(b) \wedge (a \in b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(b, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}numbers-\allowbreak{}subring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(\{q \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, q)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fraction-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}fraction\text{-}field}(a) \subseteq \{q \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{anfa}, b \in a.\; (\neg (b = 0) \wedge ((q \cdot b) = \mathit{anfa}))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fraction-\allowbreak{}common-\allowbreak{}denominator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \{q \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{anfa}, b \in a.\; (\neg (b = 0) \wedge ((q \cdot b) = \mathit{anfa}))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in a.\; (\neg (d = 0) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < k) \Rightarrow ((d \cdot c(j)) \in a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}leading}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, p, a, h, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(b) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((((p + 1) + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (a(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad a((p + 1)) = n \wedge \\ \quad \neg (n = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(h, j))), ((p + 1) + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(b, (n \cdot h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}over-\allowbreak{}fractions-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over\text{-}field}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fraction\text{-}field}(a), h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; (\neg (k = 0) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, (k \cdot h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}subring-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(\mathbb{Z})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qq-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}subring-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(\mathbb{Q})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qq-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(\mathbb{Q})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}over-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, x. \\ \quad ((a \subseteq b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, x)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(b, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}over-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, x. \\ \quad ((a \subseteq b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over\text{-}field}(a, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over\text{-}field}(b, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, x.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, x) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over\text{-}field}(a, x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qq-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}fractions}}{\vnbstmt{\mathbb{Q} \subseteq \{q \in \mathbb{C} : \exists a, b \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\neg (b = 0) \wedge ((q \cdot b) = a))\}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}ps-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, c, z. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge (z \in \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; c(0) + (z \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c((k + 1)))(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{recip-\allowbreak{}algebraic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, c, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad c(n) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(b, j))), (n + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(k, \operatorname{recip}(b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}fraction-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}sup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \{q \in \mathbb{C} : \exists \mathit{anfa}, b \in a.\; (\neg (b = 0) \wedge ((q \cdot b) = \mathit{anfa}))\} \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}fraction\text{-}field}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}monic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over\text{-}field}(k, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(k, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}numbers-\allowbreak{}over-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(\operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}over-\allowbreak{}qq-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}fraction-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}algebraic-\allowbreak{}integers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall h \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over\text{-}field}(\mathbb{Q}, h) \Leftrightarrow (h \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}fraction\text{-}field}(\{q \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(\mathbb{Z}, q)\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}degree-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, v, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(a, v, m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}of\text{-}degree\text{-}le}(a, r, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{monic-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}leading}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, m, c, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((m + 1) \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c(m) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(x, j))), (m + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{anmc} \in (\mathbb{N} \to k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((m + 1) \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{anmc}(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{anmc}(m) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{anmc}(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(x, j))), (m + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}space-\allowbreak{}dim-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, v, m, n. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \leq n) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(k, v, m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(k, v, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}degree-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}invariant-\allowbreak{}space}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, h, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}of\text{-}degree\text{-}le}(k, h, n) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(k, v, n) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((h \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{partial-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < k) \Rightarrow (f(j) \in v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, k) \in v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}tower-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, a, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < j) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, c(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists z \in \{v \in \mathbb{C} : \exists b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to a).\; (v = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, u))\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, t \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (i < j) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (c(i) \cdot u(t)) \in \{v \in \mathbb{C} : \exists b \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to a).\; (v = \operatorname{cc\text{-}lincomb}(n, b, u))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}over-\allowbreak{}algebraic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, c, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < (n + 1)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, c(i))) \wedge \\ \quad c(n) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad h \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(h, j))), (n + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, c, m, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c(m) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (m + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}numbers-\allowbreak{}algebraically-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, c, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge ((c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k))) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (c((m + 1)) = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), ((m + 1) + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g.; \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(k) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q < n) \wedge (g(q) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}(g, n) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{algebraic-\allowbreak{}numbers-\allowbreak{}factorization}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, c, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c(n) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < n) \Rightarrow (r(i) \in \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; c(n) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}((\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z - r(\mathit{cfi}))), n) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/basw-top.scm}{theorem-library/basw-top.scm}
\noindent{\small basw-top.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-SW), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/basw-1109/basw-top.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, f.; \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d), f) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((p \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (\operatorname{dist}(d)(f(p), f(q)) < s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}cont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \operatorname{pts}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t), s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((p \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (\operatorname{dist}(d)(f(p), f(q)) < s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \emptyset \in a \wedge \\ \quad \forall b, c \in a.\; ((b \cup c) \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((p \in u) \wedge (u \in a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(t) \in a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \simeq \{f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) : \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), f)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}). \\ \quad ((f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}), p \in \operatorname{pts}(t), s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((p \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (\lvert (f(p) - f(q)) \rvert < s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t), s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t).\; ((p \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (\lvert (f(p) - f(q)) \rvert < s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (f(z) + g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}lin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, g, a, b, h. \\ \quad f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \lvert a \rvert \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \lvert b \rvert \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = ((f(z) \cdot a) + (g(z) \cdot b))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad ((f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t})) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \lvert f(z) \rvert))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq m) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\lvert f(z) \rvert \leq m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \simeq \{h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) : \forall e.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \exists g \in a.\; \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\lvert (h(y) - g(y)) \rvert < e))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((a \subseteq C_{\mathbb{R}}({t})) \wedge (f \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, h. \\ \quad a \subseteq C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a).\; \forall y \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\lvert (h(y) - g(y)) \rvert < e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (k(z) = c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge (g \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (k(z) = (f(z) + g(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge (g \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (k(z) = (f(z) \cdot g(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, g.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge ((g \in a) \wedge (g \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a. \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad k(z) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(g(z), j))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}on}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}on}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{ccint}(a, b).\; \lvert w \rvert), \operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{R}, e. \\ \quad ((0 \leq m) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lvert x \rvert \leq m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lvert (\lvert x \rvert - \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(x, j))), n)) \rvert < e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}ucl-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \lvert f(z) \rvert) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}ucl-\allowbreak{}lin}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, g, b, c, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \lvert b \rvert \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \lvert c \rvert \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = ((f(z) \cdot b) + (g(z) \cdot c))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}ucl-\allowbreak{}max}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a). \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad (f(z) \leq m(z)) \wedge ((g(z) \leq m(z)) \wedge ((m(z) = f(z)) \vee (m(z) = g(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}ucl-\allowbreak{}min}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a). \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad (m(z) \leq f(z)) \wedge ((m(z) \leq g(z)) \wedge ((m(z) = f(z)) \vee (m(z) = g(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}interp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c, p, q, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, c) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in c.\; ((k(p) = a) \wedge (k(q) = b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}interp-\allowbreak{}f}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; ((k(p) = f(p)) \wedge (k(q) = f(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sw-\allowbreak{}step1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, x, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a). \\ \quad \quad \quad (g(x) = f(x)) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (g(z) < (f(z) + e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}sw-\allowbreak{}step2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a). \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad (g(z) < (f(z) + e)) \wedge ((f(z) - e) < g(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}stone-\allowbreak{}weierstrass-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\lvert (f(z) - g(z)) \rvert < e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}stone-\allowbreak{}weierstrass-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}dense}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, a) \wedge (f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{rcont\text{-}closure}(t, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f.; \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), f) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(p) - f(q))) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), g) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = g(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}re}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}rcont-\allowbreak{}im}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ccont\text{-}star\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (k(z) = c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ccont\text{-}star\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge (g \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (k(z) = (f(z) + g(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ccont\text{-}star\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge (g \in a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (k(z) = (f(z) \cdot g(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}conj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ccont\text{-}star\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge (f \in a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (k(z) = \operatorname{conjugate}(f(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}sa}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}ccont\text{-}star\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}rcont\text{-}subalgebra}(t, \{h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) : \exists g \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = g(z))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}sep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}ccont\text{-}star\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, \{h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) : \exists g \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = g(z))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bsw-\allowbreak{}stone-\allowbreak{}weierstrass-\allowbreak{}complex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, f, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ccont\text{-}star\text{-}subalgebra}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}point\text{-}separating}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in a.\; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - g(z))) < e) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-lft-topology.scm}{theorem-library/ca-lft-topology.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-lft-topology.scm -- Lemma 1.16 of complex-analysis.pdf: convergence in the topology of the extended plane C u \{oo\} is Euclidean convergence at a finite point, and |x\_n| -$>$ +oo at oo. CA-LFT, 2026-10-19.  Library: complex-analysis.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-lft-vocab.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k. \\ \quad ((k \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall z \in k.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}separated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((k \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, k)) \wedge \neg (x \in k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall y \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < r) \Rightarrow \neg (y \in k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}opens-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat\text{-}opens} \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; u \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}) \wedge \\ \quad (u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \vee \\ \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad (h \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, h)) \wedge (u = \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}, h))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{C}, r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, x, r) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat\text{-}opens}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}complement-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, m)) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat\text{-}opens})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}nbhd-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat\text{-}opens}, x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (x \in u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall y \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < r) \Rightarrow (y \in u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}nbhd-\allowbreak{}inf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat\text{-}opens}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}inf} \in u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall y \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((m < \operatorname{magnitude}(y)) \Rightarrow (y \in u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{top\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat\text{-}top}, f, x) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}hat-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}inf-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{top\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat\text{-}top}, f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf}) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow (m \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(k))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-real-part-facts.scm}{theorem-library/cc-real-part-facts.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-real-part-facts.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/ca-lft-cayley.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by cc-real-bound; CC arithmetic. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. cc-real-of-im-zero ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}imag-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(x) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) = 0) \Rightarrow (z \in \mathbb{R}))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-lft-cayley.scm}{theorem-library/ca-lft-cayley.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-lft-cayley.scm -- Prop. 1.21 of complex-analysis.pdf: the Cayley transform C z = (z - i)/(z + i) maps R bijectively onto T \textbackslash{} \{1\} and the upper half plane H+ bijectively onto the disc D = B(0, 1). CA-LFT, 2026-10-19.  Library: complex-analysis.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-lft-vocab.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}mag-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((w + +i)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((w + +i))) = ((\operatorname{magnitude}((w - +i)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((w - +i))) + (4 \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\neg ((w + +i) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cayley}(w) = ((w - +i) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w + +i)))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}mag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg ((w + +i) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cayley}(w)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((w + +i))) = \operatorname{magnitude}((w - +i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg ((w + +i) = 0) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cayley}(w)) < 1) \Leftrightarrow (0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg ((w + +i) = 0) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cayley}(w)) = 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(0) = 0}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{magnitude}(1) = 1}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}pole}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((0 \leq \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w)) \Rightarrow \neg ((w + +i) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; ((u \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \Leftrightarrow ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(u) = 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{upper-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z.\; ((z \in \operatorname{upper\text{-}half\text{-}plane}) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(u) < 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}disc-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(u) < 1) \Rightarrow (u \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\mathit{cayley} \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1), \mathit{cayley}) = \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{compose}(\mathit{cayley}, \operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)) = \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}.\; (\operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)(\operatorname{cayley}(z)) = z)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}.\; (\operatorname{cayley}(\operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)(u)) = u)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (u = 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)(u) = (((+i \cdot u) + +i) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(((-1 \cdot u) + 1)))) \wedge (\operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)(u) \in \mathbb{C})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}pole}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)(1) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}pole}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{cayley}(-+i) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}inf}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}maps-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{cayley}(x) \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}, \operatorname{singleton}(1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}maps-\allowbreak{}circle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}, \operatorname{singleton}(1)). \\ \quad \operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)(u) \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}maps-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \operatorname{upper\text{-}half\text{-}plane}.\; (\operatorname{cayley}(z) \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}maps-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{lft}(+i, +i, -1, 1)(u) \in \operatorname{upper\text{-}half\text{-}plane})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}circle}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda r \in \mathbb{R}.\; \operatorname{cayley}(r)) \in \mathrm{Bij}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}, \operatorname{singleton}(1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}upper-\allowbreak{}disc}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda r \in \operatorname{upper\text{-}half\text{-}plane}.\; \operatorname{cayley}(r)) \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{upper\text{-}half\text{-}plane}, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-characters.scm}{theorem-library/ba-characters.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-characters.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-1G), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba1g-1109/ba-characters.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}comm-\allowbreak{}uba}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{a}(x, y) = \cdot_{a}(y, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}left-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}sided}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, j. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutative-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}left\text{-}ideal}(a, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutative-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall m \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), m) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; m \in i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}ideal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, \\ \quad \quad \quad \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \exists b \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), w) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \cdot_{a}(b, x)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad i \\ \quad \quad \subseteq\; \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \exists b \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), w) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \cdot_{a}(b, x)))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \exists b \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), w) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \cdot_{a}(b, x)))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{vec}({a}/{i}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \neg (c = \operatorname{vzero}({a}/{i})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}({a}/{i}, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}scalar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), x) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}scalar-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(w, 1_{a})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad z = w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}chi-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall t \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\iota\, v.\;((v \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), t) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(v, 1_{a}))))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(a)((\iota\, v.\;((v \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), t) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(v, 1_{a}))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1_{a})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bch-\allowbreak{}chi-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall t \in \operatorname{vec}(a), w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), t) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(w, 1_{a})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\iota\, v.\;((v \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), t) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(v, 1_{a}))))) \\ \quad \quad =\; w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{characters}(a).\; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; ((b(x) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (x \in i)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), x) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}({a}/{i})(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), x)) = \operatorname{magnitude}(z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{character-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (c(\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) = (z + -c(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{character-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}maximal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : (c(x) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{character-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c, d \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\{x \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : (c(x) = 0)\} = \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : (d(x) = 0)\})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{characters}(a).\; (\{x \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : (b(x) = 0)\} = i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{principal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}sided}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall s \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(a, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \exists b \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (w = \cdot_{a}(b, s))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{noninvertible-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall s \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, m) \wedge (s \in m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{spectrum-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \sigma({x}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \exists i \in \operatorname{characters}(a).\; (i(x) = z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{characters-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{characters}(a) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}transform-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x) \in (\operatorname{characters}(a) \to \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}range-\allowbreak{}spectrum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sigma({x}) = \operatorname{image}(\operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x), \operatorname{characters}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{character-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cdual\text{-}norm}(a, c) = 1) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-im-i-mul.scm}{theorem-library/cc-im-i-mul.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-im-i-mul.scm -- lemmas MOVED 2026-11-10 (integration of the 11-09/10 waves) out of theorem-library/triangle-orientation.scm into library analysis, for the library gate: cited by cc-real-bound; CC arithmetic. The proofs are the originals, verbatim; the helper defines are a copy of the source's. cc-im-i-mul}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((+i \cdot z)) = \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z))}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/cc-real-bound.scm}{theorem-library/cc-real-bound.scm}
\noindent{\small cc-real-bound.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba2-1109/cc-real-bound.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{crb-\allowbreak{}linear-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall y, d \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((2 \cdot (y \cdot t)) \leq d) \Rightarrow (y = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}quadratic-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z + (+i \cdot t))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((z + (+i \cdot t)))) \leq (c + (t \cdot t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z \in \mathbb{R} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba2-cstar.scm}{theorem-library/ba2-cstar.scm}
\noindent{\small ba2-cstar.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ba2-1109/ba2-cstar.scm. Library: operator-algebras.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vneg}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{act}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vmul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)} \simeq \cdot_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}ro-\allowbreak{}vone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (1_{\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)} \simeq 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad ({x}^{-1} \simeq (\iota\, u.\;((u \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \wedge ((\cdot_{a}(u, x) = 1_{a}) \wedge (\cdot_{a}(x, u) = 1_{a}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{-1} \in \operatorname{vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}({x}^{-1}, x) = 1_{a} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(x, {x}^{-1}) = 1_{a} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{-1} \in \operatorname{vec}(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}({x}^{-1}, x) = 1_{a} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(x, {x}^{-1}) = 1_{a} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, u \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((\cdot_{a}(u, x) = 1_{a}) \wedge (\cdot_{a}(x, u) = 1_{a}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, u \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((\cdot_{a}(u, x) = 1_{a}) \wedge (\cdot_{a}(x, u) = 1_{a}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {x}^{-1} = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, u, w \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((\cdot_{a}(u, x) = 1_{a}) \wedge (\cdot_{a}(x, w) = 1_{a}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u = w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bae-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(z, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y)) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) + \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}homog}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x)) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}submult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\cdot_{a}(x, y)) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vone-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(1_{a}) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), y) = \operatorname{act}(a)(r, \cdot_{a}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \cdot_{a}(x, \operatorname{act}(a)(r, y)) = \operatorname{act}(a)(r, \cdot_{a}(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bal-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bas-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bas-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u, z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x))) = \operatorname{act}(a)((u + -z), 1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bas-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(0, v) = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bas-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(a)(1, v) = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bcp-\allowbreak{}u-\allowbreak{}bas-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(a))(z) = -z) \end{array}}}
