\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t), s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \in u) \wedge \forall q \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(p) - f(q))) < s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}compose}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t), e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall q \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}((f(p) - f(q))) < d) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(p) - g(q))) < d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((h(p) - h(q))) < e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}((a - x)) < d) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((b - y)) < d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((a + b) - (x + y))) < s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}((a - x)) < d) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((b - y)) < d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((a \cdot b) - (x \cdot y))) < s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, p, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = p(f(z), g(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}((a - x)) < d) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((b - y)) < d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((p(a, b) - p(x, y))) < s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall x \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((a - x)) < d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((-a - -x)) < s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((a - x)) < d) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{conjugate}(a) - \operatorname{conjugate}(x))) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}ptw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (f(z) + g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}ptw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, g, h. \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (f(z) \cdot g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}ptw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad ((f \in C({t})) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = -f(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}ptw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad ((f \in C({t})) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \operatorname{conjugate}(f(z))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}ptw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c, f, h. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((f \in C({t})) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (c \cdot f(z)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}ptw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (C({t}) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t) \in ((C({t}) \times C({t})) \to C({t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t) \in ((C({t}) \times C({t})) \to C({t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vneg}(t) \in (C({t}) \to C({t}))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vstar-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vstar}(t) \in (C({t}) \to C({t}))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t) \in ((\mathbb{C} \times C({t})) \to C({t}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vzero-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t) \in C({t})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vone-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t) \in C({t})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}rcont}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad ((f \in C({t})) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \operatorname{magnitude}(f(z))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (f \in C({t}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq m) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, f.\; (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}sup\text{-}norm}(f, \operatorname{pts}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}), x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq \lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}), m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq m) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \wedge (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \leq m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (f \in C({t}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vnrm}(t) \in (C({t}) \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (f(z) + g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} \leq (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} + \lVert g \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (f(z) \cdot g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} \leq (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \cdot \lVert g \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (c \cdot f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (c \cdot f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} = (\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}conj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \operatorname{conjugate}(f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} = \lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}cstar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad f \in C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = (\operatorname{conjugate}(f(z)) \cdot f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} = (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \cdot \lVert f \rVert_{\infty}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f.; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge ((f \in C({t})) \wedge (\lVert f \rVert_{\infty} = 0))) \Rightarrow (f(z) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sup-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}t-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert h \rVert_{\infty} = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}pointwise-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s.; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to C({t})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cxi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cxi})(z)), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}function}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to C({t})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cxz} \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \varepsilon(\{l \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cxi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cxi})(\mathit{cxz})), l)\})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cxi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cxi})(z)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cxz} \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \varepsilon(\{l \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cxi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cxi})(\mathit{cxz})), l)\}))(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}uniform}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to C({t})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \leq i) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - (\lambda \mathit{cxz} \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \varepsilon(\{l \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cxi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cxi})(\mathit{cxz})), l)\}))(z))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}four-\allowbreak{}eps}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, w \in \mathbb{C}, r, d, e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad (r + r) = d \wedge \\ \quad (d + d) = e \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((b - c)) < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((b - a)) \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((c - w)) \leq r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((a - w)) < e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to C({t})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cxz} \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \varepsilon(\{l \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cxi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(\mathit{cxi})(\mathit{cxz})), l)\})) \\ \quad \quad \in\; C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}uniformly-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to C({t})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in C({t}). \forall a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq i) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - g(z))) \leq a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f, g \in C({t}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, g) \in C({t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f, g \in C({t}), p \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, g)(p) = (f(p) + g(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f, g \in C({t}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, g) \in C({t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vmul-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f, g \in C({t}), p \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, g)(p) = (f(p) \cdot g(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in C({t}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vneg}(t)(f) \in C({t})) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ucsa-\allowbreak{}tuple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), C({t}), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vneg}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vnrm}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vstar}(t)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}ccsa-\allowbreak{}tuple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}([\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), C({t}), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vneg}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vnrm}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t), \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vstar}(t)]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}unital-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}commutative-\allowbreak{}c-\allowbreak{}star}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}union2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow ((u \cup v) \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}hausdorff-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}sep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, k.; \forall p \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, k) \wedge \neg (p \in k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u, v \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \in u) \wedge ((k \subseteq v) \wedge \forall x \in u.\; \neg (x \in v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}hausdorff-\allowbreak{}normal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \neg (x \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u, v \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad (a \subseteq u) \wedge ((b \subseteq v) \wedge \forall x \in u.\; \neg (x \in v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}hausdorff-\allowbreak{}shrink}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a.; \forall u \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \wedge (a \subseteq u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(t), f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, f) \wedge ((a \subseteq v) \wedge ((v \subseteq f) \wedge (f \subseteq u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq C({t})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vneg}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vnrm}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vmul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\cdot_{\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)} \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vone}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (1_{\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)} \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}vstar}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow ({}^{*_{\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)}} \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vstar}(t)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}cone-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad ({a}_{+} \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \forall c \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(a)).\; ((\forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), y) \in c) \wedge \forall u, v \in c.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(a)(u, v) \in c)) \Rightarrow (x \in c))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}cone-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in {\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)}_{+}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (f \in C({t})) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq f(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq y) \wedge ((y \leq x) \wedge ((0 < e) \wedge (((x \cdot x) - (y \cdot y)) < (e \cdot e))))) \Rightarrow ((x - y) < e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}sqrt-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq p) \wedge ((0 \leq q) \wedge ((0 < e) \wedge (\lvert (p - q) \rvert < (e \cdot e))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert (\sqrt{p} - \sqrt{q}) \rvert < e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}sqrt-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((a - x)) < d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\sqrt{\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(a) \rvert} - \sqrt{\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(x) \rvert})) < s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}sqrt-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}ptw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, f, h. \\ \quad ((f \in C({t})) \wedge ((h \in (\operatorname{pts}(t) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h(z) = \sqrt{\lvert \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(f(z)) \rvert}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}cone}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in C({t}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq f(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f \in {\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)}_{+} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}positive-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall f \in C({t}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (f \in {\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)}_{+}) \Leftrightarrow \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq f(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{kcs-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a), h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}el}(a, h)) \Rightarrow (c(h) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{character-\allowbreak{}preserves-\allowbreak{}involution}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (c({}^{*_{a}}(x)) = \operatorname{conjugate}(c(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccsa-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}preserves-\allowbreak{}involution}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (c({}^{*_{a}}(x)) = \operatorname{conjugate}(c(x))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}cu-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t) \simeq \{w \in (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t)) \times \operatorname{opens}(t)) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{nth}(1, w)) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(1, w) \subseteq \operatorname{nth}(2, w)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}cu-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}cu-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{nth}(1, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nth}(2, c) \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, c) \subseteq \operatorname{nth}(2, c) \wedge \\ \quad c = [\operatorname{nth}(1, c), \operatorname{nth}(2, c)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}cu-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \wedge (a \subseteq u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [a, u] \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}v}(t, c) \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, k) \wedge ((\operatorname{nth}(1, c) \subseteq \operatorname{ury\text{-}v}(t, c)) \wedge ((\operatorname{ury\text{-}v}(t, c) \subseteq k) \wedge (k \subseteq \operatorname{nth}(2, c))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}k-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}k}(t, c) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{ury\text{-}k}(t, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}v}(t, c) \subseteq \operatorname{ury\text{-}k}(t, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}k}(t, c) \subseteq \operatorname{nth}(2, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}l-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}l}(t, c) \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}r-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}r}(t, c) \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lr-\allowbreak{}nth}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{ury\text{-}l}(t, c)) = \operatorname{nth}(1, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{ury\text{-}l}(t, c)) = \operatorname{ury\text{-}v}(t, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{ury\text{-}r}(t, c)) = \operatorname{ury\text{-}k}(t, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{ury\text{-}r}(t, c)) = \operatorname{nth}(2, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n) \in (\operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t) \to \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{nth}(2, c))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, 0)(c) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)) \wedge \neg (x \in \operatorname{nth}(2, c))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, 0)(c) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}succ-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, (n + 1))(c) \\ \quad \quad =\; 1/2 \cdot (\operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(\operatorname{ury\text{-}l}(t, c)) + \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(\operatorname{ury\text{-}r}(t, c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c)) \wedge (\operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c) \leq 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{nth}(1, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}u}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \neg (x \in \operatorname{nth}(2, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t), m, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, a) \subseteq \operatorname{nth}(1, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, k)(b) \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, m)(a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}mid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(\operatorname{ury\text{-}r}(t, c)) \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c) \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(\operatorname{ury\text{-}l}(t, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c) \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, (n + 1))(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}apx-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d \in \mathbb{N}, t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, k)(c) \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, (k + d))(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, c, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) \simeq \operatorname{esup}(\{r \in \mathbb{R} : \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r = \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c))\})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{r \in \mathbb{R} : \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r = \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c))\} \subseteq \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}upper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, n)(c) \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t), b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ury\text{-}apx}(t, x, q)(c) \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x)) \wedge (\operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}c}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{nth}(1, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}off-\allowbreak{}u}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \neg (x \in \operatorname{nth}(2, c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}mid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x) = (1/2 \cdot (\operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, \operatorname{ury\text{-}l}(t, c), x) + \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, \operatorname{ury\text{-}r}(t, c), x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}inter2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(t) \Rightarrow ((u \cap v) \in \operatorname{opens}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ury-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}osc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t, x.; \forall c \in \operatorname{cu\text{-}pairs}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{pts}(t)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((x \in w) \wedge \forall y \in w.\; (\lvert (\operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, y) - \operatorname{ury\text{-}lim}(t, c, x)) \rvert \leq \operatorname{power}(3/4, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{urysohn-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}hausdorff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \neg (x \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in C_{\mathbb{R}}({t}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((0 \leq f(z)) \wedge (f(z) \leq 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in a.\; (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in b.\; (f(z) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccx-\allowbreak{}characters-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \simeq \{c \in (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)) \to \mathbb{C}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t), c) \wedge (\forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)).\; (c(\cdot_{\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)}(x, y)) = (c(x) \cdot c(y))) \wedge (c(1_{\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)}) = 1)))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}laws}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall h \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in (C({t}) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in C({t}).\; (h(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(x, y)) = (h(x) + h(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in C({t}).\; (h(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)(z, x)) = (z \cdot h(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in C({t}).\; (h(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(x, y)) = (h(x) \cdot h(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad h(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{point-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), f \in C({t}).\; (\operatorname{point\text{-}eval}(t, x)(f) = f(x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{point-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{point\text{-}eval}(t, x) \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall h \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)), x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), f \in C({t}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \forall g \in C({t}).\; ((h(g) = 0) \Rightarrow (g(x) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h(f) = f(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}lipschitz-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 \leq a) \wedge (1 \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (\operatorname{recip}(a) - \operatorname{recip}(b)) \rvert \leq \lvert (a - b) \rvert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}bump}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall h \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)), g \in C({t}), p \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge ((h(g) = 0) \wedge \neg (g(p) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad p \in u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad u \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \{w \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t)) : \exists \mathit{uhh} \in C({t}).\; ((h(\mathit{uhh}) = 0) \wedge (\forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((\operatorname{uhh}(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{uhh}(z))) \wedge \forall z \in w.\; (1 \leq \operatorname{uhh}(z))))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}no-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall \mathit{uch} \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)), h \in C({t}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (1 \leq h(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{uch}(h) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall h \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \exists g \in C({t}).\; ((h(g) = 0) \wedge \neg (g(x) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(t) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{w \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t)) : \exists \mathit{uhh} \in C({t}).\; ((h(\mathit{uhh}) = 0) \wedge (\forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((\operatorname{uhh}(z) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{uhh}(z))) \wedge \forall z \in w.\; (1 \leq \operatorname{uhh}(z))))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}kernel-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall h \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \forall g \in C({t}).\; ((h(g) = 0) \Rightarrow (g(x) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}eval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall h \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (h = \operatorname{point\text{-}eval}(t, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}hausdorff-\allowbreak{}singleton-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(t, \operatorname{singleton}(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{point-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \neg (x = y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{point\text{-}eval}(t, x) = \operatorname{point\text{-}eval}(t, y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}algebra-\allowbreak{}uba}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t))) \simeq C({t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}uba-\allowbreak{}vnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t))) \simeq \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vnrm}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}characters-\allowbreak{}view}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t))) \simeq \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall h \in \operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t)), f \in C({t}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \exists p.\; (p \in \operatorname{pts}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(h(f)) \leq \lVert f \rVert_{\infty} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uiba-\allowbreak{}characters-\allowbreak{}view}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{characters}(\operatorname{uiba\text{-}as\text{-}uba}(a)) \simeq \operatorname{characters}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}bump}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i.; \forall g \in i, p \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t) \in i \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, \mathit{bmg} \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, \mathit{bmg}) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)(z, f) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{bmg} \in C({t}), f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, \mathit{bmg}) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (g(p) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{opens}(t). \\ \quad \quad \quad p \in u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad u \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \{w \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t)) : \exists h \in C({t}).\; ((h \in i) \wedge (\forall \mathit{uhz} \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(\mathit{uhz}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq h(\mathit{uhz}))) \wedge \forall \mathit{uhz} \in w.\; (1 \leq h(\mathit{uhz}))))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i.; \forall h \in i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t) \in i \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)(z, f) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in C({t}), f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ulz} \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(\mathit{ulz}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (1 \leq h(\mathit{ulz}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t) \in i \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t) \in i \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)(z, f) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in C({t}), f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \exists \mathit{ucg} \in i.\; \neg (\operatorname{ucg}(x) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(t) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \{w \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(t)) : \exists h \in C({t}).\; ((h \in i) \wedge (\forall \mathit{uhz} \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(\mathit{uhz}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq h(\mathit{uhz}))) \wedge \forall \mathit{uhz} \in w.\; (1 \leq h(\mathit{uhz}))))\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}common-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t) \in i \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)(z, f) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in C({t}), f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t) \in i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; \forall \mathit{ukg} \in i.\; (\operatorname{ukg}(x) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}all}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \\ \quad i \subseteq C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t) \in i \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)(z, f) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in C({t}), f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vone}(t) \in i \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i = C({t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}laws}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t), i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad i \subseteq C({t}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ccont\text{-}vzero}(t) \in i \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall f, g \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vadd}(t)(f, g) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}act}(t)(z, f) \in i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall g \in C({t}), f \in i.\; (\operatorname{ccont\text{-}vmul}(t)(f, g) \in i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}sided}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}two\text{-}sided\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t), \{h \in C({t}) : (h(x) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}proper}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow \neg (\{h \in C({t}) : (h(x) = 0)\} = C({t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}maximal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t), \{h \in C({t}) : (h(x) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t), i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (i = \{h \in C({t}) : (h(x) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}ideals}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{ccont\text{-}algebra}(t), i) \Leftrightarrow \exists x \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; (i = \{h \in C({t}) : (h(x) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccont-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(t) \wedge \neg (x = y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\{h \in C({t}) : (h(x) = 0)\} = \{h \in C({t}) : (h(y) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/triangle-orientation.scm}{theorem-library/triangle-orientation.scm}
\noindent{\small triangle-orientation.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-angle.scm (proofs), scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-orient.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{real-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}im}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, w. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (w \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((c \cdot w)) = (c \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w))) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((c \cdot w)) = (c \cdot \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{exp-\allowbreak{}polar-\allowbreak{}re-\allowbreak{}im}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(\exp l) = (\exp \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(l) \cdot \sin \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(l)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\exp l) = (\exp \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(l) \cdot \cos \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{angle-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}pi-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, v. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\neg (z = 0) \wedge \neg (v = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{angle}(z, v) < \pi \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; 0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((z \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(v))) \vee \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((z \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(v))) = 0) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((z \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conv3-\allowbreak{}cross-\allowbreak{}weights}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall z \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c). \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a - z)))) = (t \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - c) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a - c))))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((c - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((b - z)))) = (t \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((c - a) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((b - a))))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((a - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((c - z)))) = (t \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((a - b) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((c - b))))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interior-\allowbreak{}cross-\allowbreak{}sign}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, k, s, u. \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = q) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s. \exists t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq t) \wedge (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - z)))) = (t \cdot k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 < (k \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - u))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interior-\allowbreak{}angle-\allowbreak{}sign}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, k, s.; \forall u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s). \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s. \exists t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq t) \wedge (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - z)))) = (t \cdot k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{angle}((q - u), (p - u)) < \pi) \Leftrightarrow (0 < k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{positively-\allowbreak{}oriented-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists v.\; (v \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{angle}((b - u), (a - u)) < \pi) \wedge ((\operatorname{angle}((c - u), (b - u)) < \pi) \wedge (\operatorname{angle}((a - u), (c - u)) < \pi))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/triangle-winding.scm}{theorem-library/triangle-winding.scm}
\noindent{\small triangle-winding.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-wind.scm, scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-wext.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, \mathit{aouu}. \\ \quad ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\mathit{aouu} \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \{w \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((u \cdot (w - \mathit{aouu}))))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}dot-\allowbreak{}coords}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, w. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (w \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((\operatorname{conjugate}(z) \cdot w)) = ((\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) \cdot \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(w)) + (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z) \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}dot-\allowbreak{}cross}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, u, s. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (s \in \mathbb{R})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot ((p + (s \cdot (q - p))) - u))) = \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - u)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}log}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, u. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - u)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; \operatorname{recip}((w - u))), p, q) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (q - u))\right) - \log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (p - u))\right)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, u. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - u)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exp (\log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (q - u))\right) - \log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (p - u))\right)) \cdot (p - u) \\ \quad \quad =\; (q - u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((\log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (q - u))\right) - \log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (p - u))\right))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((\log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (q - u))\right) - \log\left((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (p - q))) \cdot (p - u))\right))) \\ \quad \quad <\; \pi \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seg-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}punctured}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, u. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - u)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(p, q), 0, 1) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triangle-\allowbreak{}crosses-\allowbreak{}positive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a - u)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((c - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((b - u)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((a - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((c - u)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triangle-\allowbreak{}tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}interior}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; \operatorname{recip}((w - u))), a, b, c) = ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triangle-\allowbreak{}winding-\allowbreak{}interior}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(\operatorname{tri\text{-}road}(a, b, c), \operatorname{tri\text{-}road\text{-}deriv}(a, b, c), 0, 3, u) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cross-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, u, w. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (w \in \mathbb{C})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (q - p))) \cdot (w - (1/2 \cdot (p + u))))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - w) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - w)))) - (1/2 \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - u)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cross-\allowbreak{}barycentric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, z. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (z \in \mathbb{C})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a - z)))) + \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((c - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((b - z))))) + \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((a - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((c - z)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - c) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a - c)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - c) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a - c)))) \cdot z \\ \quad \quad =\; ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((c - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((b - z)))) \cdot a) + (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((a - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((c - z)))) \cdot b)) + (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((a - z)))) \cdot c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triangle-\allowbreak{}outside-\allowbreak{}side}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, u, p, q. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c).\; (0 \leq \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - z))))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - u) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((p - u)))) < 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; \operatorname{recip}((w - u))), a, b, c) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triangle-\allowbreak{}winding-\allowbreak{}exterior}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall u \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \exists v.\; (v \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(\operatorname{tri\text{-}road}(a, b, c), \operatorname{tri\text{-}road\text{-}deriv}(a, b, c), 0, 3, u) = 0 \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/triangle-cauchy-formula.scm}{theorem-library/triangle-cauchy-formula.scm}
\noindent{\small triangle-cauchy-formula.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-cif.scm, scratchpad/ch3e/ch3e-cif2.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{triangle-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}formula}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f.; \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(n, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - u)))), a, b, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{triangle-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}deriv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f.; \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, n, f, u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(n, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - u)), 2))), a, b, c) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/holomorphy-across-line.scm}{theorem-library/holomorphy-across-line.scm}
\noindent{\small holomorphy-across-line.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3f-line.scm (proofs). Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}continuity-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, \mathit{lny} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((x - \mathit{lny})) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(x) - f(\mathit{lny}))) \leq s) \end{array}}}
