\vnbentry{\texttt{ln-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), w.; \forall q \in w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \wedge \\ \quad w \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{restrict}(f, w), q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p, d) \simeq \{z \in \mathbb{C} : (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((z - p) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ln-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, p. \\ \quad ((z \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 \leq p) \wedge \forall e.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq (e \cdot p)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ln-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}conv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, p_{0}, d, s.; \forall z \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c). \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad p_{0} \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((a - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((c - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((z - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ln-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}identities}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, p_{0}, d, s, a. \\ \quad ((w \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((p_{0} \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((s \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((\operatorname{conjugate}((+i \cdot (s \cdot d))) \cdot (w - (p_{0} - ((1/2 \cdot a) \cdot (+i \cdot (s \cdot d))))))) \\ \quad \quad =\; (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((w - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) + ((1/2 \cdot a) \cdot ((s \cdot s) \cdot (\operatorname{magnitude}(d) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((((w + (a \cdot (+i \cdot (s \cdot d)))) - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((w - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) + (a \cdot (s \cdot (\operatorname{magnitude}(d) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}half-\allowbreak{}plane}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), p_{0}, d, c \in \mathbb{C}, r, s \in \mathbb{R}, a, b, \mathit{aoc} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (2 \cdot r)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad (s \cdot s) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(s) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((a - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((b - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((\mathit{aoc} - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, \mathit{aoc}) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ln-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}seg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, p_{0}, d, t. \\ \quad ((p \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((q \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((p_{0} \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge ((d \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (t \in \mathbb{R}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((((p + (t \cdot (q - p))) - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((p - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) + (t \cdot (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) - \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((p - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ln-\allowbreak{}cut-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, p_{0}, d, s. \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad p_{0} \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad (s \cdot s) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad 0 < (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((p - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) < 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}path}(p, q), 0, 1). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((y - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}cross-\allowbreak{}vertex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), p_{0}, d, c \in \mathbb{C}, r, s \in \mathbb{R}, p, q, x \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (2 \cdot r)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad (s \cdot s) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(s) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad 0 < (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((p - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) \wedge \\ \quad (s \cdot \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((q - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d)))) < 0 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((x - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, p, q, x) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}vertex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), p_{0}, d, c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, p, q, x \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (2 \cdot r)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((x - p_{0}) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, p, q, x) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{tri-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}line-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), p_{0}, d, c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, a, b, \mathit{aoc} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (2 \cdot r)) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, \mathit{aoc}) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}across-\allowbreak{}line}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), p_{0}, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/schwarz-reflection.scm}{theorem-library/schwarz-reflection.scm}
\noindent{\small schwarz-reflection.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3e/ch3f-refl.scm (proofs). Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}mag-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, a, s. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(z) - g(a))) < s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}mag-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, a. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in u \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(z) - g(a))) < s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conj-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{conj\text{-}set}(a) \simeq \{z \in \mathbb{C} : (\operatorname{conjugate}(z) \in a)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{conj-\allowbreak{}set-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{conj\text{-}set}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}transfer-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, h, p, l, b.; \forall g \in (b \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, a, h, p, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), b) \wedge \\ \quad p \in b \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall z \in b.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - p)) < r) \Rightarrow ((z \in a) \wedge (g(z) = h(z))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, b, g, p, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{reflection-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(a, h) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{conj\text{-}set}(a), (\lambda w \in \operatorname{conj\text{-}set}(a).\; \operatorname{conjugate}(h(\operatorname{conjugate}(w))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rx-\allowbreak{}im-\allowbreak{}conj}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(\operatorname{conjugate}(z)) = -\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{interior-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}symmetric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall z \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s). \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (\operatorname{conjugate}(z) \in s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{conjugate}(z) \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{schwarz-\allowbreak{}reflection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in ((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R})) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (0 < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in (u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R})). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, \operatorname{restrict}(f, u)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R}).\; (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R})) \cup \operatorname{conj\text{-}set}((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R}))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, ((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R})) \cup \operatorname{conj\text{-}set}((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R}))))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (z \in (u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow (g(z) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, ((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R})) \cup \operatorname{conj\text{-}set}((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R}))))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{conjugate}(z) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R})) \cup \operatorname{conj\text{-}set}((u \cup (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \cap \mathbb{R}))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad g(\operatorname{conjugate}(z)) = \operatorname{conjugate}(g(z)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gamma-continuation.scm}{theorem-library/gamma-continuation.scm}
\noindent{\small gamma-continuation.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch3g/ch3g-gamma.scm (proofs). Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{poch-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{poch}(z, n) \in \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poch-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall \mathit{gdn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + \mathit{gdn}) = 0)\}. \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{poch}(z, n) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poch-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{poch}(z, (n + 1)) = (z \cdot \operatorname{poch}((z + 1), n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}poch-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall \mathit{gdn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + \mathit{gdn}) = 0)\}. \\ \quad (0 < (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) + n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\Gamma((z + (n + 1))) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{poch}(z, (n + 1)))) = (\Gamma((z + n)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{poch}(z, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}poch-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall \mathit{gdn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + \mathit{gdn}) = 0)\}. \\ \quad (0 < (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) + n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\Gamma((z + (n + k))) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{poch}(z, (n + k)))) = (\Gamma((z + n)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{poch}(z, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall \mathit{gdn} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + \mathit{gdn}) = 0)\}. \\ \quad (0 < (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) + n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(z) = (\Gamma((z + n)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{poch}(z, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}rhp-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}omega}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \Rightarrow (z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}extends}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\}) \wedge (\operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(z) = \Gamma(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}omega-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\}. \\ \quad (z + 1) \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}recursion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}((z + 1)) = (z \cdot \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}separation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < m) \Rightarrow \neg ((a + j) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < r) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < m) \Rightarrow (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((a + j)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}omega-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (0 < (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(a) + m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (w \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}) \wedge (0 < (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(w) + m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}omega-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poch-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, (\lambda w \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{poch}(w, m)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}, \\ \quad (\lambda w \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}.\; \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}slit-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}omega}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\} \\ \subseteq\; \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}slit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\}, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gyz} \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\mathit{gyz})) \Rightarrow (d(\mathit{gyz}) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d(z) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}continuation-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall z \in \{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{\mathit{gdz} \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((\mathit{gdz} + n) = 0)\}, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gyz} \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\mathit{gyz})) \Rightarrow (d(\mathit{gyz}) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d(z) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}analytic-\allowbreak{}continuation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}, \\ \quad (\lambda w \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}.\; \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(w))) \wedge \\ \forall \mathit{gxz} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\mathit{gxz})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(\mathit{gxz}) = \Gamma(\mathit{gxz})) \wedge \\ \forall \mathit{gxz} \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}. \\ \quad (\mathit{gxz} + 1) \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}((\mathit{gxz} + 1)) = (\mathit{gxz} \cdot \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(\mathit{gxz})) \wedge \\ \forall g.; \forall \mathit{gxz} \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gyz} \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\mathit{gyz})) \Rightarrow (g(\mathit{gyz}) = \Gamma(\mathit{gyz}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(\mathit{gxz}) = \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(\mathit{gxz}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4c-inverse.scm}{theorem-library/ch4c-inverse.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4c-inverse.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4c/ch4c-inverse.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}segment-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, c \in \mathbb{C}, k \in \mathbb{R}, z_{1}, z_{2} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) - c)) \leq k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((f(z_{1}) - f(z_{2})) - (c \cdot (z_{1} - z_{2})))) \leq (\operatorname{magnitude}((z_{1} - z_{2})) \cdot k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}bilipschitz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) - \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; 1/2 \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z_{1}, z_{2} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (1/2 \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((z_{1} - z_{2})) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{magnitude}((f(z_{1}) - f(z_{2}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r, k, p \in \mathbb{R}, v \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r).\; ((k \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((y - a))) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((f(y) - f(a)))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad p < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((v - f(a))) < (1/2 \cdot (k \cdot p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, p).\; (f(z) = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, v, w.; \forall g \in (w \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in w.\; ((g(y) \in v) \wedge (f(g(y)) = y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in w. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, \mathit{rgy}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in v.\; \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, x) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(w, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}preimage-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}open}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), o, w. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, o) \wedge \\ \quad o \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \{z \in o : (f(z) \in w)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}function-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v, w, g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g \in (w \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in v.\; ((f(z) \in w) \wedge (g(f(z)) = z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in w.\; ((g(y) \in v) \wedge (f(g(y)) = y)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(w, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \wedge (1 \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r_{7} \in \mathbb{R}, k_{7}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r_{7} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}), k_{7}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{k7}(a) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}), k_{7}, a) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z_{7} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}).\; (f(z_{7}) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{k7}(z_{7}), m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}unity-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (2 \leq m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q_{8} \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(q_{8}, m) = 1) \wedge (\neg (q_{8} = 1) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(q_{8}) = 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}injective-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{9}, y_{9} \in u.\; ((f(x_{9}) = f(y_{9})) \Rightarrow (x_{9} = y_{9})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{automorphism-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}holomorphic\text{-}automorphism}(u, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, i^{-1}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{disc-\allowbreak{}automorphism-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}rotation}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}holomorphic\text{-}automorphism}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), i) \wedge (i(0) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (i(z) = (r \cdot z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nth-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m \in \mathbb{N}, c_{12} \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((1 \leq m) \Rightarrow \exists w_{12} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{power}(w_{12}, m) = c_{12}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}openness}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, o.; \forall a \in o. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x_{13}, y_{13} \in u.\; \neg (f(x_{13}) = f(y_{13})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), o) \wedge \\ \quad o \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e_{13}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e_{13}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall v_{13} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((v_{13} - f(a))) < e_{13}) \Rightarrow \exists z_{13} \in o.\; (f(z_{13}) = v_{13}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{open-\allowbreak{}mapping-\allowbreak{}theorem-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x_{13}, y_{13} \in u.\; \neg (f(x_{13}) = f(y_{13})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), o) \wedge \\ \quad o \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \{w_{14} \in \mathbb{C} : \exists z_{14} \in o.\; (f(z_{14}) = w_{14})\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}derivative-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n_{15} \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall c \in u, f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, c, n_{15})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r_{15} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r_{15} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h_{15} \in (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}), h_{15}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z_{15} \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}), \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (f(z_{15}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z_{15}) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z_{15}))) = (\operatorname{h15}(z_{15}) + (n_{15} \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z_{15} - c)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{argument-\allowbreak{}principle-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall e \in \mathbf{Set}, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |e| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in u.\; ((f(x_{16}) = 0) \Rightarrow (x_{16} \in e)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in e.\; (f(x_{16}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in e.\; \exists m_{16}.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, x_{16}, m_{16}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, e) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda z_{16} \in \operatorname{difference}(u, e).\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z_{16}) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z_{16})))), p, q, s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(u, f, x) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad e) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch4d-meromorphic.scm}{theorem-library/ch4d-meromorphic.scm}
\noindent{\small ch4d-meromorphic.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch4d/ch4d-meromorphic.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge ((|s| = n) \wedge (s \subseteq \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{difference}(u, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (s \subseteq \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{difference}(u, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, c, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \mathbb{C}, (\lambda v \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{power}((v - c), (j + 1))), w, ((j + 1) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}derivative-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}pole}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, c, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), \operatorname{singleton}(c)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge ((\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z))) = (h(z) + (-n \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - c)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}pole-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}decomposition}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, c, r, d, h. \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + (d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - c)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, c, 1) \wedge (\operatorname{residue}(f, c) = d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}derivative-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}pole}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, c, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c) = -n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}derivative-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in u, f, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, c, m) \wedge (1 \leq m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c) = m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pole-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, a, n, m.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, a, n) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, a, m)) \Rightarrow (n = m))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pole-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, a, n.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, a, n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pole\text{-}order}(f, a) = n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{argument-\allowbreak{}principle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall \mathit{mzs} \in \mathbf{Set}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mzs}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{difference}(u, s).\; ((f(x) = 0) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathit{mzs})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzs}.\; (f(x) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzs}.\; \exists m.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f, x, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, (\mathit{mzs} \cup s)) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(\mathit{mds}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, \mathit{mds}, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, (\mathit{mzs} \cup s)).\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{difference}(u, s), f, z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z)))), p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t, \mathit{mqx}))), \mathit{mzs}) + \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (-\operatorname{pole\text{-}order}(f, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t, \mathit{mqx}))), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{road-\allowbreak{}holomorphic-\allowbreak{}composite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge (\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}((\lambda \mathit{c4ct} \in \operatorname{ccint}(s, t).\; f(p(\mathit{c4ct}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{c4ct} \in \operatorname{ccint}(s, t).\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, p(\mathit{c4ct})) \cdot q(\mathit{c4ct}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad s, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}unfold-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, s, t, z. \\ \quad (\operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, z) \simeq (\operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(z)).\; \operatorname{recip}((w - z))), p, q, s, t))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{winding-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}composite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, p, q, s, t.; \forall w \in \mathbb{C}, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq v \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in v.\; \neg (f(y) = w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}((\lambda \mathit{c4ct} \in \operatorname{ccint}(s, t).\; f(p(\mathit{c4ct}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{c4ct} \in \operatorname{ccint}(s, t).\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, p(\mathit{c4ct})) \cdot q(\mathit{c4ct}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad s, t, w) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda z \in v.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((f(z) - w)))), p, q, s, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{circle-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - c)) = r)) \Rightarrow (y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{convex-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}path-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}homotopic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, p, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}path}(p, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad p(b) = p(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, a, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}restrict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, m, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad a \in v \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(v, \operatorname{restrict}(f, v), a, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zeros-\allowbreak{}poles-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall \mathit{mzs} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mzs}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzs}.\; (f(x) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \mathit{mzs} \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{mzs} \cup s) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |(\mathit{mzs} \cup s)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{mzs} \cup s) \subseteq u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rouche-\allowbreak{}theorem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall \mathit{mpf} \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall \mathit{mzf}, \mathit{mpg} \in \mathbf{Set}, g.; \forall \mathit{mzg} \in \mathbf{Set}, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mpf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{mpf} \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpf}), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mpf}.\; \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mzf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpf}).\; ((f(x) = 0) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathit{mzf})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzf}.\; (f(x) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzf}.\; \exists m.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpf}), f, x, m) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mpg}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{mpg} \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpg}), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mpg}.\; \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(g, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mzg}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpg}).\; ((g(x) = 0) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathit{mzg})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzg}.\; (g(x) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzg}.\; \exists m.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpg}), g, x, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, ((\mathit{mzf} \cup \mathit{mpf}) \cup (\mathit{mzg} \cup \mathit{mpg}))) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(y) - g(y))) < \operatorname{magnitude}(g(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpf}), f, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, \mathit{mqx}))), \mathit{mzf}) + \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (-\operatorname{pole\text{-}order}(f, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, \mathit{mqx}))), \mathit{mpf}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpg}), g, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, \mathit{mqx}))), \mathit{mzg}) + \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (-\operatorname{pole\text{-}order}(g, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, \mathit{mqx}))), \mathit{mpg}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; (s(z) = (f(z) + g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; (s(z) = (f(z) \cdot g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}recip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, p), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, p), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; (s(z) = \operatorname{recip}(f(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{holomorphic-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}meromorphic-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u, f.; \forall a \in u.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, f, b, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, a), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, b), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(g, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(g, x, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{meromorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, (a \cup b)).\; (f(z) + g(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{meromorphic-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, f, b, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, a), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, b), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(g, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(g, x, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{meromorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, (a \cup b)).\; (f(z) \cdot g(z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zeros-\allowbreak{}count-\allowbreak{}winding}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, q \in \mathbb{R}, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; \neg (f(y) = w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = w)\} \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\{z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = w)\}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(u, (\lambda \mathit{c4nx} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{c4nx}) - w)), x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = w)\}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{winding}((\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; f(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r)(t))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r)(t)) \cdot \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r)(t)), \\ \quad \quad \quad 0, (2 \cdot \pi), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}card-\allowbreak{}induction}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|s| = n) \wedge (s \subseteq \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; 1), s) = n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{simple-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall b \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \exists w \in u.\; \neg (f(w) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad f(b) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, b) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, b, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{multiplicity-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}simple}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; (f(x) - f(a))), a, n) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (f(z) = f(a)) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{local-\allowbreak{}n-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; (f(x) - f(a))), a, n) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v, w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in v.\; (f(z) \in w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in w.\; \exists b \in v.\; (f(b) = y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in w.\; (\neg (y = f(a)) \Rightarrow (|\{b \in v : (f(b) = y)\}| = n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bgf-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, p)) \Rightarrow (p(\operatorname{vzero}(a)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bgf-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}nsum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(k) = p({y}^{k})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(h, n) = p(\sum_{k < n} {y}^{k}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bgf-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}conv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, p.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(a)), l \in \operatorname{vec}(a), h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(p(v)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), s, l) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(n) = p(s(n))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, h, p(l)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bgf-\allowbreak{}laurent-\allowbreak{}resolvent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(p(v)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(k) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(-(k + 1)) = p({x}^{k})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < \operatorname{magnitude}(z) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(c, 0, z) = p({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{bgf-\allowbreak{}resolvent-\allowbreak{}circle-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (s \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) = s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}) \leq m) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{gelfand-\allowbreak{}spectral-\allowbreak{}radius-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (s \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \rho({x}) \leq s \end{array}}}
