\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{pprod}(f, (n + p)) = (\operatorname{pprod}(f, n) \cdot \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; f((n + k))), p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}magnitude}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{pprod}(f, n)) = \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(f(k))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow \neg (f(j) = 0)) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{pprod}(f, n) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((j < n) \wedge (f(j) = 0)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pprod}(f, n) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}plus-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), n) - 1)) \\ \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))), n) - 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}bounds}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq r(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (1 + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(r, n)) \leq \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), n) \leq \exp\left(\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(r, n)\right) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 \leq x) \wedge (x \leq 1/2)) \Rightarrow (\exp\left((-2 \cdot x)\right) \leq (1 - x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}lower}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(a(i)) \leq 1/2) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exp\left((-2 \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k))), n))\right) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}mag-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), n)) \leq \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), (n + p)) - \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), n))) \\ \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))), (n + p)) - \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{r-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq x) \Rightarrow ((\exp\left(x\right) - 1) \leq (x \cdot \exp\left(x\right))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}ratio-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq r(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), (n + p)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), n) \cdot \exp\left((\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(r, (n + p)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(r, n))\right) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k))), i) \leq b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), (n + p)) - \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), n))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\exp\left(b\right) \cdot \exp\left(b\right)) \cdot (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k))), (n + p)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k))), n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(a(i)) \leq 1/2) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\neg (z = 0) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), n)), z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sps-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a((m + k)))), n) \\ \quad =\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k))), (m + n)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k))), m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a((m + k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}terms-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(a(q)) \leq 1/2) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l.\; \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l. \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l) \Rightarrow ((l = 0) \Leftrightarrow \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(q) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}convergent-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (l = 0) \Leftrightarrow \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 + a(q)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < f(i)) \Rightarrow (0 < \operatorname{pprod}(f, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}dec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < f(i)) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(i) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}(f, (n + p)) \leq \operatorname{pprod}(f, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}pprod}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq r(i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \log\left(\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), n)\right) = \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \log\left((1 + r(k))\right)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}omr-\allowbreak{}ratio}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq r(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq i) \Rightarrow (r(i) \leq 1/2)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 - r(k))), n) \cdot \exp\left((-2 \cdot (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(r, (n + p)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(r, n)))\right) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 - r(k))), (n + p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}opr-\allowbreak{}omr-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq r(i)) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq (\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), n) \cdot \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 - r(k))), n)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), n) \cdot \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 - r(k))), n)) \leq 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lemma-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < r(i)) \wedge (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), j) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lemma-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < r(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), j) \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lemma-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < r(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), j) \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \log\left((1 + r(k))\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lemma-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < r(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \log\left((1 + r(k))\right))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), j) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lemma-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}3}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < r(i)) \wedge (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < c) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c \leq \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 - r(k))), j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lemma-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < r(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < c) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c \leq \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 - r(k))), j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), j) \leq b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lemma-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 < r(i)) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (r(i) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \log\left((1 + r(k))\right))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), j) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + r(k))), j) \leq b \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < c) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c \leq \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 - r(k))), j)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}plus-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq 1/10) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + z)) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + z)) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + z)\right)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + z)\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{abs-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}terms-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}eps}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(a(q)) \leq e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{series-\allowbreak{}unshift-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a((m + k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}8-\allowbreak{}forward}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(a(q)) \leq 1/10)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + a((m + k)))\right)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}8-\allowbreak{}backward}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + a((m + k)))\right)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}8}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + a((m + k)))\right)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csps-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (f(j) = g(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csps-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) + g(k))), n) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) + \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csps-\allowbreak{}delta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, s \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (s < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k = s)\text{ then }c\text{ else }0\right)), n) = c) \wedge \\ \quad (n \leq s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k = s)\text{ then }c\text{ else }0\right)), n) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csps-\allowbreak{}trunc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k < n)\text{ then }a(k)\text{ else }0\right)), (n + p)) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(a, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{csps-\allowbreak{}mask}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad (\forall u, v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((g(u) = g(v)) \Rightarrow (u = v)) \wedge \forall u \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((u < m) \Rightarrow (g(u) < n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(g(k))), m) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }\exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((t < m) \wedge (g(t) = k))\text{ then }a(k)\text{ else }0\right)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rsps-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (f(j) = g(j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) = \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rsps-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) + g(k))), n) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n) + \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rsps-\allowbreak{}delta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, s \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (s < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k = s)\text{ then }c\text{ else }0\right)), n) = c) \wedge \\ \quad (n \leq s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k = s)\text{ then }c\text{ else }0\right)), n) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rsps-\allowbreak{}trunc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k < n)\text{ then }a(k)\text{ else }0\right)), (n + p)) = \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(a, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rsps-\allowbreak{}mask}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad (\forall u, v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((g(u) = g(v)) \Rightarrow (u = v)) \wedge \forall u \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((u < m) \Rightarrow (g(u) < n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(g(k))), m) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }\exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((t < m) \wedge (g(t) = k))\text{ then }a(k)\text{ else }0\right)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{surj-\allowbreak{}covers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(t) = w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (j < n) \Rightarrow \exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((t < m) \wedge (g(t) = j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}values-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall u \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (u < m) \Rightarrow (g(u) < n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rearrangement-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((g(u) = g(v)) \Rightarrow (u = v)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(g(k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rearrangement-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((g(u) = g(v)) \Rightarrow (u = v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(t) = w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(g(k))), \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pps-\allowbreak{}agree-\allowbreak{}below}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (f(j) = g(j))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pprod}(f, n) = \operatorname{pprod}(g, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pps-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(k) \cdot g(k))), n) = (\operatorname{pprod}(f, n) \cdot \operatorname{pprod}(g, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pps-\allowbreak{}delta}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, s \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (s < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k = s)\text{ then }c\text{ else }1\right)), n) = c) \wedge \\ \quad (n \leq s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k = s)\text{ then }c\text{ else }1\right)), n) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pps-\allowbreak{}trunc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }(k < n)\text{ then }a(k)\text{ else }1\right)), (n + p)) = \operatorname{pprod}(a, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pps-\allowbreak{}mask}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad (\forall u, v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((g(u) = g(v)) \Rightarrow (u = v)) \wedge \forall u \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((u < m) \Rightarrow (g(u) < n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(g(k))), m) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \left(\text{if }\exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((t < m) \wedge (g(t) = k))\text{ then }a(k)\text{ else }1\right)), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}partial-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l. \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pprod}(f, n)), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}rearrangement-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), l. \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((g(u) = g(v)) \Rightarrow (u = v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(t) = w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(g(k)))), n)), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{corollary-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}9}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((g(u) = g(v)) \Rightarrow (u = v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists t \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(t) = w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}abs\text{-}converges}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}abs\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(g(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + a(k))), l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(g(k)))(k))), l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, l) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, m)) \Rightarrow (l = m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges}(f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{prod\text{-}value}(f) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges\text{-}to}(f, \operatorname{prod\text{-}value}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{normal-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}compacta-\allowbreak{}pointwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), x \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; f(k)(x))(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}11}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), x \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{prod\text{-}value}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(x)))) = 0) \Leftrightarrow \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 + f(q)(x)) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sps-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}dominated}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n \in \mathbb{N}, f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(j) \leq g(j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, (n + p)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(f, n)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, (n + p)) - \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(g, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}estimate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), n \in \mathbb{N}, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge (\operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \forall j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad (m \leq j) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(z))), j) - \operatorname{prod\text{-}value}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(z)))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}12}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f) \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(x))), n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ppx-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f(i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(x))), n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}fun-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f(i)) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zeros-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}accumulating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, c. \\ \quad \neg \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, g, c) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall w \in u.\; (((w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \wedge \neg (w = c)) \Rightarrow \neg (g(w) = 0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}cover}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), c \in u, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \exists q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (q < n) \wedge ((1 + f(q)(x)) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((q < n) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; ((1 + f(q)(z)) = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nonneg-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}terms-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), e. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq g(i)) \wedge (\operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((m \leq q) \Rightarrow (g(q) \leq e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{corollary-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}13}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists w \in u.\; \neg ((1 + f(i)(w)) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)) \wedge \exists v \in u.\; \neg (\operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)(v) = 0)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ch6-fun.scm}{theorem-library/ch6-fun.scm}
\noindent{\small ch6-fun.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ch6/ch6-fun.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ppx-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(i) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(x))), n)) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(i) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rseries-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, g, t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq g(i)) \wedge (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (t(j) = g((m + j))) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rseries-\allowbreak{}untail-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, g, t \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq g(i)) \wedge (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (t(j) = g((m + j))) \wedge \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}(g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}plus-\allowbreak{}lower}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + z)) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + z)) \leq 0)) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + z)\right)) \leq 1/2)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + z)\right))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}14-\allowbreak{}forward}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, w \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n).\; \log\left((1 + f((m + k))(x))\right))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}14-\allowbreak{}backward}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(i) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, w \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n).\; \log\left((1 + f((m + k))(x))\right))), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(f, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}14}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(i) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, w \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n).\; \log\left((1 + f((m + k))(x))\right))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{corollary-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}16}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(i) \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, w \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + f(q)(w))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n).\; \log\left((1 + f((m + k))(x))\right))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}quotient}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), p, q \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (q = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (b(i) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, b, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(b(k)))), (p \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}deriv-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, p, g.; \forall h \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; (h(y) \simeq (p(y) \cdot g(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, h, z) \\ \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, p, z) \cdot g(z)) + (p(z) \cdot \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ppx-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}deriv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((1 + f(q)(z)) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(x))), n)), z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(z))), n) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; (1 + f(k)(x))), z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((1 + f(k)(z))))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prop-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}17}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)(z) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; (1 + f(k)(x))), z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((1 + f(k)(z)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f), z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)(z))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{power}((x \cdot c), n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}q-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot c), k))), n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}holomorphic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad (((1 - (x \cdot c)) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot c), k))), (n + 1))) - 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{recip-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \leq 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}partial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq 1/2) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), ((n + 1) + d)) - \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (2 \cdot (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), (n + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))) \cdot (1 - \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{log-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq 1/2) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\log\left((1 - z)\right) + \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), (n + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq 1/2) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(\exp z) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\exp z) \leq 0)) \wedge (\log\left(\exp z\right) = z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}exp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq 1/2) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (1 - z) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \exp (\log\left((1 - z)\right) + \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((1 - z) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1))) = 0 \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; z = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq 1/4) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(((1 - z) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(((1 - z) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left(((1 - z) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)))\right)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; 2 \cdot (\operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), (n + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (a = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 1 + (((1 - (z \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a))) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({k}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((z \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a)), k))), (n + 1))) - 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; z = a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}ratio-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (a = 0) \wedge ((0 \leq r) \wedge (((4 \cdot (r + 1)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a))) \leq 1/4) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((z \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a))) \leq (r \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{magnitude}(a))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}20-\allowbreak{}family}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (a(q) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(a(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{power}((r \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))), (u(k) + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((u(k) + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad f(k)(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((1 - (x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k)))) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{clhk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({\mathit{clhk}}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k))), \mathit{clhk}))), (u(k) + 1))) - 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(\mathbb{C}, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(\mathbb{C}, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(\mathbb{C}, f)(z) = 0) \Leftrightarrow \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z = a(q))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}n}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(j) = s((n + j))) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, h, l) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{prod\text{-}converges}(f) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; f((n + k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}value}(f) = (\operatorname{pprod}(f, n) \cdot \operatorname{prod\text{-}value}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; f((n + k))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{prod-\allowbreak{}normal-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; f((n + k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}order-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C})), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (a(q) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad f(k)(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((1 - (x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k)))) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{clhk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({\mathit{clhk}}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k))), \mathit{clhk}))), (u(k) + 1))) - 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\mathbb{C}, (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (1 + f(n)(x))), a(n), 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weier-\allowbreak{}pp-\allowbreak{}order}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C})), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (a(q) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad f(k)(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((1 - (x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k)))) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{clhk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({\mathit{clhk}}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k))), \mathit{clhk}))), (u(k) + 1))) - 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\mathbb{C}, (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + f(k)(x))), n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad z, \operatorname{count\text{-}hits}(a, z, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}20-\allowbreak{}multiplicity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C})), z \in \mathbb{C}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (a(q) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(a(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{power}((r \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))), (u(k) + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((u(k) + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad f(k)(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((1 - (x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k)))) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{clhk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({\mathit{clhk}}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k))), \mathit{clhk}))), (u(k) + 1))) - 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq q) \Rightarrow \neg (a(q) = z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(\mathbb{C}, f), z, \operatorname{count\text{-}hits}(a, z, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zero-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, h.; \forall a \in u, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; ((\operatorname{power}((y - a), m) \cdot g(y)) = (\operatorname{power}((y - a), m) \cdot h(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(a) = h(a) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{gamma-\allowbreak{}factor-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad 1 + (\lambda \mathit{c6k} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (((1 - (x \cdot \operatorname{recip}((\lambda \mathit{c6gk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; -(\mathit{c6gk} + 1))(\mathit{c6k})))) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{clhk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({\mathit{clhk}}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}((\lambda \mathit{c6gk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; -(\mathit{c6gk} + 1))(\mathit{c6k}))), \mathit{clhk}))), ((\lambda \mathit{c6gk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; 1)(\mathit{c6k}) + 1))) - 1)))(k)(z) \\ \quad =\; (1 + (z \cdot \operatorname{recip}((k + 1)))) \cdot \exp -(z \cdot \operatorname{recip}((k + 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pprod-\allowbreak{}exp-\allowbreak{}harmonic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{pprod}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exp -(z \cdot \operatorname{recip}((k + 1)))), m) \\ \quad =\; \exp -(z \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{recip}((j + 1))), m)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{inequality-\allowbreak{}186}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge (t \leq (n + 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq (\exp\left(-t\right) - \operatorname{power}((1 - (t \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))), (n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\exp\left(-t\right) - \operatorname{power}((1 - (t \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))), (n + 1))) \leq (((t \cdot t) \cdot \exp\left(-t\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{power-\allowbreak{}lin-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}on-\allowbreak{}rhp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{C}, a \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}, \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; \operatorname{power}((1 - (w \cdot c)), (k + 1))), \\ \quad \quad a, (((k + 1) \cdot \operatorname{power}((1 - (a \cdot c)), k)) \cdot -c)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{truncated-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < m) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge (r < m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{r}^{m} (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; (\operatorname{power}((1 - (w \cdot \operatorname{recip}(m))), 0) \cdot \exp ((z - 1) \cdot \log\left(w\right)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; ((\exp (z \cdot \log\left(m\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z)) - (\exp (z \cdot \log\left(r\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{truncated-\allowbreak{}integral-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < m) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge (r < m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \int_{r}^{m} (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; (\operatorname{power}((1 - (w \cdot \operatorname{recip}(m))), (k + 1)) \cdot \exp ((z - 1) \cdot \log\left(w\right)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; -(\operatorname{power}((1 - (r \cdot \operatorname{recip}(m))), (k + 1)) \cdot (\exp (z \cdot \log\left(r\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z))) + (((k + 1) \cdot (\operatorname{recip}(m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z))) \cdot \int_{r}^{m} (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; (\operatorname{power}((1 - (w \cdot \operatorname{recip}(m))), k) \cdot \exp (((z + 1) - 1) \cdot \log\left(w\right))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{boundary-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, e. \\ \quad ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad d \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (r < d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((\exp (z \cdot \log\left(r\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z))) \leq e) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{truncated-\allowbreak{}value-\allowbreak{}recursion}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((0 < m) \wedge (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\exp (z \cdot \log\left(m\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + (z \cdot \operatorname{recip}((q + 1))))), (k + 1))) \\ \quad \quad =\; ((k + 1) \cdot (\operatorname{recip}(m) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z))) \cdot ((\exp ((z + 1) \cdot \log\left(m\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z + 1))) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + ((z + 1) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((q + 1))))), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{truncated-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}, e. \\ \quad ((0 < m) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge ((r < d) \wedge (r < m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\int_{r}^{m} (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; (\operatorname{power}((1 - (w \cdot \operatorname{recip}(m))), k) \cdot \exp ((z - 1) \cdot \log\left(w\right)))) - ((\exp (z \cdot \log\left(m\right)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(z)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{pprod}((\lambda q \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 + (z \cdot \operatorname{recip}((q + 1))))), k))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integrand-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}, t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge ((0 < t) \wedge (t \leq (n + 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z)(t) - (\operatorname{power}((1 - (t \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))), (n + 1)) \cdot \exp ((z - 1) \cdot \log\left(t\right))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}((\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) + 2))(t)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{integral-\allowbreak{}difference-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z)) \wedge ((0 < r) \wedge (r < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\int_{r}^{((n + 1) + 1)} \operatorname{gamma\text{-}integrand}(z) - \int_{r}^{((n + 1) + 1)} (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u))\}.\; (\operatorname{power}((1 - (w \cdot \operatorname{recip}(((n + 1) + 1)))), ((n + 1) + 1)) \cdot \exp ((z - 1) \cdot \log\left(w\right)))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (1 + (2 \cdot \exp (((\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) + 2) \cdot (\log\left((2 \cdot (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(z) + 2))\right) - 1)) - 1/2))) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(((n + 1) + 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}pos-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(f))) \Rightarrow (0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ms-\allowbreak{}locally-\allowbreak{}constant-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{pts}(s). \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall b \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((\operatorname{dist}(s)(a, b) \leq d) \Rightarrow (f(b) = f(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, t, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z, u, v \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\neg (z = 0) \wedge ((z \cdot u) = (z \cdot v))) \Rightarrow (u = v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow (i(\operatorname{zero}(f)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow ((i(\operatorname{neg}(f)(x)) \cdot i(x)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)(x) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(a, x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, b, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)(c) \cdot \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, b)(c)) = \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, \operatorname{add}(f)(a, b))(c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}conj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{conjugate}(\operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)(b)) = \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, \operatorname{neg}(f)(a))(b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}psi-\allowbreak{}separates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \neg (a = \operatorname{zero}(f)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, c)(a) = \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{zero}(f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge (\operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a) = \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}15-\allowbreak{}core}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall b, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, c)) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(a) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i(a) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; f(\operatorname{mul}(a)(c, x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}bichar-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, y) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(a, \operatorname{mul}(f)(x, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}bichar-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a) \in ((\operatorname{carr}(f) \times \operatorname{carr}(f)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}bicharacter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, y) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(y, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) \cdot g(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, (\lambda x \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (i(x) \cdot a(x)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ch-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, \operatorname{neg}(f)(\operatorname{one}(f)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((i(x) \cdot \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, \operatorname{neg}(f)(\operatorname{one}(f)))(x)) = 1) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{subgroup-\allowbreak{}adjoin-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall c \in (h \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}), b \in \operatorname{carr}(g), m \in \mathbb{N}, t \in \mathbb{C}, p_{1} \in h, k_{1} \in \mathbb{Z}, p_{2} \in h, k_{2} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in h.\; (c(\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, v)) = (c(u) \cdot c(v))) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, m, b) \in h \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq j) \wedge (j < m)) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, j, b) \in h)) \wedge \\ \quad c(\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, m, b)) = \exp (m \cdot t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{opr}(g)(p_{1}, \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k_{1}, b)) = \operatorname{opr}(g)(p_{2}, \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, k_{2}, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (c(p_{1}) \cdot \exp (k_{1} \cdot t)) = (c(p_{2}) \cdot \exp (k_{2} \cdot t)) \end{array}}}
