\vnbentry{\texttt{subgroup-\allowbreak{}adjoin-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 1 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, m, b) \in h \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq j) \wedge (j < m)) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(g, j, b) \in h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ag-\allowbreak{}trivial-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, \{y_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (y_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z_{0} \in \{y_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (y_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}.\; 1) \in (\{y_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (y_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g))\} \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall u, v \in \{y_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (y_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda z_{0} \in \{y_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (y_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}.\; 1)(\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, v)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; (\lambda z_{0} \in \{y_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (y_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}.\; 1)(u) \cdot (\lambda z_{0} \in \{y_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (y_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}.\; 1)(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subgroup-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h.; \forall c \in (h \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}), b \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in h.\; (c(\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, v)) = (c(u) \cdot c(v))) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h_{2}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad h \subseteq h_{2} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad b \in h_{2} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c_{2} \in (h_{2} \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\forall u, v \in h_{2}.\; (\operatorname{c2}(\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, v)) = (\operatorname{c2}(u) \cdot \operatorname{c2}(v))) \wedge \forall x \in h.\; (\operatorname{c2}(x) = c(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}character-\allowbreak{}separates}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall x_{0} \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (x_{0} = \operatorname{iden}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\operatorname{carr}(g) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(g).\; (c(\operatorname{opr}(g)(u, v)) = (c(u) \cdot c(v))) \wedge \neg (c(x_{0}) = 1)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/padic-laws.scm}{theorem-library/padic-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small padic-laws.scm -- THE p-ADIC ABSOLUTE VALUE ON QQ AND CCR.pdf 1.19-1.21, 1.24, and Remark 5.21 (the p-adic character of Q; that section cites ch-cc-cancel, so theorem-library/ccr4-chars must load first).  Vocabulary: structure-library/padic-vocab.scm.  Agent PADIC, wave MAP-1026, 2026-10-26.  Destination: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{power}(p, n) \in \mathbb{Z})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}zz}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p \in \mathbb{Z}, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{power}(p, n) \in \mathbb{Z})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((2 \leq p) \Rightarrow ((n + 1) \leq \operatorname{power}(p, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}ge}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p \in \mathbb{Z}, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((2 \leq p) \Rightarrow ((n + 1) \leq \operatorname{power}(p, n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}dvd-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, n.; \forall c \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, n) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, (c \cdot n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}dvd-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, a) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, (a + b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}dvd-\allowbreak{}refl}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, d)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}dvd-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}dvd-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, n.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, n) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, -n))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}dvd}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p \in \mathbb{Z}, k, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((k \leq j) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{power}(p, k), \operatorname{power}(p, j)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}dvd-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, n.\; ((\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, n) \wedge \neg (n = 0)) \Rightarrow (\lvert d \rvert \leq \lvert n \rvert))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}euclid}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, (a \cdot b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, a) \vee \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}cancel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q, x, y \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((\neg (q = 0) \wedge ((q \cdot x) = (q \cdot y))) \Rightarrow (x = y))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (n = 0)) \Rightarrow \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, n, k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, n.; \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, n, i) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, n, j))) \Rightarrow (i = j) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}mult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{Z}, i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, a, i) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, b, j))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, (a \cdot b), (i + j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{Z}, i, j, s, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, b, j) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, (a + b), s) \wedge \\ \quad m \leq i \wedge \\ \quad m \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, 1, 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}p}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, p, 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < c) \wedge ((a \cdot c) = (b \cdot c))) \Rightarrow (a = b))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \exists w.\; \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, w))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, v) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, w))) \Rightarrow (v = w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}iota}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, (\iota\, v.\;((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, v)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p) \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, v)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, a, b \in \mathbb{Z}, i, j \in \mathbb{N}, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \neg (x = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = 0) \wedge \\ \quad (x \cdot b) = a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, b, j) \wedge \\ \quad (v \cdot \operatorname{power}(2, i)) = \operatorname{power}(2, j) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a \leq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{power}(2, a) \leq \operatorname{power}(2, b)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}pos}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, v)) \Rightarrow ((0 \leq v) \wedge (\neg (x = 0) \Rightarrow (0 < v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, 0, 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall z \in \mathbb{Q}, u.; \forall n, d \in \mathbb{Z}, s, t \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, z, u) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad (z \cdot d) = n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, d, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (u \cdot \operatorname{power}(2, s)) = \operatorname{power}(2, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}ultra-\allowbreak{}num}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i, j, l, s \in \mathbb{N}, u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq v) \wedge (((i + l) \leq s) \wedge (((u \cdot \operatorname{power}(2, s)) = \operatorname{power}(2, (j + l))) \wedge ((v \cdot \operatorname{power}(2, i)) = \operatorname{power}(2, j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u \leq v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}, v, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, v) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, y, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, (x \cdot y), (v \cdot w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}, v, w, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, v) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, y, w) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, (x + y), u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u \leq \operatorname{max}(v, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}rel}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{padic\text{-}rel}(p, x, \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (x = 0)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x \cdot y)) = (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) \cdot \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x + y)) \leq \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x), \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pz-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}triangle}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x + y)) \leq (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) + \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pq-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = \mathbb{Q}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pq-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{Q}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pq-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{Q}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pq-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = (\lambda x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; -x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pq-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pq-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pq-\allowbreak{}fnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qq-\allowbreak{}padic-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qq-\allowbreak{}padic-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}nv-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}bezout-\allowbreak{}prime}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall b \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m, n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (((m \cdot p) + (n \cdot b)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}bezout-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, p, b \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \exists m, n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (((m \cdot p) + (n \cdot b)) = 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m, n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (((m \cdot \operatorname{power}(p, k)) + (n \cdot b)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}bezout-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall b \in \mathbb{Z}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m, n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (((m \cdot \operatorname{power}(p, k)) + (n \cdot b)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(1) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(n) \leq 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(p), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(p), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(2, j) \leq \operatorname{power}(2, i)) \Rightarrow (j \leq i))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}prime-\allowbreak{}not-\allowbreak{}dvd-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}denominator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, b) \wedge ((x \cdot b) \in \mathbb{Z})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, m, y, n, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (((m \cdot y) + (n \cdot b)) = 1) \Rightarrow ((x + -((x \cdot b) \cdot n)) = ((x \cdot m) \cdot y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}nv-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) = \{x \in \mathbb{Q} : (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) \leq 1)\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}raw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x + -h)) \leq \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{power}(p, k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((n \cdot y)) \leq \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}19}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 \leq h) \wedge ((h < \operatorname{power}(p, k)) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x - h)) \leq \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(p), k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, \operatorname{power}(p, k), k))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(2, k)) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}two-\allowbreak{}beats}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (1 < (r \cdot \operatorname{power}(2, k))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}z-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) \subseteq \mathbb{Q}) \wedge (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(x, y) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x + -y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}21}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{totally\text{-}bounded}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) = \mathbb{Q})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) = (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{Q}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) = (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{Q}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) = (\lambda x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; -x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) = 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}fnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) = f)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f(x) \in \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq f(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), x \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow ((f(x) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (x = 0)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}law}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f((x \cdot y)) = (f(x) \cdot f(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}law}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f(-x) = f(x)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qn-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f((x + y)) \leq \operatorname{max}(f(x), f(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f(1) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f(n) \leq 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f(m) \leq 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}all-\allowbreak{}units}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \wedge (\neg \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((0 < n) \wedge (f(n) < 1)) \wedge \neg (m = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(m) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}nv}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((0 < n) \wedge (f(n) < 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}prime}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), p \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < p \wedge \\ \quad f(p) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((0 < e) \wedge (f(e) < 1)) \Rightarrow (p \leq e)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}units}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), p.; \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge ((f(p) < 1) \wedge \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(m) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), p \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \Rightarrow (f(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) = \operatorname{power}(f(p), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}), p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge ((f(p) < 1) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, n, i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(n) = \operatorname{power}(f(p), i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}24}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}nv}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad r < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, a, b \in \mathbb{Z}, i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\neg (x = 0) \wedge (\neg (b = 0) \wedge (((x \cdot b) = a) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, a, i) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, b, j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, j)) = \operatorname{power}(r, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}20}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(h, x) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\forall e \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot e) = 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot (r + s)) = (\exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot r) \cdot \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot r) = 1) \Rightarrow (r \in \mathbb{Z}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\forall r \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot r) \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall w \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(-w) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(w)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, m)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(m) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}frac-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall y \in \mathbb{Q}, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge ((\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(y) \leq 1) \wedge ((y \cdot \operatorname{power}(p, m)) \in \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow (y \in \mathbb{Z}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \exists r.\; \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, r))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}, r, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, r) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, y, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, (x + y), (r + s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}shift}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, y, r) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x + -y)) \leq 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}int}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, r, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, r) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (r + -s) \in \mathbb{Z} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, r, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, r) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot r) = \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}iota}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\iota\, w.\;((w \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \exists \mathit{cpr} \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, \mathit{cpr}) \wedge (w = \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot \mathit{cpr}))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{padic\text{-}frac\text{-}rep}(p, x, r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(x) = \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)((x + y)) = (\operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(x) \cdot \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x + -y)) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(x) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(x) = 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p) \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pc-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p) \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{C})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}20-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p), \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}21}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(x) = 1) \Leftrightarrow (x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/qp-laws.scm}{theorem-library/qp-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small qp-laws.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ccrqp/qp-laws.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}isosceles}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((x + -y)) < \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(y) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}init-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Q}). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 \leq b) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n < k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(f(n)) \leq b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 \leq b) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(f(n)) \leq b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Q}). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (b \leq a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((f(a) + -g(a))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cseq\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Q}), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{cseq\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f, g) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (b \leq a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((f(a) + -g(a))) \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Q}). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a, c \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((b \leq a) \wedge (b \leq c)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((f(a) + -f(c))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a, c \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((b \leq a) \wedge (b \leq c)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((f(a) + -f(c))) \leq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) + g(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; -f(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall c \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \cdot g(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (h \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Q}). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cseq\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), f, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 0)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b \leq a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(f(a)) \leq s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}member-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b \leq a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(h(a)) \leq s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(n) + b(n))) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; -a(n)) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 0) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p), a \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (x(n) \cdot a(n))) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p), a \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(n) \cdot x(n))) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}sadd-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(u, v)(k) = (u(k) + v(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}smul-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}smul}(p)(u, v)(k) = (u(k) \cdot v(k))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}sadd-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p) \in ((\operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p) \times \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p)) \to \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}smul-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}smul}(p) \in ((\operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p) \times \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p)) \to \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}cs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 1) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}cs}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall z \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p).\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (z \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.; \forall h \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p).\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Q})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}sadd-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(u, v) = (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(n) + v(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}smul-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}smul}(p)(u, v) = (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (u(n) \cdot v(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}sneg-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}sneg}(p)(u) = (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; -u(n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p) \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}csr-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}csr}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p)))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}csr-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}csr}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{qp\text{-}smul}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}csr-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}csr}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{qp\text{-}sneg}(p)))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}null-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(a, \operatorname{qp\text{-}sneg}(p)(b)) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{cseq\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), a, b) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}rel}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}csr}(p)) = \operatorname{crel}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}csr}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}smul-\allowbreak{}comm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}smul}(p)(u, v) = \operatorname{qp\text{-}smul}(p)(v, u)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p), v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x(n))), v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x)) = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}null}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x)) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}const}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p), a \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x(k)) = c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x)) = c \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(x, y)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 0)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 0)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p) \end{array}}}
