\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(a, \operatorname{qp\text{-}sneg}(p)(b)) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), a) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}ultra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(x, y))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{max}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}ne-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 0)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}seq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(\operatorname{qp\text{-}smul}(p)(x, y), \operatorname{qp\text{-}sneg}(p)((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 1))) \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}null}(p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ring}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}fnrm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}nv-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}converges}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x(n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}26-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp}(p)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{qp}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{qp}(p))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}sadd}(p)(x, \operatorname{qp\text{-}sneg}(p)(y)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}26-\allowbreak{}carrier}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qp}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}26-\allowbreak{}metric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qp}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{qp}(p))(a, b) = \operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(a, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}26-\allowbreak{}embed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{qp}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(v)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((u + -v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}26-\allowbreak{}zp}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zp}(p) \simeq \{v \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qp}(p)) : (\operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(v) \leq 1)\}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p), b \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x(k)) \leq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x)) \leq a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}eventually-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{qp\text{-}cs}(p). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), x)) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(x(k)) \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}28}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall h \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(h) \in \operatorname{zp}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{zp}(p), s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{qp}(p))(a, \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(h)) < s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}fractions-\allowbreak{}aux}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall q \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (v = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(k)(q, v) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}fractions-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}integers}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}29}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}translation-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall t \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda v \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k)).\; \operatorname{add}(k)(t, v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}translate-\allowbreak{}integers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall t \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k)).\; \operatorname{add}(k)(t, v)), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), t, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}integers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\neg (a = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(a) < s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u) \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qp}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u)) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{qp}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(z) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{qp}(p))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 0)), z) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}zp-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zp}(p) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{qp}(p), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; 0)), 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{qp}(p) \simeq \operatorname{completion}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}zp-\allowbreak{}totally-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{totally\text{-}bounded}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{qp}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}zp-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{qp}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}metric-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \simeq \operatorname{qp}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}elements}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (a = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(a) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}18}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}rational-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall q \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (q = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(q) = {2}^{m}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = {2}^{m}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}ord-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = {2}^{m})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) = -m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}ppos-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, k))) = {2}^{-k} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}ppos-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (\operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = {2}^{k}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}31}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}. \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) = n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}halves}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{max}(k, 0) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((\operatorname{max}(-k, 0) \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((\operatorname{max}(k, 0) + -\operatorname{max}(-k, 0)) = k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u, w \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\operatorname{mul}(k)(v, w) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}ppow-\allowbreak{}def}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, \operatorname{max}(-k, 0)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, \operatorname{max}(k, 0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}ppow-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k)) = {2}^{-k} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}32}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x)), x) \in \operatorname{zp}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, q), x) \in \operatorname{zp}(p)) \Rightarrow (-\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \leq q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}ultrametric}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subspace-\allowbreak{}ultrametric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \in \operatorname{power}(a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall u, v \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}] \in (a \times a).\; \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}))(u, v) = \operatorname{add}(k)(u, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall u, v \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}] \in (a \times a).\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}))(u, v) = \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall u \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow ((\lambda \mathit{rsu} \in a.\; \operatorname{neg}(k)(\mathit{rsu}))(u) = \operatorname{neg}(k)(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}] \in (a \times a).\; \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_})) \in ((a \times a) \to a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}] \in (a \times a).\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_})) \in ((a \times a) \to a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow ((\lambda u \in a.\; \operatorname{neg}(k)(u)) \in (a \to a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}] \in (a \times a).\; \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}] \in (a \times a).\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{rsu\_}, \operatorname{rsv\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq (\lambda u \in a.\; \operatorname{neg}(k)(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq \operatorname{zero}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq \operatorname{one}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}idl}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{idl}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall b, c \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)), b) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)), c) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{add}(k)(b, \operatorname{neg}(k)(c)) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rs-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)) \simeq \operatorname{eps\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a), 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}7}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, a)) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, a))| \in \mathbb{N}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow ((u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(u) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x, y, u, w \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, w) = u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(y, u) = w \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) = \operatorname{one}(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}ppow-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, -k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}10}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{Z}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad x = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{Z}, u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k)) = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v, \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (k = l) \wedge (u = v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \simeq \mathbb{Z})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \simeq 1)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \simeq (\lambda x \in \mathbb{Z}.\; -x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_}))(u, v) = (u + v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_}))(u, v) = (u \cdot v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}val}}{\vnbstmt{\forall u \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((\lambda x \in \mathbb{Z}.\; -x)(u) = -u)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}pz-\allowbreak{}power}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\{n \in \mathbb{Z} : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, n)\} \in \operatorname{power}(\mathbb{Z})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{fp\text{-}ringoid}(p)) \simeq \mathbb{Z}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{fp\text{-}ringoid}(p)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} + \operatorname{y\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{fp\text{-}ringoid}(p)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{x\_}, \operatorname{y\_}] \in (\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}).\; (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{y\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{fp\text{-}ringoid}(p)) \simeq (\lambda x \in \mathbb{Z}.\; -x)))}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}idl}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{idl}(\operatorname{fp\text{-}ringoid}(p)) \simeq \{n \in \mathbb{Z} : \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, n)\}) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}eq-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{fp\text{-}ringoid}(p)), a) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{fp\text{-}ringoid}(p)), b) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, (a + -b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{fp-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{fp}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{power}(x, 1) = x)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(n) < 1) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}fp-\allowbreak{}iso}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, k, a, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad o \in (\mathbb{Z} \to a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m, n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad (o((m + n)) = \operatorname{add}(k)(o(m), o(n))) \wedge (o((m \cdot n)) = \operatorname{mul}(k)(o(m), o(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (o(-m) = \operatorname{neg}(k)(o(m))) \wedge \\ \quad o(0) = \operatorname{zero}(k) \wedge \\ \quad o(1) = \operatorname{one}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((o(m) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in a. \exists m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(b, \operatorname{neg}(k)(o(m))) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}ring\text{-}iso}(\operatorname{fp}(p), \operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, a), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}22}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring\text{-}iso}(\operatorname{fp}(p), \operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))((u + v)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))((u \cdot v)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(-u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(0) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(1) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}24}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}ring\text{-}iso}(\operatorname{fp}(p), \operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)), f) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}p}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)(p) \cdot 2) = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}rpow-\allowbreak{}half}}{\vnbstmt{\forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (({2}^{m} < 1) \Rightarrow (({2}^{m} \cdot 2) \leq 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}principal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}nn}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p, u.; \forall x \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(n), x) \in u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}int-\allowbreak{}mult}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u.; \forall x \in u, n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(n), x) \in u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qo-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}subgroup-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}13}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), u) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u = \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)).\; (u = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}ppow-\allowbreak{}char}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}, s, t \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge ((s + -t) = k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, t))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}ppow-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(p)) = \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (k + 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \simeq \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \simeq \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, a, n.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, 0) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}succ}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a, n.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, (m + 1)) \simeq \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, m), \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(a((n + m))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (n + m))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}psum-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, m) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}ultra-\allowbreak{}lt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v, w \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v))) < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(w))) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(w))) < r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}ultra-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v, w \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v))) \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(w))) \leq r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(w))) \leq r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}diff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall u, v \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(v)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((u + -v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall d, e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge ((0 \leq d) \wedge ((d < p) \wedge ((0 \leq e) \wedge ((e < p) \wedge (\operatorname{padic\text{-}abs}(p)((d + -e)) < 1)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad d = e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}qp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), d, e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad d < p \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq e \wedge \\ \quad e < p \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(y, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(d)))) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(y, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(e)))) < 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d = e \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{zp}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 \leq g \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g < p \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(y, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(g)))) < 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}def}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{zp}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, y) \in \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, y) < p \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(y, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, y))))) \\ \quad \quad <\; 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{zp}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{zp}(p). \\ \quad \quad \quad y \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, y)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(p), z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}digit-\allowbreak{}sequence}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall y \in \operatorname{zp}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{zp}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(0) = y \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f(k) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, f(k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(p), f((k + 1)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}rp-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\forall s, t \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((s \leq t) \Rightarrow ({2}^{s} \leq {2}^{t}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}rp-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((q \leq m) \Rightarrow ({2}^{-(n + m)} < s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}expand-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{zp}(p)), a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad f(k) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, f(k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(p), f((k + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a((n + j)) = \operatorname{qp\text{-}digit}(p, f(j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, n), f(0)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, m), \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (n + m)), f(m))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}expansion-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, -n), x) \in \operatorname{zp}(p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}tail-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), n \in \mathbb{Z}, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, (m + l)), \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, m)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; {2}^{-(n + m)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}tail}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), n \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{qp}(p), (\lambda \mathit{qtm} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, \mathit{qtm})), x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(x, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, m)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; {2}^{-(n + m)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}pad-\allowbreak{}psum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), l \in \mathbb{Z}, d \in \mathbb{N}, n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (((l + d) = n) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((k < n) \Rightarrow (a(k) = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, l, (d + m)) = \operatorname{qp\text{-}psum}(p, a, n, m) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}pad}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall l \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge (l \leq n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, l, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}same-\allowbreak{}start}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{N}, p, a, b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, b, n, x) \wedge (j < c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a((n + j)) = b((n + j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}unique-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, b.; \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, b, m, x) \wedge (n \leq m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a(k) = b(k) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}19}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a.; \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, b.; \forall m, k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, b, m, x)) \Rightarrow (a(k) = b(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}30}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad u \subseteq \operatorname{zp}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), \operatorname{zp}(p)), u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{zp}(p).\; (u = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}term-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), n \in \mathbb{Z}, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(a((n + j))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (n + j)))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(a((n + j))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (n + j)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(a((n + j))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (n + j)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; {2}^{-(n + j)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qe-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}convergent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(a((n + j))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (n + j)))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}ppow-\allowbreak{}rat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{power}(p, \operatorname{max}(k, 0)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(p, \operatorname{max}(-k, 0)))) \in \mathbb{Q} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k) = \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))((\operatorname{power}(p, \operatorname{max}(k, 0)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{power}(p, \operatorname{max}(-k, 0))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k, z \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(x, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(z))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; 1 \end{array}}}

\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}rat-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(x, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u)))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), u, v \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(x, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u)))) \\ \quad \leq\; 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(x, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(v)))) \\ \quad \leq\; 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(u) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), u \in \mathbb{Q}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(x, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(u)))) \\ \quad \leq\; 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda\text{-}at}(p, x) = \operatorname{padic\text{-}char}(p)(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}app}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p)(x) \simeq \operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda\text{-}at}(p, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p) \in (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qx-\allowbreak{}lam-\allowbreak{}type-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p) \in (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \to \mathbb{C})))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}20}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)).\; ((\operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p)(x) = 1) \Leftrightarrow (x \in \operatorname{zp}(p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}18-\allowbreak{}qp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge \neg (a(n) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = {2}^{-n} \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}dense-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \exists c \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, c) < b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(s, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}20-\allowbreak{}dense}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p))), \mathbb{Z}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}23-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \to a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(i(x)))) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (i(x) = x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))), i(x)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))), x) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, w \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq u) \wedge ((0 \leq w) \wedge ((u \cdot w) = 1))) \Rightarrow ((u < 1) \Leftrightarrow (1 < w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(k)(a, b) = \operatorname{one}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) < 1) \Leftrightarrow (1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}46-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}iii}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c)) \Leftrightarrow (1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) < 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) < 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}46-\allowbreak{}iii-\allowbreak{}iv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) < 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) < 1)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c)) \Leftrightarrow (1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}46-\allowbreak{}ii-\allowbreak{}v}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c)) \Leftrightarrow (1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) \leq 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) \leq 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}46-\allowbreak{}vi-\allowbreak{}v}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < l) \wedge \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) = {\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c)}^{l}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) \leq 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) \leq 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ideal-\allowbreak{}principal-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \wedge \\ \quad g \in i \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in i.\; \exists l \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(l, g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}max}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a). \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}13-\allowbreak{}converse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, a) \wedge (a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}13}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \end{array}}}
