\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}cancel-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, m, l \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < l) \Rightarrow (((p \cdot l) < (m \cdot l)) \Leftrightarrow (p < m)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}prod-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < q) \wedge ((q \cdot r) = 1)) \Rightarrow (((p \cdot q) < 1) \Leftrightarrow (p < r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}log-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\forall t, s \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 < t) \wedge (0 < s)) \Rightarrow ((t < s) \Leftrightarrow (\log\left(t\right) < \log\left(s\right))))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}cut-\allowbreak{}witness}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq u) \wedge (u < v)) \Rightarrow \exists m, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n \cdot u) < m) \wedge (m \leq (n \cdot v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}cut-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq u) \wedge ((0 \leq v) \wedge \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n \cdot u) < m) \Leftrightarrow ((n \cdot v) < m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u = v \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c9v-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x, a \in \operatorname{carr}(k), u \in \mathbb{R}, m, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(a) \wedge \\ \quad (u \cdot \log\left(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(a)\right)) = \log\left(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x)\right) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), x, n)) \\ \quad \quad <\; \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), a, m)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (n \cdot u) < m \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c9v-\allowbreak{}pow-\allowbreak{}same-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(a), x, n) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(b), x, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c9v-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall c, x \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) < 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) < 1)) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(b)(x) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(x) = {\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(x)}^{(\log\left(\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c)\right) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\log\left(\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c)\right)))} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}46-\allowbreak{}v-\allowbreak{}vi}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) \leq 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < l) \wedge \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) = {\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c)}^{l}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{metric-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}transfer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s_{1}, s_{2}, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{pts}(s_{2}) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(s_{1})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{pts}(s_{1}), r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists t.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(s_{1}, c, t) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(s_{2}, c, r))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s_{2}, o) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s_{1}, o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}transfer-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall l \in \mathbb{R}, c \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a)), r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(d) = {\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(d)}^{l}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists t. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), c, t) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), c, r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}transfer-\allowbreak{}root}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall l \in \mathbb{R}, c \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b)), r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(d) = {\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(d)}^{l}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists t. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), c, t) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), c, r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}46-\allowbreak{}vi-\allowbreak{}i}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < l) \wedge \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) = {\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c)}^{l}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), o) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), o) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}open-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall o. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), o) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) < 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) < 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}46-\allowbreak{}i-\allowbreak{}iii}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad (\operatorname{carr}(b) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{add}(b) = \operatorname{add}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{neg}(b) = \operatorname{neg}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(b) = \operatorname{mul}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(b) = \operatorname{zero}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{one}(b) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall o.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), o) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), o)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(c) < 1) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(c) < 1) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}2-\allowbreak{}23}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \to a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(i(x)))) < 1) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (i(x) = x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}ring\text{-}iso}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, a), \operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)), f) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}strict-\allowbreak{}anti}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{sq}, \mathit{tq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < q) \wedge ((q < 1) \wedge (\mathit{sq} < \mathit{tq}))) \Rightarrow ({q}^{\mathit{tq}} < {q}^{\mathit{sq}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}small}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q \in \mathbb{R}, p. \\ \quad ((0 < q) \wedge ((q < 1) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(p))) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{zq} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({q}^{\mathit{zq}} \leq p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) \leq {\mathit{rq}}^{\mathit{nq}}) \Leftrightarrow \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{nq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))) \simeq \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})))(\mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}neg}(q, \mathit{gq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})))(\mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \leq {\mathit{rq}}^{\mathit{nq}} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{nq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{gq}(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}converges-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{sq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)), \mathit{lq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})), \mathit{sq}, \mathit{lq}) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \exists \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall \mathit{iq} \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{mq} \leq \mathit{iq}) \wedge (j < \mathit{nq})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sq}(\mathit{iq})(j) = \operatorname{lq}(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}stab}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{sq}.; \forall \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge ((\mathit{rq} < 1) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})), \mathit{sq})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall \mathit{iq}, r \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{mq} \leq \mathit{iq}) \wedge ((\mathit{mq} \leq r) \wedge (j < \mathit{nq}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sq}(\mathit{iq})(j) = \operatorname{sq}(r)(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}limc-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{sq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)), \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \forall \mathit{iq} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mq} \leq \mathit{iq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sq}(\mathit{iq})(\mathit{jq}) = \operatorname{sq}(\mathit{mq})(\mathit{jq}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}limc}(q, \mathit{sq}, \mathit{jq}) \in \operatorname{carr}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{iq} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\mathit{mq} \leq \mathit{iq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sq}(\mathit{iq})(\mathit{jq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}limc}(q, \mathit{sq}, \mathit{jq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q, \mathit{sq}.; \forall \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}lim}(q, \mathit{sq})(\mathit{jq}) \simeq \operatorname{laurent\text{-}limc}(q, \mathit{sq}, \mathit{jq}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{sq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)), \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \forall \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \exists \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall \mathit{iq}, r \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{mq} \leq \mathit{iq}) \wedge ((\mathit{mq} \leq r) \wedge (j < \mathit{nq}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sq}(\mathit{iq})(j) = \operatorname{sq}(r)(j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall \mathit{iq} \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\mathit{mq} \leq \mathit{iq}) \wedge (j < \mathit{nq})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sq}(\mathit{iq})(j) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}lim}(q, \mathit{sq})(j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}lim-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{sq} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)). \\ \quad \forall \mathit{nq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \exists \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall \mathit{iq}, r \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{mq} \leq \mathit{iq}) \wedge ((\mathit{mq} \leq r) \wedge (j < \mathit{nq}))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{sq}(\mathit{iq})(j) = \operatorname{sq}(r)(j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}lim}(q, \mathit{sq}) \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}fnrm-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))(\mathit{fq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (\mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q)) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}x-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}abs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{zq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \operatorname{one}(q), \mathit{zq}) \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \operatorname{one}(q), \mathit{zq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \operatorname{one}(q), \mathit{zq})) = {\mathit{rq}}^{\mathit{zq}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}small-\allowbreak{}elements}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge ((\mathit{rq} < 1) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (s = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))(s) < p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polys-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, \mathit{mq}, \mathit{gq}. \\ \quad \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(q, \mathit{mq}) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((\mathit{mq} \leq j) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polys-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q, \mathit{mq}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(q, \mathit{mq}) \in \mathbf{Set}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}mono-\allowbreak{}off}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q), \mathit{tq}, \mathit{vq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \neg (\mathit{vq} = \mathit{tq})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \mathit{cq}, \mathit{tq})(\mathit{vq}) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polys-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(q, 0)| \in \mathbb{N}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polys-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{mq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(q)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|\operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(q, \mathit{mq})| \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(q, (\mathit{mq} + 1))| \in \mathbb{N} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polys-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{kq}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(\mathit{kq}) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(\mathit{kq})| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(\mathit{kq}, q)| \in \mathbb{N}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}trunc-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)), \mathit{zq} \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, \mathit{gq}, (\mathit{zq} + -1)) \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(q, \mathit{zq}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < \mathit{zq}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}trunc}(q, \mathit{gq}, (\mathit{zq} + -1))(j) = \operatorname{gq}(j))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polys-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}integers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{zq} \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}polys}(q, \mathit{zq}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}tb}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(q)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{totally\text{-}bounded}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(q)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}e-\allowbreak{}square}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) = 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (((z \cdot z) - 1) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(((z \cdot z) - 1))) = (((z - 1) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((z - 1))) \cdot (4 - ((z - 1) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((z - 1))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}nss-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, i.; \forall l \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((i(y) - 1)) < 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((n + 1) \cdot ((i(y) - 1) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}((i(y) - 1)))) < 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}nss}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall l \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((i(y) - 1)) < 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq l \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i(y) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}17-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq r) \Rightarrow (i(y) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}17}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}constant\text{-}fn}(f, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}16}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}constant\text{-}fn}(f, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}constant\text{-}fn}(f, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(f)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), e)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < b) \wedge \forall x \in e.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(f)), a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), q, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{char\text{-}converges}(f, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, q(k))), \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(f, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, w.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \Rightarrow (w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}maximal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(f, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(f, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, w.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \Rightarrow \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(f)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}nv-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, w.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (w \in \operatorname{carr}(f)) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w) < 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f) = \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}compact}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge (0 < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), r))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}lu-\allowbreak{}discrete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}10}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, s, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, s(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{char\text{-}converges}(f, s, i) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((n \leq m) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (s(m)(x) = i(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}15-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(a) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(k), a)) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(0), a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < b) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(q(k)) \leq b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}15}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(a) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(k), a)) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(0), a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(b) \wedge \exists l \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{subseq}(q, b), l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}chi-\allowbreak{}min-\allowbreak{}ind}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, w, i.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f), d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq a) \Rightarrow (i(y) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (i(b) = 1) \wedge \\ \quad d = (a - (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w) \cdot a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\neg (i(c) = 1) \wedge \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c)) \Rightarrow (i(y) = 1))) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (\neg (i(c) = 1) \wedge ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c) + (n \cdot d)) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}chi-\allowbreak{}min}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i, a.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq a) \Rightarrow (i(y) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (i(b) = 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\neg (i(c) = 1) \wedge \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c)) \Rightarrow (i(y) = 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, x.\; ((x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)) \Leftrightarrow ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(f)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq 1)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}polar-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, v, h. \\ \quad (h \in \operatorname{bichar\text{-}polar}(f, w, v)) \Leftrightarrow ((h \in \operatorname{carr}(f)) \wedge \forall x \in v.\; (w(h, x) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}14}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq r) \Rightarrow (i(y) = 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}converse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dualizing\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall x, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad w(x, b) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, c) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, b)(x, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}20}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f), w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dualizing\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall x, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad w(x, b) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(a, x), b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a, d \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(x, b) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(a, x), b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(x, b) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(d, x), b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad a = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}18-\allowbreak{}unipolar}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}21}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w.; \forall c, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, w) \wedge \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(f)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a \in \operatorname{bichar\text{-}polar}(f, w, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(c, a)) \leq 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c5-\allowbreak{}unipolar-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i, w.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (w(x, b) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(x, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}23}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i, w, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dualizing\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(b) = 1) \wedge \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (w(x, c) = q(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, x), c))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b, d \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (w(x, c) = q(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, x), c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (w(x, c) = q(\operatorname{mul}(f)(d, x), c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}6}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dualizing\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; \neg (w(x, y) = 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f), r, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, r) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (z \in \operatorname{carr}(f)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{add}(f)(x, \operatorname{neg}(f)(z))) \leq r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}ball0-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, r, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), r)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \operatorname{carr}(f)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(z) \leq r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((0 \leq r) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{add}(f)(x, \operatorname{neg}(f)(y))) \leq r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, r) = \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), y, r) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, s, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, s) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall s, b \in \mathbb{R}, c \in \operatorname{image}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge (s \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \varepsilon(c) \in \operatorname{carr}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\varepsilon(c)) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \varepsilon(c) \in c \wedge \\ \quad \quad c = \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \varepsilon(c), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}nv-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq r) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{add}(f)(x, y)) \leq r \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall s, b \in \mathbb{R}, c \in \operatorname{image}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge ((s \leq b) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(t) \leq b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{add}(f)(\varepsilon(c), t), s) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{image}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}back}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall s, b \in \mathbb{R}, c \in \operatorname{image}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b)), t \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge ((s \leq b) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(t) \leq b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(f)(\varepsilon(\operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{add}(f)(\varepsilon(c), t), s)), \operatorname{neg}(f)(t)), \\ \quad \quad \quad s) \\ \quad \quad =\; c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}fix}}{\vnbstmt{\forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\neg (z = 1) \wedge (w = (z \cdot w))) \Rightarrow (w = 0))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}orth}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall s, b \in \mathbb{R}, g.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b)) \to \mathbb{C}), h \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad s \leq b \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b))| \\ \quad \in\; \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (g(x) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (g(\operatorname{add}(a)(x, y)) = (g(x) \cdot g(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(a)(y) \leq s) \Rightarrow (g(y) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b)). \\ \quad \quad f(c) = g(\varepsilon(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(a)(h) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \neg (g(h) = 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{zero}(a), b))) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|s| = n) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) = 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), f, s) = n \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}cs-\allowbreak{}finite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w.; \forall s, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge ((0 < s) \wedge (s \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{image}((\lambda x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), x, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{zero}(f), b))| \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathbb{N} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}prod1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall u, v, p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(f)(u, v) = \operatorname{one}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(p) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(q) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(p, q)) \leq 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}gt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall u, v, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((\operatorname{mul}(f)(u, v) = \operatorname{one}(f)) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(u)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(v) < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(u, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}orth-\allowbreak{}a}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b.; \forall s, d \in \mathbb{R}, g.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, f \in (\operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d)) \to \mathbb{C}), h \in \operatorname{carr}(b). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(b) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad s \leq d \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d))| \\ \quad \in\; \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(b).\; (g(x) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(b).\; (g(\operatorname{add}(b)(x, y)) = (g(x) \cdot g(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(b).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(b)(y) \leq s) \Rightarrow (g(y) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d).\; \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d)). \\ \quad \quad f(c) = (a \cdot g(\varepsilon(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(b)(h) \leq d \wedge \\ \quad \neg (g(h) = 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{image}((\lambda \mathit{sdx} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \mathit{sdx}, s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(b), \operatorname{zero}(b), d))) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}mul1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall u, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(u, x)) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a, b, v \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((((a \cdot b) = 1) \wedge ((b \cdot v) = 1)) \Rightarrow (a = v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}dsum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i, u.; \forall c, a, g, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(m) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(m) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall h \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad (1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq 1) \wedge \neg (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(h, x)) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(f)(c, a) = \operatorname{one}(f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(y) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c)) \Rightarrow (u(y) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(f)(g, b) = \operatorname{one}(f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(b) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall q \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(q) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(g)) \Rightarrow (u(q) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(p, q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}ge1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((\operatorname{mul}(f)(u, v) = \operatorname{one}(f)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(u) \leq 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}pow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(f), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge ((\operatorname{mul}(f)(u, v) = \operatorname{one}(f)) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(u)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(u) \leq 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), u, k) \in \operatorname{carr}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), v, k) \in \operatorname{carr}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(f)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), u, k), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), v, k)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{one}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), u, k)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(u), k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), v, k)) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), u, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), u, k)) \leq 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad 1 \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), v, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}core}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(m) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(m) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall h \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad (1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq 1) \wedge \neg (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(h, x)) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (u(x) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(a, x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sdl-\allowbreak{}unipolar-\allowbreak{}phi}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, w)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, (\lambda \mathit{chx} \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; w(\operatorname{one}(f), \mathit{chx}))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall m \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(m) \leq 1) \Rightarrow ((\lambda \mathit{chx} \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; w(\operatorname{one}(f), \mathit{chx}))(m) = 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall h \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad (1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(x) \leq 1) \wedge \neg ((\lambda \mathit{chx} \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; w(\operatorname{one}(f), \mathit{chx}))(\operatorname{mul}(f)(h, x)) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}13}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (u = \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}13-\allowbreak{}dualizing}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dualizing\text{-}character}(f, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}3-\allowbreak{}converse-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad w(x, c) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, b)(x, c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; \neg (w(x, y) = 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}20-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f), w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall x, d \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad w(x, d) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, x), d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b, g \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, d \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(x, d) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, x), d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, d \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(x, d) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(g, x), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b = g \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}23-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i, w, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(b) = 1) \wedge \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (w(x, c) = q(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, x), c))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall b, d \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (w(x, c) = q(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, x), c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (w(x, c) = q(\operatorname{mul}(f)(d, x), c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}18}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sdw}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, \mathit{sdw}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, \mathit{sdw})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}22-\allowbreak{}forward}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, w.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(f)), i, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(f, w) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), q, i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; w(q(n), b)), w(i, b)) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small ccr1109a5-pairing.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-A5), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109a5/ccr1109a5-pairing.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}principal-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall h \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(h) < 1) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(h) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(f, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(f, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}uniformizer-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}gap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall h \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(h) < 1) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(h) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(w))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}abs-\allowbreak{}lt-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge ((\mathit{rq} < 1) \wedge (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) < 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) \leq \mathit{rq} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}local-\allowbreak{}uniformizer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(q)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mono}(q, \operatorname{one}(q), 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}coeff-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), \mathit{jq} \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{fq}(\mathit{jq}) \in \operatorname{carr}(q))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))(\mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))(\mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, c.; \forall \mathit{uq}, \mathit{vq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(\mathit{uq}, \mathit{vq}) \simeq c(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{vq}, \mathit{uq})(0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, c \in (\operatorname{carr}(q) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}), \mathit{yq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})).\; c(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{yq}, z)(0))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}section-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, c \in (\operatorname{carr}(q) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}), \mathit{yq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \mathit{rq} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{rq} < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (c(\operatorname{add}(q)(x, y)) = (c(x) \cdot c(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})).\; c(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \mathit{yq}, z)(0)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}bilinear-\allowbreak{}symmetric}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, c \in (\operatorname{carr}(q) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \mathit{rq} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{rq} < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (c(\operatorname{add}(q)(x, y)) = (c(x) \cdot c(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(x, y) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(y, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}triv-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}parts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}nf}(q), c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad c \in (\operatorname{carr}(q) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (c(\operatorname{add}(q)(x, y)) = (c(x) \cdot c(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; \neg (c(x) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lp-\allowbreak{}nontrivial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, c \in (\operatorname{carr}(q) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \mathit{rq} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{rq} < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (c(\operatorname{add}(q)(x, y)) = (c(x) \cdot c(y))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; \neg (c(x) = 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})).\; c(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}mul}(q, \operatorname{laurent\text{-}one}(q), z)(0)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(a, b) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}10}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(q)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \mathit{rq} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{rq} < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}nf}(q), c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(x, y) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(y, x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)) \end{array}}}
