\vnbentry{\texttt{finite-\allowbreak{}field-\allowbreak{}nontrivial-\allowbreak{}character}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(q)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}nf}(q), c) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}10-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}field}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(q)| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(\operatorname{triv\text{-}nf}(q), c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(x, y) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)(y, x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}), \operatorname{laurent\text{-}pairing}(q, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coeff-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{cq} \in \operatorname{carr}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q).\; (\operatorname{fq}(0) = \mathit{cq}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}coeff-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(0) = \operatorname{add}(q)(\operatorname{fq}(0), \operatorname{gq}(0))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}unit-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}integers}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) \leq 1) \Leftrightarrow (\mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}coeff-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, t.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q) \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \mathit{rq} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{rq} < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p, a \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (p(j) = a(j))) \Rightarrow (f(p) = f(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})), t, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rpow-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}least-\allowbreak{}exponent}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, o \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((0 < q) \wedge ((q < 1) \wedge ((0 < o) \wedge \forall t \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (({q}^{t} \leq o) \Rightarrow (-z < t))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ({q}^{n} \leq o) \wedge \forall a \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (({q}^{a} \leq o) \Rightarrow (n \leq a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}order}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq}, o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge ((\mathit{rq} < 1) \wedge (0 < o)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad {\mathit{rq}}^{n} \leq o \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((m < n) \Rightarrow (o < {\mathit{rq}}^{m})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}abs}(q, \mathit{rq}, \mathit{fq}) \leq o) \Leftrightarrow \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, s.; \forall \mathit{fq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (s \subseteq \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow ((\lambda i \in s.\; \operatorname{fq}(i)) \in (s \to \operatorname{carr}(q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}restrict-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, s.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq \mathbb{Z} \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\neg (j \in s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\neg (j \in s) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda i \in s.\; \operatorname{fq}(i)) = (\lambda i \in s.\; \operatorname{gq}(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \mathit{fq} = \mathit{gq} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{zz-\allowbreak{}extend-\allowbreak{}by-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, s.; \forall h \in (s \to \operatorname{carr}(q)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge (s \subseteq \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \left(\text{if }(i \in s)\text{ then }h(i)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(q)\right)) \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (j \in s) \Rightarrow ((\lambda i \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \left(\text{if }(i \in s)\text{ then }h(i)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(q)\right))(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad (\lambda i \in s.\; (\lambda i \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \left(\text{if }(i \in s)\text{ then }h(i)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(q)\right))(i)) = h \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i)) \in (\{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall h \in (\{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)). \exists \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i)) = h \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((j < n) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gq}(j) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \wedge ((\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\}.\; \operatorname{gq}(i)) = h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{gq} = \mathit{fq} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}product-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), x \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\}.\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(i))(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(q)((\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i))(x), (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (n \leq k)\}.\; \operatorname{gq}(i))(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polar-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i)) \in (\{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{Z}. \forall x \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (x < b) \Rightarrow ((\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i))(x) = \operatorname{zero}(q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall h \in (\{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\} \to \operatorname{carr}(q)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \forall x \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; ((x < b) \Rightarrow (h(x) = \operatorname{zero}(q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q).\; ((\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i)) = h) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polar-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{rq} \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(q) \wedge ((0 < \mathit{rq}) \wedge (\mathit{rq} < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathit{fq} \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}nf}(q, \mathit{rq})) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i))(x) = \operatorname{zero}(q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{laurent-\allowbreak{}polar-\allowbreak{}part-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q.; \forall \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq} \in \operatorname{laurent\text{-}set}(q), x \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(q) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}add}(q, \mathit{fq}, \mathit{gq})(i))(x) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{add}(q)((\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; \operatorname{fq}(i))(x), (\lambda i \in \{k \in \mathbb{Z} : (k < 0)\}.\; \operatorname{gq}(i))(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}remark-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall w \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge ((\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}remark-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall w \in a, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge ((\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w) \in a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}remark-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}4}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall w, b \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (b = \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}remark-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}5}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall w, b \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge ((\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, b) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((b \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{is-\allowbreak{}fractions-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}mono}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, b. \\ \quad ((a \subseteq b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, a)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, a) \simeq \operatorname{ringoid\text{-}quotient\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, a)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}class}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \simeq \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))), \operatorname{zero}(k))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}maximal-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}zf}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \in f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \subseteq \operatorname{nv\text{-}zf}(k, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}20-\allowbreak{}collapse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k), f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \in f \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}zf}(k, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a) \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a), s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in a.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(b))) < s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \exists b \in a.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(b))) < s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}near-\allowbreak{}scaled}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), a), c \in \operatorname{carr}(k), b, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((a \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(d))) < b) \wedge ((\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(c) \cdot \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, \operatorname{neg}(k)(d)))) < s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}recip-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p, u, v \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((((p \cdot u) = 1) \wedge ((p \cdot v) = 1)) \Rightarrow (u = v))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(k)(x) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(x, y) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}smul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall c \in s, y \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(c, y) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s).\; (\operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) = \operatorname{one}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}subfield}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}gen}(k, x) \simeq \{z \in \operatorname{carr}(k) : \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{carr}(k)).\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge (x \subseteq s)) \Rightarrow (z \in s))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, x.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}gen}(k, x) \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (x \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k))) \Rightarrow (x \subseteq \operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}gen}(k, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, x.; \forall s \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{carr}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge (x \subseteq s)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}gen}(k, x) \subseteq s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}subfield}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, \operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}gen}(k, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w) \simeq \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}gen}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base\text{-}gen}(k, w)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}base\text{-}gen}(k, w) \simeq \{z \in \operatorname{carr}(k) : ((z = w) \wedge \exists p.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}gen-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, w.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{nv\text{-}base\text{-}gen}(k, w) \subseteq \operatorname{carr}(k)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}subfield}}{\vnbstmt{\forall k, w.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}contains-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}gen}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base\text{-}gen}(k, w)) \subseteq \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}p}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k), p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w, z. \\ \quad \forall p.\; \neg \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (z \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base\text{-}gen}(k, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}21-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \cap \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}21-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}p}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}23-\allowbreak{}base-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}p}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < 1) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4b-remark418.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4b-remark418.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4b-remark418.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-C3), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109c3/ccr4b-remark418.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}remark-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}18}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, b, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b(n) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4c-local.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4c-local.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4c-local.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-C4), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109c4/ccr4c-local.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sub-\allowbreak{}nf-\allowbreak{}local}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall w \in s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \cap s))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}nf}(k, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}21}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}nf}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}residue-\allowbreak{}zz-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad n, \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}quotient\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad n, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}quotient\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{ringoid\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{nv\text{-}res\text{-}ringoid}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}act}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad n, \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}4-\allowbreak{}21-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}0}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p.\; \neg \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{sub\text{-}nf}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr6-e.scm}{theorem-library/ccr6-e.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr6-e.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-D3), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109d3/ccr6-e.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}qp-\allowbreak{}uniformizer}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}nontrivial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((i(x) = 1) \Leftrightarrow (x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}20-\allowbreak{}nontrivial}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}18-\allowbreak{}qp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unipolar}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}vs-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}vs-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \simeq \operatorname{add}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \simeq \operatorname{mul}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}scal-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \simeq \operatorname{one}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(f), x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(d)(r, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(f), x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(r, s), x) = \operatorname{act}(d)(r, \operatorname{act}(d)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d.; \forall r, s \in \operatorname{carr}(f), x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{add}(f)(r, s), x) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{act}(d)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(d)(s, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{one}(f), x) = x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d.; \forall r \in \operatorname{carr}(f), x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(d)(r, \operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(\operatorname{act}(d)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(d)(r, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}epolar-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, w, v, h. \\ \quad (h \in \operatorname{e\text{-}polar}(d, w, v)) \Leftrightarrow ((h \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \forall x \in v.\; (w(h, x) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, u, r, x.\; ((x \in \operatorname{norm\text{-}ball}(d, u, r)) \Leftrightarrow ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (u(x) \leq r)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}30}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d, u, w.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f), a \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}unipolar}(f, d, u, w) \wedge \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(f)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (a \in \operatorname{e\text{-}polar}(d, w, \operatorname{norm\text{-}ball}(d, u, \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c)))) \Leftrightarrow (u(\operatorname{act}(d)(c, a)) \leq 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}wk-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k.; \forall a, l \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad k(\operatorname{mul}(f)(a, l), \operatorname{one}(f)) = k(l, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}32-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, b, c.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (k(b(u, v), \operatorname{one}(f)) = k(c(u, v), \operatorname{one}(f))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b(u, v) = c(u, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}wk-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k.; \forall a, b, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad k(\operatorname{add}(f)(a, b), y) = (k(a, y) \cdot k(b, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}wk-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k.; \forall a, b, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad k(y, \operatorname{add}(f)(a, b)) = (k(y, a) \cdot k(y, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, b.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; k(b(\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}), \operatorname{one}(f)))(u, v) \\ \quad \quad =\; k(b(u, v), \operatorname{one}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; k(b(\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}), \operatorname{one}(f))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; ((\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}69-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, a.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f), u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; k(a(\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}), \operatorname{one}(f)))(\operatorname{act}(d)(b, u), v) \\ \quad \quad =\; k(a(u, v), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}69-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, a.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f), u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; k(a(\operatorname{c6p\_}, \operatorname{c6q\_}), \operatorname{one}(f)))(u, \operatorname{act}(d)(b, v)) \\ \quad \quad =\; k(a(u, v), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}32-\allowbreak{}converse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f), u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (e(\operatorname{act}(d)(b, u), v) = k(a(u, v), b)) \wedge (e(u, \operatorname{act}(d)(b, v)) = k(a(u, v), b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (e(u, v) = k(a(u, v), \operatorname{one}(f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}char-\allowbreak{}finsum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, i, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (i(x) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(a).\; (i(\operatorname{opr}(a)(x, y)) = (i(x) \cdot i(y))) \wedge \\ \quad i(\operatorname{iden}(a)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (g(z) = i(f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i(\operatorname{finsum}(a, f, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad g, \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}wij-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d, w.; \forall e, a \in \operatorname{vec}(d), y, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{c6s\_}, \operatorname{c6t\_}] \in (\operatorname{carr}(f) \times \operatorname{carr}(f)).\; w(\operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{c6s\_}, e), \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{c6t\_}, a)))(y, x) \\ \quad \quad =\; w(\operatorname{act}(d)(y, e), \operatorname{act}(d)(x, a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}wij-\allowbreak{}bilinear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d, w.; \forall e, a \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{c6s\_}, \operatorname{c6t\_}] \in (\operatorname{carr}(f) \times \operatorname{carr}(f)).\; w(\operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{c6s\_}, e), \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{c6t\_}, a)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}24-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f), d, w.; \forall e, b \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{c6a} \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall y, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad w(\operatorname{act}(d)(y, e), \operatorname{act}(d)(x, b)) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\mathit{c6a}, y), x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall \mathit{c6a}, \mathit{c6b} \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(\operatorname{act}(d)(y, e), \operatorname{act}(d)(x, b)) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\mathit{c6a}, y), x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(\operatorname{act}(d)(y, e), \operatorname{act}(d)(x, b)) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\mathit{c6b}, y), x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{c6a} = \mathit{c6b} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d, w.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad w(\operatorname{vzero}(d), y) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, d, w.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad w(y, \operatorname{vzero}(d)) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}l}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, w.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bicharacter}(a, d, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad w(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), f, \operatorname{interval}(1, n)), y) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; w(f(i), y)), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6-\allowbreak{}w-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}r}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, w.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bicharacter}(a, d, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad w(y, \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), f, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; w(y, f(i))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}24-\allowbreak{}expand}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, w.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bicharacter}(a, d, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (h(z) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad w(\operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), f, \operatorname{interval}(1, n)), \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), h, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; w(f(i), h(j))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr6-f.scm}{theorem-library/ccr6-f.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr6-f.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent CCR-1109-D4), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/ccr1109d4/ccr6-f.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6f-\allowbreak{}wk-\allowbreak{}inj}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; (k(x, b) = k(y, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6f-\allowbreak{}lambda-\allowbreak{}raw}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in ((\operatorname{vec}(d) \times \operatorname{vec}(d)) \to \operatorname{carr}(f)). \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d), b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad e(\operatorname{act}(d)(b, u), v) = k(l(u, v), b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}32-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f), u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (e(\operatorname{act}(d)(b, u), v) = k(l(u, v), b)) \wedge (e(u, \operatorname{act}(d)(b, v)) = k(l(u, v), b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}32}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k, d, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}faithful\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f), u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (e(\operatorname{act}(d)(b, u), v) = k(l(u, v), b)) \wedge (e(u, \operatorname{act}(d)(b, v)) = k(l(u, v), b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall m.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, d, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(f), u, v \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (e(\operatorname{act}(d)(b, u), v) = k(m(u, v), b)) \wedge (e(u, \operatorname{act}(d)(b, v)) = k(m(u, v), b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad m(u, v) = l(u, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}24}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, b.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f), d, w.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(f, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, d, w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (e(z) \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), y, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(\operatorname{act}(d)(y, e(i)), \operatorname{act}(d)(x, e(j))) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, b, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\operatorname{entry}(m, i, j), y), x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n), y, x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad w(\operatorname{act}(d)(y, e(i)), \operatorname{act}(d)(x, e(j))) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, b, c)(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, j), y), x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad p = m \end{array}}}
