\vnbentry{\texttt{c6h-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}bilinear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (1 \leq n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}bilinear\text{-}form}(f, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda [\operatorname{c6hp\_}, \operatorname{c6hq\_}] \in (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n)) \times \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n))).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n, \operatorname{c6hp\_}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), x, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n, \operatorname{c6hq\_}), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{c6h-\allowbreak{}row}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(f)), x, i, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f))(c, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), a, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n, x), 1, n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad i, 1)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{one}(f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; k(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\operatorname{entry}(a, i, j), c), x(j))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}24-\allowbreak{}converse-\allowbreak{}66}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(f)), y, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k(\operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n, y), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), a, \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}row}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n, x), 1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1, 1), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{one}(f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; k(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\operatorname{entry}(a, i, j), y(i)), x(j))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}6-\allowbreak{}24-\allowbreak{}converse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, k.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, k) \wedge (1 \leq n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}e\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, \operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n), w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y, x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}pow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(f), n)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad w(y, x) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}cm}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; k(\operatorname{mul}(f)(\operatorname{entry}(a, i, j), y(i)), x(j))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/pruefer-laws.scm}{theorem-library/pruefer-laws.scm}
\noindent{\small pruefer-laws.scm -- WAVE 2 (2026-10-27..30), wired 2026-10-30 from scratchpad/ccrpr/pruefer-laws.scm. Library: complex-analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nfag-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f)) \simeq \operatorname{carr}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nfag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f)) \simeq \operatorname{add}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nfag-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f)) \simeq \operatorname{zero}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nfag-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f)) \simeq \operatorname{neg}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}integers-\allowbreak{}subgroup}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}separating-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}character}(f, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f)), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)), x)) = l(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)))(c, d)) = (b(c) \cdot b(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (b(c) = b(d)) \Rightarrow (c = d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}22}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p.\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}lambda-\allowbreak{}separating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}character}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}23}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}character}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x)) = l(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p))(c, d)) = (b(c) \cdot b(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (b(c) = b(d)) \Rightarrow (c = d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}gpow-\allowbreak{}embed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gpow}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), x, n) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(n), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}ppow-\allowbreak{}nat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, n) = \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(\operatorname{power}(p, n))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}pruefer-\allowbreak{}order}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (-\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) = n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(p, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}1-\allowbreak{}33}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (0 \leq -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(p, -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}24}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x \in \operatorname{zp}(p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (x \in \operatorname{zp}(p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(p, -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}gpow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, q, b.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (b(c) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad b(\operatorname{iden}(q)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (b(\operatorname{opr}(q)(c, d)) = (b(c) \cdot b(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b(\operatorname{gpow}(q, c, n)) = \operatorname{power}(b(c), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{qp-\allowbreak{}lambda-\allowbreak{}onto-\allowbreak{}roots}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall w \in \operatorname{mu\text{-}pinf}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p)(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(r)) = w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}25}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)), \operatorname{mu\text{-}pinf}(p)). \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p))(c, d)) = (f(c) \cdot f(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{root-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (1 \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{power}(\exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot (j \cdot \operatorname{recip}(n))), m) = 1) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(n, (j \cdot m)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{coprime-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}primitive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad ((1 \leq n) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(j, n)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot (j \cdot \operatorname{recip}(n))) \in \operatorname{primitive\text{-}roots}(n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{primitive-\allowbreak{}root-\allowbreak{}coprime}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, j \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad ((1 \leq n) \wedge (\exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot (j \cdot \operatorname{recip}(n))) \in \operatorname{primitive\text{-}roots}(n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(j, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{root-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}unity-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((1 \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{power}(z, n) = 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (z = \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot (r \cdot \operatorname{recip}(n)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{root-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad ((1 \leq n) \wedge (\exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot (a \cdot \operatorname{recip}(n))) = \exp (((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot (b \cdot \operatorname{recip}(n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{euler-\allowbreak{}primitive-\allowbreak{}roots}}{\vnbstmt{\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq n) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{primitive\text{-}roots}(n)| = \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ccr-\allowbreak{}5-\allowbreak{}26}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{primitive\text{-}roots}(\operatorname{power}(p, (k + 1)))| = (\operatorname{power}(p, (k + 1)) + -\operatorname{power}(p, k)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-lft-group.scm}{theorem-library/ca-lft-group.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-lft-group.scm -- Cor. 1.19 of complex-analysis.pdf: the linear fractional transformations form a group under composition. CA-LFT, 2026-10-19.  Library: complex-analysis.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-lft-vocab.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lfts-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d) \in \mathit{lfts}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lfts-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in \mathit{lfts}.\; (f \in (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lfts-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f, g \in \mathit{lfts}.\; (\operatorname{compose}(f, g) \in \mathit{lfts})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{id-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}lfts}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}) \in \mathit{lfts}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}adjugate-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{lft}(d, -b, -c, a), \operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)) = \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}adjugate-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d), \operatorname{lft}(d, -b, -c, a)) = \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}adjugate-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}. \\ \quad \neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(d, -b, -c, a)(\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)(u)) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}adjugate-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}. \\ \quad \neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)(\operatorname{lft}(d, -b, -c, a)(u)) = u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d) \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}bij}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d)^{-1} = \operatorname{lft}(d, -b, -c, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lfts-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\mathit{lfts} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lfts-\allowbreak{}inverse-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\forall f \in \mathit{lfts}.\; (f^{-1} \in \mathit{lfts})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}opr-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} (\lambda [\operatorname{lfg\_}, \operatorname{lfh\_}] \in (\mathit{lfts} \times \mathit{lfts}).\; \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{lfg\_}, \operatorname{lfh\_})) \\ \in\; ((\mathit{lfts} \times \mathit{lfts}) \to \mathit{lfts}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}inv-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{(\lambda g \in \mathit{lfts}.\; g^{-1}) \in (\mathit{lfts} \to \mathit{lfts})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}group-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}group}(\operatorname{lft\text{-}group})}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-lft-matrix.scm}{theorem-library/ca-lft-matrix.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-lft-matrix.scm -- Prop. 1.18 of complex-analysis.pdf in matrix form: S |-$>$ L\_S from the invertible 2-by-2 complex matrices onto the linear fractional transformations is a surjective homomorphism whose kernel is the scalar multiples of the identity. CA-LFT, 2026-10-19.  Library: complex-analysis.  Vocabulary: ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}matmul-\allowbreak{}2x2-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, q \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}), i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, 2). \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), p, q), i, k) \\ \quad =\; (\operatorname{entry}(p, i, 1) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(q, 1, k)) + (\operatorname{entry}(p, i, 2) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(q, 2, k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}2x2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \\ \quad =\; ((\operatorname{entry}(s, 1, 1) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(s, 2, 2)) - (\operatorname{entry}(s, 1, 2) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(s, 2, 1))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}mat22-\allowbreak{}entries}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}([[a, b], [c, d]], 1, 1) = a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}([[a, b], [c, d]], 1, 2) = b \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}([[a, b], [c, d]], 2, 1) = c \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}([[a, b], [c, d]], 2, 2) = d \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}mat}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}invertible-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}nonzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \neg (((\operatorname{entry}(s, 1, 1) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(s, 2, 2)) - (\operatorname{entry}(s, 1, 2) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(s, 2, 1))) = 0) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}det-\allowbreak{}nonzero-\allowbreak{}invertible}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \neg (((\operatorname{entry}(s, 1, 1) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(s, 2, 2)) - (\operatorname{entry}(s, 1, 2) \cdot \operatorname{entry}(s, 2, 1))) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}literal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}([[a, b], [c, d]]) = \operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}lfts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(s) \in \mathit{lfts} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s, t)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(s), \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in \mathit{lfts}. \exists s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \wedge (f = \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(s) = \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})) \Leftrightarrow \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; (s = [[r, 0], [0, r]]) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-lft-sl2.scm}{theorem-library/ca-lft-sl2.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-lft-sl2.scm -- Cor. 1.20 of complex-analysis.pdf: S |-$>$ L\_S restricted to the matrices of determinant 1 is a surjective homomorphism onto the linear fractional transformations, with kernel \{I, -I\}. CA-LFT, 2026-10-19.  Library: complex-analysis.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-lft-vocab.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}sqrt-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\neg (d = 0) \Rightarrow \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((r \cdot r) = d))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v, k \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg (k = 0) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{homog\text{-}point}((k \cdot u), (k \cdot v)) = \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(u, v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lft-\allowbreak{}scale-\allowbreak{}invariant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, k \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\neg (((a \cdot d) - (b \cdot c)) = 0) \wedge \neg (k = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lft}((k \cdot a), (k \cdot b), (k \cdot c), (k \cdot d)) = \operatorname{lft}(a, b, c, d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sl2-\allowbreak{}matmul-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, t) = 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad 2, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s, t)) \\ \quad \quad =\; 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sl2-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, t) = 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(\operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s, t)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{compose}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(s), \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sl2-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in \mathit{lfts}. \exists s \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad ((\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) = 1) \wedge (f = \operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(s))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sl2-\allowbreak{}lft-\allowbreak{}kernel}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \operatorname{mat}(2, 2, \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{det}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), 2, s) = 1) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mat\text{-}lft}(s) = \operatorname{id\text{-}fun}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})) \Leftrightarrow ((s = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]) \vee (s = [[-1, 0], [0, -1]])) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ca-hopf-fibration.scm}{theorem-library/ca-hopf-fibration.scm}
\noindent{\small ca-hopf-fibration.scm -- THE HOPF FIBRATION: complex-analysis.pdf s. 1.6.3, Prop. 1.22, Def. 1.23, Cor. 1.24.  CA-HOPF, 2026-10-25.  Library: complex-analysis. Destination: theorem-library/ca-hopf-fibration.scm.  Vocabulary: structure-library/ca-hopf-vocab.scm.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc2-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w. \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere} \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; w \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, w))) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)))) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}cr-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr} \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((p \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{R})) \wedge (((\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, p)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))) + (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) \cdot \operatorname{nth}(2, p))) = 1)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}([a, b]) \\ \quad =\; [(2 \cdot (a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b))), ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) - (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b)))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc2-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ([a, b] \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}) \Leftrightarrow (((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}cr-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ([z, r] \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr}) \Leftrightarrow (((\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) + (r \cdot r)) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}first}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((2 \cdot (a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b)))) = (2 \cdot (\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}identity}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((2 \cdot (a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b)))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((2 \cdot (a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b))))) + (((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) - (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \cdot ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) - (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b)))) \\ \quad =\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \cdot ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad [(2 \cdot (a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b))), ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) - (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b)))] \\ \quad \in\; (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}cr}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; (\operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(w) \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}maps-\allowbreak{}sphere}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}.\; (\operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(w) \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}magnitude-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(x) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(x)) = (x \cdot x))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}onto-\allowbreak{}sphere}}{\vnbstmt{\forall p \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr}.\; \exists w \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}.\; (\operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(w) = p)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}conjugate-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda w \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{conjugate}(w)), y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, h, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, g, x) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (h(q) = \operatorname{conjugate}(g(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, h, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, p, q, h, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, p, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, q, x) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hcq} \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (h(\mathit{hcq}) = (p(\mathit{hcq}) \cdot q(\mathit{hcq}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, h, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}const-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, h, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (h(q) = c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, h, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, r, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f, x) \wedge ((r \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \forall q \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(q) = r(q)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, r, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hr-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}sub-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g, h, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, f, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, x) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (h(q) = (f(q) - g(q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, h, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}coords-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, b, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (2 \cdot (a(z) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b(z))))), x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a(z)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a(z))) - (\operatorname{magnitude}(b(z)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b(z))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, b, x)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}([a(z), b(z)]))), x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}([a(z), b(z)]))), x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}nonneg-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((0 \leq x) \wedge ((x \cdot x) = 1)) \Rightarrow (x = 1))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}unimodular-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}([(r \cdot a), (r \cdot b)]) = \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}([a, b])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}fibre-\allowbreak{}pair}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(c)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(d) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(d))) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad (2 \cdot (a \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(b))) = (2 \cdot (c \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) - (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \\ \quad =\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(c)) - (\operatorname{magnitude}(d) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge ((c = (r \cdot a)) \wedge (d = (r \cdot b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}fibre-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}. \\ \quad \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(u) = \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(v) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge (v = [(r \cdot \operatorname{nth}(1, u)), (r \cdot \operatorname{nth}(2, u))])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc2-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}unimodular}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(c)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(d) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(d))) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad c = (r \cdot a) \wedge \\ \quad d = (r \cdot b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{homog-\allowbreak{}point-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(a)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(b) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(c)) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(d) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(d))) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(a, b) = \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge ((c = (r \cdot a)) \wedge (d = (r \cdot b)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}cr-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr} \subseteq (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{R})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{unit-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}cr-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr} \in \mathbf{Set}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{hopf\text{-}quotient\text{-}map} \in (\operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr}. \\ \quad \operatorname{hopf\text{-}quotient\text{-}map}(p) = \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(\operatorname{nth}(1, p), (1 - \operatorname{nth}(2, p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}. \\ \quad \operatorname{hopf\text{-}quotient\text{-}map}(\operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(u)) = \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(\operatorname{nth}(1, u), \operatorname{nth}(2, u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}onto}}{\vnbstmt{\forall w \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}.\; \exists z \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr}.\; (\operatorname{hopf\text{-}quotient\text{-}map}(z) = w)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{hopf\text{-}quotient\text{-}map}(a) = \operatorname{hopf\text{-}quotient\text{-}map}(b)) \Rightarrow (a = b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{hopf\text{-}quotient\text{-}map} \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}factors-\allowbreak{}through-\allowbreak{}bijection}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \exists g \in (\operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}). \\ \quad g \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{unit\text{-}sphere\text{-}cr}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hat}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}.\; (g(\operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(u)) = \operatorname{homog\text{-}point}(\operatorname{nth}(1, u), \operatorname{nth}(2, u))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc2-\allowbreak{}sphere-\allowbreak{}equiv-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}. \\ \quad \operatorname{homog\text{-}equiv}(u, v) \Leftrightarrow \exists r \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge (u = [(r \cdot \operatorname{nth}(1, v)), (r \cdot \operatorname{nth}(2, v))])) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}fibre-\allowbreak{}equiv}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, v \in \operatorname{cc2\text{-}sphere}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(u) = \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(v)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{homog\text{-}equiv}(u, v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}identity-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(w))) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(w)))) + (\operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(w)) \cdot \operatorname{nth}(2, \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(w))) \\ \quad =\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, w))) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)))) \cdot ((\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, w)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(1, w))) + (\operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w)))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/product2-hopf.scm}{theorem-library/product2-hopf.scm}
\noindent{\small product2-hopf.scm -- Prop. 1.22 of the complex-analysis notes in its literal form: "pi is continuous C\textasciicircum{}2 -$>$ C x R", with C\textasciicircum{}2 = PRODUCT2-MS(CC-MS, CC-MS) and C x R = PRODUCT2-MS(CC-MS, RR-MS).  Helper prefix p2h-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms})) \simeq (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{product2-\allowbreak{}cc-\allowbreak{}rr-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \simeq (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{R}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \\ \quad \quad (\lambda v \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(v)), w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hopf-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}continuous-\allowbreak{}product}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), \\ \quad (\lambda v \in (\mathbb{C} \times \mathbb{C}).\; \operatorname{hopf\text{-}map}(v))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/gal-ch.scm}{theorem-library/gal-ch.scm}
\noindent{\small gal-ch.scm -- general Cayley-Hamilton for a linear operator on a finite-dimensional space (GALOIS B6, 2026-10-26), with its general bricks: a homomorphism of abelian groups passes through a finite sum; the determinant commutes with a ring homomorphism; the operators p(T) form a commutative ring F[T] with the evaluation ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, h, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(a, b, h) \wedge \forall i \in \mathrm{OS}(n).\; (g(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(a, g, n)) = \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(b, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; h(g(k))), n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}finsum-\allowbreak{}interval}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, f \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, n) \to \operatorname{carr}(a)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(a, b, h) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h(\operatorname{finsum}(a, f, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) = \operatorname{finsum}(b, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; h(f(z))), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, x, y.; \forall h \in (x \to y), a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, x). \\ \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}map}(h, m, n, a) \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, x, y.; \forall h \in (x \to y), a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, x), i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}map}(h, m, n, a), i, j) = h(\operatorname{entry}(a, i, j)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hom-\allowbreak{}monoid-\allowbreak{}mpow}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a, b, h.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}monoid}(a, b, h) \Rightarrow (h(\operatorname{mpow}(a, x, k)) = \operatorname{mpow}(b, h(x), k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{minor-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}map}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b, c.; \forall h \in (\operatorname{carr}(b) \to \operatorname{carr}(c)), n \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(b)), p, q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{minor}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}map}(h, (n + 1), (n + 1), a), p, q, n) = \operatorname{mat\text{-}map}(h, n, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, p, q, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{det-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, b, c, h.; \forall a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(b)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}ring}(b, c, h) \Rightarrow (h(\operatorname{det}(b, n, a)) = \operatorname{det}(c, n, \operatorname{mat\text{-}map}(h, n, n, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p)(w) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}ops}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p) \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d))) \wedge (\operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p) \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ops-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ops}(d, t) \simeq \{f \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) : \exists p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; (f = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ops-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall f \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ((f \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(d))) \wedge \exists p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))).\; (f = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ops-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}set}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ops}(d, t) \in \mathbf{Set}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}pneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(p), w) = \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}poly}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w) = w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}add}(d, t)(\operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p), \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, q)) = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}mul}(d, t)(\operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p), \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, q)) = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(p, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}neg-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}neg}(d, t)(\operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p)) = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))(p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}zero}(d) = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}one}(d) = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}alg-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)) \simeq \operatorname{ops}(d, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}alg-\allowbreak{}add}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)) \simeq \operatorname{op\text{-}add}(d, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}alg-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)) \simeq \operatorname{op\text{-}mul}(d, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}alg-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)) \simeq \operatorname{op\text{-}neg}(d, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}alg-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)) \simeq \operatorname{op\text{-}zero}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}alg-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{one}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)) \simeq \operatorname{op\text{-}one}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ops-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}add}(d, t)(f, g) \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}mul}(d, t)(f, g) \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}neg}(d, t)(f) \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}alg-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}commutative-\allowbreak{}ring}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ev-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ev\text{-}op}(d, t)(p) = \operatorname{op\text{-}of}(d, t, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ev-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d)), \operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t), \operatorname{ev\text{-}op}(d, t)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, \operatorname{vneg}(d)(x)) = \operatorname{vneg}(d)(\operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, p, x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall f \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t)), \operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{gex} \in \operatorname{ops}(d, t).\; \operatorname{gex}(x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{ops}(d, t)), u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}act}(d, n, p, u) \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}act}(d, n, p, u), i, 1) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(p, i, k)(\operatorname{entry}(u, k, 1))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{mat-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}assoc-\allowbreak{}entry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, p, q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{ops}(d, t)), u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge (1 \leq n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}act}(d, n, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{op\text{-}alg}(d, t), p, q), u), i, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}act}(d, n, p, \operatorname{mat\text{-}act}(d, n, q, u)), i, 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(d, t, w, 1) = t(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{char-\allowbreak{}mat-\allowbreak{}kills-\allowbreak{}basis}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, n, u, t, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{mat\text{-}act}(d, n, \operatorname{mat\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ev\text{-}op}(d, t), n, n, \operatorname{transpose}(\operatorname{char\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), a, n), n, n)), u), k, 1) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}hamilton-\allowbreak{}basis}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad n = (m + 1) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, n, u, t, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{char\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), a, n), \operatorname{entry}(u, j, 1)) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cayley-\allowbreak{}hamilton}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), w \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, n, u, t, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(d, t, \operatorname{char\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), a, n), w) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}

\noindent{\small l2-families.scm -- wave of 2026-11-09/10 (agent BA-ONB2), wired 2026-11-10 from scratchpad/baonb2-1109/bo2-l2a.scm. Library: analysis.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}normed-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}carr}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag})) \simeq \mathbb{C})}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}iden}}{\vnbstmt{(\operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag})) \simeq 0)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}opr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag}))(a, b) = (a + b) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}inv}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag}))(a) = -a)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}nrm}}{\vnbstmt{\forall a \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{nrm}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag})(a) = \operatorname{magnitude}(a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}nag-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}abelian-\allowbreak{}group}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{finsum-\allowbreak{}hom-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(a, b, h) \wedge ((|s| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \in \operatorname{carr}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad h(\operatorname{finsum}(a, f, s)) = \operatorname{finsum}(b, (\lambda z \in s.\; h(f(z))), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sums-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}uniform-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, h.; \forall f \in (\operatorname{dom}(f) \to \operatorname{carr}(a)), r \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(a), \operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(b), h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{nrm}(a)(\operatorname{opr}(a)(x, \operatorname{inv}(a)(y))) < l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nrm}(b)(\operatorname{opr}(b)(h(x), \operatorname{inv}(b)(h(y)))) < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{sums\text{-}to}(a, f, r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sums\text{-}to}(b, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{dom}(f).\; h(f(z))), h(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{normed\text{-}ag\text{-}as\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}nag}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(w, a))) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{esum-\allowbreak{}real-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, f, g. \\ \quad f \in (d \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (d \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (0 \leq f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in d.\; (f(z) \leq g(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{esum}(g) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{esum}(f) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (\operatorname{esum}(f) \leq \operatorname{esum}(g)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}intro}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a, c \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((b \leq a) \wedge (b \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{q(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(f(a), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(f(c))), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(f(a), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(f(c))))} \leq s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}cauchy-\allowbreak{}elim}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{N}. \forall a, c \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((b \leq a) \wedge (b \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{q(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(f(a), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(f(c))), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(f(a), \operatorname{vneg}(d)(f(c))))} \leq s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}cseq-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall d, q.\; (\operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \simeq \operatorname{cseq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}cseq-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \end{array}}}
