\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}cseq-\allowbreak{}out}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, g) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, g)(n) = \operatorname{vadd}(d)(f(n), g(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, f) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, f)(n) = \operatorname{vneg}(d)(f(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}act}(d, a, f) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, f, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}act}(d, a, f)(n) = \operatorname{act}(d)(a, f(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}zero}(d) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}zero}(d)(n) = \operatorname{vzero}(d) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g) \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g)(n) = q(f(n), g(n)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), \operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), \operatorname{seq\text{-}act}(d, a, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}embed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{seq\text{-}zero}(d) \simeq \operatorname{embed\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), \operatorname{vzero}(d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), \operatorname{seq\text{-}zero}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}scal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{scal}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{scal}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{hcf\_}, \operatorname{hcg\_}] \in (\operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \times \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q)).\; \operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, \operatorname{hcf\_}, \operatorname{hcg\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vzero}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{seq\text{-}zero}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q)) \simeq (\lambda f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q).\; \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, f))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q)) \simeq (\lambda [\operatorname{hca\_}, \operatorname{hcf\_}] \in (\mathbb{C} \times \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q)).\; \operatorname{seq\text{-}act}(d, \operatorname{hca\_}, \operatorname{hcf\_}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}cseq-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(d)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, g) \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, f) \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}act}(d, a, f) \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seq\text{-}zero}(d) \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q))(f, g) = \operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, g) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vneg-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q))(f) = \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q))(a, f) = \operatorname{seq\text{-}act}(d, a, f) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cseq-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}module}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{seq-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}cauchy}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cauchy\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}iota}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\iota\, c.\;((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g), c))) \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\iota\, c.\;((c \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g), c)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}prop}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, g) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g), \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, g))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, g), c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, g) = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q) \in ((\operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \times \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q)) \to \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(\operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, g), h) = (\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, h) + \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(g, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, f, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(\operatorname{seq\text{-}act}(d, a, f), h) = (a \cdot \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, h)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}conjugate}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, h \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), l \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (h(j) = \operatorname{conjugate}(s(j))) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, h, \operatorname{conjugate}(l)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(g, f) = \operatorname{conjugate}(\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}diag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, f) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}psd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}psd\text{-}form}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}completion-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}cips}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}ip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}psd\text{-}form}(d, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{{d}/N_{q}} \simeq \operatorname{form\text{-}qip}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}embed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(\operatorname{embed\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), x), \operatorname{embed\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), y)) = q(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}ip}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)}(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x), \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(y)) = q(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}psd\text{-}form}(d, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}({d}/N_{q}) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, N_{q}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}psd\text{-}form}(d, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}({d}/N_{q}) \simeq \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, N_{q}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}psd\text{-}form}(d, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}({d}/N_{q}) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, N_{q}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}quotient-\allowbreak{}vneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}psd\text{-}form}(d, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vneg}({d}/N_{q}) \simeq \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, N_{q}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x), \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(\operatorname{act}(d)(a, x)) = \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(a, \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sqrt-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq x) \wedge (0 \leq y)) \Rightarrow (\lvert (\sqrt{x} - \sqrt{y}) \rvert \leq \sqrt{\lvert (x - y) \rvert}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}limit-\allowbreak{}sqrt}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq a(j)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq l \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (b(j) = \sqrt{a(j)}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, a, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, b, \sqrt{l}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{limit-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}rr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seq\text{-}form}(q, f, f), \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(f, f)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{dist-\allowbreak{}seq-\allowbreak{}limit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{dist\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), f, g), \\ \quad \quad \quad \sqrt{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)(\operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, g)), \operatorname{seq\text{-}vadd}(d, f, \operatorname{seq\text{-}vneg}(d, g)))}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}fwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, p, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q))(p, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q))(a)) \\ \quad \in\; N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cseq\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), p, a) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}bwd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, p, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{form\text{-}cseq}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cseq\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q), p, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q))(p, \operatorname{vneg}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q))(a)) \\ \quad \quad \in\; N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}rel-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qmod\text{-}rel}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)}) = \operatorname{crel}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}setoid-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}vec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{quotient}(\operatorname{cauchy\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}pts}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{completion}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}dist}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{completion}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{completion}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(x, y) = \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{completion}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q)))(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}completion-\allowbreak{}complete}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}completion-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}hilbert}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}near}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(x, \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(z)) \leq s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}dense}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)), \operatorname{image}(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q), \operatorname{vec}(d))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}isometry}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x), \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(y)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))(x, y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}injective}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x) = \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad x = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}embed-\allowbreak{}inverse}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\iota\, u.\;((u \in \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge (\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(u) = \operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x)))) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hilbert-\allowbreak{}completion-\allowbreak{}universal}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, k, t, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(k) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k))(t(x), t(y)) \leq (b \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))(x, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)), \operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (g(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x)) = t(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)), \operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (h(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(x)) = t(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad h = g \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y, u, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(d)(u, w)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))(x, u) + \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))(y, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}ms-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)}), \operatorname{form\text{-}qip}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), \operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}form}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \simeq \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cseq\text{-}module}(d, q), N_{\operatorname{limit\text{-}form}(d, q)}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(x, y) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}add-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, x, y, u, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(x, y), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(u, w)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(x, u) + \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(y, w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}additive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, m, \mathit{hcq}, t, g.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(m, \mathit{hcq}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hcx}, \mathit{hcy} \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vadd}(d)(\mathit{hcx}, \mathit{hcy})) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(t(\mathit{hcx}), t(\mathit{hcy})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)), \operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(m, \mathit{hcq}), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hcx} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (g(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(\mathit{hcx})) = t(\mathit{hcx})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(m)(g(x), g(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))(\operatorname{act}(d)(a, x), \operatorname{act}(d)(a, y)) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(d, q))(x, y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(a, x) \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}dist-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, a, x, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(a, x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(a, u)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a) \cdot \operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)))(x, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hc-\allowbreak{}ext-\allowbreak{}homogeneous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, q, m, \mathit{hcq}, t, g.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(d, q) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}form}(m, \mathit{hcq}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(d) \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hca} \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{hcx} \in \operatorname{vec}(d). \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{act}(d)(\mathit{hca}, \mathit{hcx})) = \operatorname{act}(m)(\mathit{hca}, t(\mathit{hcx})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q)), \operatorname{form\text{-}ms}(m, \mathit{hcq}), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{hcx} \in \operatorname{vec}(d).\; (g(\operatorname{hc\text{-}embed}(d, q)(\mathit{hcx})) = t(\mathit{hcx})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{hilbert\text{-}completion}(d, q))(a, x)) = \operatorname{act}(m)(a, g(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-trace-class.scm}{theorem-library/ba-trace-class.scm}
\noindent{\small bta-trace.scm -- BA-1111-A, 2026-11-11.  BanachAlgebras.pdf ch. 2 s.2-3: the Hilbert-Schmidt inner product as an inner product, HS norm of an operator diagonal in a basis (2.11), and the trace-class laws 2.13-2.23 on top of the TH3 development (th3-vocab: IS-TRACE-CLASS is Def. 2.13, T = A B with A, B Hilbert-Schmidt; ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}hs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, v, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, {s}{t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, {t}{s}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}factor}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, v, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, v, b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathrm{tr}\,{{a}{b}} = \langle {b} \mid {{a}^{*}} \rangle_{HS} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}comm-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t) \wedge (s \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathrm{tr}\,{{t}{s}} = \mathrm{tr}\,{{s}{t}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}class-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, {t}^{*}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}trace-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathrm{tr}\,{{t}^{*}} = \operatorname{conjugate}(\mathrm{tr}\,{t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}homog-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, c, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle {{c}\,{s}} \mid {t} \rangle_{HS} = (c \cdot \langle {s} \mid {t} \rangle_{HS}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}self-\allowbreak{}nonneg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle {t} \mid {t} \rangle_{HS} \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \langle {t} \mid {t} \rangle_{HS}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}zero-\allowbreak{}vanishes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t, x, e.; \forall a \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t(a) = \operatorname{vzero}(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}ip-\allowbreak{}definite}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, w, t) \wedge \\ \quad \langle {t} \mid {t} \rangle_{HS} = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t(x) = \operatorname{vzero}(w) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}pairing-\allowbreak{}nondeg-\allowbreak{}left}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s \in L({v}, {v}).\; (\mathrm{tr}\,{{s}{t}} = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad t(x) = \operatorname{vzero}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}eigenbasis}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t, x, e, \ell. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, x, e) \wedge \\ \quad \ell \in (x \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in x.\; (t(e(k)) = \operatorname{act}(v)(\ell(k), e(k))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \sum_{i \in {x}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda \mathit{kqk} \in x.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\ell(\mathit{kqk})) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(\ell(\mathit{kqk}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hs-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}compact-\allowbreak{}sa}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}op}(v, v, t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}self\text{-}adjoint\text{-}op}(v, t))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i, e, l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthonormal\text{-}basis}(v, i, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad l \in (i \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in i.\; (t(e(k)) = \operatorname{act}(v)(l(k), e(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \sum_{i \in {i}} \lVert {t} {e}_i \rVert^2 = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda \mathit{kqk} \in i.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(l(\mathit{kqk})) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}(l(\mathit{kqk}))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rank-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}hs}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}schmidt}(v, v, \langle \cdot \mid {a} \rangle {b}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{trace-\allowbreak{}pairing-\allowbreak{}nondeg-\allowbreak{}right}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall s \in L({v}, {v}), x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \forall t.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}trace\text{-}class}(v, t) \Rightarrow (\mathrm{tr}\,{{s}{t}} = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad s(x) = \operatorname{vzero}(v) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-graph-commutation.scm}{theorem-library/ba-graph-commutation.scm}
\noindent{\small btg-graphs.scm -- BA-1111-A, 2026-11-11.  BanachAlgebras.pdf ch. 3 s.5-6 for graphs (decision D4: an unbounded operator is its graph G, a subset of H x H; ba-unbdd-vocab).}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, h, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ([a, b] \in {g}{h}) \Leftrightarrow \exists y \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (([a, y] \in h) \wedge ([y, b] \in g)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [a, b] \in {{g}^{*}}{g} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad [a, z] \in g \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ([c, d] \in g) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(c, b) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(d, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutes-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge (s \in L({v}, {v})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad ([a, b] \in {{g}^{*}}{g}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad [s(a), s(b)] \in {{g}^{*}}{g} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad [a, z] \in g \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ([c, d] \in g) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(c, b) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(d, z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad [s(a), z] \in g \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ([c, d] \in g) \Rightarrow (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(c, s(b)) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(d, z)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutes-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}of}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, r, s.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad r \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad s \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad ([c, d] \in g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad ([s(c), r(d)] \in g) \wedge ([{s}^{*}(c), {r}^{*}(d)] \in g) \wedge \\ \quad [a, b] \in {{g}^{*}}{g} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [s(a), s(b)] \in {{g}^{*}}{g} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, d, f, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [a, b] \in \{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in d) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) = f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; (a \in d) \wedge (b = f(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}operator-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, d, q, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (b \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad ([a, b] \in T_{q}) \Leftrightarrow ((a \in d) \wedge \forall x \in d.\; (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, b) = q(x, a))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{graph-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {g}{h} \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{form-\allowbreak{}operator-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, d, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad T_{q} \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adjoint-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}operator-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}iff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, d, f, c, \delta. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad d \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (d \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \delta \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [c, \delta] \\ \quad \quad \in\; {{\{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in d) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) = f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\}}^{*}}{\{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in d) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) = f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\}} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; [c, \delta] \\ \quad \quad \in\; T_{(\lambda [\operatorname{bgx\_}, \operatorname{bgy\_}] \in (d \times d).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(f(\operatorname{bgx\_}), f(\operatorname{bgy\_})))} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adjoint-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}operator-\allowbreak{}pointwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, d, f.; \forall c, \mathit{ugd} \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((d \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (f \in (d \to \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad [c, \mathit{ugd}] \\ \quad \quad \in\; {{\{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in d) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) = f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\}}^{*}}{\{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in d) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) = f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\}} \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; [c, \mathit{ugd}] \\ \quad \quad \in\; T_{(\lambda [\operatorname{bgx\_}, \operatorname{bgy\_}] \in (d \times d).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(f(\operatorname{bgx\_}), f(\operatorname{bgy\_})))} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{adjoint-\allowbreak{}compose-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}operator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, d, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((d \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (f \in (d \to \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {{\{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in d) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) = f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\}}^{*}}{\{p \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) : ((\operatorname{nth}(1, p) \in d) \wedge (\operatorname{nth}(2, p) = f(\operatorname{nth}(1, p))))\}} \\ \quad \quad =\; T_{(\lambda [\operatorname{bgx\_}, \operatorname{bgy\_}] \in (d \times d).\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(f(\operatorname{bgx\_}), f(\operatorname{bgy\_})))} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba4-sqrt.scm}{theorem-library/ba4-sqrt.scm}
\noindent{\small ba4-sqrt.scm -- 1 - y IS A SQUARE for ||y|| $<$ 1, by iteration (the square root behind Prop 4.7). Agent BA-1111-B, 2026-11-11.  Destination: theorem-library/ba4-sqrt.scm.  Library: operator-algebras. Load window: after structure-library/ba-rep-vocab (HALF-SQ-ITER), theorem-library/kal-laws, ba-laws, ba-elem ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{g4s-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{half\text{-}sq\text{-}iter}(a, y, n) \in \operatorname{vec}(a)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{g4s-\allowbreak{}contract}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y, u, w \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, \cdot_{a}(u, u))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, \cdot_{a}(w, w)))))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (1/2 \cdot (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(u) + \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(w))) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(u, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(w))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{g4s-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y) < 1) \wedge (s = (1/2 \cdot (1 + \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{half\text{-}sq\text{-}iter}(a, y, n)) \leq s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{g4s-\allowbreak{}iter-\allowbreak{}incr}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), s \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y) < 1) \wedge (s = (1/2 \cdot (1 + \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{half\text{-}sq\text{-}iter}(a, y, n), \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{half\text{-}sq\text{-}iter}(a, y, (n + 1))))) \leq \operatorname{power}(s, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{half-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}fixed-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(z) < 1) \wedge (z = \operatorname{act}(a)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, \cdot_{a}(z, z)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{half-\allowbreak{}sq-\allowbreak{}fixed-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y, u, w \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(u) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad u = \operatorname{act}(a)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, \cdot_{a}(u, u))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(w) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad w = \operatorname{act}(a)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(y, \cdot_{a}(w, w))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u = w \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{one-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}square}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\cdot_{a}(b, b) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uiba-\allowbreak{}one-\allowbreak{}minus-\allowbreak{}sa-\allowbreak{}square}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (({}^{*_{a}}(y) = y) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(y) < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad ({}^{*_{a}}(b) = b) \wedge (\cdot_{a}(b, b) = \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(y))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba4-pos.scm}{theorem-library/ba4-pos.scm}
\noindent{\small ba4-pos.scm -- POSITIVE FUNCTIONALS: BanachAlgebras.pdf Lemma 4.4, Corollary 4.6. Agent BA-1111-B, 2026-11-11.  Destination: theorem-library/ba4-pos.scm.  Library: operator-algebras. Load window: after structure-library/ba-rep-vocab (this wave), theorem-library/kal-laws (the law set kal-uiba of dk-alg-norm!), ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}conj-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), y)) = \operatorname{conjugate}(f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x))) \end{array}}}
