\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}sesquilinear}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(z), \operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y))) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(z), x)) + f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(z), y)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), \operatorname{act}(a)(c, x))) = (c \cdot f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), y)) = \operatorname{conjugate}(f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad (f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}hermitian}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f({}^{*_{a}}(x)) = \operatorname{conjugate}(f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}expand-\allowbreak{}two}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r, s \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(a)(s, y))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(r, x), \operatorname{act}(a)(s, y)))) \\ \quad \quad =\; ((((\operatorname{conjugate}(r) \cdot r) \cdot f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x))) + ((\operatorname{conjugate}(r) \cdot s) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x))))) + ((\operatorname{conjugate}(s) \cdot r) \cdot f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x)))) + ((\operatorname{conjugate}(s) \cdot s) \cdot f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}schwarz}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x)) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), y)) \cdot f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}schwarz-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(f(x))) \leq (f(1_{a}) \cdot f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (f(1_{a}) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq f(1_{a})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}ball}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x)) \leq f(1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}ball-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq f(1_{a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (f(1_{a}) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (f \in \operatorname{cdual\text{-}vec}(a)) \wedge (\operatorname{cdual\text{-}norm}(a, f) = f(1_{a})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}sandwich}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, (\lambda u \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; f(\cdot_{a}(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), u), y)))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}sandwich-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(\cdot_{a}(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), x), y))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \cdot f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(y), y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uiba-\allowbreak{}vnrm-\allowbreak{}real}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{uiba-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}le}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x)) \leq (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v, p.; \forall e \in \operatorname{vec}(v), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}representation}(a, v, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f_{{p},{e}}(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(p(x)(e), e) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}positive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v, p.; \forall e \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}representation}(a, v, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f_{{p},{e}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}norm}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v, p.; \forall e \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}representation}(a, v, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f_{{p},{e}} \in \operatorname{cdual\text{-}vec}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cdual\text{-}norm}(a, f_{{p},{e}}) = (\lVert e \rVert \cdot \lVert e \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}square}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v, p.; \forall e \in \operatorname{vec}(v), x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}representation}(a, v, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f_{{p},{e}}(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(x), x)) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(p(x)(e), p(x)(e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}functional-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, v, p.; \forall e \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}representation}(a, v, p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f_{{p},{e}}(1_{a}) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(e, e) \end{array}}}

\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u, w \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(u), w) \\ \quad \quad =\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)}(u, \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, {}^{*_{a}}(x))(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, \cdot_{a}(x, y))(u) = \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(\operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, y)(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}unit}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, 1_{a})(u) = u \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(u), \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(u)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)}(u, u) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)) \simeq \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}module}(a), N_{\operatorname{gns\text{-}form}(a, f)}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)) \simeq \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}module}(a), N_{\operatorname{gns\text{-}form}(a, f)}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}vadd-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall b, c \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}setoid}(a, f), b), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}setoid}(a, f), c)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}setoid}(a, f), \operatorname{vadd}(a)(b, c)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}pre-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}computes}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, b \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(c, \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}setoid}(a, f), b)) = \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}setoid}(a, f), \operatorname{act}(a)(c, b)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}vadd}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u, w \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(\operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(u, w)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(\operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(u), \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}act}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(\operatorname{act}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(c, u)) = \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(c, \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y))(u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(\operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(u), \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, y)(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, \operatorname{act}(a)(c, x))(u) = \operatorname{act}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f))(c, \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(u)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{gns-\allowbreak{}matrix-\allowbreak{}coeff}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{\operatorname{gns\text{-}pre}(a, f)}(\operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, x)(\operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, y)(\operatorname{gns\text{-}vector}(a, f))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{gns\text{-}op}(a, f, z)(\operatorname{gns\text{-}vector}(a, f))) \\ \quad \quad =\; f(\cdot_{a}({}^{*_{a}}(z), \cdot_{a}(x, y))) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba4-states.scm}{theorem-library/ba4-states.scm}
\noindent{\small ba4-states.scm -- STATES: BanachAlgebras.pdf Corollary 4.9 (states have norm 1), the convexity of Sigma(A) and "a pure state is an extreme point" (Proposition 4.24, first half of its proof). Agent BA-1111-B, 2026-11-11.  Destination: theorem-library/ba4-states.scm.  Library: operator-algebras. Load window: after ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{states-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad (\Sigma({a}) \simeq \{f \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{C}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f) \wedge (f(1_{a}) = 1))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}combo}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, g, h.; \forall b, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, h) \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq b \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, (\lambda w \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; ((b \cdot g(w)) + (c \cdot h(w))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{states-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall g \in \Sigma({a}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (g \in \operatorname{cdual\text{-}vec}(a)) \wedge (\operatorname{cdual\text{-}norm}(a, g) = 1) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{states-\allowbreak{}convex}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall g, h \in \Sigma({a}), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((0 \leq r) \wedge (r \leq 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; ((r \cdot g(w)) + ((1 - r) \cdot h(w)))) \in \Sigma({a}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pure-\allowbreak{}state-\allowbreak{}extreme}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall g, h \in \Sigma({a}), r \in \mathbb{R}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pure\text{-}state}(a, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (f(y) = ((r \cdot g(y)) + ((1 - r) \cdot h(y)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (g(x) = f(x)) \wedge (h(x) = f(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lf-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}positive}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{functional\text{-}le}(a, g, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, (\lambda w \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (f(w) + (-1 \cdot g(w))))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pos-\allowbreak{}lf-\allowbreak{}vanish}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}lf}(a, f) \wedge (f(1_{a}) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(x) = 0 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{extreme-\allowbreak{}state-\allowbreak{}pure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall f \in \Sigma({a}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g, h \in \Sigma({a}), r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge ((r < 1) \wedge \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (f(y) = ((r \cdot g(y)) + ((1 - r) \cdot h(y)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad g(z) = f(z) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pure\text{-}state}(a, f) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/tvs-sub-bound.scm}{theorem-library/tvs-sub-bound.scm}
\noindent{\small tvs-sub-bound.scm -- continuity from seminorm bounds for a map that is only ADDITIVE in the sense tt(a - b) = tt(a) - tt(b), not linear.  The copies of sn-bound-combine / sn-cont-of-bound (tvs-continuity.scm) and sn-cont-of-single-bound (tvs-single-bound.scm) with the hypothesis IS-LINEAR-MAP(m1, m2, tt) replaced by ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}combine-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t.; \forall g \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{sba}, \mathit{sbb} \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\mathit{sba}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\mathit{sbb}))) = \operatorname{vadd}(b)(t(\mathit{sba}), \operatorname{vneg}(b)(t(\mathit{sbb}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \\ \quad |g| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq x_{2} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in g, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{sba}, \mathit{sbb} \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\mathit{sba}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\mathit{sbb}))) = \operatorname{vadd}(b)(t(\mathit{sba}), \operatorname{vneg}(b)(t(\mathit{sbb}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}single-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad t \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{sba}, \mathit{sbb} \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad t(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\mathit{sba}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\mathit{sbb}))) = \operatorname{vadd}(b)(t(\mathit{sba}), \operatorname{vneg}(b)(t(\mathit{sbb}))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists i \in x_{1}, c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq c) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{f1}(i)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t.; \forall j \in x_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sn-\allowbreak{}cont-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}bound-\allowbreak{}cc}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-optop-adjoint.scm}{theorem-library/ba-optop-adjoint.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-optop-adjoint.scm -- Thayer, Banach Algebras and Applications, Prop 5.11, third clause: S |-$>$ S* is continuous for the weak operator topology.  The proof is the notes': p\_(xi,eta)(S*) = |$<$S* xi | eta$>$| = |$<$xi | S eta$>$| = |$<$S eta | xi$>$| = p\_(eta,xi)(S), with the seminorm continuity condition for a map that is only ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{op-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}neg}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {-{t}}^{*} = -{{t}^{*}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}^{*}) \in (\operatorname{vec}(L({v})) \to \operatorname{vec}(L({v}))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bh-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}map-\allowbreak{}sub}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{vec}(L({v})). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}^{*})(\operatorname{vadd}(L({v}))(a, \operatorname{vneg}(L({v}))(b))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{vadd}(L({v}))((\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}^{*})(a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(L({v}))((\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}^{*})(b))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}adjoint-\allowbreak{}wot-\allowbreak{}continuous}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{w}, L({v})_{w}, (\lambda s \in L({v}, {v}).\; {s}^{*})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strong-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}unfold-\allowbreak{}sot}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad (L_{\bullet}({v}) \simeq \{f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to \mathbb{C}) : (\operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(L({v}), \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}module}, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{s}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}top}, f))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (L({v})_{s} \simeq \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(L({v}), \operatorname{vec}(v), \operatorname{sot\text{-}pf}(v)))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{strong-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (f \in L_{\bullet}({v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sbf} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |\mathit{sbf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{sbf} \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in L({v}, {v}), t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge \forall i \in \mathit{sbf}.\; (\lVert x(i) \rVert \leq t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (c \cdot t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{wot-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad (L({v})_{w} \simeq \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(L({v}), (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)), \operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{weak-\allowbreak{}dual-\allowbreak{}bound}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (f \in \operatorname{weak\text{-}dual}(v))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sbf} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |\mathit{sbf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{sbf} \subseteq (\operatorname{vec}(v) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in L({v}, {v}), t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge \forall i \in \mathit{sbf}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x(\operatorname{nth}(1, i)), \operatorname{nth}(2, i))) \leq t)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (c \cdot t) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-vn.scm}{theorem-library/ba-vn.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-vn.scm -- Thayer, Banach Algebras and Applications, chapter 6: commutants and bicommutants, the strong closedness of a commutant (Thm 6.1, first half), the one-vector core of the bicommutant theorem (T xi in the closure of A xi for T in A''), the commutant of a self-adjoint set as a von Neumann algebra, Prop 6.8 ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutant-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad ({s}' \simeq \{t \in L({v}, {v}) : \forall a \in s.\; ({t}{a} = {a}{t})\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bicommutant-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v, s.\; ({s}'' \simeq {{s}'}')}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutant-\allowbreak{}membership}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad t \in {s}' \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; ((t \in L({v}, {v})) \wedge \forall a \in s.\; ({t}{a} = {a}{t})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{subset-\allowbreak{}bicommutant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad s \subseteq {s}'' \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyclic-\allowbreak{}commutant-\allowbreak{}separating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, {s}', i) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, s, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cc-\allowbreak{}conjugate-\allowbreak{}zero}}{\vnbstmt{\operatorname{conjugate}(0) = 0}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{separating-\allowbreak{}commutant-\allowbreak{}cyclic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, {s}', i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, s, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutant-\allowbreak{}subset-\allowbreak{}bo}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}' \subseteq L({v}, {v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyclic-\allowbreak{}superset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t, i. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, s, i)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, t, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{separating-\allowbreak{}subset}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, t, i. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq t) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, t, i)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, s, i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cyclic-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}commutant-\allowbreak{}separating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, s, i) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, {s}', i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutant-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \subseteq L({v}, {v})) \wedge \forall a \in s.\; ({a}^{*} \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, {s}') \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{separating-\allowbreak{}iff-\allowbreak{}commutant-\allowbreak{}cyclic}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge ({s}'' = s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, s, i) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, {s}', i) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutant-\allowbreak{}sot-\allowbreak{}closed}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(L({v})_{s}, {s}') \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{commutant-\allowbreak{}von-\allowbreak{}neumann}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \subseteq L({v}, {v})) \wedge \forall a \in s.\; ({a}^{*} \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}von\text{-}neumann\text{-}algebra}(v, {s}') \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bicommutant-\allowbreak{}von-\allowbreak{}neumann}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \subseteq L({v}, {v})) \wedge \forall a \in s.\; ({a}^{*} \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}von\text{-}neumann\text{-}algebra}(v, {s}'') \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{von-\allowbreak{}neumann-\allowbreak{}of-\allowbreak{}bicommutant-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge ({s}'' = s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}von\text{-}neumann\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{orbit-\allowbreak{}projection-\allowbreak{}commutant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, \{m \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \exists b \in s.\; (m = b(i))\}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad E_{{\{m \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \exists b \in s.\; (m = b(i))\}}^{\perp}} \in {s}' \wedge \\ \quad \quad E_{{\{m \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \exists b \in s.\; (m = b(i))\}}^{\perp}}(i) = \operatorname{vzero}(v) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bicommutant-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, i, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (t \in {s}'')))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad t(i) \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \{m \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \exists b \in s.\; (m = b(i))\}) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-amp.scm}{theorem-library/ba-amp.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-amp.scm -- Thayer, Banach Algebras and Applications, ch. 6: von Neumann's bicommutant theorem (Theorem 6.1) by amplification, and Corollary 6.9 for a von Neumann algebra. Part A  the injections, projections and diagonal operators of the Hilbert direct sum HSUM(w, v), their values and bounds; composites of bounded ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}vec-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vec}({w} \oplus {v}) = (\operatorname{vec}(w) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{cips-\allowbreak{}act-\allowbreak{}vzero}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(v)(c, \operatorname{vzero}(v)) = \operatorname{vzero}(v)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}in1-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_1(x) = [x, \operatorname{vzero}(v)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}in2-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_2(y) = [\operatorname{vzero}(w), y] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}pr1-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \pi_1([x, y]) = x \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}pr2-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \pi_2([x, y]) = y \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {a} \oplus {b}([x, y]) = [a(x), b(y)] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}split}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad [x, y] = \operatorname{vadd}({w} \oplus {v})([x, \operatorname{vzero}(v)], [\operatorname{vzero}(w), y]) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}pair-\allowbreak{}sq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert [a, b] \rVert \cdot \lVert [a, b] \rVert \\ \quad \quad =\; (\lVert a \rVert \cdot \lVert a \rVert) + (\lVert b \rVert \cdot \lVert b \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert a \rVert \leq \lVert [a, b] \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert b \rVert \leq \lVert [a, b] \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}le-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert [a, b] \rVert \leq (\lVert a \rVert + \lVert b \rVert) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}apply-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, s, t, x. \\ \quad ((t \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(b))) \wedge ((s \in (\operatorname{vec}(b) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}{t}(x) = s(t(x)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}in1-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_1 \in L({w}, {{w} \oplus {v}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}in2-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_2 \in L({v}, {{w} \oplus {v}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}pr1-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \pi_1 \in L({{w} \oplus {v}}, {w}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}pr2-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \pi_2 \in L({{w} \oplus {v}}, {v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bop-\allowbreak{}comp-\allowbreak{}bounded-\allowbreak{}gen}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(c) \wedge \\ \quad t \in L({a}, {b}) \wedge \\ \quad s \in L({b}, {c}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {s}{t} \in L({a}, {c}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in L({w}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in L({v}, {v}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {a} \oplus {b} \in L({{w} \oplus {v}}, {{w} \oplus {v}}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}pr1-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \pi_1(p) = \operatorname{nth}(1, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}pr2-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \pi_2(p) = \operatorname{nth}(2, p) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}value}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \to \operatorname{vec}(w)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in (\operatorname{vec}(w) \times \operatorname{vec}(v)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {a} \oplus {b}(p) = [a(\operatorname{nth}(1, p)), b(\operatorname{nth}(2, p))] \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{id-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.; \forall t \in L({v}, {v}).\; (\mathrm{id}(t) = t)}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amp-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}apply}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, f.; \forall t \in L({v}, {v}). \\ \quad ({f} \oplus \mathrm{id}(t) \simeq {f(t)} \oplus {t}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{id-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \mathrm{id} \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({v}, {v})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amp-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}type}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({w}, {w})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {f} \oplus \mathrm{id} \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({{w} \oplus {v}}, {{w} \oplus {v}})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{intertwined-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}intertwined}(v, v, \mathrm{id}, \mathrm{id}, v, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{intertwined-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}codomain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, w, v, f, r, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({w}, {w})) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({u}, {u})) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}intertwined}(u, w, r, f, v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}intertwined}(u, v, r, \mathrm{id}, v, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}intertwined}(u, {w} \oplus {v}, r, {f} \oplus \mathrm{id}, v, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{intertwined-\allowbreak{}split-\allowbreak{}domain}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, u, f, r, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({w}, {w})) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({u}, {u})) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}intertwined}(w, u, f, r, v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}intertwined}(v, u, \mathrm{id}, r, v, s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}intertwined}({w} \oplus {v}, u, {f} \oplus \mathrm{id}, r, v, s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}sum}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in L({w}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in L({w}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad d \in L({v}, {v}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {{a} \oplus {b}} + {{c} \oplus {d}} \\ \quad \quad =\; {{a} + {c}} \oplus {{b} + {d}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}scale}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in L({w}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{C} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {k}\,{{a} \oplus {b}} \\ \quad \quad =\; {{k}\,{a}} \oplus {{k}\,{b}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}comp}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in L({w}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in L({w}, {w}) \wedge \\ \quad d \in L({v}, {v}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad {{a} \oplus {b}}{{c} \oplus {d}} \\ \quad \quad =\; {{a}{c}} \oplus {{b}{d}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}id}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {1} \oplus {1} = 1 \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{hsum-\allowbreak{}diag-\allowbreak{}adjoint}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((a \in L({w}, {w})) \wedge (b \in L({v}, {v}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {{a} \oplus {b}}^{*} \\ \quad \quad =\; {{a}^{*}} \oplus {{b}^{*}} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{id-\allowbreak{}rep-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}rep}(v, v, \mathrm{id}))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amp-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}rep}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}rep}(v, w, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}rep}(v, {w} \oplus {v}, {f} \oplus \mathrm{id}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amplification-\allowbreak{}base}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, v, \mathrm{id}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amplification-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, w, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((s \subseteq L({v}, {v})) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, w, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, {w} \oplus {v}, {f} \oplus \mathrm{id}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, f, s. \\ \quad ({f}({s}) \simeq \{b \in L({w}, {w}) : \exists t \in s.\; (b = f(t))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}star-\allowbreak{}algebra}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, w, f, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(w) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}rep}(v, w, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(w, {f}({s})) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{rep-\allowbreak{}image-\allowbreak{}bicommutant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, w, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, w, f) \wedge \\ \quad t \in {s}'' \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(t) \in {{f}({s})}'' \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amp-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}1}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, f, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({w}, {w})) \wedge \\ \quad a \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(w)(f(a)(c), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(f(b)(c))) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \lVert \operatorname{vadd}({w} \oplus {v})({f} \oplus \mathrm{id}(a)([c, d]), \operatorname{vneg}({w} \oplus {v})({f} \oplus \mathrm{id}(b)([c, d]))) \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amp-\allowbreak{}step-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}ge-\allowbreak{}2}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w, v, f, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (L({v}, {v}) \to L({w}, {w})) \wedge \\ \quad a \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a(d), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b(d))) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \lVert \operatorname{vadd}({w} \oplus {v})({f} \oplus \mathrm{id}(a)([c, d]), \operatorname{vneg}({w} \oplus {v})({f} \oplus \mathrm{id}(b)([c, d]))) \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amp-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}step}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, w, f, x, u, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, w, f) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad u \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b \in L({v}, {v}), y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a(y), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b(y))) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(w)(f(a)(x), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(f(b)(x))) \rVert \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{cqw}, \mathit{cqf} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, \mathit{cqw}, \mathit{cqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{cqx} \in \operatorname{vec}(\mathit{cqw}). \forall a, b \in L({v}, {v}), y \in (u \cup \{z\}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a(y), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b(y))) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(\mathit{cqw})(\operatorname{cqf}(a)(\mathit{cqx}), \operatorname{vneg}(\mathit{cqw})(\operatorname{cqf}(b)(\mathit{cqx}))) \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{amp-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}exists}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |g| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists w, f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, w, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(w). \forall a, b \in L({v}, {v}), y \in g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a(y), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b(y))) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(w)(f(a)(x), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(f(b)(x))) \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bicommutant-\allowbreak{}approx-\allowbreak{}at}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, w, f, x, g, t, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}amplification}(v, s, w, f) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(w) \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cqa}, b \in L({v}, {v}), y \in g. \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\operatorname{cqa}(y), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(b(y))) \rVert \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(w)(f(\mathit{cqa})(x), \operatorname{vneg}(w)(f(b)(x))) \rVert \wedge \\ \quad t \in {s}'' \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{cqa} \in s. \forall y \in g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(t(y), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cqa}(y))) \rVert < a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bicommutant-\allowbreak{}finite-\allowbreak{}approx}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, g, t, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad |g| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad t \in {s}'' \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{cqa} \in s. \forall y \in g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(t(y), \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cqa}(y))) \rVert < a \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{ip-\allowbreak{}norm-\allowbreak{}diff-\allowbreak{}sym}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)) \rVert = \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(y, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)) \rVert \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}unfold}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, a. \\ \quad (\overline{a} \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(q) : \forall u \in \operatorname{opens}(q).\; ((x \in u) \Rightarrow \exists y \in a.\; (y \in u))\}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sot-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}bicommutant}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (s \subseteq L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \overline{s} \subseteq {s}'' \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bicommutant-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}sot-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}'' \subseteq \overline{s} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bicommutant-\allowbreak{}is-\allowbreak{}sot-\allowbreak{}closure}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}op\text{-}algebra}(v, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}'' = \overline{s} \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{top-\allowbreak{}closure-\allowbreak{}closed-\allowbreak{}mem}}{\vnbstmt{\forall q, a, x.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(q, a) \wedge (x \in \overline{a})) \Rightarrow (x \in a))}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{von-\allowbreak{}neumann-\allowbreak{}bicommutant-\allowbreak{}eq}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}von\text{-}neumann\text{-}algebra}(v, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad {s}'' = s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{von-\allowbreak{}neumann-\allowbreak{}cyclic-\allowbreak{}separating}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}von\text{-}neumann\text{-}algebra}(v, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, s, i) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, {s}', i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}for}(v, s, i) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}for}(v, {s}', i) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ba-sesq.scm}{theorem-library/ba-sesq.scm}
\noindent{\small ba-sesq.scm -- Thayer, Banach Algebras and Applications, ch. 5 (used for 5.10): a bounded sesquilinear form on a Hilbert space is $<$S x | y$>$ for a unique bounded operator S.  The form is CURRIED, bf in FUN(VEC v, FUN(VEC v, CC)), linear in its first and conjugate-linear in its second argument. Route: for each y, x |-$>$ ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{sesq-\allowbreak{}riesz-\allowbreak{}point}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, c, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, \mathit{bsy} \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b))(\mathit{bsy}) = (f(a)(\mathit{bsy}) + f(b)(\mathit{bsy})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, a, \mathit{bsy} \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{act}(v)(k, a))(\mathit{bsy}) = (k \cdot f(a)(\mathit{bsy})) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, \mathit{bsy} \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a)(\mathit{bsy})) \leq (c \cdot (\lVert a \rVert \cdot \lVert \mathit{bsy} \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x)(y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sesq-\allowbreak{}riesz-\allowbreak{}map}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b))(y) = (f(a)(y) + f(b)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{act}(v)(k, a))(y) = (k \cdot f(a)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a)(y)) \leq (c \cdot (\lVert a \rVert \cdot \lVert y \rVert)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \forall y, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(x)(y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, r(y)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{sesq-\allowbreak{}riesz-\allowbreak{}bounded}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, c, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b))(y) = (f(a)(y) + f(b)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{act}(v)(k, a))(y) = (k \cdot f(a)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a)(y)) \leq (c \cdot (\lVert a \rVert \cdot \lVert y \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, y)) = (f(a)(b) + f(a)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(a)(\operatorname{act}(v)(k, y)) = (\operatorname{conjugate}(k) \cdot f(a)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad r \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y, x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x)(y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, r(y))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad r \in L({v}, {v}) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}sesquilinear-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}operator}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b))(y) = (f(a)(y) + f(b)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{act}(v)(k, a))(y) = (k \cdot f(a)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a)(y)) \leq (c \cdot (\lVert a \rVert \cdot \lVert y \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, y)) = (f(a)(b) + f(a)(y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, a, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad f(a)(\operatorname{act}(v)(k, y)) = (\operatorname{conjugate}(k) \cdot f(a)(y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in L({v}, {v}). \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(x)(y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(s(x), y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{bounded-\allowbreak{}sesquilinear-\allowbreak{}form-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, s_{1}, s_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \mathbb{C})) \wedge \\ \quad s_{1} \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad s_{2} \in L({v}, {v}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x)(y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{s1}(x), y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x)(y) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{s2}(x), y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad s_{1} = s_{2} \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4e-unif0.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4e-unif0.scm}
