\vnbentry{\texttt{pem-\allowbreak{}mvag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r)) \simeq \operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pem-\allowbreak{}mult-\allowbreak{}hom}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall t \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r), \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r), (\lambda y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, y))) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pem-\allowbreak{}iter}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall t, y \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{op\text{-}iter}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r), (\lambda a \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, a)), y, k) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(r, t, k), y) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{pem-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}op-\allowbreak{}one}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall t \in \operatorname{carr}(r), p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(r)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}op}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(r), (\lambda y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, y)), p, \operatorname{one}(r)) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(r, p, t) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}mul}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall t \in \operatorname{carr}(r), p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(r)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(r, \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(r))(p, q), t) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(r, p, t), \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(r, q, t)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4f-digits.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4f-digits.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4f-digits.scm -- THE DIGIT MAP AND THE COORDINATE MAP ARE FUNCTIONS (CCR-1111 finding F1), and lifts of a matrix of residue classes.  Agent CCR-1111B, 2026-11-11.  Destination: theorem-library/ccr4f-digits.scm. Helper prefix nd6-.  Library: analysis (the 4.17 hypotheses; the setoid and matrix lemmas are core / ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}digits-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}digits}(k, w, p, x) \in (\mathbb{Z} \to p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, \operatorname{nv\text{-}digits}(k, w, p, x), n, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}digits-\allowbreak{}unique}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k), b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b = \operatorname{nv\text{-}digits}(k, w, p, x) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}digits-\allowbreak{}fun}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; \operatorname{nv\text{-}digits}(k, w, p, x)) \in (\operatorname{carr}(k) \to (\mathbb{Z} \to p)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{lin-\allowbreak{}coords-\allowbreak{}spec}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, d, u, p.; \forall c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, d, p), r. \\ \quad \forall c_{1}, c_{2} \in \operatorname{mat}(1, d, p). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{lincomb}(m, d, c_{1}, u) = \operatorname{lincomb}(m, d, c_{2}, u)) \Rightarrow (c_{1} = c_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad r = \operatorname{lincomb}(m, d, c, u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lin\text{-}coords}(m, d, u, p, r) = c \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{setoid-\allowbreak{}lift-\allowbreak{}matrix}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall m, q \in \mathbb{N}, e \in \operatorname{mat}(m, q, \operatorname{quotient}(s)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}setoid}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, q, \operatorname{pts}(s)). \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, q). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(s, \operatorname{entry}(b, i, j)) = \operatorname{entry}(e, i, j) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4f-poly.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4f-poly.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4f-poly.scm -- POLYNOMIALS EVALUATED IN A NORMED FIELD, AND THE SUBFIELD GENERATED BY ONE ELEMENT AS QUOTIENTS OF THEIR VALUES (CCR-1111 finding F2).  Agent CCR-1111B, 2026-11-11. Destination: theorem-library/ccr4f-poly.scm.  Helper prefix fp7-.  Library: analysis (normed fields); the first two lemmas are algebra ...}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{monalg-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, s.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m), x \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(a) \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in s.\; (\operatorname{add}(a)(u, v) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in s.\; (\operatorname{mul}(a)(u, v) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (f(y) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (g(y) \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(a, m, f, g)(x) \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{poly-\allowbreak{}mul-\allowbreak{}coef-\allowbreak{}in}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s.; \forall f, g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(a)), x \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zero}(a) \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in s.\; (\operatorname{add}(a)(u, v) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in s.\; (\operatorname{mul}(a)(u, v) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(y) \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(y) \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(a))(f, g)(x) \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}poly-\allowbreak{}eval-\allowbreak{}in-\allowbreak{}subfield}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall w \in s, p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge \forall y \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(y) \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p, w) \in s \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}rat-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}subfield}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, b.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, \operatorname{nf\text{-}rat\text{-}at}(k, b, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}rat-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}contains}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, b.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in b.\; (z \in \operatorname{nf\text{-}rat\text{-}at}(k, b, w)) \wedge (w \in \operatorname{nf\text{-}rat\text{-}at}(k, b, w)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}rat-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}least}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, b, s.; \forall w \in s, x \in \operatorname{nf\text{-}rat\text{-}at}(k, b, w). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, b) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge \forall z \in b.\; (z \in s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in s \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4g-coords.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4g-coords.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4g-coords.scm -- LINCOMB AS A SUM-AG, and the REARRANGEMENT of a series of linear combinations by coordinates (CCR 4.24, GENERATES half; brief CCR-1111C target 1).  Agent CCR-1111C, 2026-11-11. Destination: theorem-library/ccr4g-coords.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix cg1-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{lincomb-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}ptwise}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))), u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathrm{OS}(n). \\ \quad \quad (g(i) \simeq \operatorname{act}(d)(\operatorname{entry}(c, 1, (i + 1)), \operatorname{entry}(u, (i + 1), 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(d, n, c, u) = \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(d), g, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}subfield-\allowbreak{}module-\allowbreak{}vector-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{module\text{-}vector\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}module}(k, s)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}ag}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, s), u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(k)), g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathrm{OS}(n). \\ \quad \quad (g(i) \simeq \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{entry}(c, 1, (i + 1)), \operatorname{entry}(u, (i + 1), 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}module}(k, s), n, c, u) = \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(k), g, n) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}ring-\allowbreak{}additive-\allowbreak{}ag-\allowbreak{}view}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)) \simeq \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(k)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nf-\allowbreak{}series-\allowbreak{}lincomb-\allowbreak{}swap}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, s.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{carr}(k)), e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{mat}(1, n, s)), r \in \operatorname{mat}(1, n, s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda m \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(k), (\lambda \mathit{cgk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{entry}(e(\mathit{cgk}), 1, j)), m)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(r, 1, j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda m \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(k), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{cgk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}module}(k, s), n, e(\mathit{cgk}), b)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad m)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{lincomb}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}subfield\text{-}module}(k, s), n, r, b)) \end{array}}}

\vnbfile{theorem-library/ccr4g-residue.scm}{theorem-library/ccr4g-residue.scm}
\noindent{\small ccr4g-residue.scm -- THE LEADING TERM OF A POLYNOMIAL VALUE, and THE RESIDUE OF F(w) MEET A IS F (CCR 4.24, REL-FREE half; brief CCR-1111C target 2).  Agent CCR-1111C, 2026-11-11. Destination: theorem-library/ccr4g-residue.scm.  Library: analysis.  Helper prefix cg2-.}\par
\vnbentry{\texttt{rr-\allowbreak{}power-\allowbreak{}strict}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{R}, s, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((0 < x) \wedge ((x < 1) \wedge (s < n))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{power}(x, n) < \operatorname{power}(x, s)) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}sum-\allowbreak{}leading}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, k, f, w, a, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in f.\; (x \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in f.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad w \in \operatorname{carr}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(j) \in f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (g(j) \simeq \operatorname{mul}(k)(a(j), \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, j))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(k), g, n) = \operatorname{zero}(k) \vee \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \mathbb{N}, c \in f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (c = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad s < n \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(k), g, n), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{neg}(k)(\operatorname{mul}(k)(c, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, s))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad <\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w), s) \end{array}}}
\vnbentry{\texttt{nv-\allowbreak{}rat-\allowbreak{}at-\allowbreak{}residue}}{\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, f.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k), y \in \operatorname{nf\text{-}rat\text{-}at}(k, f, w). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in f.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq 1) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y) \leq 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in f.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(y, \operatorname{neg}(k)(c))) < 1) \end{array}}}
